devi/dasamahavidya/02_bagalamukhi_kavaca.ityetat kavacaṁ divyaṁ dharmakāmārthasād: ity-etat kavacaṁ divyaṁ dharma-kāmārtha-sādhanam | gopanīyaṁ prayatnena kasyacin-na prakāśayet ||
devi/dasamahavidya/02_bagalamukhi_kavaca.yaḥ sakṛcchṛṇuyādetat kavacaṁ manmukhodi: yaḥ sakṛcchṛṇuyād-etat kavacaṁ man-mukhoditam | sa sarvān labhate kāmān mūrkho vidyām-avāpnuyāt | tasyāśu śatravo yānti yamasya bhavane śive ||

devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.oṅkārarūpiṇī devi viśuddhasattvarūpiṇī |: oṅkāra-rūpiṇī devi viśuddha-sattva-rūpiṇī | devānāṁ jananī tvaṁ hi prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.tanmātraṁ caiva bhūtāni tava vakṣaḥsthal: tanmātraṁ caiva bhūtāni tava vakṣaḥ-sthalaṁ smṛtam | tvam-eva veda-gamyā tu prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.lokātītā dvaitātītā samastabhūtaveṣṭitā: lokātītā dvaitātītā samasta-bhūta-veṣṭitā | vidvaj-jana-kīrtitā ca prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.paripūrṇā sadā lakṣmi trātrī tu śaraṇārt: paripūrṇā sadā lakṣmi trātrī tu śaraṇārthiṣu | viśvādyā viśva-kartrī ca prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.brahmarūpā ca sāvitrī tvaddīptyā bhāsate: brahma-rūpā ca sāvitrī tvad-dīptyā bhāsate jagat | viśvarūpā vareṇyā ca prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.caṇḍī durgā kālikā ca kauśikī siddhirūpi: caṇḍī durgā kālikā ca kauśikī siddhi-rūpiṇī | yoginī yoga-gamyā ca prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.bālye ca bālikā tvaṁ hi yauvane yuvatīti: bālye ca bālikā tvaṁ hi yauvane yuvatīti ca | sthavire vṛddha-rūpā ca prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.guṇamayī guṇātītā ādyā vidyā sanātanī |: guṇamayī guṇātītā ādyā vidyā sanātanī | mahat-tattvādi-samyuktā prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.tapasvinī tapaḥ siddhiḥ svargasiddhistad: tapasvinī tapaḥ siddhiḥ svarga-siddhis-tad-arthiṣu | cinmayī prakṛtis-tvaṁ tu prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.tvamādirjagatāṁ devi tvameva sthitikāraṇ: tvam-ādir-jagatāṁ devi tvam-eva sthiti-kāraṇam | tvam-ante nidhana-sthānaṁ svecchācārā tvam-eva hi ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.carācarāṇāṁ bhūtānāṁ bahirantastvameva h: carācarāṇāṁ bhūtānāṁ bahir-antas-tvam-eva hi | vyāpya-vyāpaka-rūpeṇa tvaṁ bhāsi bhakta-vatsale ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.tvanmāyayā hṛtajñānā naṣṭātmāno vicetasa: tvan-māyayā hṛta-jñānā naṣṭātmāno vicetasaḥ | gatāgataṁ prapadyante pāpa-puṇya-vaśāt-sadā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.tāvatsatyaṁ jagadbhāti śuktikārajataṁ ya: tāvat-satyaṁ jagad-bhāti śuktikā-rajataṁ yathā | yāvan-na jñāyate jñānaṁ cetasā nānvagāminī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.tvajjñānāttu sadā yuktaḥ putradāragṛhādi: tvaj-jñānāt-tu sadā yuktaḥ putra-dāra-gṛhādiṣu | ramante viṣayān sarvān-ante duḥkha-pradān dhruvam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.tvadājñayā tu deveśi gagane sūryamaṇḍala: tvad-ājñayā tu deveśi gagane sūrya-maṇḍalam | candraś-ca bhramate nityaṁ prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.brahmeśaviṣṇujananī brahmākhyā brahmasaṁ: brahmeśa-viṣṇu-jananī brahmākhyā brahma-saṁśrayā | vyaktā'vyaktā ca deveśi prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.sarvakāryaniyantrī ca sarvabhūteśvareśva: sarva-kārya-niyantrī ca sarva-bhūteśvareśvarī | anantā niṣkālā tvaṁ hi prasannā bhava-sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.sarveśvarī sarvavandyā acintyā paramātmi: sarveśvarī sarva-vandyā acintyā paramātmikā | bhukti-mukti-pradā tvaṁ hi prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.brahmāṇī brahmaloke tvaṁ vaikuṇṭhe sarva: brahmāṇī brahma-loke tvaṁ vaikuṇṭhe sarva-maṅgalā | indrāṇī amarāvatyām-ambikā varuṇālaye ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.yamālaye kālarūpā kuberabhavane śubhā |: yamālaye kāla-rūpā kubera-bhavane śubhā | mahānandāgnikoṇe ca prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.nairṛtyāṁ raktadantā tvaṁ vāyavyāṁ mṛgav: nairṛtyāṁ raktadantā tvaṁ vāyavyāṁ mṛga-vāhinī | pātāle vaiṣṇavī-rūpā prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.surasā tvaṁ maṇidvīpe aiśānyāṁ śūladhāri: surasā tvaṁ maṇidvīpe aiśānyāṁ śūla-dhāriṇī | bhadrakālī ca laṅkāyāṁ prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.rāmeśvarī setubandhe siṁhale devamohinī: rāmeśvarī setu-bandhe siṁhale deva-mohinī | vimalā tvaṁ ca śrīkṣetre prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.kālikā tvaṁ kālighaṭṭe kāmākhyā nīlaparv: kālikā tvaṁ kālighaṭṭe kāmākhyā nīla-parvate | virajā auḍra-deśe tvaṁ prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.vārāṇasyāmannapūrṇā ayodhyāyāṁ maheśvarī: vārāṇasyām-annapūrṇā ayodhyāyāṁ maheśvarī | gayāsurī gayā-dhāmni prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.kṣudhā tvaṁ sarvajīvānāṁ velā ca sāgaras: kṣudhā tvaṁ sarva-jīvānāṁ velā ca sāgarasya hi | maheśvarī mathurāyāṁ prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.viṣṇubhaktipradā tvaṁ ca kaṁsāsura vināś: viṣṇu-bhakti-pradā tvaṁ ca kaṁsāsura vināśinī | rāvaṇa-nāśinī caiva prasannā bhava sundari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.lakṣmīstotramidaṁ puṇyaṁ yaḥ paṭhedbhakt: lakṣmī-stotram-idaṁ puṇyaṁ yaḥ paṭhed-bhakti-samyutaḥ | sarva-jvara-bhayaṁ naśyet sarva-vyādhi-nivāraṇam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.idaṁ stotraṁ mahāpuṇyamāpaduddhārakāraṇa: idaṁ stotraṁ mahā-puṇyam-āpad-uddhāra-kāraṇam | trisandhyam-eka-sandhyaṁ vā yaḥ paṭhet satataṁ naraḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.mucyate sarvapāpebhyastathā tu sarvasaṅk: mucyate sarva-pāpebhyas-tathā tu sarva-saṅkaṭāt | mucyate nātra sandeho bhuvi svarge rasātale ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.samastaṁ ca tathā caikaṁ yaḥ paṭhedbhakt: samastaṁ ca tathā caikaṁ yaḥ paṭhed-bhakti-tatparaḥ | sa sarva-duṣkaraṁ tīrtvā labhate paramāṁ gatim ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.sukhadaṁ mokṣadaṁ stotraṁ yaḥ paṭhedbhak: sukhadaṁ mokṣa-daṁ stotraṁ yaḥ paṭhed-bhakti-samyutaḥ | sa tu koṭi-tīrtha-phalaṁ prāpnoti nātra saṁśayaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.ekā devī tu kamalā yasmiṁstuṣṭā bhavetsa: ekā devī tu kamalā yasmiṁs-tuṣṭā bhavet-sadā | tasyā'sādhyaṁ tu deveśi nāstikiñcijjagattraye ||
devi/dasamahavidya/03_kamala_stotram.txt.paṭhanādapi stotrasya kiṁ na siddhyati b: paṭhanād-api stotrasya kiṁ na siddhyati bhūtale | tasmāt stotra-varaṁ proktaṁ satyaṁ satyaṁ hi pārvati ||

devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.īśvara uvāca | atha vakṣye maheśāni kava: īśvara uvāca | atha vakṣye maheśāni kavacaṁ sarva-kāmadam | yasya vijñāna-mātreṇa bhavet-sākṣāt-sadāśivaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.nārcanaṁ tasya deveśi mantramātraṁ japen: nārcanaṁ tasya deveśi mantra-mātraṁ japen-naraḥ | sa bhavet-pārvatī-putraḥ sarva-śāstreṣu pāragaḥ | vidyārthinā sadā sevyā viśeṣe viṣṇu-vallabhā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.asyāścaturakṣariviṣṇuvanitārūpāyāḥ kavac: asyāś-catur-akṣari-viṣṇu-vanitā-rūpāyāḥ kavacasya śrī-bhagavān śiva ṛṣir-anuṣṭup-chando, vāgbhavī devatā, vāgbhavaṁ bījaṁ, lajjā śaktiḥ, ramā kīlakaṁ, kāma-bījātmakaṁ kavacaṁ, mama supāṇḍitya kavitva sarva-siddhi-samṛddhaye jape viniyogaḥ || atha kavacam | aiṅkārī mastake pātu vāgbhavī sarva-siddhidā | hrīṁ pātu cakṣuṣor-madhye cakṣur-yugme ca śāṅkarī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.jihvāyāṁ mukhavṛtte ca karṇayorgaṇḍayorn: jihvāyāṁ mukha-vṛtte ca karṇayor-gaṇḍayor-nasi | oṣṭhādhare danta-paṅktau tālu-mūle hanau punaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.pātu māṁ viṣṇuvanitā lakṣmīḥ śrīvarṇarūp: pātu māṁ viṣṇu-vanitā lakṣmīḥ śrī-varṇa-rūpiṇī | karṇa-yugme bhuja-dvandve stana-dvandve ca pārvatī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.vyuṣṭiḥ pātu mahāmāyā utkṛṣṭiḥ sarvadā'v: vyuṣṭiḥ pātu mahāmāyā utkṛṣṭiḥ sarvadā'vatu | sandhiṁ pātu sadā devī sarvatra śambhu-vallabhā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.vāgbhavī sarvadā pātu pātu māṁ harigehin: vāgbhavī sarvadā pātu pātu māṁ hari-gehinī | ramā pātu sadā devī pātu māyā svarāṭ svayam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.sarvāṅge pātu māṁ lakṣmīrviṣṇumāyā sureś: sarvāṅge pātu māṁ lakṣmīr-viṣṇu-māyā sureśvarī | vijayā pātu bhavane jayā pātu sadā mama ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.śivadūtī sadā pātu sundarī pātu sarvadā: śiva-dūtī sadā pātu sundarī pātu sarvadā | bhairavī pātu sarvatra bhairuṇḍā sarvadā'vatu ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.tvaritā pātu māṁ nityamugratārā sadā'vat: tvaritā pātu māṁ nityam-ugratārā sadā'vatu | pātu māṁ kālikā nityaṁ kālarātriḥ sadā'vatu ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.mātaraḥ pāntu devyaśca cakrasthā yoginīg: mātaraḥ pāntu devyaś-ca cakra-sthā yoginī-gaṇāḥ | sarvatra sarva-kāryeṣu sarva-karmasu sarvadā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.pātu māṁ devadevī ca lakṣmīḥ sarvasamṛdd: pātu māṁ deva-devī ca lakṣmīḥ sarva-samṛddhidā | iti te kathitaṁ divyaṁ kavacaṁ sarva-siddhaye ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.yatra tatra na vaktavyaṁ yadīcchedātmano: yatra tatra na vaktavyaṁ yadīcched-ātmano hitam | śaṭhāya bhakti-hīnāya nindakāya maheśvari ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.nyūnāṅge atiriktāṅge darśayenna kadācana: nyūnāṅge atiriktāṅge darśayen-na kadācana | na stavaṁ darśayed-divyaṁ sandarśya śivahā bhavet ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.kulīnāya mahocchrāya durgābhaktiparāya c: kulīnāya mahocchrāya durgā-bhakti-parāya ca | vaiṣṇavāya viśuddhāya dadyāt-kavacam-uttamam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.nijaśiṣyāya śāntāya dhanine jñānine tath: nija-śiṣyāya śāntāya dhanine jñānine tathā | dadyāt-kavacam-ity-uktaṁ sarva-tantra-samanvitam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.vilikhya kavacaṁ divyaṁ svayambhukusumai: vilikhya kavacaṁ divyaṁ svayambhu-kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ | sva-śukraiḥ para-śukraiś-ca nānā-gandha-samanvitaiḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.gorocanākuṅkumena raktacandanakena vā |: gorocanā-kuṅkumena rakta-candanakena vā | sutithau śubha-yoge vā śravaṇāyāṁ raver-dine ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.aśvinyāṁ kṛttikāyāṁ vā phalgunyāṁ vā mag: aśvinyāṁ kṛttikāyāṁ vā phalgunyāṁ vā maghāsu ca | pūrva-bhādrapadā-yoge svātyāṁ maṅgalavāsare ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.vilikhet prapaṭhet stotraṁ śubhayoge sur: vilikhet prapaṭhet stotraṁ śubha-yoge surālaye | āyuṣmat-prīti-yoge ca brahma-yoge viśeṣataḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.indrayoge śubhayoge śukrayoge tathaiva c: indra-yoge śubha-yoge śukra-yoge tathaiva ca | kaulave bālave caiva vaṇije caiva sattamaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.śūnyāgāre śmaśāne vā vijane ca viśeṣataḥ: śūnyāgāre śmaśāne vā vijane ca viśeṣataḥ | kumārīṁ pūjayitvādau yajed-devīṁ sanātanīm ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.matsyamāṁsaiḥ śākasūpaiḥ pūjayetparadeva: matsya-māṁsaiḥ śāka-sūpaiḥ pūjayet-para-devatām | ghṛtādyaiḥ sopakaraṇaiḥ pūpa-sūpair-viśeṣataḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.brāhmaṇānbhojāyitvādau prīṇayetparameśva: brāhmaṇān-bhojāyitvādau prīṇayet-parameśvarīm | bahunā kim-ihoktena kṛte tvevaṁ dina-trayam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.tadādharenmahārakṣāṁ śaṅkareṇābhibhāṣita: tadādharen-mahā-rakṣāṁ śaṅkareṇābhibhāṣitam | māraṇa-dveṣaṇādīni labhate nātra saṁśayaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.sa bhavetpārvatīputraḥ sarvaśāstraviśāra: sa bhavet-pārvatī-putraḥ sarva-śāstra-viśāradaḥ | gurur-devo haraḥ sākṣāt-patnī tasya hara-priyā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.abhedena bhajedyastu tasya siddhiradūrat: abhedena bhajed-yas-tu tasya siddhir-adūrataḥ | sarva-deva-mayīṁ devīṁ sarva-mantra-mayīṁ tathā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.subhaktyā pūjayedyastu sa bhavetkamalāpr: subhaktyā pūjayed-yas-tu sa bhavet-kamalā-priyaḥ | rakta-puṣpais-tathā gandhair-vastrālaṅkaraṇais-tathā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.bhaktyā yaḥ pūjayeddevīṁ labhate paramāṁ: bhaktyā yaḥ pūjayed-devīṁ labhate paramāṁ gatim | nārī vā puruṣo vāpi yaḥ paṭhet-kavacaṁ śubham | mantra-siddhiḥ kārya-siddhir-labhate nātra saṁśayaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/04_kamala_kavacam.txt.paṭhati ya iha martyo nityamārdrāntarātm: paṭhati ya iha martyo nityam-ārdrāntarātmā japa-phalam-anumeyaṁ lapsyate yad-vidheyam | sa bhavati padam-uccaiḥ sampadāṁ pāda-namraḥ kṣitipa-mukuṭa-lakṣmīr-lakṣaṇānāṁ cirāya ||

devi/dasamahavidya/06_tarashtakam.txt.śūnyasthāmatitejasāṁ ca dadhatīṁ śūlābja: śūnya-sthām-atitejasāṁ ca dadhatīṁ śūlābja khaḍgaṁ gadāṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/06_tarashtakam.txt.mātaste padasevane hi vimukhān kiṁ manda: mātas-te pada-sevane hi vimukhān kiṁ manda-dhīḥ sevate ||
devi/dasamahavidya/06_tarashtakam.txt.tattulyāṁ niyataṁ yathā śaśiravī nāśaṁ v: tat-tulyāṁ niyataṁ yathā śaśi-ravī nāśaṁ vrajanti svayam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/06_tarashtakam.txt.ḍākinyaḥ kupitāntakaśca manujān mātaḥ kṣ: ḍākinyaḥ kupitāntakaś-ca manujān mātaḥ kṣaṇaṁ bhūtale ||
devi/dasamahavidya/06_tarashtakam.txt.mātastvatpadasevayā khalu nṛṇāṁ siddhyan: mātas-tvat-pada-sevayā khalu nṛṇāṁ siddhyanti te te guṇāḥ
devi/dasamahavidya/06_tarashtakam.txt.kīrtiṁ kāntiṁ ca nairujyaṁ prāptyānte mo: kīrtiṁ kāntiṁ ca nairujyaṁ prāptyānte mokṣam-āpnuyāt |

devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.aiṁ pātu dakṣanetraṁ me hrīṁ pātu vāmalo: aiṁ pātu dakṣa-netraṁ me hrīṁ pātu vāma-locanam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.śrīṁ pātu dakṣakarṇaṁ me trivarṇākhyā ma: śrīṁ pātu dakṣa-karṇaṁ me trivarṇākhyā maheśvarī |
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.vāmakarṇaṁ sadā pātu aiṁ ghrāṇaṁ pātu me: vāma-karṇaṁ sadā pātu aiṁ ghrāṇaṁ pātu me sadā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.vākpuṭaṁ ca trivarṇātmā kaṇṭhaṁ pātu par: vāk-puṭaṁ ca trivarṇātmā kaṇṭhaṁ pātu parāmbikā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.oṁ pātu hṛdayaṁ hrīṁ me madhyadeśaṁ sadā: oṁ pātu hṛdayaṁ hrīṁ me madhya-deśaṁ sadā'vatu |
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.krauṁ pātu nābhideśaṁ me tryakṣarī bhuva: krauṁ pātu nābhi-deśaṁ me tryakṣarī bhuvaneśvarī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.hrīṁ pātu guhyadeśaṁ me namo bhagavatī k: hrīṁ pātu guhya-deśaṁ me namo bhagavatī kaṭim ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.annapūrṇā sadā pātu svāhā pātu padadvaya: annapūrṇā sadā pātu svāhā pātu pada-dvayam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.tāraṁ māyā ramākāmaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā tataḥ par: tāraṁ māyā ramā-kāmaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā tataḥ param ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.tāraṁ durgeyugaṁ rakṣet svāheti ca daśāk: tāraṁ durge-yugaṁ rakṣet svāheti ca daśākṣarī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.jayadurgā ghanaśyāmā pātu māṁ sarvato mu: jayadurgā ghana-śyāmā pātu māṁ sarvato mudā |
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.māyābījādikā caiṣā daśārṇā ca parā tathā: māyā-bījādikā caiṣā daśārṇā ca parā tathā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.tāraṁ māyā tu kavacaṁ khe rakṣetsatataṁ: tāraṁ māyā tu kavacaṁ khe rakṣet-satataṁ vadhūḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.hrūṁ kṣaṁ hrīṁ phaṭ mahāvidyā dvādaśārṇā: hrūṁ kṣaṁ hrīṁ phaṭ mahāvidyā dvādaśārṇākhila-pradā |
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.aiṁ klīṁ sauḥ satataṁ bālā mūrdhadeśe ta: aiṁ klīṁ sauḥ satataṁ bālā mūrdha-deśe tato'vatu |
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.iti te kathitaṁ puṇyaṁ trailokyamaṅgalaṁ: iti te kathitaṁ puṇyaṁ trailokya-maṅgalaṁ param |
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.vāṇī ca nivasedvaktre satyaṁ satyaṁ na s: vāṇī ca nivased-vaktre satyaṁ satyaṁ na saṁśayaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/08_bhuvaneswari_kavac.puruṣo dakṣiṇe bāhau nārī vāmabhuje tath: puruṣo dakṣiṇe bāhau nārī vāma-bhuje tathā |

devi/dasamahavidya/09_chinnamasta_devi_s.kuṇḍe vā maṇḍale vā śuciratha manunā bhā: kuṇḍe vā maṇḍale vā śucir-atha manunā bhāvayaty-eva mantrī
devi/dasamahavidya/09_chinnamasta_devi_s.andhaḥ sājyaṁ samāṁsaṁ dadhiyutamathavā: andhaḥ sājyaṁ samāṁsaṁ dadhi-yutam-athavā yo'nvahaṁ yāminīnāṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/09_chinnamasta_devi_s.madhye devyai dadāti prabhavati gṛhagā ś: madhye devyai dadāti prabhavati gṛhagā śrīr-amuṣyāvakhaṇḍā |
devi/dasamahavidya/09_chinnamasta_devi_s.ājyaṁ māṁsaṁ saraktaṁ tilayutamathavā ta: ājyaṁ māṁsaṁ saraktaṁ tila-yutam-athavā taṇḍulaṁ pāyasaṁ vā hutvā
devi/dasamahavidya/09_chinnamasta_devi_s.māṁsaṁ trisandhyaṁ sa bhavati manujo bhū: māṁsaṁ trisandhyaṁ sa bhavati manujo bhūtibhir-bhūta-nāthaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/09_chinnamasta_devi_s.idaṁ devyāḥ stotraṁ paṭhati manujo yastr: idaṁ devyāḥ stotraṁ paṭhati manujo yas-tri-samayaṁ

devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.huṁkāro me śiraḥ pātu chinnamastā balapr: huṁkāro me śiraḥ pātu chinnamastā bala-pradā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.śrīṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ aiṁ dṛśau pātu muṇḍaṁ kar: śrīṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ aiṁ dṛśau pātu muṇḍaṁ kartri-dharāpi sā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.vajravairocanīye huṁ phaṭ svāhā ca dhruv: vajra-vairocanīye huṁ phaṭ svāhā ca dhruvādikā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.hūṁ phaṭ svāhā mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśī brahmarū: hūṁ phaṭ svāhā mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśī brahma-rūpiṇī |
devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.ḍākinī dakṣiṇe pātu śrīmahābhairavī ca m: ḍākinī dakṣiṇe pātu śrī-mahā-bhairavī ca mām ||
devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.hrūṁ hrūṁ pātu marutkoṇe svāhā pātu sado: hrūṁ hrūṁ pātu marut-koṇe svāhā pātu sadottare ||
devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.tāro māyā vadhūḥ kūrcaṁ phaṭ kāro'yaṁ ma: tāro māyā vadhūḥ kūrcaṁ phaṭ kāro'yaṁ mahā-manuḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.iti te kathitaṁ devyāḥ kavacaṁ mantravig: iti te kathitaṁ devyāḥ kavacaṁ mantra-vigraham |
devi/dasamahavidya/10_chinnamasta_kavaca.dhārayeddakṣiṇe bāhau kaṇṭhe vā yadi vān: dhārayed-dakṣiṇe bāhau kaṇṭhe vā yadi vānyataḥ |

devi/dasamahavidya/11_dhumavati_stotram..sā devī devadevī tribhuvanajananī kālikā: sā devī deva-devī tri-bhuvana-jananī kālikāpātu yuṣmān ||
devi/dasamahavidya/11_dhumavati_stotram..spheṁ spheṁ spheṁ sphārakārā ṭakaṭakitah: spheṁ spheṁ spheṁ sphārakārā ṭakaṭakita-hasā nāda-saṅghaṭṭa bhīmā |
devi/dasamahavidya/11_dhumavati_stotram..vāme karṇe mṛgāṅkaṁ palayaparigataṁ dakṣ: vāme karṇe mṛgāṅkaṁ palayaparigataṁ dakṣiṇe sūrya-bimbaṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/11_dhumavati_stotram..raktāruddhiḥ sabhāsthā maraṇabhayaharā t: raktāruddhiḥ sabhā-sthā maraṇa-bhaya-harā tvaṁ śivā caṇḍa-ghaṇṭā ||

devi/dasamahavidya/12_dhumavati_kavacam..kavacaṁ śrotumicchāmi tasyā deva vadasva: kavacaṁ śrotum-icchāmi tasyā deva vadasva me ||
devi/dasamahavidya/12_dhumavati_kavacam..anuṣṭupchandaḥ śrīdhūmāvatī devatā dhūṁ: anuṣṭup-chandaḥ śrī-dhūmāvatī devatā dhūṁ bījam svāhā śaktiḥ
devi/dasamahavidya/12_dhumavati_kavacam..dhūmā netrayugaṁ pātu vatī karṇau sadāva: dhūmā netra-yugaṁ pātu vatī karṇau sadāvatu ||
devi/dasamahavidya/12_dhumavati_kavacam..dīrghā tūdaramadhye tu nābhiṁ me malinām: dīrghā tūdara-madhye tu nābhiṁ me malināmbarā |
devi/dasamahavidya/12_dhumavati_kavacam..śūrpahantā pātu guhyaṁ rūkṣā rakṣatu jān: śūrpa-hantā pātu guhyaṁ rūkṣā rakṣatu jānunī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/12_dhumavati_kavacam..dhūmahastā sadā pātu pādau pātu bhayāvah: dhūma-hastā sadā pātu pādau pātu bhayāvahā ||

devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.bhairavī yā purā proktā vidyā tripurapūr: bhairavī yā purā proktā vidyā tripura-pūrvikā |
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.tasyāstu kavacaṁ divyaṁ mahyaṁ kathaya t: tasyās-tu kavacaṁ divyaṁ mahyaṁ kathaya tattvataḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.adbhutaṁ kavacaṁ devyā bhairavyā divyarū: adbhutaṁ kavacaṁ devyā bhairavyā divya-rūpi vai ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.kakārī pātu māṁ devī kāminī kāmadāyinī |: kakārī pātu māṁ devī kāminī kāma-dāyinī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.hrīṅkārī pātu māṁ devī sarvadā śambhusun: hrīṅkārī pātu māṁ devī sarvadā śambhu-sundarī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.kakārī pātu māṁ devī śarvāṇī haragehinī: kakārī pātu māṁ devī śarvāṇī hara-gehinī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.kakārī pātu māṁ devī kāmarūpadharā sadā: kakārī pātu māṁ devī kāmarūpa-dharā sadā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.kākārī pātu māṁ devī śambarāripriyā sadā: kākārī pātu māṁ devī śambarāri-priyā sadā |
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.makāraḥ pātu māṁ devī sāvitrī sarvadāyin: makāraḥ pātu māṁ devī sāvitrī sarva-dāyinī |
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.lakāraḥ pātu māṁ devī lakṣmīḥ sarvasulak: lakāraḥ pātu māṁ devī lakṣmīḥ sarva-sulakṣaṇā |
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.oṁ hrīṁ māṁ pātu sarvatra devī tribhuvan: oṁ hrīṁ māṁ pātu sarvatra devī tri-bhuvaneśvarī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.pātu māṁ sarvadā devī nānāśaṅkhanidhiḥ ś: pātu māṁ sarvadā devī nānā-śaṅkha-nidhiḥ śivā |
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.paṅktiśchandaḥ svarūpā tu mukhe pātu sur: paṅktiś-chandaḥ svarūpā tu mukhe pātu sureśvarī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.yaḥ paṭhetprayato bhūtvā trisandhyaṁ niy: yaḥ paṭhet-prayato bhūtvā trisandhyaṁ niyataḥ śuciḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.tanmanuṁ pūjayitvā ca gurupaṅktiṁ tathai: tan-manuṁ pūjayitvā ca guru-paṅktiṁ tathaiva ca ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.dhṛtvā suvarṇamadhyasthaṁ kaṇṭhe vā dakṣ: dhṛtvā suvarṇa-madhyasthaṁ kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bhuje |
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.na durbhikṣaphalaṁ tatra na śatroḥ pīḍan: na durbhikṣa-phalaṁ tatra na śatroḥ pīḍanaṁ tathā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.ślokaṁ vā stavamekaṁ vā yaḥ paṭhetprayat: ślokaṁ vā stavam-ekaṁ vā yaḥ paṭhet-prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.gururdevo haraḥ sākṣātpatnī tasya ca pār: gurur-devo haraḥ sākṣāt-patnī tasya ca pārvatī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/14_tripura_bhairavi_k.iti śrīrudrayāmale bhairavabhairavīsaṁvā: iti śrī-rudrayāmale bhairava-bhairavī-saṁvāde śrī tripurabhairavī kavacam ||

devi/dasamahavidya/15_tripurasundari_sto.śrīṁ bīje nāda bindudvitaya śaśi kalākār: śrīṁ bīje nāda bindu-dvitaya śaśi kalākāra-rūpe svarūpe
devi/dasamahavidya/15_tripurasundari_sto.mātarme dehi buddiṁ jahi jahi jaḍatāṁ pā: mātar-me dehi buddiṁ jahi jahi jaḍatāṁ pāhimāṁ dīna dīnam |
devi/dasamahavidya/15_tripurasundari_sto.brahmeśādyaḥsurendraiḥ suragaṇa vinataiḥ: brahmeśādyaḥsurendraiḥ sura-gaṇa vinataiḥ saṁstutāṁ tvāṁ namāmi ||

devi/dasamahavidya/17_bagalamukhi_hriday.diśātaḥ sadbhaktiṁ bhuvi bhagavatāṁ bhūr: diśātaḥ sad-bhaktiṁ bhuvi bhagavatāṁ bhūri bhavadām ||
devi/dasamahavidya/17_bagalamukhi_hriday.paṭhedyo bagalā tasya prasannā pāṭhato b: paṭhed-yo bagalā tasya prasannā pāṭhato bhavet ||
devi/dasamahavidya/17_bagalamukhi_hriday.yastvidaṁ paṭhate premṇā bagalā prītimet: yas-tv-idaṁ paṭhate premṇā bagalā prītim-eti saḥ ||

devi/dasamahavidya/19_chinnamasta_hriday.yattvayā paripṛṣṭo'haṁ vakṣye prītyai ta: yat-tvayā paripṛṣṭo'haṁ vakṣye prītyai tava priye ||
devi/dasamahavidya/19_chinnamasta_hriday.yajñānāṁ yogayajñāya yā tu jātā yuge yug: yajñānāṁ yoga-yajñāya yā tu jātā yuge yuge |
devi/dasamahavidya/19_chinnamasta_hriday.yo japettasya vidveṣī bhasmatāṁ yāti tāṁ: yo japet-tasya vidveṣī bhasmatāṁ yāti tāṁ bhaje ||
devi/dasamahavidya/19_chinnamasta_hriday.dvijakulakamalānāṁ bhāsinī bhānumūrtirbh: dvija-kula-kamalānāṁ bhāsinī bhānu-mūrtir-bhavatu bhavatu vāṇī chinnamastā bhavānī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/19_chinnamasta_hriday.yāṁ smṛtvā santi sadyaḥ sakalaḥ suragaṇā: yāṁ smṛtvā santi sadyaḥ sakalaḥ sura-gaṇāḥ sarvadā sampadāḍhyāḥ
devi/dasamahavidya/19_chinnamasta_hriday.sā'ādyā śrīśādisevyā suphalatu sutarāṁ c: sā'ādyā śrīśādi-sevyā suphalatu sutarāṁ chinnamastā praśastā ||

devi/dasamahavidya/20_dhumavati_hridayam.kaṅkāṅkṣutkṣānta dehaṁ muhurati kuṭilāṁ: kaṅkāṅkṣutkṣānta dehaṁ muhur-ati kuṭilāṁ vāridābhāṁ vicitrāṁ |
devi/dasamahavidya/20_dhumavati_hridayam.ya idaṁ paṭhati stotraṁ pavitraṁ pāpanāś: ya idaṁ paṭhati stotraṁ pavitraṁ pāpa-nāśanaṁ |

devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.divyaṁ hi kavacaṁ tasyāḥ śṛṇuṣva sarvakā: divyaṁ hi kavacaṁ tasyāḥ śṛṇuṣva sarva-kāmadam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu brahmarūpā maheśva: praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu brahma-rūpā maheśvarī |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.kharvā māṁ pātu deveśī gaṇḍayugme bhayāp: kharvā māṁ pātu deveśī gaṇḍa-yugme bhayāpahā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.lalajjihvā sadā pātu nābhau māṁ bhuvaneś: lalaj-jihvā sadā pātu nābhau māṁ bhuvaneśvarī |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.karālāsyā sadā pātu liṅge devī harapriyā: karālāsyā sadā pātu liṅge devī hara-priyā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.nīlavarṇā sadā pātu jānunī sarvadā mama: nīla-varṇā sadā pātu jānunī sarvadā mama |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.rakṣa rakṣa nadīkuñje hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ susam: rakṣa rakṣa nadī-kuñje hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ susamanvite |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.oṁ hrīṁ vajrapuṣpaṁ huṁ phaṭ prāntare sa: oṁ hrīṁ vajra-puṣpaṁ huṁ phaṭ prāntare sarva-kāmadā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.oṁ puṣpe puṣpe mahāpuṣpe pātu putrānmahe: oṁ puṣpe puṣpe mahā-puṣpe pātu putrān-maheśvarī |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.hūṁ svāhā śaktisamyuktā dārān rakṣatu sa: hūṁ svāhā śakti-samyuktā dārān rakṣatu sarvadā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.oṁ āṁ hūṁ svāhā maheśānī pātu dyūte hara: oṁ āṁ hūṁ svāhā maheśānī pātu dyūte hara-priyā |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.oṁ hrīṁ sarvavighnotsāriṇī devī vighnānm: oṁ hrīṁ sarva-vighnotsāriṇī devī vighnān-māṁ sadā'vatu ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.oṁ pavitravajrabhūme huṁ phaṭ svāhā sama: oṁ pavitra-vajra-bhūme huṁ phaṭ svāhā samanvitā |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.oṁ āḥ surekhe vajrarekhe huṁ phaṭ svāhā: oṁ āḥ surekhe vajra-rekhe huṁ phaṭ svāhā samanvitā |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.pātāle pātu sā devī lākinī nāmasañjñikā: pātāle pātu sā devī lākinī nāma-sañjñikā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.hrīṅkārī pātu māṁ pūrve śaktirūpā maheśv: hrīṅkārī pātu māṁ pūrve śakti-rūpā maheśvarī |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.paścime pātu māṁ devī phaṭ svarūpā harap: paścime pātu māṁ devī phaṭ svarūpā hara-priyā |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.nīlavarṇā sadā pātu sarvato vāgbhavā sad: nīla-varṇā sadā pātu sarvato vāgbhavā sadā |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.śaknomi gadituṁ devi bhavettasya phalaṁ: śaknomi gadituṁ devi bhavet-tasya phalaṁ ca yat |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.na vidyate bhayaṁ tasya nṛpapūjyo bhavec: na vidyate bhayaṁ tasya nṛpa-pūjyo bhavec-ca saḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.raṇe dyūte vivāde ca jayastatra bhaveddh: raṇe dyūte vivāde ca jayas-tatra bhaved-dhruvam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.garvī kharvī bhavatyeva vādī skhalati da: garvī kharvī bhavaty-eva vādī skhalati darśanāt |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.taṁ dṛṣṭvā sādhakaṁ devi lajjāyuktā bhav: taṁ dṛṣṭvā sādhakaṁ devi lajjā-yuktā bhavanti te ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.svarge martye ca pātāle ye devāḥ siddhid: svarge martye ca pātāle ye devāḥ siddhi-dāyakāḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.vighnātmakāśca ye devāḥ svarge martye ra: vighnātmakāś-ca ye devāḥ svarge martye rasātale |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.iti te kathitaṁ devi mayā samyakprakīrti: iti te kathitaṁ devi mayā samyak-prakīrtitam |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.mitraṁ tasya nṛpāśca devi vipado naśyant: mitraṁ tasya nṛpāś-ca devi vipado naśyanti tasyāśu ca ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.tadgātraṁ prāpya śastrāṇi brahmāstrādīni: tad-gātraṁ prāpya śastrāṇi brahmāstrādīni vai bhuvi |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.tasya gehe sthirā lakṣmīrvāṇī vaktre vas: tasya gehe sthirā lakṣmīr-vāṇī vaktre vased-dhruvam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.idaṁ kavacamajñātvā tārāṁ yo bhajate nar: idaṁ kavacam-ajñātvā tārāṁ yo bhajate naraḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/21_tara_kavacam.txt.likhitvā dhārayedyastu kaṇṭhe vā mastake: likhitvā dhārayed-yas-tu kaṇṭhe vā mastake bhuje |

devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.yastvāṁ paśyati tasya yānti vilayaṁ sady: yas-tvāṁ paśyati tasya yānti vilayaṁ sadyohi sarvāpadaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.mudrāṁ vāmakare nidhāya ca punarmantrī m: mudrāṁ vāma-kare nidhāya ca punar-mantrī manojñākṣarīṁ |
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.tasyā mitracayasya saṁsadi mukha stambho: tasyā mitra-cayasya saṁsadi mukha stambho bhavet-tatkṣaṇāt ||
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.mantrastāvadayaṁ vipakṣadalane stotraṁ p: mantras-tāvad-ayaṁ vipakṣa-dalane stotraṁ pavitraṁ ca te
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.yantraṁvādini yantriṇaṁ trijagatāṁ jaitr: yantraṁvādini yantriṇaṁ tri-jagatāṁ jaitraṁ sa citraṁ ca tat |
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.vaśye ca stambhane vā ripuvadhasamaye pr: vaśye ca stambhane vā ripu-vadha-samaye prāṇa-bādhe raṇe vā
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.gacchantīṣṭaṁ trikālaṁ tava paṭhanamidaṁ: gacchantīṣṭaṁ trikālaṁ tava paṭhanam-idaṁ kārayed-āśu dhīraḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.tvaṁ vidyā paramā trilokajananī vyoṣānan: tvaṁ vidyā paramā triloka-jananī vyoṣānanaṁ chedinī
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.dakṣe kare'kṣasūtraṁ ca adhaḥpadmaṁ ca d: dakṣe kare'kṣa-sūtraṁ ca adhaḥ-padmaṁ ca dhāriṇīm ||
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.viśvādye viśvajaitrī tripuraḥ bagale viś: viśvādye viśva-jaitrī tripuraḥ bagale viśva-vandye tvam-ekā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.śaṅkhaṁ kheṭaṁ halamapi ca gadāṁ bibhrat: śaṅkhaṁ kheṭaṁ halam-api ca gadāṁ bibhratīṁ vāma-dorbhiḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.gehaṁ nātati garvitaḥ praṇamati strīsaṅg: gehaṁ nātati garvitaḥ praṇamati strī-saṅgamo mokṣati
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.nityaṁ yastu manoharaṁ stavamidaṁ divyaṁ: nityaṁ yastu manoharaṁ stavam-idaṁ divyaṁ paṭhet-sādaraṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.dhṛtvā yantramidaṁ tathaiva samare bāhvo: dhṛtvā yantram-idaṁ tathaiva samare bāhvoḥ kare vā gale ||
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.stotrairyānti vimohitā ripugaṇā lakṣmīḥ: stotrair-yānti vimohitā ripu-gaṇā lakṣmīḥ sthirā siddhayaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.ye nityaṁ prajapanti bhakti bharitāstebh: ye nityaṁ prajapanti bhakti bharitās-tebhyas-stavaṁ niścitam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.nūnaṁ śreyo vaśyamārogyatāṁ ca prāptassa: nūnaṁ śreyo vaśyam-ārogyatāṁ ca prāptas-sarvaṁ bhūtale sādhakas-tu |
devi/dasamahavidya/22_bagalamukhi_stotra.bhaktyā nityaṁ stotrametatpaṭhanvai vidy: bhaktyā nityaṁ stotram-etat-paṭhan-vai vidyāṁ kīrtiṁ vamśa-vṛddhiṁ ca vindet ||

devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.hrīṁ hrīṁ hrīṅkārarūpe munigaṇanamite si: hrīṁ hrīṁ hrīṅkāra-rūpe muni-gaṇa-namite siddhi-de śubhra-dehe |
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.krauṁ krauṁ krauṁmīśarūpe arikulahanane: krauṁ krauṁ krauṁmīśarūpe ari-kula-hanane dehakīle kapāle
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.hasrauṁ hasrauṁ svarūpe samarasanirate d: hasrauṁ hasrauṁ svarūpe samarasa-nirate divya-rūpe svarūpe |
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.jrauṁ jrauṁ jrauṁ jātarūpe jahi jahi dur: jrauṁ jrauṁ jrauṁ jātarūpe jahi jahi duritaṁ jambha-rūpe prabhāve
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.kāli kaṅkālarūpe arijanadalane dehi sidd: kāli kaṅkāla-rūpe ari-jana-dalane dehi siddhiṁ parāṁ me ||
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.hasrāṁ hasrīṁ ca hasraiṁ tribhuvanavidit: hasrāṁ hasrīṁ ca hasraiṁ tri-bhuvana-vidite caṇḍa-mārtaṇḍa-caṇḍe
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ kaulavidye satataśamapare: aiṁ klīṁ sauṁ kaula-vidye satata-śama-pare naumi pīta-svarūpe |
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.dhāṁ dhāṁ dhāṁ dhārayantīṁ ripukularasan: dhāṁ dhāṁ dhāṁ dhārayantīṁ ripu-kula-rasanāṁ mudgaraṁ vajra-pāśam |
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.ḍāṁ ḍāṁ ḍāṁ ḍākinyādyairḍimakaḍimaḍimaṁ: ḍāṁ ḍāṁ ḍāṁ ḍākinyādyair-ḍimakaḍimaḍimaṁ ḍamarukaṁ vādayantīṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.mātaḥ śrībagale parātparatare vāde vivād: mātaḥ śrī-bagale parātparatare vāde vivāde jayam |
devi/dasamahavidya/23_bagalamukhi_kilaka.māṅgalyaṁ vasudhāsu dehi satataṁ sarvasv: māṅgalyaṁ vasudhāsu dehi satataṁ sarva-svarūpe śive ||

devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.yaṁ praviśya ca bādhante bāṇairapi narāḥ: yaṁ praviśya ca bādhante bāṇair-api narāḥ kvacit ||
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ śrīmat pītāmbarādevī ba: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ śrīmat pītāmbarā-devī bagalā buddhi-vardhinī |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ śikhādipādaparyantaṁ va: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ śikhādi-pāda-paryantaṁ vajra-pañjara-dhāriṇī |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ bagalā māmavatyatra mūr: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ bagalā mām-avaty-atra mūrdha-bhāgaṁ maheśvarī |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ karṇayoścaiva yugapadat: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ karṇayoś-caiva yugapadatiratnaprapūjitā |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.pātu māṁ bagalādevī nāsikāṁ me guṇākarā: pātu māṁ bagalā-devī nāsikāṁ me guṇākarā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ pītapuṣpaiḥ pītavastrai: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ pīta-puṣpaiḥ pīta-vastraiḥ pūjitā veda-dāyinī |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ pītāmbarā prasannāsyā n: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ pītāmbarā prasannāsyā netrayor-yugapad bhruvau |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.pātu māṁ bagalā nityaṁ baladā pītavastra: pātu māṁ bagalā nityaṁ baladā pīta-vastra-dhṛk ||
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ adharoṣṭhau tathā dantā: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ adharoṣṭhau tathā dantān jihvāṁ ca mukha-gāṁ mama |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ gale haste tathā bāhvoḥ: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ gale haste tathā bāhvoḥ yugapad-buddhidā satām |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ hṛdaye ca stanau nābhau: oṁ aiṁ hlīṁ śrīṁ hṛdaye ca stanau nābhau karāv-api kṛśodarī |
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.anuktamapi yat sthānaṁ tvak keśa nakha l: anuktam-api yat sthānaṁ tvak keśa nakha lomakam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.tāḥ sarvā bagalādevī rakṣenme ca manohar: tāḥ sarvā bagalā-devī rakṣen-me ca manoharā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.svarge martye ca pātāle nā'rayastaṁ kadā: svarge martye ca pātāle nā'rayas-taṁ kadācana ||
devi/dasamahavidya/24_bagalamukhi_panjar.ato bhaktaiḥ kaulikaiśca svarakṣārthaṁ s: ato bhaktaiḥ kaulikaiś-ca sva-rakṣārthaṁ sadaiva hi ||

devi/dasamahavidya/25_taramba_tara_hrida.śṛṇu pārvati bhadraṁ te lokānāṁ hitakāra: śṛṇu pārvati bhadraṁ te lokānāṁ hita-kārakaṁ |
devi/dasamahavidya/25_taramba_tara_hrida.evaṁ dhyātvā śubhāṁ tārāṁ tatastu hṛdaya: evaṁ dhyātvā śubhāṁ tārāṁ tatas-tu hṛdayaṁ paṭhet |
devi/dasamahavidya/25_taramba_tara_hrida.strīṁ hrīṁ hūṁ trīṁ phaṇmantreṇa jalaṁ j: strīṁ hrīṁ hūṁ trīṁ phaṇ-mantreṇa jalaṁ japtvā'bhiṣecayet |
devi/dasamahavidya/25_taramba_tara_hrida.hrīṁ hūṁ strīṁ phaḍantamantraiḥ puṣpaṁ s: hrīṁ hūṁ strīṁ phaḍanta-mantraiḥ puṣpaṁ samśodhyasaptadhā |
devi/dasamahavidya/25_taramba_tara_hrida.strīṁ trīṁ hrīṁ mantravaryeṇa akṣatāścāb: strīṁ trīṁ hrīṁ mantra-varyeṇa akṣatāś-cābhi mantritāḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/25_taramba_tara_hrida.tasyaiva tilakaṁ kṛtvā jaganmohaṁ sa vaś: tasyaiva tilakaṁ kṛtvā jagan-mohaṁ sa vaśaṁ nayet ||

devi/dasamahavidya/26_nilasarasvati_stot.mūḍhatvaṁ ca harerdevi trāhi māṁ śaraṇāg: mūḍhatvaṁ ca harer-devi trāhi māṁ śaraṇāgatam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/26_nilasarasvati_stot.aṣṭamyāṁ ca caturdaśyāṁ navamyāṁ yaḥ paṭ: aṣṭamyāṁ ca caturdaśyāṁ navamyāṁ yaḥ paṭhen-naraḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/26_nilasarasvati_stot.tasya śatruḥ kṣayaṁ yāti mahāprajñā praj: tasya śatruḥ kṣayaṁ yāti mahā-prajñā prajāyate ||

devi/dasamahavidya/27_bhuvaneswari_hrida.śaṅkhaṁ cakraṁ ca bāṇaṁ dhanurapi dadhat: śaṅkhaṁ cakraṁ ca bāṇaṁ dhanur-api dadhatīṁ doś-catuṣkāmbujātau
devi/dasamahavidya/27_bhuvaneswari_hrida.māyāmādyāṁ viśiṣṭāṁ bhava bhava bhuvanāṁ: māyām-ādyāṁ viśiṣṭāṁ bhava bhava bhuvanāṁ bhū-bhavā bhāra-bhūmim ||
devi/dasamahavidya/27_bhuvaneswari_hrida.yato jagajjanma babhūva yonestadeva madh: yato jagaj-janma babhūva yones-tad-eva madhye pratipāti yāṁ vā |

devi/dasamahavidya/28_tripura_bhairavi_h.sacandrabhālabhairavāsya darśana spṛhacc: sacandra-bhāla-bhairavāsya darśana spṛhac-cakora-nīla-kañja-darśanāṁ bhajāmi bhairavīṁ sadā ||

devi/dasamahavidya/29_bhuvaneswari_panja.yena saṁrakṣito martyo bāṇaiḥ śastrairna: yena saṁrakṣito martyo bāṇaiḥ śastrair-na bādhyate ||
devi/dasamahavidya/29_bhuvaneswari_panja.jvara mārī paśu vyāghra kṛtyā caurādyupa: jvara mārī paśu vyāghra kṛtyā caurādy-upadravaiḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/29_bhuvaneswari_panja.yadi śakyamaśakyaṁ tanme bhagavati śamay: yadi śakyam-aśakyaṁ tanme bhagavati śamaya svāhā |
devi/dasamahavidya/29_bhuvaneswari_panja.trailokyamohinyai vidmahe viśvajananyai: trailokya-mohinyai vidmahe viśva-jananyai dhīmahi tannaḥ śaktiḥ pracodayāt ||
devi/dasamahavidya/29_bhuvaneswari_panja.oṁ kroṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ aiṁ sauḥ adhastānmāṁ s: oṁ kroṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ aiṁ sauḥ adhastān-māṁ sthitā pāhi vāṇinī bhuvaneśvari |
devi/dasamahavidya/29_bhuvaneswari_panja.dīpasyārambhakāle vai yaḥ kuryāt pañjara: dīpasyārambha-kāle vai yaḥ kuryāt pañjaraṁ sudhīḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/29_bhuvaneswari_panja.raṇe rājakule dyūte sarvatra vijayī bhav: raṇe rāja-kule dyūte sarvatra vijayī bhavet |
devi/dasamahavidya/29_bhuvaneswari_panja.brahmāstrādīni śastrāṇi tadgātraṁ na lag: brahmāstrādīni śastrāṇi tad-gātraṁ na laganti ca |

devi/dasamahavidya/30_bagalamukhi_kavaca.śrutvā ca bagalāpūjāṁ stotraṁ cāpi maheś: śrutvā ca bagalā-pūjāṁ stotraṁ cāpi maheśvara |
devi/dasamahavidya/30_bagalamukhi_kavaca.idānīṁ śrotumicchāmi kavacaṁ vada me pra: idānīṁ śrotum-icchāmi kavacaṁ vada me prabho ||
devi/dasamahavidya/30_bagalamukhi_kavaca.śubhadaṁ smaraṇāt puṇyaṁ trāhi māṁ duḥkh: śubhadaṁ smaraṇāt puṇyaṁ trāhi māṁ duḥkha-nāśanam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/30_bagalamukhi_kavaca.śiro me bagalā pātu hṛdayamekākṣarī parā: śiro me bagalā pātu hṛdayam-ekākṣarī parā |
devi/dasamahavidya/30_bagalamukhi_kavaca.oṁ hrīṁ oṁ me lalāṭe ca bagalā vairināśi: oṁ hrīṁ oṁ me lalāṭe ca bagalā vairi-nāśinī ||
devi/dasamahavidya/30_bagalamukhi_kavaca.gadāhastā sadā pātu mukhaṁ me mokṣadāyin: gadā-hastā sadā pātu mukhaṁ me mokṣa-dāyinī |
devi/dasamahavidya/30_bagalamukhi_kavaca.udaraṁ nābhideśaṁ ca pātu nityaṁ parātpa: udaraṁ nābhi-deśaṁ ca pātu nityaṁ parātparā |
devi/dasamahavidya/30_bagalamukhi_kavaca.mahābhaye vipattau ca paṭhedvā pāṭhayet: mahā-bhaye vipattau ca paṭhed-vā pāṭhayet tu yaḥ |

devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.vāmasthā girijā praṇamya kavacaṁ bhūtipr: vāma-sthā girijā praṇamya kavacaṁ bhūti-pradaṁ pṛcchati |
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.tasyāḥ śāpavimukta mantrasahitaṁ prītyā': tasyāḥ śāpa-vimukta mantra-sahitaṁ prītyā'dhunā brūhi mām ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.kānte śrībagalānane mama ripūn nāśāya yu: kānte śrī-bagalānane mama ripūn nāśāya yugmaṁ tviti ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.aiśvaryāṇi padaṁ ca dehi yugalaṁ śīghraṁ: aiśvaryāṇi padaṁ ca dehi yugalaṁ śīghraṁ mano-vāñchitaṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.kaṁsārestanayaṁ ca bījamaparā śaktiśca v: kaṁsāres-tanayaṁ ca bījam-aparā śaktiś-ca vāṇī tathā
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.kīlaṁ śrīmiti bhairavarṣisahitaṁ chando: kīlaṁ śrīm-iti bhairavarṣi-sahitaṁ chando virāṭ samyutam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.hastairmudgarapāśabaddharasanāṁ sambibhr: hastair-mudgara-pāśa-baddha-rasanāṁ sambibhratīṁ bhūṣaṇair-vyāptāṅgīṁ bagalāmukhīṁ tri-jagatāṁ saṁstambhinīṁ cintayet ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.pātu gaṇḍau sadā māmaiśvaryāṇyantaṁ tu m: pātu gaṇḍau sadā mām-aiśvaryāṇy-antaṁ tu mastakam ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.kāryaṁ sādhayadvandvaṁ tu karau pātu sad: kāryaṁ sādhaya-dvandvaṁ tu karau pātu sadā mama |
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.māyāyuktā tathā svāhā hṛdayaṁ pātu sarva: māyā-yuktā tathā svāhā hṛdayaṁ pātu sarvadā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.mantrarājaḥ sadā rakṣāṁ karotu mama sarv: mantra-rājaḥ sadā rakṣāṁ karotu mama sarvadā ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.oṁ hrīṁ pātu nābhideśaṁ kaṭiṁ me bagalā': oṁ hrīṁ pātu nābhi-deśaṁ kaṭiṁ me bagalā'vatu |
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.stambhayeti padaṁ pṛṣṭhaṁ pātu varṇatray: stambhayeti padaṁ pṛṣṭhaṁ pātu varṇa-trayaṁ mama ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.jihvāṁ varṇadvayaṁ pātu gulphau me kīlay: jihvāṁ varṇa-dvayaṁ pātu gulphau me kīlayeti ca |
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.pādordhvaṁ sarvadā pātu buddhiṁ pādatale: pādordhvaṁ sarvadā pātu buddhiṁ pāda-tale mama ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.hrīṁ bījaṁ sarvadā pātu buddhīndriyavacā: hrīṁ bījaṁ sarvadā pātu buddhīndriya-vacāṁsi me ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.paṭhedidaṁ hi kavacaṁ niśāyāṁ niyamāt tu: paṭhed-idaṁ hi kavacaṁ niśāyāṁ niyamāt tu yaḥ ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.guruṁ dhyātvā surāṁ pītvā rātrau śaktisa: guruṁ dhyātvā surāṁ pītvā rātrau śakti-samanvitaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.kavacaṁ yaḥ paṭheddevi tasyā'sādhyaṁ na: kavacaṁ yaḥ paṭhed-devi tasyā'sādhyaṁ na kiñcana ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.yaṁ dhyātvā prajapenmantraṁ sahasraṁ kav: yaṁ dhyātvā prajapen-mantraṁ sahasraṁ kavacaṁ paṭhet |
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.likhitvā hyadi taṁ nāma taṁ dhyātvā praj: likhitvā hyadi taṁ nāma taṁ dhyātvā prajapen-manum ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.śatakoṭiṁ japitvā tu tasya siddhirna jāy: śata-koṭiṁ japitvā tu tasya siddhir-na jāyate ||
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.dārāḍhyo manujo'sya lakṣajapataḥ prāpnot: dārāḍhyo manujo'sya lakṣa-japataḥ prāpnoti siddhiṁ parāṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.vidyāṁ śrīvijayaṁ tathā suniyataṁ dhīraṁ: vidyāṁ śrī-vijayaṁ tathā suniyataṁ dhīraṁ ca vīraṁ varam |
devi/dasamahavidya/31_bagalamukhi_kavaca.dhṛtvā rājapuraṁ vrajanti khalu ye dāso': dhṛtvā rāja-puraṁ vrajanti khalu ye dāso'sti teṣāṁ nṛpaḥ ||

devi/dasamahavidya/32_tara_ashtottarasha.dakṣiṇā caiva dakṣā ca dakṣajā dakṣiṇera: dakṣiṇā caiva dakṣā ca dakṣa-jā dakṣiṇeratā || 8 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/32_tara_ashtottarasha.bhavatyeva mahāmāye satyaṁ satyaṁ na saṁ: bhavaty-eva mahāmāye satyaṁ satyaṁ na saṁśayaḥ || 18 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/32_tara_ashtottarasha.mande maṅgalavāre ca yaḥ paṭhenniśi saṁy: mande maṅgalavāre ca yaḥ paṭhen-niśi saṁyataḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/32_tara_ashtottarasha.tasyaiva mantrasiddhiḥ syād gāṇapatyaṁ l: tasyaiva mantra-siddhiḥ syād gāṇapatyaṁ labheta saḥ || 19 ||

devi/dasamahavidya/33_shodashi_ashtottar.oṁ asya śrīṣoḍaśyaṣṭottaraśatanāmastotra: oṁ asya śrī-ṣoḍaśy-aṣṭottara-śata-nāma-stotrasya śambhur-ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup-chandaḥ śrī-ṣoḍaśī devatā dharmārtha-kāma-mokṣa-siddhaye viniyogaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/33_shodashi_ashtottar.caturvaktra jagannātha stotraṁ vada mayi: catur-vaktra jagannātha stotraṁ vada mayi prabho |
devi/dasamahavidya/33_shodashi_ashtottar.ṣaḍvargā ca ṣaḍaṅgā ca ṣoḍhā ṣoḍaśavārṣi: ṣaḍvargā ca ṣaḍaṅgā ca ṣoḍhā ṣoḍaśa-vārṣikī || 7 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/33_shodashi_ashtottar.iti te kathitaṁ gopyaṁ nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṁ: iti te kathitaṁ gopyaṁ nāmnām-aṣṭottaraṁ śatam || 17 ||

devi/dasamahavidya/34_bhuvaneswari_ashto.oṁ asya śrībhuvaneśvaryaṣṭottaraśatanāma: oṁ asya śrī-bhuvaneśvary-aṣṭottara-śata-nāma-stotrasya śaktir-ṛṣir-gāyatrīcchando bhuvaneśvarī devatā catur-varga-sādhane jape viniyogaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/34_bhuvaneswari_ashto.jayā ca vijayā caiva kaumārī sarvamaṅgal: jayā ca vijayā caiva kaumārī sarva-maṅgalā || 6 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/34_bhuvaneswari_ashto.hiṅgulā ca vilāsī ca jvālinī jvālarūpiṇī: hiṅgulā ca vilāsī ca jvālinī jvāla-rūpiṇī |
devi/dasamahavidya/34_bhuvaneswari_ashto.ya idaṁ paṭhate bhaktyā śṛṇuyādvā samāhi: ya idaṁ paṭhate bhaktyā śṛṇuyād-vā samāhitaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/34_bhuvaneswari_ashto.ye paṭhanti sadā bhaktyā na te vai duḥkh: ye paṭhanti sadā bhaktyā na te vai duḥkha-bhāginaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/34_bhuvaneswari_ashto.ekakālaṁ dvikālaṁ vā trikālaṁ vā caturth: eka-kālaṁ dvi-kālaṁ vā trikālaṁ vā caturthakam || 22 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/34_bhuvaneswari_ashto.ye paṭhanti sadā bhaktyā svargaloke ca p: ye paṭhanti sadā bhaktyā svarga-loke ca pūjitāḥ |

devi/dasamahavidya/35_tripura_bhairavi_a.na śrutaṁ devadeveśa vada māṁ dīnavatsal: na śrutaṁ deva-deveśa vada māṁ dīna-vatsala |
devi/dasamahavidya/35_tripura_bhairavi_a.iti te kathitaṁ divyaṁ nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṁ: iti te kathitaṁ divyaṁ nāmnām-aṣṭottaraṁ śatam || 19 ||

devi/dasamahavidya/36_chinnamasta_ashtot.pratyālīḍhapadāṁ sadaiva dadhatīṁ chinna: pratyālīḍha-padāṁ sadaiva dadhatīṁ chinnaṁ śiraḥ kartrikāṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/36_chinnamasta_ashtot.oṁ asya śrīchinnamastāṣṭottaraśatanāmast: oṁ asya śrī-chinnamastāṣṭottara-śata-nāma-stotrasya sadāśiva ṛṣir-anuṣṭup-chandaḥ śrī-chinnamastā devatā mama sakala-siddhi-prāptaye jape viniyogaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/36_chinnamasta_ashtot.sahasranāmapāṭhe ca aśakto yaḥ pumān bha: sahasranāma-pāṭhe ca aśakto yaḥ pumān bhavet || 2 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/36_chinnamasta_ashtot.iti te kathitaṁ devi stotraṁ paramadurla: iti te kathitaṁ devi stotraṁ parama-durlabham |

devi/dasamahavidya/37_dhumavati_ashtotta.vṛddhā virūpā vidhavā vidyā ca viraladvi: vṛddhā virūpā vidhavā vidyā ca virala-dvijā || 3 ||

devi/dasamahavidya/38_bagala_ashtottaras.oṁ asya śrīpītāmbaryaṣṭottaraśatanāmasto: oṁ asya śrī-pītāmbary-aṣṭottara-śata-nāma-stotrasya sadāśiva ṛṣir-anuṣṭup-chandaḥ śrī-pītāmbarī devatā śrī-pītāmbarī-prītaye jape viniyogaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/38_bagala_ashtottaras.ripūṇāṁ stambhanaṁ yāti satyaṁ satyaṁ va: ripūṇāṁ stambhanaṁ yāti satyaṁ satyaṁ vadāmy-aham || 3 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/38_bagala_ashtottaras.raktā nīlā ghanā śubhrā śvetā saubhāgyad: raktā nīlā ghanā śubhrā śvetā saubhāgya-dāyinī |
devi/dasamahavidya/38_bagala_ashtottaras.iti te kathitaṁ vipra nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṁ ś: iti te kathitaṁ vipra nāmnām-aṣṭottaraṁ śatam || 17 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/38_bagala_ashtottaras.drutaṁ bhavettasya samastavṛddhirvināśam: drutaṁ bhavet-tasya samasta-vṛddhir-vināśam-āyāti ca tasya śatruḥ || 19 ||

devi/dasamahavidya/39_matangi_ashtottara.oṁ asya śrīmātaṅgīśatanāmnāṁ bhagavān ma: oṁ asya śrī-mātaṅgī-śata-nāmnāṁ bhagavān mataṅga ṛṣir-anuṣṭup-chando mātaṅgī devatā mātaṅgī-prītaye jape viniyogaḥ |
devi/dasamahavidya/39_matangi_ashtottara.yad guhyaṁ sarvatantreṣu kenāpi na prakā: yad guhyaṁ sarva-tantreṣu kenāpi na prakāśitam || 1 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/39_matangi_ashtottara.kṣamā kṣemaśīlā kṣapākāriṇī cākṣayaprīti: kṣamā kṣema-śīlā kṣapākāriṇī cākṣaya-prīti-dā bhūti-yuktā bhavānī |
devi/dasamahavidya/39_matangi_ashtottara.iti te kathitaṁ devi nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṁ śa: iti te kathitaṁ devi nāmnām-aṣṭottaraṁ śatam |
devi/dasamahavidya/39_matangi_ashtottara.gopyaṁ ca sarvatantreṣu gopanīyaṁ ca sar: gopyaṁ ca sarva-tantreṣu gopanīyaṁ ca sarvadā || 14 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/39_matangi_ashtottara.na tasya duṣkaraṁ kiñcijjāyate sparśataḥ: na tasya duṣkaraṁ kiñcij-jāyate sparśataḥ kṣaṇāt |
devi/dasamahavidya/39_matangi_ashtottara.ayogā ye tava evāgre suyogāśca bhavanti: ayogā ye tava evāgre suyogāś-ca bhavanti vai || 17 ||

devi/dasamahavidya/40_kamala_ashtottaras.daṇḍaṁ śaktimasiṁ ca carma jalajaṁ ghaṇṭ: daṇḍaṁ śaktim-asiṁ ca carma jalajaṁ ghaṇṭāṁ surā-bhājanam |
devi/dasamahavidya/40_kamala_ashtottaras.śūlaṁ pāśasudarśane ca daśatīṁ hastaiḥ p: śūlaṁ pāśa-sudarśane ca daśatīṁ hastaiḥ prasannānanāṁ
devi/dasamahavidya/40_kamala_ashtottaras.śūlinī cakriṇī mā ca pāśinī śaṅkhadhāriṇ: śūlinī cakriṇī mā ca pāśinī śaṅkha-dhāriṇī |
devi/dasamahavidya/40_kamala_ashtottaras.yaṁ yaṁ kāmayate kāmaṁ taṁ taṁ prāpnotya: yaṁ yaṁ kāmayate kāmaṁ taṁ taṁ prāpnoty-asaṁśayaḥ || 18 ||
devi/dasamahavidya/40_kamala_ashtottaras.imaṁ stavaṁ yaḥ paṭhatīha martyo vaikuṇṭ: imaṁ stavaṁ yaḥ paṭhatīha martyo vaikuṇṭha-patnyāḥ paramādareṇa |

devi/durga/01_durga_pancaratnam.txt.iti paramapūjya śrī candraśekharendra sa: iti parama-pūjya śrī candraśekharendra sarasvatī svāmi kṛtaṁ durgā pañca-ratnaṁ sampūrṇam |

devi/durga/02_durga_saptashloki.txt.asya śrī durgā saptaślokī stotramantrasy: asya śrī durgā saptaślokī stotra-mantrasya nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ, anuṣṭup chandaḥ, śrī mahākālī mahālakṣmī mahāsarasvatyo devatāḥ, śrī durgā prīty-arthaṁ saptaślokī durgā-pāṭhe viniyogaḥ |
devi/durga/02_durga_saptashloki.txt.jñānināmapi cetāṁsi devī bhagavatī hi sā: jñāninām-api cetāṁsi devī bhagavatī hi sā |
devi/durga/02_durga_saptashloki.txt.bhayebhyastrāhi no devi durge devi namo': bhayebhyas-trāhi no devi durge devi namo'stu te ||

devi/durga/03_argala_stotram.txt.oṁ asya śrī argalāstotramahāmantrasya vi: oṁ asya śrī argalā-stotra-mahā-mantrasya viṣṇuḥ ṛṣiḥ | anuṣṭup chandaḥ | śrī mahālakṣmīr-devatā |
devi/durga/03_argala_stotram.txt.pustakaṁ cākṣamālāṁ ca varaṁ cābhayakaṁ: pustakaṁ cākṣa-mālāṁ ca varaṁ cābhayakaṁ kramāt ||
devi/durga/03_argala_stotram.txt.sā devī navakoṭimūrtisahitā māṁ pātu viś: sā devī nava-koṭi-mūrti-sahitā māṁ pātu viśveśvarī ||
devi/durga/03_argala_stotram.txt.jaya sarvagate devi kālarātri namo'stu t: jaya sarva-gate devi kālarātri namo'stu te ||
devi/durga/03_argala_stotram.txt.dehi saubhāgyamārogyaṁ dehi devi paraṁ s: dehi saubhāgyam-ārogyaṁ dehi devi paraṁ sukham |
devi/durga/03_argala_stotram.txt.idaṁ stotraṁ paṭhitvā tu mahāstotraṁ paṭ: idaṁ stotraṁ paṭhitvā tu mahā-stotraṁ paṭhen-naraḥ |

devi/durga/04_kilaka_stotram.txt.oṁ asya śrīkīlakamantrasya śivaṛṣiḥ anuṣ: oṁ asya śrī-kīlaka-mantrasya śivaṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup-chandaḥ śrī-mahāsarasvatī devatā śrī-jagad-ambā-prīty-arthaṁ saptaśatī-pāṭhāṅgatvena jape viniyogaḥ |
devi/durga/04_kilaka_stotram.txt.na mantro nauṣadhaṁ tasya na kiñcidapi v: na mantro nauṣadhaṁ tasya na kiñcid-api vidyate |
devi/durga/04_kilaka_stotram.txt.stotraṁ vai caṇḍikāyāstu tacca guhyaṁ ca: stotraṁ vai caṇḍikāyās-tu tacca guhyaṁ cakāra saḥ |
devi/durga/04_kilaka_stotram.txt.śatruhāniḥ paro mokṣaḥ stūyate sā na kiṁ: śatru-hāniḥ paro mokṣaḥ stūyate sā na kiṁ janaiḥ ||
devi/durga/04_kilaka_stotram.txt.hṛdyaṁ kāmamavāpnoti hṛdi devī sadā vase: hṛdyaṁ kāmam-avāpnoti hṛdi devī sadā vaset ||

devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.cāmuṇḍā devatā | aṅganyāsokta mātaro bīj: cāmuṇḍā devatā | aṅga-nyāsokta mātaro bījam | navāvaraṇo mantra-śaktiḥ | dig-bandha devatāḥ tatvam | śrī jagad-ambā prīty-arthe saptaśatī pāṭhāṅgatvena jape viniyogaḥ ||
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.oṁ yadguhyaṁ paramaṁ loke sarvarakṣākara: oṁ yad-guhyaṁ paramaṁ loke sarva-rakṣā-karaṁ nṛṇām |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.nāpadaṁ tasya paśyāmi śokaduḥkhabhayaṁ n: nāpadaṁ tasya paśyāmi śoka-duḥkha-bhayaṁ na hi ||
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.kheṭakaṁ tomaraṁ caiva paraśuṁ pāśameva: kheṭakaṁ tomaraṁ caiva paraśuṁ pāśam-eva ca |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.trāhi māṁ devi duṣprekṣye śatrūṇāṁ bhaya: trāhi māṁ devi duṣprekṣye śatrūṇāṁ bhaya-vardhini |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.trinetrā ca bhruvormadhye yamaghaṇṭā ca: trinetrā ca bhruvor-madhye yama-ghaṇṭā ca nāsike ||
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.dantān rakṣatu kaumārī kaṇṭhadeśe tu caṇ: dantān rakṣatu kaumārī kaṇṭha-deśe tu caṇḍikā |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.ghaṇṭikāṁ citraghaṇṭā ca mahāmāyā ca tāl: ghaṇṭikāṁ citra-ghaṇṭā ca mahāmāyā ca tāluke ||
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.nābhau ca kāminī rakṣedguhyaṁ guhyeśvarī: nābhau ca kāminī rakṣed-guhyaṁ guhyeśvarī tathā |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.śukraṁ brahmāṇi! me rakṣecchāyāṁ chatreś: śukraṁ brahmāṇi! me rakṣec-chāyāṁ chatreśvarī tathā |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.rakṣāhīnaṁ tu yatsthānaṁ varjitaṁ kavace: rakṣā-hīnaṁ tu yat-sthānaṁ varjitaṁ kavacena tu |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.tatsarvaṁ rakṣa me devi! jayantī pāpanāś: tat-sarvaṁ rakṣa me devi! jayantī pāpa-nāśinī ||
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.idaṁ tu devyāḥ kavacaṁ devānāmapi durlab: idaṁ tu devyāḥ kavacaṁ devānām-api durlabham ||
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.sthāvaraṁ jaṅgamaṁ caiva kṛtrimaṁ caiva: sthāvaraṁ jaṅgamaṁ caiva kṛtrimaṁ caiva yad-viṣam |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.japetsaptaśatīṁ caṇḍīṁ kṛtvā tu kavacaṁ: japet-saptaśatīṁ caṇḍīṁ kṛtvā tu kavacaṁ purā |
devi/durga/05_devi_kavacam.txt.iti vārāhapurāṇe hariharabrahmaviracitaṁ: iti vārāha-purāṇe harihara-brahma-viracitaṁ devyāḥ kavacaṁ sampūrṇam ||

devi/durga/06_aparajita_stotram.txt.namo jagatpratiṣṭhāyai devyai kṛtyai nam: namo jagat-pratiṣṭhāyai devyai kṛtyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/durga/06_aparajita_stotram.txt.citirūpeṇa yā kṛtsnametad vyāpya sthitā: citi-rūpeṇa yā kṛtsnam-etad vyāpya sthitā jagat |

devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.lakṣmīśe yoganidrāṁ prabhajati bhujagādh: lakṣmīśe yoganidrāṁ prabhajati bhujagādhīśa-talpe sadarpāv-utpannau dānavau tacchravaṇa-mala-mayāṅgau madhuṁ kaiṭabhaṁ ca |
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.dṛṣṭvā bhītasya dhātuḥ stutibhirabhinutā: dṛṣṭvā bhītasya dhātuḥ stutibhir-abhinutāṁ āśu tau nāśayantīṁ durgāṁ devīṁ prapadye śaraṇam-aham-aśeṣāpad-unmūlanāya ||
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.yuddhe nirjitya daityastribhuvanamakhila: yuddhe nirjitya daityas-tri-bhuvanam-akhilaṁ yas-tadīyeṣu dhiṣṇyeṣv-āsthāya svān vidheyān svayam-agamad-asau śakratāṁ vikrameṇa |
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.taṁ sāmātyāptamitraṁ mahiṣamapi nihatyās: taṁ sāmātyāpta-mitraṁ mahiṣam-api nihatyāsya mūrdhādhirūḍhāṁ durgāṁ devīṁ prapadye śaraṇam-aham-aśeṣāpad-unmūlanāya ||
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.viśvotpattipraṇāśasthitivihṛtipare devi: viśvotpatti-praṇāśa-sthiti-vihṛti-pare devi ghorāmarāri-trāsāt-trātuṁ kulaṁ naḥ punar-api ca mahā-saṅkaṭeṣv-īdṛśeṣu |
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.āvirbhūyāḥ purastāditi caraṇanamatsarvag: āvirbhūyāḥ purastād-iti caraṇa-namat-sarva-gīrvāṇa-vargāṁ durgāṁ devīṁ prapadye śaraṇam-aham-aśeṣāpad-unmūlanāya ||
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.hantuṁ śumbhaṁ niśumbhaṁ vibudhagaṇanutā: hantuṁ śumbhaṁ niśumbhaṁ vibudha-gaṇa-nutāṁ hema-ḍolāṁ himādrāv-ārūḍhāṁ vyūḍha-darpān yudhi nihatavatīṁ dhūmradṛk-caṇḍa-muṇḍān |
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.cāmuṇḍākhyāṁ dadhānāṁ upaśamitamahārakta: cāmuṇḍākhyāṁ dadhānāṁ upaśamita-mahā-raktabījopasargāṁ durgāṁ devīṁ prapadye śaraṇam-aham-aśeṣāpad-unmūlanāya ||
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.brahmeśaskandanārāyaṇakiṭinarasiṁhendraś: brahmeśa-skanda-nārāyaṇa-kiṭi-narasiṁhendra-śaktīḥ sva-bhṛtyāḥ kṛtvā hatvā niśumbhaṁ jita-vibudha-gaṇaṁ trāsitāśeṣalokam |
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.ekībhūyātha śumbhaṁ raṇaśirasi nihatyāst: ekībhūyātha śumbhaṁ raṇa-śirasi nihatyāsthitām-ātta-khaḍgāṁ durgāṁ devīṁ prapadye śaraṇam-aham-aśeṣāpad-unmūlanāya ||
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.utpannā nandajeti svayamavanitale śumbha: utpannā nandajeti svayam-avani-tale śumbham-anyaṁ niśumbhaṁ bhrāmaryākhyāruṇākhyā punar-api jananī durgamākhyaṁ nihantum |
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.bhīmā śākambharīti truṭitaripubhaṭāṁ rak: bhīmā śākambharīti truṭita-ripu-bhaṭāṁ raktadanteti jātāṁ durgāṁ devīṁ prapadye śaraṇam-aham-aśeṣāpad-unmūlanāya ||
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.traiguṇyānāṁ guṇānāṁ anusaraṇakalākeli n: traiguṇyānāṁ guṇānāṁ anusaraṇa-kalā-keli nānāvatāraiḥ trailokya-trāṇa-śīlāṁ danuja-kula-vana-vahni-līlāṁ salīlām |
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.devīṁ saccinmayīṁ tāṁ vitaritavinamatsat: devīṁ saccinmayīṁ tāṁ vitarita-vinamat-satrivargāpavargāṁ durgāṁ devīṁ prapadye śaraṇam-aham-aśeṣāpad-unmūlanāya ||
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.siṁhārūḍhāṁ trinetrīṁ karatalavilasaccha: siṁhārūḍhāṁ trinetrīṁ kara-tala-vilasacchaṅkha-cakrāsi-ramyāṁ bhaktābhīṣṭa-pradātrīṁ ripu-mathana-karīṁ sarva-lokaika-vandyām |
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.sarvālaṅkārayuktāṁ śaśiyutamakuṭāṁ śyāma: sarvālaṅkāra-yuktāṁ śaśi-yuta-makuṭāṁ śyāmalāṅgīṁ kṛśāṅgīṁ durgāṁ devīṁ prapadye śaraṇam-aham-aśeṣāpad-unmūlanāya ||
devi/durga/07_apadunmulana_durga_stotram.trāyasva svāminīti tribhuvanajanani prār: trāyasva svāminīti tri-bhuvana-janani prārthanā tvayy-apārthā pālyante'bhyarthanāyāṁ bhagavati śiśavaḥ kintv-ananyāḥ jananyāḥ |

devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.namaste śaraṇye śive sānukampe namaste j: namaste śaraṇye śive sānukampe namaste jagad-vyāpike viśvarūpe |
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.namaste jagadvandyapādāravinde namaste j: namaste jagad-vandya-pādāravinde namaste jagat-tāriṇi trāhi durge ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.namaste namaste sadānandarūpe namaste ja: namaste namaste sadānanda-rūpe namaste jagat-tāriṇi trāhi durge ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.tvamekā gatirdevi nistārakartrī namaste: tvam-ekā gatir-devi nistāra-kartrī namaste jagat-tāriṇi trāhi durge ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.araṇye raṇe dāruṇe śatrumadhye'nale sāga: araṇye raṇe dāruṇe śatru-madhye'nale sāgare prāntare rāja-gehe |
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.tvamekā gatirdevi nistāranaukā namaste j: tvam-ekā gatir-devi nistāra-naukā namaste jagat-tāriṇi trāhi durge ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.tvamekā gatirdevi nistāraheturnamaste ja: tvam-ekā gatir-devi nistāra-hetur-namaste jagat-tāriṇi trāhi durge ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.tvamekā gatirdevi nistārabījaṁ namaste j: tvam-ekā gatir-devi nistāra-bījaṁ namaste jagat-tāriṇi trāhi durge ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.iḍā piṅgalā tvaṁ suṣumnā ca nāḍī namaste: iḍā piṅgalā tvaṁ suṣumnā ca nāḍī namaste jagat-tāriṇi trāhi durge ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.namo devi durge śive bhīmanāde sadāsarva: namo devi durge śive bhīma-nāde sadā-sarva-siddhi-pradātṛ-svarūpe |
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.vibhūtiḥ śacī kālarātriḥ satī tvaṁ namas: vibhūtiḥ śacī kālarātriḥ satī tvaṁ namaste jagat-tāriṇi trāhi durge ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.śaraṇamasi surāṇāṁ siddhavidyādharāṇāṁ m: śaraṇam-asi surāṇāṁ siddha-vidyādharāṇāṁ muni-manuja-paśūnāṁ dasyubhis-trāsitānāṁ nṛpati-gṛha-gatānāṁ vyādhibhiḥ pīḍitānām |
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.sarvaṁ vā ślokamekaṁ vā yaḥ paṭhedbhakti: sarvaṁ vā ślokam-ekaṁ vā yaḥ paṭhed-bhaktimān-sadā ||
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.paṭhanādasya deveśi kiṁ na siddhyati bhū: paṭhanād-asya deveśi kiṁ na siddhyati bhūtale |
devi/durga/08_durga_apaduddharashtakam.t.iti śrī siddheśvarītantre paramaśivokta: iti śrī siddheśvarī-tantre paramaśivokta śrī durgā āpad-uddhāra stotram |

devi/durga/09_durga_kavacam.txt.ajñātvā kavacaṁ devi durgāmantraṁ ca yo: ajñātvā kavacaṁ devi durgā-mantraṁ ca yo japet |

devi/durga/20_durga_arya_stavam.txt.tribhirmāsaiḥ kāṅkṣitaṁ ca phalaṁ vai sa: tribhir-māsaiḥ kāṅkṣitaṁ ca phalaṁ vai samprayacchasi |

devi/durga/20_durga_arya_stavam.txt.nṛṇāṁ bandhaṁ vadhaṁ ghoraṁ putranāśaṁ d: nṛṇāṁ bandhaṁ vadhaṁ ghoraṁ putra-nāśaṁ dhana-kṣayam ||
devi/durga/20_durga_arya_stavam.txt.mohayitvā ca taṁ kaṁsamekā tvaṁ bhokṣyas: mohayitvā ca taṁ kaṁsam-ekā tvaṁ bhokṣyase jagat |

devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.oṁ bhadraṁ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadr: oṁ bhadraṁ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṁ paśyemākṣabhir-yajatrāḥ |

devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no: svasti nas-tārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatir-dadhātu ||
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.oṁ sarve vai devā devīmupatasthuḥ kāsi t: oṁ sarve vai devā devīm-upatasthuḥ kāsi tvaṁ mahādevīti ||
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.ahaṁ suve pitaramasya mūrdhanmama yonira: ahaṁ suve pitaram-asya mūrdhan-mama yonir-apsv-antaḥ samudre |

devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.tāmagnivarṇāṁ tapasā jvalantīṁ vairocanī: tām-agni-varṇāṁ tapasā jvalantīṁ vairocanīṁ karma-phaleṣu juṣṭām |
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.durgāṁ devīṁ śaraṇaṁ prapadyāmahe'surānn: durgāṁ devīṁ śaraṇaṁ prapadyāmahe'surān-nāśayitryai te namaḥ ||
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.devīṁ vācamajanayanta devāstāṁ viśvarūpā: devīṁ vācam-ajanayanta devās-tāṁ viśvarūpāḥ paśavo vadanti |
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.sā no mandreṣamūrjaṁ duhānā dhenurvāgasm: sā no mandreṣam-ūrjaṁ duhānā dhenur-vāg-asmān-upa suṣṭutaitu ||
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.mahālakṣmyai ca vidmahe sarvaśaktyai ca: mahālakṣmyai ca vidmahe sarva-śaktyai ca dhīmahi |
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.kāmo yoniḥ kamalā vajrapāṇirguhā hasā mā: kāmo yoniḥ kamalā vajrapāṇir-guhā hasā mātariśvābhram-indraḥ |
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.punarguhā sakalā māyayā ca purūcyaiṣā vi: punar-guhā sakalā māyayā ca purūcyaiṣā viśvamātādividyom ||
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.eṣā śrīmahāvidyā | ya evaṁ veda sa śokaṁ: eṣā śrī-mahāvidyā | ya evaṁ veda sa śokaṁ tarati ||
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.saiṣā dvādaśādityāḥ | saiṣā viśvedevāḥ s: saiṣā dvādaśādityāḥ | saiṣā viśvedevāḥ somapā asomapāś-ca |
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.anantāṁ vijayāṁ śuddhāṁ śaraṇyāṁ śivadāṁ: anantāṁ vijayāṁ śuddhāṁ śaraṇyāṁ śiva-dāṁ śivām ||
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.yasyāḥ svarūpaṁ brahmādayo na jānanti ta: yasyāḥ svarūpaṁ brahmādayo na jānanti tasmād-ucyate ajñeyā |
devi/durga/21_devi_atharvashirsha.txt.yasyā anto na labhyate tasmāducyate anan: yasyā anto na labhyate tasmād-ucyate anantā |

devi/durga/22_durga_stotram_arjuna_kruta.tvaṁ brahmavidyā vidyānāṁ mahānidrā ca d: tvaṁ brahma-vidyā vidyānāṁ mahā-nidrā ca dehinām |

devi/durga/22_durga_stotram_arjuna_kruta.tvaṁ jambhanī mohinī ca māyā hrīḥ śrīsta: tvaṁ jambhanī mohinī ca māyā hrīḥ śrīs-tathaiva ca |
devi/durga/22_durga_stotram_arjuna_kruta.iti śrīmanmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi tray: iti śrīman-mahābhārate bhīṣma-parvaṇi trayoviṁśo'dhyāye arjuna kṛta śrī durgā stotram |

devi/durga/23_durga_stotram_yudhishthira.pātrī ca paṅkajī ghaṇṭī strīviśuddhā ca: pātrī ca paṅkajī ghaṇṭī strī-viśuddhā ca yā bhuvi |
devi/durga/23_durga_stotram_yudhishthira.prasannā me suraśreṣṭhe dayāṁ kuru śivā: prasannā me sura-śreṣṭhe dayāṁ kuru śivā bhava ||
devi/durga/23_durga_stotram_yudhishthira.jayā tvaṁ vijayā caiva saṅgrāme ca jayap: jayā tvaṁ vijayā caiva saṅgrāme ca jaya-pradā |

devi/durga/23_durga_stotram_yudhishthira.iti śrīmanmahābhārate virāṭaparvaṇi aṣṭa: iti śrīman-mahābhārate virāṭa-parvaṇi aṣṭamo'dhyāye yudhiṣṭhira kṛta śrī durgā stotram |

devi/durga/26_mangala_chandika_stotram.t.jagaddhātrīṁ ca dātrīṁ ca sarvebhyaḥ sar: jagad-dhātrīṁ ca dātrīṁ ca sarvebhyaḥ sarva-sampadām ||
devi/durga/26_mangala_chandika_stotram.t.sāre ca maṅgalādhāre pāre tvaṁ sarvakarm: sāre ca maṅgalādhāre pāre tvaṁ sarva-karmaṇām |

devi/durga/26_mangala_chandika_stotram.t.iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe prakṛti: iti śrī-brahmavaivarte mahā-purāṇe prakṛti-khaṇḍe nārada-nārāyaṇa-saṁvāde catuścatvāriṁśo'dhyāye maṅgala caṇḍikā stotram |

devi/durga/29_durga_stotram_krishna_krut.grāme grāme grāmadevī gṛhadevī gṛhe gṛhe: grāme grāme grāma-devī gṛha-devī gṛhe gṛhe |

devi/durga/29_durga_stotram_krishna_krut.tathānte tvaṁ mahāmārī viśve viśvaiśca p: tathānte tvaṁ mahā-mārī viśve viśvaiś-ca pūjite |
devi/durga/29_durga_stotram_krishna_krut.yayā mugdho hi vidvāṁśca mokṣamārgaṁ na: yayā mugdho hi vidvāṁś-ca mokṣa-mārgaṁ na paśyati ||

devi/durga/30_durga_stotram_mahadeva_kru.māyayā puruṣastvaṁ ca māyayā prakṛtiḥ sv: māyayā puruṣas-tvaṁ ca māyayā prakṛtiḥ svayam |
devi/durga/30_durga_stotram_mahadeva_kru.goloke ca svayaṁ rādhā śrīkṛṣṇasyaiva va: goloke ca svayaṁ rādhā śrī-kṛṣṇasyaiva vakṣasi |

devi/durga/30_durga_stotram_mahadeva_kru.gandharūpā ca bhūmau ca ākāśe śabdarūpiṇ: gandha-rūpā ca bhūmau ca ākāśe śabda-rūpiṇī |

devi/durga/30_durga_stotram_mahadeva_kru.kṣut tvaṁ dayā tvaṁ nidrā tvaṁ tṛṣṇā tva: kṣut tvaṁ dayā tvaṁ nidrā tvaṁ tṛṣṇā tvaṁ buddhi-rūpiṇī |
devi/durga/30_durga_stotram_mahadeva_kru.tuṣṭistvaṁ cāpi puṣṭistvaṁ śraddhāstvaṁ: tuṣṭis-tvaṁ cāpi puṣṭis-tvaṁ śraddhāstvaṁ ca kṣamā svayam ||
devi/durga/30_durga_stotram_mahadeva_kru.śāntistvaṁ ca svayaṁ bhrāntiḥ kāntistvaṁ: śāntis-tvaṁ ca svayaṁ bhrāntiḥ kāntis-tvaṁ kīrtir-eva ca |
devi/durga/30_durga_stotram_mahadeva_kru.lajjā tvaṁ ca tathā māyā bhuktimuktisvar: lajjā tvaṁ ca tathā māyā bhukti-mukti-svarūpiṇī ||
devi/durga/30_durga_stotram_mahadeva_kru.kṛpāṁ kuru mahāmāye mama śatrukṣayaṁ kur: kṛpāṁ kuru mahāmāye mama śatru-kṣayaṁ kuru ||

devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.kṛṣṇastāṁ sahasā bhīto vīryādhānaṁ cakār: kṛṣṇas-tāṁ sahasā bhīto vīryādhānaṁ cakāra ha ||

devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.kṛṣṇena vidyā yā dattā sarvajñānaprasūḥ: kṛṣṇena vidyā yā dattā sarva-jñāna-prasūḥ śubhā |
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.stutvā muktaśca yāṁ devīṁ tāṁ mūrdhnā pr: stutvā muktaś-ca yāṁ devīṁ tāṁ mūrdhnā praṇamāmy-aham ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.babhūva śaktimān stutvā tāṁ durgāṁ praṇa: babhūva śaktimān stutvā tāṁ durgāṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.yāṁ tuṣṭuvuḥ surāḥ sarve tāṁ durgāṁ praṇ: yāṁ tuṣṭuvuḥ surāḥ sarve tāṁ durgāṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.jaghāna tripuraṁ stutvā tāṁ durgāṁ praṇa: jaghāna tripuraṁ stutvā tāṁ durgāṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.sraṣṭā sṛjati sṛṣṭiṁ ca pātā pāti yadājñ: sraṣṭā sṛjati sṛṣṭiṁ ca pātā pāti yad-ājñayā |
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.yayā vinā na śaktaśca sṛṣṭiṁ kartuṁ namā: yayā vinā na śaktaś-ca sṛṣṭiṁ kartuṁ namāmi tām ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.ityuktvā paraśurāmaśca natvā tāṁ ca ruro: ity-uktvā paraśurāmaś-ca natvā tāṁ ca ruroda ha |
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.bhaktirbhavatu te kṛṣṇe śivade ca śive g: bhaktir-bhavatu te kṛṣṇe śivade ca śive gurau ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.taṁ hantuṁ na hi śaktā vā ruṣṭā vā sarva: taṁ hantuṁ na hi śaktā vā ruṣṭā vā sarva-devatāḥ ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.śrīkṛṣṇasya ca bhaktastvaṁ śiṣyo vai śaṅ: śrī-kṛṣṇasya ca bhaktas-tvaṁ śiṣyo vai śaṅkarasya ca |
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.anyadeveṣu ye bhaktā na bhaktā vā niraṅk: anya-deveṣu ye bhaktā na bhaktā vā niraṅkuśāḥ ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.teṣāṁ tārāgaṇā ruṣṭāḥ kiṁ kurvanti ca du: teṣāṁ tārā-gaṇā ruṣṭāḥ kiṁ kurvanti ca durbalāḥ ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.tasya kiṁ vā kariṣyanti ruṣṭā bhṛtyāśca: tasya kiṁ vā kariṣyanti ruṣṭā bhṛtyāś-ca durbalāḥ ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.ityuktvā pārvatī tuṣṭā dattvā rāmāya cāś: ity-uktvā pārvatī tuṣṭā dattvā rāmāya cāśiṣam |
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.stotraṁ vai kāṇvaśākhoktaṁ pūjākāle ca y: stotraṁ vai kāṇva-śākhoktaṁ pūjā-kāle ca yaḥ paṭhet |
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.yasya ruṣṭo gururdevo rājā vā bāndhavo't: yasya ruṣṭo gurur-devo rājā vā bāndhavo'thavā ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.rājadvāre śmaśāne ca kārāgāre ca bandhan: rāja-dvāre śmaśāne ca kārāgāre ca bandhane ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.kṛtvā haviṣyaṁ varṣaṁ ca stotrarājaṁ śṛṇ: kṛtvā haviṣyaṁ varṣaṁ ca stotra-rājaṁ śṛṇoti yā ||
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.bhaktyā durgāṁ ca sampūjya mahāvandhyā p: bhaktyā durgāṁ ca sampūjya mahā-vandhyā prasūyate |
devi/durga/31_durga_stotram_parashurama_.stotrarājaṁ yā śṛṇoti sā putraṁ labhate: stotra-rājaṁ yā śṛṇoti sā putraṁ labhate dhruvam |

devi/durga/32_durga_stotram_shivarahasye.durgāṁ śivāṁ śāntikarīṁ brahmāṇīṁ brahma: durgāṁ śivāṁ śānti-karīṁ brahmāṇīṁ brahmaṇaḥ priyām |
devi/durga/32_durga_stotram_shivarahasye.ya idaṁ paṭhate stotraṁ śṛṇuyādvāpi yo n: ya idaṁ paṭhate stotraṁ śṛṇuyād-vāpi yo naraḥ |
devi/durga/32_durga_stotram_shivarahasye.sa muktaḥ sarvapāpaistu modate durgayā s: sa muktaḥ sarva-pāpais-tu modate durgayā saha ||

devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.kanyā prajā putriṇī syādetat stotra prab: kanyā prajā putriṇī syād-etat stotra prabhāvataḥ |
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.grahabādhā devabādhā bādhā śatrukṛtā ca: graha-bādhā deva-bādhā bādhā śatru-kṛtā ca yā ||
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.sarve rogāḥ vinaśyanti sarve bālagrahāśc: sarve rogāḥ vinaśyanti sarve bāla-grahāś-ca ye ||
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.ūrdhvaṁ tu śāradā rakṣedadho rakṣatu pār: ūrdhvaṁ tu śāradā rakṣed-adho rakṣatu pārvatī |
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.īśānī ca bhujau rakṣetkukṣiṁ nābhiṁ ca k: īśānī ca bhujau rakṣet-kukṣiṁ nābhiṁ ca kālikā ||
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.ūrū rakṣatu kaumārī jayā jānudvayaṁ tath: ūrū rakṣatu kaumārī jayā jānu-dvayaṁ tathā ||
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.putrasaukhyaṁ dehi dehi garbharakṣāṁ kur: putra-saukhyaṁ dehi dehi garbha-rakṣāṁ kuruṣva naḥ ||
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.oṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ śrīṁ śrīṁ aiṁ aiṁ: oṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ śrīṁ śrīṁ aiṁ aiṁ aiṁ mahākālī mahālakṣmī mahāsarasvatī rūpāyai nava-koṭi-mūrtyai durgāyai namaḥ ||
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.oṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ durgārtināśinī santāna: oṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ durgārti-nāśinī santāna-saukhyaṁ dehi dehi vandhyatvaṁ mṛta-vatsatvaṁ ca hara hara garbha-rakṣāṁ kuru kuru sakalāṁ bādhāṁ kulajāṁ bāhyajāṁ kṛtāṁ akṛtāṁ ca nāśaya nāśaya sarva-gātrāṇi rakṣa rakṣa garbhaṁ poṣaya poṣaya sarvopadravaṁ śoṣaya śoṣaya svāhā ||
devi/durga/35_vamsavruddhikaram_durga_ka.ṛtusnāta jalaṁ pītvā bhavet garbhavatī d: ṛtu-snāta jalaṁ pītvā bhavet garbhavatī dhruvam |

devi/durga/36_durga_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ hema prakhyāmindu khaṇḍāttamauliṁ śaṅ: oṁ hema prakhyāmindu khaṇḍātta-mauliṁ śaṅkhābhīṣṭā bhīti hastāṁ trinetrām |
devi/durga/36_durga_panjara_stotram.txt.hemābjasthāṁ pīna vastrāṁ prasannāṁ devī: hemābja-sthāṁ pīna vastrāṁ prasannāṁ devīṁ durgāṁ divya-rūpāṁ namāmi |
devi/durga/36_durga_panjara_stotram.txt.varade tvaṁ mahāghore durge rakṣa namo's: varade tvaṁ mahā-ghore durge rakṣa namo'stute ||
devi/durga/36_durga_panjara_stotram.txt.deva dvāre nadī tīre rājadvāre ca saṅkaṭ: deva dvāre nadī tīre rāja-dvāre ca saṅkaṭe |

devi/durga/37_durga_ashtottarashatanama_.yasya prasādamātreṇa durgā prītā bhavet: yasya prasāda-mātreṇa durgā prītā bhavet satī ||

devi/durga/39_vedokta_ratri_suktam.txt.oṁ rātrītyādyaṣṭarcasya sūktasya kuśikaḥ: oṁ rātrīty-ādy-aṣṭarcasya sūktasya kuśikaḥ saubharo rātrir-vā bhāradvājo ṛṣiḥ, rātrir-devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, devī-māhātmya-pāṭhe viniyogaḥ |
devi/durga/39_vedokta_ratri_suktam.txt.sā no adya yasyā vayaṁ ni te yāmannavikṣ: sā no adya yasyā vayaṁ ni te yāmann-avikṣamahi |
devi/durga/39_vedokta_ratri_suktam.txt.1—brahmamāyātmikā rātriḥ parameśalayātmi: 1—brahma-māyātmikā rātriḥ parameśa-layātmikā | tad-adhiṣṭhātṛ-devī tu bhuvaneśī prakīrtitā || (devīpurāṇa)

devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.oṁ ahamityaṣṭarcasya sūktasya vāgāmbhṛṇī: oṁ aham-ity-aṣṭarcasya sūktasya vāg-āmbhṛṇī ṛṣiḥ, saccit-sukhātmakaḥ sarva-gataḥ paramātmā devatā, dvitīyāyā ṛcco jagatī, śiṣṭānāṁ triṣṭup chandaḥ, devī-māhātmya-pāṭhe viniyogaḥ|
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.ahaṁ somamāhanasaṁ bibharmyahaṁ tvaṣṭāra: ahaṁ somam-āhanasaṁ bibharmy-ahaṁ tvaṣṭāram-uta pūṣaṇaṁ bhagam|
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.tāṁ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhāt: tāṁ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūri-sthātrāṁ bhūryyāveśayantīm||
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.mayā so annamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇi: mayā so annam-atti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇiti ya īṁ śṛṇoty-uktam|
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.ahameva svayamidaṁ vadāmi juṣṭaṁ devebhi: aham-eva svayam-idaṁ vadāmi juṣṭaṁ devebhir-uta mānuṣebhiḥ|
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.yaṁ kāmaye taṁ tamugraṁ kṛṇomi taṁ brahm: yaṁ kāmaye taṁ tam-ugraṁ kṛṇomi taṁ brahmāṇaṁ tam-ṛṣiṁ taṁ sumedhām||
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.ahaṁ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe: ahaṁ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahma-dviṣe śarave hantavā u|
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.ahaṁ janāya samadaṁ kṛṇomyahaṁ dyāvāpṛth: ahaṁ janāya samadaṁ kṛṇomy-ahaṁ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa||
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.ahaṁ suve pitaramasya mūrdhanmama yonira: ahaṁ suve pitaram-asya mūrdhan-mama yonir-apsv-antaḥ samudre|
devi/durga/42_rgvedokta_devi_suktam.txt.ahameva vāta iva pravāmyārabhamāṇā bhuva: aham-eva vāta iva pravāmy-ārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā|

devi/durga/43_tantrokta_devi_suktam.txt.namo jagatpratiṣṭhāyai devyai kṛtyai nam: namo jagat-pratiṣṭhāyai devyai kṛtyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/durga/43_tantrokta_devi_suktam.txt.stutā suraiḥ pūrvamabhīṣṭasaṁśrayā: stutā suraiḥ pūrvam-abhīṣṭa-saṁśrayā        ttathā surendreṇa dineṣu sevitā |
devi/durga/43_tantrokta_devi_suktam.txt.yā sāmprataṁ coddhatadaityatāpite: yā sāmprataṁ coddhata-daitya-tāpite        rasmābhirīśā ca surair-namasyate |
devi/durga/43_tantrokta_devi_suktam.txt.yā ca smṛtā tatkṣaṇameva hanti naḥ: yā ca smṛtā tatkṣaṇam-eva hanti naḥ

devi/durga/44_kshama_prarthana.txt.yatpūjitaṁ mayā devi paripūrṇaṁ tadastu: yat-pūjitaṁ mayā devi paripūrṇaṁ tad-astu me ||

devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.oṁ prathamacaritrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ, mahāk: oṁ prathama-caritrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ, mahākālī devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, nandā śaktiḥ, raktadantikā bījam, agnis-tattvam, ṛgvedaḥ svarūpam, śrī-mahākālī-prīty-arthe prathama-caritra-jape viniyogaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.yāmastaut svapite harau kamalajo hantuṁ: yām-astaut svapite harau kamalajo hantuṁ madhuṁ kaiṭabham ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.kośo balaṁ cāpahṛtaṁ tatrāpi svapure tat: kośo balaṁ cāpahṛtaṁ tatrāpi sva-pure tataḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.matpūrvaiḥ pālitaṁ pūrvaṁ mayā hīnaṁ pur: mat-pūrvaiḥ pālitaṁ pūrvaṁ mayā hīnaṁ puraṁ hi tat |
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.sa pṛṣṭastena kastvaṁ bho hetuścāgamane': sa pṛṣṭas-tena kas-tvaṁ bho hetuś-cāgamane'tra kaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.saśoka iva kasmāttvaṁ durmanā iva lakṣya: saśoka iva kasmāt-tvaṁ durmanā iva lakṣyase ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.kiṁ nu teṣāṁ gṛhe kṣemamakṣemaṁ kiṁ nu s: kiṁ nu teṣāṁ gṛhe kṣemam-akṣemaṁ kiṁ nu sāmpratam ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.kathaṁ te kiṁ nu sadvṛttā durvṛttāḥ kiṁ: kathaṁ te kiṁ nu sad-vṛttā durvṛttāḥ kiṁ nu me sutāḥ ||
