devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.sudhā tvamakṣare nitye tridhā mātrātmikā: sudhā tvam-akṣare nitye tridhā mātrātmikā sthitā ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.tvameva sandhyā sāvitrī tvaṁ devi jananī: tvam-eva sandhyā sāvitrī tvaṁ devi jananī parā ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.visṛṣṭau sṛṣṭirūpā tvaṁ sthitirūpā ca pā: visṛṣṭau sṛṣṭi-rūpā tvaṁ sthiti-rūpā ca pālane |
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.lajjā puṣṭistathā tuṣṭistvaṁ śāntiḥ kṣān: lajjā puṣṭis-tathā tuṣṭis-tvaṁ śāntiḥ kṣāntir-eva ca ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.yayā tvayā jagatsraṣṭā jagatpātyatti yo: yayā tvayā jagat-sraṣṭā jagat-pāty-atti yo jagat |
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.kāritāste yato'tastvāṁ kaḥ stotuṁ śaktim: kāritāste yato'tas-tvāṁ kaḥ stotuṁ śaktimān bhavet ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.prabhāvamasyā devyāstu bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vadām: prabhāvam-asyā devyās-tu bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vadāmi te ||
devi/durga_saptashati/01_madhukaitabha_v.|| aiṁ om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāv: || aiṁ om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye madhu-kaiṭabha-vadho nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.oṁ madhyamacaritrasya viṣṇurṛṣiḥ, mahāla: oṁ madhyama-caritrasya viṣṇur-ṛṣiḥ, mahālakṣmīr-devatā, uṣṇik chandaḥ, śākambharī śaktiḥ, durgā bījam, vāyus-tattvam, yajurvedaḥ svarūpam, śrī-mahālakṣmī-prīty-arthaṁ madhyama-caritra-jape viniyogaḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.daṇḍaṁ śaktimasiṁ ca carma jalajaṁ ghaṇṭ: daṇḍaṁ śaktim-asiṁ ca carma jalajaṁ ghaṇṭāṁ surā-bhājanam |
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.śūlaṁ pāśasudarśane ca dadhatīṁ hastaiḥ: śūlaṁ pāśa-sudarśane ca dadhatīṁ hastaiḥ prasannānanāṁ |
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.śaraṇaṁ vaḥ prapannāḥ smo vadhastasya vi: śaraṇaṁ vaḥ prapannāḥ smo vadhas-tasya vicintyatām ||
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.[* tato devā dadustasyai svāni svānyāyud: [* tato devā dadus-tasyai svāni svāny-āyudhāni ca | *]
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.cakraṁ ca dattavān kṛṣṇaḥ samutpādya sva: cakraṁ ca dattavān kṛṣṇaḥ samutpādya sva-cakrataḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.kālaśca dattavān khaḍgaṁ tasyāścarma ca: kālaś-ca dattavān khaḍgaṁ tasyāś-carma ca nirmalam ||
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.nāgahāraṁ dadau tasyai dhatte yaḥ pṛthiv: nāga-hāraṁ dadau tasyai dhatte yaḥ pṛthivīm-imām |
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.sa dadarśa tato devīṁ vyāptalokatrayāṁ t: sa dadarśa tato devīṁ vyāpta-loka-trayāṁ tviṣā ||
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṁ tayā devyā surad: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṁ tayā devyā sura-dviṣām ||
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.vṛto rathānāṁ koṭyā ca yuddhe tasminnayu: vṛto rathānāṁ koṭyā ca yuddhe tasminn-ayudhyata |
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.devīṁ khaḍgaprahāraistu te tāṁ hantuṁ pr: devīṁ khaḍga-prahārais-tu te tāṁ hantuṁ pracakramuḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.ta eva sadyaḥ sambhūtā gaṇāḥ śatasahasra: ta eva sadyaḥ sambhūtā gaṇāḥ śata-sahasraśaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.devyā gaṇaiśca taistatra kṛtaṁ yuddhaṁ t: devyā gaṇaiś-ca tais-tatra kṛtaṁ yuddhaṁ tathāsuraiḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/02_mahishasura_sai.|| iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike man: || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye mahiṣāsura-sainya-vadho nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.tasyāḥ khaḍgo bhujaṁ prāpya paphāla nṛpa: tasyāḥ khaḍgo bhujaṁ prāpya paphāla nṛpa-nandana |
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.tato vegāt khamutpatya nipatya ca mṛgāri: tato vegāt kham-utpatya nipatya ca mṛgāriṇā |
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.dṛṣṭvā sā caṇḍikā kopaṁ tadvadhāya tadā': dṛṣṭvā sā caṇḍikā kopaṁ tad-vadhāya tadā'karot ||
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.tatyāja māhiṣaṁ rūpaṁ so'pi baddho mahām: tatyāja māhiṣaṁ rūpaṁ so'pi baddho mahā-mṛdhe ||
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.kareṇa ca mahāsiṁhaṁ taṁ cakarṣa jagarja: kareṇa ca mahā-siṁhaṁ taṁ cakarṣa jagarja ca |
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.sā ca tān prahitāṁstena cūrṇayantī śarot: sā ca tān prahitāṁs-tena cūrṇayantī śarotkaraiḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.garja garja kṣaṇaṁ mūḍha madhu yāvatpibā: garja garja kṣaṇaṁ mūḍha madhu yāvat-pibāmy-aham |
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.tato hāhākṛtaṁ sarvaṁ daityasainyaṁ nanā: tato hāhā-kṛtaṁ sarvaṁ daitya-sainyaṁ nanāśa tat |
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.praharṣaṁ ca paraṁ jagmuḥ sakalā devatāg: praharṣaṁ ca paraṁ jagmuḥ sakalā devatā-gaṇāḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/03_mahishasura_vad.|| iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇike man: || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye mahiṣāsura-vadho nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..śaṅkhaṁ cakraṁ kṛpāṇaṁ triśikhamapi kara: śaṅkhaṁ cakraṁ kṛpāṇaṁ triśikham-api karair-udvahantīṁ trinetrām |
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..dhyāyed durgāṁ jayākhyāṁ tridaśaparivṛtā: dhyāyed durgāṁ jayākhyāṁ tridaśa-parivṛtāṁ sevitāṁ siddhi-kāmaiḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..brahmā haraśca na hi vaktumalaṁ balaṁ ca: brahmā haraś-ca na hi vaktum-alaṁ balaṁ ca |
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..hetuḥ samastajagatāṁ triguṇāpi doṣairna: hetuḥ samasta-jagatāṁ triguṇāpi doṣair-na jñāyase hariharādibhir-apy-apārā |
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..svāhāsi vai pitṛgaṇasya ca tṛptiheturucc: svāhāsi vai pitṛ-gaṇasya ca tṛpti-hetur-uccāryase tvam-ata eva janaiḥ svadhā ca ||
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..dṛṣṭvā tu devi kupitaṁ bhrukuṭīkarālamud: dṛṣṭvā tu devi kupitaṁ bhrukuṭī-karālam-udyacchaśāṅka-sadṛśacchavi yanna sadyaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..teṣāṁ yaśāṁsi na ca sīdati dharmavargaḥ: teṣāṁ yaśāṁsi na ca sīdati dharma-vargaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..dharmyāṇi devi sakalāni sadaiva karmāṇya: dharmyāṇi devi sakalāni sadaiva karmāṇy-atyādṛtaḥ pratidinaṁ sukṛtī karoti |
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..svargaṁ prayāti ca tato bhavatīprasādāll: svargaṁ prayāti ca tato bhavatī-prasādāl-loka-traye'pi phaladā nanu devi tena ||
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..ityetatkathitaṁ bhūpa sambhūtā sā yathā: ity-etat-kathitaṁ bhūpa sambhūtā sā yathā purā |
devi/durga_saptashati/04_shakradi_stuti..|| hrīṁ om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sā: || hrīṁ om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye śakrādi-stutir-nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.oṁ asya śrīuttaracaritrasya rudra ṛṣiḥ,: oṁ asya śrī-uttara-caritrasya rudra ṛṣiḥ, mahāsarasvatī devatā, anuṣṭup chandaḥ, bhīmā śaktiḥ, bhrāmarī bījam, sūryas-tattvam, sāmavedaḥ svarūpam, mahāsarasvatī-prītyarthe uttara-caritra-pāṭhe viniyogaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.kauberamatha yāmyaṁ ca cakrāte varuṇasya: kauberam-atha yāmyaṁ ca cakrāte varuṇasya ca ||
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.namo jagatpratiṣṭhāyai devyai kṛtyai nam: namo jagat-pratiṣṭhāyai devyai kṛtyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.stutā suraiḥ pūrvamabhīṣṭasaṁśrayāttathā: stutā suraiḥ pūrvam-abhīṣṭa-saṁśrayāt-tathā surendreṇa dineṣu sevitā |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.yā ca smṛtā tatkṣaṇameva hanti naḥ: yā ca smṛtā tatkṣaṇam-eva hanti naḥ
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.sā tu tiṣṭhati daityendra tāṁ bhavān dra: sā tu tiṣṭhati daityendra tāṁ bhavān draṣṭum-arhati ||
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.chatraṁ te vāruṇaṁ gehe kāñcanasrāvi tiṣ: chatraṁ te vāruṇaṁ gehe kāñcana-srāvi tiṣṭhati |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.niśamyeti vacaḥ śumbhaḥ sa tadā caṇḍamuṇ: niśamyeti vacaḥ śumbhaḥ sa tadā caṇḍa-muṇḍayoḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.iti ceti ca vaktavyā sā gatvā vacanānmam: iti ceti ca vaktavyā sā gatvā vacanān-mama |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.strīratnabhūtāṁ tvāṁ devi loke manyāmahe: strī-ratna-bhūtāṁ tvāṁ devi loke manyāmahe vayam |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.bhaja tvaṁ cañcalāpāṅgi ratnabhūtāsi vai: bhaja tvaṁ cañcalāpāṅgi ratna-bhūtāsi vai yataḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.ityuktā sā tadā devī gambhīrāntaḥsmitā j: ity-uktā sā tadā devī gambhīrāntaḥ-smitā jagau |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.kiṁ tvatra yatpratijñātaṁ mithyā tatkriy: kiṁ tvatra yat-pratijñātaṁ mithyā tat-kriyate katham |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.anyeṣāmapi daityānāṁ sarve devā na vai y: anyeṣām-api daityānāṁ sarve devā na vai yudhi |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.tiṣṭhanti sammukhe devi kiṁ punaḥ strī t: tiṣṭhanti sammukhe devi kiṁ punaḥ strī tvam-ekikā ||
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.sā tvaṁ gaccha mayaivoktā pārśvaṁ śumbha: sā tvaṁ gaccha mayaivoktā pārśvaṁ śumbha-niśumbhayoḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.kiṁ karomi pratijñā me yadanālocitā purā: kiṁ karomi pratijñā me yad-anālocitā purā ||
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.sa tvaṁ gaccha mayoktaṁ te yadetatsarvam: sa tvaṁ gaccha mayoktaṁ te yad-etat-sarvam-ādṛtaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/05_devi_duta_samva.|| om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇi: || om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye devyā dūta-saṁvādo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/06_dhumralochana_v.sa dṛṣṭvā tāṁ tato devīṁ tuhinācalasaṁst: sa dṛṣṭvā tāṁ tato devīṁ tuhinācala-saṁsthitām |
devi/durga_saptashati/06_dhumralochana_v.balānnayasi māmevaṁ tataḥ kiṁ te karomya: balān-nayasi mām-evaṁ tataḥ kiṁ te karomy-aham ||
devi/durga_saptashati/06_dhumralochana_v.tato dhutasaṭaḥ kopāt kṛtvā nādaṁ subhai: tato dhuta-saṭaḥ kopāt kṛtvā nādaṁ subhairavam |
devi/durga_saptashati/06_dhumralochana_v.kṣaṇena tadbalaṁ sarvaṁ kṣayaṁ nītaṁ mah: kṣaṇena tad-balaṁ sarvaṁ kṣayaṁ nītaṁ mahātmanā |
devi/durga_saptashati/06_dhumralochana_v.balaṁ ca kṣayitaṁ kṛtsnaṁ devīkesariṇā t: balaṁ ca kṣayitaṁ kṛtsnaṁ devī-kesariṇā tataḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/06_dhumralochana_v.he caṇḍa he muṇḍa balairbahubhiḥ parivār: he caṇḍa he muṇḍa balair-bahubhiḥ parivāritau |
devi/durga_saptashati/06_dhumralochana_v.keśeṣvākṛṣya baddhvā vā yadi vaḥ saṁśayo: keśeṣv-ākṛṣya baddhvā vā yadi vaḥ saṁśayo yudhi |
devi/durga_saptashati/06_dhumralochana_v.|| om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇi: || om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye śumbha-niśumbha-senānī-dhūmralocana-vadho nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/07_chanda_munda_va.oṁ dhyāyeyaṁ ratnapīṭhe śukakalapaṭhitaṁ: oṁ dhyāyeyaṁ ratna-pīṭhe śuka-kala-paṭhitaṁ śṛṇvatīṁ śyāmalāṅgīṁ
devi/durga_saptashati/07_chanda_munda_va.hataśeṣaṁ tataḥ sainyaṁ dṛṣṭvā caṇḍaṁ ni: hata-śeṣaṁ tataḥ sainyaṁ dṛṣṭvā caṇḍaṁ nipātitam |
devi/durga_saptashati/07_chanda_munda_va.muṇḍaṁ ca sumahāvīryaṁ diśo bheje bhayāt: muṇḍaṁ ca sumahā-vīryaṁ diśo bheje bhayāturam ||
devi/durga_saptashati/07_chanda_munda_va.śiraścaṇḍasya kālī ca gṛhītvā muṇḍameva: śiraś-caṇḍasya kālī ca gṛhītvā muṇḍam-eva ca |
devi/durga_saptashati/07_chanda_munda_va.yuddhayajñe svayaṁ śumbhaṁ niśumbhaṁ ca: yuddha-yajñe svayaṁ śumbhaṁ niśumbhaṁ ca haniṣyasi ||
devi/durga_saptashati/07_chanda_munda_va.yasmāccaṇḍaṁ ca muṇḍaṁ ca gṛhītvā tvamup: yasmāc-caṇḍaṁ ca muṇḍaṁ ca gṛhītvā tvam-upāgatā |
devi/durga_saptashati/07_chanda_munda_va.|| om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇi: || om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye caṇḍa-muṇḍa-vadho nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/08_raktabija_vadha.śaktiḥ sāpyāyayau tatra vārāhīṁ bibhratī: śaktiḥ sāpy-āyayau tatra vārāhīṁ bibhratī tanum ||
devi/durga_saptashati/08_raktabija_vadha.dūta tvaṁ gaccha bhagavan pārśvaṁ śumbha: dūta tvaṁ gaccha bhagavan pārśvaṁ śumbha-niśumbhayoḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/08_raktabija_vadha.ityuktvā tāṁ tato devī śūlenābhijaghāna: ity-uktvā tāṁ tato devī śūlenābhijaghāna tam ||
devi/durga_saptashati/08_raktabija_vadha.tāṁścakhādātha cāmuṇḍā papau tasya ca śo: tāṁś-cakhādātha cāmuṇḍā papau tasya ca śoṇitam |
devi/durga_saptashati/08_raktabija_vadha.|| om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇi: || om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye raktabīja-vadho nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/09_nishumbha_vadha.taiḥ śabdairasurāstresuḥ śumbhaḥ kopaṁ p: taiḥ śabdair-asurās-tresuḥ śumbhaḥ kopaṁ paraṁ yayau ||
devi/durga_saptashati/09_nishumbha_vadha.ciccheda tāni cakrāṇi svaśaraiḥ sāyakāṁś: ciccheda tāni cakrāṇi sva-śaraiḥ sāyakāṁśca tān ||
devi/durga_saptashati/09_nishumbha_vadha.khaḍgena śitadhāreṇa sa ca śūlaṁ samādad: khaḍgena śita-dhāreṇa sa ca śūlaṁ samādade ||
devi/durga_saptashati/09_nishumbha_vadha.|| om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇi: || om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye niśumbha-vadho nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/10_shumbha_vadha.t.ciccheda devī cakreṇa tāmapyasya kare st: ciccheda devī cakreṇa tām-apy-asya kare sthitām ||
devi/durga_saptashati/10_shumbha_vadha.t.niyuddhaṁ khe tadā daityaścaṇḍikā ca par: niyuddhaṁ khe tadā daityaś-caṇḍikā ca parasparam |
devi/durga_saptashati/10_shumbha_vadha.t.sa kṣipto dharaṇīṁ prāpya muṣṭimudyamya: sa kṣipto dharaṇīṁ prāpya muṣṭim-udyamya vegitaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/10_shumbha_vadha.t.utpātameghāḥ solkā ye prāgāsaṁste śamaṁ: utpāta-meghāḥ solkā ye prāg-āsaṁs-te śamaṁ yayuḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/10_shumbha_vadha.t.|| om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇi: || om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye śumbha-vadho nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..bhayebhyastrāhi no devi durge devi namo': bhayebhyas-trāhi no devi durge devi namo'stu te ||
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..pātu naḥ sarvabhītibhyaḥ kātyāyani namo': pātu naḥ sarva-bhītibhyaḥ kātyāyani namo'stu te ||
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..triśūlaṁ pātu no bhīterbhadrakāli namo's: triśūlaṁ pātu no bhīter-bhadrakāli namo'stu te ||
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..sā ghaṇṭā pātu no devi pāpebhyo naḥ sutā: sā ghaṇṭā pātu no devi pāpebhyo naḥ sutān-iva ||
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..vidyāsu śāstreṣu vivekadīpeṣvādyeṣu vāky: vidyāsu śāstreṣu viveka-dīpeṣv-ādyeṣu vākyeṣu ca kā tvad-anyā |
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..devi prasīda paripālaya no'ribhīternitya: devi prasīda paripālaya no'ribhīter-nityaṁ yathāsura-vadhād-adhunaiva sadyaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..tato māṁ devatāḥ svarge martyaloke ca mā: tato māṁ devatāḥ svarge martya-loke ca mānavāḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..punaścāhaṁ yadā bhīmaṁ rūpaṁ kṛtvā himāc: punaś-cāhaṁ yadā bhīmaṁ rūpaṁ kṛtvā himācale ||
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..bhrāmarīti ca māṁ lokāstadā stoṣyanti sa: bhrāmarīti ca māṁ lokās-tadā stoṣyanti sarvataḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/11_narayani_stuti..|| om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇi: || om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye devyāḥ stutir-nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.ebhiḥ stavaiśca māṁ nityaṁ stoṣyate yaḥ: ebhiḥ stavaiś-ca māṁ nityaṁ stoṣyate yaḥ samāhitaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.śroṣyanti caiva ye bhaktyā mama māhātmya: śroṣyanti caiva ye bhaktyā mama māhātmyam-uttamam ||
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.na teṣāṁ duṣkṛtaṁ kiñcidduṣkṛtotthā na c: na teṣāṁ duṣkṛtaṁ kiñcid-duṣkṛtotthā na cāpadaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.sadā na tadvimokṣyāmi sānnidhyaṁ tatra m: sadā na tad-vimokṣyāmi sānnidhyaṁ tatra me sthitam ||
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.śaratkāle mahāpūjā kriyate yā ca vārṣikī: śarat-kāle mahā-pūjā kriyate yā ca vārṣikī |
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.tasmiñchrute vairikṛtaṁ bhayaṁ puṁsāṁ na: tasmiñchrute vairi-kṛtaṁ bhayaṁ puṁsāṁ na jāyate ||
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.brahmaṇā ca kṛtāstāstu prayacchantu śubh: brahmaṇā ca kṛtās-tās-tu prayacchantu śubhāṁ matim ||
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.dasyubhirvā vṛtaḥ śūnye gṛhīto vāpi śatr: dasyubhir-vā vṛtaḥ śūnye gṛhīto vāpi śatrubhiḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.rājñā kruddhena cājñapto vadhyo bandhaga: rājñā kruddhena cājñapto vadhyo bandha-gato'pi vā ||
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.daityāśca devyā nihate śumbhe devaripau: daityāś-ca devyā nihate śumbhe deva-ripau yudhi |
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.dadāti vittaṁ putrāṁśca matiṁ dharme gat: dadāti vittaṁ putrāṁś-ca matiṁ dharme gatiṁ śubhām ||
devi/durga_saptashati/12_bhagavati_vakya.|| om || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sāvarṇi: || om || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye phala-stutir-nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/13_suratha_vaishya.jagāma sadyastapase sa ca vaiśyo mahāmun: jagāma sadyas-tapase sa ca vaiśyo mahā-mune |
devi/durga_saptashati/13_suratha_vaishya.sa ca vaiśyastapastepe devīsūktaṁ paraṁ: sa ca vaiśyas-tapas-tepe devī-sūktaṁ paraṁ japan |
devi/durga_saptashati/13_suratha_vaishya.yatprārthyate tvayā bhūpa tvayā ca kulan: yat-prārthyate tvayā bhūpa tvayā ca kula-nandana |
devi/durga_saptashati/13_suratha_vaishya.atraiva ca nijaṁ rājyaṁ hataśatrubalaṁ b: atraiva ca nijaṁ rājyaṁ hata-śatru-balaṁ balāt ||
devi/durga_saptashati/13_suratha_vaishya.|| klīṁ oṁ || iti śrīmārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe sā: || klīṁ oṁ || iti śrī-mārkaṇḍeya-purāṇe sāvarṇike manvantare devī-māhātmye suratha-vaiśyayor-vara-pradānaṁ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||

devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.oṁ asya śrīsaptaśatīrahasyatrayasya nārā: oṁ asya śrī-saptaśatī-rahasya-trayasya nārāyaṇa ṛṣir-anuṣṭup-chandaḥ mahākālī-mahālakṣmī-mahāsarasvatyo devatā yathokta-phalāvāpty-arthaṁ jape viniyogaḥ |
devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.ārādhyaṁ yanmayā devyāḥ svarūpaṁ yena ca: ārādhyaṁ yan-mayā devyāḥ svarūpaṁ yena ca dvija |
devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.mātuluṅgaṁ gadāṁ kheṭaṁ pānapātraṁ ca bi: mātuluṅgaṁ gadāṁ kheṭaṁ pāna-pātraṁ ca bibhratī |
devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.nāma karma ca me mātardehi tubhyaṁ namo: nāma karma ca me mātar-dehi tubhyaṁ namo namaḥ ||
devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.sā babhūva varā nārī nāmānyasyai ca sā d: sā babhūva varā nārī nāmāny-asyai ca sā dadau ||
devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.ityuktvā te mahālakṣmīḥ sasarja mithunaṁ: ity-uktvā te mahālakṣmīḥ sasarja mithunaṁ svayam |
devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.brahman vidhe viriñceti dhātarityāha taṁ: brahman vidhe viriñceti dhātar-ity-āha taṁ naram |
devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.śrīḥ padme kamale lakṣmītyāha mātā ca tā: śrīḥ padme kamale lakṣmīty-āha mātā ca tāṁ striyam ||
devi/durga_saptashati/14_pradhanika_raha.etayorapi rūpāṇi nāmāni ca vadāmi te ||: etayor-api rūpāṇi nāmāni ca vadāmi te ||

devi/durga_saptashati/15_vaikrutika_raha.teṣāṁ kila surāmāṁsairnoktā pūjā nṛpa kv: teṣāṁ kila surā-māṁsair-noktā pūjā nṛpa kvacit |)
devi/durga_saptashati/15_vaikrutika_raha.yo na pūjayate nityaṁ caṇḍikāṁ bhaktavat: yo na pūjayate nityaṁ caṇḍikāṁ bhakta-vatsalām |

devi/durga_saptashati/16_murti_rahasyam..imāṁ yaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā sa vyāpnoti carā: imāṁ yaḥ pūjayed-bhaktyā sa vyāpnoti carācaram ||
devi/durga_saptashati/16_murti_rahasyam..adhīte ya imaṁ nityaṁ raktadantyā vapuḥs: adhīte ya imaṁ nityaṁ raktadantyā vapuḥ-stavam |
devi/durga_saptashati/16_murti_rahasyam..candrahāsaṁ ca ḍamaruṁ śiraḥpātraṁ ca bi: candrahāsaṁ ca ḍamaruṁ śiraḥ-pātraṁ ca bibhratī |
devi/durga_saptashati/16_murti_rahasyam..idaṁ rahasyaṁ paramaṁ na vācyaṁ kasyacit: idaṁ rahasyaṁ paramaṁ na vācyaṁ kasyacit-tvayā ||
devi/durga_saptashati/16_murti_rahasyam..devyā dhyānaṁ mayā khyātaṁ guhyādguhyata: devyā dhyānaṁ mayā khyātaṁ guhyād-guhyataraṁ mahat |

devi/gayatri/01_gayatri_stotram_1.txt.ajare amare mātā trāhi māṁ bhavasāgarāt: ajare amare mātā trāhi māṁ bhava-sāgarāt ||
devi/gayatri/01_gayatri_stotram_1.txt.namo namaste gāyatrī sāvitrī tvaṁ namāmy: namo namaste gāyatrī sāvitrī tvaṁ namāmy-aham |

devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.mucyate kena puṇyena brahmarūpaṁ kathaṁ: mucyate kena puṇyena brahma-rūpaṁ kathaṁ bhavet |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.asya śrīgāyatrīkavacasya brahmaviṣṇurudr: asya śrī-gāyatrī-kavacasya brahma-viṣṇu-rudrā ṛṣayaḥ, ṛg-yajuḥ-sāmātharvāṇi chandāṁsi, parabrahma-svarūpiṇī gāyatrī devatā, bhūr-bījaṁ, bhuvaḥ śaktiḥ, svaḥ kīlakaṁ, śrī-gāyatrī-prīty-arthe jape viniyogaḥ ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsavituriti aṅguṣṭh: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ tat-savitur-iti aṅguṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vareṇyamiti tarjanībh: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ vareṇyamiti tarjanībhyāṁ namaḥ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhargo devasyeti madh: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ bhargo devasyeti madhyamābhyāṁ namaḥ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ dhīmahīti anāmikābhyā: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ dhīmahīti anāmikābhyāṁ namaḥ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ iti kani: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ iti kaniṣṭhikābhyāṁ namaḥ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pracodayāditi karatal: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ pracodayād-iti kara-tala kara-pṛṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsavituriti hṛdayāy: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ tat-savitur-iti hṛdayāya namaḥ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ vareṇyamiti śirase sv: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ vareṇyamiti śirase svāhā |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ bhargo devasyeti śikh: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ bhargo devasyeti śikhāyai vaṣaṭ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ dhīmahīti kavacāya hu: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ dhīmahīti kavacāya hum |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ iti netr: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ dhiyo yo naḥ iti netra-trayāya vauṣaṭ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.oṁ bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ pracodayāditi astrāya: oṁ bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaḥ pracodayād-iti astrāya phaṭ ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.brahmavidyā ca me paścāduttare māṁ saras: brahma-vidyā ca me paścād-uttare māṁ sarasvatī ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.vedamātā ca māṁ pātu sarahasyā sadaivatā: veda-mātā ca māṁ pātu sarahasyā sadaivatā |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.tatpadaṁ pātu me pādau jaṅghe me savituḥ: tat-padaṁ pātu me pādau jaṅghe me savituḥ padam |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.vareṇyaṁ kaṭideśaṁ tu nābhiṁ bhargastath: vareṇyaṁ kaṭi-deśaṁ tu nābhiṁ bhargas-tathaiva ca ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.tadvarṇaḥ pātu mūrdhānaṁ sakāraḥ pātu ph: tad-varṇaḥ pātu mūrdhānaṁ sakāraḥ pātu phālakam ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.cakṣuṣī me vikārastu śrotraṁ rakṣettu kā: cakṣuṣī me vikāras-tu śrotraṁ rakṣet-tu kārakaḥ |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.śikhāyāṁ dakṣiṇe bāhau kaṇṭhe vā dhāraye: śikhāyāṁ dakṣiṇe bāhau kaṇṭhe vā dhārayed-budhaḥ ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.yo vetti dhāraṇāṁ yuñjan jīvanmuktaḥ sa: yo vetti dhāraṇāṁ yuñjan jīvan-muktaḥ sa ucyate ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.kāle kāle tu kartavyaṁ siddhirbhavati nā: kāle kāle tu kartavyaṁ siddhir-bhavati nānyathā ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.mantramadhye tu yā māyā gāyatrī saphalā: mantra-madhye tu yā māyā gāyatrī saphalā bhavet ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.akṣamālāṁ ca mudrāṁ ca gurorapi na darśa: akṣamālāṁ ca mudrāṁ ca guror-api na darśayet |
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.asaṅkhyayā ca yajjaptaṁ tajjaptaṁ niṣpha: asaṅkhyayā ca yaj-japtaṁ taj-japtaṁ niṣphalaṁ bhavet ||
devi/gayatri/02_gayatri_kavacham_1.txt.vastrapucchaṁ na jānāti vṛthā tasya pari: vastra-pucchaṁ na jānāti vṛthā tasya pariśramaḥ ||

devi/gayatri/03_gayatryashtakam.txt.kāñcīcelavibhūṣitāṁ śivamayīṁ mālārdhamā: kāñcī-cela-vibhūṣitāṁ śiva-mayīṁ mālārdha-mālādikān-bibhrāṇāṁ parameśvarīṁ śaraṇadāṁ mohāndha-buddhicchidām |
devi/gayatri/03_gayatryashtakam.txt.japtvā yānti parāṁ gatiṁ manumimaṁ devyā: japtvā yānti parāṁ gatiṁ manum-imaṁ devyāḥ paraṁ vaidikāḥ ||

devi/gayatri/05_gayatri_ashtakam_2.txt.hiraṇyāṁ guṇyāṁ tāṁ sukavijana gītāṁ sun: hiraṇyāṁ guṇyāṁ tāṁ sukavi-jana gītāṁ sunipuṇīm |
devi/gayatri/05_gayatri_ashtakam_2.txt.anantāṁ śāntāṁ yāṁ bhajati budhavṛndaḥ ś: anantāṁ śāntāṁ yāṁ bhajati budha-vṛndaḥ śruti-mayīṁ
devi/gayatri/05_gayatri_ashtakam_2.txt.sugeyāṁ dhyeyāṁ yāṁ smarati hṛdi nityaṁ: sugeyāṁ dhyeyāṁ yāṁ smarati hṛdi nityaṁ sura-patiḥ |
devi/gayatri/05_gayatri_ashtakam_2.txt.aho bhāgyo bhavelloke tasmin mātā prasīd: aho bhāgyo bhavel-loke tasmin mātā prasīdati ||

devi/gayatri/06_gayatri_kavacham_2.txt.asya śrīgāyatrī kavacasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ an: asya śrī-gāyatrī kavacasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ gāyatrī devatā bhūḥ bījaṁ bhuvaḥ śaktiḥ svaḥ kīlakaṁ śrī-gāyatrī prīty-arthe jape viniyogaḥ |
devi/gayatri/06_gayatri_kavacham_2.txt.lalāṭaṁ brahmadaivatyā bhruvau me pātu v: lalāṭaṁ brahma-daivatyā bhruvau me pātu vaiṣṇavī ||
devi/gayatri/06_gayatri_kavacham_2.txt.stanau me pātu indrāṇī hṛdayaṁ brahmavād: stanau me pātu indrāṇī hṛdayaṁ brahma-vādinī ||
devi/gayatri/06_gayatri_kavacham_2.txt.udaraṁ viśvabhoktrī ca nābhiṁ pātu surap: udaraṁ viśva-bhoktrī ca nābhiṁ pātu sura-priyā |
devi/gayatri/06_gayatri_kavacham_2.txt.sūryā padadvayaṁ pātu candrā pādāṅgulīṣu: sūryā pada-dvayaṁ pātu candrā pādāṅgulīṣu ca ||
devi/gayatri/06_gayatri_kavacham_2.txt.sarvāṅgaṁ vedamātā ca pātu me sarvadā'na: sarvāṅgaṁ veda-mātā ca pātu me sarvadā'naghā |

devi/gayatri/07_gayatri_stotram_2.txt.sarvatra vyāpike'nante śrīsandhye te nām: sarvatra vyāpike'nante śrī-sandhye te nāmo'stu te ||
devi/gayatri/07_gayatri_stotram_2.txt.tvameva sandhyā gāyatrī sāvitrī ca saras: tvam-eva sandhyā gāyatrī sāvitrī ca sarasvatī |
devi/gayatri/07_gayatri_stotram_2.txt.bhuvo loke vāyuśaktiḥ svarloke tejasāṁ n: bhuvo loke vāyu-śaktiḥ svar-loke tejasāṁ nidhiḥ ||
devi/gayatri/07_gayatri_stotram_2.txt.gāndhārī hastijihvā ca pūṣāpūṣā tathaiva: gāndhārī hasti-jihvā ca pūṣāpūṣā tathaiva ca |
devi/gayatri/07_gayatri_stotram_2.txt.nāḍī ca tvaṁ śarīrasthā gīyase prāktanai: nāḍī ca tvaṁ śarīra-sthā gīyase prāktanair-budhaiḥ |
devi/gayatri/07_gayatri_stotram_2.txt.śikhāmadhyāsanā tvaṁ hi śikhāgre tu mano: śikhā-madhyāsanā tvaṁ hi śikhāgre tu manonmanī |
devi/gayatri/07_gayatri_stotram_2.txt.tatsarvaṁ tvaṁ mahādevi śriye sandhye na: tat-sarvaṁ tvaṁ mahādevi śriye sandhye namo'stu te |

devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.prāgdehasthoya dāhaṁ tava caraṇa yugānnā: prāgdehasthoya dāhaṁ tava caraṇa yugān-nāśrito nārcito'haṁ
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.kṣiptvā janmāntarānnaḥ punarihabhavitā k: kṣiptvā janmāntarān-naḥ punarihabhavitā kvāśrayaḥ kvāpi sevā
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.na tvāṁ jānāmi mātaḥ kalikaluṣaharā bhog: na tvāṁ jānāmi mātaḥ kali-kaluṣa-harā bhoga-mokṣa pradātrīm |
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.nācāro naiva pūjā na ca yajana kathā na: nācāro naiva pūjā na ca yajana kathā na smṛtir-naiva sevā
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.naṣṭa prajñaḥ parastrī paradhana haraṇe: naṣṭa prajñaḥ para-strī para-dhana haraṇe sarvadā sābhilāṣaḥ |
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.tvatpādāmbhojayugmaṁ kṣaṇamapi manasā na: tvat-pādāmbhoja-yugmaṁ kṣaṇam-api manasā na smṛto'haṁ kadāpi
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.prauḍho bhikṣābhilāṣī suta duhitṛ kalatr: prauḍho bhikṣābhilāṣī suta duhitṛ kalatrārtham-annādi ceṣṭa
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.kva prāpsye kutrayāmī tvanudinamaniśaṁ c: kva prāpsye kutrayāmī tv-anudinam-aniśaṁ cintayāmagna dehaḥ |
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.kṛtvāsnānaṁ dinādau kvacidapi salilaṁ no: kṛtvāsnānaṁ dinādau kvacid-api salilaṁ nokṛtaṁ naiva puṣpaṁ
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.te naivedyādikaṁ ca kvacidapi na kṛtaṁ n: te naivedyādikaṁ ca kvacid-api na kṛtaṁ nāpibhāvo na bhaktiḥ |
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.jānāmi tvāṁ na cāhaṁ bhavabhayaharaṇīṁ s: jānāmi tvāṁ na cāhaṁ bhava-bhaya-haraṇīṁ sarva-siddhi-pradātrīṁ
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.brahmā viṣṇustatheśaḥ pariṇamati sadā tv: brahmā viṣṇus-tatheśaḥ pariṇamati sadā tvat-padāmbhoja yuktaṁ
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.nityaṁ lobha pralobhaiḥ kṛtaviśamatiḥ kā: nityaṁ lobha pralobhaiḥ kṛtaviśamatiḥ kāmukas-tvāṁ prayāṣe
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.rogī duḥkhī daridraḥ paravaśakṛpaṇaḥ pāṁ: rogī duḥkhī daridraḥ paravaśa-kṛpaṇaḥ pāṁśulaḥ pāpa cetā
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.dāridryasya kva dharmaḥ kva ca jananiruc: dāridryasya kva dharmaḥ kva ca jananiruciḥ kva sthitiḥ sādhu-saṅghaiḥ
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.tvaṁ hartā kārayitrī karaṇa guṇamayī kar: tvaṁ hartā kārayitrī karaṇa guṇamayī karma-hetu svarūpā |
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.tvaṁ bhūmistvaṁ jalaṁ ca tvamasi hutavah: tvaṁ bhūmis-tvaṁ jalaṁ ca tvam-asi hutavahas-tvaṁ jagad-vāyu-rūpā
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.tvaṁ cākāśaṁ manaśca prakṛtirasi mahatpū: tvaṁ cākāśaṁ manaś-ca prakṛtir-asi mahat-pūrvikā pūrva-pūrvā |
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.ātmā tvaṁ cā'si mātaḥ paramasi bhavatī t: ātmā tvaṁ cā'si mātaḥ param-asi bhavatī tvat-paran-naiva kiñcit
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.tvaṁ kālī tvaṁ ca tārā tvamasi girisutā: tvaṁ kālī tvaṁ ca tārā tvam-asi giri-sutā sundarī bhairavī tvaṁ
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.tvaṁ durgā chinnamastā tvamasi ca bhuvan: tvaṁ durgā chinnamastā tvam-asi ca bhuvanā tvaṁ hi lakṣmīḥ śivā tvam |
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.dhūmā mātaṅginī tvaṁ tvamasi ca bagalā m: dhūmā mātaṅginī tvaṁ tvam-asi ca bagalā maṅgalādi-stavākhyā
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.stotreṇānena devīṁ pariṇamati jano yaḥ s: stotreṇānena devīṁ pariṇamati jano yaḥ sadā-bhakti-yukto
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.duṣkṛtyādurga saṅghaṁ paritarati śataṁ v: duṣkṛtyādurga saṅghaṁ paritarati śataṁ vighnatāṁ nāśam-eti |
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.nādhirvyādhi kadācidbhavati yadi punaḥ s: nādhir-vyādhi kadācid-bhavati yadi punaḥ sarvadā sā'parādhaḥ
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.sarvaṁ tat kāmarūpe tribhuvanajanani kṣā: sarvaṁ tat kāmarūpe tri-bhuvana-janani kṣāmaye putra buddhyā ||
devi/kalika/17_kali_aparadha_kshamapana_.jñātā vaktā kavīśo bhavati dhanapatirdān: jñātā vaktā kavīśo bhavati dhana-patir-dāna-śīlo dayātmā

devi/kalika/19_kali_ashtottarashatanama_.yāmastautsvapite harau kamalajo hantuṁ m: yām-astaut-svapite harau kamalajo hantuṁ madhuṁ kaiṭabham ||

devi/kalika/19_kali_ashtottarashatanama_.prātaḥkāle ca madhyāhne sāyāhne ca sadā: prātaḥ-kāle ca madhyāhne sāyāhne ca sadā niśi |
devi/kalika/19_kali_ashtottarashatanama_.vahnimadhye ca saṁgrāme tathā prāṇasya s: vahni-madhye ca saṁgrāme tathā prāṇasya saṁśaye |

devi/lakshmi/01_kanakadhara_stotram_shan.trisandhyaṁ yaḥ paṭhennityaṁ sa kuberasa: trisandhyaṁ yaḥ paṭhen-nityaṁ sa kubera-samo bhavet ||

devi/lakshmi/03_ashtalakshmi_stotram.txt.suragaṇa pūjita śīghra phalaprada, jñāna: sura-gaṇa pūjita śīghra phala-prada, jñāna vikāsini śāstra-nute |

devi/lakshmi/03_ashtalakshmi_stotram.txt.jaya jayahe madhusūdana kāmini, santānal: jaya jayahe madhusūdana kāmini, santāna-lakṣmi tvaṁ pālaya mām ||
devi/lakshmi/03_ashtalakshmi_stotram.txt.jaya kamalāsini sadgati dāyini, jñānavik: jaya kamalāsini sad-gati dāyini, jñāna-vikāsini gānamaye
devi/lakshmi/03_ashtalakshmi_stotram.txt.anudinamarcita kuṅkuma dhūsara, bhūṣita: anudinam-arcita kuṅkuma dhūsara, bhūṣita vāsita vādya-nute |

devi/lakshmi/03_ashtalakshmi_stotram.txt.maṇimaya bhūṣita karṇavibhūṣaṇa, śānti s: maṇimaya bhūṣita karṇa-vibhūṣaṇa, śānti samāvṛta hāsya-mukhe |
devi/lakshmi/03_ashtalakshmi_stotram.txt.navanidhi dāyini kalimalahāriṇi, kāmita: nava-nidhi dāyini kali-mala-hāriṇi, kāmita phala-prada hasta-yute
devi/lakshmi/03_ashtalakshmi_stotram.txt.jaya jayahe madhusūdana kāmini, vidyālak: jaya jayahe madhusūdana kāmini, vidyā-lakṣmi sadā pālaya mām ||
devi/lakshmi/03_ashtalakshmi_stotram.txt.ghumaghuma ghuṅghuma ghuṅghuma ghuṅghuma: ghumaghuma ghuṅghuma ghuṅghuma ghuṅghuma, śaṅkha nināda suvādya-nute |

devi/lakshmi/04_ashtalakshmi_dhyana_slok.dvibhujāṁ ca dvinetrāṁ ca sā'bhayāṁ vara: dvi-bhujāṁ ca dvi-netrāṁ ca sā'bhayāṁ varadānvitām |

devi/lakshmi/06_sri_suktam.txt.śrīmanmanda kaṭākṣa labdha vibhava brahm: śrīman-manda kaṭākṣa labdha vibhava brahmendra gaṅgādharām |

devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.stotuṁ ke vayamityadaśca jagṛhuḥ prāñco: stotuṁ ke vayam-ity-adaś-ca jagṛhuḥ prāñco viriñcādayaḥ |

devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.stotavyasya tataśca te stutidhurā mayyev: stotavyasya tataś-ca te stuti-dhurā mayy-eva viśrāmyati |

devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.ye te śrīraṅgaharmyāṅgaṇakanakalate na k: ye te śrīraṅga-harmyāṅgaṇa-kanaka-late na kṣaṇaṁ lakṣyam-āsan ||
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.īṣṭe kaścijjagata iti yaḥ pauruṣe sūkta: īṣṭe kaścij-jagata iti yaḥ pauruṣe sūkta uktaḥ
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.tuṅgaṁ maṅgalamujjvalaṁ garimavat puṇyaṁ: tuṅgaṁ maṅgalam-ujjvalaṁ garimavat puṇyaṁ punaḥ pāvanaṁ
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.dṛpyaddantāvalastho na gaṇayati natān ya: dṛpyad-dantāvala-stho na gaṇayati natān yat-kṣaṇaṁ kṣoṇipālān |
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.yaddūre manaso yadeva tamasaḥ pāre yadat: yad-dūre manaso yadeva tamasaḥ pāre yad-atyadbhutaṁ
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padaṁ tava kṛte mātaḥ: tad-viṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padaṁ tava kṛte mātaḥ samāmnāsiṣuḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.puṇyāste paricārakarmaṇi sadā paśyanti y: puṇyās-te paricāra-karmaṇi sadā paśyanti ye sūrayaḥ |
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.devi tvāmanu nīlayā saha mahīdevyaḥ saha: devi tvām-anu nīlayā saha mahī-devyaḥ sahasraṁ tathā
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.te sādhyāḥ santi devā janani guṇavapurve: te sādhyāḥ santi devā janani guṇa-vapur-veṣa-vṛtta-svarūpaiḥ

devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.na caivaṁ tvādevaṁ svadata iti kaścitkav: na caivaṁ tvādevaṁ svadata iti kaścit-kavayate ||
