devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.praśastiḥ sā rājño yadapi ca purīkośakat: praśastiḥ sā rājño yadapi ca purī-kośa-kathanam ||
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.svataḥ śrīstvaṁ viṣṇoḥ svamasi tata evai: svataḥ śrīs-tvaṁ viṣṇoḥ svam-asi tata evaiṣa bhagavān
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.svayā dīptyā ratnaṁ bhavadapi mahārghaṁ: svayā dīptyā ratnaṁ bhavad-api mahārghaṁ na viguṇaṁ
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.na kuṇṭhasvātantryaṁ bhavati ca na cānyā: na kuṇṭha-svātantryaṁ bhavati ca na cānyāhita-guṇam ||
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.tvayi strītvaikāntān mradimapatipārārthy: tvayi strītvaikāntān mradimapatipārārthyakaruṇākṣamādīnvā bhoktuṁ bhavati yuvayor-ātmani bhidā ||
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.ekaṁ nyañcya natikṣamaṁ mama paraṁ cākuñ: ekaṁ nyañcya nati-kṣamaṁ mama paraṁ cākuñcya pādāmbujaṁ
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.tvāṁ paśyema niṣeduṣīṁ pratikalaṁ kāruṇy: tvāṁ paśyema niṣeduṣīṁ pratikalaṁ kāruṇya-kūlaṅkaṣa-sphārāpāṅga-taraṅgam-amba madhuraṁ mugdhaṁ mukhaṁ bibhratīm ||
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.dṛgbhyāmeva hi puṇḍarīkanayanaṁ vedo vid: dṛgbhyām-eva hi puṇḍarīka-nayanaṁ vedo vidāmāsa te
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.ḍolā te vanamālayā haribhuje hā kaṣṭaśab: ḍolā te vanamālayā hari-bhuje hā kaṣṭa-śabdāspadaṁ
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.āmaryādamakaṇṭakaṁ stanayugaṁ nādyāpi nā: āmaryādam-akaṇṭakaṁ stana-yugaṁ nādyāpi nālokita-bhrū-bheda-smita-vibhramā jahati vā naisargikatvāyaśaḥ |
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.kākaṁ taṁ ca vibhīṣaṇaṁ śaraṇamityuktikṣ: kākaṁ taṁ ca vibhīṣaṇaṁ śaraṇam-ity-ukti-kṣamau rakṣataḥ
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.kliṣṭaṁ grāvasu mālatīmṛdupadaṁ viśliṣya: kliṣṭaṁ grāvasu mālatī-mṛdu-padaṁ viśliṣya vāso vane
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.udadhiparamavyomnorvismṛtya mādṛśarakṣaṇ: udadhi-parama-vyomnor-vismṛtya mādṛśa-rakṣaṇa-kṣamam-iti dhiyā bhūyaḥ śrīraṅga-dhāmani modase ||
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.yadvā na me bhujabalaṁ tava pādapadmalāb: yadvā na me bhuja-balaṁ tava pāda-padma-lābhe tvamevaśaraṇaṁ vidhitaḥ kṛtā'si ||
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.śrīraṅge śaradaḥ śataṁ saha suhṛdvargeṇa: śrīraṅge śaradaḥ śataṁ saha suhṛd-vargeṇa niṣkaṇṭakaṁ
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.nirduḥkhaṁ susukhañca dāsyarasikāṁ bhukt: nirduḥkhaṁ susukhañ-ca dāsyarasikāṁ bhuktvā samṛddhiṁ parām |
devi/lakshmi/07_sriguna_ratnakosha.txt.sarvaṁ dharmamapi tvameva bhava naḥ svīk: sarvaṁ dharmam-api tvam-eva bhava naḥ svīkurv-akasmāt-kṛpām ||

devi/lakshmi/08_dipalakshmi_stavam.txt.ārogyaṁ dehi putrāṁśca avaidhavyaṁ praya: ārogyaṁ dehi putrāṁś-ca avaidhavyaṁ prayaccha me ||

devi/lakshmi/09_dipalakshmi_stotram.txt.dīpo haratu me pāpaṁ sandhyādīpa namo'st: dīpo haratu me pāpaṁ sandhyā-dīpa namo'stu te ||

devi/lakshmi/11_bhadralakshmi_stavam.txt.pañcamaṁ viṣṇupatnī ca ṣaṣṭhaṁ syāt vaiṣ: pañcamaṁ viṣṇu-patnī ca ṣaṣṭhaṁ syāt vaiṣṇavī tathā |
devi/lakshmi/11_bhadralakshmi_stavam.txt.ekādaśaṁ tu lakṣmīḥ syāt dvādaśaṁ śrīhar: ekādaśaṁ tu lakṣmīḥ syāt dvādaśaṁ śrī-hari-priyā ||

devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.samprāpya kavacaṁ brahma tatpadme sasṛje: samprāpya kavacaṁ brahma tat-padme sasṛje jagat |
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.dharmaśca karmaṇāṁ sākṣī pātā yasya pras: dharmaś-ca karmaṇāṁ sākṣī pātā yasya prasādataḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.oṁ hrīṁ kamalavāsinyai svāhā me pātu mas: oṁ hrīṁ kamala-vāsinyai svāhā me pātu mastakam |
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.oṁ śrīṁ śriyai svāheti ca karṇayugmaṁ sa: oṁ śrīṁ śriyai svāheti ca karṇa-yugmaṁ sadā'vatu |
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.oṁ śrīṁ padmālayāyai ca svāhā dantānsadā: oṁ śrīṁ padmālayāyai ca svāhā dantān-sadā'vatu |
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.oṁ śrīṁ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca dantarandhraṁ s: oṁ śrīṁ kṛṣṇa-priyāyai ca danta-randhraṁ sadā'vatu ||
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.oṁ śrīṁ keśavakāntāyai mama skandhaṁ sad: oṁ śrīṁ keśava-kāntāyai mama skandhaṁ sadā'vatu ||
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.oṁ śrīṁ padmanivāsinyai svāhā nābhiṁ sad: oṁ śrīṁ padma-nivāsinyai svāhā nābhiṁ sadā'vatu |
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.oṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ saṁsāramātre mama vakṣaḥ sa: oṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ saṁsāra-mātre mama vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu ||
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.oṁ śrīṁ oṁ kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṁ s: oṁ śrīṁ oṁ kṛṣṇa-kāntāyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṁ sadā'vatu |
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.padmā māṁ dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtyāṁ śrīhari: padmā māṁ dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtyāṁ śrī-hari-priyā ||
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau sa śrīmānpratija: kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau sa śrīmān-pratijanmani ||
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yasyedaṁ kavacaṁ: sa snātaḥ sarva-tīrtheṣu yasyedaṁ kavacaṁ gale ||
devi/lakshmi/12_padma_kavacam.txt.iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye: iti śrī-brahmavaivarte mahā-purāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapati-khaṇḍe aṣṭātriṁśattamo'dhyāye nārada-nārāyaṇa-saṁvāde śrī lakṣmī kavacam ||

devi/lakshmi/13_padmavati_stotram.txt.kṛpayā pāhi naḥ padme tvadbhaktibharitān: kṛpayā pāhi naḥ padme tvad-bhakti-bharitān rame ||

devi/lakshmi/14_padmavati_navaratnamalik.sā viṣṇorekapatnī tribhuvanajananī pātu: sā viṣṇor-eka-patnī tri-bhuvana-jananī pātu padmāvatī naḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/14_padmavati_navaratnamalik.stokaṁ yasyāḥ prasādaḥ prasarati manuje: stokaṁ yasyāḥ prasādaḥ prasarati manuje krūra-dāridrya-dagdhe |

devi/lakshmi/15_mahalakshmyashtakam_indr.mantramūrte sadā devi mahālakṣmi namo'st: mantra-mūrte sadā devi mahālakṣmi namo'stu te ||

devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.asya śrīmahālakṣmī kavacamantrasya brahm: asya śrī-mahālakṣmī kavaca-mantrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chandaḥ mahālakṣmīr-devatā śrī-mahālakṣmī prīty-arthaṁ jape viniyogaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.skandhau me jānakī pātu bhujau bhārgavan: skandhau me jānakī pātu bhujau bhārgava-nandinī |
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.bāhū dvau draviṇī pātu karau harivarāṅga: bāhū dvau draviṇī pātu karau hari-varāṅganā ||
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.vakṣaḥ pātu ca śrīrdevī hṛdayaṁ harisund: vakṣaḥ pātu ca śrīr-devī hṛdayaṁ hari-sundarī |
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.kukṣiṁ ca vaiṣṇavī pātu nābhiṁ bhuvanamā: kukṣiṁ ca vaiṣṇavī pātu nābhiṁ bhuvana-mātṛkā ||
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.kaṭiṁ ca pātu vārāhī sakthinī devadevatā: kaṭiṁ ca pātu vārāhī sakthinī deva-devatā |
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.indirā pātu jaṅghe me pādau bhaktanamask: indirā pātu jaṅghe me pādau bhakta-namaskṛtā |
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.ye paṭhanti mahātmānaste ca dhanyā jagat: ye paṭhanti mahātmānas-te ca dhanyā jagat-traye ||
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.nāmatrayamidaṁ japtvā sa yāti paramāṁ śr: nāma-trayam-idaṁ japtvā sa yāti paramāṁ śriyam |
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.yaḥ paṭhetsa ca dharmātmā sarvān kāmānav: yaḥ paṭhet-sa ca dharmātmā sarvān kāmān-avāpnuyāt ||
devi/lakshmi/16_mahalakshmi_kavacham_1.t.iti śrībrahmapurāṇe indropadiṣṭaṁ śrī ma: iti śrī-brahma-purāṇe indropadiṣṭaṁ śrī mahālakṣmī kavacam ||

devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.surāstaṁ gāyanti sphuritatanugaṅgādharam: surās-taṁ gāyanti sphurita-tanu-gaṅgādhara-mukhās-tavāyaṁ dṛk-pāto yad-upari kṛpāto vilasati ||
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.dṛgeṣā te yeṣāmupari kamale devi sadayā: dṛgeṣā te yeṣām-upari kamale devi sadayā ||
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.lasatphullāmbhojamradimaharaṇaḥ ko'pi ca: lasat-phullāmbhoja-mradima-haraṇaḥ ko'pi caraṇaś-ciraṁ cetaś-cārī mama bhavatu vārīśa-duhituḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.japedyaḥ svacchandaṁ sa hi punaramandaṁ: japed-yaḥ svacchandaṁ sa hi punar-amandaṁ gaja-ghaṭā-mada-bhrāmyad-bhṛṅgair-mukharayati veśmāni viduṣām ||
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.smaro nāmaṁ nāmaṁ trijagadabhirāmaṁ tava: smaro nāmaṁ nāmaṁ tri-jagad-abhirāmaṁ tava padaṁ
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.prapede siddhiṁ yāṁ kathamiva narastāṁ k: prapede siddhiṁ yāṁ katham-iva naras-tāṁ kathayatu |
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.miṣānmāṇikyānāṁ vigalitanimeṣaṁ nimiṣatā: miṣān-māṇikyānāṁ vigalita-nimeṣaṁ nimiṣatām-amandaṁ saundarya tava caraṇayor-ambudhi-sute |
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.kalakvāṇāṁ kāñcīṁ maṇigaṇajaṭālāmadhivah: kala-kvāṇāṁ kāñcīṁ maṇi-gaṇa-jaṭālām-adhivahan-vasānaḥ kausumbhaṁ vasanam-asanaṁ kaustubha-rucām |
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.jaganmithyābhūtaṁ mama nigadatāṁ vedavac: jagan-mithyā-bhūtaṁ mama nigadatāṁ veda-vacasām-abhiprāyo nādyāvadhi hṛdayam-adhyāviśad-ayam |
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.mama svāntadhvāntaṁ kimapi ca nitāntaṁ g: mama svānta-dhvāntaṁ kimapi ca nitāntaṁ gamayatu ||
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.śrutīnāṁ spardhāṁ ye dadhata iva kaṇṭhe: śrutīnāṁ spardhāṁ ye dadhata iva kaṇṭhe madhu-ripoḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.hariḥ kambuṁ cumbatyatha vahati pāṇau ki: hariḥ kambuṁ cumbaty-atha vahati pāṇau kim-adhikaṁ
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.abhūdapratyūhaḥ sakalaharidullāsanavidhi: abhūd-apratyūhaḥ sakala-harid-ullāsana-vidhir-vilīno lokānāṁ sa hi nayana-tāpo'pi kamale |
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.jagatpāyaṁ pāyaṁ svapiti nirapāyaṁ tava: jagat-pāyaṁ pāyaṁ svapiti nirapāyaṁ tava patiḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.nivāso muktānāṁ nibiḍataranīlāmbudanibha: nivāso muktānāṁ nibiḍatara-nīlāmbuda-nibhas-tavāyaṁ dhammillo vimalayatu mal-locana-yugam |
devi/lakshmi/17_lakshmi_lahari.txt.spṛśantī mā rodīriti vada samāśvāsyasi k: spṛśantī mā rodīr-iti vada samāśvāsyasi kadā ||

devi/lakshmi/18_lakshmi_gadyam.txt.bhagavati jaya jaya padmāvati he | bhāga: bhagavati jaya jaya padmāvati he | bhāgavata-nikara bahutara bhaya-kara bahulodyamayama sadmāyati he | bhavijana bhaya-nāśi bhāgya-payo-rāśi velātigalola vipulatarollola vīci-līlāvahe | padmaja-bhava-yuvati pramukhāmara-yuvati paricāraka-yuvati vitati sarati satata viracita paricaraṇa caraṇāmbhoruhe | akuṇṭha-vaikuṇṭha mahā-vibhūti-nāyaki | akhilāṇḍakoṭi brahmāṇḍa-nāyaki | śrī-veṅkaṭa-nāyaki | śrīmati padmāvati | jaya vijayī-bhava ||
devi/lakshmi/18_lakshmi_gadyam.txt.jaya jaya jaya jagadīśvara kamalāpati ka: jaya jaya jaya jagad-īśvara kamalā-pati karuṇā-rasa varuṇālaya-vele | caraṇāmbuja śaraṇāgata karuṇā-rasa varuṇālaya mura-bādhana karabodhana saphalīkṛta śaraṇāgata janatāgamavele | kiñcid-udañcita susmita-bhañjita candra-kalā-mada-sūcita sampada vimala vilocana jita-kamalānana sakṛd-avalokana sajjana durjana bheda-vilopana līlā-lole | śobhana-śīle | śubha-guṇa-māle | sundara-bhāle | kuṭila-nirantara kuntala-māle | maṇi-vara-viracita mañjula-māle | padma-surabhi gandha mārdava makaranda phalitākṛti-bandha padminī bāle | akuṇṭha-vaikuṇṭha mahā-vibhūti-nāyaki | akhilāṇḍakoṭi brahmāṇḍa-nāyaki | śrī-veṅkaṭa-nāyaki | śrīmati padmāvati | jaya vijayī-bhava ||
devi/lakshmi/18_lakshmi_gadyam.txt.cāmpeye tena baddhā svapatimavarayattasy: cāmpeye tena baddhā sva-patim-avarayat-tasya kanyā satī yā |
devi/lakshmi/18_lakshmi_gadyam.txt.seyaṁ śrī veṅkaṭādriprabhuvaramahiṣī bhā: seyaṁ śrī veṅkaṭādri-prabhu-vara-mahiṣī bhātu padmāvatī śrīḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/18_lakshmi_gadyam.txt.kharvībhavadatigarvīkṛta gurumervīśagiri: kharvībhavad-atigarvīkṛta gurumervīśagiri mukhorvīdhara kula darvīkara-dayitorvī dhara śikharorvī phaṇi-pati gurvīśvarakṛta rāmānuja-muni nāmāṅkita bahu-bhūmāśraya sura-dhāmālaya vara-nandana-vana sundaratarānanda mandirānanta guruvanānanta keli-yuta nibhṛtatara vihṛti rata līlā-cora rāja-kumāra nija-pati svaira-saha-vihāra samaya nibhṛtoṣita phaṇi-pati guru-bhakti pāśa-vaśaṁvada nigṛhītārāma campaka nibaddhe | bhakta janāvana baddha śraddhe | bhajana vimukha bhavijana bhagavad-upasadana samaya nirīkṣaṇa santata sannaddhe | bhāgadheya-guru bhavyaśeṣaguru bāhu-mūla dhṛta bālikābhūte | śrī-veṅkaṭa-nātha vara-parigṛhīte | śrī-veṅkaṭa-nātha tātabhūta śrīśailapūrṇa-guru gṛha-snuṣā-bhūte | akuṇṭha-vaikuṇṭha mahā-vibhūti-nāyaki | akhilāṇḍakoṭi brahmāṇḍa-nāyaki | śrī-veṅkaṭa-nāyaki | śrīmati padmāvati | jaya vijayī-bhava ||
devi/lakshmi/18_lakshmi_gadyam.txt.śrīśaile kelikāle munisamupagame yā bhay: śrīśaile keli-kāle muni-samupagame yā bhayāt prāk prayātā
devi/lakshmi/18_lakshmi_gadyam.txt.bhadre | bhakta janāvana nirnidre | bhag: bhadre | bhakta janāvana nirnidre | bhagavad-dakṣiṇa vakṣo-lakṣaṇa lākṣā-lakṣita mṛdu-pada mudre | bhañjita bhavya-navya-dara-dalita-dala mṛdula kokanada mada vilasa dadharordhva vinyāsa savyāpasavya-kara virājadanitara śaraṇa-bhakta-gaṇa nija-caraṇa śaraṇīkaraṇābhaya vitaraṇa nipuṇa nirūpaṇa nirnidra-mudre | ullasadūrdhvatarāparakara śikhara-yugala śekhara nija-mañjima mada-bhañjana kuśalavadana vidhu-maṇḍala vilokana vidīrṇa hṛdayatā vibhramadharadara vidalita-dala komala kamala-mukula yugalanirargala vinirgalat-kānti samudre | śrī-veṅkaṭa śikharasahamahiṣī nikara kānta-līlāvasara saṅgata-muni-nikara samudita bahulatara bhayalasadapasārakeli bahu-mānye | śrīśailādhīśa racita dinādhīśa bimbaramādhīśaviṣaya tapojanye | śrīśailāsanna śuka-purī-sampanna padma-sara utpanna padminī-kanye | padmasarovarya racita mahāścarya ghora-tapaścarya śrī-śuka-muni-dhurya kāmita vadānye | mānava karma-jāla durmala marma nirmūlana labdha-varṇa nija-salilaja-varṇa nirjita durvarṇa vajra-sphaṭika savarṇa salila sampūrṇa suvarṇamukharī saikata sañjāta santata makaranda bindu-sandoha niṣyanda sandānitāmandānanda milinda vṛnda madhuratara jhaṅkāra-rava rucira santata samphulla mallī mālatī pramukha vratati vitati kunda kuravaka maruvaka damanakādi gulma-kusuma mahima ghumaghumita sarva diṅ-mukha sarvato-mukha mahanīyā mandamākandāvirala nārikela niravadhika kramuka pramukha taru-nikara-vīthi ramaṇīya vipula taṭodyāna vihāriṇi | mañjulatara maṇi-hāriṇi | mahanīyatara maṇi-jita-taraṇi makuṭa-manohāriṇi | mantharatara sundara-gati matta marāla yuvati sugati madāpahāriṇi | kalakaṇṭha yuvākuṇṭha kaṇṭha-nāda kala vyāhāriṇi | akuṇṭha-vaikuṇṭha mahā-vibhūti-nāyaki | akhilāṇḍakoṭi brahmāṇḍa-nāyaki | śrī-veṅkaṭa-nāyaki | śrīmati padmāvati | jaya vijayī-bhava ||
devi/lakshmi/18_lakshmi_gadyam.txt.ambhoruhavāsini | ambhoruhāsana pramukhā: ambhoruha-vāsini | ambhoruhāsana pramukhākhila bhūtānuśāsini | anavaratātma-nātha vakṣaḥ siṁhāsanādhyāsini | aṅghri-yugāvatāra pathasantata saṅgāhamāna ghoratarā bhaṅgura saṁsāra gharma-santapta manuja santāpa-nāśini | bahula kuntala vadana-maṇḍala pāṇi-pallava rucira-locana subhaga-kandharā bāhu-vallikā jaghana nitamba maṇḍalamaya vitata-śaivāla samphulla kamala kuvalaya kambukamalinī nālottuṅga vipula pulina śobhini | mādhava mahārṇavagāhini | mahita-lāvaṇya mahāvāhini | (...long chain of further compound epithets describing her face, brow, eyes, cheeks, ears and ornaments...) manthara taramehi | mandam-imam-avehi | mayi mana ādhehi | mama śubham-avadhehi | maṅgalamayi bhāhi | akuṇṭha-vaikuṇṭha mahā-vibhūti-nāyaki | akhilāṇḍakoṭi brahmāṇḍa-nāyaki | śrī-veṅkaṭa-nāyaki | śrīmati padmāvati | jaya vijayī-bhava ||

devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.dāridryāttrāhi māṁ lakṣmi kṛpāṁ kuru mam: dāridryāt-trāhi māṁ lakṣmi kṛpāṁ kuru mamopari ||
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.ārtihantri namastubhyaṁ samṛddhiṁ kuru m: ārti-hantri namas-tubhyaṁ samṛddhiṁ kuru me sadā ||
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.rudrādyā ravicandradevapatayo vaktuṁ ca: rudrādyā ravi-candra-deva-patayo vaktuṁ ca naiva kṣamāḥ |
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.mātarmāṁ paripāhi viśvajananī kṛtvā mame: mātar-māṁ paripāhi viśva-jananī kṛtvā mameṣṭaṁ dhruvam ||
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.tvameva jananī lakṣmīḥ pitā lakṣmīstvame: tvam-eva jananī lakṣmīḥ pitā lakṣmīs-tvam-eva ca |
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.bhrātā tvaṁ ca sakhā lakṣmīrvidyā lakṣmī: bhrātā tvaṁ ca sakhā lakṣmīr-vidyā lakṣmīs-tvam-eva ca ||
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.anyanme śaraṇaṁ nāsti satyaṁ satyaṁ hari: anyan-me śaraṇaṁ nāsti satyaṁ satyaṁ hari-priye ||
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.nityaṁ paṭhati yo bhaktyā tvalakṣmīstasy: nityaṁ paṭhati yo bhaktyā tv-alakṣmīs-tasya naśyati |
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.gṛhe tasya sadā tiṣṭennityaṁ śrīḥ patinā: gṛhe tasya sadā tiṣṭen-nityaṁ śrīḥ patinā saha ||
devi/lakshmi/19_lakshmi_stotram_agastya_.putravān guṇavān śreṣṭho bhogabhoktā ca: putravān guṇavān śreṣṭho bhoga-bhoktā ca mānavaḥ ||

devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.kṛṣṇapriyāyai sārāyai padmāyai ca namo n: kṛṣṇa-priyāyai sārāyai padmāyai ca namo namaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.surabhiḥ sā gavāṁ mātā dakṣiṇā yajñakāmi: surabhiḥ sā gavāṁ mātā dakṣiṇā yajña-kāminī ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.svāhā tvaṁ ca havirdāne kavyadāne svadhā: svāhā tvaṁ ca havir-dāne kavya-dāne svadhā smṛtā ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.tvaṁ hi viṣṇusvarūpā ca sarvādhārā vasun: tvaṁ hi viṣṇu-svarūpā ca sarvādhārā vasundharā |
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.jīvanmṛtaṁ ca viśvaṁ ca śavatulyaṁ yayā: jīvan-mṛtaṁ ca viśvaṁ ca śava-tulyaṁ yayā vinā ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.sarveṣāṁ ca parā tvaṁ hi sarvabāndhavarū: sarveṣāṁ ca parā tvaṁ hi sarva-bāndhava-rūpiṇī |
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.yayā vinā na sambhāṣyo bāndhavairbāndhav: yayā vinā na sambhāṣyo bāndhavair-bāndhavaḥ sadā ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.tathā tvaṁ sarvadā mātā sarveṣāṁ sarvavi: tathā tvaṁ sarvadā mātā sarveṣāṁ sarva-viśvataḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.tvayā hīno janaḥ ko'pi na jīvatyeva niśc: tvayā hīno janaḥ ko'pi na jīvaty-eva niścitam ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.vairigrastaṁ ca viṣayaṁ dehi mahyaṁ sanā: vairi-grastaṁ ca viṣayaṁ dehi mahyaṁ sanātani ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.kīrtiṁ dehi dhanaṁ dehi putrānmahyaṁ ca: kīrtiṁ dehi dhanaṁ dehi putrān-mahyaṁ ca dehi vai ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.kāmaṁ dehi matiṁ dehi bhogān dehi haripr: kāmaṁ dehi matiṁ dehi bhogān dehi hari-priye |
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.jñānaṁ dehi ca dharmaṁ ca sarvasaubhāgya: jñānaṁ dehi ca dharmaṁ ca sarva-saubhāgyam-īpsitam ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.ityuktvā tu mahendraśca sarvaiḥ suragaṇa: ity-uktvā tu mahendraś-ca sarvaiḥ sura-gaṇaiḥ saha |
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.nanāma sāśrunetro'yaṁ mūrdhnā caiva puna: nanāma sāśru-netro'yaṁ mūrdhnā caiva punaḥ punaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.brahmā ca śaṅkaraścaiva śeṣo dharmaśca k: brahmā ca śaṅkaraś-caiva śeṣo dharmaś-ca keśavaḥ |
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.yayurdaivāśca santuṣṭāḥ svaṁ svaṁ sthāna: yayur-daivāś-ca santuṣṭāḥ svaṁ svaṁ sthānaṁ ca nārada |
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.devī yayau hareḥ kroḍaṁ hṛṣṭā kṣīrodaśāy: devī yayau hareḥ kroḍaṁ hṛṣṭā kṣīroda-śāyinaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.dattvā śubhāśiṣaṁ tau ca devebhyaḥ prīti: dattvā śubhāśiṣaṁ tau ca devebhyaḥ prīti-pūrvakam ||
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.idaṁ stotraṁ mahāpuṇyaṁ trisandhyaṁ yaḥ: idaṁ stotraṁ mahā-puṇyaṁ trisandhyaṁ yaḥ paṭhen-naraḥ |
devi/lakshmi/20_mahalakshmi_stotram_mahe.mahāsukhī ca rājendro bhaviṣyati na saṁś: mahā-sukhī ca rājendro bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ||

devi/lakshmi/21_trailokya_mangala_lakshm.namo bhaktipriye devi lakṣmīdevi namo'st: namo bhakti-priye devi lakṣmī-devi namo'stu te ||
devi/lakshmi/21_trailokya_mangala_lakshm.tasya gehe sthirā lakṣmīrjāyate nātra sa: tasya gehe sthirā lakṣmīr-jāyate nātra saṁśayaḥ ||

devi/lakshmi/22_mahalakshmi_kavacham_2.t.sāvadhānamanā bhūtvā śṛṇu tvaṁ śuka satt: sāvadhāna-manā bhūtvā śṛṇu tvaṁ śuka sattama |
devi/lakshmi/22_mahalakshmi_kavacham_2.t.kamale ca supatrāḍhye hyabhayaṁ dadhatīṁ: kamale ca supatrāḍhye hy-abhayaṁ dadhatīṁ varam |
devi/lakshmi/22_mahalakshmi_kavacham_2.t.vakṣaḥ kukṣiṁ karau pāyuṁ pṛṣṭhamavyādra: vakṣaḥ kukṣiṁ karau pāyuṁ pṛṣṭham-avyād-ramā svayam ||
devi/lakshmi/22_mahalakshmi_kavacham_2.t.kaṭimūrudvayaṁ jānu jaṅghaṁ pātu ramā ma: kaṭim-ūru-dvayaṁ jānu jaṅghaṁ pātu ramā mama |
devi/lakshmi/22_mahalakshmi_kavacham_2.t.saptadhātūn svayaṁ cāpi raktaṁ śukraṁ ma: sapta-dhātūn svayaṁ cāpi raktaṁ śukraṁ mano mama |
devi/lakshmi/22_mahalakshmi_kavacham_2.t.mayā kṛtaṁ ca yatkiñcittatsarvaṁ pātu se: mayā kṛtaṁ ca yat-kiñcit-tat-sarvaṁ pātu sendirā |
devi/lakshmi/22_mahalakshmi_kavacham_2.t.sarvābhīṣṭaṁ tu me dadyātpātu māṁ kamalā: sarvābhīṣṭaṁ tu me dadyāt-pātu māṁ kamalālayā ||
devi/lakshmi/22_mahalakshmi_kavacham_2.t.nāgninā dahyate gehaṁ na corādyaiśca pīḍ: nāgninā dahyate gehaṁ na corādyaiś-ca pīḍyate |

devi/lakshmi/23_mahalakshmi_stava.txt.devi tvāṁ stotumicchāmi na kṣamāḥ stotum: devi tvāṁ stotum-icchāmi na kṣamāḥ stotum-īśvarāḥ |
devi/lakshmi/23_mahalakshmi_stava.txt.staumi vāṅmanasoḥ pārāṁ kiṁ vā'haṁ jagad: staumi vāṅ-manasoḥ pārāṁ kiṁ vā'haṁ jagad-ambike ||
devi/lakshmi/23_mahalakshmi_stava.txt.vedānāṁ vai vedavidāṁ jananīṁ varṇayāmi: vedānāṁ vai veda-vidāṁ jananīṁ varṇayāmi kim ||
devi/lakshmi/23_mahalakshmi_stava.txt.kutra mātā putradoṣaṁ taṁ vihāya ca gacc: kutra mātā putra-doṣaṁ taṁ vihāya ca gacchati ||
devi/lakshmi/23_mahalakshmi_stava.txt.stanandhayebhya iva me he mātardehi darś: stanandhayebhya iva me he mātar-dehi darśanam |
devi/lakshmi/23_mahalakshmi_stava.txt.sukhadaṁ mokṣadaṁ sāraṁ śubhadaṁ sampada: sukhadaṁ mokṣa-daṁ sāraṁ śubhadaṁ sampadaḥ pradam ||
devi/lakshmi/23_mahalakshmi_stava.txt.idaṁ stotraṁ mahāpuṇyaṁ pūjākāle ca yaḥ: idaṁ stotraṁ mahā-puṇyaṁ pūjā-kāle ca yaḥ paṭhet |

devi/lakshmi/24_lakshmi_stotram_sarvadev.tvayā vinā jagatsarvaṁ mṛtatulyaṁ ca niṣ: tvayā vinā jagat-sarvaṁ mṛta-tulyaṁ ca niṣphalam ||
devi/lakshmi/24_lakshmi_stotram_sarvadev.kailāse pārvatī tvaṁ ca kṣīrode sindhuka: kailāse pārvatī tvaṁ ca kṣīrode sindhu-kanyakā |
devi/lakshmi/24_lakshmi_stotram_sarvadev.gaṅgā ca tulasī tvaṁ ca sāvitrī brahmalo: gaṅgā ca tulasī tvaṁ ca sāvitrī brahma-lokataḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/24_lakshmi_stotram_sarvadev.iti lakṣmīstavaṁ puṇyaṁ sarvadevaiḥ kṛta: iti lakṣmī-stavaṁ puṇyaṁ sarva-devaiḥ kṛtaṁ śubham |
devi/lakshmi/24_lakshmi_stotram_sarvadev.yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya sa vai sarvaṁ la: yaḥ paṭhet-prātar-utthāya sa vai sarvaṁ labhed-dhruvam ||

devi/lakshmi/25_lakshmi_stotram_lopamudr.candre jyotsnā prabhā sūrye viśvamātarna: candre jyotsnā prabhā sūrye viśva-mātar-namo'stu te ||
devi/lakshmi/25_lakshmi_stotram_lopamudr.devo gṛhaṁ kaṇaḥ śreṣṭhā viśvamātarnamo': devo gṛhaṁ kaṇaḥ śreṣṭhā viśva-mātar-namo'stu te ||
devi/lakshmi/25_lakshmi_stotram_lopamudr.abdhije viṣṇupatni tvaṁ prasīda satataṁ: abdhije viṣṇu-patni tvaṁ prasīda satataṁ priye ||

devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.asya śrīsiddhalakṣmīstotramantrasya hira: asya śrī-siddhalakṣmī-stotra-mantrasya hiraṇyagarbha ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ, śrī-mahākālī-mahālakṣmī-mahāsarasvatyo devatāḥ śrīṁ bījaṁ hrīṁ śaktiḥ klīṁ kīlakaṁ mama sarva-kleśa-pīḍā-parihārārthaṁ sarva-duḥkha-dāridrya-nāśanārthaṁ sarva-kārya-siddhy-arthaṁ śrī-siddhilakṣmī-stotra pāṭhe viniyogaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.oṁ klīṁ brāhmyai vaiṣṇavyai rudrāṇyai ka: oṁ klīṁ brāhmyai vaiṣṇavyai rudrāṇyai kara-tala kara-pṛṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.oṁ hrīṁ tejaḥ prakāśinyai netratrayāya v: oṁ hrīṁ tejaḥ prakāśinyai netra-trayāya vauṣaṭ |
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.oṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ śrīṁ siddhalakṣmyai na: oṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ śrīṁ siddhalakṣmyai namaḥ iti dig-bandhaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.brāhmīṁ ca vaiṣṇavīṁ bhadrāṁ ṣaḍbhujāṁ c: brāhmīṁ ca vaiṣṇavīṁ bhadrāṁ ṣaḍbhujāṁ ca catur-mukhīm |
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.oṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ śrīṁ siddhalakṣmyai na: oṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ śrīṁ siddhalakṣmyai namaḥ iti dig-vimokaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.etat stotravaraṁ devyā ye paṭhanti sadā: etat stotra-varaṁ devyā ye paṭhanti sadā narāḥ |
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.ekamāsaṁ dvimāsaṁ ca trimāsaṁ ca catusth: eka-māsaṁ dvi-māsaṁ ca trimāsaṁ ca catusthathā |
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.pañcamāsaṁ ca ṣaṇmāsaṁ trikālaṁ yaḥ sadā: pañca-māsaṁ ca ṣaṇmāsaṁ trikālaṁ yaḥ sadā paṭhet ||
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.yā śrīḥ padmavane kadambaśikhare rājagṛh: yā śrīḥ padma-vane kadamba-śikhare rāja-gṛhe kuñjare
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.śvete cāśvayute vṛṣe ca yugale yajñe ca: śvete cāśvayute vṛṣe ca yugale yajñe ca yūpa-sthite |
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.sā śrīstiṣṭhatu sarvadā mama gṛhe bhūyāt: sā śrīs-tiṣṭhatu sarvadā mama gṛhe bhūyāt sadā niścalā ||
devi/lakshmi/26_siddha_lakshmi_stotram.t.nityaṁ sā padmahastā mama vasatu gṛhe sa: nityaṁ sā padma-hastā mama vasatu gṛhe sarva-māṅgalya-yuktā ||

devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.yaśo dehi dhanaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca dehi: yaśo dehi dhanaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.putrān dehi dhanaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca de: putrān dehi dhanaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.vidyāṁ dehi kalān dehi sarvakāmāṁśca deh: vidyāṁ dehi kalān dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.dhanaṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca de: dhanaṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.dhānyaṁ dehi dhanaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca d: dhānyaṁ dehi dhanaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.prajñāṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca d: prajñāṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.aśvāṁśca gokulaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca dehi: aśvāṁś-ca gokulaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.vīryaṁ dehi balaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca deh: vīryaṁ dehi balaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.jayaṁ dehi śubhaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca deh: jayaṁ dehi śubhaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.bhāgyaṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca d: bhāgyaṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.kīrtiṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca de: kīrtiṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.āyurdehi śriyaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca dehi: āyur-dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.siddhiṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca d: siddhiṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.rūpaṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca deh: rūpaṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||
devi/lakshmi/27_mahalakshmi_stutih.txt.mokṣaṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarvakāmāṁśca de: mokṣaṁ dehi śriyaṁ dehi sarva-kāmāṁś-ca dehi me ||

devi/lakshmi/28_lakshmi_kavacam.txt.yaḥ paṭhenniyato bhaktyā sa eva viṣṇuvad: yaḥ paṭhen-niyato bhaktyā sa eva viṣṇuvad-bhavet |
devi/lakshmi/28_lakshmi_kavacam.txt.rājadvāre ca naukāyāṁ tathā ca raṇamadhy: rāja-dvāre ca naukāyāṁ tathā ca raṇa-madhyataḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/28_lakshmi_kavacam.txt.aputrā ca tathā vandhyā tripakṣaṁ śṛṇuyā: aputrā ca tathā vandhyā tripakṣaṁ śṛṇuyād-yadi ||

devi/lakshmi/30_lakshmi_stotram_devaih_k.namaḥ śriyai lokadhātryai brahmamātre na: namaḥ śriyai loka-dhātryai brahma-mātre namo namaḥ |

devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.sa(vi)ndhyāvalī prāñjalistāṁ natvā hṛdi: sa(vi)ndhyāvalī prāñjalis-tāṁ natvā hṛdi jagāda ca |
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.namaḥ prakṛtisaṁjñāyai mūlāyai te namo n: namaḥ prakṛti-saṁjñāyai mūlāyai te namo namaḥ |
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.saṁhartryai brahmamātre te kukṣisṛṣṭyai: saṁhartryai brahma-mātre te kukṣi-sṛṣṭyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.vāmanā vāpi dīrghāśca nārāyaṇāstu te muk: vāmanā vāpi dīrghāś-ca nārāyaṇās-tu te mukhe |
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.bhagavantaśca te garbhe caṇḍalakṣmyai na: bhagavantaś-ca te garbhe caṇḍa-lakṣmyai namo'stu te ||
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.śaktayaste raktaleśaḥ pāhi kāntaṁ drutaṁ: śaktayas-te rakta-leśaḥ pāhi kāntaṁ drutaṁ kuru ||
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.yadyahaṁ vidhavā syāṁ cetpūrvaṁ tvaṁ vid: yady-ahaṁ vidhavā syāṁ cet-pūrvaṁ tvaṁ vidhavā bhava ||
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.yadyahaṁ rājyaśūnyāṁ syāṁ tvaṁ vaikuṇṭha: yady-ahaṁ rājya-śūnyāṁ syāṁ tvaṁ vaikuṇṭhaṁ vinā bhava |
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.madyajñe cedbhavedvighnaṁ tava yajñe tat: mad-yajñe ced-bhaved-vighnaṁ tava yajñe tathā'stu vai |
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.sāntvayitvā ca tāṁ rājñīṁ patitāṁ kharva: sāntvayitvā ca tāṁ rājñīṁ patitāṁ kharva-pādayoḥ |
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.vāmanaśca tadā prāha nainaṁ vai mārayāmy: vāmanaś-ca tadā prāha nainaṁ vai mārayāmy-aham |
devi/lakshmi/31_lakshmi_stotram_sandhyav.daityo'yaṁ daityarājyaṁ vai karotu sutal: daityo'yaṁ daitya-rājyaṁ vai karotu sutale priye ||

devi/lakshmi/33_lakshmi_stutih.txt.nutapadakamalā kamalā karadhṛtakamalā ka: nuta-pada-kamalā kamalā kara-dhṛta-kamalā karotu me kamalam ||
devi/lakshmi/33_lakshmi_stutih.txt.pāyādvaḥ puruṣottamo'yamiti yo nyastaḥ s: pāyād-vaḥ puruṣottamo'yam-iti yo nyastaḥ sa puṣpāñjaliḥ ||

devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.padmākṣī padmanābhorasi kṛtavasatiḥ padm: padmākṣī padmanābhorasi kṛta-vasatiḥ padma-gā śrīḥ śriyai naḥ ||
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.śrīḥ padmā prakṛtiḥ sattvā śāntā cicchak: śrīḥ padmā prakṛtiḥ sattvā śāntā cicchaktir-avyayā |
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.śuddhā dhvaniḥ sṛtiḥ sṛṣṭirvikṛtiḥ kṛṣṭi: śuddhā dhvaniḥ sṛtiḥ sṛṣṭir-vikṛtiḥ kṛṣṭir-eva ca |
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.siddhiḥ svāhā svadhā svasti sudhā sarvār: siddhiḥ svāhā svadhā svasti sudhā sarvārtha-sādhinī ||
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.mahāśvanā ca yā śṛṅgī kārdamī kambukandh: mahā-śvanā ca yā śṛṅgī kārdamī kambu-kandharā |
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.dīkṣā vīkṣā parīkṣā ca samīkṣā vīravatsa: dīkṣā vīkṣā parīkṣā ca samīkṣā vīra-vatsalā |
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.kāśyapī śubhadātrī ca vanamālā śubhā var: kāśyapī śubha-dātrī ca vanamālā śubhā varā ||
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.sāṅgā pracaṇḍā dīptā ca vaidyutiḥ sumahā: sāṅgā pracaṇḍā dīptā ca vaidyutiḥ sumahā-dyutiḥ |
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.dhurandharā ca bālā ca dharmasevyā tathā: dhurandharā ca bālā ca dharma-sevyā tathāgatā ||
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.sā devī pāpahantrī ca sāṁnidhyaṁ kurutān: sā devī pāpa-hantrī ca sāṁnidhyaṁ kurutān-mama ||
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.yasyā lakṣmyāśca sambhūtāḥ śaktayo viśva: yasyā lakṣmyāś-ca sambhūtāḥ śaktayo viśva-gāḥ sadā |
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.yo yo jagati pumbhāvaḥ sa viṣṇuriti niśc: yo yo jagati pum-bhāvaḥ sa viṣṇur-iti niścayaḥ |
devi/lakshmi/34_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.yā yā tu nārībhāvasthā tatra lakṣmīrvyav: yā yā tu nārī-bhāva-sthā tatra lakṣmīr-vyavasthitā ||

devi/lakshmi/35_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.raktā kṛṣṇā sitā pītā sarvavarṇā nirīśva: raktā kṛṣṇā sitā pītā sarva-varṇā nirīśvarī |
devi/lakshmi/35_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.śraddhā medhā kṛtiḥ prajñā dhāraṇā kānti: śraddhā medhā kṛtiḥ prajñā dhāraṇā kāntir-eva ca ||
devi/lakshmi/35_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.durbhikṣadhvaṁsinī devī sītā satyā ca ru: durbhikṣa-dhvaṁsinī devī sītā satyā ca rukmiṇī |
devi/lakshmi/35_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.siṁhagā vyāghragā devī vāyugā ca mahādri: siṁha-gā vyāghra-gā devī vāyugā ca mahādrigā ||
devi/lakshmi/35_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.ekamātrā dvimātrā ca trimātrā ca tathāpa: eka-mātrā dvi-mātrā ca trimātrā ca tathāparā |
devi/lakshmi/35_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.nityā tathyā ramā rāmā ramaṇī mṛtyubhañj: nityā tathyā ramā rāmā ramaṇī mṛtyu-bhañjanī ||
devi/lakshmi/35_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.mahālakṣmīruvāca- nāmnāṁ sāṣṭasahasraṁ m: mahālakṣmīruvāca- nāmnāṁ sāṣṭa-sahasraṁ me pramādād-vāpi yas-sakṛt |
devi/lakshmi/35_lakshmi_sahasranama_stot.mannāma stuvatāṁ loke durlabhaṁ nāsti ci: man-nāma stuvatāṁ loke durlabhaṁ nāsti cintitam |

devi/lalita/02_kalyanavrishti_stavah.txt.stotraṁ yaḥ prativāsaraṁ tava puro mātar: stotraṁ yaḥ prativāsaraṁ tava puro mātar-japen-mantravit |
devi/lalita/02_kalyanavrishti_stavah.txt.iti śrīmatparamahaṁsaparivrājakācāryasya: iti śrīmat-paramahaṁsa-parivrājakācāryasya śrī-govinda-bhagavat-pūjyapāda-śiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkara-bhagavataḥ kṛtau kalyāṇa-vṛṣṭi stavaḥ |

devi/lalita/03_kamakshi_stotram_1.txt.aiṁ klīṁ sauriti yāṁ vadanti munayastatt: aiṁ klīṁ sauriti yāṁ vadanti munayas-tattvārtha-rūpāṁ parāṁ
devi/lalita/03_kamakshi_stotram_1.txt.vācāmādimakāraṇaṁ hṛdi sadā dhyāyanti yā: vācām-ādima-kāraṇaṁ hṛdi sadā dhyāyanti yāṁ yoginaḥ |
devi/lalita/03_kamakshi_stotram_1.txt.vāgdevīti ca yāṁ vadanti munayaḥ kṣīrābd: vāgdevīti ca yāṁ vadanti munayaḥ kṣīrābdhi-kanyeti ca
devi/lalita/03_kamakshi_stotram_1.txt.kṣoṇībhṛttanayeti ca śrutigiro yāṁ āmana: kṣoṇībhṛt-tanayeti ca śruti-giro yāṁ āmananti sphuṭam |

devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.yā karoti svasaṅkalpāttasyai devyai namo: yā karoti sva-saṅkalpāt-tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.nāgamaiśca na vedaiśca na śāstrairna ca: nāgamaiś-ca na vedaiś-ca na śāstrair-na ca yogibhiḥ |
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.vedyā yā ca svasaṁvedyā tasyai devyai na: vedyā yā ca sva-saṁvedyā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.hṛdayasthāpi sarveṣāṁ yā na kenāpi dṛśya: hṛdaya-sthāpi sarveṣāṁ yā na kenāpi dṛśyate |
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.yaddhyānaikaparā nityaṁ tasyai devyai na: yad-dhyānaika-parā nityaṁ tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.dhatte sarvajanādhārāṁ tasyai devyai nam: dhatte sarva-janādhārāṁ tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.yanmayaṁ munayaḥ prāhustasyai devyai nam: yan-mayaṁ munayaḥ prāhus-tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.gururmantro devatā ca tathā prāṇāśca pañ: gurur-mantro devatā ca tathā prāṇāś-ca pañcadhā |
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.yā virājati cidrūpā tasyai devyai namo n: yā virājati cid-rūpā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.tattadrūpeṇa yā bhāti tasyai devyai namo: tat-tad-rūpeṇa yā bhāti tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
devi/lalita/05_kamakshi_stotram_3_brahma.iti śrībrahmāṇḍamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge l: iti śrī-brahmāṇḍa-mahā-purāṇe uttara-bhāge lalitopākhyāne ekonacatvāriṁśo'dhyāye brahma-kṛta śrī kāmākṣī stotram |

devi/lalita/06_kamakshi_stotram_4_parama.grahanutacaraṇe gṛhasutadāyini nava nava: graha-nuta-caraṇe gṛha-suta-dāyini nava nava bhavate kāmākṣi |
devi/lalita/06_kamakshi_stotram_4_parama.śivamukhavinute bhavasukhadāyini nava na: śiva-mukha-vinute bhava-sukha-dāyini nava nava bhavate kāmākṣi |

devi/lalita/07_kamesvari_stutih.txt.tvaṁ bījaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ tvaṁ buddhiścet: tvaṁ bījaṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ tvaṁ buddhiś-cetanā dhṛtiḥ |
devi/lalita/07_kamesvari_stutih.txt.tvaṁ prabodhaśca nidrā ca kāmeśvari namo: tvaṁ prabodhaś-ca nidrā ca kāmeśvari namo'stu te ||
devi/lalita/07_kamesvari_stutih.txt.tvāmāśrayanti ye bhaktyā yānti cāśrayatā: tvām-āśrayanti ye bhaktyā yānti cāśrayatāṁ tu te |
devi/lalita/07_kamesvari_stutih.txt.iti śrīmahābhāgavate mahāpurāṇe yudhiṣṭh: iti śrī-mahābhāgavate mahā-purāṇe yudhiṣṭhira-kṛta śrī kāmeśvarī stutiḥ |

devi/lalita/08_tripurasundaryashtakam.tx.iti śrīmatparamahaṁsaparivrājakācāryasya: iti śrīmat-paramahaṁsa-parivrājakācāryasya śrī-govinda-bhagavat-pūjyapāda-śiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkara-bhagavataḥ kṛtau tripurasundaryaṣṭakam |

devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.jaya jaya jagadekamātarnamaścandra cūḍen: jaya jaya jagad-eka-mātar-namaś-candra cūḍendra sopendra padmodbhavoṣṇāṁśu śītāṁśu śikhi pavana yama dhanada danujendra-pati varuṇa-pramukha sakala sura mukuṭa-maṇi nicaya-kara nikara parijanita pura vividha ruci-rucira kusuma-caya buddhi-lubdha bhramad-bhramara-mālā ninādānugata mañju-śiñjāna mañjīra-kala kanakamaya kiṅkiṇī kvāṇayan nṛtyad-uddāma nibhṛta-pada-lalita kiṅkarālaṅkṛta sucaṅkramaṇa līle sulīle, sthalāmbhoja nibha-caraṇa nakha-ratna kānticchalena hara-nayana havyāśana-pratikṛtānaṅga vijaya-śriyā asau bhavatyā bhava iva śaraṇāgataḥ pāda-mūle samālīna ivālakṣyate sulakṣyate, lalita lāvaṇya-taru kandalī subhaga jaṅghā-late cillate ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.galita kaladhauta prabhorudyute sudyute: galita kaladhauta prabhorudyute sudyute vidyud-udyota māṇikya bandhojjvalānargha kāñcī
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.dakṣiṇāvarta nābhibhramatrivalitaṭa pari: dakṣiṇāvarta nābhibhramatrivalitaṭa pariluṭhita lalita lāvaṇya-rasa sura-nimnagā bhūṣita sumadhya deśe sudeśe, sphurat-tāra hārāvalī gagana gaṅgā-taraṅga vrajāliṅgitottuṅga nibiḍa-stana sauvarṇa
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.murārikara kamburekhānugata kaṇṭhapīṭhe: murāri-kara kambu-rekhānugata kaṇṭha-pīṭhe supīṭhe, lasat sarala savilāsa bhuja-yugala parihasita
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.mahārhamaṇivalayaja mayūkhacaya māṁsala: mahārha-maṇi-valaya-ja mayūkha-caya māṁsala kara-kamala nakha-ratna kiraṇe jitaraṇe sukaraṇe suśaraṇe ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.sphurat padmarāgendra maṇikuṇḍalollasita: sphurat padmarāgendra maṇi-kuṇḍalollasita kānticchaṭocchurita gaṇḍasthalī racita kastūrikā patra-rekhā samudghāta sunāsīra gāṇḍīva śobhe suśobhe ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.mahāsiddha gandharvagaṇa kinnarī tumburu: mahā-siddha gandharva-gaṇa kinnarī tumburu pramukha vara-racita vara-vividha pada-maṅgalānaṅga saṅgīta sukha-śravaṇa sampūrṇa-karṇe jaya svāmini ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.śaśi śakala sugandhi tāmbūla paripūrṇamu: śaśi śakala sugandhi tāmbūla paripūrṇa-mukhi sumukhi ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.bālapravāla prabhādhara dalopānta viśrān: bāla-pravāla prabhādhara dalopānta viśrānta danta-dyuti dyotitāśoka nava-pallavāsakta śarad-indu kara-nikara sāndra-prabhe suprabhe devi ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.kapolatala kāntivibhavena na vibhānti na: kapola-tala kānti-vibhavena na vibhānti naśyanti yānti dhāvanti tejāṁsi ca tamāṁsi ca vimalatara taralatara tārakānaṅga līlā vilāsollasat karṇa-mūlānta viśrānta vipulekṣaṇākṣepa vikṣipta
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.lasadvaṁśamaṇi jālakāntarita vara calat: lasad-vaṁśa-maṇi jālakāntarita vara calat kuntalāntānugata kunda-mālānuṣakta bhramad-bhramara paṅkte supaṅkte ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.vahadbahala parimala manohāri navamālikā: vahad-bahala parimala manohāri navamālikā mallikā mālatī ketakī campakendīvarodāra mandāra mālānu saṅgrathita dhammilla-mūrdhāvanaddhendu karasañcayoyaṁ gagana-tala sañcaroyaṁ yaśaścatra rūpaḥ
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.yasya madhurasmita jyotiṣā pūrṇahariṇāṅk: yasya madhura-smita jyotiṣā pūrṇa-hariṇāṅka-lakṣmīḥ kṣaṇākṣepa vikṣipyate tasya mukha-puṇḍarīkasya kavibhiḥ kadā kopamā kena kasmin kathaṁ dīyate ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.sphuṭa sphaṭika ghaṭitākṣasūtra nakṣatra: sphuṭa sphaṭika ghaṭitākṣasūtra nakṣatra-caya cakra-parivartana vinoda sandarśita niśā-samaya-cāre sucāre, mahā-jñānamaya pustakaṁ hasta-padme atra vāme dadhatyā bhavatyā tadā susphuṭaṁ vāma-mārgasya sarvottamattvaṁ samupadiṣyate ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.divyamukhasaurabhe yogaparyaṅka baddhāsa: divya-mukha-saurabhe yoga-paryaṅka baddhāsane suvadane surasane sudarśane sumadane suhasane sureśi janani tubhyaṁ namo jaya janani tubhyaṁ namo jaya janani tubhyaṁ namaḥ ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.a i u ṛ ḷ iti laghutayā tadanu dairghyeṇ: a i u ṛ ḷ iti laghutayā tadanu dairghyeṇa pañcaiva yonis-tathā vāgbhavaṁ praṇava au binduraḥ, ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ta tha da dha na pa pha ba bha ma ya ra la va śa ṣa sa ha la iti subaddha rudrātmikāṁ amṛta-kara kiraṇa-gaṇa varṣiṇīṁ mātṛkāṁ udgirantī hasantī lasantī vasantī tadā tatra kamala-vana bhavanabhūmau bhavantī bhava-bhedinī bhaya-bhañjinī sabhūrbhuvaḥsvarbhuvanamūrti bhavye subhavye sukāvye ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.sukṛtinā yena sambhāvyase tasya jarjarit: sukṛtinā yena sambhāvyase tasya jarjarita jarasovirajaso'pi putrīkṛtārkasya sat-tarka pada-vākya āgama veda vedāṅga vedānta siddhānta saura śaivādi vaiṣṇava purāṇetihāsa smṛti gāruḍa bhūta-tantra svarodaya jyotiṣāyurveda nānākhyāna pātāla-śāstrārtha mantra-śikṣādikaṁ vividha vidyā-kulaṁ likhita pada-gumpha sambandha rasa sat-kānti sodāra bhaṇita prabandha prabhūtārtha
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.samālaṅkṛtāśeṣa bhāṣā mahākāvya līlodayā: samālaṅkṛtāśeṣa bhāṣā mahā-kāvya līlodayāsiddhi rūpayāti sadya ambike ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.vāgbhavenaikena vāgdevi vāgīśvaro jāyate: vāgbhavenaikena vāgdevi vāgīśvaro jāyate kinnukila kāmākṣareṇa sakṛd-uccaritenaiva tava sādhako bādhako bhavati bhuvi sarva śṛṅgāriṇāṁ tan-nayana-patha patita netra-nīlotpalā jhaṭiti yadi
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.siddha gandharvagaṇa sundarī lalitavarav: siddha gandharva-gaṇa sundarī lalita-vara-vidyādharī vā surīvāmarīvā mahī-nātha-nāthāṅganā vā
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.jvalanmadana śaranikara dalita saṅkṣobhi: jvalan-madana śara-nikara dalita saṅkṣobhitā nigaḍiteva jvaliteva skhaliteva muṣiteva sampadyate, śakti-bījaika sandhyāyināṁ yogināṁ bhogināṁ vainateyāyate dāhināṁ amṛta-meghāyate dussahaviṣāṇāṁ niśānātha-cūḍāyate dhyāyate dhāryate yenabījatrayaṁ tasyanāmnaiva paśu-pāśa-mala-pañjaraṁ tṛṭyati tad-ājñayā siddhyati ca guṇāṣṭakaṁ bhakti-bhājāṁ mahā-bhairavi kavalita sakala-tattvātmike susvarūpe surūpe pariṇataśivāyaṁ tvāyi tadā kaḥ paraḥ śiṣyate, kā kriyā śiṣyate yadi tvad-bhakti-hīnasya tatvasya kā artha-kriyā kāritā taditi tasmin vidhau tasya kiṁ dhāma kiṁ nāma kiṁ karma kiṁ śarma kiṁ narma kiṁ varma kiṁ dharma kā gatiḥ kā ratiḥ kā matiḥ kiṁ varjanīyaṁ ca ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.jhaṭiti yadi sarvaśūnyāntarbhūmau nijecc: jhaṭiti yadi sarva-śūnyāntarbhūmau nijecchā samunmeṣa samayaṁ samāsādya bālārka koṭy-aṁśa-rūpā vigarbhīkṛtāśeṣa saṁsāra bījā'nubaddhāsi kandaṁ tadā tvaṁ ambikā gīyase tadanu parijanita kuṭilāgra tejo'ṅkurā janani vāmeti saṁstūyase, tataḥ baddha suspaṣṭa rekhā śikhā jyeṣṭheti sambhāvyase, saiva śṛṅgāṭakākāratāṁ āgatā tadā raudrīti vikhyāpyase ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.tāśca vāmādikāsvat kalāstrīn guṇān sanda: tāśca vāmādikāsvat kalās-trīn guṇān sandadhatyaḥ kriyā jñānacaya vāñchā svarūpāḥ kramāt tāmarasa-janma madhu-mathana pura-vairiṇāṁ bīja-bhāvaṁ bhajantyaḥ sṛjantyas-tri-bhuvanaṁ tripurasundarī iti tena saṅkīrtyase ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.tatra śṛṅgāṭapīṭhollasat kuṇḍalākāra tej: tatra śṛṅgāṭa-pīṭhollasat kuṇḍalākāra tejo kulāt prollasantī sagandhī śivārkaṁ samāskandya cāndraṁ mahā-maṇḍalaṁ drāvayantī pibantī sudhāṁ kula-vadhūḥ kulaṁ parityajya para-puruṣa kulīnam-avalambya viśvaṁ paribhrāmya sarvasvam-ākramya tenaiva mārgeṇa nija-kula-nivāsaṁ samāgatya santuṣyasīti priyaḥ kaḥ patiḥ kaḥ prabhuḥ ko'stu tenaiva jānīmahe he maheśāni ramase ca kāmeśvarī kāmagiry-ālaye'naṅga-kusumādibhiḥ sevitā tad-upari jālandhara-pīṭhe vajra-pīṭheṣu vajreśvarī parijanān-naṭayasi punaḥ pūrṇa-giri-gahvare nagna-vasanārcite bhagamālinī vilasasi devi jvalanmamadana śara-nikara madhu vikasita samada madhukara kadamba vipina vibhave bhagavati
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.śrī tripurasundari śrī oḍyāṇapīṭhe namas: śrī tripurasundari śrī oḍyāṇa-pīṭhe namaste namaste namaste namaste śive ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.sa cāṣṭaguṇa sampadāṁ bhavatu bhājanaṁ s: sa cāṣṭa-guṇa sampadāṁ bhavatu bhājanaṁ sarvadā ||
devi/lalita/09_tripurasundari_dandakam.t.iti śrīdīpakanāthasiddha viracitaṁ śrī t: iti śrī-dīpakanātha-siddha viracitaṁ śrī tripurasundarī daṇḍakam |

devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.mama na bhajanaśaktiḥ pādayoste na bhakt: mama na bhajana-śaktiḥ pādayos-te na bhaktir-na ca viṣaya-viraktir-dhyāna-yoge na saktiḥ |
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.madhyālambiviśālamauktikarucā jyotsnāyit: madhyālambi-viśāla-mauktika-rucā jyotsnāyitaṁ kutracin-mātaḥ śrī-maṇi-mandiraṁ tava sadā vandāmahe sundaram ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.nīto vājibhirutpathaṁ bata rathaḥ sūtena: nīto vājibhir-utpathaṁ bata rathaḥ sūtena tigma-dyuter-valgāvalgita-hastam-asta-śikharaṁ kaṣṭair-itaḥ prāpyate ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.ā jñātaṁ girije kaṭākṣakalayā nūnaṁ tvay: ā jñātaṁ girije kaṭākṣa-kalayā nūnaṁ tvayā toṣite
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.śaṅkhe śrīvasudhārayā vasumatīyuktaṁ ca: śaṅkhe śrī-vasudhārayā vasumatī-yuktaṁ ca padmaṁ smaran-kāmaṁ naumi rati-priyaṁ sahacaraṁ prītyā vasantaṁ bhaje ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.pādyaṁ te parikalpayāmi padayorarghyaṁ t: pādyaṁ te parikalpayāmi padayor-arghyaṁ tathā hastayoḥ
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.nidhehi maṇipādukopari padāmbujaṁ majjan: nidhehi maṇi-pādukopari padāmbujaṁ majjanālayaṁ vraja śanaiḥ sakhīkṛta-karāmbujālambanam |
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.tailaṁ kaṅkatikaṁ kareṣu dadhatīrvande'm: tailaṁ kaṅkatikaṁ kareṣu dadhatīr-vande'mba te dāsikāḥ ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.veṇībandhamapāsya kaṅkatikayā keśaprasād: veṇī-bandham-apāsya kaṅkatikayā keśa-prasādaṁ manāk-kurvāṇā para-devatā bhagavatī citte mama dyotatām ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.snānaṁ te parikalpayāmi girije bhaktyā t: snānaṁ te parikalpayāmi girije bhaktyā tad-aṅgīkuru ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.madhyasthāruṇaratnakāntirucirāṁ prāntast: madhyasthāruṇa-ratna-kānti-rucirāṁ prānta-stha-muktāphala-vrātām-amba catuṣkikāṁ paraśive vakṣaḥ-sthale sthāpaya ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.muktābhiḥ padmarāgairmarakatamaṇibhirnir: muktābhiḥ padmarāgair-marakata-maṇibhir-nirmitā dīpyamānair-nityaṁ hāra-trayī te paraśiva-rasike cetasi dyotatāṁ naḥ ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.vegādakṣipathaṁ gatānsuragaṇānālokayantī: vegād-akṣi-pathaṁ gatān-sura-gaṇān-ālokayantī śanair-ditsantī caraṇāmbujaṁ pathi jagat-pāyān-maheśa-priyā ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.agre gāyati kiṁnarī kalapadaṁ gandharvak: agre gāyati kiṁnarī kala-padaṁ gandharva-kāntāḥ śanair-ātodyāni ca vādayanti madhuraṁ savyāpasavya-sthitāḥ |
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.visphūrjanmaṇipāduke ca dadhatīḥ siṁhāsa: visphūrjan-maṇi-pāduke ca dadhatīḥ siṁhāsanasyābhitas-tiṣṭhantīḥ paricārikās-tava sadā vandāmahe sundari ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.nairṛtye mahiṣāsurapramathinīṁ durgāṁ ca: nairṛtye mahiṣāsura-pramathinīṁ durgāṁ ca sampūjayann-āgneye'khila-bhakta-rakṣaṇa-paraṁ kṣetrādhināthaṁ bhaje ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.lokeśaḥ pṛthivīpatirnigadito viṣṇurjalān: lokeśaḥ pṛthivī-patir-nigadito viṣṇur-jalānāṁ prabhus-tejo-nātha umāpatiś-ca marutām-īśas-tathā ceśvaraḥ |
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.sthitā dadhatu maṅgalaṁ subhagasarvasaṅk: sthitā dadhatu maṅgalaṁ subhaga-sarva-saṅkṣobhiṇī-mukhāḥ sakala-siddhayo vidita-sampradāyābhidhāḥ ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.ramyaṁ puṣpaśarāsanaṁ sulalitaṁ pāśaṁ ta: ramyaṁ puṣpa-śarāsanaṁ sulalitaṁ pāśaṁ tathā cāṅkuśaṁ
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.visphūrjadvadanā parāpararahaḥ sā pātu m: visphūrjad-vadanā parāpara-rahaḥ sā pātu māṁ yoginī ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.dūrataḥ parihṛtaṁ madhuvratairarpayāmi t: dūrataḥ parihṛtaṁ madhuvratair-arpayāmi tava devi campakam ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.itthaṁ kāmakalātmikāṁ bhagavatīmantaḥ sa: itthaṁ kāma-kalātmikāṁ bhagavatīm-antaḥ samārādhayann-ānandāmbudhi-majjane pralabhatām-ānandathuṁ sajjanaḥ ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.prājyaṁ māhiṣamājyamuttamamidaṁ haiyaṅga: prājyaṁ māhiṣam-ājyam-uttamam-idaṁ haiyaṅgavīnaṁ pṛthak-pātreṣu pratipāditaṁ paraśive tat-sarvam-aṅgīkuru ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.sampannāni ca vesavāravisarairdivyāni bh: sampannāni ca vesavāra-visarair-divyāni bhaktyā kṛtāny-agre te vinivedayāmi girije sauvarṇa-pātra-vraje ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.jñātvā tattvacatuṣṭayaṁ prathamato manye: jñātvā tattva-catuṣṭayaṁ prathamato manye sutṛptāṁ tataḥ |
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.vāmena svarṇapātrīmanupamaparamānnena pū: vāmena svarṇa-pātrīm-anupama-paramānnena pūrṇāṁ dadhānām-anyena svarṇa-darvīṁ nija-jana-hṛdayābhīṣṭadāṁ dhārayantīm |
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.śrotraṁ hanta śṛṇotu na tvagapi na sparś: śrotraṁ hanta śṛṇotu na tvag-api na sparśaṁ samālambatām |
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.jihvā vettu na vā rasaṁ mama paraṁ yuṣma: jihvā vettu na vā rasaṁ mama paraṁ yuṣmat-svarūpāmṛte
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.yastvāṁ paśyati pārvati pratidinaṁ dhyān: yas-tvāṁ paśyati pārvati pratidinaṁ dhyānena tejo-mayīṁ
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.manye sundari tattvametadakhilaṁ vedeṣu: manye sundari tattvam-etad-akhilaṁ vedeṣu niṣṭhāṁ gatam |
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.nityānandasudhāmbudhiṁ tava mukhaṁ paśya: nityānanda-sudhāmbudhiṁ tava mukhaṁ paśyanti dṛśyanti ca ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.gītajñābhiḥ prakāmaṁ madhurasamadhuraṁ v: gīta-jñābhiḥ prakāmaṁ madhurasa-madhuraṁ vāditaṁ kiṁnarībhir-vīṇā-jhaṅkāra-nādaṁ kalaya paraśivānanda-sandhāna-hetoḥ ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.kṛtāñjalipuṭo muhuḥ kalitabhūmiraṣṭāṅgak: kṛtāñjali-puṭo muhuḥ kalita-bhūmir-aṣṭāṅgakair-namāmi bhagavaty-ahaṁ tripurasundari trāhi mām ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.vijñaptīravadhehi me sumahatā yatnena te: vijñaptīr-avadhehi me sumahatā yatnena te saṁnidhiṁ
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.cittaṁ tvatpadabhāvane vyabhicareddṛgvāk: cittaṁ tvat-pada-bhāvane vyabhicared-dṛg-vāk-ca me jātu cet-tat-saumye sva-guṇair-badhāna na yathā bhūyo vinirgacchati ||
devi/lalita/12_tripurasundari_manasapuja.dhyātaṁ devi tathāpi te svamanasā śrīpād: dhyātaṁ devi tathāpi te sva-manasā śrīpādukā-pūjanam |

devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.sadyaḥ prasīda me mātaḥ sandhyāvidye sar: sadyaḥ prasīda me mātaḥ sandhyā-vidye sarasvatī ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.mandā nindālolupāhaṁ svabhāvādetatstotra: mandā nindā-lolupāhaṁ svabhāvād-etat-stotraṁ pūryate kiṁ mayeti |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.mā te bhītirhe mate tvādṛśānāmeṣā netrī: mā te bhītir-he mate tvādṛśānām-eṣā netrī rādhasā sūnṛtānām ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tatra paśyāmi buddhyā tadakṣare parame v: tatra paśyāmi buddhyā tad-akṣare parame vyoman ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.idaṁ tava kṣālanajātasaubhagaṁ caraṇaṁ n: idaṁ tava kṣālana-jāta-saubhagaṁ caraṇaṁ no loke sudhitāṁ dadhātu ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.seve nityaṁ śreyase bhūyase tvāmajāmekāṁ: seve nityaṁ śreyase bhūyase tvām-ajām-ekāṁ lohita-śukla-kṛṣṇām ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.devi dhyātvā tvāṁ purā kaiṭabhārirviśvaṁ: devi dhyātvā tvāṁ purā kaiṭabhārir-viśvaṁ bibharti bhuvanasya nābhiḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.mūrtiṁ dhyātvā śāśvatīṁ bhūtimāyannindro: mūrtiṁ dhyātvā śāśvatīṁ bhūtim-āyann-indro rājā jagato ya īśe ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.antevāsinnasti cette mumukṣā vakṣye yukt: antevāsinn-asti cette mumukṣā vakṣye yuktiṁ mukta-sarvaiṣaṇaḥ san |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.śānto dānto deśikendraṁ praṇamya tasyāde: śānto dānto deśikendraṁ praṇamya tasyādeśāt-tārakaṁ mantra-tattvam |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.jānīte cedamba dhanyaḥ samānaṁ nātaḥ par: jānīte ced-amba dhanyaḥ samānaṁ nātaḥ paraṁ veditavyaṁ hi kiñcit ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tvameva kāraṇaṁ kāryaṁ kriyā jñānaṁ tvam: tvam-eva kāraṇaṁ kāryaṁ kriyā jñānaṁ tvam-eva ca |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tvāmamba na vinā kiñcittvayi sarvaṁ prat: tvām-amba na vinā kiñcit-tvayi sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.aṣṭābhistvāṁ sāyudhairbhāsamānāṁ durgāṁ: aṣṭābhis-tvāṁ sāyudhair-bhāsamānāṁ durgāṁ devīgṁ śaraṇam-ahaṁ prapadye ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.madvaśyā ye durācārā ye ca sanmārgagāmin: mad-vaśyā ye durācārā ye ca sanmārga-gāminaḥ |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.bandhūkābhāṁ bhāvayāmi trinetrāṁ tāmagni: bandhūkābhāṁ bhāvayāmi trinetrāṁ tām-agni-varṇāṁ tapasā jvalantīm ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.no vā yāgairnaiva pūrtādikṛtyairno vā ja: no vā yāgair-naiva pūrtādi-kṛtyair-no vā japyair-no mahadbhis-tapobhiḥ |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.no vā yogaiḥ kleśakṛdbhiḥ sumedhā nicāyy: no vā yogaiḥ kleśa-kṛdbhiḥ sumedhā nicāyyemāṁ śāntim-atyantam-eti ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.prātaḥ pāhi mahāvidye madhyāhne tu mṛḍap: prātaḥ pāhi mahāvidye madhyāhne tu mṛḍa-priye |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.sāyaṁ pāhi jagadvandye punarnaḥ pāhi viś: sāyaṁ pāhi jagad-vandye punar-naḥ pāhi viśvataḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.lāvaṇyābdheḥ sundari tvaṁ prasādādāyuḥ p: lāvaṇyābdheḥ sundari tvaṁ prasādād-āyuḥ prajāgṁ rayim-asmāsu dhehi ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.trirvadāmi mumukṣūṇāṁ sā kāṣṭhā sā parā: trir-vadāmi mumukṣūṇāṁ sā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tava nāmāsti yattena jihvā me madhumatta: tava nāmāsti yat-tena jihvā me madhumattamā ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.prasīda me dayādhune praśastimamba naḥ s: prasīda me dayādhune praśastim-amba naḥ skṛdhi ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.muñca pāpīyasīṁ niṣṭhāṁ mā gṛdhaḥ kasya: muñca pāpīyasīṁ niṣṭhāṁ mā gṛdhaḥ kasya svid-dhanam ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.aṅkuśastava taṁ hanyādyaśca no dviṣate j: aṅkuśas-tava taṁ hanyād-yaś-ca no dviṣate janaḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.re re citta tvaṁ vṛdhā śokasindhau majja: re re citta tvaṁ vṛdhā śoka-sindhau majjasy-antar-vacmy-upāyaṁ vimuktyai |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.devyāḥ pādau pūjayaikākṣareṇa tatte pada: devyāḥ pādau pūjayaikākṣareṇa tatte padaṁ saṅgraheṇa bravīmy-om ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.hanta svātmatvena yāṁ muktikāmo matvā dh: hanta svātmatvena yāṁ mukti-kāmo matvā dhīro harṣa-śokau jahāti ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.śape tvatpādukābhyāṁ me nānyaḥ panthā ay: śape tvat-pādukābhyāṁ me nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yoginyo'nyāḥ śaktayaścāṇimādyā yūyaṁ pāt: yoginyo'nyāḥ śaktayaś-cāṇimādyā yūyaṁ pātaḥ svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.paśyantastvāṁ ye ca tṛptiṁ labhante teṣā: paśyantas-tvāṁ ye ca tṛptiṁ labhante teṣāṁ śāntiḥ śāśvatī netareṣām ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.candrottaṁsaṁ cinmayaṁ vastu kiñcidviddh: candrottaṁsaṁ cinmayaṁ vastu kiñcid-viddhi tvam-etan-nihitaṁ guhāyām ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yāmāśliṣyanmodate devadevaḥ sā no devī s: yām-āśliṣyan-modate deva-devaḥ sā no devī suhavā śarma yacchatu ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.kā me bhītiḥ kā kṣatiḥ kiṁ durāpaṁ kāmeś: kā me bhītiḥ kā kṣatiḥ kiṁ durāpaṁ kāmeśāṅkottuṅga-paryaṅka-saṁsthām |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.lalite tvāṁ sakṛnnatvā na bibheti kutaśc: lalite tvāṁ sakṛn-natvā na bibheti kutaścana ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.kṛpayā kuru kalyāṇi tathā me svastirāyuṣ: kṛpayā kuru kalyāṇi tathā me svastir-āyuṣi ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.cakraṁ seve tārakaṁ sarvasidhyai śrīmanm: cakraṁ seve tārakaṁ sarvasidhyai śrīman-mātaḥ siddhayaś-cāṇimādyāḥ |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.nityā mudrā śaktayaścāṅgadevyo yasmindev: nityā mudrā śaktayaś-cāṅga-devyo yasmin-devā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.vidyudvallīkandalīṁ kalpayantīṁ mūrtiṁ s: vidyud-vallī-kandalīṁ kalpayantīṁ mūrtiṁ sphūrtyā paṅkajaṁ dhārayantīm |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.dhyāyanhi tvāṁ jāyate sārvabhaumo viśvā: dhyāyan-hi tvāṁ jāyate sārvabhaumo viśvā āśāḥ pṛtanāḥ sañjayañ-jayan ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.herambāmba tvāṁ hṛdā lambate yastasmai v: herambāmba tvāṁ hṛdā lambate yas-tasmai viśaḥ svayam-evānamante ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.hrīmityekaṁ tāvakaṁ vācakārṇaṁ yajjihvāg: hrīm-ity-ekaṁ tāvakaṁ vācakārṇaṁ yaj-jihvāgre devi jāgarti kiñcit |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.ko vāyaṁ syātkāmakāmastrilokyāṁ sarve'sm: ko vāyaṁ syāt-kāma-kāmas-trilokyāṁ sarve'smai devāḥ balim-āvahanti ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tvatpāṇisthaṁ kuṅkumābhaṁ śive yaṁ dviṣm: tvat-pāṇi-sthaṁ kuṅkumābhaṁ śive yaṁ dviṣmas-tasmin-prati muñcāmi pāśam ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yo japatyamba te vidyāṁ so'kṣaraḥ parama: yo japaty-amba te vidyāṁ so'kṣaraḥ paramaḥ svarāṭ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.dāridryābdhau devi magno'pi śaśvadvācā y: dāridryābdhau devi magno'pi śaśvad-vācā yāce nāham-amba tvad-anyam |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tasmādasmadvāñchitaṁ pūrayaitaduṣā sā na: tasmād-asmad-vāñchitaṁ pūrayaitad-uṣā sā naktā sudugheva dhenuḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yo vā yadyatkāmanākṛṣṭacittaḥ stutvopāst: yo vā yad-yat-kāmanākṛṣṭa-cittaḥ stutvopāste devi te cakra-vidyām |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.kalyāṇānāmālayaḥ kālayogāttaṁ taṁ lokaṁ: kalyāṇānām-ālayaḥ kāla-yogāt-taṁ taṁ lokaṁ jayate tāṁśca kāmān ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.śrīsaṁmrājñi tvāṁ sadālokayeyaṁ sadā sad: śrī-saṁmrājñi tvāṁ sadālokayeyaṁ sadā sadbhiḥ sevyamānāṁ nigūḍhām ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tvadrūpaṁ hi svānubhūtyaikavedyaṁ na cak: tvad-rūpaṁ hi svānubhūtyaika-vedyaṁ na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.mūrtiṁ bhaktyā dhyāyate hṛtsaroje na tas: mūrtiṁ bhaktyā dhyāyate hṛt-saroje na tasya rogo na jarā na mṛtyuḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tubhyaṁ mātaryo'ñjaliṁ mūrdhni dhatte ma: tubhyaṁ mātar-yo'ñjaliṁ mūrdhni dhatte mauli-śreṇyā bhūbhujas-taṁ namanti |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yaḥ stauti tvāmamba cidvallivācā taṁ dhī: yaḥ stauti tvām-amba cid-valli-vācā taṁ dhīrāsaḥ kavaya unnayanti ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yantreśi tvaṁ vartase stūyamānā na tatra: yantreśi tvaṁ vartase stūyamānā na tatra sūryo bhāti na candra-tārakam ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yastvāṁ paśyan santataṁ naiva tṛptaḥ tas: yas-tvāṁ paśyan santataṁ naiva tṛptaḥ tasmai ca devi vaṣaḍ-astu tubhyam ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.śṛṅgāradevate mātaḥ śriyaṁ vāsaya me kul: śṛṅgāra-devate mātaḥ śriyaṁ vāsaya me kule ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.bhaktyābhaktyā vāpi padyāvasānaśrutyā st: bhaktyābhaktyā vāpi padyāvasāna-śrutyā stutyā caitayā stauti yas-tvām |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tasya kṣipraṁ tvatprasādena mātaḥ satyāḥ: tasya kṣipraṁ tvat-prasādena mātaḥ satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yaḥ paṭhati stutimetāṁ vidyāvantaṁ tamam: yaḥ paṭhati stutim-etāṁ vidyāvantaṁ tam-amba dhanavantam |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tvāmevāhaṁ staumi nityaṁ praṇaumi śrīvid: tvām-evāhaṁ staumi nityaṁ praṇaumi śrīvidyeśāṁ vacmi sañcintayāmi |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.adhyāste yā viśvamātā virājo hṛtpuṇḍarīk: adhyāste yā viśva-mātā virājo hṛt-puṇḍarīkaṁ virajaṁ viśuddham ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.śaṅkareṇa racitaṁ stavottamaṁ yaḥ paṭhej: śaṅkareṇa racitaṁ stavottamaṁ yaḥ paṭhej-jagati bhaktimān-naraḥ |
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.tasya siddhiratulā bhaveddhruvā sundarī: tasya siddhir-atulā bhaved-dhruvā sundarī ca satataṁ prasīdati ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.yatraiva yatraiva śiro madīyaṁ tatraiva: yatraiva yatraiva śiro madīyaṁ tatraiva tatraiva pada-dvayaṁ te ||
devi/lalita/13_tripurasundari_vedapada_s.iti śrīmatparamahaṁsaparivrājakācāryasya: iti śrīmat-paramahaṁsa-parivrājakācāryasya śrī-govinda-bhagavat-pūjyapāda-śiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkara-bhagavataḥ kṛtau tripurasundarī veda-pāda stavaḥ |

devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.na cedevaṁ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spandit: na ced-evaṁ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spanditum-api |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.śaraṇye lokānāṁ tava hi caraṇāveva nipuṇ: śaraṇye lokānāṁ tava hi caraṇāv-eva nipuṇau ||
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.dhanuḥ pauṣpaṁ maurvī madhukaramayī pañc: dhanuḥ pauṣpaṁ maurvī madhukara-mayī pañca viśikhāḥ
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.sakṛnna tvā natvā kathamiva satāṁ sannid: sakṛn-na tvā natvā katham-iva satāṁ sannidadhate
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.sa kartā kāvyānāṁ bhavati mahatāṁ bhaṅgi: sa kartā kāvyānāṁ bhavati mahatāṁ bhaṅgi-rucibhiḥ
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.sahorvaśyā vaśyāḥ kati kati na gīrvāṇaga: sahorvaśyā vaśyāḥ kati kati na gīrvāṇa-gaṇikāḥ ||
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.sa sadyaḥ saṅkṣobhaṁ nayati vanitā ityat: sa sadyaḥ saṅkṣobhaṁ nayati vanitā ity-atilaghu
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.iti stotuṁ vāñchan kathayati bhavāni tva: iti stotuṁ vāñchan kathayati bhavāni tvam-iti yaḥ |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.sadāpūrvaḥ sarvaṁ tadidamanugṛhṇāti ca ś: sadāpūrvaḥ sarvaṁ tad-idam-anugṛhṇāti ca śivas-tavājñām-ālambya kṣaṇa-calitayor-bhrū-latikayoḥ ||
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.niṣevye nitye tvāmahamiti sadā bhāvayati: niṣevye nitye tvām-aham-iti sadā bhāvayati yaḥ |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.śivaḥ śaktiḥ kāmaḥ kṣitiratha raviḥ śīta: śivaḥ śaktiḥ kāmaḥ kṣitir-atha raviḥ śītakiraṇaḥ
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.smaraṁ yoniṁ lakṣmīṁ tritayamidamādau ta: smaraṁ yoniṁ lakṣmīṁ tritayam-idam-ādau tava manor-nidhāyaike
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.tvamāpastvaṁ bhūmistvayi pariṇatāyāṁ na: tvam-āpas-tvaṁ bhūmis-tvayi pariṇatāyāṁ na hi param |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.kirīṭaṁ te haimaṁ himagirisute kīrtayati: kirīṭaṁ te haimaṁ hima-giri-sute kīrtayati yaḥ |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.rajaḥ sattvaṁ bibhrattama iti guṇānāṁ tr: rajaḥ sattvaṁ bibhrat-tama iti guṇānāṁ trayam-iva ||
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.anenāyaṁ dhanyo bhavati na ca te hāniriy: anenāyaṁ dhanyo bhavati na ca te hānir-iyatā
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.vane vā harmye vā samakaranipāto himakar: vane vā harmye vā sama-kara-nipāto hima-karaḥ ||
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.pibanti svacchandaṁ niśi niśi bhṛśaṁ kāñ: pibanti svacchandaṁ niśi niśi bhṛśaṁ kāñjika-dhiyā ||
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.japāpuṣpacchāyā tava janani jihvā jayati: japā-puṣpacchāyā tava janani jihvā jayati sā |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.karāṇāṁ te kāntiṁ kathaya kathayāmaḥ kat: karāṇāṁ te kāntiṁ kathaya kathayāmaḥ katham-ume |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.kayācidvā sāmyaṁ bhajatu kalayā hanta ka: kayācid-vā sāmyaṁ bhajatu kalayā hanta kamalaṁ
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.tavedaṁ naḥ khedaṁ haratu satataṁ prasnu: tavedaṁ naḥ khedaṁ haratu satataṁ prasnuta-mukham |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.kṛśe madhye kiṁcijjanani tava yadbhāti s: kṛśe madhye kiṁcij-janani tava yad-bhāti sudhiyām |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.mamāpyetau mātaḥ śirasi dayayā dhehi car: mamāpy-etau mātaḥ śirasi dayayā dhehi caraṇau |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.niśāyāṁ nidrāṇaṁ niśi caramabhāge ca viś: niśāyāṁ nidrāṇaṁ niśi carama-bhāge ca viśadau |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.padaṁ te kīrtīnāṁ prapadamapadaṁ devi vi: padaṁ te kīrtīnāṁ prapadam-apadaṁ devi vipadāṁ
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.vidhirbhūyo bhūyo nibiḍayati nūnaṁ tava: vidhir-bhūyo bhūyo nibiḍayati nūnaṁ tava kṛte ||
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.śriyo devyāḥ ko vā na bhavati patiḥ kair: śriyo devyāḥ ko vā na bhavati patiḥ kair-api dhanaiḥ |
devi/lalita/14_saundarya_lahari.txt.harasya tvadbhrāntiṁ manasi janayanti sm: harasya tvad-bhrāntiṁ manasi janayanti sma vimalāḥ

devi/lalita/15_sri_lalitha_kavacham.txt.diśaṁ pātu tathā dakṣapārśvaṁ me pātu sa: diśaṁ pātu tathā dakṣa-pārśvaṁ me pātu sarvadā |
devi/lalita/15_sri_lalitha_kavacham.txt.staimityācca sadā pātu prerayantyaḥ śubh: staimityāc-ca sadā pātu prerayantyaḥ śubhaṁ prati ||
devi/lalita/15_sri_lalitha_kavacham.txt.nityāḥ ṣoḍaśa māṁ pātu gajārūḍhāḥ svaśak: nityāḥ ṣoḍaśa māṁ pātu gajārūḍhāḥ sva-śaktibhiḥ |
devi/lalita/15_sri_lalitha_kavacham.txt.tathā hayasamārūḍhāḥ pātu māṁ sarvataḥ s: tathā haya-samārūḍhāḥ pātu māṁ sarvataḥ sadā ||
devi/lalita/15_sri_lalitha_kavacham.txt.rathārūḍhāśca māṁ pātu sarvataḥ sarvadā: rathārūḍhāś-ca māṁ pātu sarvataḥ sarvadā raṇe ||
devi/lalita/15_sri_lalitha_kavacham.txt.tārkṣyārūḍhāśca māṁ pātu tathā vyomagatā: tārkṣyārūḍhāś-ca māṁ pātu tathā vyoma-gatāś-ca tāḥ |
devi/lalita/15_sri_lalitha_kavacham.txt.bhūtagāḥ sarvagāḥ pātu pātu devyaśca sar: bhūta-gāḥ sarvagāḥ pātu pātu devyaś-ca sarvadā ||

devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.yat sūcitaṁ purā nātha kimarthaṁ na prak: yat sūcitaṁ purā nātha kim-arthaṁ na prakāśitam ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.kavacaṁ yadi me prītaḥ kathayasva vṛṣadh: kavacaṁ yadi me prītaḥ kathayasva vṛṣa-dhvaja ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.na deyaṁ kavacaṁ guhyaṁ prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhaga: na deyaṁ kavacaṁ guhyaṁ prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭha-gatair-api |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.haṁsaḥ śaktiḥ parābījaṁ ramābījaṁ ca kīl: haṁsaḥ śaktiḥ parābījaṁ ramā-bījaṁ ca kīlakam |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.aiṁ klīṁ sauḥ vadane bālā pātu sarvārtha: aiṁ klīṁ sauḥ vadane bālā pātu sarvārtha-siddhi-dā ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.girirājasutā devī pātu nityaṁ ca śīrṣake: giri-rāja-sutā devī pātu nityaṁ ca śīrṣake |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.sauḥ pātu tathā pārśve praṇavo bāhumūlak: sauḥ pātu tathā pārśve praṇavo bāhu-mūlake |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.śrotre ratipriyaḥ pātu ghrāṇe śakraḥ sad: śrotre rati-priyaḥ pātu ghrāṇe śakraḥ sadā'vatu |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.hrasauḥ śvāse ca niḥśvāse pātāṁ paramasi: hrasauḥ śvāse ca niḥśvāse pātāṁ parama-siddhidau |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.kāmaḥ kāme sadā pātu pinākī liṅgagocare: kāmaḥ kāme sadā pātu pinākī liṅga-gocare ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.stanau bhṛgupriyā pātu kukṣau ca sa purā: stanau bhṛgu-priyā pātu kukṣau ca sa purāntakaḥ ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.netre vajradharaḥ pātu māyā vai jaṭhare': netre vajra-dharaḥ pātu māyā vai jaṭhare'vatu |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.padadvandve ca sauḥ pātu aiṁ jihvānilaye: pada-dvandve ca sauḥ pātu aiṁ jihvā-nilaye'vatu ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.rakṣāhīnaṁ ca yat sthānaṁ varjitaṁ kavac: rakṣā-hīnaṁ ca yat sthānaṁ varjitaṁ kavacena tu |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.tat sarvaṁ parameśāni ! pātu nityaṁ hari: tat sarvaṁ parameśāni ! pātu nityaṁ hari-priyā ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.śaktikūṭaṁ tathā pātu bhruvormadhye ca p: śakti-kūṭaṁ tathā pātu bhruvor-madhye ca pārvati ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.dakṣagaṇḍe sadā pātu nityaṁ māṁ kulasund: dakṣa-gaṇḍe sadā pātu nityaṁ māṁ kula-sundarī |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.ūrdhvadante sadā pātu devī māṁ sarvamaṅg: ūrdhva-dante sadā pātu devī māṁ sarva-maṅgalā ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.madhyāhne pātu kaumārī rātrau ca śatruva: madhyāhne pātu kaumārī rātrau ca śatru-vallabhā ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.khecarī pādayoḥ pātu yonimudrā ca sarvat: khecarī pādayoḥ pātu yoni-mudrā ca sarvataḥ ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.gandhākarṣaṇarūpā māṁ pātu gandhe ca sar: gandhākarṣaṇa-rūpā māṁ pātu gandhe ca sarvadā ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.pātāle caiva māṁ pātu sarvavaśyakarī tat: pātāle caiva māṁ pātu sarva-vaśya-karī tathā |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.sarvajñā ca gṛhe pātu sarvaśaktimayī raṇ: sarvajñā ca gṛhe pātu sarva-śaktimayī raṇe ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.aruṇā pātu māṁ vāde jayinī jalpakarmaṇi: aruṇā pātu māṁ vāde jayinī jalpa-karmaṇi ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.sarvajñā hṛdaye pātu nityakṛtyā ca śīrṣa: sarvajñā hṛdaye pātu nitya-kṛtyā ca śīrṣake |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.tava nāmni smṛte devi ! sarvayajñaphalaṁ: tava nāmni smṛte devi ! sarva-yajña-phalaṁ labhet ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.nāmnaḥ śataguṇaṁ stotraṁ vyākhyānaṁ cāpi: nāmnaḥ śata-guṇaṁ stotraṁ vyākhyānaṁ cāpi tacchrutam ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.taṁ hiṁsanti ca yoginyo madīyaśāsanāt pr: taṁ hiṁsanti ca yoginyo madīya-śāsanāt priye |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.mano bhavati vai līnaṁ pādayoḥ śrīguroḥ: mano bhavati vai līnaṁ pādayoḥ śrī-guroḥ priye ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.sa ca devo haraḥ sākṣāt tatpatnī parameś: sa ca devo haraḥ sākṣāt tat-patnī parameśvarī ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.yasya bhaktirgurau nityaṁ vartate devava: yasya bhaktir-gurau nityaṁ vartate devavat priye ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.idaṁ kavacamajñātvā yo japet sundarīṁ pa: idaṁ kavacam-ajñātvā yo japet sundarīṁ parām |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.navalakṣaṁ prajaptvāpi tasya vidyā na si: nava-lakṣaṁ prajaptvāpi tasya vidyā na siddhyati ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.yā śaktiḥ sā mahādevī hararūpastu sādhak: yā śaktiḥ sā mahādevī hara-rūpas-tu sādhakaḥ ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.sakṛd yastu paṭhed devi ! kavacaṁ devadu: sakṛd yastu paṭhed devi ! kavacaṁ deva-durlabham ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.sa sarvān labhate kāmān pare devīpuraṁ v: sa sarvān labhate kāmān pare devī-puraṁ vrajet |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.dahet tṛṇaṁ yathā vahnistathā śatrūn jay: dahet tṛṇaṁ yathā vahnis-tathā śatrūn jayet sadā |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.tadgātraṁ prāpya śastrāṇi brahmāstrādīni: tad-gātraṁ prāpya śastrāṇi brahmāstrādīni yāni ca |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.vyādhistasya kadācit tu duḥkhaṁ nāsti ka: vyādhis-tasya kadācit tu duḥkhaṁ nāsti kadācana ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.cāturvargyaṁ kare tasya bhavatyeva na sa: cāturvargyaṁ kare tasya bhavaty-eva na saṁśayaḥ ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.ihaloke sukhaṁ bhuktvā pare mukto bhaviṣ: iha-loke sukhaṁ bhuktvā pare mukto bhaviṣyati ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.na kālasya vaśaṁ gacchenna jarā na ca du: na kālasya vaśaṁ gacchen-na jarā na ca duḥkhitā |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.na rogāstatra jāyante notpātāḥ prabhavan: na rogās-tatra jāyante notpātāḥ prabhavanti ca |
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.akṣayān labhate kāmān muktisthānaṁ ca ga: akṣayān labhate kāmān mukti-sthānaṁ ca gacchati ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.eṣā tu guṭikā devi ! kaṇṭhalagnā dhanapr: eṣā tu guṭikā devi ! kaṇṭha-lagnā dhana-pradā ||
devi/lalita/17_rajarajeshvari_kavacham.t.dakṣiṇe bāhumūle vai yadi tiṣṭhati sarva: dakṣiṇe bāhu-mūle vai yadi tiṣṭhati sarvadā |

devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.evaṁ pūjāgṛhaṁ dhyātvā śrīcakre śrīśivāṁ: evaṁ pūjā-gṛhaṁ dhyātvā śrīcakre śrī-śivāṁ bhaje ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.dhyātvā vai vajrakavacaṁ nyāsaṁ tava kar: dhyātvā vai vajra-kavacaṁ nyāsaṁ tava karomy-ahaṁ ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.karomyatha ṣaḍaṁgākhyaṁ mātṛkāṁ ca kalāṁ: karomy-atha ṣaḍaṁgākhyaṁ mātṛkāṁ ca kalāṁ nyase |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.mahāṣoḍhāṁ tataḥ kurve śāṁbhavaṁ ca mahā: mahā-ṣoḍhāṁ tataḥ kurve śāṁbhavaṁ ca mahā-priye |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.suśriyaṁ ca surūpāṁ ca kampilāṁ praṇamām: suśriyaṁ ca surūpāṁ ca kampilāṁ praṇamāmy-ahaṁ |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.naumi havyavahāṁ nityāṁ bhaje kavyavahāṁ: naumi havya-vahāṁ nityāṁ bhaje kavya-vahāṁ kalāṁ ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.dhāriṇīṁ ca kṣamāṁ vande saurīretāḥ kalā: dhāriṇīṁ ca kṣamāṁ vande saurīr-etāḥ kalā bhaje |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.amṛtāṁ mānadāṁ vande pūṣāṁ tuṣṭiṁ bhajām: amṛtāṁ mānadāṁ vande pūṣāṁ tuṣṭiṁ bhajāmy-ahaṁ |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.lakṣmīṁ dyutiṁ sthitāṁ vande sthitiṁ sid: lakṣmīṁ dyutiṁ sthitāṁ vande sthitiṁ siddhiṁ bhajāmy-ahaṁ |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.etā brahmakalā vande jarāṁ tāṁ pālinīṁ b: etā brahma-kalā vande jarāṁ tāṁ pālinīṁ bhaje ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.varadāṁ hlādinīṁ vande prītiṁ dīrghāṁ bh: varadāṁ hlādinīṁ vande prītiṁ dīrghāṁ bhajāmy-ahaṁ ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.ulkārīṁ mṛtyurūpāṁ ca etā rudrakalā bhaj: ulkārīṁ mṛtyu-rūpāṁ ca etā rudra-kalā bhaje |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.nīlāṁ pītāṁ bhaje śvetāṁ vande'hamaruṇāṁ: nīlāṁ pītāṁ bhaje śvetāṁ vande'ham-aruṇāṁ kalāṁ ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.nivṛttiṁ ca pratiṣṭhāṁ ca vidyāṁ śāntiṁ: nivṛttiṁ ca pratiṣṭhāṁ ca vidyāṁ śāntiṁ bhajāmy-ahaṁ ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.dhūpaṁ dīpaṁ ca naivedyaṁ kalpayāmi śiva: dhūpaṁ dīpaṁ ca naivedyaṁ kalpayāmi śiva-priye |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.jvālāmālāṁ ca citrāṁ ca mahānityāṁ ca sa: jvālāmālāṁ ca citrāṁ ca mahā-nityāṁ ca saṁstuve |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.pāśaṁ cāpaṁ bhaje nityaṁ bhaje stambhana: pāśaṁ cāpaṁ bhaje nityaṁ bhaje stambhanam-aṅkuśaṁ ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.tatra mantreṇa dāsyāmi devi te balimutta: tatra mantreṇa dāsyāmi devi te balim-uttamaṁ |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.jyotirmayi mahārūpe pāhi māṁ tripure sad: jyotirmayi mahā-rūpe pāhi māṁ tripure sadā |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.tvatprītyarthaṁ yataḥ kāñcī śaktiṁ vai p: tvat-prīty-arthaṁ yataḥ kāñcī śaktiṁ vai pūjayāmyahaṁ ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.tathāpi tvāṁ bhajaṁstoṣaṁ cidagnau ca da: tathāpi tvāṁ bhajaṁs-toṣaṁ cid-agnau ca dadāmy-ahaṁ ||
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.yaḥ paṭhet śraddhayā nityaṁ śṛṇuyādvā sa: yaḥ paṭhet śraddhayā nityaṁ śṛṇuyād-vā samāhitaḥ |
devi/lalita/18_sri_lalitha_hrudayam.txt.tatpuṇyaṁ labhate nityaṁ mānavo nātra sa: tat-puṇyaṁ labhate nityaṁ mānavo nātra saṁśayaḥ ||

devi/lalita/32_lalita_arya_kavacam.txt.lalitā kavacaṁ brūhi karuṇā mayi cettava: lalitā kavacaṁ brūhi karuṇā mayi cet-tava ||

devi/lalita/32_lalita_arya_kavacam.txt.jaṅghe ca ṣoḍaśī me pāyātpādau ca pāśasṛ: jaṅghe ca ṣoḍaśī me pāyāt-pādau ca pāśa-sṛṇi-hastā ||
devi/lalita/32_lalita_arya_kavacam.txt.prātaḥ pātu parā māṁ madhyāhne pātu māṁ: prātaḥ pātu parā māṁ madhyāhne pātu māṁ maṇi-gṛhāntasthā |

devi/lalita/32_lalita_arya_kavacam.txt.śrīvidyā ca yaśo me śīlaṁ cāvyācciraṁ ma: śrīvidyā ca yaśo me śīlaṁ cāvyāc-ciraṁ mahārājñī ||

devi/lalita/32_lalita_arya_kavacam.txt.vāgdevī vindhyavāsinī bāle bhuvaneśi pāl: vāgdevī vindhya-vāsinī bāle bhuvaneśi pālaya ciraṁ mām ||
devi/lalita/32_lalita_arya_kavacam.txt.prahasitamukhīṁ ca bhavatīṁ dhyāyantoye: prahasita-mukhīṁ ca bhavatīṁ dhyāyantoye bhavanti mūrdhanyāḥ ||
devi/lalita/32_lalita_arya_kavacam.txt.anudinamanucintayatāṁ phalāni vaktuṁ pra: anudinam-anucintayatāṁ phalāni vaktuṁ pragalbhate na śivaḥ ||
