hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..kroḍāstra vahnijāyāṁ taṁ manuḥ pādadvaya: kroḍāstra vahni-jāyāṁ taṁ manuḥ pāda-dvayaṁ mama ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..hrāṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya nābhideśaṁ sadā: hrāṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya nābhi-deśaṁ sadā mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..hrīṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya pātu jaṅghadvay: hrīṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya pātu jaṅgha-dvayaṁ mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..hrūṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya pātu jānudvayaṁ: hrūṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya pātu jānu-dvayaṁ mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..hraḥ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya codaraṁ pātu sa: hraḥ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya codaraṁ pātu sarvadā ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..aiṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya hṛdayaṁ pātu sar: aiṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya hṛdayaṁ pātu sarvadā |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..klīṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya karayugmaṁ sadā: klīṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya kara-yugmaṁ sadā mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..klaiṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya cubukaṁ me sad: klaiṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya cubukaṁ me sadā'vatu |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..klauṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya pātu coṣṭhadva: klauṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya pātu coṣṭha-dvayaṁ mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..rīṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya phālaṁ pātu mahā: rīṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya phālaṁ pātu mahā-balaḥ |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..rūṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya śiraḥ pāyāt sadā: rūṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya śiraḥ pāyāt sadā mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..raiṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya śikhāṁ mama sad: raiṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya śikhāṁ mama sadā'vatu |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..rauṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya mūrdhānaṁ pātu: rauṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya mūrdhānaṁ pātu sarvadā |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..raḥ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya mukhaṁ pātu sadā: raḥ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya mukhaṁ pātu sadā mama ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..kṣrīṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya netrayugmaṁ sa: kṣrīṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya netra-yugmaṁ sadā mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..kṣrūṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya pātu coṣṭhadva: kṣrūṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya pātu coṣṭha-dvayaṁ mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..kṣraiṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya bhrūyugmaṁ pā: kṣraiṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya bhrū-yugmaṁ pātu sarvadā |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..kṣrauṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya nāsikāṁ pātu: kṣrauṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya nāsikāṁ pātu sarvadā |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..kṣaḥ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya kaṇṭhaṁ pātu ka: kṣaḥ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya kaṇṭhaṁ pātu kapīśvaraḥ ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..glāṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya pātu vakṣasthal: glāṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya pātu vakṣa-sthalaṁ mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..glīṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya bāhuyugmaṁ sadā: glīṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya bāhu-yugmaṁ sadā mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..glaiṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya mama pātu vali: glaiṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya mama pātu vali-trayam |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..glauṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya coradaṁ pātu s: glauṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya coradaṁ pātu sarvadā |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..glaḥ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya nābhiṁ pātu sad: glaḥ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya nābhiṁ pātu sadā mama ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..āṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya vānarāya kaṭiṁ ma: āṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya vānarāya kaṭiṁ mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..ūṁ namaḥ pañcavaktrāya jānudvandvaṁ sadā: ūṁ namaḥ pañca-vaktrāya jānu-dvandvaṁ sadā mama |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..ūrdhvaṁ hayānanaḥ pātu sarvataḥ pātu mṛt: ūrdhvaṁ hayānanaḥ pātu sarvataḥ pātu mṛtyu-hā ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..ūrdhve rāmasakhaḥ pātu pātāle ca kapīśva: ūrdhve rāma-sakhaḥ pātu pātāle ca kapīśvaraḥ |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..evaṁ sarvato māṁ pātu pañcavaktraḥ sadā: evaṁ sarvato māṁ pātu pañca-vaktraḥ sadā kapiḥ ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..guhyaṁ pātu mahāprājñaḥ sandhau pātu śiv: guhyaṁ pātu mahā-prājñaḥ sandhau pātu śiva-priyaḥ ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..jaṅghau pātu kapiśreṣṭhaḥ gulphau pātu m: jaṅghau pātu kapi-śreṣṭhaḥ gulphau pātu mahā-balaḥ ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..sarvāṅgāni mahāśūraḥ pātu māṁ romavān sa: sarvāṅgāni mahā-śūraḥ pātu māṁ romavān sadā |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..bhāryāṁ pātu mahātejaḥ putrān pātu nakhā: bhāryāṁ pātu mahā-tejaḥ putrān pātu nakhāyudhaḥ ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..sa eṣa puruṣaśreṣṭho bhakti muktiṁ ca vi: sa eṣa puruṣa-śreṣṭho bhakti muktiṁ ca vindati ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..sarvaśatrūn kṣaṇe jitvā svayaṁ ca vijayī: sarva-śatrūn kṣaṇe jitvā svayaṁ ca vijayī bhavet ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..sa pumān śriyamāpnoti saṅgrāme vijayī bh: sa pumān śriyam-āpnoti saṅgrāme vijayī bhavet ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..anena mantritaṁ cāpi yaḥ pibet rogapīḍit: anena mantritaṁ cāpi yaḥ pibet roga-pīḍitaḥ |
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..sa naro roganirmuktaḥ sukhī bhavati niśc: sa naro roga-nirmuktaḥ sukhī bhavati niścayaḥ ||
hanuman/03_panchamukha_hanumat_kavacham..na śīghraṁ phalamāpnoti satyaṁ satyaṁ ma: na śīghraṁ phalam-āpnoti satyaṁ satyaṁ mayoditam |

hanuman/05_hanumat_pancharatnam.txt.dāritadaśamukhakīrtiḥ purato mama bhātu: dārita-daśamukha-kīrtiḥ purato mama bhātu hanumato mūrtiḥ ||

hanuman/06_ramadoota_stavam.txt.tvadīyena vegena tulyo na vāyurna vā mān: tvadīyena vegena tulyo na vāyur-na vā mānasaṁ mānavānāṁ kapīśa |
hanuman/06_ramadoota_stavam.txt.bhubhuḥkāranādena rakṣaḥ samūhāstvayā nā: bhubhuḥkāra-nādena rakṣaḥ samūhās-tvayā nāśitā vānarendreṇa sarve ||

hanuman/07_anjaneya_stotram.txt.aṅkuśaṁ ca dadhānaṁ ca kapivīraṁ namāmya: aṅkuśaṁ ca dadhānaṁ ca kapi-vīraṁ namāmy-aham |
hanuman/07_anjaneya_stotram.txt.prāpnoti cintitaṁ kāryaṁ śīghrameva na s: prāpnoti cintitaṁ kāryaṁ śīghram-eva na saṁśayaḥ ||

hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.vibhīṣaṇāya rāmeṇa premṇā dattaṁ ca yatp: vibhīṣaṇāya rāmeṇa premṇā dattaṁ ca yat-purā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.asya śrīhanumat kavacastotramantrasya śr: asya śrī-hanumat kavaca-stotra-mantrasya śrī-rāmacandra ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrī-mahāvīro hanumān devatā, mārutātmaja iti bījaṁ, oṁ añjanā-sūnur-iti śaktiḥ, oṁ hraiṁ hrāṁ hrauṁ iti kavacaṁ svāhā iti kīlakaṁ lakṣmaṇa-prāṇa-dātā iti bījaṁ mama sakala-kārya-siddhy-arthe jape viniyogaḥ ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ rāmadūtāya vidmahe kapirājāya dhīmahi: oṁ rāma-dūtāya vidmahe kapi-rājāya dhīmahi | tanno hanumān pracodayāt ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ huṁ phaṭ svāhā | iti digbandhaḥ ||: oṁ huṁ phaṭ svāhā | iti dig-bandhaḥ ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.prasthānaṁ ca kariṣyāmi siddhirbhavatu m: prasthānaṁ ca kariṣyāmi siddhir-bhavatu me sadā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ hrīṁ hrauṁ oṁ namo bhagavate mahābala: oṁ hrīṁ hrauṁ oṁ namo bhagavate mahā-bala-parākramāya bhūta preta piśāca śākinī ḍākinī yakṣiṇī pūtanā mārī mahā-mārī bhairava yakṣa vetāla rākṣasa graha-rākṣasādikaṁ kṣaṇena hana hana bhañjaya bhañjaya māraya māraya śikṣaya śikṣaya mahā-māheśvara rudrāvatāra huṁ phaṭ svāhā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ namo bhagavate hanumadākhya rudrāya s: oṁ namo bhagavate hanumad-ākhya rudrāya sarva-duṣṭa-jana-mukha-stambhanaṁ kuru kuru hrāṁ hrīṁ hraḥ ṭhaṇṭhaṇṭhaṁ phaṭ svāhā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ namo bhagavate añjanīgarbhasambhūtāya: oṁ namo bhagavate añjanī-garbha-sambhūtāya rāma-lakṣmaṇānanda-karāya kapi-sainya-prakāśanāya parvatotpāṭanāya sugrīva-sādhakāya raṇoccāṭanāya kumāra-brahmacāriṇe gambhīra-śabdodayāya oṁ hrāṁ hrīṁ hraḥ sarva-duṣṭa-nivāraṇāya svāhā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ namo hanumate sarvagrahān bhūtabhaviṣ: oṁ namo hanumate sarva-grahān bhūta-bhaviṣyad-vartamānān dūra-sthān samīpa-sthān sarva-kāla duṣṭa-durbuddhīn-uccāṭayoccāṭaya para-balāni kṣobhaya kṣobhaya mama sarva-kāryaṁ sādhaya sādhaya hanumate oṁ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ phaṭ jahi oṁ śivaṁ siddhaṁ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrauṁ oṁ svāhā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ namo hanumate parakṛta yantramantra p: oṁ namo hanumate para-kṛta yantra-mantra parāhaṅkāra bhūta preta piśāca para-dṛṣṭi vighna-durjana-ceṭaka-vidyā sarva-graha-bhayān nivāraya nivāraya vadha vadha paca paca dala dala cilu cilu kila kila sarva-kuyantrāṇi duṣṭa-vācaṁ phaṭ svāhā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ namo hanumate pāhi pāhi ehi ehi sarva: oṁ namo hanumate pāhi pāhi ehi ehi sarva-graha-bhūtānāṁ śākinī-ḍākinīnāṁ jvala jvala prajvala prajvala bhūta-maṇḍalaṁ preta-maṇḍalaṁ piśāca-maṇḍalaṁ nivāraya nivāraya bhūta-jvara preta-jvara cāturthika-jvara viṣama-jvara māheśvara-jvarān chindhi chindhi bhindhi bhindhi akṣi-śūla vakṣaḥ-śūla śiro'bhyantara-śūla gulma-śūla pitta-śūla brahmarākṣasa-kula para-kula nāga-kula viṣaṁ nāśaya nāśaya nirviṣaṁ kuru kuru phaṭ svāhā | oṁ hrīṁ sarva-duṣṭa-grahān nivāraya phaṭ svāhā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.oṁ namo hanumate pavanaputrāya vaiśvānar: oṁ namo hanumate pavana-putrāya vaiśvānara-mukhāya hana hana antyādṛṣṭyā pāpa-dṛṣṭiṁ duṣṭa-dṛṣṭiṁ hana hana hanumad-ājñayā sphura sphura phaṭ svāhā ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.adhaśca viṣṇubhaktastu pātu madhyaṁ ca p: adhaś-ca viṣṇu-bhaktas-tu pātu madhyaṁ ca pāvaniḥ ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.bhujau pātu mahātejāḥ karau tu caraṇāyud: bhujau pātu mahā-tejāḥ karau tu caraṇāyudhaḥ |
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.guhmaṁ pātu mahāprājñaḥ sakthinī ca śiva: guhmaṁ pātu mahā-prājñaḥ sakthinī ca śiva-priyaḥ ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.sarvān ripūn kṣaṇe jitvā sa pumān śriyam: sarvān ripūn kṣaṇe jitvā sa pumān śriyam-āpnuyāt |
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.yaḥ kare dhārayennityaṁ sa pumān śriyamā: yaḥ kare dhārayen-nityaṁ sa pumān śriyam-āpnuyāt |
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.vivāhe divyakāle ca dyūte rājakule raṇe: vivāhe divya-kāle ca dyūte rāja-kule raṇe ||
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.bhūrje vā vasane rakte kṣaume vā tālapat: bhūrje vā vasane rakte kṣaume vā tāla-patrake |
hanuman/08_ekamukha_hanumat_kavacham.txt.gale kaṭyāṁ bāhumūle kaṇṭhe śirasi dhāri: gale kaṭyāṁ bāhu-mūle kaṇṭhe śirasi dhāritam |

hanuman/09_hanumadashtakam.txt.pātakinaṁ ca samuddhara māṁ mahatāṁ hi s: pātakinaṁ ca samuddhara māṁ mahatāṁ hi satām-api mānam-udāraṁ
hanuman/09_hanumadashtakam.txt.tvāṁ bhajato mama dehi dayāghana he hanu: tvāṁ bhajato mama dehi dayā-ghana he hanuman sva-padāmbuja-dāsyam ||
hanuman/09_hanumadashtakam.txt.taṁ hyadhiruhya hare patitaṁ śaraṇāgatam: taṁ hy-adhiruhya hare patitaṁ śaraṇāgatam-eva vimocaya mūḍhaṁ
hanuman/09_hanumadashtakam.txt.dāśarathiṁ japati kṣitimaṇḍala eṣa nidhā: dāśarathiṁ japati kṣiti-maṇḍala eṣa nidhāya sadaiva hṛd-abje |
hanuman/09_hanumadashtakam.txt.yaḥ satataṁ hi paṭhetsa naro labhate'cyu: yaḥ satataṁ hi paṭhet-sa naro labhate'cyuta-rāma-padābja-nivāsam ||

hanuman/11_vibhishana_krita_hanumat_stot.namaḥ śrīrāmabhaktāya śyāmāsyāya ca te n: namaḥ śrī-rāma-bhaktāya śyāmāsyāya ca te namaḥ ||
hanuman/11_vibhishana_krita_hanumat_stot.saumitri jayadātre ca rāmadūtāya te nama: saumitri jaya-dātre ca rāma-dūtāya te namaḥ ||
hanuman/11_vibhishana_krita_hanumat_stot.rakṣoghnāya ripughnāya bhūtaghnāya ca te: rakṣoghnāya ripu-ghnāya bhūta-ghnāya ca te namaḥ |
hanuman/11_vibhishana_krita_hanumat_stot.viṣaghnāya dviṣaghnāya jvaraghnāya ca te: viṣaghnāya dviṣaghnāya jvara-ghnāya ca te namaḥ ||
hanuman/11_vibhishana_krita_hanumat_stot.vāde vivāde saṅgrāme bhaye ghore mahāvan: vāde vivāde saṅgrāme bhaye ghore mahā-vane ||
hanuman/11_vibhishana_krita_hanumat_stot.tasya kvāpi bhayaṁ nāsti hanumat stavapā: tasya kvāpi bhayaṁ nāsti hanumat stava-pāṭhataḥ ||
hanuman/11_vibhishana_krita_hanumat_stot.sarvadā vai trikālaṁ ca paṭhanīyamidaṁ s: sarvadā vai trikālaṁ ca paṭhanīyam-idaṁ stavam |
hanuman/11_vibhishana_krita_hanumat_stot.ye paṭhiṣyanti bhaktyā vai siddhayastatk: ye paṭhiṣyanti bhaktyā vai siddhayas-tat-kare sthitāḥ ||

hanuman/12_yantrodharaka_hanumat_stotram.namāmi dūtaṁ rāmasya sukhadaṁ ca suradru: namāmi dūtaṁ rāmasya sukhadaṁ ca sura-drumam |
hanuman/12_yantrodharaka_hanumat_stotram.trivāraṁ yaḥ paṭhennityaṁ stotram bhakty: trivāraṁ yaḥ paṭhen-nityaṁ stotram bhaktyā dvijottamaḥ |
hanuman/12_yantrodharaka_hanumat_stotram.sarvathā mā'stu sandeho hariḥ sākṣī jaga: sarvathā mā'stu sandeho hariḥ sākṣī jagat-patiḥ |
hanuman/12_yantrodharaka_hanumat_stotram.yaḥ karotyatra sandehaṁ sa yāti narakaṁ: yaḥ karoty-atra sandehaṁ sa yāti narakaṁ dhruvam ||

hanuman/13_apaduddharaka_hanumat_stotram.oṁ asya śrī āpaduddhāraka hanumat stotra: oṁ asya śrī āpad-uddhāraka hanumat stotra mahā-mantra kavacasya, vibhīṣaṇa ṛṣiḥ, hanumān devatā, sarvāpad-uddhāraka śrī-hanumat-prasādena mama sarvāpan-nivṛtty-arthe, sarva-kāryānukūlya siddhy-arthe jape viniyogaḥ |
hanuman/13_apaduddharaka_hanumat_stotram.pradoṣe vā prabhāte vā ye smarantyañjanā: pradoṣe vā prabhāte vā ye smaranty-añjanā-sutam |
hanuman/13_apaduddharaka_hanumat_stotram.arthasiddhiṁ jayaṁ kīrtiṁ prāpnuvanti na: artha-siddhiṁ jayaṁ kīrtiṁ prāpnuvanti na saṁśayaḥ ||
hanuman/13_apaduddharaka_hanumat_stotram.vibhīṣaṇakṛtaṁ stotram yaḥ paṭhet prayat: vibhīṣaṇa-kṛtaṁ stotram yaḥ paṭhet prayato naraḥ |

hanuman/18_mantratmaka_maruti_stotram.tx.hāniḥ kuto bhavettasya sarvatra vijayī b: hāniḥ kuto bhavet-tasya sarvatra vijayī bhavet ||

hanuman/19_hanumat_tandava_stotram.txt.iti plavaṅganāthabhāṣitaṁ niśamya vānarā: iti plavaṅga-nātha-bhāṣitaṁ niśamya vānarā-'dhinātha āpa śaṁ tadā sa rāma-dūta āśrayaḥ ||
hanuman/19_hanumat_tandava_stotram.txt.na śatruto bhayaṁ bhavetkadāpi tasya nus: na śatruto bhayaṁ bhavet-kadāpi tasya nustviha ||

hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.raṁ raṁ raṁ raktavarṇaṁ dinakaravadanaṁ: raṁ raṁ raṁ rakta-varṇaṁ dinakara-vadanaṁ tīkṣṇa-daṁṣṭrā-karālaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.raṁ raṁ raṁ ramyatejaṁ giricalanakaraṁ k: raṁ raṁ raṁ ramya-tejaṁ giri-calanakaraṁ kīrtipañcādi vaktram |
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.raṁ raṁ raṁ rājayogaṁ sakalaśubhanidhiṁ: raṁ raṁ raṁ rājayogaṁ sakala-śubha-nidhiṁ sapta-bhetāla-bhedyaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.raṁ raṁ raṁ rākṣasāntaṁ sakaladiśayaśaṁ: raṁ raṁ raṁ rākṣasāntaṁ sakala-diśa-yaśaṁ rāma-dūtaṁ namāmi ||
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.khaṁ khaṁ khaṁ khaḍgahastaṁ viṣajvarahar: khaṁ khaṁ khaṁ khaḍga-hastaṁ viṣa-jvara-haraṇaṁ veda-vedāṅga-dīpaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.khaṁ khaṁ khaṁ khaḍgarūpaṁ tribhuvananil: khaṁ khaṁ khaṁ khaḍga-rūpaṁ tri-bhuvana-nilayaṁ devatāsuprakāśam |
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.khaṁ khaṁ khaṁ kalpavṛkṣaṁ maṇimayamakuṭ: khaṁ khaṁ khaṁ kalpavṛkṣaṁ maṇimaya-makuṭaṁ māya māyā-svarūpaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.khaṁ khaṁ khaṁ kālacakraṁ sakaladiśayaśa: khaṁ khaṁ khaṁ kāla-cakraṁ sakala-diśa-yaśaṁ rāma-dūtaṁ namāmi ||
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.iṁ iṁ iṁ indravandyaṁ jalanidhikalanaṁ s: iṁ iṁ iṁ indra-vandyaṁ jala-nidhi-kalanaṁ saumya-sāmrājya-lābhaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.iṁ iṁ iṁ siddhiyogaṁ natajanasadayaṁ āry: iṁ iṁ iṁ siddhi-yogaṁ nata-jana-sadayaṁ ārya-pūjyārcitāṅgam |
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.iṁ iṁ iṁ siṁhanādaṁ amṛtakaratalaṁ ādian: iṁ iṁ iṁ siṁha-nādaṁ amṛta-kara-talaṁ ādiantyaprakāśaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.iṁ iṁ iṁ citsvarūpaṁ sakaladiśayaśaṁ rām: iṁ iṁ iṁ cit-svarūpaṁ sakala-diśa-yaśaṁ rāma-dūtaṁ namāmi ||
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.saṁ saṁ saṁ sākṣibhūtaṁ vikasitavadanaṁ: saṁ saṁ saṁ sākṣi-bhūtaṁ vikasita-vadanaṁ piṅgalākṣaṁ surakṣaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.saṁ saṁ saṁ satyagītaṁ sakalamuninutaṁ ś: saṁ saṁ saṁ satya-gītaṁ sakala-muni-nutaṁ śāstra-sampat-karīyam |
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.saṁ saṁ saṁ sāmavedaṁ nipuṇa sulalitaṁ n: saṁ saṁ saṁ sāmavedaṁ nipuṇa sulalitaṁ nitya-tattva-svarūpaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.saṁ saṁ saṁ sāvadhānaṁ sakaladiśayaśaṁ r: saṁ saṁ saṁ sāvadhānaṁ sakala-diśa-yaśaṁ rāma-dūtaṁ namāmi ||
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.haṁ haṁ haṁ haṁsarūpaṁ sphuṭavikaṭamukha: haṁ haṁ haṁ haṁsa-rūpaṁ sphuṭa-vikaṭa-mukhaṁ sūkṣma-sūkṣmāvatāraṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.haṁ haṁ haṁ antarātmaṁ raviśaśinayanaṁ r: haṁ haṁ haṁ antarātmaṁ ravi-śaśi-nayanaṁ ramya-gambhīra-bhīmam |
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.haṁ haṁ haṁ aṭṭahāsaṁ suravaranilayaṁ ūr: haṁ haṁ haṁ aṭṭahāsaṁ sura-vara-nilayaṁ ūrdhva-romaṁ karālaṁ
hanuman/21_ramadoota_anjaneya_stotram.tx.haṁ haṁ haṁ haṁsahaṁsaṁ sakaladiśayaśaṁ: haṁ haṁ haṁ haṁsahaṁsaṁ sakala-diśa-yaśaṁ rāma-dūtaṁ namāmi ||

hanuman/24_hanumat_kavacam.txt.asya śrī hanumat kavacastotramahāmantras: asya śrī hanumat kavaca-stotra-mahā-mantrasya vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrī hanumān devatā mārutātmaja iti bījaṁ añjanā-sūnur-iti śaktiḥ vāyu-putra iti kīlakaṁ hanumat-prasāda siddhy-arthe jape viniyogaḥ ||
hanuman/24_hanumat_kavacam.txt.śrīrāma rāma rāmeti rame rāme manorame |: śrī-rāma rāma rāmeti rame rāme manorame |
hanuman/24_hanumat_kavacam.txt.guhyaṁ vajratanuḥ pātu jaghanaṁ tu jagad: guhyaṁ vajra-tanuḥ pātu jaghanaṁ tu jagaddhitaḥ ||
hanuman/24_hanumat_kavacam.txt.udaraṁ pātu hṛdgehī hṛdayaṁ ca mahābalaḥ: udaraṁ pātu hṛd-gehī hṛdayaṁ ca mahā-balaḥ ||
hanuman/24_hanumat_kavacam.txt.māmahni pātu sarvajñaḥ pātu rātrau mahāy: mām-ahni pātu sarvajñaḥ pātu rātrau mahā-yaśāḥ |
hanuman/24_hanumat_kavacam.txt.ya idaṁ kavacaṁ nityaṁ paṭhecca śṛṇuyānn: ya idaṁ kavacaṁ nityaṁ paṭhec-ca śṛṇuyān-naraḥ ||

hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.oṁ asya śrī hanumatkavaca stotramahāmant: oṁ asya śrī hanumat-kavaca stotra-mahā-mantrasya śrī rāmacandra ṛṣiḥ śrī hanumān paramātmā devatā anuṣṭup chandaḥ mārutātmajeti bījaṁ añjanī-sūnur-iti śaktiḥ lakṣmaṇa-prāṇa-dāteti kīlakaṁ rāma-dūtāyety-astraṁ hanumān devatā iti kavacaṁ piṅgākṣo'mita-vikrama iti mantraḥ śrī-rāmacandra preraṇayā rāmacandra-prītyarthaṁ mama sakala-kāmanā-siddhy-arthaṁ jape viniyogaḥ |
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.oṁ namo hanumate śobhitānanāya yaśolaṅkṛ: oṁ namo hanumate śobhitānanāya yaśolaṅkṛtāya añjanī-garbha-sambhūtāya rāma-lakṣmaṇānandakāya kapi-sainya-prakāśana parvatotpāṭanāya sugrīva-sāhya-karaṇa paroccāṭana kumāra brahmacarya gambhīra śabdodaya oṁ hrīṁ sarva-duṣṭa-graha-nivāraṇāya svāhā ||
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.oṁ namo hanumate ehi ehi ehi sarvagrahab: oṁ namo hanumate ehi ehi ehi sarva-graha-bhūtānāṁ śākinī ḍākinīnāṁ viṣama-duṣṭānāṁ sarveṣām-ākarṣayākarṣaya mardaya mardaya chedaya chedaya martyān māraya māraya śoṣaya śoṣaya prajvala prajvala bhūta-maṇḍala piśāca-maṇḍala nirasanāya bhūta-jvara preta-jvara cāturthika-jvara brahmarākṣasa piśācacchedanākriyā viṣṇu-jvara maheśa-jvarān chindhi chindhi bhindhi bhindhi akṣi-śūle śiro'bhyantare hy-akṣi-śūle gulma-śūle pitta-śūle brahmarākṣasa-kula-prabala nāgakulavinirviṣajhaṭiti jhaṭiti oṁ hrīṁ phaṭ gheghe svāhā |
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.oṁ namo hanumate pavanaputra vaiśvānaram: oṁ namo hanumate pavana-putra vaiśvānara-mukha pāpa-dṛṣṭi ṣoḍhādṛṣṭi hanumate kā ājñā phure svāhā | sva-gṛhe dvāre paṭṭake tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti tatra roga-bhayaṁ rāja-kula-bhayaṁ nāsti tasyoccāraṇa-mātreṇa sarve jvarā naśyanti oṁ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ gheghe svāhā |
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.adhastu viṣṇubhaktaśca pātu madhyaṁ tu p: adhas-tu viṣṇu-bhaktaś-ca pātu madhyaṁ tu pāvaniḥ ||
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.bhujau pātu mahātejāḥ karau ca caraṇāyud: bhujau pātu mahā-tejāḥ karau ca caraṇāyudhaḥ ||
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.guhyaṁ pātu mahāprājño liṅgaṁ pātu śivap: guhyaṁ pātu mahā-prājño liṅgaṁ pātu śiva-priyaḥ |
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.jaṅghe pātu kapiśreṣṭho gulphau pātu mah: jaṅghe pātu kapi-śreṣṭho gulphau pātu mahā-balaḥ |
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.sa eva puruṣaśreṣṭho bhuktiṁ muktiṁ ca v: sa eva puruṣa-śreṣṭho bhuktiṁ muktiṁ ca vindati ||
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.sarvān ripūn kṣaṇājjitvā sa pumān śriyam: sarvān ripūn kṣaṇāj-jitvā sa pumān śriyam-āpnuyāt ||
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.śokasya haraṇe dakṣaṁ vande taṁ raṇadāru: śokasya haraṇe dakṣaṁ vande taṁ raṇa-dāruṇam ||
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.ya idaṁ prātarutthāya paṭhecca kavacaṁ s: ya idaṁ prātar-utthāya paṭhec-ca kavacaṁ sadā |
hanuman/26_hanumat_kavacam_ananda_ramaya.ye paṭhanti narāścātra paṭhanaṁ tadvṛthā: ye paṭhanti narāś-cātra paṭhanaṁ tad-vṛthā bhavet ||

hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.asya śrīsaptamukhavīrahanumatkavaca stot: asya śrī-saptamukha-vīra-hanumat-kavaca stotra-mantrasya, nārada ṛṣiḥ, anuṣṭup chandaḥ, śrī-saptamukhī-kapiḥ paramātmā devatā, hrāṁ bījaṁ, hrīṁ śaktiḥ, hrūṁ kīlakaṁ, mama sarvābhīṣṭa-siddhy-arthe jape viniyogaḥ ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.śūlaṁ saptaśikhaṁ dadhānamamaraiḥ sevyaṁ: śūlaṁ sapta-śikhaṁ dadhānam-amaraiḥ sevyaṁ kapiṁ kāma-dam ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.saptacchado hariḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṁ bāhū giri: saptacchado hariḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṁ bāhū giri-sthitaḥ ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.paśūn dhanaṁ ca dhānyaṁ ca lakṣmīṁ lakṣm: paśūn dhanaṁ ca dhānyaṁ ca lakṣmīṁ lakṣmī-prado'vatu |
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.oṁ namo bhagavate saptavadanāya ādya kap: oṁ namo bhagavate sapta-vadanāya ādya kapi-mukhāya vīra-hanumate sarva-śatru-saṁhāraṇāya ṭhaṇṭhaṇṭhaṇṭhaṇṭhaṇṭhaṇṭhaṁ oṁ namaḥ svāhā ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.oṁ namo bhagavate saptavadanāya dvitīya: oṁ namo bhagavate sapta-vadanāya dvitīya nārasiṁhāsyāya atyugra-tejo-vapuṣe bhīṣaṇāya bhaya-nāśanāya haṁhaṁhaṁhaṁhaṁhaṁhaṁ oṁ namaḥ svāhā ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.oṁ namo bhagavate saptavadanāya tṛtīya g: oṁ namo bhagavate sapta-vadanāya tṛtīya garuḍa-vaktrāya vajra-daṁṣṭrāya mahā-balāya sarva-roga-vināśāya maṁmaṁmaṁmaṁmaṁmaṁmaṁ oṁ namaḥ svāhā ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.oṁ namo bhagavate saptavadanāya caturtha: oṁ namo bhagavate sapta-vadanāya caturtha kroḍa-tuṇḍāya saumitri-rakṣakāya putrādy-abhivṛddhi-karāya laṁlaṁlaṁlaṁlaṁlaṁlaṁ oṁ namaḥ svāhā ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.oṁ namo bhagavate saptavadanāya pañcama: oṁ namo bhagavate sapta-vadanāya pañcama aśva-vadanāya rudra-mūrtaye sarva-vaśīkaraṇāya sarvāgama-svarūpāya ruṁruṁruṁruṁruṁruṁruṁ oṁ namaḥ svāhā ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.oṁ namo bhagavate saptavadanāya ṣaṣṭha g: oṁ namo bhagavate sapta-vadanāya ṣaṣṭha gomukhāya sūrya-svarūpāya sarva-roga-harāya mukti-dātre oṁoṁoṁoṁoṁoṁoṁ oṁ namaḥ svāhā ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.oṁ namo bhagavate saptavadanāya saptama: oṁ namo bhagavate sapta-vadanāya saptama mānuṣa-mukhāya rudrāvatārāya añjanī-sutāya sakala-dig-yaśo-vistārakāya vajra-dehāya sugrīva-sāhya-karāya udadhi-laṅghanāya sītā-śuddhi-karāya laṅkā-dahanāya aneka-rākṣasāntakāya rāmānanda-dāyakāya aneka-parvatotpāṭakāya setu-bandhakāya kapi-sainya-nāyakāya rāvaṇāntakāya brahmacaryāśramiṇe kaupīna-brahmasūtra-dhārakāya rāma-hṛdayāya sarva-duṣṭa-graha-nivāraṇāya, śākinī ḍākinī vetāla brahmarākṣasa bhairava-graha yakṣa-graha piśāca-graha brahma-graha kṣatriya-graha vaiśya-graha śūdra-grahāntyaja-graha mleccha-graha sarpa-grahoccāṭakāya, mama sarva-kārya-sādhakāya sarva-śatru-saṁhārakāya siṁha-vyāghrādi duṣṭa-satvākarṣakāya ekāhikādi vividha-jvaracchedakāya para-yantra-mantra-tantra-nāśakāya sarva-vyādhi-nikṛntakāya sarpādi sarva-sthāvara-jaṅgama-viṣa-stambhana-karāya sarva-rāja-bhaya cora-bhaya agni-bhaya praśamanāya ādhyātmikādhidaivikādhibhautika tāpa-traya-nivāraṇāya sarva-vidyā sarva-sampat sarva-puruṣārtha-dāyakāya asādhya-kārya-sādhakāya sarva-vara-pradāya sarvābhīṣṭa-karāya oṁ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ hraiṁ hrauṁ hraḥ oṁ namaḥ svāhā ||
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.rājānaṁ sa vaśaṁ nītvā trailokyavijayī b: rājānaṁ sa vaśaṁ nītvā trailokya-vijayī bhavet |
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.idaṁ hi paramaṁ gopyaṁ deyaṁ bhaktiyutāy: idaṁ hi paramaṁ gopyaṁ deyaṁ bhakti-yutāya ca |
hanuman/27_saptamukha_hanumat_kavacam.tx.na deyaṁ bhaktihīnāya datvā sa nirayaṁ v: na deyaṁ bhakti-hīnāya datvā sa nirayaṁ vrajet ||

hanuman/28_panchamukha_hanumat_hridayam..asya śrīpañcavaktra hanumat hṛdayastotra: asya śrī-pañcavaktra hanumat hṛdaya-stotra-mantrasya bhagavān śrī-rāmacandra ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrī-pañcavaktra-hanumān devatā oṁ bījaṁ rudra-mūrtaye iti śaktiḥ svāhā kīlakaṁ śrī-pañcavaktra-hanumad-devatā prasāda-siddhy-arthe jape viniyogaḥ ||
hanuman/28_panchamukha_hanumat_hridayam..oṁ namo vāyuputrāya pañcavaktrāya te nam: oṁ namo vāyu-putrāya pañca-vaktrāya te namaḥ |
hanuman/28_panchamukha_hanumat_hridayam..iti te kathitaṁ devi hṛdayaṁ śrīhanūmata: iti te kathitaṁ devi hṛdayaṁ śrī-hanūmataḥ ||
hanuman/28_panchamukha_hanumat_hridayam..hṛdayaṁ paṭhate nityaṁ sa brahmasadṛśo b: hṛdayaṁ paṭhate nityaṁ sa brahma-sadṛśo bhavet ||
hanuman/28_panchamukha_hanumat_hridayam..satyaṁ satyaṁ punaḥ satyaṁ mantrasiddhik: satyaṁ satyaṁ punaḥ satyaṁ mantra-siddhi-karaṁ param |
hanuman/28_panchamukha_hanumat_hridayam..itthaṁ ca kathitaṁ pūrvaṁ sāmbena svapri: itthaṁ ca kathitaṁ pūrvaṁ sāmbena sva-priyāṁ prati ||

hanuman/31_hanuman_ashtottarashatanama_s.satkaupīnaṁ kapicaravṛtaṁ kāmarūpaṁ kapī: sat-kaupīnaṁ kapi-cara-vṛtaṁ kāmarūpaṁ kapīndraṁ putraṁ vāyor-ina-suta-sukhadaṁ vajra-dehaṁ vareṇyam ||

hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.tvayā gamyo na ko deśastvaṁ ca jñānavatā: tvayā gamyo na ko deśas-tvaṁ ca jñānavatāvaraḥ ||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hanumate rāmadūtāya laṅ: oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ hanumate rāma-dūtāya laṅkā vidhvaṁsanāya
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.kilikili bu bu kāreṇa vibhīṣaṇāya hanuma: kilikili bu bu kāreṇa vibhīṣaṇāya hanumad-devāya
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.vālmīke brūhi nastūrṇaṁ śuśrūṣāmaḥ kathā: vālmīke brūhi nas-tūrṇaṁ śuśrūṣāmaḥ kathāṁ parām ||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ hanumate rāmadūtāya aṅguṣṭhā: oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ hanumate rāma-dūtāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ |
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.oṁ kilikili bū bū kāreṇa vibhīṣaṇāya han: oṁ kilikili bū bū kāreṇa vibhīṣaṇāya hanumad-devatāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṁ namaḥ |
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.oṁ hrīṁ śrī hrauṁ hāṁ huṁ phaṭ svāhā kar: oṁ hrīṁ śrī hrauṁ hāṁ huṁ phaṭ svāhā kara-tala kara-pṛṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ ||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ hanumate rāmadūtāya hṛdayāya: oṁ aiṁ hrīṁ hanumate rāma-dūtāya hṛdayāya namaḥ |
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.oṁ kilikili bū bū kāreṇa vibhīṣaṇāya han: oṁ kilikili bū bū kāreṇa vibhīṣaṇāya hanumad-devatāya netra-trayāya vauṣaṭ |
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.bālo vṛddho yuvā tattvaṁ tattvagamyaḥ sa: bālo vṛddho yuvā tattvaṁ tattva-gamyaḥ sakhā hyajaḥ||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.dhyātā dhyeyo layaḥ sākṣī cetā caitanyav: dhyātā dhyeyo layaḥ sākṣī cetā caitanya-vigrahaḥ||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.saumyo guruḥ kāvyakartā bhaktānāṁ ca var: saumyo guruḥ kāvya-kartā bhaktānāṁ ca vara-pradaḥ||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.raviścandraḥ kujaḥ saumyo guruḥ kāvyaḥ ś: raviś-candraḥ kujaḥ saumyo guruḥ kāvyaḥ śanaiścaraḥ|
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.khaṁ vāyuḥ pṛthivī cāpo vahnirdikpāla ev: khaṁ vāyuḥ pṛthivī cāpo vahnir-dikpāla eva ca|
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.raso rasajñaḥ sammāno rūpaṁ cakṣuḥ śruti: raso rasajñaḥ sammāno rūpaṁ cakṣuḥ śrutir-vacaḥ|
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.nandī bhṛṅgī ca caṇḍī ca gaṇeśo gaṇasevi: nandī bhṛṅgī ca caṇḍī ca gaṇeśo gaṇa-sevitaḥ|
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.|| iti mantramahārṇave pūrvakhaṇḍe navam: || iti mantra-mahārṇave pūrva-khaṇḍe navama-taraṅge śrī-rāma-kṛtaṁ śrī-hanumat-sahasra-nāma-stotraṁ sampūrṇam ||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.iti nāmna sahasreṇa stuto rāmeṇa vāyubhū: iti nāmna sahasreṇa stuto rāmeṇa vāyu-bhūḥ |
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.svāmin kṛpānidhe rāma jñāto'si kapinā ma: svāmin kṛpā-nidhe rāma jñāto'si kapinā mayā || 130||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.hatvā taṁ nirghṛṇaṁ vīramānaya tvaṁ kapī: hatvā taṁ nirghṛṇaṁ vīram-ānaya tvaṁ kapīśvara || 133||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.mama dāsyaṁ kuru sakhe bhava viśvasukhaṁ: mama dāsyaṁ kuru sakhe bhava viśva-sukhaṁkaraḥ |
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.idaṁ nāmasahasraṁ tu yo'dhīte pratyahaṁ: idaṁ nāma-sahasraṁ tu yo'dhīte pratyahaṁ naraḥ |
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.vaśyaṁ caturvidhaṁ tasya bhavatyeva na s: vaśyaṁ catur-vidhaṁ tasya bhavaty-eva na saṁśayaḥ || 136||
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.brāhme muhūrte cotthāya pratyahaṁ yaḥ pa: brāhme muhūrte cotthāya pratyahaṁ yaḥ paṭhen-naraḥ |
hanuman/33_hanumat_sahasranama_stotram.t.ya idaṁ paṭhate nityaṁ pāṭhayedvā samāhi: ya idaṁ paṭhate nityaṁ pāṭhayed-vā samāhitaḥ |

hanuman/34_hanuman_dvadasanama_stotram.t.svāpakāle prabodhe ca yātrākāle ca yaḥ p: svāpa-kāle prabodhe ca yātrā-kāle ca yaḥ paṭhet ||
hanuman/34_hanuman_dvadasanama_stotram.t.tasya sarvabhayaṁ nāsti raṇe ca vijayī b: tasya sarva-bhayaṁ nāsti raṇe ca vijayī bhavet |
hanuman/34_hanuman_dvadasanama_stotram.t.rājadvāre gahvare ca bhayaṁ nāsti kadāca: rāja-dvāre gahvare ca bhayaṁ nāsti kadācana ||

krishna/02_gopala_krishna_kavacham.txt.brahmaṇā kathitaṁ mahyaṁ paraṁ snehādvad: brahmaṇā kathitaṁ mahyaṁ paraṁ snehād-vadāmi te |
krishna/02_gopala_krishna_kavacham.txt.śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ padato gopījanavallabhapa: śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ padato gopī-jana-vallabha-padaṁ tataḥ ||
krishna/02_gopala_krishna_kavacham.txt.sarvāṅgaṁ me sadā pātu dvārakānāyako bal: sarvāṅgaṁ me sadā pātu dvārakā-nāyako balī |
krishna/02_gopala_krishna_kavacham.txt.śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ ca daśārṇastu klīṁ hrīṁ ś: śrīṁ hrīṁ klīṁ ca daśārṇas-tu klīṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ṣoḍaśārṇakaḥ ||
krishna/02_gopala_krishna_kavacham.txt.śrīṁ gopījanavallabhāya svāhā hastau tat: śrīṁ gopī-jana-vallabhāya svāhā hastau tataḥ param ||
krishna/02_gopala_krishna_kavacham.txt.kālīyasya phaṇāmadhye divyaṁ nṛtyaṁ karo: kālīyasya phaṇā-madhye divyaṁ nṛtyaṁ karoti tam ||
krishna/02_gopala_krishna_kavacham.txt.kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so'pi viṣṇurna s: kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so'pi viṣṇur-na saṁśayaḥ ||

krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.hṛdayaṁ madhuraṁ gamanaṁ madhuraṁ madhur: hṛdayaṁ madhuraṁ gamanaṁ madhuraṁ madhurādhipater-akhilaṁ madhuram ||
krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.calitaṁ madhuraṁ bhramitaṁ madhuraṁ madh: calitaṁ madhuraṁ bhramitaṁ madhuraṁ madhurādhipater-akhilaṁ madhuram ||
krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.nṛtyaṁ madhuraṁ sakhyaṁ madhuraṁ madhurā: nṛtyaṁ madhuraṁ sakhyaṁ madhuraṁ madhurādhipater-akhilaṁ madhuram ||
krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.rūpaṁ madhuraṁ tilakaṁ madhuraṁ madhurād: rūpaṁ madhuraṁ tilakaṁ madhuraṁ madhurādhipater-akhilaṁ madhuram ||
krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.vamitaṁ madhuraṁ śamitaṁ madhuraṁ madhur: vamitaṁ madhuraṁ śamitaṁ madhuraṁ madhurādhipater-akhilaṁ madhuram ||
krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.salilaṁ madhuraṁ kamalaṁ madhuraṁ madhur: salilaṁ madhuraṁ kamalaṁ madhuraṁ madhurādhipater-akhilaṁ madhuram ||
krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.dṛṣṭaṁ madhuraṁ śiṣṭaṁ madhuraṁ madhurād: dṛṣṭaṁ madhuraṁ śiṣṭaṁ madhuraṁ madhurādhipater-akhilaṁ madhuram ||
krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.gopā madhurā gāvo madhurā yaṣṭirmadhurā: gopā madhurā gāvo madhurā yaṣṭir-madhurā sṛṣṭir-madhurā |
krishna/03_madhurashtakam.txt.dalitaṁ madhuraṁ phalitaṁ madhuraṁ madhu: dalitaṁ madhuraṁ phalitaṁ madhuraṁ madhurādhipater-akhilaṁ madhuram ||

krishna/04_krishna_kavacham_1.txt.praṇamya ca munīn sarvān sarvaśāstra viś: praṇamya ca munīn sarvān sarva-śāstra viśāradān ||
krishna/04_krishna_kavacham_1.txt.kāntāre pathi durge ca sadā rakṣākaraṁ n: kāntāre pathi durge ca sadā rakṣā-karaṁ nṛṇām ||
krishna/04_krishna_kavacham_1.txt.idaṁ kṛṣṇabalopetaṁ yaḥ paṭhet kavacaṁ n: idaṁ kṛṣṇa-balopetaṁ yaḥ paṭhet kavacaṁ naraḥ |

krishna/05_govindashtakam.txt.iti śrīmatparamahaṁsaparivrājakācāryasya: iti śrīmat-paramahaṁsa-parivrājakācāryasya śrī-govinda-bhagavat-pūjyapāda-śiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkara-bhagavataḥ kṛtau śrī govindāṣṭakam |

krishna/08_achyutashtakam.txt.iti śrīmatparamahaṁsaparivrājakācāryasya: iti śrīmat-paramahaṁsa-parivrājakācāryasya śrī-govinda-bhagavat-pūjyapāda-śiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkara-bhagavataḥ kṛtau śrī acyutāṣṭakam ||

krishna/10_narada_krta_krishna_stuti.txt.sānandaṁ sundaraṁ śuddhaṁ śrīkṛṣṇaṁ prak: sānandaṁ sundaraṁ śuddhaṁ śrī-kṛṣṇaṁ prakṛteḥ param ||
krishna/10_narada_krta_krishna_stuti.txt.dhyāyante yogino yogān siddhāḥ siddheśva: dhyāyante yogino yogān siddhāḥ siddheśvarāś-ca yam |
krishna/10_narada_krta_krishna_stuti.txt.ihaiva jīvanmuktaśca paraṁ yāti parāṁ ga: ihaiva jīvan-muktaś-ca paraṁ yāti parāṁ gatim |

krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca śāntāyai ca namo: namaḥ kṛṣṇa-priyāyai ca śāntāyai ca namo namaḥ |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.padmanābhapriyāyai ca padmāyai ca namo n: padmanābha-priyāyai ca padmāyai ca namo namaḥ ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.mahāviṣṇośca mātre ca parādyāyai namo na: mahāviṣṇoś-ca mātre ca parādyāyai namo namaḥ |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namaḥ sindhusutāyai ca martyalakṣmyai na: namaḥ sindhu-sutāyai ca martya-lakṣmyai namo namaḥ ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namo'stu viṣṇumāyāyai vaiṣṇavyai ca namo: namo'stu viṣṇu-māyāyai vaiṣṇavyai ca namo namaḥ ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namaḥ kalyāṇarūpiṇyai śubhāyai ca namo n: namaḥ kalyāṇa-rūpiṇyai śubhāyai ca namo namaḥ ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.adhiṣṭhānakṛtāyai ca prakṛtyai ca namo n: adhiṣṭhāna-kṛtāyai ca prakṛtyai ca namo namaḥ |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namo dakṣasutāyai ca namaḥ satyai namo n: namo dakṣa-sutāyai ca namaḥ satyai namo namaḥ |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namaḥ śailasutāyai ca pārvatyai ca namo: namaḥ śaila-sutāyai ca pārvatyai ca namo namaḥ ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namo namastapasvinyai hyumāyai ca namo n: namo namas-tapasvinyai hy-umāyai ca namo namaḥ |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.bhayāyai cābhayāyai ca muktidāyai namo n: bhayāyai cābhayāyai ca mukti-dāyai namo namaḥ |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namastuṣṭyai ca puṣṭyai ca dayāyai ca na: namas-tuṣṭyai ca puṣṭyai ca dayāyai ca namo namaḥ |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.namo nidrāsvarūpāyai śraddhāyai ca namo: namo nidrā-svarūpāyai śraddhāyai ca namo namaḥ ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.agnau dāhasvarūpāyai bhadrāyai ca namo n: agnau dāha-svarūpāyai bhadrāyai ca namo namaḥ ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.śobhāyai pūrṇacandre ca śaratpadme namo: śobhāyai pūrṇa-candre ca śarat-padme namo namaḥ |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.nāsti bhedo yathā devi dugdhadhāvalyayoḥ: nāsti bhedo yathā devi dugdha-dhāvalyayoḥ sadā ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.cetanaṁ kuru kalyāṇi dehi māmuttaraṁ sat: cetanaṁ kuru kalyāṇi dehi mām-uttaraṁ sati ||
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.iha loke sukhaṁ bhuktvā yātyante hariman: iha loke sukhaṁ bhuktvā yāty-ante hari-mandiram |
krishna/11_radha_stotram_uddhava_krtam.t.proṣitā strī labhetkāntaṁ bhāryābhedī la: proṣitā strī labhet-kāntaṁ bhāryā-bhedī labhet priyām |

krishna/12_gopi_gitam.txt.dayita dṛśyatāṁ dikṣu tāvakāstvayi dhṛtā: dayita dṛśyatāṁ dikṣu tāvakās-tvayi dhṛtāsavas-tvāṁ vicinvate ||
krishna/12_gopi_gitam.txt.ghanarajasvalaṁ darśayanmuhurmanasi naḥ: ghana-rajasvalaṁ darśayan-muhur-manasi naḥ smaraṁ vīra yacchasi ||

krishna/14_vasudeva_krta_krishna_stotram.svapne teṣāmadṛśyaṁ ca tvāmevaṁ kiṁ stuv: svapne teṣām-adṛśyaṁ ca tvām-evaṁ kiṁ stuvanti te ||

krishna/15_akrura_krta_krishna_stuti.txt.trayyā ca vidyayā kecittvāṁ vai vaitānik: trayyā ca vidyayā kecit-tvāṁ vai vaitānikā dvijāḥ |
krishna/15_akrura_krta_krishna_stuti.txt.tairāmṛṣṭaśuco lokā mudā gāyanti te yaśa: tair-āmṛṣṭa-śuco lokā mudā gāyanti te yaśaḥ ||
krishna/15_akrura_krta_krishna_stuti.txt.hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyaṁ prapannaṁ pāhi māṁ: hṛṣīkeśa namas-tubhyaṁ prapannaṁ pāhi māṁ prabho ||

krishna/17_radha_krupa_katakshastotram.t.rākāyāṁ ca sitāṣṭamyāṁ daśamyāṁ ca viśud: rākāyāṁ ca sitāṣṭamyāṁ daśamyāṁ ca viśuddha-dhīḥ |
krishna/17_radha_krupa_katakshastotram.t.yaṁ yaṁ kāmayate kāmaṁ taṁ tamāpnoti sād: yaṁ yaṁ kāmayate kāmaṁ taṁ tam-āpnoti sādhakaḥ |
krishna/17_radha_krupa_katakshastotram.t.rādhākuṇḍajale sthitā yaḥ paṭhet sādhaka: rādhākuṇḍa-jale sthitā yaḥ paṭhet sādhakaḥ śatam ||
krishna/17_radha_krupa_katakshastotram.t.tasya sarvārtha siddhiḥ syād vāksāmarthy: tasya sarvārtha siddhiḥ syād vāk-sāmarthyaṁ tathā labhet |
krishna/17_radha_krupa_katakshastotram.t.aiśvaryaṁ ca labhet sākṣāddṛśā paśyati r: aiśvaryaṁ ca labhet sākṣād-dṛśā paśyati rādhikām ||
krishna/17_radha_krupa_katakshastotram.t.tena sa tatkṣaṇādeva tuṣṭā datte mahāvar: tena sa tatkṣaṇād-eva tuṣṭā datte mahā-varam |

krishna/18_krishna_krupa_katakshastotram.madbhaktā yatra gāyanti tatra tiṣṭhāmi n: mad-bhaktā yatra gāyanti tatra tiṣṭhāmi nārada ||
krishna/18_krishna_krupa_katakshastotram.dine dine navaṁ navaṁ namāmi nandasambha: dine dine navaṁ navaṁ namāmi nanda-sambhavam ||
krishna/18_krishna_krupa_katakshastotram.yadā tadā yathā tathā tathaiva kṛṣṇasatk: yadā tadā yathā tathā tathaiva kṛṣṇa-satkathā

krishna/23_gopalashtakam.txt.bhaktyā nityaṁ yo manujo vai sthiracetāḥ: bhaktyā nityaṁ yo manujo vai sthira-cetāḥ |

krishna/26_damodara_stotram.txt.tṛtīye'hni sakṛdbhuṅkte patraṁ mūlaṁ pha: tṛtīye'hni sakṛd-bhuṅkte patraṁ mūlaṁ phalaṁ tathā ||

krishna/28_indra_krta_krishna_stotram.tx.rādhādattāṁ gale mālāṁ dhṛtavantaṁ ca ku: rādhā-dattāṁ gale mālāṁ dhṛtavantaṁ ca kutracit ||
krishna/28_indra_krta_krishna_stotram.tx.idamindrakṛtaṁ stotraṁ nityaṁ bhaktyā ca: idam-indra-kṛtaṁ stotraṁ nityaṁ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet ||
krishna/28_indra_krta_krishna_stotram.tx.sa hi prāpya dṛḍhāṁ bhaktimante dāsyaṁ l: sa hi prāpya dṛḍhāṁ bhaktimante dāsyaṁ labhed-dhruvam |
krishna/28_indra_krta_krishna_stotram.tx.na hi paśyati svapne'pi yamadūtaṁ yamāla: na hi paśyati svapne'pi yama-dūtaṁ yamālayam ||

krishna/29_krishna_ashtottarashatanama_s.madhuraravakaleśaṁ śaṁ bhaje bhrātṛśeṣaṁ: madhura-rava-kaleśaṁ śaṁ bhaje bhrātṛ-śeṣaṁ vraja-jana-vaniteśaṁ mādhavaṁ rādhikeśam ||

krishna/30_gopala_shatanama_stotram.txt.kastūrītilakaṁ lalāṭapaṭale vakṣaḥsthale: kastūrī-tilakaṁ lalāṭa-paṭale vakṣaḥ-sthale kaustubhaṁ nāsāgre vara-mauktikaṁ kara-tale veṇuḥ kare kaṅkaṇam |
krishna/30_gopala_shatanama_stotram.txt.sarvāṅge haricandanaṁ sulalitaṁ kaṇṭhe c: sarvāṅge haricandanaṁ sulalitaṁ kaṇṭhe ca muktāvalī gopa-strī-pariveṣṭito vijayate gopāla-cūḍāmaṇiḥ ||
krishna/30_gopala_shatanama_stotram.txt.oṁ asya śrīgopālaśatanāmastotrasya nārad: oṁ asya śrī-gopāla-śata-nāma-stotrasya nārada ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrī-gopālaḥ paramātmā devatā śrī-gopāla-prīty-arthe śata-nāma-pāṭhe viniyogaḥ |
krishna/30_gopala_shatanama_stotram.txt.japalakṣeṇa siddhaṁ syātsatyaṁ satyaṁ na: japa-lakṣeṇa siddhaṁ syāt-satyaṁ satyaṁ na saṁśayaḥ |

krishna/31_krishna_sahasranama_stotram.t.śrīkṛṣṇeti bījam, śrīvallabheti śaktiḥ,: śrī-kṛṣṇeti bījam, śrīvallabheti śaktiḥ, śārṅgīti kīlakaṁ,
krishna/31_krishna_sahasranama_stotram.t.śrīkṛṣṇāya bījāya namaḥ iti guhye, śrīva: śrī-kṛṣṇāya bījāya namaḥ iti guhye, śrīvallabhāya śaktyai namaḥ iti
krishna/31_krishna_sahasranama_stotram.t.rajakapratighātaka ityārabhya dvārakāpur: rajaka-pratighātaka ity-ārabhya dvārakā-pura-kalpana iti kaniṣṭhikābhyāṁ namaḥ
krishna/31_krishna_sahasranama_stotram.t.dvārakānilaya ityārabhya parāśara iti ka: dvārakā-nilaya ity-ārabhya parāśara iti kara-tala-kara-pṛṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ,
krishna/31_krishna_sahasranama_stotram.t.prodbhūto vasudevasadmani mudā cikrīḍa y: prodbhūto vasudeva-sadmani mudā cikrīḍa yo gokule |

krishna/32_gopala_sahasranama_stotram.tx.tayā sārddhaṁ vacaḥ kṛtvā tato jāto mahī: tayā sārddhaṁ vacaḥ kṛtvā tato jāto mahī-tale ||
krishna/32_gopala_sahasranama_stotram.tx.japedvā dhyāyate vāpi sa bhavetpātakī śi: japed-vā dhyāyate vāpi sa bhavet-pātakī śive ||
krishna/32_gopala_sahasranama_stotram.tx.sa brahmahā surāpī ca svarṇasteyī ca pañ: sa brahmahā surāpī ca svarṇa-steyī ca pañcamaḥ|
krishna/32_gopala_sahasranama_stotram.tx.śrīkṛṣṇena tataḥ proktaṁ rādhāyai nāradā: śrī-kṛṣṇena tataḥ proktaṁ rādhāyai nāradāya ca ||

narasimha/12_nrsimha_panchamrta_stotram..sādhu sādhviti taṁ procuḥ devā ṛṣigaṇaiḥ: sādhu sādhv-iti taṁ procuḥ devā ṛṣi-gaṇaiḥ saha ||

narasimha/13_kamasikashtakam.txt.prāyeṇa praṇipeduṣaḥ prabhurasau yogaṁ n: prāyeṇa praṇipeduṣaḥ prabhur-asau yogaṁ nijaṁ śikṣayan
narasimha/13_kamasikashtakam.txt.tvayi rakṣati rakṣakaiḥ kimanyaistvayi c: tvayi rakṣati rakṣakaiḥ kim-anyais-tvayi cārakṣati rakṣakaiḥ kim-anyaiḥ |

narasimha/14_naraharyashtakam.txt.gatadūṣaṇa me śatrūn hare narahare hara: gata-dūṣaṇa me śatrūn hare narahare hara ||

narasimha/15_nrsimha_mantrarajapada_stot.mantrāṇāṁ paramaṁ mantraṁ guhyānāṁ guhya: mantrāṇāṁ paramaṁ mantraṁ guhyānāṁ guhyam-eva ca |
narasimha/15_nrsimha_mantrarajapada_stot.jvalanti tejasā yasya taṁ jvalantaṁ namā: jvalanti tejasā yasya taṁ jvalantaṁ namāmy-aham ||
narasimha/15_nrsimha_mantrarajapada_stot.śriyā ca bhadrayā juṣṭo yastaṁ bhadraṁ n: śriyā ca bhadrayā juṣṭo yastaṁ bhadraṁ namāmy-aham ||
narasimha/15_nrsimha_mantrarajapada_stot.ato'hamapi te dāsaḥ iti matvā namāmyaham: ato'ham-api te dāsaḥ iti matvā namāmy-aham ||

narasimha/16_rnamocana_nrsimha_stotram.t.vāgīśā yasya vadane lakṣmīryasya ca vakṣ: vāgīśā yasya vadane lakṣmīr-yasya ca vakṣasi |
narasimha/16_rnamocana_nrsimha_stotram.t.itthaṁ yaḥ paṭhate nityaṁ ṛṇamocana sidd: itthaṁ yaḥ paṭhate nityaṁ ṛṇa-mocana siddhaye |

narasimha/18_nrsimha_stuti_shukracharya_.pūjitaṁ ca hṛṣīkeśaṁ taṁ namāmi jagadgur: pūjitaṁ ca hṛṣīkeśaṁ taṁ namāmi jagad-gurum ||
narasimha/18_nrsimha_stuti_shukracharya_.hṛdi saṅkalpya yadrūpaṁ dhyāyanti yataya: hṛdi saṅkalpya yad-rūpaṁ dhyāyanti yatayaḥ sadā |
narasimha/18_nrsimha_stuti_shukracharya_.na jānanti paraṁ rūpaṁ brahmādyā devatāg: na jānanti paraṁ rūpaṁ brahmādyā devatā-gaṇāḥ |
narasimha/18_nrsimha_stuti_shukracharya_.trātaṁ yatra jagallīnaṁ taṁ namāmi janār: trātaṁ yatra jagal-līnaṁ taṁ namāmi janārdanam ||
narasimha/18_nrsimha_stuti_shukracharya_.bhaktairabhyarcito yastu nityaṁ bhaktapr: bhaktair-abhyarcito yastu nityaṁ bhakta-priyo hi yaḥ |

narasimha/19_nrsimha_stotram_brahma_krta.tāṁ bhavān vedavidyātmā puruṣaḥ śāśvato: tāṁ bhavān veda-vidyātmā puruṣaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ ||
narasimha/19_nrsimha_stotram_brahma_krta.bhavanmayā vayaṁ deva bhavānātmā bhavān: bhavan-mayā vayaṁ deva bhavān-ātmā bhavān prabhuḥ ||
narasimha/19_nrsimha_stotram_brahma_krta.sraṣṭā tvaṁ tvaṁ ca saṁhartā tvameko lok: sraṣṭā tvaṁ tvaṁ ca saṁhartā tvam-eko loka-bhāvanaḥ ||
narasimha/19_nrsimha_stotram_brahma_krta.bhavān brahmā ca rudraśca mahendro varuṇ: bhavān brahmā ca rudraś-ca mahendro varuṇo yamaḥ |
narasimha/19_nrsimha_stotram_brahma_krta.bhavān kartā vikartā ca lokānāṁ prabhura: bhavān kartā vikartā ca lokānāṁ prabhur-avyayaḥ ||

narasimha/21_lakshminrsimha_ashtottarash.yogīśa śāśvata śaraṇya bhavābdhipota lak: yogīśa śāśvata śaraṇya bhavābdhi-pota lakṣmīnṛsiṁha mama dehi karāvalambam ||

narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.karaṇaṁ kāraṇaṁ kartā bhartā hartā tvamī: karaṇaṁ kāraṇaṁ kartā bhartā hartā tvam-īśvaraḥ |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.stutiḥ stutyaḥ stavaprītaḥ stotā netā ni: stutiḥ stutyaḥ stava-prītaḥ stotā netā niyāmakaḥ ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.tvaṁ gatistvaṁ matirmahyaṁ pitā mātā gur: tvaṁ gatis-tvaṁ matir-mahyaṁ pitā mātā guruḥ sakhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.suhṛdaścātmarūpastvaṁ tvāṁ vinā nāsti me: suhṛdaś-cātma-rūpas-tvaṁ tvāṁ vinā nāsti me gatiḥ ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.svacchāya svaccharūpāya svacchandāya ca: svacchāya svaccha-rūpāya svacchandāya ca te namaḥ ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.vyomātmane ca vyomne ca namaste vyomakeś: vyomātmane ca vyomne ca namaste vyoma-keśine ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.etān paśya maheśānaṁ brahmāṇaṁ māṁ śacīp: etān paśya maheśānaṁ brahmāṇaṁ māṁ śacī-patim|
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.prakṛtistho bhava tvaṁ hi śāntibhāvaṁ ca: prakṛti-stho bhava tvaṁ hi śānti-bhāvaṁ ca dhāraya ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.śṛṇudhvaṁ mama vākyaṁ ca bhavantu vigata: śṛṇudhvaṁ mama vākyaṁ ca bhavantu vigata-jvarāḥ ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.evaṁ nāmasahasraṁ me trisandhyaṁ yaḥ paṭ: evaṁ nāma-sahasraṁ me trisandhyaṁ yaḥ paṭhecchuciḥ ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.śīghraṁ naśyanti te sarve nṛsiṁhasmaraṇā: śīghraṁ naśyanti te sarve nṛsiṁha-smaraṇāt surāḥ|
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.gacchan tiṣṭhan svapan bhuñjan jāgrannap: gacchan tiṣṭhan svapan bhuñjan jāgrann-api hasann-api|
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.pumān na lipyate pāpairbhuktiṁ muktiṁ ca: pumān na lipyate pāpair-bhuktiṁ muktiṁ ca vindati|
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.daivataiḥ saha suprīto hyātmalolaṁ yayau: daivataiḥ saha suprīto hy-ātma-lolaṁ yayau svayam ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.evaṁ nāmasahasraṁ me brahmaṇā nirmitaṁ p: evaṁ nāma-sahasraṁ me brahmaṇā nirmitaṁ purā ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.siṁhatejāśca tasmācca śrīpriyāya dadau c: siṁha-tejāś-ca tasmāc-ca śrī-priyāya dadau ca saḥ|
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.tvaṁ hi nityaṁ śucirbhūtvā tamārādhaya ś: tvaṁ hi nityaṁ śucir-bhūtvā tam-ārādhaya śāśvatam|
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.yadihāsti tadanyatra yannehāsti na tat k: yad-ihāsti tad-anyatra yan-nehāsti na tat kvacit ||
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.aṁ āṁ iti śaktayaḥ vikīrṇanakhadaṁṣṭrāyu: aṁ āṁ iti śaktayaḥ vikīrṇa-nakha-daṁṣṭrāyudhāyeti kīlakaṁ
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ aindrīṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnā: oṁ aindrīṁ      diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ āgneyīṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi: oṁ āgneyīṁ    diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ yāmyāṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi: oṁ yāmyāṁ    diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ nairṛtiṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badhn: oṁ nairṛtiṁ      diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ vāruṇīṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena bad: oṁ vāruṇīṁ         diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ vāyavīṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badhn: oṁ vāyavīṁ       diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ kauberīṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badh: oṁ kauberīṁ       diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ īśānīṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnā: oṁ īśānīṁ       diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ ūrdhvāṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnā: oṁ ūrdhvāṁ      diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ adhastāddiśaṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badh: oṁ adhastād-diśaṁ  diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |
narasimha/22_lakshminrsimha_sahasranama_.oṁ antarikṣāṁ diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnā: oṁ antarikṣāṁ   diśaṁ sudarśanena badhnāmi namaś-cakrāya svāhā |

navagraha/01_navagraha_stotram.txt.devānāṁ ca ṛṣīṇāṁ ca guruṁ kāñcanasannib: devānāṁ ca ṛṣīṇāṁ ca guruṁ kāñcana-sannibham |
navagraha/01_navagraha_stotram.txt.raudraṁ raudrātmakaṁ ghoraṁ taṁ ketuṁ pr: raudraṁ raudrātmakaṁ ghoraṁ taṁ ketuṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||
navagraha/01_navagraha_stotram.txt.divā vā yadi vā rātrau vighnaśāntirbhavi: divā vā yadi vā rātrau vighna-śāntir-bhaviṣyati ||

navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.śiro me pātu mārtāṇḍo kapālaṁ rohiṇīpati: śiro me pātu mārtāṇḍo kapālaṁ rohiṇī-patiḥ |
navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.buddhiṁ jīvaḥ sadā pātu hṛdayaṁ bhṛgunan: buddhiṁ jīvaḥ sadā pātu hṛdayaṁ bhṛgu-nandanaḥ |
navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.jaṭharaṁ ca śaniḥ pātu jihvāṁ me ditinan: jaṭharaṁ ca śaniḥ pātu jihvāṁ me diti-nandanaḥ ||
navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.pādau ketuḥ sadā pātu vārāḥ sarvāṅgameva: pādau ketuḥ sadā pātu vārāḥ sarvāṅgam-eva ca |
navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.aṁsau rāśiḥ sadā pātu yogāśca sthairyame: aṁsau rāśiḥ sadā pātu yogāś-ca sthairyam-eva ca |
navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.guhyaṁ liṅgaṁ sadā pāntu sarve grahāḥ śu: guhyaṁ liṅgaṁ sadā pāntu sarve grahāḥ śubha-pradāḥ ||
navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.etāṁ rakṣāṁ paṭhedyastu bhaktyā sa praya: etāṁ rakṣāṁ paṭhed-yas-tu bhaktyā sa prayataḥ sudhīḥ ||
navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.yaḥ kare dhārayennityaṁ bhayaṁ tasya na: yaḥ kare dhārayen-nityaṁ bhayaṁ tasya na vidyate ||
navagraha/02_navagraha_kavacham.txt.kākavandhyā janmavandhyā mṛtavatsā ca yā: kāka-vandhyā janma-vandhyā mṛta-vatsā ca yā bhavet |

navagraha/03_aditya_hridayam.txt.rāma rāma mahābāho śṛṇu guhyaṁ sanātanam: rāma rāma mahā-bāho śṛṇu guhyaṁ sanātanam |
navagraha/03_aditya_hridayam.txt.eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaḥ skandaḥ pra: eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuś-ca śivaḥ skandaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
navagraha/03_aditya_hridayam.txt.pitaro vasavaḥ sādhyā hyaśvinau maruto m: pitaro vasavaḥ sādhyā hy-aśvinau maruto manuḥ |
navagraha/03_aditya_hridayam.txt.nāśayatyeṣa vai bhūtaṁ tadeva sṛjati pra: nāśayaty-eṣa vai bhūtaṁ tadeva sṛjati prabhuḥ |
navagraha/03_aditya_hridayam.txt.asmin kṣaṇe mahābāho rāvaṇaṁ tvaṁ vadhiṣ: asmin kṣaṇe mahā-bāho rāvaṇaṁ tvaṁ vadhiṣyasi |
navagraha/03_aditya_hridayam.txt.ādityaṁ prekṣya japtvā tu paraṁ harṣamav: ādityaṁ prekṣya japtvā tu paraṁ harṣam-avāptavān |

navagraha/04_suryashtakam.txt.prabhuṁ ca sarvalokānāṁ taṁ sūryaṁ praṇa: prabhuṁ ca sarva-lokānāṁ taṁ sūryaṁ praṇamāmy-aham ||
navagraha/04_suryashtakam.txt.āmiṣaṁ madhupānaṁ ca yaḥ karoti raverdin: āmiṣaṁ madhu-pānaṁ ca yaḥ karoti raver-dine |
navagraha/04_suryashtakam.txt.na vyādhiḥ śokadāridryaṁ sūryalokaṁ sa g: na vyādhiḥ śoka-dāridryaṁ sūrya-lokaṁ sa gacchati ||

navagraha/05_aditya_kavacham.txt.asya śrī ādityakavacastotramahāmantrasya: asya śrī āditya-kavaca-stotra-mahāmantrasya agastyo bhagavān-ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup-chandaḥ ādityo devatā śrīṁ bījaṁ ṇīṁ śaktiḥ sūṁ kīlakaṁ mama āditya-prasāda-siddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ |
navagraha/05_aditya_kavacham.txt.ghṛṇiḥ pātu śirodeśe sūryaḥ pātu lalāṭak: ghṛṇiḥ pātu śiro-deśe sūryaḥ pātu lalāṭakam |
navagraha/05_aditya_kavacham.txt.jihvāṁ pātu jagannetraḥ kaṇṭhaṁ pātu vib: jihvāṁ pātu jagan-netraḥ kaṇṭhaṁ pātu vibhāvasuḥ ||
navagraha/05_aditya_kavacham.txt.skandhau grahapatiḥ pātu bhujau pātu pra: skandhau graha-patiḥ pātu bhujau pātu prabhākaraḥ |
navagraha/05_aditya_kavacham.txt.ūrū pātu suraśreṣṭho jānunī pātu bhāskar: ūrū pātu sura-śreṣṭho jānunī pātu bhāskaraḥ ||

navagraha/06_navagraha_stotram_vadirajay.śaniśca śaṁ prāpayatu ketuḥ ketuṁ jaye'r: śaniś-ca śaṁ prāpayatu ketuḥ ketuṁ jaye'rpayet ||

navagraha/08_surya_kavacham_yajnavalkya..śiro me bhāskaraḥ pātu lalāṭaṁ me'mitady: śiro me bhāskaraḥ pātu lalāṭaṁ me'mita-dyutiḥ |
navagraha/08_surya_kavacham_yajnavalkya..jihvāṁ me mānadaḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṁ me surava: jihvāṁ me mānadaḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṁ me sura-vanditaḥ ||
navagraha/08_surya_kavacham_yajnavalkya..skandhau prabhākaraḥ pātu vakṣaḥ pātu ja: skandhau prabhākaraḥ pātu vakṣaḥ pātu jana-priyaḥ |
navagraha/08_surya_kavacham_yajnavalkya..dadhāti yaḥ kare tasya vaśagāḥ sarvasidd: dadhāti yaḥ kare tasya vaśagāḥ sarva-siddhayaḥ ||
navagraha/08_surya_kavacham_yajnavalkya..sa rogamukto dīrghāyuḥ sukhaṁ puṣṭiṁ ca: sa roga-mukto dīrghāyuḥ sukhaṁ puṣṭiṁ ca vindati ||
navagraha/08_surya_kavacham_yajnavalkya..iti śrīmadyājñavalkyamuniviracitaṁ śrī s: iti śrīmad-yājñavalkya-muni-viracitaṁ śrī sūrya kavaca stotram ||

navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ satyatejojjvalajvālāmāline maṇikumbhā: oṁ satya-tejojjvala-jvālā-māline maṇi-kumbhāya huṁ phaṭ svāhā |
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ brahmatejojjvalajvālāmāline maṇikumbh: oṁ brahma-tejojjvala-jvālā-māline maṇi-kumbhāya huṁ phaṭ svāhā |
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ viṣṇutejojjvalajvālāmāline maṇikumbhā: oṁ viṣṇu-tejojjvala-jvālā-māline maṇi-kumbhāya huṁ phaṭ svāhā |
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ rudratejojjvalajvālāmāline maṇikumbhā: oṁ rudra-tejojjvala-jvālā-māline maṇi-kumbhāya huṁ phaṭ svāhā |
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ bhavāya rudrarūpiṇe uttaradigbhāge sa: oṁ bhavāya rudra-rūpiṇe uttara-dig-bhāge sarva-mṛtyopaśamanārthaṁ māṁ rakṣatu ||
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ agnitejojjvalajvālāmāline maṇikumbhāy: oṁ agni-tejojjvala-jvālā-māline maṇi-kumbhāya huṁ phaṭ svāhā |
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ timiratejase sarvaroganivāraṇāya ūrdh: oṁ timira-tejase sarva-roga-nivāraṇāya ūrdhva-dig-bhāge māṁ rakṣatu ||
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ sarvatejojjvalajvālāmāline maṇikumbhā: oṁ sarva-tejojjvala-jvālā-māline maṇi-kumbhāya huṁ phaṭ svāhā |
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ namaskārapriyāya śrīsūryanārāyaṇāya a: oṁ namaskāra-priyāya śrī-sūryanārāyaṇāya adho-dig-bhāge sarvābhīṣṭa-siddhy-arthaṁ māṁ rakṣatu ||
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.sūryādi navagrahebhyo namaḥ lalāṭasthāne: sūryādi navagrahebhyo namaḥ lalāṭa-sthāne māṁ rakṣatu ||
navagraha/10_surya_panjara_stotram.txt.oṁ bhāskarāya vidmahe mahādyutikarāya dh: oṁ bhāskarāya vidmahe mahā-dyuti-karāya dhīmahi | tanno ādityaḥ pracodayāt ||

navagraha/12_dvadasharya_surya_stuti.txt.hṛdrogaṁ mama sūryo harimāṇaṁ cā'āśu nāś: hṛd-rogaṁ mama sūryo harimāṇaṁ cā'āśu nāśayatu ||
navagraha/12_dvadasharya_surya_stuti.txt.dvādaśadhā yo vicarati sa dvādaśamūrtira: dvādaśadhā yo vicarati sa dvādaśa-mūrtir-astu modāya ||
navagraha/12_dvadasharya_surya_stuti.txt.tvaṁ viśvaṁ tvaṁ haṁsaḥ tvaṁ bhāno param: tvaṁ viśvaṁ tvaṁ haṁsaḥ tvaṁ bhāno paramahaṁsaś-ca ||
navagraha/12_dvadasharya_surya_stuti.txt.tvaci doṣā dṛśi doṣāḥ hṛdi doṣā ye'khile: tvaci doṣā dṛśi doṣāḥ hṛdi doṣā ye'khilendriyaja-doṣāḥ |
navagraha/12_dvadasharya_surya_stuti.txt.yena vinedaṁ timiraṁ jagadetya grasati c: yena vinedaṁ timiraṁ jagad-etya grasati caram-acaram-akhilam |
navagraha/12_dvadasharya_surya_stuti.txt.tvaṁ mātā tvaṁ śaraṇaṁ tvaṁ dhātā tvaṁ d: tvaṁ mātā tvaṁ śaraṇaṁ tvaṁ dhātā tvaṁ dhanaṁ tvam-ācāryaḥ |
navagraha/12_dvadasharya_surya_stuti.txt.tvaṁ trātā tvaṁ hartā vipadāmarka prasīd: tvaṁ trātā tvaṁ hartā vipadām-arka prasīda mama bhāno ||

navagraha/13_aditya_dvadashanama_stotram.duḥsvapno naśyate tasya sarvaduḥkhaṁ ca: duḥsvapno naśyate tasya sarva-duḥkhaṁ ca naśyati ||
navagraha/13_aditya_dvadashanama_stotram.yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya bhaktyā stotram: yaḥ paṭhet prātar-utthāya bhaktyā stotram-idaṁ naraḥ |

navagraha/14_chandra_kavacham.txt.evaṁ dhyātvā japennityaṁ candrasya kavac: evaṁ dhyātvā japen-nityaṁ candrasya kavacaṁ mudā ||
navagraha/14_chandra_kavacham.txt.śaśī pātu śirodeśe phālaṁ pātu kalānidhi: śaśī pātu śiro-deśe phālaṁ pātu kalā-nidhiḥ |
navagraha/14_chandra_kavacham.txt.ūrū maitrīnidhiḥ pātu madhyaṁ pātu niśāk: ūrū maitrī-nidhiḥ pātu madhyaṁ pātu niśākaraḥ |
navagraha/14_chandra_kavacham.txt.pādau himakaraḥ pātu pātu candro'khilaṁ: pādau hima-karaḥ pātu pātu candro'khilaṁ vapuḥ ||

navagraha/15_runa_vimochana_angaraka_sto.etāni kujanāmāni yo nityaṁ prayataḥ paṭh: etāni kuja-nāmāni yo nityaṁ prayataḥ paṭhet |
navagraha/15_runa_vimochana_angaraka_sto.ṛṇaṁ na jāyate tasya dhanaṁ prāpnotyasaṁ: ṛṇaṁ na jāyate tasya dhanaṁ prāpnoty-asaṁśayam ||
navagraha/15_runa_vimochana_angaraka_sto.evaṁ kṛtvā na sandeho ṛṇahīno dhanī bhav: evaṁ kṛtvā na sandeho ṛṇa-hīno dhanī bhavet ||

navagraha/16_budha_kavacham.txt.budhaḥ pātu śirodeśaṁ saumyaḥ pātu ca ph: budhaḥ pātu śiro-deśaṁ saumyaḥ pātu ca phālakam |
navagraha/16_budha_kavacham.txt.iti śrī brahmavaivartapurāṇe śrī budha k: iti śrī brahmavaivarta-purāṇe śrī budha kavacam samāptam |

navagraha/18_rahu_kavacham.txt.cakṣuṣī pātu me rāhuḥ śrotre tvardhaśarī: cakṣuṣī pātu me rāhuḥ śrotre tv-ardha-śarīravān ||
navagraha/18_rahu_kavacham.txt.jihvāṁ me siṁhikāsūnuḥ kaṇṭhaṁ me kaṭhin: jihvāṁ me siṁhikā-sūnuḥ kaṇṭhaṁ me kaṭhināṅghrikaḥ ||
navagraha/18_rahu_kavacham.txt.pātu vakṣaḥsthalaṁ mantrī pātu kukṣiṁ vi: pātu vakṣaḥ-sthalaṁ mantrī pātu kukṣiṁ vidhuntudaḥ ||
navagraha/18_rahu_kavacham.txt.kaṭiṁ me vikaṭaḥ pātu ūrū me surapūjitaḥ: kaṭiṁ me vikaṭaḥ pātu ūrū me sura-pūjitaḥ |
navagraha/18_rahu_kavacham.txt.svarbhānurjānunī pātu jaṅghe me pātu jāḍ: svarbhānur-jānunī pātu jaṅghe me pātu jāḍya-hā ||
navagraha/18_rahu_kavacham.txt.gulphau grahapatiḥ pātu pādau me bhīṣaṇā: gulphau graha-patiḥ pātu pādau me bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ |
navagraha/18_rahu_kavacham.txt.prāpnoti kīrtimatulāṁ śriyamṛddhimāyurār: prāpnoti kīrtim-atulāṁ śriyam-ṛddhim-āyur-ārogyam-ātma-vijayaṁ ca hi tat-prasādāt ||
navagraha/18_rahu_kavacham.txt.iti śrīmanmahābhārate droṇaparvaṇi dhṛta: iti śrīman-mahābhārate droṇa-parvaṇi dhṛtarāṣṭra-sañjaya-saṁvāde śrī rāhu kavacam samāptam |

navagraha/19_navagraha_pidahara_stotram..vṛṣṭikṛdvṛṣṭihartā ca pīḍāṁ haratu me ku: vṛṣṭi-kṛd-vṛṣṭi-hartā ca pīḍāṁ haratu me kujaḥ ||
navagraha/19_navagraha_pidahara_stotram..sūryapriyakaro vidvān pīḍāṁ haratu me bu: sūrya-priya-karo vidvān pīḍāṁ haratu me budhaḥ ||
navagraha/19_navagraha_pidahara_stotram..prabhustārāgrahāṇāṁ ca pīḍāṁ haratu me b: prabhus-tārā-grahāṇāṁ ca pīḍāṁ haratu me bhṛguḥ ||
navagraha/19_navagraha_pidahara_stotram..mandacāraḥ prasannātmā pīḍāṁ haratu me ś: manda-cāraḥ prasannātmā pīḍāṁ haratu me śaniḥ ||
navagraha/19_navagraha_pidahara_stotram..utpātarūpo jagatāṁ pīḍāṁ haratu me tamaḥ: utpāta-rūpo jagatāṁ pīḍāṁ haratu me tamaḥ ||

navagraha/20_angaraka_mangala_stotram.tx.sarvāḥ naśyati pīḍā ca tasya grahakṛtā d: sarvāḥ naśyati pīḍā ca tasya graha-kṛtā dhruvam ||

navagraha/21_brihaspati_kavacham.txt.jihvāṁ pātu surācāryo nāsāṁ me vedapārag: jihvāṁ pātu surācāryo nāsāṁ me veda-pāragaḥ |
navagraha/21_brihaspati_kavacham.txt.mukhaṁ me pātu sarvajño kaṇṭhaṁ me devat: mukhaṁ me pātu sarvajño kaṇṭhaṁ me devatā-guruḥ ||
navagraha/21_brihaspati_kavacham.txt.stanau me pātu vāgīśaḥ kukṣiṁ me śubhala: stanau me pātu vāgīśaḥ kukṣiṁ me śubha-lakṣaṇaḥ ||
navagraha/21_brihaspati_kavacham.txt.nābhiṁ devaguruḥ pātu madhyaṁ pātu sukha: nābhiṁ deva-guruḥ pātu madhyaṁ pātu sukha-pradaḥ |
navagraha/21_brihaspati_kavacham.txt.kaṭiṁ pātu jagadvandya ūrū me pātu vākpa: kaṭiṁ pātu jagad-vandya ūrū me pātu vāk-patiḥ ||
navagraha/21_brihaspati_kavacham.txt.anyāni yāni cāṅgāni rakṣenme sarvato gur: anyāni yāni cāṅgāni rakṣen-me sarvato guruḥ ||

navagraha/22_shukra_stavaraja_stotram.tx.jīvaputrāya yo vidyā prādāttasmai namo n: jīva-putrāya yo vidyā prādāt-tasmai namo namaḥ |

navagraha/23_ketu_kavacham.txt.pātu netre piṅgalākṣaḥ śrutī me raktaloc: pātu netre piṅgalākṣaḥ śrutī me rakta-locanaḥ ||
navagraha/23_ketu_kavacham.txt.hastau pātu suraśreṣṭhaḥ kukṣiṁ pātu mah: hastau pātu sura-śreṣṭhaḥ kukṣiṁ pātu mahograhaḥ |
navagraha/23_ketu_kavacham.txt.pātu pādau ca me krūraḥ sarvāṅgaṁ narapi: pātu pādau ca me krūraḥ sarvāṅgaṁ nara-piṅgalaḥ ||

navagraha/24_chandra_stotram.txt.idaṁ niśākarastotraṁ yaḥ paṭhet pratyaha: idaṁ niśākara-stotraṁ yaḥ paṭhet pratyahaṁ naraḥ |

navagraha/26_rahu_stotram.txt.tvaṁ brahmā varuṇo devastvaṁ viṣṇustvaṁ: tvaṁ brahmā varuṇo devas-tvaṁ viṣṇus-tvaṁ hariḥ śivaḥ |
navagraha/26_rahu_stotram.txt.annaṁ khaḍgaṁ ca yaddattaṁ rāhave suphal: annaṁ khaḍgaṁ ca yad-dattaṁ rāhave suphala-pradam |
navagraha/26_rahu_stotram.txt.godānaṁ bhūmidānaṁ ca hyannaṁ vastraṁ ca: godānaṁ bhūmi-dānaṁ ca hy-annaṁ vastraṁ ca dāpayet ||

navagraha/28_shukra_kavacham.txt.netre daityaguruḥ pātu śrotre me candana: netre daitya-guruḥ pātu śrotre me candana-dyutiḥ ||
navagraha/28_shukra_kavacham.txt.pātu me nāsikāṁ kāvyo vadanaṁ daityavand: pātu me nāsikāṁ kāvyo vadanaṁ daitya-vanditaḥ |
navagraha/28_shukra_kavacham.txt.jihvā me cośanāḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṁ śrīkaṇṭhab: jihvā me cośanāḥ pātu kaṇṭhaṁ śrīkaṇṭha-bhaktimān ||
navagraha/28_shukra_kavacham.txt.bhujau tejonidhiḥ pātu kukṣiṁ pātu manov: bhujau tejo-nidhiḥ pātu kukṣiṁ pātu mano-vrajaḥ |
navagraha/28_shukra_kavacham.txt.nābhiṁ bhṛgusutaḥ pātu madhyaṁ pātu mahī: nābhiṁ bhṛgu-sutaḥ pātu madhyaṁ pātu mahī-priyaḥ ||
navagraha/28_shukra_kavacham.txt.kaṭiṁ me pātu viśvātmā ūrū me surapūjita: kaṭiṁ me pātu viśvātmā ūrū me sura-pūjitaḥ |
navagraha/28_shukra_kavacham.txt.jānuṁ jāḍyaharaḥ pātu jaṅghe jñānavatāṁ: jānuṁ jāḍya-haraḥ pātu jaṅghe jñānavatāṁ varaḥ ||
navagraha/28_shukra_kavacham.txt.gulphau guṇanidhiḥ pātu pātu pādau varām: gulphau guṇa-nidhiḥ pātu pātu pādau varāmbaraḥ |

navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.nāmnāṁ sahasraṁ savituḥ śrotumicchāmi he: nāmnāṁ sahasraṁ savituḥ śrotum-icchāmi he dvija|
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.na tadasti bhayaṁ kiñcit yadanena na naś: na tad-asti bhayaṁ kiñcit yad-anena na naśyati|
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.anye ca rogāḥ śāmyanti paṭhataḥ śṛṇvatas: anye ca rogāḥ śāmyanti paṭhataḥ śṛṇvatas-tathā|
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.asya śrīsūryasahasranāmastotrasya bhagav: asya śrī-sūrya-sahasra-nāma-stotrasya bhagavān vedavyāsa ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ, savitā devatā, sakalābhīṣṭa-siddhy-arthe jape viniyogaḥ|
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.kīrtiḥ kīrtikaro nityaḥ kuṇḍalī kavacī r: kīrtiḥ kīrti-karo nityaḥ kuṇḍalī kavacī rathī||
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.vyādhihā sukhadaḥ saukhyaṁ kalyāṇaṁ kala: vyādhi-hā sukhadaḥ saukhyaṁ kalyāṇaṁ kalatāṁ varaḥ||
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.hiraṇyaretā ārogyaṁ vidvān bradhno budho: hiraṇya-retā ārogyaṁ vidvān bradhno budho mahān||
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.sukhī sukhapradaḥ saukhyaḥ kāntiḥ kāntip: sukhī sukha-pradaḥ saukhyaḥ kāntiḥ kānti-priyo muniḥ||
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.yastvidaṁ śṛṇuyānnityaṁ paṭhed vā prayat: yas-tv-idaṁ śṛṇuyān-nityaṁ paṭhed vā prayato naraḥ|
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.kīrtimān subhago vidvān sa sukhī priyada: kīrtimān subhago vidvān sa sukhī priya-darśanaḥ|
navagraha/29_surya_sahasranama_stotram.t.|| iti śrībhaviṣyapurāṇe saptamakalpe śr: || iti śrī-bhaviṣya-purāṇe saptama-kalpe śrī-bhagavat-sūryasya sahasranāma-stotraṁ sampūrṇam ||

navagraha/30_surya_ashtottarashatanama_s.brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca skando vai varu: brahmā viṣṇuś-ca rudraś-ca skando vai varuṇo yamaḥ || 3 ||
navagraha/30_surya_ashtottarashatanama_s.|| iti śrīmahābhārate vanaparvaṇi dhaumy: || iti śrī-mahābhārate vanaparvaṇi dhaumya-yudhiṣṭhira-saṁvāde śrī-sūryāṣṭottara-śata-nāma-stotraṁ sampūrṇam ||

pitr/01_rucistava.txt.ye tu tejasi ye caite somasūryāgnimūrtay: ye tu tejasi ye caite soma-sūryāgni-mūrtayaḥ |

pitr/02_ruci_pitr_stotram.txt.namasye'haṁ pitṝn martyairarcyante bhuvi: namasye'haṁ pitṝn martyair-arcyante bhuvi ye sadā |

pitr/02_ruci_pitr_stotram.txt.namasye'haṁ pitṝn vaiśyairarcyante bhuvi: namasye'haṁ pitṝn vaiśyair-arcyante bhuvi ye sadā |
pitr/02_ruci_pitr_stotram.txt.namasye'haṁ pitṝn śrāddhe śūdrairapi ca: namasye'haṁ pitṝn śrāddhe śūdrair-api ca bhaktitaḥ |
pitr/02_ruci_pitr_stotram.txt.agniṣvāttāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ prācīṁ rakṣantu me: agniṣvāttāḥ pitṛ-gaṇāḥ prācīṁ rakṣantu me diśam |
pitr/02_ruci_pitr_stotram.txt.bhūtido bhūtikṛdbhūtiḥ pitṝṇāṁ ye gaṇā n: bhūtido bhūti-kṛd-bhūtiḥ pitṝṇāṁ ye gaṇā nava ||
pitr/02_ruci_pitr_stotram.txt.viśvapātā tathā dhātā saptaite ca gaṇāḥ: viśva-pātā tathā dhātā saptaite ca gaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||

pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.asuṁ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pit: asuṁ ya īyur-avṛkā ṛta-jñās-te no'vantu pitaro haveṣu ||
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.teṣāṁ vayaṁ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre: teṣāṁ vayaṁ sumatau yajñiyānām-api bhadre saumanase syāma ||
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso'nūhire soma: ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso'nūhire soma-pīthaṁ vasiṣṭhāḥ |
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.tvaṁ soma pra cikito manīṣā tvaṁ rajiṣṭh: tvaṁ soma pra cikito manīṣā tvaṁ rajiṣṭham-anu neṣi panthām |
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratna: tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratnam-abhajanta dhīrāḥ ||
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.ta ā gatāvasā śantamenāthā naḥ śaṁ yorar: ta ā gatāvasā śantamenāthā naḥ śaṁ yor-arapo dadhāta ||
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidh: upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣy-eṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu |
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvant: ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantv-adhi bruvantu te'vantv-asmān ||
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsad: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥ-sadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ |
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.attā havīṁṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayiṁ: attā havīṁṣi prayatāni barhiṣy-athā rayiṁ sarva-vīraṁ dadhātana ||
pitr/03_pitr_suktam_vajasaneyi.txt.agniṣvāttānṛtumato havāmahe nārāśaṁse so: agniṣvāttān-ṛtumato havāmahe nārāśaṁse soma-pīthaṁ ya āśuḥ |

pitr/04_pitr_suktam_rigveda.txt.āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṁ dhatta dāś: āsīnāso aruṇīnām-upasthe rayiṁ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya |

pitr/04_pitr_suktam_rigveda.txt.ye tātṛṣurdevatrā jehamānā hotrāvidaḥ st: ye tātṛṣur-devatrā jehamānā hotrā-vidaḥ stoma-taṣṭāso arkaiḥ |
pitr/04_pitr_suktam_rigveda.txt.ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā iṁdreṇa deva: ye satyāso havir-ado haviṣ-pā iṁdreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṁ dadhānāḥ |
pitr/04_pitr_suktam_rigveda.txt.āgne yāhi sahasraṁ devavaṁdaiḥ paraiḥ pū: āgne yāhi sahasraṁ devavaṁdaiḥ paraiḥ pūrvaiḥ pitṛbhir-gharma-sadbhiḥ ||
pitr/04_pitr_suktam_rigveda.txt.agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsad: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥ-sadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ |
pitr/04_pitr_suktam_rigveda.txt.attā havīṁṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayiṁ: attā havīṁṣi prayatāni barhiṣy-athā rayiṁ sarva-vīraṁ dadhātana ||
pitr/04_pitr_suktam_rigveda.txt.prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi: prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣann-addhi tvaṁ deva prayatā havīṁṣi ||

puja/pauranika/smarta/14_vinayaka_chavit.iti dhātryukta suślokaṁ yaśca smṛtyā jal: iti dhātry-ukta suślokaṁ yaśca smṛtyā jalaṁ pibet |
puja/pauranika/smarta/14_vinayaka_chavit.talapuna ninnu veḍedanu daivagaṇādhipa l: talapuna ninnu veḍedanu daiva-gaṇādhipa loka nāyakā! ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/14_vinayaka_chavit.puṣpajātulu tecci pūjintu nenepuḍu bahub: puṣpajātulu tecci pūjintu nenepuḍu bahu-buddhi gaṇapatiki bāgugānu || jaya ||

puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.punaḥ saṅkalpam — pūrvokta evaṁ guṇaviśe: punaḥ saṅkalpam — pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa-viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau śrī-mahāgaṇapatim-uddiśya śrī-mahāgaṇapati-prīty-arthaṁ śrīman-mudgala-purāṇe śrī-gṛtsamada prokta śloka-vidhānena yāvacchakti dhyānāvahanādi ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjāṁ kariṣye ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.asmin bimbe saparivāra sameta śrīmahāgaṇ: asmin bimbe saparivāra sameta śrī-mahāgaṇapati svāminaṁ āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi pūjayāmi ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.gṛhāṇa bhāvasamyuktaṁ mayā dattaṁ namo's: gṛhāṇa bhāva-samyuktaṁ mayā dattaṁ namo'stu te ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.oṁ śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ śuddhodaka sn: oṁ śrī-mahāgaṇapataye namaḥ śuddhodaka snānaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.oṁ śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ nānāvidha par: oṁ śrī-mahāgaṇapataye namaḥ nānā-vidha parimala puṣpāṇi samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.oṁ kapilāya namaḥ | oṁ gajakarṇikāya nam: oṁ kapilāya namaḥ | oṁ gaja-karṇikāya namaḥ |
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.oṁ vighnarājāya namaḥ | oṁ gaṇādhipāya n: oṁ vighna-rājāya namaḥ | oṁ gaṇādhipāya namaḥ |
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.oṁ phālacandrāya namaḥ | oṁ gajānanāya n: oṁ phāla-candrāya namaḥ | oṁ gajānanāya namaḥ |
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.oṁ herambāya namaḥ | oṁ skandapūrvajāya: oṁ herambāya namaḥ | oṁ skanda-pūrvajāya namaḥ |
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.naivedyaṁ te mayā dattaṁ bhojanaṁ kuru v: naivedyaṁ te mayā dattaṁ bhojanaṁ kuru vighna-pa ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.oṁ śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ pradakṣiṇa na: oṁ śrī-mahāgaṇapataye namaḥ pradakṣiṇa namaskārān samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.heramba sarvapūjya tvaṁ gṛhāṇa tu mayā k: heramba sarva-pūjya tvaṁ gṛhāṇa tu mayā kṛtam ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.oṁ śrīmahāgaṇapataye namaḥ sāṣṭāṅga nama: oṁ śrī-mahāgaṇapataye namaḥ sāṣṭāṅga namaskārān samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.bhaktaṁ kuru ca māṁ ḍhuṇḍhe tava pādapri: bhaktaṁ kuru ca māṁ ḍhuṇḍhe tava pāda-priyaṁ sadā ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/15_mahaganapati_sh.bāhyaṁ nānāvidhaṁ pāpaṁ mahograṁ tallaya: bāhyaṁ nānā-vidhaṁ pāpaṁ mahograṁ tal-layaṁ vrajet |

puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau mama saṅkalpita mano-vāñchā-phala siddhy-arthaṁ iṣṭa-kāmyārtha siddhy-arthaṁ śrīmad-āñjaneya svāmi devatā prīty-arthaṁ yathāśakti ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjāṁ kariṣye ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ vastrayugmaṁ samar: oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ vastra-yugmaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ divya śrīcandanaṁ: oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ divya śrī-candanaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ nānāvidha parimala: oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ nānā-vidha parimala patra puṣpāṇi samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ mantrapuṣpaṁ samar: oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ mantra-puṣpaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāntarakṛtāni ca: yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāntara-kṛtāni ca |
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.anyathā śaraṇaṁ nāsti tvameva śaraṇaṁ ma: anyathā śaraṇaṁ nāsti tvam-eva śaraṇaṁ mama |
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ ātmapradakṣiṇa nam: oṁ śrī hanumate namaḥ ātma-pradakṣiṇa namaskārān samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.yatpūjitaṁ mayā deva paripūrṇaṁ tadastu: yat-pūjitaṁ mayā deva paripūrṇaṁ tad-astu te ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.anayā dhyāna āvāhanādi ṣoḍaśopacāra pūja: anayā dhyāna āvāhanādi ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjayā bhagavān sarvātmakaḥ śrīmad-āñjaneya svāmi suprītā suprasannā varadā bhavantu ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/16_anjaneya_shodas.samasta pāpakṣayakaraṁ śrīāñjaneya pādod: samasta pāpa-kṣaya-karaṁ śrī-āñjaneya pādodakaṁ pāvanaṁ śubham ||

puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.asmin liṅge śrīumāmaheśvara svāminamāvāh: asmin liṅge śrī-umā-maheśvara svāminam-āvāhayāmi sthāpayāmi | tataḥ prāṇa pratiṣṭhāpanaṁ kariṣye ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.viśvādyaṁ viśvavandyaṁ nikhila bhayahara: viśvādyaṁ viśva-vandyaṁ nikhila bhaya-haraṁ pañca-vaktraṁ trinetram || 3
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.tāvattvaṁ prīti bhāvena liṅge'smin sanni: tāvat-tvaṁ prīti bhāvena liṅge'smin sannidhiṁ kuru ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.kailāse kamanīya ratna khacite kalpadrum: kailāse kamanīya ratna khacite kalpadru-mūle sthitaṁ
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.gaṅgottuṅga taraṅga rañjita jaṭā bhāraṁ: gaṅgottuṅga taraṅga rañjita jaṭā bhāraṁ kṛpā-sāgaraṁ
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.oṁ śrī umāmaheśvara svāmine namaḥ vastra: oṁ śrī umāmaheśvara svāmine namaḥ vastra-yugmaṁ samarpayāmi |

puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.oṁ śrī umāmaheśvarāya namaḥ – sarvāṇyaṅg: oṁ śrī umāmaheśvarāya namaḥ – sarvāṇy-aṅgāni pūjayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.oṁ śrī umāmaheśvara svāmine namaḥ dhūpam: oṁ śrī umāmaheśvara svāmine namaḥ dhūpam-āghrāpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.oṁ śrī umāmaheśvara svāmine namaḥ ātmapr: oṁ śrī umāmaheśvara svāmine namaḥ ātma-pradakṣiṇa namaskārān samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.samasta rājopacāra devopacāra bhaktyupac: samasta rājopacāra devopacāra bhakty-upacāra śakty-upacāra mantropacāra pūjāssamarpayāmi ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.yatpūjitaṁ mayā deva paripūrṇaṁ tadastu: yat-pūjitaṁ mayā deva paripūrṇaṁ tad-astu te ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.anayā dhyānāvahanādi ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjayā: anayā dhyānāvahanādi ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjayā bhagavān sarvātmakaḥ śrī umāmaheśvara-svāmī suprītaḥ suprasanno varado bhavatu |
puja/pauranika/smarta/17_shiva_shodashop.iti trivāraṁ pītvā śiva nirmālya rūpa bi: iti trivāraṁ pītvā śiva nirmālya rūpa bilva-dalaṁ vā dakṣiṇe karṇe dhārayet |

puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau śrī mahālakṣmī anugraha-prasāda siddhy-arthaṁ śrī mahālakṣmī prīty-arthaṁ dhyāna āvāhanādi ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjāṁ kariṣye ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.gambhīrā vartanābhiḥ stanabhara namitā ś: gambhīrā vartanābhiḥ stana-bhara namitā śubhra vastrottarīyā |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.nityaṁ sā padmahastā mama vasatu gṛhe sa: nityaṁ sā padma-hastā mama vasatu gṛhe sarva-māṅgalya-yuktā ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.tvāṁ trailokya kuṭumbinīṁ sarasijāṁ vand: tvāṁ trailokya kuṭumbinīṁ sarasijāṁ vande mukunda-priyām ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.śāntāṁ ca śrīhareḥ kāntāṁ tāṁ bhaje jaga: śāntāṁ ca śrī-hareḥ kāntāṁ tāṁ bhaje jagatāṁ prasūm ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ navaratnakhaci: oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ navaratna-khacita suvarṇa siṁhāsanaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.kārpāsajaṁ ca kṛmijaṁ vasanaṁ devi gṛhya: kārpāsajaṁ ca kṛmi-jaṁ vasanaṁ devi gṛhyatām ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ vastrayugmaṁ s: oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ vastra-yugmaṁ samarpayāmi |

puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ puṣpamālām sam: oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ puṣpa-mālām samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.nānāvidhāni ramyāṇi pakvāni ca phalāni t: nānā-vidhāni ramyāṇi pakvāni ca phalāni tu |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ mantrapuṣpāñja: oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ mantra-puṣpāñjaliṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāntarakṛtāni ca: yāni kāni ca pāpāni janmāntara-kṛtāni ca |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.anyathā śaraṇaṁ nāsti tvameva śaraṇaṁ ma: anyathā śaraṇaṁ nāsti tvam-eva śaraṇaṁ mama |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ ātmapradakṣiṇa: oṁ śrī mahālakṣmyai namaḥ ātma-pradakṣiṇa namaskārān samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.imāṁ mayā kṛtāṁ pūjāṁ gṛhṇaṁstejaḥ prava: imāṁ mayā kṛtāṁ pūjāṁ gṛhṇaṁs-tejaḥ pravardhaya ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.oṁ dīpāya namaḥ iti gandhakṣatapuṣpaiḥ s: oṁ dīpāya namaḥ iti gandhakṣata-puṣpaiḥ sampūjya śrī-mahālakṣmyai nivedayet |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.yā rātriḥ sarvabhūtānāṁ yā ca deveṣvavas: yā rātriḥ sarva-bhūtānāṁ yā ca deveṣv-avasthitā |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.saṁvatsarapriyā yā ca sā mamāstu sumaṅga: saṁvatsara-priyā yā ca sā mamāstu sumaṅgalam || 4 ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.sarvadā dehi me dravyaṁ dānāya bhuktihet: sarvadā dehi me dravyaṁ dānāya bhukti-hetave || 8 ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.dhanaṁ dhānyaṁ dharāṁ harṣaṁ kīrtimāyury: dhanaṁ dhānyaṁ dharāṁ harṣaṁ kīrtim-āyur-yaśaḥ śriyaḥ |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.yanmayā vāñchitaṁ devi tatsarvaṁ saphala: yan-mayā vāñchitaṁ devi tat-sarvaṁ saphalaṁ kuru |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.nyūnaṁ vā'pyatulaṁ vāpi yanmayā mohitaṁ: nyūnaṁ vā'py-atulaṁ vāpi yan-mayā mohitaṁ kṛtam |
puja/pauranika/smarta/18_mahalakshmi_vis.samastapāpakṣayakaraṁ śrī mahālakṣmī pād: samasta-pāpa-kṣaya-karaṁ śrī mahālakṣmī pādodakaṁ pāvanaṁ śubham ||

puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau śrī jagad-ambā prasādena sarvāpan-nivṛty-arthaṁ mano-vāñchā-phala siddhy-arthaṁ, mama samasta vyādhi-nāśana-dvārā kṣipram-evārogya-prāpty-arthaṁ, graha-pīḍā-nivāraṇārthaṁ, piśācopadravādi sarvāriṣṭa nivāraṇārthaṁ kṣemāyuḥ sakalaiśvarya siddhy-arthaṁ śrī-mahākālī śrī-mahālakṣmī śrī-mahāsarasvatī svarūpiṇī śrī durgā parādevī prīty-arthaṁ, sambhavadbhiḥ dravyaiḥ sambhavadbhiḥ upacāraiś-ca sambhavatā niyamena sambhavitā prākāreṇa yāvacchakti dhyānāvāhanādi ṣoḍaśopacāra pūjāṁ kariṣye ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.asmin bimbe sāṅgāṁ sāyudhāṁ savāhanāṁ sa: asmin bimbe sāṅgāṁ sāyudhāṁ savāhanāṁ saśaktiṁ pati-putra-parivāra sametaṁ śrī-mahākālī śrī-mahālakṣmī śrī-mahāsarasvatī svarūpiṇī śrī-durgā parādevī āvāhitā bhava sthāpitā bhava | suprasanno bhava varadā bhava | sthirāsanaṁ kuru prasīda prasīda ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.khaḍgaṁ cakragadeṣu cāpaparighān śūlaṁ b: khaḍgaṁ cakra-gadeṣu cāpa-parighān śūlaṁ bhuśuṇḍīṁ śiraḥ
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.yāmastaut svapite harau kamalajo hantuṁ: yām-astaut svapite harau kamalajo hantuṁ madhuṁ kaiṭabham ||
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.daṇḍaṁ śaktimasiṁ ca carma jalajaṁ ghaṇṭ: daṇḍaṁ śaktim-asiṁ ca carma jalajaṁ ghaṇṭāṁ surā-bhājanam |
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.śūlaṁ pāśasudarśane ca dadhatīṁ hastaiḥ: śūlaṁ pāśa-sudarśane ca dadhatīṁ hastaiḥ pravāla-prabhāṁ
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.śaṅkhaṁ cakra dhanuḥ śarāṁśca dadhatī ne: śaṅkhaṁ cakra dhanuḥ śarāṁś-ca dadhatī netrais-tribhiḥ śobhitā |
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.oṁ śrīmahākālī śrīmahālakṣmī śrīmahāsara: oṁ śrī-mahākālī śrī-mahālakṣmī śrī-mahāsarasvatī svarūpiṇī śrī-durgā parādevyai namaḥ dhyāyāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.oṁ śrīdurgāparādevyai namaḥ navaratnakha: oṁ śrī-durgā-parā-devyai namaḥ navaratna-khacita suvarṇa-siṁhāsanaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.oṁ śrīdurgāparādevyai namaḥ pādayoḥ pādy: oṁ śrī-durgā-parā-devyai namaḥ pādayoḥ pādyaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.oṁ śrīdurgāparādevyai namaḥ hastayoḥ arg: oṁ śrī-durgā-parā-devyai namaḥ hastayoḥ arghyaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.oṁ śrīdurgāparādevyai namaḥ mukhe ācaman: oṁ śrī-durgā-parā-devyai namaḥ mukhe ācamanīyaṁ samarpayāmi |
puja/pauranika/smarta/19_durga_shodashop.oṁ śrīdurgāparādevyai namaḥ śuddhodaka s: oṁ śrī-durgā-parā-devyai namaḥ śuddhodaka snānaṁ samarpayāmi |
