rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.tathā tvamapi sarvābhiḥ strībhiḥ saha ma: tathā tvam-api sarvābhiḥ strībhiḥ saha mahā-bala ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.samayaśca kṛtaḥ sīte vadhārthaṁ vālino m: samayaś-ca kṛtaḥ sīte vadhārthaṁ vālino mayā |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.eṣā sā dṛśyate pampā nalinī citrakānanā: eṣā sā dṛśyate pampā nalinī citra-kānanā ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.asmin deśe mahākāyo virādho nihato mayā: asmin deśe mahā-kāyo virādho nihato mayā |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.ete te tāpasā devi dṛśyante tanumadhyame: ete te tāpasā devi dṛśyante tanu-madhyame ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.atra sīte tvayā dṛṣṭā tāpasī dharmacāriṇ: atra sīte tvayā dṛṣṭā tāpasī dharma-cāriṇī ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.eṣā sā yamunā ramyā dṛśyate citrakānanā: eṣā sā yamunā ramyā dṛśyate citra-kānanā |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.eṣā sā dṛśyate sīte rājadhānī piturmama: eṣā sā dṛśyate sīte rājadhānī pitur-mama |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/123_sarga_123_r.ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvy: ity-ārṣe śrīmad-rāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādi-kāvye yuddha-kāṇḍe trayoviṁśaty-adhika-śatatamaḥ sargaḥ

rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.kaccit sa yukto bharato jīvantyapi ca mā: kaccit sa yukto bharato jīvanty-api ca mātaraḥ ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.strītṛtīyaṁ cyutaṁ rājyād dharmakāmaṁ ca: strī-tṛtīyaṁ cyutaṁ rājyād dharma-kāmaṁ ca kevalam ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.sarvaṁ ca sukhaduḥkhaṁ te viditaṁ mama r: sarvaṁ ca sukha-duḥkhaṁ te viditaṁ mama rāghava |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.sugrīveṇa ca te sakhyaṁ yatra vālī hatas: sugrīveṇa ca te sakhyaṁ yatra vālī hatas-tvayā |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.yathā ca nihataḥ saṁkhye rāvaṇo baladarp: yathā ca nihataḥ saṁkhye rāvaṇo bala-darpitaḥ ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.yathā ca nihate tasmin rāvaṇe devakaṇṭak: yathā ca nihate tasmin rāvaṇe deva-kaṇṭake |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.sampatanti ca me śiṣyāḥ pravṛttyākhyāḥ p: sampatanti ca me śiṣyāḥ pravṛttyākhyāḥ purīm-itaḥ ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.ahamapyatra te dadmi varaṁ śastrabhṛtāṁ: aham-apy-atra te dadmi varaṁ śastra-bhṛtāṁ vara |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/124_sarga_124_r.ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvy: ity-ārṣe śrīmad-rāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādi-kāvye yuddha-kāṇḍe caturviṁśaty-adhika-śatatamaḥ sargaḥ

rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.bhaviṣyati guhaḥ prītaḥ sa mamātmasamaḥ: bhaviṣyati guhaḥ prītaḥ sa mamātma-samaḥ sakhā ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.ayodhyāyāśca te mārgaṁ pravṛttiṁ bharata: ayodhyāyāś-ca te mārgaṁ pravṛttiṁ bharatasya ca |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.siddhārthaṁ śaṁsa māṁ tasmai sabhāryaṁ s: siddhārthaṁ śaṁsa māṁ tasmai sabhāryaṁ saha-lakṣmaṇam ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.sugrīveṇa ca saṁvādaṁ vālinaśca vadhaṁ r: sugrīveṇa ca saṁvādaṁ vālinaś-ca vadhaṁ raṇe ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.yathā ca kāritaḥ setū rāvaṇaśca yathā ha: yathā ca kāritaḥ setū rāvaṇaś-ca yathā hataḥ ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.jitvā śatrugaṇān rāmaḥ prāpya cānuttamaṁ: jitvā śatru-gaṇān rāmaḥ prāpya cānuttamaṁ yaśaḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.sa ca te veditavyaḥ syāt sarvaṁ yaccāpi: sa ca te veditavyaḥ syāt sarvaṁ yac-cāpi māṁ prati ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.sakhā tu tava kākutstho rāmaḥ satyaparāk: sakhā tu tava kākutstho rāmaḥ satya-parākramaḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.sasītaḥ saha saumitriḥ sa tvāṁ kuśalamab: sasītaḥ saha saumitriḥ sa tvāṁ kuśalam-abravīt ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.so'paśyad rāmatīrthaṁ ca nadīṁ vālukinīṁ: so'paśyad rāma-tīrthaṁ ca nadīṁ vālukinīṁ tathā |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.varūthīṁ gomatīṁ caiva bhīmaṁ śālavanaṁ: varūthīṁ gomatīṁ caiva bhīmaṁ śāla-vanaṁ tathā ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.priyamākhyāmi te deva śokaṁ tyaja sudāru: priyam-ākhyāmi te deva śokaṁ tyaja sudāruṇam ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.gavāṁ śatasahasraṁ ca grāmāṇāṁ ca śataṁ: gavāṁ śata-sahasraṁ ca grāmāṇāṁ ca śataṁ param |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/125_sarga_125_h.ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvy: ity-ārṣe śrīmad-rāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādi-kāvye yuddha-kāṇḍe pañcaviṁśaty-adhika-śatatamaḥ sargaḥ

rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.yathā pravrājito rāmo māturdattau varau: yathā pravrājito rāmo mātur-dattau varau tava |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.yathā ca putraśokena rājā daśaratho mṛta: yathā ca putra-śokena rājā daśaratho mṛtaḥ ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.tvayi pratiprayāte tu yad vṛttaṁ tannibo: tvayi pratiprayāte tu yad vṛttaṁ tan-nibodha me ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.tat kṛtvā duṣkaraṁ karma bhrātarau rāmal: tat kṛtvā duṣkaraṁ karma bhrātarau rāma-lakṣmaṇau |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.jagrāha tarasā sītāṁ grahaḥ khe rohiṇīmi: jagrāha tarasā sītāṁ grahaḥ khe rohiṇīm-iva |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.trātukāmaṁ tato yuddhe hatvā gṛdhraṁ jaṭ: trātu-kāmaṁ tato yuddhe hatvā gṛdhraṁ jaṭāyuṣam ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.tataḥ śīghrataraṁ gatvā tad vimānaṁ mano: tataḥ śīghrataraṁ gatvā tad vimānaṁ mano-javam |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.āruhya saha vaidehyā puṣpakaṁ sa mahābal: āruhya saha vaidehyā puṣpakaṁ sa mahā-balaḥ ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.tṛṇavad bhāṣitaṁ tasya taṁ ca nairṛtapuṅ: tṛṇavad bhāṣitaṁ tasya taṁ ca nairṛta-puṅgavam ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.śrutvā tāṁ maithilīṁ rāmastvāśaśaṁse ca: śrutvā tāṁ maithilīṁ rāmas-tv-āśaśaṁse ca jīvitam |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.sa tu dattavaraḥ prītyā vānaraiśca samāg: sa tu datta-varaḥ prītyā vānaraiś-ca samāgataiḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/126_sarga_126_h.ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe ādikāvye yuddhakā: ity-ārṣe śrīmad-rāmāyaṇe ādi-kāvye yuddha-kāṇḍe ṣaḍviṁśaty-adhika-śatatamaḥ sargaḥ

rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.kṛtsnaṁ tu nagaraṁ tat tu nandigrāmamupā: kṛtsnaṁ tu nagaraṁ tat tu nandigrāmam-upāgamat |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.manye vānarasenā sā nadīṁ tarati gomatīm: manye vānara-senā sā nadīṁ tarati gomatīm |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.maindaṁ ca dvividaṁ nīlamṛṣabhaṁ caiva s: maindaṁ ca dvividaṁ nīlam-ṛṣabhaṁ caiva sasvaje ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.te kṛtvā mānuṣaṁ rūpaṁ vānarāḥ kāmarūpiṇ: te kṛtvā mānuṣaṁ rūpaṁ vānarāḥ kāma-rūpiṇaḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.tvamasmākaṁ caturṇāṁ vai bhrātā sugrīva: tvam-asmākaṁ caturṇāṁ vai bhrātā sugrīva pañcamaḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.abravīcca tadā rāmaṁ bharataḥ sa kṛtāñja: abravīc-ca tadā rāmaṁ bharataḥ sa kṛtāñjaliḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.adya janma kṛtārthaṁ me saṁvṛttaśca mano: adya janma kṛtārthaṁ me saṁvṛttaś-ca manorathaḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.tathā bruvāṇaṁ bharataṁ dṛṣṭvā taṁ bhrāt: tathā bruvāṇaṁ bharataṁ dṛṣṭvā taṁ bhrātṛ-vatsalam |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/127_sarga_127_r.ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvy: ity-ārṣe śrīmad-rāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādi-kāvye yuddha-kāṇḍe saptaviṁśaty-adhika-śatatamaḥ sargaḥ

rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.pūjitā māmikā mātā dattaṁ rājyamidaṁ mam: pūjitā māmikā mātā dattaṁ rājyam-idaṁ mama |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.tad dadāmi punastubhyaṁ yathā tvamadadā: tad dadāmi punas-tubhyaṁ yathā tvam-adadā mama ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.tasya nānubhavedarthaṁ yasya hetoḥ sa ro: tasya nānubhaved-arthaṁ yasya hetoḥ sa ropitaḥ ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.yadyasmān manujendra tvaṁ bhartā bhṛtyān: yady-asmān manujendra tvaṁ bhartā bhṛtyān na śādhi hi ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.pūrvaṁ tu bharate snāte lakṣmaṇe ca mahā: pūrvaṁ tu bharate snāte lakṣmaṇe ca mahā-bale |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.śvetaṁ ca vālavyajanaṁ jagṛhe paritaḥ st: śvetaṁ ca vāla-vyajanaṁ jagṛhe paritaḥ sthitaḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.akṣataṁ jātarūpaṁ ca gāvaḥ kanyāḥ sahadv: akṣataṁ jātarūpaṁ ca gāvaḥ kanyāḥ saha-dvijāḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.vānarāṇāṁ ca tat karma hyācacakṣe'tha ma: vānarāṇāṁ ca tat karma hy-ācacakṣe'tha mantriṇām ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.tato hyabhyucchrayan paurāḥ patākāśca gṛ: tato hy-abhyucchrayan paurāḥ patākāś-ca gṛhe gṛhe |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.kausalyāṁ ca sumitrāṁ ca kaikeyīmabhivād: kausalyāṁ ca sumitrāṁ ca kaikeyīm-abhivādya ca ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā bharataḥ satyav: tasya tad vacanaṁ śrutvā bharataḥ satya-vikramaḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.tejo dhṛtiryaśo dākṣyaṁ sāmarthyaṁ vinay: tejo dhṛtir-yaśo dākṣyaṁ sāmarthyaṁ vinayo nayaḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.yathārhaṁ pūjitāḥ sarve kāmai ratnaiśca: yathārhaṁ pūjitāḥ sarve kāmai ratnaiś-ca puṣkalaiḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.ātiṣṭha dharmajña mayā sahemāṁ gāṁ pūrva: ātiṣṭha dharmajña mayā sahemāṁ gāṁ pūrva-rājādhyuṣitāṁ balena |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.tulyaṁ mayā tvaṁ pitṛbhirdhṛtā yā tāṁ ya: tulyaṁ mayā tvaṁ pitṛbhir-dhṛtā yā tāṁ yauvarājye dhuram-udvahasva ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.sarvātmanā paryanunīyamāno yadā na saumi: sarvātmanā paryanunīyamāno yadā na saumitrir-upaiti yogam |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.na paryadevan vidhavā na ca vyālakṛtaṁ b: na paryadevan vidhavā na ca vyāla-kṛtaṁ bhayam |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.na ca sma vṛddhā bālānāṁ pretakāryāṇi ku: na ca sma vṛddhā bālānāṁ preta-kāryāṇi kurvate ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.rāmo rāmo rāma iti prajānāmabhavan kathā: rāmo rāmo rāma iti prajānām-abhavan kathāḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.āsan prajā dharmaparā rāme śāsati nānṛtā: āsan prajā dharma-parā rāme śāsati nānṛtāḥ |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.putrakāmaśca putrān vai dhanakāmo dhanān: putra-kāmaś-ca putrān vai dhana-kāmo dhanāni ca ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.vināyakāśca śāmyanti gṛhe tiṣṭhanti yasy: vināyakāś-ca śāmyanti gṛhe tiṣṭhanti yasya vai ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.sākṣād rāmo raghuśreṣṭhaḥ śeṣo lakṣmaṇa: sākṣād rāmo raghu-śreṣṭhaḥ śeṣo lakṣmaṇa ucyate ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.bhaktyā rāmasya ye cemāṁ saṁhitāmṛṣiṇā k: bhaktyā rāmasya ye cemāṁ saṁhitām-ṛṣiṇā kṛtām |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.kuṭumbavṛddhiṁ dhanadhānyavṛddhiṁ striya: kuṭumba-vṛddhiṁ dhana-dhānya-vṛddhiṁ striyaś-ca mukhyāḥ sukham-uttamaṁ ca |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.śrutvā śubhaṁ kāvyamidaṁ mahārthaṁ prāpn: śrutvā śubhaṁ kāvyam-idaṁ mahārthaṁ prāpnoti sarvāṁ bhuvi cārtha-siddhim ||
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.āyuṣyamārogyakaraṁ yaśasyaṁ saubhrātṛkaṁ: āyuṣyam-ārogya-karaṁ yaśasyaṁ saubhrātṛkaṁ buddhi-karaṁ śubhaṁ ca |
rama/valmiki_yuddhakanda/128_sarga_128_r.ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvy: ity-ārṣe śrīmad-rāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādi-kāvye yuddhakāṇḍe'ṣṭāviṁśaty-adhika-śatatamaḥ sargaḥ

shani/01_shani_vajrapanjara_kavacham.txt.śiraḥ śanaiścaraḥ pātu phālaṁ me sūryana: śiraḥ śanaiścaraḥ pātu phālaṁ me sūrya-nandanaḥ |
shani/01_shani_vajrapanjara_kavacham.txt.snigdhakaṇṭhaśca me kaṇṭhaṁ bhujau pātu: snigdha-kaṇṭhaś-ca me kaṇṭhaṁ bhujau pātu mahā-bhujaḥ ||
shani/01_shani_vajrapanjara_kavacham.txt.skandhau pātu śaniścaiva karau pātu śubh: skandhau pātu śaniś-caiva karau pātu śubha-pradaḥ |
shani/01_shani_vajrapanjara_kavacham.txt.nābhiṁ grahapatiḥ pātu mandaḥ pātu kaṭiṁ: nābhiṁ graha-patiḥ pātu mandaḥ pātu kaṭiṁ tathā |
shani/01_shani_vajrapanjara_kavacham.txt.ūrū mamāntakaḥ pātu yamo jānuyugaṁ tathā: ūrū mamāntakaḥ pātu yamo jānu-yugaṁ tathā ||
shani/01_shani_vajrapanjara_kavacham.txt.pādau mandagatiḥ pātu sarvāṅgaṁ pātu pip: pādau manda-gatiḥ pātu sarvāṅgaṁ pātu pippalaḥ |
shani/01_shani_vajrapanjara_kavacham.txt.na tasya jāyate pīḍā prīto bhavati sūrya: na tasya jāyate pīḍā prīto bhavati sūrya-jaḥ ||
shani/01_shani_vajrapanjara_kavacham.txt.kalatrastho gato vā'pi suprītastu sadā ś: kalatrastho gato vā'pi suprītas-tu sadā śaniḥ ||

shani/02_shani_stotram_dasaratha_krutam..namo nityaṁ kṣudhārtāya nityataptāya vai: namo nityaṁ kṣudhārtāya nitya-taptāya vai namaḥ ||
shani/02_shani_stotram_dasaratha_krutam..namo mandagate tubhyaṁ nistriṁśāya namo: namo manda-gate tubhyaṁ nistriṁśāya namo namaḥ |
shani/02_shani_stotram_dasaratha_krutam..tvayā vilokitāḥ saure dainyamāśu vrajant: tvayā vilokitāḥ saure dainyam-āśu vrajanti ca ||
shani/02_shani_stotram_dasaratha_krutam..rājyabhraṣṭāśca te sarve tava dṛṣṭyā vil: rājya-bhraṣṭāś-ca te sarve tava dṛṣṭyā vilokitāḥ ||
shani/02_shani_stotram_dasaratha_krutam..raudradṛṣṭyā tu ye dṛṣṭāḥ kṣayaṁ gacchan: raudra-dṛṣṭyā tu ye dṛṣṭāḥ kṣayaṁ gacchanti tat kṣaṇāt ||

shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.śanimantraprabhedā ye tairyuktaṁ yat sta: śani-mantra-prabhedā ye tair-yuktaṁ yat stavaṁ śubham |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.evaṁ nyāsavidhiṁ kṛtvā paścāt kālātmanaḥ: evaṁ nyāsa-vidhiṁ kṛtvā paścāt kālātmanaḥ śaneḥ ||
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.nyāsaṁ dhyānam pravakṣyāmi tanau dhyātvā: nyāsaṁ dhyānam pravakṣyāmi tanau dhyātvā paṭhen-naraḥ |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.namaḥ kālaprabodhāya māghaṁ vai codare n: namaḥ kāla-prabodhāya māghaṁ vai codare nyaset |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.mandagāya namo meḍhre nyasedvai phālguna: manda-gāya namo meḍhre nyased-vai phālgunaṁ tathā ||
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.namaḥ sarvajite caiva toyaṁ sarvāṅgulau: namaḥ sarva-jite caiva toyaṁ sarvāṅgulau nyaset ||
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.jānudvaye dhaniṣṭhāṁ ca nyaset kṛṣṇaruce: jānu-dvaye dhaniṣṭhāṁ ca nyaset kṛṣṇa-ruce namaḥ |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.revatīṁ ca nyasennābhau namo mandacarāya: revatīṁ ca nyasen-nābhau namo manda-carāya ca |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.namo bhogisraje nityaṁ yamaṁ stanayuge n: namo bhogi-sraje nityaṁ yamaṁ stana-yuge nyaset |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.mukhe nyasedbhagarkṣaṁ ca namaḥ krūragra: mukhe nyased-bhagarkṣaṁ ca namaḥ krūra-grahāya ca ||
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.śākraṁ nyasecca śirasi namaḥ saṁvartakāy: śākraṁ nyasec-ca śirasi namaḥ saṁvartakāya ca |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.prītiyogaṁ bhruvoḥ sandhau mahāmanda nam: prīti-yogaṁ bhruvoḥ sandhau mahāmanda namo'stu te |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.tanmūlasandhau śūlaṁ ca nyasedugrāya te: tan-mūla-sandhau śūlaṁ ca nyased-ugrāya te namaḥ ||
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.vṛddhiṁ tanmaṇibandhe ca kālajñāya namo: vṛddhiṁ tan-maṇibandhe ca kāla-jñāya namo nyaset ||
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.siddhiṁ tanmaṇibandhe ca nyaset kālāgnay: siddhiṁ tan-maṇibandhe ca nyaset kālāgnaye namaḥ |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.tajjānau bhāvayet siddhiṁ mahādehāya te: taj-jānau bhāvayet siddhiṁ mahā-dehāya te namaḥ ||
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.sādhyaṁ nyasecca tadgulphasandhau ghorāy: sādhyaṁ nyasec-ca tad-gulpha-sandhau ghorāya te namaḥ |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.aindraṁ tadgulphasandhau ca yogādhīśāya: aindraṁ tad-gulpha-sandhau ca yogādhīśāya te namaḥ |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.garaṁ nyasedvapāyāṁ ca sarvagrāsāya te n: garaṁ nyased-vapāyāṁ ca sarva-grāsāya te namaḥ |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.tuṣṭāya ca variṣṭhāya namo rāhusakhāya c: tuṣṭāya ca variṣṭhāya namo rāhu-sakhāya ca ||
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.pādayoḥ śanivāraṁ ca nirmāṁsāya namo'stu: pādayoḥ śani-vāraṁ ca nirmāṁsāya namo'stu te |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.kālasya vaśagāḥ sarve na kālaḥ kasyacidv: kālasya vaśagāḥ sarve na kālaḥ kasyacid-vaśaḥ |
shani/03_shani_mrityunjaya_stotram.txt.āpadastasya naśyanti pāpāni ca jayaṁ bha: āpadas-tasya naśyanti pāpāni ca jayaṁ bhavet |

shani/05_shani_kavacham_1.txt.asya śrī śanaiścara kavaca stotrasya kaś: asya śrī śanaiścara kavaca stotrasya kaśyapa ṛṣiḥ, anuṣṭup chandaḥ, śanaiścaro devatā, śaṁ bījaṁ, vāṁ śaktiḥ yaṁ kīlakaṁ, mama śanaiścara-kṛta-pīḍā-parihārārthe jape viniyogaḥ ||
shani/05_shani_kavacham_1.txt.kṛṣṇāṅgo nāsikāṁ rakṣet karṇau me ca śik: kṛṣṇāṅgo nāsikāṁ rakṣet karṇau me ca śikhaṇḍi-jaḥ |
shani/05_shani_kavacham_1.txt.bhujau me subhujaḥ pātu hastau nīlotpala: bhujau me subhujaḥ pātu hastau nīlotpala-prabhaḥ ||
shani/05_shani_kavacham_1.txt.pātu me hṛdayaṁ kṛṣṇaḥ kukṣiṁ śuṣkodaras: pātu me hṛdayaṁ kṛṣṇaḥ kukṣiṁ śuṣkodaras-tathā |
shani/05_shani_kavacham_1.txt.kaṭiṁ me vikaṭaḥ pātu ūrū me ghorarūpavā: kaṭiṁ me vikaṭaḥ pātu ūrū me ghora-rūpavān ||
shani/05_shani_kavacham_1.txt.jānunī pātu dīrgho me jaṅghe me maṅgalap: jānunī pātu dīrgho me jaṅghe me maṅgala-pradaḥ |
shani/05_shani_kavacham_1.txt.gulphau guṇākaraḥ pātu pādau me paṅgupād: gulphau guṇākaraḥ pātu pādau me paṅgu-pādakaḥ |
shani/05_shani_kavacham_1.txt.ya idaṁ kavacaṁ divyaṁ sarvapīḍāharaṁ nṛ: ya idaṁ kavacaṁ divyaṁ sarva-pīḍā-haraṁ nṛṇām |

shani/06_shanaischara_raksha_stavah.txt.śiro me bhāskariḥ pātu phālaṁ chāyāsuto': śiro me bhāskariḥ pātu phālaṁ chāyā-suto'vatu |

shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.sa kasya stotavyaḥ katividhaguṇaḥ kasya: sa kasya stotavyaḥ katividha-guṇaḥ kasya viṣayaḥ

shiva/05_shiva_mahimna_stotram.txt.hariste sāhasraṁ kamalabalimādhāya paday: haris-te sāhasraṁ kamala-balim-ādhāya padayor-yad-ekone tasmin nijam-udaharan-netra-kamalam |

shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.guhāyāṁ gehe vā bahirapi vane vā'driśikh: guhāyāṁ gehe vā bahir-api vane vā'dri-śikhare

shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.upekṣā no cetkiṁ na harasi bhavaddhyānav: upekṣā no cetkiṁ na harasi bhavad-dhyāna-vimukhāṁ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.phalādvā puṇyānāṁ mayi karuṇayā vā tvayi: phalād-vā puṇyānāṁ mayi karuṇayā vā tvayi vibho

shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.vadeyaṁ prītiścettava śiva kṛtārthāḥ kha: vadeyaṁ prītiś-cet-tava śiva kṛtārthāḥ khalu vayam ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.dṛḍhaṁ bhaktyā baddhvā śiva bhavadadhīna: dṛḍhaṁ bhaktyā baddhvā śiva bhavad-adhīnaṁ kuru vibho ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.imaṁ cetaścoraṁ kathamiha sahe śaṅkara v: imaṁ cetaś-coraṁ katham-iha sahe śaṅkara vibho
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.karomi tvatpūjāṁ sapadi sukhado me bhava: karomi tvat-pūjāṁ sapadi sukhado me bhava vibho
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.vidhitvaṁ viṣṇutvaṁ diśasi khalu tasyāḥ: vidhitvaṁ viṣṇutvaṁ diśasi khalu tasyāḥ phalam-iti |
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kadā vā tvāṁ dṛṣṭvā giriśa tava bhavyāṅg: kadā vā tvāṁ dṛṣṭvā giriśa tava bhavyāṅghri-yugalaṁ
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.kamarthaṁ dāsye'haṁ bhavatu bhavadarthaṁ: kam-arthaṁ dāsye'haṁ bhavatu bhavad-arthaṁ mama manaḥ ||
shiva/07_shivanandalahari.txt.sāyujyaṁ mama siddhamatra bhavati svāmin: sāyujyaṁ mama siddham-atra bhavati svāmin kṛtārtho'smy-aham ||

shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yajñānāmapi yo yajñaḥ śivānāmapi yaḥ śiv: yajñānām-api yo yajñaḥ śivānām-api yaḥ śivaḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yogināmapi yo yogī kāraṇānāṁ ca kāraṇam: yoginām-api yo yogī kāraṇānāṁ ca kāraṇam |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.aṣṭottarasahasraṁ tu nāmnāṁ śarvasya me: aṣṭottara-sahasraṁ tu nāmnāṁ śarvasya me śṛṇu |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.jaṭī carmī śikhī khaḍgī sarvāṅgaḥ sarvab: jaṭī carmī śikhī khaḍgī sarvāṅgaḥ sarva-bhāvanaḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.dīrghaśca harikeśaśca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa ev: dīrghaś-ca harikeśaś-ca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.ghoro mahātapāḥ pāśo nityo giriruho nabh: ghoro mahā-tapāḥ pāśo nityo giri-ruho nabhaḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.bhagahārī nihantā ca kālo brahmā pitāmah: bhaga-hārī nihantā ca kālo brahmā pitāmahaḥ ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.dambho hyadambho vaidambho vaśyo vaśakar: dambho hy-adambho vaidambho vaśyo vaśa-karaḥ kaliḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.dhātā śakraśca viṣṇuśca mitrastvaṣṭā dhr: dhātā śakraś-ca viṣṇuś-ca mitras-tvaṣṭā dhruvo dharaḥ ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.kalā kāṣṭhā lavā mātrā muhūrtāhaḥkṣapāḥ: kalā kāṣṭhā lavā mātrā muhūrtāhaḥ-kṣapāḥ kṣaṇāḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.guhaḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraṁ sarvap: guhaḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraṁ sarva-pāvanaḥ |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.gīyate ca sa buddhyeta brahmā śaṅkarasan: gīyate ca sa buddhyeta brahmā śaṅkara-sannidhau ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.idaṁ puṇyaṁ pavitraṁ ca sarvadā pāpanāśa: idaṁ puṇyaṁ pavitraṁ ca sarvadā pāpa-nāśanam |
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yogadaṁ mokṣadaṁ caiva svargadaṁ toṣadaṁ: yogadaṁ mokṣa-daṁ caiva svargadaṁ toṣadaṁ tathā ||
shiva/29_shiva_sahasranama_stotram.txt.yā gatiḥ sāṅkhyayogānāṁ vrajantyetāṁ gat: yā gatiḥ sāṅkhya-yogānāṁ vrajanty-etāṁ gatiṁ tadā ||

shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.kurudvayaṁ tataḥ paścād baṭukāya punaḥ k: kuru-dvayaṁ tataḥ paścād baṭukāya punaḥ kṣipet |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.na dāridryaṁ na daurbhāgyaṁ nāpadāṁ bhay: na dāridryaṁ na daurbhāgyaṁ nāpadāṁ bhayam-eva ca || 15 ||
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.ka eṣa bhairavo nāma āpaduddhāraṇo mataḥ: ka eṣa bhairavo nāma āpad-uddhāraṇo mataḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.tvayā ca kathito deva bhairavaḥ kalpavit: tvayā ca kathito deva bhairavaḥ kalpa-vittamaḥ || 16 ||
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.anādināthaṁ saumye ca śaktihastaṁ gale n: anādi-nāthaṁ saumye ca śakti-hastaṁ gale nyaset |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.udare ca sadā tuṣṭaṁ kṣetreśaṁ pārśvayos: udare ca sadā tuṣṭaṁ kṣetreśaṁ pārśvayos-tathā |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.dhyānaṁ tasya pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā: dhyānaṁ tasya pravakṣyāmi yathā dhyātvā paṭhen-naraḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.smerāsyaṁ varadaṁ kapālamabhayaṁ śūlaṁ d: smerāsyaṁ varadaṁ kapālam-abhayaṁ śūlaṁ dadhānaṁ karaiḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.digvastraṁ piṅgakeśaṁ ḍamarumatha sṛṇiṁ: dig-vastraṁ piṅga-keśaṁ ḍamarum-atha sṛṇiṁ śūla-khaḍgau dadhānam |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.asya śrībaṭukabhairavanāmāṣṭaśatakāpadud: asya śrī-baṭuka-bhairava-nāmāṣṭa-śatakāpad-uddhāraṇa-stotra-mantrasya bṛhadāraṇyaka ṛṣiḥ, śrī-baṭuka-bhairavo devatā, anuṣṭup chandaḥ, hrīṁ bījam, baṭukāyeti śaktiḥ, praṇavaḥ kīlakam, abhīṣṭa-siddhy-arthe pāṭhe jape viniyogaḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.hāṁ vām aṅguṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ | hrīṁ vīṁ t: hāṁ vām aṅguṣṭhābhyāṁ namaḥ | hrīṁ vīṁ tarjanībhyāṁ svāhā | hūṁ vūṁ madhyamābhyāṁ vaṣaṭ | haiṁ vaiṁ anāmikābhyāṁ hum | hauṁ vauṁ kaniṣṭhikābhyāṁ vauṣaṭ | haḥ vaḥ kara-tala-kara-pṛṣṭhābhyāṁ phaṭ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.hāṁ vāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ | hrīṁ vīṁ śirase: hāṁ vāṁ hṛdayāya namaḥ | hrīṁ vīṁ śirase svāhā | hūṁ vūṁ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ | haiṁ vaiṁ kavacāya hum | hauṁ vauṁ netra-trayāya vauṣaṭ | haḥ vaḥ astrāya phaṭ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.śūlaṁ khaḍgaṁ ca vajraṁ paraśumusalake d: śūlaṁ khaḍgaṁ ca vajraṁ paraśu-musalake dakṣiṇāṅge vahantam |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.nāgaṁ pāśaṁ ca ghaṇṭāṁ nalinakarayutaṁ s: nāgaṁ pāśaṁ ca ghaṇṭāṁ nalina-kara-yutaṁ sāṅkuśaṁ vāma-bhāge
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.na tasya duritaṁ kiñcinna ca bhūtabhayaṁ: na tasya duritaṁ kiñcin-na ca bhūta-bhayaṁ tathā |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.na ca mārībhayaṁ tasya graharājabhayaṁ t: na ca mārī-bhayaṁ tasya graha-rāja-bhayaṁ tathā || 16 ||
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.bhīto bhayātpramucyeta devi sadyo na saṁ: bhīto bhayāt-pramucyeta devi sadyo na saṁśayaḥ |
shiva/31_batuka_bhairava_ashtottarashata.aprakāśyamidaṁ guhyaṁ na deyaṁ yasya kas: aprakāśyam-idaṁ guhyaṁ na deyaṁ yasya kasyacit |

shiva/32_harihara_ashtottarashatanama_st.kuryādimāṁ srajamaho sa yamaṁ na paśyet: kuryād-imāṁ srajam-aho sa yamaṁ na paśyet || 11 ||
shiva/32_harihara_ashtottarashatanama_st.nityaṁ japet stanarasaṁ sa pibenna mātuḥ: nityaṁ japet stana-rasaṁ sa piben-na mātuḥ || 12 ||
shiva/32_harihara_ashtottarashatanama_st.|| iti śrīskandamahāpurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍapūr: || iti śrī-skanda-mahā-purāṇe kāśī-khaṇḍa-pūrvārdhe yama-proktaṁ śrī-hariharāṣṭottara-śata-nāma-stotraṁ sampūrṇam ||

venkateswara/03_venkateswara_prapatti.tx.syāṁ kiṅkaro vṛṣagirīśa na jātu mahyam |: syāṁ kiṅkaro vṛṣa-girīśa na jātu mahyam ||

venkateswara/05_venkateswara_vajrakavach.prāṇeśaḥ prāṇanilayaḥ prāṇān rakṣatu me: prāṇeśaḥ prāṇa-nilayaḥ prāṇān rakṣatu me hariḥ ||
venkateswara/05_venkateswara_vajrakavach.sāyaṁ prātaḥ paṭhennityaṁ mṛtyuṁ tarati: sāyaṁ prātaḥ paṭhen-nityaṁ mṛtyuṁ tarati nirbhayaḥ ||
venkateswara/05_venkateswara_vajrakavach.iti mārkaṇḍeya kṛta śrī veṅkaṭeśvara vaj: iti mārkaṇḍeya kṛta śrī veṅkaṭeśvara vajra-kavaca stotram |

venkateswara/07_venkatesha_ashtakam.txt.trikāle yaḥ paṭhennityaṁ pāpaṁ tasya na: trikāle yaḥ paṭhen-nityaṁ pāpaṁ tasya na vidyate ||
venkateswara/07_venkatesha_ashtakam.txt.iti śrī brahmāṇḍapurāṇe brahmanāradasaṁv: iti śrī brahmāṇḍa-purāṇe brahma-nārada-saṁvāde veṅkaṭa-giri-māhātmye śrī veṅkaṭeśa aṣṭakam |

venkateswara/08_venkatesha_karavalamba_s.iti śrī śṛṅgeri jagadguruṇā śrī nṛsiṁha: iti śrī śṛṅgeri jagad-guruṇā śrī nṛsiṁha bhārati svāminā racitaṁ śrī veṅkaṭeśa karāvalamba stotram |

venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.tārkṣyo yasya ratho mahaśca bhavanaṁ bra: tārkṣyo yasya ratho mahaśca bhavanaṁ brahmāṇḍam-ādyaḥ pumān
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.saundaryaṁ ca manobhavānapi bahūn kāntiś: saundaryaṁ ca manobhavānapi bahūn kāntiś-ca kādambinīṁ
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.yaḥ svāmī sarasastaṭe viharato śrīsvāmin: yaḥ svāmī sarasas-taṭe viharato śrī-svāmi-nāmnaḥ sadā
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.yaḥ śatrūn hanayan nijānavati ca śrībhūv: yaḥ śatrūn hanayan nijān-avati ca śrī-bhūvarāhātmakaḥ
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.tebhyo yaḥ pradadādvarān bahuvidhān lakṣ: tebhyo yaḥ pradadād-varān bahuvidhān lakṣmī-nivāso vibhuḥ
venkateswara/11_venkatesha_mangalashtaka.yo devo bhuvi vartate kaliyuge vaikuṇṭha: yo devo bhuvi vartate kali-yuge vaikuṇṭha-loka-sthito

venkateswara/13_venkatesha_dvadasanama_s.asya śrī veṅkaṭeśa dvādaśanāma stotra ma: asya śrī veṅkaṭeśa dvādaśa-nāma stotra mahā-mantrasya brahmā ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ śrī veṅkaṭeśvaro devatā iṣṭārthe viniyogaḥ |

venkateswara/14_srinivasa_stuti_skanda_p.iti śrīskāndapurāṇe veṅkaṭācalamāhātmye: iti śrī-skānda-purāṇe veṅkaṭācala-māhātmye trayoviṁśo'dhyāye padmanābhākhya-dvija kṛta śrīnivāsa stutiḥ |

venkateswara/15_venkateswara_saranagati_.kalau sa veṅkaṭeśākhyaḥ śaraṇaṁ me ramāp: kalau sa veṅkaṭeśākhyaḥ śaraṇaṁ me ramā-patiḥ ||

venkateswara/17_thondaman_srinivasa_stut.anena stavarājena māmarcanti ca ye janāḥ: anena stava-rājena mām-arcanti ca ye janāḥ ||

venkateswara/19_venkateswara_dvadasa_man.yaḥ paṭhet satataṁ bhaktyā tasya muktiḥ: yaḥ paṭhet satataṁ bhaktyā tasya muktiḥ kare-sthitā ||

venkateswara/21_venkatesha_ashtottarasha.jaladharanibhakāntiṁ śrīmahībhyāṁ sameta: jaladhara-nibha-kāntiṁ śrī-mahībhyāṁ sametaṁ parama-puruṣam-ādyaṁ veṅkaṭeśaṁ namāmi ||
venkateswara/21_venkatesha_ashtottarasha.iti pṛṣṭastadā sūto dhyātvā svātmani tat: iti pṛṣṭas-tadā sūto dhyātvā svātmani tatkṣaṇāt |
venkateswara/21_venkatesha_ashtottarasha.durmedhaḥ prāṇahartre ca śrīdharāya namo: durmedhaḥ prāṇa-hartre ca śrīdharāya namo namaḥ |

vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.tatsaviturityasya viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savit: tat-savitur-ity-asya viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.āpohiṣṭheti tisṛṇām, sindhudvīpa ṛṣiḥ, ā: āpohiṣṭheti tisṛṇām, sindhu-dvīpa ṛṣiḥ, āpo devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, mārjane viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.oṁ sūryaśca mā manyuśca manyupatayaśca m: oṁ sūryaś-ca mā manyuś-ca manyu-patayaś-ca manyu-kṛtebhyaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.āpaḥ punantviti mantrasya, nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ: āpaḥ punantv-iti mantrasya, nārāyaṇa ṛṣiḥ, āpo devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, udaka prāśane viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.āpo hiṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātan: āpo hiṣṭhā mayo-bhuvas-tā na ūrje dadhātana |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.yo vaśśivatamo rasastasya bhājayate ha n: yo vaś-śivatamo rasas-tasya bhājayate ha naḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.tatsaviturityasya, viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savi: tat-savitur-ity-asya, viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, arghya-pradāne viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.śrī padminī uṣā saujñā chāyā sameta śrī: śrī padminī uṣā saujñā chāyā sameta śrī sūrya-nārāyaṇa parabrahmaṇe namaḥ | idam-arghyaṁ samarpayāmi |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.uṣasta ityasya mantrasya, gautama ṛṣiḥ,: uṣasta ity-asya mantrasya, gautama ṛṣiḥ, uṣo devatā, uṣṇik-chandaḥ, prāyaścittārghya pradāne viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.ākṛṣṇenetyasya mantrasya, hiraṇya stūpa: ākṛṣṇenety-asya mantrasya, hiraṇya stūpa ṛṣiḥ, sūryo devatā, triṣṭup-chandaḥ, prāyaścittārghya pradāne viniyogaḥ ||
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.ārātrītyasya mantrasya, kaśipā bharadvāj: ārātrīty-asya mantrasya, kaśipā bharadvāja duhitā ṛṣiḥ, rātrir-devatā, pathbhyā bṛhatī chandaḥ, prāyaścitārghya pradāne viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.sarasvatyā, vaśiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ, viṣṇurdevatā: sarasvatyā, vaśiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ, viṣṇur-devatā jagatī chandaḥ, sāyaṁ sandhyā tarpaṇe viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.ādityāstvā chṛndantu jāgatena chandasājg: ādityās-tvā chṛndantu jāgatena chandasājgirasva dviśvetvā devāvaiśvānarā āchṛndantv-ānuṣṭubhena chandasājgirasvat ||
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.udvayamudityamitidvayo, praskaṇva ṛṣiḥ,: udvayamudityamitidvayo, praskaṇva ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, prathamasyānuṣṭup-chandaḥ, dvitīyasya gāyatrī chandaḥ,
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.gāyatryasyekapadī dvipadī tripadī catuṣp: gāyatry-asy-ekapadī dvipadī tripadī catuṣpadya padasi na hi padyase |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.mādhyāhnika sandhyā, sāvitrī nāmā, śveta: mādhyāhnika sandhyā, sāvitrī nāmā, śveta-varṇā, vṛṣabha vāhanā, rudra-hṛdayā, yavvana rūpā, gārhapatyāgni-rūpa-sthānā, antarikṣāyatanā, svapnavad-dhṛtiḥ, mādhyāhnika savane yajurvede viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.sāyaṁ sandhyā, sarasvatī nāmā, kṛṣṇavarṇ: sāyaṁ sandhyā, sarasvatī nāmā, kṛṣṇa-varṇā, garuḍa vāhanā, viṣṇu hṛdayā, vṛddha-rūpā, dakṣiṇāgni-rūpa-sthānā, dyaur-āyatanā, suṣuptivad-dhṛtiḥ, sāyaṁ-savane sāmavede viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.asya śrī gāyatrī mahāmantrasya, viśvāmit: asya śrī gāyatrī mahā-mantrasya, viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ, mama japopasaṁhāre viniyogaḥ |
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.devā gātu vida ityasya mantrasya, manasa: devā gātu vida ity-asya mantrasya, manasaspata ṛṣiḥ, vāto devatā, virāṭ chandaḥ, japa-nivedane viniyogaḥ||
vidhi/kanva/01_shukla_yajurveda_sandhyav.sāyaṁ sandhyāṅga bhūtena gāyatryāstu jap: sāyaṁ sandhyāṅga bhūtena gāyatryās-tu japena ca |

vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ pavitre stho vaiṣṇavyau saviturvaḥ pr: oṁ pavitre stho vaiṣṇavyau savitur-vaḥ prasava utpunāmy-acchidreṇa pavitreṇa sūryasya raśmibhiḥ |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.tasya te pavitrapate pavitrapūtasya yatk: tasya te pavitra-pate pavitra-pūtasya yat-kāmaḥ pune tacchakeyam ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ yajñopavītaṁ paramaṁ pavitraṁ prajāpa: oṁ yajñopavītaṁ paramaṁ pavitraṁ prajāpater-yat-sahajaṁ purastāt |
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.āyuṣyamagryaṁ pratimuñca śubhraṁ yajñopa: āyuṣyam-agryaṁ pratimuñca śubhraṁ yajñopavītaṁ balam-astu tejaḥ ||
vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.oṁ agniriti bhasma vāyuriti bhasma jalam: oṁ agnir-iti bhasma vāyur-iti bhasma jalam-iti bhasma sthalam-iti bhasma vyometi bhasma sarvaṁ ha vā idaṁ bhasma mana etāni cakṣūṁṣi bhasma |

vidhi/madhyandina/01_sandhyopasana_vidhi.ṛtaṁ ceti tryṛcasya mādhucchandaso'ghama: ṛtaṁ ceti tryṛcasya mādhucchandaso'ghamarṣaṇa ṛṣir-anuṣṭup chando bhāvavṛttaṁ daivatam-apām-upasparśane viniyogaḥ |

vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ tacchaṁ yorāvṛṇīmahe | gātuṁ yajñāya: oṁ tacchaṁ yor-āvṛṇīmahe | gātuṁ yajñāya | gātuṁ yajña-pataye |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.daivīḥ svastirastu naḥ | svastirmānuṣebh: daivīḥ svastir-astu naḥ | svastir-mānuṣebhyaḥ | ūrdhvaṁ jigātu bheṣajam |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ namo brahmaṇe namo'stvagnaye namaḥ pṛ: oṁ namo brahmaṇe namo'stv-agnaye namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ namaḥ prācyai diśe yāśca devatā etasy: oṁ namaḥ prācyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ namo dakṣiṇāyai diśe yāśca devatā eta: oṁ namo dakṣiṇāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ namaḥ pratīcyai diśe yāśca devatā eta: oṁ namaḥ pratīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ nama udīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyā: oṁ nama udīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ nama ūrdhvāyai diśe yāśca devatā etas: oṁ nama ūrdhvāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ namo'dharāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasy: oṁ namo'dharāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.oṁ namo'vāntarāyai diśe yāśca devatā eta: oṁ namo'vāntarāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ ||
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.namo gaṅgāyamunayormadhye ye vasanti te: namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-madhye ye vasanti te me prasannātmānaś-cirañjīvitaṁ vardhayanti |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.namo gaṅgāyamunayormunibhyaśca namo namo: namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-munibhyaś-ca namo namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-munibhyaś-ca namaḥ |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.yāṁ sadā sarvabhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi: yāṁ sadā sarva-bhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca | sāyaṁ prātar-namasyanti sāmā sandhyā'bhirakṣatu ||
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.stuto mayā varadā vedamātā pracodayantī: stuto mayā varadā veda-mātā pracodayantī pavane dvijātā |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.āyuḥ pṛthivyāṁ draviṇaṁ brahmavarcasaṁ m: āyuḥ pṛthivyāṁ draviṇaṁ brahmavarcasaṁ mahyaṁ datvā prayātuṁ brahma-lokam ||
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.namo'stvanantāya sahasra mūrtaye sahasra: namo'stv-anantāya sahasra mūrtaye sahasra pādākṣi śiroru bāhave |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasra ko: sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasra koṭī yuga-dhāriṇe namaḥ ||
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.idaṁ dyāvā pṛthivī satyamastu | pitarmāt: idaṁ dyāvā pṛthivī satyam-astu | pitar-mātar-yad-ihopabruve vām |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.bhūtaṁ devānāmavame avobhiḥ | vidyāmeṣaṁ: bhūtaṁ devānām-avame avobhiḥ | vidyāmeṣaṁ vṛjinaṁ jīradānum |
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.___ pravarānvita ___ sa gotraḥ āśvalāyan: ___ pravarānvita ___ sa gotraḥ āśvalāyana-sūtraḥ ṛk śākhādhyāyī ___ śarmā'haṁ bho abhivādaye ||
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.yatkṛtaṁ tu mayādeva paripūrṇaṁ tadastu: yat-kṛtaṁ tu mayādeva paripūrṇaṁ tad-astu te ||
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.ye santi brāhmaṇā devāstebhyo nityaṁ nam: ye santi brāhmaṇā devās-tebhyo nityaṁ namo namaḥ ||
vidhi/rigveda/01_rigveda_sandhyavandanam.kāyena vācā manasendriyairvā buddhyātman: kāyena vācā manasendriyair-vā buddhyātmanā vā prakṛteḥ svabhāvāt |

vidhi/samanya/03_bhasma_dharana_vidhi.tx.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭhāyāṁ: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭhāyāṁ śubha-tithau mama śarīra rakṣaṇa siddhy-arthaṁ bhūta preta piśāca rākṣasa gaṇa ariṣṭa saṁhārārthaṁ, jñāna aiśvaryatā prāpty-arthaṁ lalāṭe kuṁkuma sahita bhasma tripuṁḍra dhāraṇaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/samanya/03_bhasma_dharana_vidhi.tx.dakṣiṇa hastena bhasmamādāya, vāma haste: dakṣiṇa hastena bhasmamādāya, vāma haste nikṣipya, jalaṁ saṁprokṣya, hasta-dvayam-ācchādya, dakṣiṇa-hastānāmikayā vāma-hastopari ṣaṭkoṇaṁ likhitvā, ṣaṭkoṇa madhye oṁkāraḥ aṁ āṁ iṁ īṁ uṁ ūṁ sauṁ, ṣaṭkoṇeṣu oṁ namaḥ śivāya iti ṣaḍbījān likhitvā ||
vidhi/samanya/03_bhasma_dharana_vidhi.tx.lalāṭe, mūrdhni, hṛdaye, udare, bāhvoḥ,: lalāṭe, mūrdhni, hṛdaye, udare, bāhvoḥ, pārśvayoḥ, kaṁṭhau ity-ādayaḥ dhāraṇaṁ kariṣye | hasta-dvayaṁ prakṣāḻya | prakṣāḻana jalaṁ kiṁcit pītvā |
vidhi/samanya/03_bhasma_dharana_vidhi.tx.sarvajanavaśīkaraṇa siddhyarthaṁ dṛṣṭido: sarva-jana-vaśīkaraṇa siddhy-arthaṁ dṛṣṭi-doṣa-pīḍā-parihārārthaṁ lalāṭe kuṁkuma dhāraṇaṁ kariṣye |

vidhi/samanya/04_karthika_snana_vidhi.tx.gaṁgāvālukābhi saptarṣimaṁḍalaparyaṁtaṁ: gaṁgā-vālukābhi saptarṣi-maṁḍala-paryaṁtaṁ kṛtavārāśeḥ pauṁḍarīkāśvamedhādi samasta kratu phalāvāpty-arthaṁ, iha janmani janmāṁtare ca bālya kaumāra yauvana vārdhakeṣu, jāgrat svapna suṣupty-avasthāsu jñānato'jñānataś-ca kāmato'kāmataḥ svataḥ preraṇayā saṁbhāvitānāṁ sarveṣāṁ pāpānām-apanodanārthaṁ dharmārtha-kāma-mokṣa catur-vidha puruṣārtha siddhy-arthaṁ, kṣema sthairya vijayāyur-ārogya aiśvaryādīnāṁ uttarottarābhivṛddhy-arthaṁ śrī śiva-keśavānugraha siddhy-arthaṁ varṣe varṣe prayukta kārtīkamāse ____ vāsara yuktānāṁ ____ tithau śrīmān (śrīmataḥ) ____ gotrābhijātaḥ ____ nāmadheyo'haṁ pavitra kārtīka prātaḥ snānaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/samanya/04_karthika_snana_vidhi.tx.aṁba tvaddarśanānmuktiḥ na jāne snānajaṁ: aṁba tvad-darśanān-muktiḥ na jāne snānajaṁ phalam |
vidhi/samanya/04_karthika_snana_vidhi.tx.gaṁgā gaṁgeti yo brūyāt yojanānāṁ śatair: gaṁgā gaṁgeti yo brūyāt yojanānāṁ śatair-api |
vidhi/samanya/04_karthika_snana_vidhi.tx.mucyate sarva pāpābhyo viṣṇulokaṁ sa gac: mucyate sarva pāpābhyo viṣṇu-lokaṁ sa gacchati ||

vidhi/samanya/05_nadi_snana_sankalpa_gan.oṁ adya brahmaṇo'hni dvitīyaparārdhe śrī: oṁ adya brahmaṇo'hni dvitīya-parārdhe śrī-śvetavārāha-kalpe vaivasvata-manvantare'ṣṭāviṁśatitame kali-yuge kali-prathama-caraṇe bauddhāvatāre bhūr-loke jambūdvīpe bharata-khaṇḍe bhārata-varṣe ......kṣetre ......nagare ......grāme ......nāma-saṁvatsare ......māse ......pakṣe ......tithau ......vāsare ......gotraḥ ......śarmāham prātaḥ sarva-karmasu śuddhy-arthaṁ śruti-smṛti-purāṇokta-phala-prāpty-arthaṁ śrī-bhagavat-prīty-arthaṁ ca prātaḥ-snānaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/samanya/05_nadi_snana_sankalpa_gan.mṛttike hara me pāpaṁ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṁ k: mṛttike hara me pāpaṁ yan-mayā duṣkṛtaṁ kṛtam ||

vidhi/samanya/06_tungabhadra_pushkara_sn.mama upātta duritakṣayadvārā śubhe śobha: mama upātta durita-kṣaya-dvārā śubhe śobhane muhūrte śrī mahāviṣṇor-ājñayā pravartamānasya adya brahmaṇaḥ dvitīya parārdhe śveta varāha kalpe vaivasvata manvaṁtare kali-yuge prathama-pāde jaṁbūdvīpe bharata-varṣe bharata-khaṁḍe meroḥ dakṣiṇa dig-bhāge śrīśailasya nairṛti pradeśe kṛṣṇā-kāveryoḥ madhya-deśe tuṁgabhadrāpuṣkara nadī tīre asmin vartamāna vyāvahārika cāṁdramānena ……nāma saṁvatsare ……ayane ……ṛtau ……māse ……pakṣe ……tithau ……vāsare śubha-nakṣatre śubha-yoge śubha-karaṇe evaṁ-guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau śrīmān ……gotraḥ ……nāmadheyaḥ mama saha-kuṭuṁbasya kṣema-sthairya vijaya abhaya āyur-ārogya aiśvaryābhivṛddhy-arthaṁ dharmārtha kāma-mokṣa catur-vidha puruṣārtha phala-siddhy-arthaṁ mṛgāgate deva-gurau sārdha-trikoṭi tīrtha puṣkara prayukta tuṁgabhadrānadī prīty-arthaṁ asmin śubha-dine mama anādy-avidyā vāsanayā pravartamāne vicitrābhiḥ karma-gatibhiḥ vicitrāsu yoniṣu punaḥ punar-anekadhā janitvā kenavā karma viśeṣeṇa idānīṁ ……gotrodbhavasya ……nāmadheyasya mama janma-prabhṛti etat-kṣaṇa paryaṁtaṁ bālya yauvana kaumāra vārdhakeṣu mano-vāk-kāya karmeṁdriya vyāpāraiḥ saṁbhāvitānāṁ pāpānāṁ tvak-cakṣuḥ śrotra-jihvā-ghrāṇānāṁ paṁcānāṁ jñāneṁdriyāṇāṁ vāk-pāṇi-pāda pāyūpasthānāṁ paṁcānāṁ karmeṁdriyāṇāṁ eteṣāṁ prerakasya aṁtaḥkaraṇasya manasaśca svasya gocaraiḥ prākṛtaiḥ kāma krodha lobha moha mada mātsaryaiḥ saṁjanita sakala doṣa-nivṛtty-arthaṁ |
vidhi/samanya/06_tungabhadra_pushkara_sn.iha janmani pūrvajanmani brahmahatyādi p: iha janmani pūrva-janmani brahma-hatyādi pāpānāṁ guru-talpakādi pāpānāṁ svarṇa-steya surā-pānādi pāpānāṁ dvija-patnī guru-patnī rāja-patnī para-patnī gamanādi doṣāṇāṁ deva-brāhmaṇa tiraskāra guru-tiraskāra para-strī-tiraskāra veda-śāstra tiraskāra patnī tiraskāra ātma-tiraskārādi doṣāṇāṁ deva-brāhmaṇa vṛtticchedana taṭākacchedana ātma-hatyādi pāpānāṁ mitra-dravyāpaharaṇa jñāti-dravyāpaharaṇa para-dravyāpaharaṇādi doṣāṇāṁ niṣiddhānna patitānna gaṇānna gaṇikānna duranna durjanānna mlecchānna ucchiṣṭādy-annādi bhakṣaṇādi doṣāṇāṁ nirhetuka bhāryā-visarjana mātā-pitṛ-visarjana mitra-visarjana putrādi visarjanādi doṣāṇāṁ brāhmaṇa-doṣa nirūpaṇa bhāryā-doṣa nirūpaṇa para-strī doṣa-nirūpaṇādi doṣāṇāṁ mama caṁḍāla sparśana para-strī sparśana para-vastra sparśana rajasvala strī sparśanādi doṣāṇāṁ ajñāna-kṛta doṣāṇāṁ kāyika vācika mānasika doṣāṇāṁ bahūnāṁ bahuvidhānāṁ sarveṣāṁ pāpānāṁ apanodanārthaṁ mṛgāgate deva-gurau sārdha-trikoṭi tīrtha puṣkara prayukta tuṁgabhadrā mahā-puṇya-nadī snānam-ahaṁ kariṣye || iti saṁkalpya |
vidhi/samanya/06_tungabhadra_pushkara_sn.pativaṁcanākaraṇa patiniṁdākaraṇa svabha: pati-vaṁcanā-karaṇa pati-niṁdā-karaṇa sva-bhartṛ-tāḍana dūṣaṇa tarjana svāpa-kāle bhartṛ-tāḍana bhartṛ-vaṁcana rūpāṇāṁ guru-vākyākaraṇa niṁdā-karaṇa rūpāṇāṁ para-devatā dūṣaṇa strī-doṣāropaṇa mānasa para-puruṣa samāgamana rūpāṇāṁ kāma-rūpāṇāṁ asnāna bhojana abhakṣya bhakṣaṇa atyaṁta bhāṣaṇa rūpāṇāṁ āraṁbha vrata tyāga nirnimitta tulasīdaḻa nikṛṁtana sadā durbhāṣaṇa durālāpana divāpuruṣa saṁsarga rūpāṇāṁ sālagrāma-sparśana brāhmaṇa-dūṣaṇa suta-vikraya go-vikraya kanyā-vikraya deha-vikraya malina vastra-dhāraṇa grahaṇa samaye puruṣa saṁsarga rajasvalādi sūtaka-madhye dravya-sparśana gṛha-bhāṁḍādi sparśana mitra-droha anṛta-saṁbhāṣaṇa kaṭhina svabhāva bhojana samaye viṣa-prayogādi pāpānāṁ deva-brāhmaṇa tiraskāra pitṛ-mātṛ tiraskāra śiśu stanya-pāna rāhitya śiśu-vadha go-vadha paṁkti-drohādi pāpānāṁ bhartṛ-pṛcchā paribhāṣaṇa upavāsākaraṇa upoṣite bhartari svayaṁ-bhojana bhartṛ-śuśrūṣā rāhitya tad-abhivādana rāhitya gṛhe vidyamāna dravya cora svagṛhastha dravya vikraya sadā anya-gṛha-vāsa bhartari doṣāropaṇa bhartur-apahāsa saṁbhāṣaṇa bhartṛ-vacana nirākaraṇa deśāṁtara-gate dehālaṁkaraṇa para-puruṣa sparśādi saṁbhāvitānāṁ pāpānāṁ ajñānato jñānataś-ca atyaṁta abhyastānāṁ svārtha-kriyā-paratva hīnānya puruṣa saṁyogādīnāṁ bahūnāṁ bahuvidhānāṁ sarveṣāṁ pāpānāṁ apanodanārthaṁ mṛgāgate deva-gurau sārdha-trikoṭi tīrtha puṣkara prayukta tuṁgabhadrā mahā-puṇya-nadī snānam-ahaṁ kariṣye || iti saṁkalpya |

vidhi/samanya/07_magha_snana_vidhi.txt.pāpaṁ nāśaya me deva vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ k: pāpaṁ nāśaya me deva vāṅ-manaḥ-karmabhiḥ kṛtam ||

vidhi/samanya/08_vaisakha_snana_vidhi.tx.prātaḥsnānena me tasmin phaladaḥ pāpahā: prātaḥ-snānena me tasmin phaladaḥ pāpahā bhava ||

vidhi/samanya/09_snana_bheda_bhasma_goma.māntraṁ bhaumaṁ tathāgneyaṁ vāyavyaṁ div: māntraṁ bhaumaṁ tathāgneyaṁ vāyavyaṁ divyam-eva ca |
vidhi/samanya/09_snana_bheda_bhasma_goma.āgneyaṁ bhasmanā snānaṁ vāyavyaṁ gorajaḥ: āgneyaṁ bhasmanā snānaṁ vāyavyaṁ go-rajaḥ smṛtam ||
vidhi/samanya/09_snana_bheda_bhasma_goma.mṛttike hara me pāpaṁ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṁ k: mṛttike hara me pāpaṁ yan-mayā duṣkṛtaṁ kṛtam ||

vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.pavitraṁte vitataṁ brahmaṇaspate | prabh: pavitraṁte vitataṁ brahmaṇaspate | prabhur-gātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ |
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.mṛgāgate devagurau sārdhatrikoṭi tīrtha: mṛgāgate deva-gurau sārdha-trikoṭi tīrtha puṣkara prayukta tuṁgabhadrā puṇya-nadī tīre - asmat-pitṝṇāṁ akṣaya puṇya-loka phalāvāpty-arthaṁ, asmat-pitṝn-uddiśya, asmat-pitṝṇāṁ prīty-arthaṁ tīrtha śrāddha kāle tila tarpaṇaṁ (savyaṁ) kariṣye | kāle adhikāra siddhy-arthaṁ yathā saṁbhavat-prāyaścittaṁ kariṣye | darbhākṣatais-saha yathāśakti pariṣaddakṣiṇāṁ gṛhītvā ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.samasta saṁpatsamavāpya hetavaḥ samutthi: samasta saṁpat-samavāpya hetavaḥ samutthitā patkuladhūma ketavaḥ |
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.apāra saṁsāra samudrahetavaḥ punaṁtumāṁ: apāra saṁsāra samudra-hetavaḥ punaṁtumāṁ brāhmaṇa pāda-pāṁsavaḥ ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.samasta tīrthāṁbu pavitramūrtayaḥ rakṣaṁ: samasta tīrthāṁbu pavitra-mūrtayaḥ rakṣaṁtumāṁ brāhmaṇa pāda-pāṁsavaḥ ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.śrī puṣṭi kīrtidaṁ vaṁde vipraśrī pāda p: śrī puṣṭi kīrti-daṁ vaṁde vipra-śrī pāda paṁkajaṁ ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.asmatpitrādīnāṁ akṣaya puṇyalokā vāptyar: asmat-pitrādīnāṁ akṣaya puṇya-lokā vāptyarthaṁ tila tarpaṇaṁ kartuṁ mukhya-kālo bhūtvā adhikāra saṁpad-astīti bhavaṁto bruvaṁtu ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.kartuṁ adhikāra saṁpadastu || kṛcchra tr: kartuṁ adhikāra saṁpad-astu || kṛcchra trayāṇi dadyāt | prācīnāvīti ||
vidhi/samanya/10_pushkara_pitru_tarpanam.1. asmat pitaraṁ .. gotraṁ ... śarmaṇaṁ: 1. asmat pitaraṁ .. gotraṁ ... śarmaṇaṁ ... svadhā namas-tarpayāmi ||

vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.oṁ tatsaviturvareṇyam | bhargo devasya d: oṁ tat-savitur-vareṇyam | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yonaḥ pracodayāt ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.mama upātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śr: mama upātta samasta durita-kṣaya dvārā śrī-parameśvaram-uddiśya śrī-parameśvara prīty-arthaṁ śubhābhyāṁ śubhe śobhane muhūrte śrī mahāviṣṇor-ājñayā pravartamānasya adya brahmaṇaḥ dvitīya parārthe śveta-varāha-kalpe vaivasvata manvaṁtare kali-yuge prathama-pāde jaṁbūdvīpe bharata-varṣe bharata-khaṁḍe meroḥ dakṣiṇa dig-bhāge śrīśailasya …… pradeśe ……, …… nadyoḥ madhya pradeśe śobhana gṛhe samasta devatā brāhmaṇa ācārya harihara guru caraṇa sannidhau asmin vartamāna vyāvahārika cāṁdramānena śrī …… nāma saṁvatsare …… ayane …… ṛtau …… māse …… pakṣe …… tithau …… vāsare …… nakṣatre …… yoge …… karaṇa evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubhāyāṁ śubha-tithau śrīmān …… gotraḥ …… nāmadheyaḥ (śrīmataḥ …… gotrasya …… nāmadheyasya dharmapatnīsametasya) śrī parameśvara prīty-arthaṁ prātaḥ / mādhyāhnika / sāyaṁ saṁdhyāṁ upāsiṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.āpo hiṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātan: āpo hiṣṭhā mayo-bhuvas-tā na ūrje dadhātana | maheraṇāya cakṣase |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayate ha: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasas-tasya bhājayate ha naḥ | uśatīr-iva mātaraḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.idamahaṁ māmamṛtayonau | sūrye jyotiṣi j: idam-ahaṁ mām-amṛta-yonau | sūrye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.sarvaṁ punantu māmāpo'satāṁ ca pratigrah: sarvaṁ punantu mām-āpo'satāṁ ca pratigrahagṁ svāhā ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.idamahaṁ māmamṛtayonau | satye jyotiṣi j: idam-ahaṁ mām-amṛta-yonau | satye jyotiṣi juhomi svāhā |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.dadhikrāvṇo'kāriṣaṁ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājina: dadhikrāvṇo'kāriṣaṁ jiṣṇor-aśvasya vājinaḥ | surabhi no mukhā karatprāṇa āyūṁṣi tāriṣat ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ: hiraṇya-varṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā yāsu jātaḥ kaśyapo yāsvindraḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yāsāṁ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte: yāsāṁ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañ-janānām |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.madhuścutaśśucayo yāḥ pāvakāstā na āpaśś: madhu-ścutaś-śucayo yāḥ pāvakās-tā na āpaśśagṁ syonā bhavantu ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yāḥ pṛthivīṁ payasondanti śukrāstā na āp: yāḥ pṛthivīṁ payasondanti śukrās-tā na āpaśśagṁ syonā bhavantu ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaśśivayā tanuv: śivena mā cakṣuṣā paśyatāpaś-śivayā tanuvopa spṛśata tvacaṁ me |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.sarvāgṁ agnīgṁ rapsuṣado huve vo mayi va: sarvāgṁ agnīgṁ rapsuṣado huve vo mayi varco balam-ojo nidhatta ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau (mukhya kālātikramaṇa doṣa nivṛtty-arthaṁ prāyaścittārghya-pradānaṁ kariṣye) ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.oṁ bhūḥ | oṁ bhuvaḥ | ogṁ suvaḥ | oṁ tat: oṁ bhūḥ | oṁ bhuvaḥ | ogṁ suvaḥ | oṁ tat-savitur-vareṇyam | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yonaḥ pracodayāt ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.udyantamastaṁ yantamādityamabhidhyāyanku: udyantam-astaṁ yantam-ādityam-abhidhyāyan-kurvan-brāhmaṇo vidvānt-sakalaṁ bhadram-aśnute'sāv-ādityo brahmeti brahmaivasanbrahmāpyeti ya evaṁ veda ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha-tithau prātaḥ / mādhyāhnika / sāyaṁ saṁdhyāṁga tarpaṇaṁ kariṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.ojo'si saho'si balamasi bhrājo'si devānā: ojo'si saho'si balam-asi bhrājo'si devānāṁ dhāmanāmāsi viśvam-asi viśvāyuḥ sarvam-asi sarvāyur-abhibhūr-oṁ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.gāyatriyā gāyatrī chaṁdo viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ: gāyatriyā gāyatrī chaṁdo viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ savitā devatā agnir-mukhaṁ brahmāśiro viṣṇur-hṛdayagṁ rudraḥ śikhā pṛthivī yoniḥ prāṇāpāna-vyānodāna samānā saprāṇā śveta-varṇā sāṁkhyāyana sagotrā gāyatrī caturviṁśaty-akṣarā tripadā ṣaṭkukṣiḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.dvimukhaṁ trimukhaṁ caiva catuḥ paṁcamuk: dvi-mukhaṁ trimukhaṁ caiva catuḥ paṁca-mukhaṁ tathā ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.gurussākṣātparaṁ brahmā tasmai śrī gurav: gurus-sākṣāt-paraṁ brahmā tasmai śrī gurave namaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.oṁ tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ | bhargo devasya d: oṁ tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.omāpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṁ brahma bhūrbhuvaḥ: omāpo jyotī raso'mṛtaṁ brahma bhūr-bhuvaḥ suvar-om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.liṁgaṁ niryāṇa mudrā cetyaṣṭa mudrāḥ pra: liṁgaṁ niryāṇa mudrā cety-aṣṭa mudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.mitro janānyātayati prajānanmitro dādhār: mitro janān-yātayati prajānan-mitro dādhāra pṛthivī mutadyām |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.ā satyena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛ: ā satyena rajasā vartamāno niveśayann-amṛtaṁ martyaṁ ca |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.citraṁ devānā mudagā danīkaṁ cakṣurmitra: citraṁ devānā mudagā danīkaṁ cakṣur-mitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.ā prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣagṁ sūrya ātm: ā prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣagṁ sūrya ātmā jagatas-tasthuṣaś-ca ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.paśyema śaradaśśataṁ jīvema śaradaśśataṁ: paśyema śaradaś-śataṁ jīvema śaradaś-śataṁ | nandāma śaradaś-śataṁ modāma śaradaś-śataṁ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.imaṁ me varuṇa śrudhī hava madyā ca mṛḍa: imaṁ me varuṇa śrudhī hava madyā ca mṛḍaya | tvām-avasyu rācake |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāst: tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānas-tadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.āheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṁsa mā na ā: āheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhy-uruśaṁsa mā na āyuḥ pramoṣīḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yacciddhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa: yac-ciddhi te viśo yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam | minīmasidyavidyavi |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yatkiñcedaṁ varuṇa daivye jane'bhi droha: yat-kiñcedaṁ varuṇa daivye jane'bhi drohaṁ manuṣyāś-carāmasi |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.oṁ namaḥ prācyai diśe yāśca devatā etasy: oṁ namaḥ prācyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo dakṣiṇāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyā: namo dakṣiṇāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namaḥ pratīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyā: namaḥ pratīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.nama udīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ p: nama udīcyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.nama ūrdhvāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ: nama ūrdhvāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo'dharāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ: namo'dharāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namo |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo'vāntarāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyā: namo'vāntarāyai diśe yāśca devatā etasyāṁ prativasantye tābhyaś-ca namaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo gaṅgāyamunayormadhye ye vasanti te: namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-madhye ye vasanti te me prasannātmānaś-cirañjīvitaṁ vardhayanti |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo gaṅgāyamunayormunibhyaśca namo namo: namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-munibhyaś-ca namo namo gaṅgā-yamunayor-munibhyaś-ca namaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.pṛthivyāpastejo vāyurākāśāt | oṁ namo bh: pṛthivy-āpas-tejo vāyur-ākāśāt | oṁ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.yathā'ntaraṁ na paśyāmi tathā me svastir: yathā'ntaraṁ na paśyāmi tathā me svastir-āyuṣi ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.namo brahmaṇya devāya gobrāhmaṇa hitāya: namo brahmaṇya devāya go-brāhmaṇa hitāya ca |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.stuto mayā varadā vedamātā pracodayantī: stuto mayā varadā veda-mātā pracodayantī pavane dvijātā |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.āyuḥ pṛthivyāṁ draviṇaṁ brahmavarcasaṁ m: āyuḥ pṛthivyāṁ draviṇaṁ brahmavarcasaṁ mahyaṁ datvā prajātuṁ brahma-lokam ||
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.kāyena vācā manaseṁdriyairvā buddhyā''tm: kāyena vācā manaseṁdriyair-vā buddhyā''tmanā vā prakṛteḥ svabhāvāt |
vidhi/taittiriya/01_krishna_yajurveda_sa.ye santi brāhmaṇā devāstebhyo nityaṁ nam: ye santi brāhmaṇā devās-tebhyo nityaṁ namo namaḥ ||

vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ ś: pūrvokta evaṁ guṇa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāṁ śubha tithau śrī-parameśvaram-uddiśya śrī-parameśvara prīty-arthaṁ śrīmān …… sagotraḥ …… nāmadheyo'haṁ catur-veda pārāyaṇa phala-siddhy-arthaṁ nitya svādhyāya brahma-yajñena yakṣye ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.hastāvavanijya | trirācāmet | dviḥ parim: hastāvavanijya | trir-ācāmet | dviḥ parimṛjya | sakṛd-upaspṛśya | yat-savyaṁ pāṇiṁ pādau prokṣati | śiraś-cakṣuṣī nāsike śrotre hṛdayam-ālabhya || apa upaspṛśya |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.yastanna veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya ittadv: yas-tan-na veda kimṛcā kariṣyati ya ittadvidusta ime samāsate ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ bhūḥ – tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ bhargo deva: oṁ bhūḥ – tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ suvaḥ – tatsaviturvareṇyaṁ bhargo dev: oṁ suvaḥ – tat-savitur-vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ iṣe tvorje tvā vāyavassthopāyavasstha: oṁ iṣe tvorje tvā vāyavassthopāyavasstha devo vas-savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇa ā pyāyadhvamaghniyā deva-bhāgam-ūrjasvatīḥ payasvatīḥ prajāvatīr-anamīvā ayakṣmāḥ mā vasstena īśata mā'ghaśagṁso rudrasya hetiḥ pari vo vṛṇaktu dhruvā asmin gopatau syāta bahvīr-yajamānasya paśūn pāhi || hariḥ om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ brahma saṁdhattaṁ tanme jinvatam | kṣ: oṁ brahma saṁdhattaṁ tanme jinvatam | kṣattragṁ saṁdhattaṁ tanme jinvatam | iṣagṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | ūrjagṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | rayigṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | puṣṭigṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | prajāgṁ saṁdhattaṁ tāṁ me jinvatam | paśūnthsaṁdhattaṁ tānme jinvatam | stuto'si janadhāḥ | devās-tvā śukrapāḥ praṇayantu || suvīrāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan-parīhi || hariḥ om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ namo brahmaṇe dhāraṇaṁ me astvanirāka: oṁ namo brahmaṇe dhāraṇaṁ me astv-anirākaraṇaṁ dhārayitā bhūyāsaṁ karṇayoś-śrutaṁ mā cyoḍhvaṁ mamāmuṣya om ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.ṛtaṁ tapassatyaṁ tapaśśrutaṁ tapaśśāntaṁ: ṛtaṁ tapas-satyaṁ tapaś-śrutaṁ tapaś-śāntaṁ tapo damas-tapaś-śamas-tapo dānaṁ tapo yajñaṁ tapo bhūr-bhuvas-suvar-brahmaitad-upāsyaitat-tapaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.yathā vṛkṣasya saṁpuṣpitasya dūrādgandho: yathā vṛkṣasya saṁpuṣpitasya dūrād-gandho vāty-evaṁ puṇyasya karmaṇo dūrād-gandho vāti yathā'si-dhārāṁ karte'vahitāmavakrāme yadyuve yuve havā vihvayiṣyāmi kartaṁ patiṣyāmīty-evam-amṛtād-ātmānaṁ jugupset || ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.ahaṁ vṛkṣasya rerivā | kīrtiḥ pṛṣṭhaṁ gi: ahaṁ vṛkṣasya rerivā | kīrtiḥ pṛṣṭhaṁ gireriva | ūrdhva-pavitro vājinīva svamṛtam-asmi | draviṇagṁ savarcasam | sumedhā amṛtokṣitaḥ | iti triśaṅkor-vedānuvacanam ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye: oṁ agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havya-dātaye | ni hotā sathsi barhiṣi ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ śaṁ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pī: oṁ śaṁ no devīr-abhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.gauḥ, gmā, jmā, kṣmā, kṣā, kṣaumā, kṣoṇī: gauḥ, gmā, jmā, kṣmā, kṣā, kṣaumā, kṣoṇī, kṣitiḥ, avaniḥ, urvī, pṛthvī, mahī, aditiḥ, ripaḥ, iḻā, nirṛtiḥ, mā, bhūmiḥ, pūṣā, gātuḥ, gotrā – ity-ekaviṁśatiḥ pṛthvī-nāmāni ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ samāmnāyaḥ samāmnātaḥ sa vyākhyātavya: oṁ samāmnāyaḥ samāmnātaḥ sa vyākhyātavyas-tam-imaṁ samāmnāyaṁ nighaṁṭava ity-ācakṣate |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.athāto brahmajijñāsā | janmādyasya yataḥ: athāto brahma-jijñāsā | janmādy-asya yataḥ | śāstra-yonitvāt | tattu samanvayāt ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.pramāṇa prameya saṁśaya prayojana dṛṣṭān: pramāṇa prameya saṁśaya prayojana dṛṣṭānta siddhāntāvayava tarka nirṇaya vāda jalpa vitaṇḍā hetvābhāsa cchala jati nigraha sthānānāṁ tattva-jñānān-niśśreyasādhigamaḥ ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.tene brahma hṛdāya ādikavaye muhyaṁti ya: tene brahma hṛdāya ādi-kavaye muhyaṁti yat-sūrayaḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.dhāmnā svena sadā nirastakuhakaṁ satyaṁ: dhāmnā svena sadā nirasta-kuhakaṁ satyaṁ paraṁ dhīmahi ||
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ namo brahmaṇe namo astvagnaye namaḥ p: oṁ namo brahmaṇe namo astv-agnaye namaḥ pṛthivyai nama oṣadhībhyaḥ |
vidhi/taittiriya/02_brahma_yajna_vidhi.t.oṁ śāntiśśāntiśśāntiḥ | evaṁ triḥ | oṁ o: oṁ śāntiś-śāntiś-śāntiḥ | evaṁ triḥ | oṁ oṁ om ||

vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.sūtram — atha caturāśramiṇāṁ snānavidhi: sūtram — atha caturāśramiṇāṁ snāna-vidhi rabhiṣekaṁ divyaṁ vā yavyamāgneyaṁ gurv-anujñā iti paṁcadhā bhavaṁtīti | abhiṣekaṁ vāruṇaṁ avagāhana snānam-iti bhāṣye tat-prakāram-āha | ubhaya pavitra-pāṇiḥ dvir-ācamya ||

vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.maṁtraḥ idamāpaḥ pravahatā vadyaṁca mala: maṁtraḥ idam-āpaḥ pravahatā vadyaṁca malaṁcayat | yadvābhi rudrahānnṛtā yadvāśepo abhīruṇaṁ | āpo mātasmādenaso viśvānmuṁcaṁ tvagṁ hasaḥ | nirmā muṁcāmiśapathānnirmā varuṇādadhi | nirmāyamasya paḍbiśāt sarvasmāddeva kilbiṣāt | idam-āpaḥ praṇīta bheṣajaṁ tanme varuṇaṁ namaḥ ||

vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.maṁtraḥ hiraṇya śṛṁgaṁ varuṇaṁ prapadye: maṁtraḥ hiraṇya śṛṁgaṁ varuṇaṁ prapadye tīrthaṁ me dehiyācataḥ | yanmayābhukta masādhūnāṁ pāpebhyaś-ca pratigrahaḥ | yanme manasā vācā karmaṇāvā duṣkṛtaṁ kṛtam | tanna iṁdrovaruṇo bṛhaspati ssavitāca punaṁtu punaḥ punaḥ | sumitrāna āpa oṣadhayas-saṁtu durmitrā stasmai bhūyāsuryo smān dveṣṭiyaṁ cavayaṁ dviṣmaḥ | namo agnaye apsumate nama iṁdrāya namo varuṇāya namo vāruṇyai namo adbhyaḥ | yad-apāṁ krūraṁ yada medhyaṁ yad-aśāṁtaṁ tad-apagacchatāt | atyāśanādati pānādyacca ugrātprati grahāt | tanme varuṇo rājā pāṇinā hy-avamarśatu | so hamapāpo virajo-nirmukto mukta-kilbiṣaḥ | nākasya pṛṣṭha māruhyagacchedbrahma salokatām | imamme gaṁge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomagṁ sacatāparuṣṇiyā | asikniyā marudvṛdhe vitastayārjīkīye śṛṇuhyāsuṣomayā ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.maṁtraḥ āpaḥ punātu pṛthivī sarvaṁ punāt: maṁtraḥ āpaḥ punātu pṛthivī sarvaṁ punātu dharaṇī | sarva-pūtā māgṁ sarva-pāpaiḥ punātu ||
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.idaṁ snānaṁ varaṁ maṁtrāt sahasrādadhika: idaṁ snānaṁ varaṁ maṁtrāt sahasrād-adhikaṁ matam |
vidhi/taittiriya/06_vaikhanasa_samantra_.dhyātvā gaṁgāṁ hareḥ pādāt patamānāṁ sva: dhyātvā gaṁgāṁ hareḥ pādāt patamānāṁ sva-mūrdhani ||

vishnu/bhagavata/0107_asvatthama_kills_s.na bharturnātmanaścārthe yo'han suptān ś: na bhartur-nātmanaś-cārthe yo'han suptān śiśūn vṛthā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0107_asvatthama_kills_s.priyaṁ ca bhīmasenasya pāñcālyā mahyamev: priyaṁ ca bhīmasenasya pāñcālyā mahyam-eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0107_asvatthama_kills_s.eṣa hi brahmabandhūnāṁ vadho nānyo'sti d: eṣa hi brahma-bandhūnāṁ vadho nānyo'sti daihikaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0107_asvatthama_kills_s.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe drauṇi-nigraho nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/0108_protection_pariksi.ke vayaṁ nāmarūpābhyāṁ yadubhiḥ saha pāṇ: ke vayaṁ nāma-rūpābhyāṁ yadubhiḥ saha pāṇḍavāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0108_protection_pariksi.atha viśveśa viśvātman viśvamūrte svakeṣ: atha viśveśa viśvātman viśva-mūrte svakeṣu me|
vishnu/bhagavata/0108_protection_pariksi.striyaśca svapuraṁ yāsyan premṇā rājñā n: striyaś-ca sva-puraṁ yāsyan premṇā rājñā nivāritaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0108_protection_pariksi.yathā paṅkena paṅkāmbhaḥ surayā vā surāk: yathā paṅkena paṅkāmbhaḥ surayā vā surā-kṛtam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0108_protection_pariksi.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe kuntī-stutir-yudhiṣṭhirānutāpo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/0109_yudhisthira_others.tadā te bhrātaraḥ sarve sadaśvaiḥ svarṇa: tadā te bhrātaraḥ sarve sad-aśvaiḥ svarṇa-bhūṣitaiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0109_yudhisthira_others.sa tairvyarocata nṛpaḥ kubera iva guhyak: sa tair-vyarocata nṛpaḥ kubera iva guhyakaiḥ||

vishnu/bhagavata/0109_yudhisthira_others.sarvaṁ kālakṛtaṁ manye bhavatāṁ ca yadap: sarvaṁ kāla-kṛtaṁ manye bhavatāṁ ca yad-apriyam|

vishnu/bhagavata/0109_yudhisthira_others.bhaktyā''veśya mano yasmin vācā yannāma: bhaktyā''veśya mano yasmin vācā yan-nāma kīrtayan|

vishnu/bhagavata/0110_sri_krsna_departs_.sāyaṁ bheje diśaṁ paścādgaviṣṭho gāṁ gat: sāyaṁ bheje diśaṁ paścād-gaviṣṭho gāṁ gatas-tadā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0110_sri_krsna_departs_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe naimiṣīyopākhyāne śrī-kṛṣṇa-dvārakāgamanaṁ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/0111_royal_welcome_sri_.naiva tṛpyanti hi dṛśaḥ śriyo dhāmāṅgama: naiva tṛpyanti hi dṛśaḥ śriyo dhāmāṅgam-acyutam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0111_royal_welcome_sri_.śriyo nivāso yasyoraḥ pānapātraṁ mukhaṁ: śriyo nivāso yasyoraḥ pāna-pātraṁ mukhaṁ dṛśām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0111_royal_welcome_sri_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe naimiṣīyopākhyāne kṛṣṇa-dvārakā-praveśo nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11||

vishnu/bhagavata/0112_birth_pariksit.txt.tasya janma mahābuddheḥ karmāṇi ca mahāt: tasya janma mahā-buddheḥ karmāṇi ca mahātmanaḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/0112_birth_pariksit.txt.prādātsvannaṁ ca viprebhyaḥ prajātīrthe: prādāt-svannaṁ ca viprebhyaḥ prajā-tīrthe sa tīrtha-vit||
vishnu/bhagavata/0112_birth_pariksit.txt.eṣa dātā śaraṇyaśca yathā hyauśīnaraḥ śi: eṣa dātā śaraṇyaś-ca yathā hy-auśīnaraḥ śibiḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/0112_birth_pariksit.txt.sa eṣa loke vikhyātaḥ parīkṣiditi yatpra: sa eṣa loke vikhyātaḥ parīkṣid-iti yat-prabhuḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0112_birth_pariksit.txt.sa rājaputro vavṛdhe āśu śukla ivoḍupaḥ|: sa rāja-putro vavṛdhe āśu śukla ivoḍupaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0112_birth_pariksit.txt.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe naimiṣīyopākhyāne parīkṣij-janmādy-utkarṣo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12||

vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.dṛṣṭāḥ śrutā vā yadavaḥ svapuryāṁ sukham: dṛṣṭāḥ śrutā vā yadavaḥ sva-puryāṁ sukham-āsate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.hṛtaṁ kṣetraṁ dhanaṁ yeṣāṁ taddattairasu: hṛtaṁ kṣetraṁ dhanaṁ yeṣāṁ tad-dattair-asubhiḥ kiyat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.gāvalgaṇe kva nastāto vṛddho hīnaśca net: gāvalgaṇe kva nas-tāto vṛddho hīnaś-ca netrayoḥ||

vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.mā kañcana śuco rājan yadīśvaravaśaṁ jag: mā kañcana śuco rājan yad-īśvara-vaśaṁ jagat|
vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.yathā gāvo nasi protāstantyāṁ baddhāḥ sv: yathā gāvo nasi protās-tantyāṁ baddhāḥ svadāmabhiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.yanmanyase dhruvaṁ lokamadhruvaṁ vā na c: yan-manyase dhruvaṁ lokam-adhruvaṁ vā na cobhayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.sarvathā na hi śocyāste snehādanyatra mo: sarvathā na hi śocyās-te snehād-anyatra moha-jāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.kathaṁ tvanāthāḥ kṛpaṇā varteraṁste ca m: kathaṁ tv-anāthāḥ kṛpaṇā varteraṁs-te ca māṁ vinā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0113_vidura_advice_dhrt.srotobhiḥ saptabhiryā vai svardhunī sapt: srotobhiḥ saptabhir-yā vai svardhunī saptadhā vyadhāt|

vishnu/bhagavata/0114_king_yudhisthira_s.yasmānnaḥ sampado rājyaṁ dārāḥ prāṇāḥ ku: yasmān-naḥ sampado rājyaṁ dārāḥ prāṇāḥ kulaṁ prajāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0114_king_yudhisthira_s.sūryaṁ hataprabhaṁ paśya grahamardaṁ mit: sūryaṁ hata-prabhaṁ paśya graha-mardaṁ mitho divi|

vishnu/bhagavata/0114_king_yudhisthira_s.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe yudhiṣṭhira-vitarko nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 14||

vishnu/bhagavata/0115_grieving_krsna_pan.tadvai dhanusta iṣavaḥ sa ratho hayāste: tadvai dhanus-ta iṣavaḥ sa ratho hayās-te

vishnu/bhagavata/0115_grieving_krsna_pan.yayāharad bhuvo bhāraṁ tāṁ tanuṁ vijahāv: yayāharad bhuvo bhāraṁ tāṁ tanuṁ vijahāv-ajaḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/0115_grieving_krsna_pan.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe pāṇḍava-svargārohaṇaṁ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 15||

vishnu/bhagavata/0116_conquests_pariksit.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe pṛthvī-dharma-saṁvādo nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 16||

vishnu/bhagavata/0117_king_pariksit_subd.gāṁ ca dharmadughāṁ dīnāṁ bhṛśaṁ śūdrapa: gāṁ ca dharma-dughāṁ dīnāṁ bhṛśaṁ śūdra-padāhatām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0117_king_pariksit_subd.yastvaṁ kṛṣṇe gate dūraṁ saha gāṇḍīvadha: yas-tvaṁ kṛṣṇe gate dūraṁ saha gāṇḍīva-dhanvanā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0117_king_pariksit_subd.tvaṁ vā mṛṇāladhavalaḥ pādairnyūnaḥ padā: tvaṁ vā mṛṇāla-dhavalaḥ pādair-nyūnaḥ padā caran|
