vishnu/bhagavata/0117_king_pariksit_subd.vṛṣasya naṣṭāṁstrīn pādān tapaḥ śaucaṁ d: vṛṣasya naṣṭāṁs-trīn pādān tapaḥ śaucaṁ dayām-iti|
vishnu/bhagavata/0117_king_pariksit_subd.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe kali-nigraho nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 17||

vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.yo vai drauṇyastravipluṣṭo na māturudare: yo vai drauṇy-astra-vipluṣṭo na mātur-udare mṛtaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.nānudveṣṭi kaliṁ samrāṭ sāraṅga iva sāra: nānudveṣṭi kaliṁ samrāṭ sāraṅga iva sāra-bhuk|
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.kiṁ nu bāleṣu śūreṇa kalinā dhīrabhīruṇā: kiṁ nu bāleṣu śūreṇa kalinā dhīra-bhīruṇā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.sūta jīva samāḥ saumya śāśvatīrviśadaṁ y: sūta jīva samāḥ saumya śāśvatīr-viśadaṁ yaśaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.yastvaṁ śaṁsasi kṛṣṇasya martyānāmamṛtaṁ: yas-tvaṁ śaṁsasi kṛṣṇasya martyānām-amṛtaṁ hi naḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.brāhmaṇaṁ pratyabhūd brahman matsaro man: brāhmaṇaṁ pratyabhūd brahman matsaro manyur-eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.sa kathaṁ tadgṛhe dvāḥsthaḥ sabhāṇḍaṁ bh: sa kathaṁ tad-gṛhe dvāḥsthaḥ sabhāṇḍaṁ bhoktum-arhati||
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.pitaraṁ vīkṣya duḥkhārto muktakaṇṭho rur: pitaraṁ vīkṣya duḥkhārto mukta-kaṇṭho ruroda ha||
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.sa vā āṅgiraso brahman śrutvā sutavilāpa: sa vā āṅgiraso brahman śrutvā suta-vilāpanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.dharmapālo narapatiḥ sa tu samrāḍ bṛhacc: dharma-pālo nara-patiḥ sa tu samrāḍ bṛhacchravāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.nāsya tat pratikurvanti tadbhaktāḥ prabh: nāsya tat pratikurvanti tad-bhaktāḥ prabhavo'pi hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0118_sage_srngi_curses_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe vipra-śāpopalambhanaṁ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 18||

vishnu/bhagavata/0119_pariksit_vow_fasti.aho adya vayaṁ brahman satsevyāḥ kṣatrab: aho adya vayaṁ brahman sat-sevyāḥ kṣatra-bandhavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0119_pariksit_vow_fasti.sadyo naśyanti vai puṁsāṁ viṣṇoriva sure: sadyo naśyanti vai puṁsāṁ viṣṇor-iva suretarāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0119_pariksit_vow_fasti.api me bhagavān prītaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pāṇḍusutap: api me bhagavān prītaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pāṇḍu-suta-priyaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0119_pariksit_vow_fasti.evamābhāṣitaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ sa rājñā ślakṣṇayā: evam-ābhāṣitaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ sa rājñā ślakṣṇayā girā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0119_pariksit_vow_fasti.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ prathama-skandhe śukāgamanaṁ nāmaikonaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 19||

vishnu/bhagavata/0201_method_meditation_.varīyāneṣa te praśnaḥ kṛto lokahitaṁ nṛp: varīyān-eṣa te praśnaḥ kṛto loka-hitaṁ nṛpa|
vishnu/bhagavata/0201_method_meditation_.teṣāṁ pramatto nidhanaṁ paśyannapi na pa: teṣāṁ pramatto nidhanaṁ paśyann-api na paśyati||
vishnu/bhagavata/0201_method_meditation_.chindyādasaṅgaśastreṇa spṛhāṁ dehe'nu ye: chindyād-asaṅga-śastreṇa spṛhāṁ dehe'nu ye ca tam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0201_method_meditation_.yaccheddhāraṇayā dhīro hanti yā tatkṛtaṁ: yacched-dhāraṇayā dhīro hanti yā tat-kṛtaṁ malam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0201_method_meditation_.yatredaṁ dṛśyate viśvaṁ bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ b: yatredaṁ dṛśyate viśvaṁ bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhavac-ca sat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0201_method_meditation_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe mahāpuruṣa-saṁsthānuvarṇane prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 1||

vishnu/bhagavata/0202_meditation_gross_s.na hyato'nyaḥ śivaḥ panthā viśataḥ saṁsṛ: na hy-ato'nyaḥ śivaḥ panthā viśataḥ saṁsṛtāv-iha|
vishnu/bhagavata/0202_meditation_gross_s.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe puruṣa-saṁsthā-varṇanaṁ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/0203_worship_various_go.rājyakāmo manūn devān nirṛtiṁ tvabhicara: rājya-kāmo manūn devān nirṛtiṁ tv-abhicaran yajet|
vishnu/bhagavata/0203_worship_various_go.ko nirvṛto harikathāsu ratiṁ na kuryāt||: ko nirvṛto hari-kathāsu ratiṁ na kuryāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0203_worship_various_go.kathā harikathodarkāḥ satāṁ syuḥ sadasi: kathā hari-kathodarkāḥ satāṁ syuḥ sadasi dhruvam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0203_worship_various_go.taravaḥ kiṁ na jīvanti bhastrāḥ kiṁ na ś: taravaḥ kiṁ na jīvanti bhastrāḥ kiṁ na śvasanty-uta|
vishnu/bhagavata/0203_worship_various_go.na khādanti na mehanti kiṁ grāmapaśavo'p: na khādanti na mehanti kiṁ grāma-paśavo'pare||
vishnu/bhagavata/0203_worship_various_go.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/0204_king_question_crea.yāṁ yāṁ śaktimupāśritya puruśaktiḥ paraḥ: yāṁ yāṁ śaktim-upāśritya puru-śaktiḥ paraḥ pumān|
vishnu/bhagavata/0204_king_question_crea.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||

vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.yatsaṁsthaṁ yatparaṁ yacca tattattvaṁ va: yat-saṁsthaṁ yat-paraṁ yacca tat-tattvaṁ vada tattvataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.nāhaṁ veda paraṁ hyasminnāparaṁ na samaṁ: nāhaṁ veda paraṁ hy-asmin-nāparaṁ na samaṁ vibho|
vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.sa bhavānacarad ghoraṁ yat tapaḥ susamāh: sa bhavān-acarad ghoraṁ yat tapaḥ susamāhitaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.nānṛtaṁ tava taccāpi yathā māṁ prabravīṣ: nānṛtaṁ tava tac-cāpi yathā māṁ prabravīṣi bhoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.avijñāya paraṁ matta etāvattvaṁ yato hi: avijñāya paraṁ matta etāvat-tvaṁ yato hi me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.dravyaṁ karma ca kālaśca svabhāvo jīva e: dravyaṁ karma ca kālaś-ca svabhāvo jīva eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.tasya mātrā guṇaḥ śabdo liṅgaṁ yad draṣṭ: tasya mātrā guṇaḥ śabdo liṅgaṁ yad draṣṭṛ-dṛśyayoḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.svarlokaḥ kalpito mūrdhnā iti vā lokakal: svarlokaḥ kalpito mūrdhnā iti vā loka-kalpanā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0205_account_creation.t.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||

vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.vācāṁ vahnermukhaṁ kṣetraṁ chandasāṁ sap: vācāṁ vahner-mukhaṁ kṣetraṁ chandasāṁ sapta dhātavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.vikramo bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca kṣemasya śaraṇ: vikramo bhūr-bhuvaḥ svaśca kṣemasya śaraṇasya ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.ahaṁ bhavān bhavaścaiva ta ime munayo'gr: ahaṁ bhavān bhavaś-caiva ta ime munayo'grajāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.sarvaṁ puruṣa evedaṁ bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhav: sarvaṁ puruṣa evedaṁ bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ bhavac-ca yat|
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.tad dravyamatyagād viśvaṁ gobhiḥ sūrya i: tad dravyam-atyagād viśvaṁ gobhiḥ sūrya ivātapan||
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.tataste bhrātara ime prajānāṁ patayo nav: tatas-te bhrātara ime prajānāṁ patayo nava|
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.na vai kvacinme manaso mṛṣā gatiḥ|: na vai kvacin-me manaso mṛṣā gatiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.nāhaṁ na yūyaṁ yadṛtāṁ gatiṁ vidu-: nāhaṁ na yūyaṁ yad-ṛtāṁ gatiṁ vidu-
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.sa eṣa ādyaḥ puruṣaḥ kalpe kalpe sṛjatya: sa eṣa ādyaḥ puruṣaḥ kalpe kalpe sṛjaty-ajaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0206_glories_cosmic_for.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6||

vishnu/bhagavata/0207_stories_lord_lila_.datto mayāhamiti yad bhagavān sa dattaḥ|: datto mayāham-iti yad bhagavān sa dattaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0207_stories_lord_lila_.kāmaḥ kathaṁ nu punarasya manaḥ śrayeta|: kāmaḥ kathaṁ nu punar-asya manaḥ śrayeta||
vishnu/bhagavata/0207_stories_lord_lila_.rnāmnā nṛṇāṁ pururujāṁ ruja āśu hanti|: rnāmnā nṛṇāṁ puru-rujāṁ ruja āśu hanti|
vishnu/bhagavata/0207_stories_lord_lila_.śulbaṁ sutasya na tu tat tadamuṣya māti|: śulbaṁ sutasya na tu tat tad-amuṣya māti|
vishnu/bhagavata/0207_stories_lord_lila_.yarhyālayeṣvapi satāṁ na hareḥ kathāḥ sy: yarhy-ālayeṣv-api satāṁ na hareḥ kathāḥ syuḥ
vishnu/bhagavata/0207_stories_lord_lila_.svāhā svadhā vaṣaḍiti sma giro na yatra: svāhā svadhā vaṣaḍ-iti sma giro na yatra
vishnu/bhagavata/0207_stories_lord_lila_.patnī manoḥ sa ca manuśca tadātmajāśca: patnī manoḥ sa ca manuś-ca tad-ātmajāś-ca
vishnu/bhagavata/0207_stories_lord_lila_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe brahma-nārada-saṁvāde saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/0208_various_questions_.yasmai yasmai yathā prāha nārado devadar: yasmai yasmai yathā prāha nārado deva-darśanaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0208_various_questions_.yugāni yugamānaṁ ca dharmo yaśca yuge yu: yugāni yuga-mānaṁ ca dharmo yaśca yuge yuge|
vishnu/bhagavata/0208_various_questions_.visṛjya vā yathā māyāmudāste sākṣivad vi: visṛjya vā yathā māyām-udāste sākṣivad vibhuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0208_various_questions_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe praśna-vidhir-nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/0209_brahma_sees_abode_.yarhi vāva mahimni sve parasmin kālamāya: yarhi vāva mahimni sve parasmin kāla-māyayoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0209_brahma_sees_abode_.sattvaṁ ca miśraṁ na ca kālavikramaḥ|: sattvaṁ ca miśraṁ na ca kāla-vikramaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0209_brahma_sees_abode_.parāvare yathā rūpe jānīyāṁ te tvarūpiṇa: parāvare yathā rūpe jānīyāṁ te tv-arūpiṇaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0209_brahma_sees_abode_.tathā tadviṣayāṁ dhehi manīṣāṁ mayi mādh: tathā tad-viṣayāṁ dhehi manīṣāṁ mayi mādhava||
vishnu/bhagavata/0209_brahma_sees_abode_.sarahasyaṁ tadaṅgaṁ ca gṛhāṇa gaditaṁ ma: sarahasyaṁ tad-aṅgaṁ ca gṛhāṇa gaditaṁ mayā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0209_brahma_sees_abode_.proktaṁ bhagavatā prāha prītaḥ putrāya b: proktaṁ bhagavatā prāha prītaḥ putrāya bhūta-kṛt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0209_brahma_sees_abode_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe navamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 9||

vishnu/bhagavata/0210_ten_characteristic.dravyaṁ karma ca kālaśca svabhāvo jīva e: dravyaṁ karma ca kālaś-ca svabhāvo jīva eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0210_ten_characteristic.ojaḥ saho balaṁ jajñe tataḥ prāṇo mahāna: ojaḥ saho balaṁ jajñe tataḥ prāṇo mahān-asuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0210_ten_characteristic.prāṇena kṣipatā kṣut tṛḍantarā jāyate pr: prāṇena kṣipatā kṣut tṛḍ-antarā jāyate prabhoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0210_ten_characteristic.karṇau ca nirabhidyetāṁ diśaḥ śrotraṁ gu: karṇau ca nirabhidyetāṁ diśaḥ śrotraṁ guṇa-grahaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0210_ten_characteristic.tato manastataścandraḥ saṅkalpaḥ kāma ev: tato manas-tataś-candraḥ saṅkalpaḥ kāma eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0210_ten_characteristic.etadbhagavato rūpaṁ sthūlaṁ te vyāhṛtaṁ: etad-bhagavato rūpaṁ sthūlaṁ te vyāhṛtaṁ mayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0210_ten_characteristic.ubhe api na gṛhṇanti māyāsṛṣṭe vipaścita: ubhe api na gṛhṇanti māyā-sṛṣṭe vipaścitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0210_ten_characteristic.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvitīya-skandhe puruṣa-saṁsthānuvarṇanaṁ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/0301_meeting_uddhava_vi.kadā vā saha saṁvāda etadvarṇaya naḥ pra: kadā vā saha saṁvāda etad-varṇaya naḥ prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/0301_meeting_uddhava_vi.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe viduroddhava-saṁvāde prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 1||

vishnu/bhagavata/0302_uddhava_describes_.sa kathaṁ sevayā tasya kālena jarasaṁgat: sa kathaṁ sevayā tasya kālena jarasaṁ-gataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0302_uddhava_describes_.kiṁ nu naḥ kuśalaṁ brūyāṁ gataśrīṣu gṛhe: kiṁ nu naḥ kuśalaṁ brūyāṁ gata-śrīṣu gṛheṣv-aham||
vishnu/bhagavata/0302_uddhava_describes_.ye saṁvasanto na vidurhariṁ mīnā ivoḍupa: ye saṁvasanto na vidur-hariṁ mīnā ivoḍupam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0302_uddhava_describes_.sa eva godhanaṁ lakṣmyā niketaṁ sitagovṛ: sa eva godhanaṁ lakṣmyā niketaṁ sita-go-vṛṣam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0302_uddhava_describes_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe viduroddhava-saṁvāde dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/0303_other_lilas_lord.t.śambaraṁ dvividaṁ bāṇaṁ muraṁ balvalamev: śambaraṁ dvividaṁ bāṇaṁ muraṁ balvalam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0303_other_lilas_lord.t.evaṁ sañcintya bhagavān svarājye sthāpya: evaṁ sañcintya bhagavān sva-rājye sthāpya dharma-jam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0303_other_lilas_lord.t.imaṁ lokamamuṁ caiva ramayan sutarāṁ yad: imaṁ lokam-amuṁ caiva ramayan sutarāṁ yadūn|
vishnu/bhagavata/0303_other_lilas_lord.t.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe viduroddhava-saṁvāde tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/0304_vidura_takes_leave.atha te tadanujñātā bhuktvā pītvā ca vār: atha te tad-anujñātā bhuktvā pītvā ca vāruṇīm|
vishnu/bhagavata/0304_vidura_takes_leave.mṛdu tīvraṁ tapo dīrghaṁ tepāte lokabhāv: mṛdu tīvraṁ tapo dīrghaṁ tepāte loka-bhāvanau||
vishnu/bhagavata/0304_vidura_takes_leave.nanu te tattvasaṁrādhya ṛṣiḥ kauṣāravo'n: nanu te tattva-saṁrādhya ṛṣiḥ kauṣāravo'nti me|
vishnu/bhagavata/0304_vidura_takes_leave.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe viduroddhava-saṁvāde caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||

vishnu/bhagavata/0305_vidura_question_ma.sa evaṁ bhagavān pṛṣṭaḥ kṣattrā kauṣārav: sa evaṁ bhagavān pṛṣṭaḥ kṣattrā kauṣāravir-muniḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0305_vidura_question_ma.sa vā eṣa tadā draṣṭā nāpaśyad dṛśyameka: sa vā eṣa tadā draṣṭā nāpaśyad dṛśyam-eka-rāṭ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0305_vidura_question_ma.sā vā etasya saṁdraṣṭuḥ śaktiḥ sadasadāt: sā vā etasya saṁdraṣṭuḥ śaktiḥ sad-asad-ātmikā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0305_vidura_question_ma.māyā nāma mahābhāga yayedaṁ nirmame vibh: māyā nāma mahā-bhāga yayedaṁ nirmame vibhuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0305_vidura_question_ma.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||

vishnu/bhagavata/0306_origin_cosmic_body.virāṭ prāṇo daśavidha ekadhā hṛdayena ca: virāṭ prāṇo daśa-vidha ekadhā hṛdayena ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0306_origin_cosmic_body.meḍhraṁ tasya vinirbhinnaṁ svadhiṣṇyaṁ k: meḍhraṁ tasya vinirbhinnaṁ sva-dhiṣṇyaṁ ka upāviśat|
vishnu/bhagavata/0306_origin_cosmic_body.dharāṁ rajaḥsvabhāvena paṇayo ye ca tāna: dharāṁ rajaḥ-svabhāvena paṇayo ye ca tānanu||
vishnu/bhagavata/0306_origin_cosmic_body.tasyāṁ jātaḥ purā śūdro yadvṛttyā tuṣyat: tasyāṁ jātaḥ purā śūdro yad-vṛttyā tuṣyate hariḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0306_origin_cosmic_body.ete varṇāḥ svadharmeṇa yajanti svaguruṁ: ete varṇāḥ svadharmeṇa yajanti sva-guruṁ harim|
vishnu/bhagavata/0306_origin_cosmic_body.ahaṁ cānya ime devāstasmai bhagavate nam: ahaṁ cānya ime devās-tasmai bhagavate namaḥ||

vishnu/bhagavata/0307_questions_vidura.t.vārtāyā daṇḍanīteśca śrutasya ca vidhiṁ: vārtāyā daṇḍa-nīteś-ca śrutasya ca vidhiṁ pṛthak||
vishnu/bhagavata/0307_questions_vidura.t.śrāddhasya ca vidhiṁ brahman pitṝṇāṁ sar: śrāddhasya ca vidhiṁ brahman pitṝṇāṁ sargam-eva ca|

vishnu/bhagavata/0307_questions_vidura.t.sarve vedāśca yajñāśca tapo dānāni cānag: sarve vedāś-ca yajñāś-ca tapo dānāni cānagha|
vishnu/bhagavata/0307_questions_vidura.t.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/0308_origin_brahma.txt.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/0309_brahma_hymn_lord.t.yo vā ahaṁ ca giriśaśca vibhuḥ svayaṁ ca: yo vā ahaṁ ca giriśaś-ca vibhuḥ svayaṁ ca
vishnu/bhagavata/0309_brahma_hymn_lord.t.bhūyastvaṁ tapa ātiṣṭha vidyāṁ caiva mad: bhūyas-tvaṁ tapa ātiṣṭha vidyāṁ caiva mad-āśrayām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0309_brahma_hymn_lord.t.tata ātmani loke ca bhaktiyuktaḥ samāhit: tata ātmani loke ca bhakti-yuktaḥ samāhitaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0309_brahma_hymn_lord.t.yanmano mayi nirbaddhaṁ prajāḥ saṁsṛjato: yan-mano mayi nirbaddhaṁ prajāḥ saṁsṛjato'pi te||
vishnu/bhagavata/0309_brahma_hymn_lord.t.yadvā tapasi te niṣṭhā sa eṣa madanugrah: yadvā tapasi te niṣṭhā sa eṣa mad-anugrahaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0309_brahma_hymn_lord.t.ya etena pumānnityaṁ stutvā stotreṇa māṁ: ya etena pumān-nityaṁ stutvā stotreṇa māṁ bhajet|

vishnu/bhagavata/0310_ten_kinds_creation.ye ca me bhagavan pṛṣṭāstvayyarthā bahuv: ye ca me bhagavan pṛṣṭās-tvayy-arthā bahuvittama|

vishnu/bhagavata/0310_ten_kinds_creation.ṣaḍime prākṛtāḥ sargā vaikṛtānapi me śṛṇ: ṣaḍime prākṛtāḥ sargā vaikṛtān-api me śṛṇu||
vishnu/bhagavata/0310_ten_kinds_creation.gaurajo mahiṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sūkaro gavayo rur: gaur-ajo mahiṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sūkaro gavayo ruruḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0310_ten_kinds_creation.ete caikaśaphāḥ kṣattaḥ śṛṇu pañcanakhān: ete caika-śaphāḥ kṣattaḥ śṛṇu pañca-nakhān paśūn||
vishnu/bhagavata/0310_ten_kinds_creation.śvā sṛgālo vṛko vyāghro mārjāraḥ śaśaśal: śvā sṛgālo vṛko vyāghro mārjāraḥ śaśa-śallakau|
vishnu/bhagavata/0310_ten_kinds_creation.siṁhaḥ kapirgajaḥ kūrmo godhā ca makarād: siṁhaḥ kapir-gajaḥ kūrmo godhā ca makarādayaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0310_ten_kinds_creation.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.evaṁ kālo'pyanumitaḥ saukṣmye sthaulye c: evaṁ kālo'py-anumitaḥ saukṣmye sthaulye ca sattama|
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.sa kālaḥ paramāṇurvai yo bhuṅkte paramāṇ: sa kālaḥ paramāṇur-vai yo bhuṅkte paramāṇutām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.trasareṇutrikaṁ bhuṅkte yaḥ kālaḥ sa tru: trasareṇu-trikaṁ bhuṅkte yaḥ kālaḥ sa truṭiḥ smṛtaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.te dve muhūrtaḥ praharaḥ ṣaḍyāmaḥ sapta: te dve muhūrtaḥ praharaḥ ṣaḍ-yāmaḥ sapta vā nṛṇām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.dvau tāvṛtuḥ ṣaḍayanaṁ dakṣiṇaṁ cottaraṁ: dvau tāv-ṛtuḥ ṣaḍ-ayanaṁ dakṣiṇaṁ cottaraṁ divi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.pareṣāṁ gatimācakṣva ye syuḥ kalpād bahi: pareṣāṁ gatim-ācakṣva ye syuḥ kalpād bahir-vidaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.kṛtaṁ tretā dvāparaṁ ca kaliśceti catury: kṛtaṁ tretā dvāparaṁ ca kaliś-ceti catur-yugam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.svaṁ svaṁ kālaṁ manurbhuṅkte sādhikāṁ hy: svaṁ svaṁ kālaṁ manur-bhuṅkte sādhikāṁ hy-ekasaptatim|
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.bhavanti caiva yugapatsureśāścānu ye ca: bhavanti caiva yugapat-sureśāś-cānu ye ca tān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0311_divisions_time_suc.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11||

vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.nāmāni kuru me dhātaḥ sthānāni ca jagadg: nāmāni kuru me dhātaḥ sthānāni ca jagad-guro||
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.abhyadhād bhadrayā vācā mā rodīstatkarom: abhyadhād bhadrayā vācā mā rodīs-tat-karomi te||
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.ebhiḥ sṛja prajā bahvīḥ prajānāmasi yatp: ebhiḥ sṛja prajā bahvīḥ prajānām-asi yat-patiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.naitatpūrvaiḥ kṛtaṁ tvadye na kariṣyanti: naitat-pūrvaiḥ kṛtaṁ tvadye na kariṣyanti cāpare|
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.kathaṁ srakṣyāmyahaṁ lokān samavetān yat: kathaṁ srakṣyāmy-ahaṁ lokān samavetān yathā purā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.yad yad yenāsṛjad devastanme brūhi tapod: yad yad yenāsṛjad devas-tan-me brūhi tapo-dhana||
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.sāvitraṁ prājāpatyaṁ ca brāhmaṁ cātha bṛ: sāvitraṁ prājāpatyaṁ ca brāhmaṁ cātha bṛhat-tathā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.na hyedhante prajā nūnaṁ daivamatra vigh: na hy-edhante prajā nūnaṁ daivam-atra vighātakam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.yastu tatra pumān so'bhūnmanuḥ svāyambhu: yastu tatra pumān so'bhūn-manuḥ svāyambhuvaḥ svarāṭ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0312_expansion_creation.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12||

vishnu/bhagavata/0313_story_varaha_avata.yeṣāṁ na tuṣṭo bhagavān yajñaliṅgo janār: yeṣāṁ na tuṣṭo bhagavān yajña-liṅgo janārdanaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0313_story_varaha_avata.teṣāṁ śramo hyapārthāya yadātmā nādṛtaḥ: teṣāṁ śramo hy-apārthāya yad-ātmā nādṛtaḥ svayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0313_story_varaha_avata.sthānaṁ tvihānujānīhi prajānāṁ mama ca p: sthānaṁ tv-ihānujānīhi prajānāṁ mama ca prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/0313_story_varaha_avata.parameṣṭhī tvapāṁ madhye tathā sannāmave: parameṣṭhī tvapāṁ madhye tathā sannām-avekṣya gām|

vishnu/bhagavata/0313_story_varaha_avata.sṛjato me kṣitirvārbhiḥ plāvyamānā rasāṁ: sṛjato me kṣitir-vārbhiḥ plāvyamānā rasāṁ gatā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0313_story_varaha_avata.yasyāhaṁ hṛdayādāsaṁ sa īśo vidadhātu me: yasyāhaṁ hṛdayād-āsaṁ sa īśo vidadhātu me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0313_story_varaha_avata.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe varāha-prādurbhāvānuvarṇane trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 13||

vishnu/bhagavata/0314_diti_conceives.txt.eṣa māṁ tvatkṛte vidvan kāma āttaśarāsan: eṣa māṁ tvat-kṛte vidvan kāma ātta-śarāsanaḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/0314_diti_conceives.txt.iti tāṁ vīra mārīcaḥ kṛpaṇāṁ bahubhāṣiṇī: iti tāṁ vīra mārīcaḥ kṛpaṇāṁ bahu-bhāṣiṇīm|
vishnu/bhagavata/0314_diti_conceives.txt.eṣa te'haṁ vidhāsyāmi priyaṁ bhīru yadic: eṣa te'haṁ vidhāsyāmi priyaṁ bhīru yad-icchasi|
vishnu/bhagavata/0314_diti_conceives.txt.tasyāḥ kāmaṁ na kaḥ kuryātsiddhistraivar: tasyāḥ kāmaṁ na kaḥ kuryāt-siddhis-traivargikī yataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0314_diti_conceives.txt.mā me garbhamimaṁ brahman bhūtānāmṛṣabho: mā me garbham-imaṁ brahman bhūtānām-ṛṣabho vadhīt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0314_diti_conceives.txt.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe diti-kaśyapa-saṁvāde caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 14||

vishnu/bhagavata/0315_sanaka_other_sages.tama etadvibho vettha saṁvignā yadvayaṁ: tama etad-vibho vettha saṁvignā yad-vayaṁ bhṛśam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0315_sanaka_other_sages.yasya vācā prajāḥ sarvā gāvastantyeva ya: yasya vācā prajāḥ sarvā gāvas-tantyeva yantritāḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/0315_sanaka_other_sages.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe jaya-vijayayoḥ sanakādi-śāpo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 15||

vishnu/bhagavata/0316_fall_jaya_vijaya_v.iti tad gṛṇatāṁ teṣāṁ munīnāṁ yogadharmi: iti tad gṛṇatāṁ teṣāṁ munīnāṁ yoga-dharmiṇām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0316_fall_jaya_vijaya_v.tadvaḥ prasādayāmyadya brahma daivaṁ par: tadvaḥ prasādayāmy-adya brahma daivaṁ paraṁ hi me|
vishnu/bhagavata/0316_fall_jaya_vijaya_v.yannāmāni ca gṛhṇāti loko bhṛtye kṛtāgas: yan-nāmāni ca gṛhṇāti loko bhṛtye kṛtāgasi|
vishnu/bhagavata/0316_fall_jaya_vijaya_v.na vayaṁ bhagavan vidmastava deva cikīrṣ: na vayaṁ bhagavan vidmas-tava deva cikīrṣitam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0316_fall_jaya_vijaya_v.stejaḥ kṣataṁ tvavanatasya sa te vinodaḥ: stejaḥ kṣataṁ tv-avanatasya sa te vinodaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0316_fall_jaya_vijaya_v.brahmatejaḥ samartho'pi hantuṁ necche ma: brahma-tejaḥ samartho'pi hantuṁ necche mataṁ tu me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0316_fall_jaya_vijaya_v.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 16||

vishnu/bhagavata/0317_birth_hiranyakasip.pūrṇe varṣaśate sādhvī putrau prasuṣuve: pūrṇe varṣa-śate sādhvī putrau prasuṣuve yamau||

vishnu/bhagavata/0317_birth_hiranyakasip.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe hiraṇyākṣa-digvijaye saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 17||

vishnu/bhagavata/0318_battle_lord_varaha.evaṁ gadābhyāṁ gurvībhyāṁ haryakṣo harir: evaṁ gadābhyāṁ gurvībhyāṁ haryakṣo harir-eva ca|

vishnu/bhagavata/0318_battle_lord_varaha.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe hiraṇyākṣa-vadhe'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 18||

vishnu/bhagavata/0319_slaying_hiranyaksa.sā hatā tena gadayā vihatā bhagavatkarāt: sā hatā tena gadayā vihatā bhagavat-karāt|

vishnu/bhagavata/0319_slaying_hiranyaksa.ityuktaḥ sa tadā bhūyastāḍayan vyanadad: ity-uktaḥ sa tadā bhūyas-tāḍayan vyanadad bhṛśam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0319_slaying_hiranyaksa.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe hiraṇyākṣa-vadho nāmaikonaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 19||

vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.tayoḥ saṁvadatoḥ sūta pravṛttā hyamalāḥ: tayoḥ saṁvadatoḥ sūta pravṛttā hy-amalāḥ kathāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.tā naḥ kīrtaya bhadraṁ te kīrtanyodāraka: tā naḥ kīrtaya bhadraṁ te kīrtanyodāra-karmaṇaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.rasajñaḥ ko nu tṛpyeta harilīlāmṛtaṁ pib: rasajñaḥ ko nu tṛpyeta hari-līlāmṛtaṁ piban||
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.devastānāha saṁvigno mā māṁ jakṣata rakṣ: devas-tān-āha saṁvigno mā māṁ jakṣata rakṣata|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.aho me yakṣarakṣāṁsi prajā yūyaṁ babhūvi: aho me yakṣa-rakṣāṁsi prajā yūyaṁ babhūvitha||
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.aho rūpamaho dhairyamaho asyā navaṁ vaya: aho rūpam-aho dhairyam-aho asyā navaṁ vayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.kāsi kasyāsi rambhoru ko vārthaste'tra b: kāsi kasyāsi rambhoru ko vārthas-te'tra bhāmini|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.yā vā kācittvamabale diṣṭyā sandarśanaṁ: yā vā kācit-tvam-abale diṣṭyā sandarśanaṁ tava|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.ta ātmasargaṁ taṁ kāyaṁ pitaraḥ pratiped: ta ātma-sargaṁ taṁ kāyaṁ pitaraḥ pratipedire|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.te tu tajjagṛhū rūpaṁ tyaktaṁ yatparameṣ: te tu taj-jagṛhū rūpaṁ tyaktaṁ yat-parameṣṭhinā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.aho etajjagatsraṣṭaḥ sukṛtaṁ bata te kṛt: aho etaj-jagat-sraṣṭaḥ sukṛtaṁ bata te kṛtam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0320_many_kinds_beings_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe viṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 20||

vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.tasyāṁ sa vai mahāyogī yuktāyāṁ yogalakṣ: tasyāṁ sa vai mahā-yogī yuktāyāṁ yoga-lakṣaṇaiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.ruciryo bhagavān brahmandakṣo vā brahmaṇ: rucir-yo bhagavān brahman-dakṣo vā brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.darśayāmāsa taṁ kṣattaḥ śābdaṁ brahma da: darśayāmāsa taṁ kṣattaḥ śābdaṁ brahma dadhad-vapuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.na vai jātu mṛṣaiva syātprajādhyakṣa mad: na vai jātu mṛṣaiva syāt-prajādhyakṣa mad-arhaṇam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.yā ta ātmabhṛtaṁ vīryaṁ navadhā prasaviṣ: yā ta ātma-bhṛtaṁ vīryaṁ navadhā prasaviṣyati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.tvaṁ ca samyaganuṣṭhāya nideśaṁ ma uśatt: tvaṁ ca samyag-anuṣṭhāya nideśaṁ ma uśattamaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.kṛtvā dayāṁ ca jīveṣu dattvā cābhayamātm: kṛtvā dayāṁ ca jīveṣu dattvā cābhayam-ātmavān|
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.mayyātmānaṁ saha jagad drakṣyasyātmani c: mayy-ātmānaṁ saha jagad drakṣyasy-ātmani cāpi mām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.āste sma bindusarasi taṁ kālaṁ pratipāla: āste sma bindu-sarasi taṁ kālaṁ pratipālayan||
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.vadhāya cāsatāṁ yastvaṁ hareḥ śaktirhi p: vadhāya cāsatāṁ yas-tvaṁ hareḥ śaktir-hi pālinī||
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.athāpi pṛcche tvāṁ vīra yadarthaṁ tvamih: athāpi pṛcche tvāṁ vīra yad-arthaṁ tvam-ihāgataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0321_austerities_kardam.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe eka-viṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 21||

vishnu/bhagavata/0322_marriage_kardama_p.hṛdayaṁ tasya hi brahma kṣatramaṁgaṁ pra: hṛdayaṁ tasya hi brahma kṣatram-aṁgaṁ pracakṣate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0322_marriage_kardama_p.ato hyanyonyamātmānaṁ brahma kṣatraṁ ca: ato hy-anyonyam-ātmānaṁ brahma kṣatraṁ ca rakṣataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0322_marriage_kardama_p.rakṣati smāvyayo devaḥ sa yaḥ sadasadātm: rakṣati smāvyayo devaḥ sa yaḥ sad-asad-ātmakaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0322_marriage_kardama_p.diṣṭyā pādarajaḥ spṛṣṭaṁ śīrṣṇā me bhava: diṣṭyā pāda-rajaḥ spṛṣṭaṁ śīrṣṇā me bhavataḥ śivam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0322_marriage_kardama_p.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe dvāviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 22||

vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.visṛjya kāmaṁ dambhaṁ ca dveṣaṁ lobhamag: visṛjya kāmaṁ dambhaṁ ca dveṣaṁ lobham-aghaṁ madam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.vayaṁ karmakarīstubhyaṁ śādhi naḥ karavā: vayaṁ karmakarīs-tubhyaṁ śādhi naḥ karavāma kim||
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.dukūle nirmale nūtne dadurasyai ca mānad: dukūle nirmale nūtne dadur-asyai ca mānadāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.tatra cāste saha strībhiryatrāste sa pra: tatra cāste saha strībhir-yatrāste sa prajāpatiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.prekṣayitvā bhuvo golaṁ patnyai yāvān sv: prekṣayitvā bhuvo golaṁ patnyai yāvān sva-saṁsthayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.tasmin vimāna utkṛṣṭāṁ śayyāṁ ratikarīṁ: tasmin vimāna utkṛṣṭāṁ śayyāṁ rati-karīṁ śritā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.neha yatkarma dharmāya na virāgāya kalpa: neha yat-karma dharmāya na virāgāya kalpate|
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.na tīrthapadasevāyai jīvannapi mṛto hi s: na tīrtha-pada-sevāyai jīvann-api mṛto hi saḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.yattvāṁ vimuktidaṁ prāpya na mumukṣeya b: yat-tvāṁ vimuktidaṁ prāpya na mumukṣeya bandhanāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0323_life_together_kard.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileyopākhyāne trayoviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 23||

vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.dhṛtavratāsi bhadraṁ te damena niyamena: dhṛta-vratāsi bhadraṁ te damena niyamena ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.gāyanti taṁ sma gandharvā nṛtyantyapsara: gāyanti taṁ sma gandharvā nṛtyanty-apsaraso mudā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.praseduśca diśaḥ sarvā ambhāṁsi ca manāṁ: praseduś-ca diśaḥ sarvā ambhāṁsi ca manāṁsi ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.loke kapila ityākhyāṁ gantā te kīrtivard: loke kapila ity-ākhyāṁ gantā te kīrti-vardhanaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.tatasta ṛṣayaḥ kṣattaḥ kṛtadārā nimantry: tatasta ṛṣayaḥ kṣattaḥ kṛta-dārā nimantrya tam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.sa eva bhagavānadya helanaṁ na gaṇayya n: sa eva bhagavān-adya helanaṁ na gaṇayya naḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.gṛheṣu jāto grāmyāṇāṁ yaḥ svānāṁ pakṣapo: gṛheṣu jāto grāmyāṇāṁ yaḥ svānāṁ pakṣa-poṣaṇaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.mayā proktaṁ hi lokasya pramāṇaṁ satyala: mayā proktaṁ hi lokasya pramāṇaṁ satya-laukike|
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.taṁ pravartayituṁ dehamimaṁ viddhi mayā: taṁ pravartayituṁ deham-imaṁ viddhi mayā bhṛtam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.dakṣiṇīkṛtya taṁ prīto vanameva jagāma h: dakṣiṇīkṛtya taṁ prīto vanam-eva jagāma ha||
vishnu/bhagavata/0324_birth_sri_kapila.t.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileye caturviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 24||

vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.na hyasya varṣmaṇaḥ puṁsāṁ varimṇaḥ sarv: na hyasya varṣmaṇaḥ puṁsāṁ varimṇaḥ sarva-yoginām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.ya ādyo bhagavān puṁsāmīśvaro vai bhavān: ya ādyo bhagavān puṁsām-īśvaro vai bhavān kila|
vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.cetaḥ khalvasya bandhāya muktaye cātmano: cetaḥ khalv-asya bandhāya muktaye cātmano matam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.mayyananyena bhāvena bhaktiṁ kurvanti ye: mayy-ananyena bhāvena bhaktiṁ kurvanti ye dṛḍhām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.madāśrayāḥ kathā mṛṣṭāḥ śṛṇvanti kathaya: mad-āśrayāḥ kathā mṛṣṭāḥ śṛṇvanti kathayanti ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.saṁgasteṣvatha te prārthyaḥ saṁgadoṣahar: saṁgas-teṣv-atha te prārthyaḥ saṁga-doṣa-harā hi te||
vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.sattva evaikamanaso vṛttiḥ svābhāvikī tu: sattva evaika-manaso vṛttiḥ svābhāvikī tu yā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.ātmānamanu ye ceha ye rāyaḥ paśavo gṛhāḥ: ātmānam-anu ye ceha ye rāyaḥ paśavo gṛhāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0325_devahuti_question_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileyopākhyāne pañcaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 25||

vishnu/bhagavata/0326_origin_several_tat.vilokya mumuhe sadyaḥ sa iha jñānagūhayā: vilokya mumuhe sadyaḥ sa iha jñāna-gūhayā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0326_origin_several_tat.prabhāvaṁ pauruṣaṁ prāhuḥ kālameke yato: prabhāvaṁ pauruṣaṁ prāhuḥ kālam-eke yato bhayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0326_origin_several_tat.ceṣṭā yataḥ sa bhagavān kāla ityupalakṣi: ceṣṭā yataḥ sa bhagavān kāla ity-upalakṣitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0326_origin_several_tat.vāṇyā vahniratho nāse prāṇoto ghrāṇa eta: vāṇyā vahnir-atho nāse prāṇoto ghrāṇa etayoḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0326_origin_several_tat.tasmātsūryo vyabhidyetāṁ karṇau śrotraṁ: tasmāt-sūryo vyabhidyetāṁ karṇau śrotraṁ tato diśaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0326_origin_several_tat.pādau ca nirabhidyetāṁ gatistābhyāṁ tato: pādau ca nirabhidyetāṁ gatis-tābhyāṁ tato hariḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0326_origin_several_tat.śrotreṇa karṇau ca diśo nodatiṣṭhattadā: śrotreṇa karṇau ca diśo nodatiṣṭhat-tadā virāṭ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0326_origin_several_tat.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileye tattva-samāmnāye ṣaḍviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 26||

vishnu/bhagavata/0327_liberation_through.svābhāsena tathā sūryo jalasthena divi s: svābhāsena tathā sūryo jala-sthena divi sthitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0327_liberation_through.yathā gandhasya bhūmeśca na bhāvo vyatir: yathā gandhasya bhūmeś-ca na bhāvo vyatirekataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0327_liberation_through.guṇeṣu satsu prakṛteḥ kaivalyaṁ teṣvataḥ: guṇeṣu satsu prakṛteḥ kaivalyaṁ teṣv-ataḥ katham||
vishnu/bhagavata/0327_liberation_through.tīvrayā mayi bhaktyā ca śrutasambhṛtayā: tīvrayā mayi bhaktyā ca śruta-sambhṛtayā ciram||
vishnu/bhagavata/0327_liberation_through.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileyopākhyāne saptaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 27||

vishnu/bhagavata/0328_method_astanga_yog.mano yenaiva vidhinā prasannaṁ yāti satp: mano yenaiva vidhinā prasannaṁ yāti sat-patham||
vishnu/bhagavata/0328_method_astanga_yog.vāyvagnibhyāṁ yathā lohaṁ dhmātaṁ tyajat: vāyv-agnibhyāṁ yathā lohaṁ dhmātaṁ tyajati vai malam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0328_method_astanga_yog.dehaṁ ca taṁ na caramaḥ sthitamutthitaṁ: dehaṁ ca taṁ na caramaḥ sthitam-utthitaṁ vā
vishnu/bhagavata/0328_method_astanga_yog.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileye sādhanānuṣṭhānaṁ nāmāṣṭāviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 28||

vishnu/bhagavata/0329_heart_devotion_pow.bhaktiyogasya me mārgaṁ brūhi vistaraśaḥ: bhakti-yogasya me mārgaṁ brūhi vistaraśaḥ prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/0329_heart_devotion_pow.abhisandhāya yo hiṁsāṁ dambhaṁ mātsaryam: abhisandhāya yo hiṁsāṁ dambhaṁ mātsaryam-eva vā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0329_heart_devotion_pow.dīyamānaṁ na gṛhṇanti vinā matsevanaṁ ja: dīyamānaṁ na gṛhṇanti vinā mat-sevanaṁ janāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0329_heart_devotion_pow.jīvāḥ śreṣṭhā hyajīvānāṁ tataḥ prāṇabhṛt: jīvāḥ śreṣṭhā hy-ajīvānāṁ tataḥ prāṇa-bhṛtaḥ śubhe|
vishnu/bhagavata/0329_heart_devotion_pow.na cāsya kaściddayito na dveṣyo na ca bā: na cāsya kaścid-dayito na dveṣyo na ca bāndhavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0329_heart_devotion_pow.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileyopākhyāne ekona-triṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 29||

vishnu/bhagavata/0330_downfall_those_att.taṁ taṁ dhunoti bhagavān pumāñchocati ya: taṁ taṁ dhunoti bhagavān pumāñchocati yat-kṛte||
vishnu/bhagavata/0330_downfall_those_att.janturvai bhava etasmin yāṁ yāṁ yonimanu: jantur-vai bhava etasmin yāṁ yāṁ yonim-anuvrajet|
vishnu/bhagavata/0330_downfall_those_att.nādriyante yathā pūrvaṁ kīnāśā iva gojar: nādriyante yathā pūrvaṁ kīnāśā iva go-jaram||
vishnu/bhagavata/0330_downfall_those_att.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileyopākhyāne karma-vipāko nāmatriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 30||

vishnu/bhagavata/0331_course_soul_that_a.daśāhena tu karkandhūḥ peśyaṇḍaṁ vā tata: daśāhena tu karkandhūḥ peśy-aṇḍaṁ vā tataḥ param||
vishnu/bhagavata/0331_course_soul_that_a.ityevaṁ śaiśavaṁ bhuktvā duḥkhaṁ paugaṇḍ: ity-evaṁ śaiśavaṁ bhuktvā duḥkhaṁ paugaṇḍam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0331_course_soul_that_a.tadarthaṁ kurute karma yadbaddho yāti sa: tad-arthaṁ kurute karma yad-baddho yāti saṁsṛtim|
vishnu/bhagavata/0331_course_soul_that_a.satyaṁ śaucaṁ dayā maunaṁ buddhiḥ śrīrhr: satyaṁ śaucaṁ dayā maunaṁ buddhiḥ śrīr-hrīr-yaśaḥ kṣamā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0331_course_soul_that_a.tasmānna kāryaḥ santrāso na kārpaṇyaṁ na: tasmān-na kāryaḥ santrāso na kārpaṇyaṁ na sambhramaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0331_course_soul_that_a.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileyopākhyāne jīva-gatir-nāmaikatriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 31||

vishnu/bhagavata/0332_course_those_go_pa.kāmamarthaṁ ca dharmān svān dogdhi bhūya: kāmam-arthaṁ ca dharmān svān dogdhi bhūyaḥ piparti tān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0332_course_those_go_pa.na stabdhāya na bhinnāya naiva dharmadhv: na stabdhāya na bhinnāya naiva dharma-dhvajāya ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0332_course_those_go_pa.nābhaktāya ca me jātu na madbhaktadviṣām: nābhaktāya ca me jātu na mad-bhakta-dviṣām-api||
vishnu/bhagavata/0332_course_those_go_pa.ya idaṁ śṛṇuyādamba śraddhayā puruṣaḥ sa: ya idaṁ śṛṇuyād-amba śraddhayā puruṣaḥ sakṛt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0332_course_those_go_pa.yo vābhidhatte maccittaḥ sa hyeti padavī: yo vābhidhatte mac-cittaḥ sa hyeti padavīṁ ca me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0332_course_those_go_pa.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileye dvātriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 32||

vishnu/bhagavata/0333_devahuti_attains_k.iti prardaśya bhagavān satīṁ tāmātmano g: iti prardaśya bhagavān satīṁ tām-ātmano gatim|
vishnu/bhagavata/0333_devahuti_attains_k.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ tṛtīya-skandhe kāpileyopākhyāne trayastriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 33||

vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.idhmaḥ kavirvibhuḥ svahnaḥ sudevo rocano: idhmaḥ kavir-vibhuḥ svahnaḥ sudevo rocano dviṣaṭ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.saha patnyā yayāvṛkṣaṁ kulādriṁ tapasi s: saha patnyā yayāv-ṛkṣaṁ kulādriṁ tapasi sthitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.śaraṇaṁ taṁ prapadye'haṁ ya eva jagadīśv: śaraṇaṁ taṁ prapadye'haṁ ya eva jagad-īśvaraḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā trayaste vibudhar: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā trayas-te vibudharṣabhāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.pratyāhuḥ ślakṣṇayā vācā prahasya tamṛṣi: pratyāhuḥ ślakṣṇayā vācā prahasya tam-ṛṣiṁ prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.yathā kṛtaste saṅkalpo bhāvyaṁ tenaiva n: yathā kṛtas-te saṅkalpo bhāvyaṁ tenaiva nānyathā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.satsaṅkalpasya te brahman yadvai dhyāyat: sat-saṅkalpasya te brahman yadvai dhyāyati te vayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.citraketuḥ surociśca virajā mitra eva ca: citraketuḥ surociś-ca virajā mitra eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.dhātāraṁ ca vidhātāraṁ śriyaṁ ca bhagava: dhātāraṁ ca vidhātāraṁ śriyaṁ ca bhagavat-parām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.tābhyāṁ tayorabhavatāṁ mṛkaṇḍaḥ prāṇa ev: tābhyāṁ tayor-abhavatāṁ mṛkaṇḍaḥ prāṇa eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.śraddhā maitrī dayā śāntistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ: śraddhā maitrī dayā śāntis-tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kriyonnatiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.śāntiḥ sukhaṁ mudaṁ tuṣṭiḥ smayaṁ puṣṭir: śāntiḥ sukhaṁ mudaṁ tuṣṭiḥ smayaṁ puṣṭir-asūyata||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.pāvakaṁ pavamānaṁ ca śuciṁ ca hutabhojan: pāvakaṁ pavamānaṁ ca śuciṁ ca huta-bhojanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.bhavasya patnī tu satī bhavaṁ devamanuvr: bhavasya patnī tu satī bhavaṁ devam-anuvratā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.ātmanaḥ sadṛśaṁ putraṁ na lebhe guṇaśīla: ātmanaḥ sadṛśaṁ putraṁ na lebhe guṇa-śīlataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0401_descendants_daught.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe vidura-maitreya-saṁvāde prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 1||

vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.etadākhyāhi me brahman jāmātuḥ śvaśurasy: etad-ākhyāhi me brahman jāmātuḥ śvaśurasya ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.sādhūnāṁ bruvato vṛttaṁ nājñānānna ca ma: sādhūnāṁ bruvato vṛttaṁ nājñānān-na ca matsarāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.eṣa me śiṣyatāṁ prāpto yanme duhituragra: eṣa me śiṣyatāṁ prāpto yanme duhitur-agrahīt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.tasyaivaṁ dadataḥ śāpaṁ śrutvā dvijakulā: tasyaivaṁ dadataḥ śāpaṁ śrutvā dvija-kulāya vai|
vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.bhavavratadharā ye ca ye ca tān samanuvr: bhava-vrata-dharā ye ca ye ca tān samanuvratāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.tadbrahma paramaṁ śuddhaṁ satāṁ vartma s: tad-brahma paramaṁ śuddhaṁ satāṁ vartma sanātanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.vigarhya yāta pāṣaṇḍaṁ daivaṁ vo yatra b: vigarhya yāta pāṣaṇḍaṁ daivaṁ vo yatra bhūta-rāṭ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.virajenātmanā sarve svaṁ svaṁ dhāma yayu: virajenātmanā sarve svaṁ svaṁ dhāma yayus-tataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0402_ill_feeling_betwee.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe dakṣa-śāpo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/0403_sati_insists_going.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe umā-rudra-saṁvāde tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/0404_sati_enters_fire.t.sva eva dharme na paraṁ kṣipetsthitaḥ||: sva eva dharme na paraṁ kṣipet-sthitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0404_sati_enters_fire.t.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe satī-dehotsargo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||

vishnu/bhagavata/0405_virabhadra_destroy.dṛṣṭvā saṁjñapanaṁ yogaṁ paśūnāṁ sa pati: dṛṣṭvā saṁjñapanaṁ yogaṁ paśūnāṁ sa patir-makhe|
vishnu/bhagavata/0405_virabhadra_destroy.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe dakṣa-yajña-vidhvaṁso nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||

vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.kṣemāya tatra sā bhūyānna prāyeṇa bubhūṣ: kṣemāya tatra sā bhūyān-na prāyeṇa bubhūṣatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.nāhaṁ na yajño na ca yūyamanye: nāhaṁ na yajño na ca yūyam-anye
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.dadṛśustatra te ramyāmalakāṁ nāma vai pu: dadṛśus-tatra te ramyām-alakāṁ nāma vai purīm|
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.vanaṁ saugandhikaṁ cāpi yatra tannāma pa: vanaṁ saugandhikaṁ cāpi yatra tan-nāma paṅkajam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.hitvā yakṣeśvarapurīṁ vanaṁ saugandhikaṁ: hitvā yakṣeśvara-purīṁ vanaṁ saugandhikaṁ ca tat|
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.kṛtvorau dakṣiṇe savyaṁ pādapadmaṁ ca jā: kṛtvorau dakṣiṇe savyaṁ pāda-padmaṁ ca jānuni|
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.śakteḥ śivasya ca paraṁ yattadbrahma nir: śakteḥ śivasya ca paraṁ yat-tad-brahma nirantaram||
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.bhṛgoḥ śmaśrūṇi rohantu pūṣṇo dantāśca p: bhṛgoḥ śmaśrūṇi rohantu pūṣṇo dantāś-ca pūrvavat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.eṣa te rudra bhāgo'stu yaducchiṣṭo'dhvar: eṣa te rudra bhāgo'stu yad-ucchiṣṭo'dhvarasya vai|
vishnu/bhagavata/0406_brahma_other_gods_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe rudra-sāntvanaṁ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6||

vishnu/bhagavata/0407_completion_daksa_s.devāḥ prakṛtasarvāṁgā ye ma uccheṣaṇaṁ d: devāḥ prakṛta-sarvāṁgā ye ma uccheṣaṇaṁ daduḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0407_completion_daksa_s.vidhāya kārtsnyena ca tadyadāha bhagavān: vidhāya kārtsnyena ca tad-yad-āha bhagavān bhavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0407_completion_daksa_s.nirguṇāya ca yatkāṣṭhāṁ nāhaṁ vedāpare'p: nirguṇāya ca yat-kāṣṭhāṁ nāhaṁ vedāpare'pi ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0407_completion_daksa_s.sa evādyākṣṇoryaḥ pathi carasi bhṛtyānav: sa evādyākṣṇor-yaḥ pathi carasi bhṛtyān-avasi naḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0407_completion_daksa_s.trayāṇāmekabhāvānāṁ yo na paśyati vai bh: trayāṇām-eka-bhāvānāṁ yo na paśyati vai bhidām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0407_completion_daksa_s.dharma eva matiṁ dattvā tridaśāste divaṁ: dharma eva matiṁ dattvā tridaśās-te divaṁ yayuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0407_completion_daksa_s.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe dakṣa-yajña-saṁdhānaṁ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.tābhyāṁ krodhaśca hiṁsā ca yadduruktiḥ s: tābhyāṁ krodhaś-ca hiṁsā ca yad-duruktiḥ svasā kaliḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.duruktau kalirādhatta bhayaṁ mṛtyuṁ ca s: duruktau kalir-ādhatta bhayaṁ mṛtyuṁ ca sattama|
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.na gṛhīto mayā yattvaṁ kukṣāvapi nṛpātma: na gṛhīto mayā yat-tvaṁ kukṣāv-api nṛpātmajaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.yatprasādaṁ sa vai puṁsāṁ durārādhyo mat: yat-prasādaṁ sa vai puṁsāṁ durārādhyo mato mama||
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.yasya yad daivavihitaṁ sa tena sukhaduḥk: yasya yad daiva-vihitaṁ sa tena sukha-duḥkhayoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.padaṁ tribhuvanotkṛṣṭaṁ jigīṣoḥ sādhu va: padaṁ tri-bhuvanotkṛṣṭaṁ jigīṣoḥ sādhu vartma me|
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.tattāta gaccha bhadraṁ te yamunāyāstaṭaṁ: tat-tāta gaccha bhadraṁ te yamunāyās-taṭaṁ śuci|
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.japyaśca paramo guhyaḥ śrūyatāṁ me nṛpāt: japyaś-ca paramo guhyaḥ śrūyatāṁ me nṛpātmaja|
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.yaṁ saptarātraṁ prapaṭhan pumān paśyati: yaṁ sapta-rātraṁ prapaṭhan pumān paśyati khecarān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.evaṁ kāyena manasā vacasā ca manogatam|: evaṁ kāyena manasā vacasā ca mano-gatam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0408_dhruva_goes_forest.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe dhruva-carite'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.sā brahmaṇi svamahimanyapi nātha mā bhūt: sā brahmaṇi sva-mahimany-api nātha mā bhūt
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.prasthite tu vanaṁ pitrā dattvā gāṁ dhar: prasthite tu vanaṁ pitrā dattvā gāṁ dharma-saṁśrayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.mātuḥ sapatnyā vāgbāṇairhṛdi viddhastu t: mātuḥ sapatnyā vāg-bāṇair-hṛdi viddhas-tu tān smaran|
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.svārājyaṁ yacchato mauḍhyānmāno me bhikṣ: svārājyaṁ yacchato mauḍhyān-māno me bhikṣito bata|
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.rājā na śraddadhe bhadramabhadrasya kuto: rājā na śraddadhe bhadram-abhadrasya kuto mama||
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.tasmai namanti bhūtāni nimnamāpa iva sva: tasmai namanti bhūtāni nimnam-āpa iva svayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.tāṁ śaśaṁsurjanā rājñīṁ diṣṭyā te putra: tāṁ śaśaṁsur-janā rājñīṁ diṣṭyā te putra ārtihā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.dhruvāya pathi dṛṣṭāya tatra tatra puras: dhruvāya pathi dṛṣṭāya tatra tatra pura-striyaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.vīkṣyoḍhavayasaṁ taṁ ca prakṛtīnāṁ ca sa: vīkṣyoḍha-vayasaṁ taṁ ca prakṛtīnāṁ ca sammatam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.anuraktaprajaṁ rājā dhruvaṁ cakre bhuvaḥ: anurakta-prajaṁ rājā dhruvaṁ cakre bhuvaḥ patim||
vishnu/bhagavata/0409_dhruva_receives_bo.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe dhruva-rājyābhiṣeka-varṇanaṁ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 9||

vishnu/bhagavata/0410_uttama_killed_dhru.te vai lalāṭalagnaistairiṣubhiḥ sarva ev: te vai lalāṭa-lagnais-tair-iṣubhiḥ sarva eva hi|
vishnu/bhagavata/0410_uttama_killed_dhru.tasya te cāpanirmuktā bhittvā varmāṇi ra: tasya te cāpa-nirmuktā bhittvā varmāṇi rakṣasām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0410_uttama_killed_dhru.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/0411_svayambhuva_manu_c.na vai svapakṣo'sya vipakṣa eva vā: na vai sva-pakṣo'sya vipakṣa eva vā
vishnu/bhagavata/0411_svayambhuva_manu_c.eke kālaṁ pare daivaṁ puṁsaḥ kāmamutāpar: eke kālaṁ pare daivaṁ puṁsaḥ kāmam-utāpare||
vishnu/bhagavata/0411_svayambhuva_manu_c.na vai cikīrṣitaṁ tāta ko vedātha svasam: na vai cikīrṣitaṁ tāta ko vedātha sva-sambhavam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0411_svayambhuva_manu_c.svaśaktyā māyayā yuktaḥ sṛjatyatti ca pā: sva-śaktyā māyayā yuktaḥ sṛjaty-atti ca pāti ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0411_svayambhuva_manu_c.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11||

vishnu/bhagavata/0412_kubera_boon_dhruva.ātiṣṭha jagatāṁ vandyaṁ tadviṣṇoḥ parama: ātiṣṭha jagatāṁ vandyaṁ tad-viṣṇoḥ paramaṁ padam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0412_kubera_boon_dhruva.sa ca svarlokamārokṣyan sunītiṁ jananīṁ: sa ca svarlokam-ārokṣyan sunītiṁ jananīṁ dhruvaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0412_kubera_boon_dhruva.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe dhruva-caritaṁ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12||

vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.puṣpārṇaṁ tigmaketuṁ ca iṣamūrjaṁ vasuṁ: puṣpārṇaṁ tigmaketuṁ ca iṣam-ūrjaṁ vasuṁ jayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.sa cakṣuḥ sutamākūtyāṁ patnyāṁ manumavāp: sa cakṣuḥ sutam-ākūtyāṁ patnyāṁ manum-avāpa ha|
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.puruṁ kutsaṁ tritaṁ dyumnaṁ satyavantamṛ: puruṁ kutsaṁ tritaṁ dyumnaṁ satyavantam-ṛtaṁ vratam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.yamaṅga śepuḥ kupitā vāgvajrā munayaḥ ki: yam-aṅga śepuḥ kupitā vāg-vajrā munayaḥ kila|
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.yanna gṛhṇanti bhāgān svān ye devāḥ karm: yanna gṛhṇanti bhāgān svān ye devāḥ karma-sākṣiṇaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.tāṁstān kāmān harirdadyādyān yān kāmayat: tāṁs-tān kāmān harir-dadyād-yān yān kāmayate janaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.sā tatpuṁsavanaṁ rājñī prāśya vai patyur: sā tat-puṁsavanaṁ rājñī prāśya vai patyur-ādadhe|
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.kadapatyabhṛtaṁ duḥkhaṁ ye na vindanti d: kadapatya-bhṛtaṁ duḥkhaṁ ye na vindanti durbharam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.paṇḍito bahu manyeta yadarthāḥ kleśadā g: paṇḍito bahu manyeta yad-arthāḥ kleśa-dā gṛhāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0413_line_dhruva_story_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 13||

vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.nirūpitaḥ prajāpālaḥ sa jighāṁsati vai p: nirūpitaḥ prajā-pālaḥ sa jighāṁsati vai prajāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.sāntvito yadi no vācaṁ na grahīṣyatyadha: sāntvito yadi no vācaṁ na grahīṣyaty-adharma-kṛt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.sa te mā vinaśedvīra prajānāṁ kṣemalakṣa: sa te mā vinaśedvīra prajānāṁ kṣema-lakṣaṇaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.rakṣan yathā baliṁ gṛhṇanniha pretya ca: rakṣan yathā baliṁ gṛhṇann-iha pretya ca modate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.yasya rāṣṭre pure caiva bhagavān yajñapū: yasya rāṣṭre pure caiva bhagavān yajña-pūruṣaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.bāliśā bata yūyaṁ vā adharme dharmamānin: bāliśā bata yūyaṁ vā adharme dharma-māninaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.ye vṛttidaṁ patiṁ hitvā jāraṁ patimupāsa: ye vṛttidaṁ patiṁ hitvā jāraṁ patim-upāsate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.nānuvindanti te bhadramiha loke paratra: nānuvindanti te bhadram-iha loke paratra ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.ko yajñapuruṣo nāma yatra vo bhaktirīdṛś: ko yajña-puruṣo nāma yatra vo bhaktir-īdṛśī|
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.ete cānye ca vibudhāḥ prabhavo varaśāpay: ete cānye ca vibudhāḥ prabhavo vara-śāpayoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.baliṁ ca mahyaṁ harata matto'nyaḥ ko'gra: baliṁ ca mahyaṁ harata matto'nyaḥ ko'gra-bhuk pumān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0414_story_king_vena.tx.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe pṛthu-carite niṣādotpattir-nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 14||

vishnu/bhagavata/0415_appearance_coronat.praśaṁsanti sma taṁ viprā gandharvaprava: praśaṁsanti sma taṁ viprā gandharva-pravarā jaguḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0415_appearance_coronat.mumucuḥ sumanodhārāḥ siddhā nṛtyanti sva: mumucuḥ sumano-dhārāḥ siddhā nṛtyanti svaḥ striyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0415_appearance_coronat.vainyasya dakṣiṇe haste dṛṣṭvā cihnaṁ ga: vainyasya dakṣiṇe haste dṛṣṭvā cihnaṁ gadā-bhṛtaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0415_appearance_coronat.pādayoraravindaṁ ca taṁ vai mene hareḥ k: pādayor-aravindaṁ ca taṁ vai mene hareḥ kalām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0415_appearance_coronat.saritsamudrā girayo nāgā gāvaḥ khagā mṛg: sarit-samudrā girayo nāgā gāvaḥ khagā mṛgāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0415_appearance_coronat.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe pṛthu-carite pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 15||

vishnu/bhagavata/0416_bards_praise_king_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 16||

vishnu/bhagavata/0417_king_prthu_angry_e.evaṁ sa bhagavān vainyaḥ khyāpito guṇaka: evaṁ sa bhagavān vainyaḥ khyāpito guṇa-karmabhiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0417_king_prthu_angry_e.yāṁ dudoha pṛthustatra ko vatso dohanaṁ: yāṁ dudoha pṛthus-tatra ko vatso dohanaṁ ca kim||
vishnu/bhagavata/0417_king_prthu_angry_e.tasya medhyaṁ hayaṁ devaḥ kasya hetorapā: tasya medhyaṁ hayaṁ devaḥ kasya hetor-apāharat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0417_king_prthu_angry_e.ahaniṣyatkathaṁ yoṣāṁ dharmajña iti yo m: ahaniṣyat-kathaṁ yoṣāṁ dharmajña iti yo mataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0417_king_prthu_angry_e.praharanti na vai strīṣu kṛtāgaḥsvapi ja: praharanti na vai strīṣu kṛtāgaḥsv-api jantavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0417_king_prthu_angry_e.tasyāmevaṁ hi duṣṭāyāṁ daṇḍo nātra na śa: tasyām-evaṁ hi duṣṭāyāṁ daṇḍo nātra na śasyate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0417_king_prthu_angry_e.tvāṁ stabdhāṁ durmadāṁ nītvā māyāgāṁ til: tvāṁ stabdhāṁ durmadāṁ nītvā māyā-gāṁ tilaśaḥ śaraiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0417_king_prthu_angry_e.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe pṛthu-vijaye dharitrī-nigraho nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 17||

vishnu/bhagavata/0418_milking_earth.txt.purā sṛṣṭā hyoṣadhayo brahmaṇā yā viśāmp: purā sṛṣṭā hy-oṣadhayo brahmaṇā yā viśāmpate|
vishnu/bhagavata/0418_milking_earth.txt.samāṁ ca kuru māṁ rājandevavṛṣṭaṁ yathā: samāṁ ca kuru māṁ rājan-deva-vṛṣṭaṁ yathā payaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0418_milking_earth.txt.apartāvapi bhadraṁ te upāvarteta me vibh: apartāv-api bhadraṁ te upāvarteta me vibho||
vishnu/bhagavata/0418_milking_earth.txt.tathā pare ca sarvatra sāramādadate budh: tathā pare ca sarvatra sāram-ādadate budhāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0418_milking_earth.txt.paśavo yavasaṁ kṣīraṁ vatsaṁ kṛtvā ca go: paśavo yavasaṁ kṣīraṁ vatsaṁ kṛtvā ca go-vṛṣam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0418_milking_earth.txt.sarve svamukhyavatsena sve sve pātre pṛt: sarve sva-mukhya-vatsena sve sve pātre pṛthak payaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0418_milking_earth.txt.athāsmin bhagavān vainyaḥ prajānāṁ vṛtti: athāsmin bhagavān vainyaḥ prajānāṁ vṛtti-daḥ pitā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0418_milking_earth.txt.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe pṛthu-vijaye'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 18||

vishnu/bhagavata/0419_hundred_asvamedha_.so'śvaṁ rūpaṁ ca taddhitvā tasthāvantarh: so'śvaṁ rūpaṁ ca taddhitvā tasthāv-antarhitaḥ svarāṭ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0419_hundred_asvamedha_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe pṛthu-vijaye ekona-viṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 19||

vishnu/bhagavata/0420_sri_visnu_appears_.śrama eva paraṁ jāto dīrghayā vṛddhaseva: śrama eva paraṁ jāto dīrghayā vṛddha-sevayā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0420_sri_visnu_appears_.apatye draviṇe vāpi kaḥ kuryānmamatāṁ bu: apatye draviṇe vāpi kaḥ kuryān-mamatāṁ budhaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0420_sri_visnu_appears_.nājyate prakṛtistho'pi tadguṇaiḥ sa mayi: nājyate prakṛti-stho'pi tad-guṇaiḥ sa mayi sthitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0420_sri_visnu_appears_.avyaktāya ca devānāṁ devāya svapuraṁ yay: avyaktāya ca devānāṁ devāya sva-puraṁ yayau||
vishnu/bhagavata/0420_sri_visnu_appears_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyā saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe viṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 20||

vishnu/bhagavata/0421_king_prthu_teachin.bibhrat sa vaiṣṇavaṁ tejo bāhvoryābhyāṁ: bibhrat sa vaiṣṇavaṁ tejo bāhvor-yābhyāṁ dudoha gām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0421_king_prthu_teachin.rakṣitā vṛttidaḥ sveṣu setuṣu sthāpitā p: rakṣitā vṛtti-daḥ sveṣu setuṣu sthāpitā pṛthak||
vishnu/bhagavata/0421_king_prthu_teachin.lokāḥ syuḥ kāmasandohā yasya tuṣyati diṣ: lokāḥ syuḥ kāma-sandohā yasya tuṣyati diṣṭa-dṛk||
vishnu/bhagavata/0421_king_prthu_teachin.vīravarya pitaḥ pṛthvyāḥ samāḥ saṁjīva ś: vīra-varya pitaḥ pṛthvyāḥ samāḥ saṁjīva śāśvatīḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0421_king_prthu_teachin.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe eka-viṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 21||

vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.yasya vo darśanaṁ hyāsīddurdarśānāṁ ca y: yasya vo darśanaṁ hy-āsīd-durdarśānāṁ ca yogibhiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.kiṁ tasya durlabhataramiha loke paratra: kiṁ tasya durlabhataram-iha loke paratra ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.yasya viprāḥ prasīdanti śivo viṣṇuśca sā: yasya viprāḥ prasīdanti śivo viṣṇuś-ca sānugaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.yathā sarvadṛśaṁ sarva ātmānaṁ ye'sya he: yathā sarva-dṛśaṁ sarva ātmānaṁ ye'sya hetavaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.tat tvaṁ narendra jagatāmatha tasthuṣāṁ: tat tvaṁ narendra jagatām-atha tasthuṣāṁ ca
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.sādhūcchiṣṭaṁ hi me sarvamātmanā saha ki: sādhūcchiṣṭaṁ hi me sarvam-ātmanā saha kiṁ dade||
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.prāṇā dārāḥ sutā brahman gṛhāśca saparic: prāṇā dārāḥ sutā brahman gṛhāś-ca saparicchadāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.saināpatyaṁ ca rājyaṁ ca daṇḍanetṛtvamev: saināpatyaṁ ca rājyaṁ ca daṇḍa-netṛtvam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.svameva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṁ vaste svaṁ: svam-eva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṁ vaste svaṁ dadāti ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0422_sanaka_other_sages.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe pṛthu-carite dvāviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 22||

vishnu/bhagavata/0423_austerities_king_p.brahmabhūto dṛḍhaṁ kāle tatyāja svaṁ kal: brahma-bhūto dṛḍhaṁ kāle tatyāja svaṁ kalevaram||
vishnu/bhagavata/0423_austerities_king_p.aho iyaṁ vadhūrdhanyā yā caiva bhūbhujāṁ: aho iyaṁ vadhūr-dhanyā yā caiva bhūbhujāṁ patim|
vishnu/bhagavata/0423_austerities_king_p.saiṣā nūnaṁ vrajatyūrdhvamanu vainyaṁ pa: saiṣā nūnaṁ vrajaty-ūrdhvam-anu vainyaṁ patiṁ satī|
vishnu/bhagavata/0423_austerities_king_p.bhuvi lolāyuṣo ye vai naiṣkarmyaṁ sādhay: bhuvi lolāyuṣo ye vai naiṣkarmyaṁ sādhayanty-uta||
vishnu/bhagavata/0423_austerities_king_p.sa vaṁcito batātmadhruk kṛcchreṇa mahatā: sa vaṁcito batātma-dhruk kṛcchreṇa mahatā bhuvi|
vishnu/bhagavata/0423_austerities_king_p.yaṁ vā ātmavidāṁ dhuryo vainyaḥ prāpācyu: yaṁ vā ātma-vidāṁ dhuryo vainyaḥ prāpācyutāśayaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0423_austerities_king_p.baliṁ tasmai harantyagre rājānaḥ pṛthave: baliṁ tasmai haranty-agre rājānaḥ pṛthave yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0423_austerities_king_p.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe trayoviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 23||

vishnu/bhagavata/0424_descendants_prthu_.barhiṣadaṁ gayaṁ śuklaṁ kṛṣṇaṁ satyaṁ ji: barhiṣadaṁ gayaṁ śuklaṁ kṛṣṇaṁ satyaṁ jita-vratam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0424_descendants_prthu_.nama ūrja iṣe trayyāḥ pataye yajñaretase: nama ūrja iṣe trayyāḥ pataye yajña-retase|
vishnu/bhagavata/0424_descendants_prthu_.tat tvaṁ brahma paraṁ jyotirākāśamiva vi: tat tvaṁ brahma paraṁ jyotir-ākāśam-iva vistṛtam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0424_descendants_prthu_.atha tvamasi no brahman paramātman vipaś: atha tvam-asi no brahman paramātman vipaścitām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0424_descendants_prthu_.idaṁ japata bhadraṁ vo viśuddhā nṛpanand: idaṁ japata bhadraṁ vo viśuddhā nṛpa-nandanāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0424_descendants_prthu_.te vayaṁ noditāḥ sarve prajāsarge prajeś: te vayaṁ noditāḥ sarve prajā-sarge prajeśvarāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0424_descendants_prthu_.ya imaṁ śraddhayā yukto madgītaṁ bhagava: ya imaṁ śraddhayā yukto mad-gītaṁ bhagavat-stavam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0424_descendants_prthu_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe rudra-gītaṁ nāma caturviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 24||

vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.na paraṁ vindate mūḍho bhrāmyan saṁsārav: na paraṁ vindate mūḍho bhrāmyan saṁsāra-vartmasu||
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.kā tvaṁ kañjapalāśākṣi kasyāsīha kutaḥ s: kā tvaṁ kañja-palāśākṣi kasyāsīha kutaḥ sati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.imāmupapurīṁ bhīru kiṁ cikīrṣasi śaṁsa m: imām-upapurīṁ bhīru kiṁ cikīrṣasi śaṁsa me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.ka ete'nupathā ye ta ekādaśa mahābhaṭāḥ|: ka ete'nupathā ye ta ekādaśa mahā-bhaṭāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.ātmanaśca parasyāpi gotraṁ nāma ca yatkṛ: ātmanaś-ca parasyāpi gotraṁ nāma ca yat-kṛtam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.ihādya santamātmānaṁ vidāma na tataḥ par: ihādya santam-ātmānaṁ vidāma na tataḥ param|
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.ete sakhāyaḥ sakhyo me narā nāryaśca mān: ete sakhāyaḥ sakhyo me narā nāryaś-ca mānada|
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.kā nāma vīra vikhyātaṁ vadānyaṁ priyadar: kā nāma vīra vikhyātaṁ vadānyaṁ priya-darśanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.tāṁ praviśya purīṁ rājanmumudāte śataṁ s: tāṁ praviśya purīṁ rājan-mumudāte śataṁ samāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.saptopari kṛtā dvāraḥ purastasyāstu dve: saptopari kṛtā dvāraḥ puras-tasyās-tu dve adhaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.āsurī nāma paścād dvāstayā yāti puraṁjan: āsurī nāma paścād dvās-tayā yāti puraṁjanaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0425_beginning_story_pu.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe puraṁjanopākhyāne pañcaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 25||

vishnu/bhagavata/0426_king_puranjana_goe.yadi na syād gṛhe mātā patnī vā patideva: yadi na syād gṛhe mātā patnī vā pati-devatā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0426_king_puranjana_goe.yā māmuddharate prajñāṁ dīpayantī pade p: yā mām-uddharate prajñāṁ dīpayantī pade pade||
vishnu/bhagavata/0426_king_puranjana_goe.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe puraṁjanopākhyāne ṣaḍviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 26||

vishnu/bhagavata/0427_candavega_attacks_.āsasāda sa vai kālo yo'priyaḥ priyayoṣit: āsasāda sa vai kālo yo'priyaḥ priya-yoṣitām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0427_candavega_attacks_.sa saptabhiḥ śataireko viṁśatyā ca śataṁ: sa saptabhiḥ śatair-eko viṁśatyā ca śataṁ samāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0427_candavega_attacks_.sa eva puryāṁ madhubhuk paṁcāleṣu svapār: sa eva puryāṁ madhu-bhuk paṁcāleṣu sva-pārṣadaiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0427_candavega_attacks_.yā tuṣṭā rājarṣaye tu vṛtādātpūrave vara: yā tuṣṭā rājarṣaye tu vṛtādāt-pūrave varam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0427_candavega_attacks_.vavre bṛhadvrataṁ māṁ tu jānatī kāmamohi: vavre bṛhad-vrataṁ māṁ tu jānatī kāma-mohitā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0427_candavega_attacks_.saṅkalpastvayi bhūtānāṁ kṛtaḥ kila na ri: saṅkalpas-tvayi bhūtānāṁ kṛtaḥ kila na riṣyati||
vishnu/bhagavata/0427_candavega_attacks_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ caturtha-skandhe puraṁjanopākhyāne saptaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 27||

vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.ta ekadā tu rabhasā puraṁjanapurīṁ nṛpa|: ta ekadā tu rabhasā puraṁjana-purīṁ nṛpa|
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.dadāha tāṁ purīṁ kṛtsnāṁ bhrātuḥ priyaci: dadāha tāṁ purīṁ kṛtsnāṁ bhrātuḥ priya-cikīrṣayā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.na mayyanāśite bhuṅkte nāsnāte snāti mat: na mayy-anāśite bhuṅkte nāsnāte snāti mat-parā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.yadā tamevānu purī viśīrṇā prakṛtiṁ gatā: yadā tam-evānu purī viśīrṇā prakṛtiṁ gatā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.haṁsāvahaṁ ca tvaṁ cārya sakhāyau mānasā: haṁsāv-ahaṁ ca tvaṁ cārya sakhāyau mānasāyanau|
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.sa tvaṁ vihāya māṁ bandho gato grāmyamat: sa tvaṁ vihāya māṁ bandho gato grāmya-matir-mahīm|
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.na tvaṁ vidarbhaduhitā nāyaṁ vīraḥ suhṛt: na tvaṁ vidarbha-duhitā nāyaṁ vīraḥ suhṛt-tava|
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.na patistvaṁ puraṁjanyā ruddho navamukhe: na patis-tvaṁ puraṁjanyā ruddho nava-mukhe yayā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.māyā hyeṣā mayā sṛṣṭā yatpumāṁsaṁ striya: māyā hyeṣā mayā sṛṣṭā yat-pumāṁsaṁ striyaṁ satīm|
vishnu/bhagavata/0428_puranjana_born_wom.ahaṁ bhavānna cānyastvaṁ tvamevāhaṁ vica: ahaṁ bhavān-na cānyas-tvaṁ tvam-evāhaṁ vicakṣva bhoḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.narakā nāma bhagavan kiṁ deśaviśeṣā atha: narakā nāma bhagavan kiṁ deśa-viśeṣā athavā

vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.daṇḍaṁ praṇayati brāhmaṇe vā śarīradaṇḍa: daṇḍaṁ praṇayati brāhmaṇe vā śarīra-daṇḍaṁ sa
vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.sa paratra kṛmibhojane narakādhame nipat: sa paratra kṛmi-bhojane narakādhame nipatati tatra

vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.ye tviha vai dāmbhikā dambhayajñeṣu paśū: ye tviha vai dāmbhikā dambha-yajñeṣu paśūn
vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.yastviha vai savarṇāṁ bhāryāṁ dvijo reta: yas-tv-iha vai savarṇāṁ bhāryāṁ dvijo retaḥ pāyayati

vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.tāṁścāpi hi paretya yamadūtā vajradaṁṣṭr: tāṁś-cāpi hi paretya yama-dūtā vajra-daṁṣṭrāḥ śvānaḥ
vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.yastviha vā anṛtaṁ vadati sākṣye dravya-: yas-tv-iha vā anṛtaṁ vadati sākṣye dravya-
vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.yastviha vai vipro rājanyo vaiśyo vā: yas-tv-iha vai vipro rājanyo vaiśyo vā

vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.sahasraśasteṣu sarveṣu ca sarva evādharm: sahasraśas-teṣu sarveṣu ca sarva evādharma-vartino ye
vishnu/bhagavata/0526_various_courses_he.sthūle nirjitamātmānaṁ śanaiḥ sūkṣmaṁ dh: sthūle nirjitam-ātmānaṁ śanaiḥ sūkṣmaṁ dhiyā nayed-iti||
