vishnu/bhagavata/0607_brhaspati_leaves_g.prakṣīṇebhyaḥ svavairibhyaḥ samṛddhānāṁ: prakṣīṇebhyaḥ sva-vairibhyaḥ samṛddhānāṁ ca yat surāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0607_brhaspati_leaves_g.vayaṁ te'tithayaḥ prāptā āśramaṁ bhadram: vayaṁ te'tithayaḥ prāptā āśramaṁ bhadram-astu te|
vishnu/bhagavata/0607_brhaspati_leaves_g.putrāṇāṁ hi paro dharmaḥ pitṛśuśrūṣaṇaṁ: putrāṇāṁ hi paro dharmaḥ pitṛ-śuśrūṣaṇaṁ satām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0607_brhaspati_leaves_g.tāṁ prāha sa mahendrāya viśvarūpa udārad: tāṁ prāha sa mahendrāya viśvarūpa udāra-dhīḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0607_brhaspati_leaves_g.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/0608_teaching_narayana_.ṣakāraṁ tu bhruvormadhye ṇakāraṁ śikhayā: ṣakāraṁ tu bhruvor-madhye ṇakāraṁ śikhayā diśet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0608_teaching_narayana_.prayāntu saṁkṣayaṁ sadyo ye naḥ śreyaḥpr: prayāntu saṁkṣayaṁ sadyo ye naḥ śreyaḥ-pratīpakāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0608_teaching_narayana_.yathā hi bhagavāneva vastutaḥ sadasacca: yathā hi bhagavān-eva vastutaḥ sad-asac-ca yat|
vishnu/bhagavata/0608_teaching_narayana_.pātu sarvaiḥ svarūpairnaḥ sadā sarvatra: pātu sarvaiḥ svarūpair-naḥ sadā sarvatra sarvagaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0608_teaching_narayana_.etad dhārayamāṇastu yaṁ yaṁ paśyati cakṣ: etad dhārayamāṇas-tu yaṁ yaṁ paśyati cakṣuṣā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0608_teaching_narayana_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe nārāyaṇa-varma-kathanaṁ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.sa vai barhiṣi devebhyo bhāgaṁ pratyakṣa: sa vai barhiṣi devebhyo bhāgaṁ pratyakṣam-uccakaiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.sa eva hi dadau bhāgaṁ parokṣamasurān pr: sa eva hi dadau bhāgaṁ parokṣam-asurān prati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.somapīthaṁ tu yat tasya śira āsīt kapiñj: soma-pīthaṁ tu yat tasya śira āsīt kapiñjalaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.indraśatro vivardhasva mā ciraṁ jahi vid: indra-śatro vivardhasva mā ciraṁ jahi vidviṣam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.vitrastā dudruvurlokā vīkṣya sarve diśo: vitrastā dudruvur-lokā vīkṣya sarve diśo daśa||
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.sa vai vṛtra iti proktaḥ pāpaḥ paramadār: sa vai vṛtra iti proktaḥ pāpaḥ parama-dāruṇaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.namaste yajñavīryāya vayase uta te namaḥ: namaste yajña-vīryāya vayase uta te namaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.yat te gatīnāṁ tisṝṇāmīśituḥ paramaṁ pad: yat te gatīnāṁ tisṝṇām-īśituḥ paramaṁ padam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.samañjasadarśana udāsta iti ha vāva na: samañjasa-darśana udāsta iti ha vāva na
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.ko nvartho durghaṭa iva bhavati svarūpad: ko nv-artho durghaṭa iva bhavati svarūpa-dvayābhāvāt
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.sa eva hi punaḥ sarvavastuni vastusvarūp: sa eva hi punaḥ sarva-vastuni vastu-svarūpaḥ
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.nirvṛtamanasaḥ kathamu ha vā ete madhuma: nirvṛta-manasaḥ katham-u ha vā ete madhu-mathana
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.atho īśa jahi tvāṣṭraṁ grasantaṁ bhuvana: atho īśa jahi tvāṣṭraṁ grasantaṁ bhuvana-trayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.grastāni yena naḥ kṛṣṇa tejāṁsyastrāyudh: grastāni yena naḥ kṛṣṇa tejāṁsy-astrāyudhāni ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.na veda kṛpaṇaḥ śreya ātmano guṇavastudṛ: na veda kṛpaṇaḥ śreya ātmano guṇa-vastu-dṛk|
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.tasya tānicchato yacched yadi so'pi tath: tasya tān-icchato yacched yadi so'pi tathāvidhaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.svayaṁ niḥśreyasaṁ vidvān na vaktyajñāya: svayaṁ niḥśreyasaṁ vidvān na vakty-ajñāya karma hi|
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.yad vā aśvaśiro nāma tayoramaratāṁ vyadh: yad vā aśva-śiro nāma tayor-amaratāṁ vyadhāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.viśvarūpāya yat prādāt tvaṣṭā yat tvamad: viśvarūpāya yat prādāt tvaṣṭā yat tvam-adhās-tataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.bhūyaḥ prāpsyatha bhadraṁ vo na hiṁsanti: bhūyaḥ prāpsyatha bhadraṁ vo na hiṁsanti ca mat-parān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0609_slaying_visvarupa_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe navamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 9||

vishnu/bhagavata/0610_gods_make_vajra_bo.nanu svārthaparo loko na veda parasaṁkaṭ: nanu svārtha-paro loko na veda para-saṁkaṭam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0610_gods_make_vajra_bo.dharmaṁ vaḥ śrotukāmena yūyaṁ me pratyud: dharmaṁ vaḥ śrotu-kāmena yūyaṁ me pratyudāhṛtāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0610_gods_make_vajra_bo.dṛṣṭvā vajradharaṁ śakraṁ rocamānaṁ svay: dṛṣṭvā vajra-dharaṁ śakraṁ rocamānaṁ svayā śriyā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0610_gods_make_vajra_bo.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe indra-vṛtrāsura-yuddha-varṇanaṁ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/0611_heroic_words_vrtra.ta evaṁ śaṁsato dharmaṁ vacaḥ patyuracet: ta evaṁ śaṁsato dharmaṁ vacaḥ patyur-acetasaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0611_heroic_words_vrtra.na hi bhītavadhaḥ ślāghyo na svargyaḥ śū: na hi bhīta-vadhaḥ ślāghyo na svargyaḥ śūra-māninām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0611_heroic_words_vrtra.agre tiṣṭhata mātraṁ me na ced grāmyasuk: agre tiṣṭhata mātraṁ me na ced grāmya-sukhe spṛhā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0611_heroic_words_vrtra.evaṁ suragaṇān kruddho bhīṣayan vapuṣā r: evaṁ sura-gaṇān kruddho bhīṣayan vapuṣā ripūn|
vishnu/bhagavata/0611_heroic_words_vrtra.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe vṛtrasyendropadeśo nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11||

vishnu/bhagavata/0612_slaying_vrtrasura..ojaḥ saho balaṁ prāṇamamṛtaṁ mṛtyumeva c: ojaḥ saho balaṁ prāṇam-amṛtaṁ mṛtyum-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0612_slaying_vrtrasura..tatra sākṣiṇamātmānaṁ yo veda na sa badh: tatra sākṣiṇam-ātmānaṁ yo veda na sa badhyate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0612_slaying_vrtrasura..paśya māṁ nirjitaṁ śakra vṛkṇāyudhabhuja: paśya māṁ nirjitaṁ śakra vṛkṇāyudha-bhujaṁ mṛdhe|
vishnu/bhagavata/0612_slaying_vrtrasura..aho dānava siddho'si yasya te matirīdṛśī: aho dānava siddho'si yasya te matir-īdṛśī|
vishnu/bhagavata/0612_slaying_vrtrasura..chinnapakṣo yathā gotraḥ khād bhraṣṭo va: chinna-pakṣo yathā gotraḥ khād bhraṣṭo vajriṇā hataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0612_slaying_vrtrasura..kṛtvādharāṁ hanuṁ bhūmau daityo divyutta: kṛtvādharāṁ hanuṁ bhūmau daityo divy-uttarāṁ hanum|
vishnu/bhagavata/0612_slaying_vrtrasura..bhittvā vajreṇa tatkukṣiṁ niṣkramya bala: bhittvā vajreṇa tat-kukṣiṁ niṣkramya balabhid vibhuḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0612_slaying_vrtrasura..iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe vṛtra-vadho nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12||

vishnu/bhagavata/0613_sin_killing_brahma.vṛtre hate trayo lokā vinā śakreṇa bhūri: vṛtre hate trayo lokā vinā śakreṇa bhūri-da|
vishnu/bhagavata/0613_sin_killing_brahma.yājayiṣyāma bhadraṁ te hayamedhena mā sm: yājayiṣyāma bhadraṁ te haya-medhena mā sma bhaiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0613_sin_killing_brahma.hrīmantaṁ vācyatāṁ prāptaṁ sukhayantyapi: hrīmantaṁ vācyatāṁ prāptaṁ sukhayanty-api no guṇāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0613_sin_killing_brahma.prāgudīcīṁ diśaṁ tūrṇaṁ praviṣṭo nṛpa mā: prāg-udīcīṁ diśaṁ tūrṇaṁ praviṣṭo nṛpa mānasam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0613_sin_killing_brahma.sa vai tvāṣṭravadho bhūyānapi pāpacayo n: sa vai tvāṣṭra-vadho bhūyān-api pāpa-cayo nṛpa|
vishnu/bhagavata/0613_sin_killing_brahma.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe indra-vijayo nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 13||

vishnu/bhagavata/0614_earlier_life_vrtra.itthaṁ dṛḍhamatiḥ kṛṣṇa āsīt saṁgrāma ul: itthaṁ dṛḍha-matiḥ kṛṣṇa āsīt saṁgrāma ulbaṇe||
vishnu/bhagavata/0614_earlier_life_vrtra.sāntānikaścāpi nṛpo na lebhe tāsu santat: sāntānikaś-cāpi nṛpo na lebhe tāsu santatim||
vishnu/bhagavata/0614_earlier_life_vrtra.na tasya saṁpadaḥ sarvā mahiṣyo vāmaloca: na tasya saṁpadaḥ sarvā mahiṣyo vāma-locanāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0614_earlier_life_vrtra.tataḥ pāhi mahābhāga pūrvaiḥ saha gataṁ: tataḥ pāhi mahā-bhāga pūrvaiḥ saha gataṁ tamaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0614_earlier_life_vrtra.grāmān hayān gajān prādād dhenūnāmarbudā: grāmān hayān gajān prādād dhenūnām-arbudāni ṣaṭ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0614_earlier_life_vrtra.tvaṁ tāta nārhasi ca māṁ kṛpaṇāmanāthāṁ: tvaṁ tāta nārhasi ca māṁ kṛpaṇām-anāthāṁ
vishnu/bhagavata/0614_earlier_life_vrtra.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe citraketu-vilāpo nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 14||

vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.ko'yaṁ syāt tava rājendra bhavān yamanuś: ko'yaṁ syāt tava rājendra bhavān yam-anuśocati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.tvaṁ cāsya katamaḥ sṛṣṭau puredānīmataḥ: tvaṁ cāsya katamaḥ sṛṣṭau puredānīm-ataḥ param||
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.vayaṁ ca tvaṁ ca ye ceme tulyakālāścarāc: vayaṁ ca tvaṁ ca ye ceme tulya-kālāś-carācarāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.bījādeva yathā bījaṁ dehyartha iva śāśva: bījād-eva yathā bījaṁ dehy-artha iva śāśvataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.kau yuvāṁ jñānasampannau mahiṣṭhau ca ma: kau yuvāṁ jñāna-sampannau mahiṣṭhau ca mahīyasām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.itthaṁ tvāṁ putraśokena magnaṁ tamasi du: itthaṁ tvāṁ putra-śokena magnaṁ tamasi dustare|
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.tadaiva te paraṁ jñānaṁ dadāmi gṛhamāgat: tadaiva te paraṁ jñānaṁ dadāmi gṛham-āgataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.mahī rājyaṁ balaṁ kośo bhṛtyāmātyāḥ suhṛ: mahī rājyaṁ balaṁ kośo bhṛtyāmātyāḥ suhṛj-janāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.yāṁ dhārayan saptarātrād draṣṭā saṅkarṣa: yāṁ dhārayan sapta-rātrād draṣṭā saṅkarṣaṇaṁ prabhum||
vishnu/bhagavata/0615_angira_narada_teac.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe citraketu-sāntvanaṁ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 15||

vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.yāvadyasya hi sambandho mamatvaṁ tāvadev: yāvad-yasya hi sambandho mamatvaṁ tāvad-eva hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.evaṁ yonigato jīvaḥ sa nityo nirahaṅkṛta: evaṁ yoni-gato jīvaḥ sa nityo nirahaṅkṛtaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.na hyasyātipriyaḥ kaścinnāpriyaḥ svaḥ pa: na hy-asyātipriyaḥ kaścin-nāpriyaḥ svaḥ paro'pi vā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.nādatta ātmā hi guṇaṁ na doṣaṁ na kriyāp: nādatta ātmā hi guṇaṁ na doṣaṁ na kriyā-phalam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.ityudīrya gato jīvo jñātayastasya te tad: ity-udīrya gato jīvo jñātayas-tasya te tadā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.śabdabrahma paraṁ brahma mamobhe śāśvatī: śabda-brahma paraṁ brahma mamobhe śāśvatī tanū||
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.sukhaṁ ca nirguṇaṁ brahma tamātmānamaveh: sukhaṁ ca nirguṇaṁ brahma tam-ātmānam-avehi mām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.anveti vyatiricyeta tajjñānaṁ brahma tat: anveti vyatiricyeta taj-jñānaṁ brahma tat param||
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.ātmānaṁ yo na buddhyeta na kvacicchamamā: ātmānaṁ yo na buddhyeta na kvacicchamam-āpnuyāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0616_citraketu_renuncia.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe citraketoḥ paramātma-darśanaṁ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 16||

vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.aṅkīkṛtya striyaṁ cāste gatahrīḥ prākṛto: aṅkīkṛtya striyaṁ cāste gata-hrīḥ prākṛto yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.ayaṁ kimadhunā loke śāstā daṇḍadharaḥ pr: ayaṁ kim-adhunā loke śāstā daṇḍa-dharaḥ prabhuḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.devairmartyāya yatproktaṁ pūrvadiṣṭaṁ hi: devair-martyāya yat-proktaṁ pūrva-diṣṭaṁ hi tasya tat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.naivātmā na paraścāpi kartā syāt sukhadu: naivātmā na paraścāpi kartā syāt sukha-duḥkhayoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.guṇapravāha etasmin kaḥ śāpaḥ ko nvanugr: guṇa-pravāha etasmin kaḥ śāpaḥ ko nv-anugrahaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.kaḥ svargo narakaḥ ko vā kiṁ sukhaṁ duḥk: kaḥ svargo narakaḥ ko vā kiṁ sukhaṁ duḥkham-eva vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.na jñātibandhurna paro na ca svaḥ|: na jñāti-bandhur-na paro na ca svaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.atha prasādaye na tvāṁ śāpamokṣāya bhāmi: atha prasādaye na tvāṁ śāpa-mokṣāya bhāmini|
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ mṛtirjanma śāpo'nugraha e: sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ mṛtir-janma śāpo'nugraha eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.na hyasyāsti priyaḥ kaścinnāpriyaḥ svaḥ: na hy-asyāsti priyaḥ kaścin-nāpriyaḥ svaḥ paro'pi vā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0617_parvati_curses_cit.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe citraketu-śāpo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 17||

vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.pṛśnistu patnī savituḥ sāvitrīṁ vyāhṛtiṁ: pṛśnis-tu patnī savituḥ sāvitrīṁ vyāhṛtiṁ trayīm|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.paulomyāmindra ādhatta trīn putrāniti na: paulomyām-indra ādhatta trīn putrān-iti naḥ śrutam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.yatra bhāgavataḥ śrīmān prahrādo balirev: yatra bhāgavataḥ śrīmān prahrādo balir-eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.ta āsannaprajāḥ sarve nītā indreṇa sātma: ta āsann-aprajāḥ sarve nītā indreṇa sātmatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.indreṇa prāpitāḥ sātmyaṁ kiṁ tatsādhu kṛ: indreṇa prāpitāḥ sātmyaṁ kiṁ tat-sādhu kṛtaṁ hi taiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.ime śraddadhate brahmannṛṣayo hi mayā sa: ime śraddadhate brahmann-ṛṣayo hi mayā saha|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.bhūtadhruk tatkṛte svārthaṁ kiṁ veda nir: bhūta-dhruk tat-kṛte svārthaṁ kiṁ veda nirayo yataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.madaśoṣaka indrasya bhūyādyena suto hi m: mada-śoṣaka indrasya bhūyād-yena suto hi me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.bāḍhamityāha vivaśo na taccitraṁ hi yoṣi: bāḍham-ity-āha vivaśo na tac-citraṁ hi yoṣiti||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.striyaṁ cakre svadehārdhaṁ yayā puṁsāṁ m: striyaṁ cakre svadehārdhaṁ yayā puṁsāṁ matir-hṛtā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.patireva hi nārīṇāṁ daivataṁ paramaṁ smṛ: patir-eva hi nārīṇāṁ daivataṁ paramaṁ smṛtam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.varado yadi me brahman putramindrahaṇaṁ: varado yadi me brahman putram-indra-haṇaṁ vṛṇe|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.amṛtyuṁ mṛtaputrāhaṁ yena me ghātitau su: amṛtyuṁ mṛta-putrāhaṁ yena me ghātitau sutau||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.dhiṅ māṁ batābudhaṁ svārthe yadahaṁ tvaj: dhiṅ māṁ batābudhaṁ svārthe yad-ahaṁ tv-ajitendriyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.hṛdayaṁ kṣuradhārābhaṁ strīṇāṁ ko veda c: hṛdayaṁ kṣura-dhārābhaṁ strīṇāṁ ko veda ceṣṭitam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.patiṁ putraṁ bhrātaraṁ vā ghnantyarthe g: patiṁ putraṁ bhrātaraṁ vā ghnanty-arthe ghātayanti ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.dhārayiṣye vrataṁ brahmanbrūhi kāryāṇi y: dhārayiṣye vrataṁ brahman-brūhi kāryāṇi yāni me|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.nāpsu snāyānna kupyeta na sambhāṣeta dur: nāpsu snāyān-na kupyeta na sambhāṣeta durjanaiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.na vasītādhautavāsaḥ srajaṁ ca vidhṛtāṁ: na vasītādhauta-vāsaḥ srajaṁ ca vidhṛtāṁ kvacit||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.śayīta nāparāṅnānyairna nagnā na ca sand: śayīta nāparāṅ-nānyair-na nagnā na ca sandhyayoḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.kāśyapaṁ garbhamādhatta vrataṁ cāñjo dad: kāśyapaṁ garbham-ādhatta vrataṁ cāñjo dadhāra sā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.rudantaṁ saptadhaikaikaṁ mā rodīriti tān: rudantaṁ saptadhaikaikaṁ mā rodīr-iti tān punaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.te tamūcuḥ pāṭyamānāḥ sarve prāñjalayo n: te tam-ūcuḥ pāṭyamānāḥ sarve prāñjalayo nṛpa|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.mā bhaiṣṭa bhrātaro mahyaṁ yūyamityāha k: mā bhaiṣṭa bhrātaro mahyaṁ yūyam-ity-āha kauśikaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.vyapohya mātṛdoṣaṁ te hariṇā somapāḥ kṛt: vyapohya mātṛ-doṣaṁ te hariṇā somapāḥ kṛtāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.ye tu necchantyapi paraṁ te svārthakuśal: ye tu necchanty-api paraṁ te svārtha-kuśalāḥ smṛtāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.ko vṛṇīte guṇasparśaṁ budhaḥ syānnarake': ko vṛṇīte guṇa-sparśaṁ budhaḥ syān-narake'pi yat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.evaṁ te sarvamākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ parip: evaṁ te sarvam-ākhyātaṁ yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripṛcchasi|
vishnu/bhagavata/0618_children_aditi_dit.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe marud-utpatti-kathanaṁ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 18||

vishnu/bhagavata/0619_method_pumsavana_v.alaṁ te nirapekṣāya pūrṇakāma namo'stu t: alaṁ te nirapekṣāya pūrṇa-kāma namo'stu te|
vishnu/bhagavata/0619_method_pumsavana_v.juṣṭa īśa guṇaiḥ sarvaistato'si bhagavān: juṣṭa īśa guṇaiḥ sarvais-tato'si bhagavān prabhuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0619_method_pumsavana_v.oṁ namo bhagavate mahāpuruṣāya mahāvibhū: oṁ namo bhagavate mahāpuruṣāya mahā-vibhūti-pataye svāheti||
vishnu/bhagavata/0619_method_pumsavana_v.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ ṣaṣṭha-skandhe puṁsavana-vrata-kathanaṁ nāmaikonaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 19||

vishnu/bhagavata/0701_dialogue_narada_yu.samaḥ priyaḥ suhṛdbrahman bhūtānāṁ bhaga: samaḥ priyaḥ suhṛd-brahman bhūtānāṁ bhagavān svayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0701_dialogue_narada_yu.na teṣāṁ yugapadrājan hrāsa ullāsa eva v: na teṣāṁ yugapad-rājan hrāsa ullāsa eva vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0701_dialogue_narada_yu.śvitro na jāto jihvāyāṁ nāndhaṁ viviśatu: śvitro na jāto jihvāyāṁ nāndhaṁ viviśatus-tamaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0701_dialogue_narada_yu.na tathā bhaktiyogena iti me niścitā mat: na tathā bhakti-yogena iti me niścitā matiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0701_dialogue_narada_yu.sambandhād vṛṣṇayaḥ snehādyūyaṁ bhaktyā: sambandhād vṛṣṇayaḥ snehād-yūyaṁ bhaktyā vayaṁ vibho||
vishnu/bhagavata/0701_dialogue_narada_yu.katamo'pi na venaḥ syātpañcānāṁ puruṣaṁ: katamo'pi na venaḥ syāt-pañcānāṁ puruṣaṁ prati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0701_dialogue_narada_yu.digvāsasaḥ śiśūn matvā dvāḥsthau tān pra: dig-vāsasaḥ śiśūn matvā dvāḥsthau tān pratyaṣedhatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0701_dialogue_narada_yu.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe prahrāda-caritopakrame prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 1||

vishnu/bhagavata/0702_after_slaying_hira.tanmātaraṁ ruṣābhānuṁ ditiṁ ca jananīṁ g: tan-mātaraṁ ruṣābhānuṁ ditiṁ ca jananīṁ girā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0702_after_slaying_hira.āha tān bālako bhūtvā yamaḥ svayamupāgat: āha tān bālako bhūtvā yamaḥ svayam-upāgataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0702_after_slaying_hira.atha nityamanityaṁ vā neha śocanti tadvi: atha nityam-anityaṁ vā neha śocanti tad-vidaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0702_after_slaying_hira.kāmaṁ nayatu māṁ devaḥ kimardhenātmano h: kāmaṁ nayatu māṁ devaḥ kim-ardhenātmano hi me|
vishnu/bhagavata/0702_after_slaying_hira.mandabhāgyāḥ pratīkṣante nīḍe me mātaraṁ: manda-bhāgyāḥ pratīkṣante nīḍe me mātaraṁ prajāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0702_after_slaying_hira.tataḥ śocata mā yūyaṁ paraṁ cātmānameva: tataḥ śocata mā yūyaṁ paraṁ cātmānam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0702_after_slaying_hira.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe diti-śokāpanayanaṁ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/0703_austerities_hirany.tena taptā divaṁ tyaktvā brahmalokaṁ yay: tena taptā divaṁ tyaktvā brahma-lokaṁ yayuḥ surāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0703_austerities_hirany.daityendratapasā taptā divi sthātuṁ na ś: daityendra-tapasā taptā divi sthātuṁ na śaknumaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0703_austerities_hirany.na bhūmau nāmbare mṛtyurna narairna mṛga: na bhūmau nāmbare mṛtyur-na narair-na mṛgair-api||
vishnu/bhagavata/0703_austerities_hirany.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe hiraṇyakaśipor-vara-yācanaṁ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/0704_cruelties_hiranyak.sa vijitya diśaḥ sarvā lokāṁśca trīn mah: sa vijitya diśaḥ sarvā lokāṁś-ca trīn mahāsuraḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0704_cruelties_hiranyak.mā bhaiṣṭa vibudhaśreṣṭhāḥ sarveṣāṁ bhad: mā bhaiṣṭa vibudha-śreṣṭhāḥ sarveṣāṁ bhadram-astu vaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0704_cruelties_hiranyak.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe prahrāda-carite caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||

vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.tau rājñā prāpitaṁ bālaṁ prahrādaṁ nayak: tau rājñā prāpitaṁ bālaṁ prahrādaṁ naya-kovidam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.yattatra guruṇā proktaṁ śuśruve'nu papāṭ: yat-tatra guruṇā proktaṁ śuśruve'nu papāṭha ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.papraccha kathyatāṁ vatsa manyate sādhu: papraccha kathyatāṁ vatsa manyate sādhu yad-bhavān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.taṁ nirbhartsyātha kupitaḥ sa dīno rājas: taṁ nirbhartsyātha kupitaḥ sa dīno rāja-sevakaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.na te viduḥ svārthagatiṁ hi viṣṇuṁ: na te viduḥ svārtha-gatiṁ hi viṣṇuṁ
vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.ayaṁ me bhrātṛhā so'yaṁ hitvā svān suhṛd: ayaṁ me bhrātṛ-hā so'yaṁ hitvā svān suhṛdo'dhamaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.dharmamarthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca nitarāṁ cānupū: dharmam-arthaṁ ca kāmaṁ ca nitarāṁ cānupūrvaśaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.atha tān ślakṣṇayā vācā pratyāhūya mahāb: atha tān ślakṣṇayā vācā pratyāhūya mahā-budhaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0705_hiranyakasipu_trie.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe prahrādānucarite pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||

vishnu/bhagavata/0706_prahlada_teaching_.tatprayāso na kartavyo yata āyurvyayaḥ p: tat-prayāso na kartavyo yata āyur-vyayaḥ param|
vishnu/bhagavata/0706_prahlada_teaching_.ko nvarthatṛṣṇāṁ visṛjet prāṇebhyo'pi ya: ko nv-artha-tṛṣṇāṁ visṛjet prāṇebhyo'pi ya īpsitaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0706_prahlada_teaching_.īkṣā trayī nayadamau vividhā ca vārtā|: īkṣā trayī naya-damau vividhā ca vārtā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0706_prahlada_teaching_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe prahrādānucarite ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6||

vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.dharmasya tattvaṁ jñānaṁ ca māmapyuddiśy: dharmasya tattvaṁ jñānaṁ ca mām-apy-uddiśya nirmalam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.vaiśāradī dhīḥ śraddhātaḥ strībālānāṁ ca: vaiśāradī dhīḥ śraddhātaḥ strī-bālānāṁ ca me yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ proktāstraya eva hi tad: aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ proktās-traya eva hi tad guṇāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.atraiva mṛgyaḥ puruṣo neti netītyatat ty: atraiva mṛgyaḥ puruṣo neti netīty-atat tyajan||
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.iti bhūtāni manasā kāmaistaiḥ sādhu māna: iti bhūtāni manasā kāmais-taiḥ sādhu mānayet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.sa vai dehastu pārakyo bhaṅguro yātyupai: sa vai dehas-tu pārakyo bhaṅguro yāty-upaiti ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.bhajan mukundacaraṇaṁ svastimān syād yat: bhajan mukunda-caraṇaṁ svastimān syād yathā vayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.prīṇanāya mukundasya na vṛttaṁ na bahujñ: prīṇanāya mukundasya na vṛttaṁ na bahu-jñatā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.khagā mṛgāḥ pāpajīvāḥ santi hyacyutatāṁ: khagā mṛgāḥ pāpa-jīvāḥ santi hy-acyutatāṁ gatāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0707_prahlada_tells_nar.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe prahrādānucarite daitya-putrānuśāsanaṁ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/0708_appearance_lord_nr.mumūrṣūṇāṁ hi mandātman nanu syurviplavā: mumūrṣūṇāṁ hi mandātman nanu syur-viplavā giraḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0708_appearance_lord_nr.muktisteṣāṁ na hi bahumatā nārasiṁhāpara: muktis-teṣāṁ na hi bahu-matā nārasiṁhāparaiḥ kim||
vishnu/bhagavata/0708_appearance_lord_nr.yena pāpena ratnāni strīratnāni hṛtāni n: yena pāpena ratnāni strī-ratnāni hṛtāni naḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0708_appearance_lord_nr.sa eṣa tvayā bhinnavakṣā nu śete: sa eṣa tvayā bhinna-vakṣā nu śete
vishnu/bhagavata/0708_appearance_lord_nr.sa tu janaparitāpaṁ tatkṛtaṁ jānatā te: sa tu jana-paritāpaṁ tat-kṛtaṁ jānatā te
vishnu/bhagavata/0708_appearance_lord_nr.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe prahrādānucarite daitya-rāja-vadhe nṛsiṁha-stavo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.yasminyato yarhi yena ca yasya yasmād: yasmin-yato yarhi yena ca yasya yasmād
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.yasmai yathā yaduta yastvaparaḥ paro vā|: yasmai yathā yaduta yas-tv-aparaḥ paro vā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.nirvidyate na tu jano yadapīti vidvān: nirvidyate na tu jano yad-apīti vidvān
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.so'haṁ kathaṁ nu visṛje tava bhṛtyasevām: so'haṁ kathaṁ nu visṛje tava bhṛtya-sevām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.yad yasya janma nidhanaṁ sthitirīkṣaṇaṁ: yad yasya janma nidhanaṁ sthitir-īkṣaṇaṁ ca
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.sturye sthito na tu tamo na guṇāṁśca yuṅ: sturye sthito na tu tamo na guṇāṁś-ca yuṅkṣe||
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.vārtā bhavantyuta na vātra tu dāmbhikānā: vārtā bhavanty-uta na vātra tu dāmbhikānām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.naite guṇā na guṇino mahadādayo ye: naite guṇā na guṇino mahad-ādayo ye
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.prīṇanti hyatha māṁ dhīrāḥ sarvabhāvena: prīṇanti hyatha māṁ dhīrāḥ sarva-bhāvena sādhavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0709_prahlada_hymn_lord.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe prahrāda-carite bhagavat-stavo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 9||

vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.āśāsāno na vai bhṛtyaḥ svāminyāśiṣa ātma: āśāsāno na vai bhṛtyaḥ svāminy-āśiṣa ātmanaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.na svāmī bhṛtyataḥ svāmyamicchan yo rāti: na svāmī bhṛtyataḥ svāmyam-icchan yo rāti cāśiṣaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.yadi rāsīśa me kāmān varāṁstvaṁ varadarṣ: yadi rāsīśa me kāmān varāṁs-tvaṁ varadarṣabha|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.indriyāṇi manaḥ prāṇa ātmā dharmo dhṛtir: indriyāṇi manaḥ prāṇa ātmā dharmo dhṛtir-matiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.hrīḥ śrīstejaḥ smṛtiḥ satyaṁ yasya naśya: hrīḥ śrīs-tejaḥ smṛtiḥ satyaṁ yasya naśyanti janmanā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.ya etat kīrtayenmahyaṁ tvayā gītamidaṁ n: ya etat kīrtayen-mahyaṁ tvayā gītam-idaṁ naraḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.tvāṁ ca māṁ ca smarankāle karmabandhāt p: tvāṁ ca māṁ ca smaran-kāle karma-bandhāt pramucyate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.tasmāt pitā me pūyeta durantād dustarāda: tasmāt pitā me pūyeta durantād dustarād-aghāt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.yat sādho'sya gṛhe jāto bhavānvai kulapā: yat sādho'sya gṛhe jāto bhavān-vai kula-pāvanaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.yatra yatra ca madbhaktāḥ praśāntāḥ sama: yatra yatra ca mad-bhaktāḥ praśāntāḥ sama-darśinaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.kuru tvaṁ pretakāryāṇi pituḥ pūtasya sar: kuru tvaṁ preta-kāryāṇi pituḥ pūtasya sarvaśaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.yo'sau labdhavaro matto na vadhyo mama s: yo'sau labdha-varo matto na vadhyo mama sṛṣṭibhiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.hṛdi sthitena hariṇā vairabhāvena tau ha: hṛdi sthitena hariṇā vaira-bhāvena tau hatau||
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.enaḥ pūrvakṛtaṁ yat tad rājānaḥ kṛṣṇavai: enaḥ pūrva-kṛtaṁ yat tad rājānaḥ kṛṣṇa-vairiṇaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.ākhyātaṁ sarvametat te yanmāṁ tvaṁ parip: ākhyātaṁ sarvam-etat te yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripṛṣṭavān|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.bhaktirjñānaṁ viraktiśca yāthātmyaṁ cāsy: bhaktir-jñānaṁ viraktiś-ca yāthātmyaṁ cāsya vai hareḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.vatsa āsīttadā brahmā svayaṁ viṣṇurayaṁ: vatsa āsīt-tadā brahmā svayaṁ viṣṇur-ayaṁ hi gauḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.rathaṁ sūtaṁ dhvajaṁ vāhāndhanurvarma śa: rathaṁ sūtaṁ dhvajaṁ vāhān-dhanur-varma śarādi yat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0710_coronation_prahlad.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe yudhiṣṭhira-nārada-saṁvāde tripura-vijayo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.nārāyaṇaparā viprā dharmaṁ guhyaṁ paraṁ: nārāyaṇa-parā viprā dharmaṁ guhyaṁ paraṁ viduḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.smṛtaṁ ca tadvidāṁ rājanyena cātmā prasī: smṛtaṁ ca tad-vidāṁ rājanyena cātmā prasīdati||
vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.saṁskārā yadavicchinnāḥ sa dvijo'jo jagā: saṁskārā yad-avicchinnāḥ sa dvijo'jo jagāda yam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.mṛtaṁ tu nityayācñā syāt pramṛtaṁ karṣaṇ: mṛtaṁ tu nitya-yācñā syāt pramṛtaṁ karṣaṇaṁ smṛtam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.varjayet tāṁ sadā vipro rājanyaśca jugup: varjayet tāṁ sadā vipro rājanyaś-ca jugupsitām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.apramattā śuciḥ snigdhā patiṁ tvapatitaṁ: apramattā śuciḥ snigdhā patiṁ tv-apatitaṁ bhajet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.prāyaḥ svabhāvavihito nṛṇāṁ dharmo yuge: prāyaḥ svabhāva-vihito nṛṇāṁ dharmo yuge yuge|
vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.vedadṛgbhiḥ smṛto rājanpretya ceha ca śa: veda-dṛgbhiḥ smṛto rājan-pretya ceha ca śarma-kṛt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0711_dharma_all_people_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe yudhiṣṭhira-nārada-saṁvāde sadācāra-nirṇayo nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11||

vishnu/bhagavata/0712_rules_brahmacarya_.ubhe sandhye ca yatavāg japanbrahma samā: ubhe sandhye ca yata-vāg japan-brahma samāhitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0712_rules_brahmacarya_.dvaitaṁ tāvanna viramet tato hyasya vipa: dvaitaṁ tāvan-na viramet tato hyasya viparyayaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0712_rules_brahmacarya_.cared vane dvādaśābdānaṣṭau vā caturo mu: cared vane dvādaśābdān-aṣṭau vā caturo muniḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0712_rules_brahmacarya_.dvāvekaṁ vā yathā buddhirna vipadyeta kṛ: dvāv-ekaṁ vā yathā buddhir-na vipadyeta kṛcchrataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0712_rules_brahmacarya_.apsu pracetasā jihvāṁ ghreyairghrāṇaṁ kṣ: apsu pracetasā jihvāṁ ghreyair-ghrāṇaṁ kṣitau nyaset||
vishnu/bhagavata/0712_rules_brahmacarya_.mano manorathaiścandre buddhiṁ bodhyaiḥ: mano manorathaiś-candre buddhiṁ bodhyaiḥ kavau pare|
vishnu/bhagavata/0712_rules_brahmacarya_.kūṭasthe tacca mahati tadavyakte'kṣare c: kūṭasthe tacca mahati tad-avyakte'kṣare ca tat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0712_rules_brahmacarya_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe yudhiṣṭhira-nārada-saṁvāde sadācāra-nirṇayo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12||

vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.ātmānaṁ ca paraṁ brahma sarvatra sadasan: ātmānaṁ ca paraṁ brahma sarvatra sad-asan-maye||
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.paśyanbandhaṁ ca mokṣaṁ ca māyāmātraṁ na: paśyan-bandhaṁ ca mokṣaṁ ca māyā-mātraṁ na vastutaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.vādavādāṁstyajet tarkānpakṣaṁ kaṁ ca na: vāda-vādāṁs-tyajet tarkān-pakṣaṁ kaṁ ca na saṁśrayet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.na vidanti janā yaṁ vai so'sāviti na vet: na vidanti janā yaṁ vai so'sāv-iti na veti ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.lokasya kurvataḥ karma śeṣe tadvīkṣitāpi: lokasya kurvataḥ karma śeṣe tad-vīkṣitāpi vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.ityetadātmanaḥ svārthaṁ santaṁ vismṛtya: ity-etad-ātmanaḥ svārthaṁ santaṁ vismṛtya vai pumān|
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.kvacidalpaṁ kvacid bhūri bhuñje'nnaṁ svā: kvacid-alpaṁ kvacid bhūri bhuñje'nnaṁ svādv-asvādu vā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.nāhaṁ ninde na ca staumi svabhāvaviṣamaṁ: nāhaṁ ninde na ca staumi svabhāva-viṣamaṁ janam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.ātmānubhūtau tāṁ māyāṁ juhuyāt satyadṛṅ: ātmānubhūtau tāṁ māyāṁ juhuyāt satya-dṛṅ muniḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0713_dharma_renunciate_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe yudhiṣṭhira-nārada-saṁvāde yati-dharme trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 13||

vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.tat sarvamupabhuñjāna etat kuryāt svato: tat sarvam-upabhuñjāna etat kuryāt svato budhaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.jahyād yadarthe svaprāṇānhanyād vā pitar: jahyād yad-arthe sva-prāṇān-hanyād vā pitaraṁ gurum|
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.tasyāṁ svatvaṁ striyāṁ jahyād yastena hy: tasyāṁ svatvaṁ striyāṁ jahyād yas-tena hy-ajito jitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.ta ete śreyasaḥ kālā nṛṇāṁ śreyovivardha: ta ete śreyasaḥ kālā nṛṇāṁ śreyo-vivardhanāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.eṣu snānaṁ japo homo vrataṁ devadvijārca: eṣu snānaṁ japo homo vrataṁ deva-dvijārcanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.sa vai puṇyatamo deśaḥ satpātraṁ yatra l: sa vai puṇyatamo deśaḥ sat-pātraṁ yatra labhyate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.yatra yatra harerarcā sa deśaḥ śreyasāṁ: yatra yatra harer-arcā sa deśaḥ śreyasāṁ padam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.pātraṁ tvatra niruktaṁ vai kavibhiḥ pātr: pātraṁ tvatra niruktaṁ vai kavibhiḥ pātra-vittamaiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.tasmāt pātraṁ hi puruṣo yāvānātmā yathey: tasmāt pātraṁ hi puruṣo yāvān-ātmā yatheyate||
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.tapasā vidyayā tuṣṭyā dhatte vedaṁ hares: tapasā vidyayā tuṣṭyā dhatte vedaṁ hares-tanum||
vishnu/bhagavata/0714_right_conduct_hous.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe sadācāra-nirṇayo nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 14||

vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.deśe kāle ca samprāpte munyannaṁ haridai: deśe kāle ca samprāpte muny-annaṁ hari-daivatam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.na dadyādāmiṣaṁ śrāddhe na cādyād dharma: na dadyād-āmiṣaṁ śrāddhe na cādyād dharma-tattvavit|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.santuṣṭaḥ kena vā rājanna vartetāpi vāri: santuṣṭaḥ kena vā rājan-na vartetāpi vāriṇā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.kṛpayā bhūtajaṁ duḥkhaṁ daivaṁ jahyāt sa: kṛpayā bhūta-jaṁ duḥkhaṁ daivaṁ jahyāt samādhinā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.etat sarvaṁ gurau bhaktyā puruṣo hyañjas: etat sarvaṁ gurau bhaktyā puruṣo hy-añjasā jayet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.yathā vārtādayo hyarthā yogasyārthaṁ na: yathā vārtādayo hy-arthā yogasyārthaṁ na bibhrati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.yato yato niḥsarati manaḥ kāmahataṁ bhra: yato yato niḥsarati manaḥ kāma-hataṁ bhramat|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.yadi seveta tānbhikṣuḥ sa vai vāntāśyapa: yadi seveta tān-bhikṣuḥ sa vai vāntāśy-apatrapaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.yaiḥ svadehaḥ smṛto nātmā martyo viṭkṛmi: yaiḥ svadehaḥ smṛto nātmā martyo viṭ-kṛmi-bhasmasāt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.rāgo dveṣaśca lobhaśca śokamohau bhayaṁ: rāgo dveṣaś-ca lobhaś-ca śoka-mohau bhayaṁ madaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.annaṁ reta iti kṣmeśa pitṛyānaṁ punarbha: annaṁ reta iti kṣmeśa pitṛ-yānaṁ punarbhavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.oṅkāraṁ bindau nāde taṁ taṁ tu prāṇe mah: oṅkāraṁ bindau nāde taṁ taṁ tu prāṇe mahaty-amum||
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.śāstreṇa cakṣuṣā veda janastho'pi na muh: śāstreṇa cakṣuṣā veda jana-stho'pi na muhyati||
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ vaco vācyaṁ tamo jyotistva: jñānaṁ jñeyaṁ vaco vācyaṁ tamo jyotis-tv-ayaṁ svayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.na saṁghāto vikāro'pi na pṛthaṅnānvito m: na saṁghāto vikāro'pi na pṛthaṅ-nānvito mṛṣā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.ahaṁ ca gāyaṁstadvidvān strībhiḥ parivṛt: ahaṁ ca gāyaṁs-tad-vidvān strībhiḥ parivṛto gataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.śrutvā kṛṣṇaṁ paraṁ brahma pārthaḥ param: śrutvā kṛṣṇaṁ paraṁ brahma pārthaḥ parama-vismitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0715_dharma_liberation_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ saptama-skandhe prahrādānucarite yudhiṣṭhira-nārada-saṁvāde sadācāra-nirṇayo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 15||

vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.yatra yatra harerjanma karmāṇi ca mahīya: yatra yatra harer-janma karmāṇi ca mahīyasaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.gṛṇanti kavayo brahmaṁstāni no vada śṛṇv: gṛṇanti kavayo brahmaṁs-tāni no vada śṛṇvatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.ādyaste kathito yatra devādīnāṁ ca sambh: ādyas-te kathito yatra devādīnāṁ ca sambhavaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.ākūtyāṁ devahūtyāṁ ca duhitrostasya vai: ākūtyāṁ devahūtyāṁ ca duhitros-tasya vai manoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.yo jāgarti śayāne'sminnāyaṁ taṁ veda ved: yo jāgarti śayāne'smin-nāyaṁ taṁ veda veda saḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.tena tyaktena bhuṁjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasyas: tena tyaktena bhuṁjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasyasvid-dhanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.yaṁ na paśyati paśyantaṁ cakṣuryasya na: yaṁ na paśyati paśyantaṁ cakṣur-yasya na riṣyati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.viśvasyāmūni yad yasmād viśvaṁ ca tadṛta: viśvasyāmūni yad yasmād viśvaṁ ca tad-ṛtaṁ mahat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.īhate bhagavānīśo na hi tatra viṣajjate|: īhate bhagavān-īśo na hi tatra viṣajjate|
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.satyā vedaśrutā bhadrā devā indrastu sat: satyā vedaśrutā bhadrā devā indras-tu satyajit||
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.satyasena iti khyāto jātaḥ satyavrataiḥ: satyasena iti khyāto jātaḥ satya-vrataiḥ saha||
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.naṣṭāḥ kālena yairvedā vidhṛtāḥ svena te: naṣṭāḥ kālena yair-vedā vidhṛtāḥ svena tejasā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.tatkathā sumahat puṇyaṁ dhanyaṁ svastyay: tat-kathā sumahat puṇyaṁ dhanyaṁ svastyayanaṁ śubham|
vishnu/bhagavata/0801_manvantaras.txt.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ aṣṭama-skandhe manvantarānucarite prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 1||

vishnu/bhagavata/0802_gajendropakhyanam..tāvatā vistṛtaḥ paryak(tāvān suvistṛto h: tāvatā vistṛtaḥ paryak(tāvān suvistṛto hyāsīt) tribhiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ payo-nidhim|
vishnu/bhagavata/0802_gajendropakhyanam..iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe manvantarānuvarṇane gajendropākhyāne dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/0803_gajendrastutih.txt.oṁ namo bhagavate tasmai yata etaccidātm: oṁ namo bhagavate tasmai yata etac-cid-ātmakam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0803_gajendrastutih.txt.yasminnidaṁ yataścedaṁ yenedaṁ ya idaṁ s: yasminn-idaṁ yataś-cedaṁ yenedaṁ ya idaṁ svayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0803_gajendrastutih.txt.yogino yaṁ prapaśyanti yogeśaṁ taṁ nato': yogino yaṁ prapaśyanti yogeśaṁ taṁ nato'smy-aham||
vishnu/bhagavata/0803_gajendrastutih.txt.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe gajendra-mokṣaṇe tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/0804_gajendramokshanam..yo'sau grāhaḥ sa vai sadyaḥ paramāścarya: yo'sau grāhaḥ sa vai sadyaḥ paramāścarya-rūpa-dhṛk|
vishnu/bhagavata/0804_gajendramokshanam..sa vai pūrvamabhūd rājā pāṇḍyo draviḍasa: sa vai pūrvam-abhūd rājā pāṇḍyo draviḍa-sattamaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0804_gajendramokshanam..ye māṁ tvāṁ ca saraścedaṁ girikandarakān: ye māṁ tvāṁ ca saraś-cedaṁ giri-kandara-kānanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0804_gajendramokshanam..śeṣaṁ ca matkalāṁ sūkṣmāṁ śriyaṁ devīṁ m: śeṣaṁ ca mat-kalāṁ sūkṣmāṁ śriyaṁ devīṁ mad-āśrayām|
vishnu/bhagavata/0804_gajendramokshanam..iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe gajendra-mokṣaṇaṁ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||

vishnu/bhagavata/0805_gods_go_brahma_bra.bhaumān reṇūnsa vimame yo viṣṇorvarṇayed: bhaumān reṇūnsa vimame yo viṣṇor-varṇayed guṇān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0805_gods_go_brahma_bra.ṣaṣṭhaśca cakṣuṣaḥ putraścākṣuṣo nāma va: ṣaṣṭhaś-ca cakṣuṣaḥ putraś-cākṣuṣo nāma vai manuḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0805_gods_go_brahma_bra.yadā durvāsasaḥ śāpāt sendrā lokāstrayo: yadā durvāsasaḥ śāpāt sendrā lokās-trayo nṛpa|
vishnu/bhagavata/0805_gods_go_brahma_bra.svānāṁ sa no dhāsyati śaṁ surapriyaḥ||: svānāṁ sa no dhāsyati śaṁ sura-priyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0805_gods_go_brahma_bra.taistaiḥ svecchādhṛtai rūpaiḥ kāle kāle: tais-taiḥ svecchā-dhṛtai rūpaiḥ kāle kāle svayaṁ vibho|
vishnu/bhagavata/0805_gods_go_brahma_bra.karma durviṣahaṁ yanno bhagavāṁstat karo: karma durviṣahaṁ yanno bhagavāṁs-tat karoti hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0805_gods_go_brahma_bra.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe- 'mṛta-mathane pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||

vishnu/bhagavata/0806_gods_daityas_toget.nāpaśyankhaṁ diśaḥ kṣoṇimātmānaṁ ca kuto: nāpaśyan-khaṁ diśaḥ kṣoṇimātmānaṁ ca kuto vibhum||
vishnu/bhagavata/0806_gods_daityas_toget.hanta brahmannaho śambho he devā mama bh: hanta brahmann-aho śambho he devā mama bhāṣitam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0806_gods_daityas_toget.lobhaḥ kāryo na vo jātu roṣaḥ kāmastu va: lobhaḥ kāryo na vo jātu roṣaḥ kāmas-tu vastuṣu||
vishnu/bhagavata/0806_gods_daityas_toget.bhavaśca jagmatuḥ svaṁ svaṁ dhāmopeyurba: bhavaś-ca jagmatuḥ svaṁ svaṁ dhāmopeyur-baliṁ surāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0806_gods_daityas_toget.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe'mṛta-mathane mandarācalānayanaṁ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6||

vishnu/bhagavata/0807_churning_ocean_beg.bhūtadruhaḥ kṣapayataḥ stutaye na tat te: bhūta-druhaḥ kṣapayataḥ stutaye na tat te|
vishnu/bhagavata/0807_churning_ocean_beg.tat tasya te sadasatoḥ parataḥ parasya: tat tasya te sad-asatoḥ parataḥ parasya
vishnu/bhagavata/0807_churning_ocean_beg.aho bata bhavānyetat prajānāṁ paśya vaiś: aho bata bhavāny-etat prajānāṁ paśya vaiśasam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0807_churning_ocean_beg.prāṇaiḥ svaiḥ prāṇinaḥ pānti sādhavaḥ kṣ: prāṇaiḥ svaiḥ prāṇinaḥ pānti sādhavaḥ kṣaṇa-bhaṅguraiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0807_churning_ocean_beg.tasmādidaṁ garaṁ bhuñje prajānāṁ svastir: tasmād-idaṁ garaṁ bhuñje prajānāṁ svastir-astu me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0807_churning_ocean_beg.praskannaṁ pibataḥ pāṇeryat kiñcijjagṛhu: praskannaṁ pibataḥ pāṇer-yat kiñcij-jagṛhuḥ sma tat|
vishnu/bhagavata/0807_churning_ocean_beg.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe- 'mṛta-mathane saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/0808_nectar_rises_ocean.pūrayatyarthino yo'rthaiḥ śaśvad bhuvi y: pūrayaty-arthino yo'rthaiḥ śaśvad bhuvi yathā bhavān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0808_nectar_rises_ocean.mā khidyata mitho'rthaṁ vaḥ sādhayiṣye s: mā khidyata mitho'rthaṁ vaḥ sādhayiṣye sva-māyayā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0808_nectar_rises_ocean.ahaṁ pūrvamahaṁ pūrvaṁ na tvaṁ na tvamit: ahaṁ pūrvam-ahaṁ pūrvaṁ na tvaṁ na tvam-iti prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/0808_nectar_rises_ocean.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe bhagavan-māyopalambhanaṁ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/0809_lord_mohini_distri.aho rūpamaho dhāma aho asyā navaṁ vayaḥ|: aho rūpam-aho dhāma aho asyā navaṁ vayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0809_lord_mohini_distri.kā tvaṁ kañjapalāśākṣi kuto vā kiṁ cikīr: kā tvaṁ kañja-palāśākṣi kuto vā kiṁ cikīrṣasi|
vishnu/bhagavata/0809_lord_mohini_distri.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe'mṛta-mathane navamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 9||

vishnu/bhagavata/0810_battle_gods_asuras.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe devāsura-saṁgrāme daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/0811_end_battle_gods_as.jitvā bālān nibaddhākṣān naṭo harati tad: jitvā bālān nibaddhākṣān naṭo harati tad-dhanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0811_end_battle_gods_as.na hṛṣyanti na śocanti tatra yūyamapaṇḍi: na hṛṣyanti na śocanti tatra yūyam-apaṇḍitāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0811_end_battle_gods_as.sakhāyaṁ patitaṁ dṛṣṭvā jambho balisakha: sakhāyaṁ patitaṁ dṛṣṭvā jambho bali-sakhaḥ suhṛt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0811_end_battle_gods_as.jambhaṁ śrutvā hataṁ tasya jñātayo nārad: jambhaṁ śrutvā hataṁ tasya jñātayo nāradād-ṛṣeḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0811_end_battle_gods_as.udayacchad ripuṁ hantuṁ vajraṁ vajradhar: udayacchad ripuṁ hantuṁ vajraṁ vajra-dharo ruṣā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0811_end_battle_gods_as.na tasya hi tvacamapi vajra ūrjito: na tasya hi tvacam-api vajra ūrjito
vishnu/bhagavata/0811_end_battle_gods_as.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe devāsura-saṁgrāme ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11||

vishnu/bhagavata/0812_mahadeva_enchanted.so'haṁ tad druṣṭumicchāmi yat te yoṣidva: so'haṁ tad druṣṭum-icchāmi yat te yoṣid-vapur-dhṛtam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0812_mahadeva_enchanted.dṛṣṭvā tasyāṁ manaścakre viṣajjantyāṁ bh: dṛṣṭvā tasyāṁ manaś-cakre viṣajjantyāṁ bhavaḥ kila||
vishnu/bhagavata/0812_mahadeva_enchanted.kāmasya ca vaśaṁ nītaḥ kareṇumiva yūthap: kāmasya ca vaśaṁ nītaḥ kareṇum-iva yūthapaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0812_mahadeva_enchanted.diṣṭyā tvaṁ vibudhaśreṣṭha svāṁ niṣṭhāmā: diṣṭyā tvaṁ vibudha-śreṣṭha svāṁ niṣṭhām-ātmanā sthitaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0812_mahadeva_enchanted.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe śaṅkara-mohanaṁ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12||

vishnu/bhagavata/0813_seven_manvantaras_.saṁjñā chāyā ca rājendra ye prāgabhihite: saṁjñā chāyā ca rājendra ye prāg-abhihite tava||
vishnu/bhagavata/0813_seven_manvantaras_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe manvantarānuvarṇanaṁ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 13||

vishnu/bhagavata/0814_separate_duties_ma.yuktāḥ sañcārayantyaddhā sve sve kāle ma: yuktāḥ sañcārayanty-addhā sve sve kāle mahīṁ nṛpa||
vishnu/bhagavata/0814_separate_duties_ma.yajñabhāgabhujo devā ye ca tatrānvitāśca: yajña-bhāga-bhujo devā ye ca tatrānvitāśca taiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0814_separate_duties_ma.bhuñjānaḥ pāti lokāṁstrīn kāmaṁ loke pra: bhuñjānaḥ pāti lokāṁs-trīn kāmaṁ loke pravarṣati||
vishnu/bhagavata/0814_separate_duties_ma.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 14||

vishnu/bhagavata/0815_king_bali_conquers.etad veditumicchāmo mahat kautūhalaṁ hi: etad veditum-icchāmo mahat kautūhalaṁ hi naḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0815_king_bali_conquers.yāṁ na vrajantyadharmiṣṭhāḥ khalā bhūtad: yāṁ na vrajanty-adharmiṣṭhāḥ khalā bhūta-druhaḥ śaṭhāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0815_king_bali_conquers.māninaḥ kāmino lubdhā ebhirhīnā vrajanti: māninaḥ kāmino lubdhā ebhir-hīnā vrajanti yat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0815_king_bali_conquers.ojaḥ saho balaṁ tejo yata etatsamudyamaḥ: ojaḥ saho balaṁ tejo yata etat-samudyamaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0815_king_bali_conquers.kīrtiṁ dikṣu vitanvānaḥ sa reja uḍurāḍiv: kīrtiṁ dikṣu vitanvānaḥ sa reja uḍurāḍ-iva||
vishnu/bhagavata/0815_king_bali_conquers.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 15||

vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.apyagnayastu velāyāṁ na hutā haviṣā sati: apy-agnayas-tu velāyāṁ na hutā haviṣā sati|
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.ko nu me bhagavankāmo na sampadyeta māna: ko nu me bhagavan-kāmo na sampadyeta mānasaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.kasya ke patiputrādyā moha eva hi kāraṇa: kasya ke pati-putrādyā moha eva hi kāraṇam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.yathā me satyasaṅkalpo vidadhyāt sa mano: yathā me satya-saṅkalpo vidadhyāt sa manoratham||
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.arcāyāṁ sthaṇḍile sūrye jale vahnau gurā: arcāyāṁ sthaṇḍile sūrye jale vahnau gurāv-api||
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.namaḥ śivāya rudrāya namaḥ śaktidharāya: namaḥ śivāya rudrāya namaḥ śakti-dharāya ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.anyāṁśca brāhmaṇāñchaktyā ye ca tatra sa: anyāṁś-ca brāhmaṇāñchaktyā ye ca tatra samāgatāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.ta eva niyamāḥ sākṣātta eva ca yamottamā: ta eva niyamāḥ sākṣāt-ta eva ca yamottamāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.tapo dānaṁ vrataṁ yajño yena tuṣyatyadho: tapo dānaṁ vrataṁ yajño yena tuṣyaty-adhokṣajaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0816_kasyapa_teaches_ad.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāmaṣṭamaskandhe'diti- payo-vrata-kathanaṁ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 16||

vishnu/bhagavata/0817_lord_appears_gives.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe vāmana-prādurbhāve saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 17||

vishnu/bhagavata/0818_lord_vamana_appear.vijayā nāma sā proktā yasyāṁ janma vidur: vijayā nāma sā proktā yasyāṁ janma vidur-hareḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0818_lord_vamana_appear.svāgataṁ te namastubhyaṁ brahmankiṁ kara: svāgataṁ te namas-tubhyaṁ brahman-kiṁ karavāma te|
vishnu/bhagavata/0818_lord_vamana_appear.adya naḥ pitarastṛptā adya naḥ pāvitaṁ k: adya naḥ pitaras-tṛptā adya naḥ pāvitaṁ kulam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0818_lord_vamana_appear.adya sviṣṭaḥ kraturayaṁ yad bhavānāgato: adya sviṣṭaḥ kratur-ayaṁ yad bhavān-āgato gṛhān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0818_lord_vamana_appear.yad yad vaṭo vāñchasi tatpratīccha me: yad yad vaṭo vāñchasi tat-pratīccha me
vishnu/bhagavata/0818_lord_vamana_appear.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe vāmana-prādurbhāve bali-vāmana-saṁvāde'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 18||

vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.hantuṁ bhrātṛhaṇaṁ kruddho jagāma nilaya: hantuṁ bhrātṛ-haṇaṁ kruddho jagāma nilayaṁ hareḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.bhrātṛhā me gato nūnaṁ yato nāvartate pu: bhrātṛ-hā me gato nūnaṁ yato nāvartate pumān||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.tvaṁ bālo bāliśamatiḥ svārthaṁ pratyabud: tvaṁ bālo bāliśa-matiḥ svārthaṁ pratyabudho yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.tasmād vṛttikarīṁ bhūmiṁ vaṭo kāmaṁ prat: tasmād vṛtti-karīṁ bhūmiṁ vaṭo kāmaṁ pratīccha me||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.arthaiḥ kāmairgatā nāntaṁ tṛṣṇāyā iti na: arthaiḥ kāmair-gatā nāntaṁ tṛṣṇāyā iti naḥ śrutam||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.tasmāt trīṇi padānyeva vṛṇe tvad varadar: tasmāt trīṇi padāny-eva vṛṇe tvad varadarṣabhāt|
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.jānaṁścikīrṣitaṁ viṣṇoḥ śiṣyaṁ prāha vid: jānaṁś-cikīrṣitaṁ viṣṇoḥ śiṣyaṁ prāha vidāṁ varaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.eṣa te sthānamaiśvaryaṁ śriyaṁ tejo yaśa: eṣa te sthānam-aiśvaryaṁ śriyaṁ tejo yaśaḥ śrutam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.niṣṭhāṁ te narake manye hyapradātuḥ prat: niṣṭhāṁ te narake manye hy-apradātuḥ pratiśrutam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.dānaṁ yajñastapaḥ karma loke vṛttimato y: dānaṁ yajñas-tapaḥ karma loke vṛttimato yataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.satyamomiti yat proktaṁ yannetyāhānṛtaṁ: satyam-om-iti yat proktaṁ yan-netyāhānṛtaṁ hi tat||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.evaṁ naṣṭānṛtaḥ sadya ātmā śuṣyenna saṁś: evaṁ naṣṭānṛtaḥ sadya ātmā śuṣyen-na saṁśayaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.parāg riktamapūrṇaṁ vā akṣaraṁ yat tadom: parāg riktam-apūrṇaṁ vā akṣaraṁ yat tad-om-iti|
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.yat kiñcidomiti brūyāt tena ricyeta vai: yat kiñcid-om-iti brūyāt tena ricyeta vai pumān|
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.sarvaṁ netyanṛtaṁ brūyāt sa duṣkīrtiḥ śv: sarvaṁ nety-anṛtaṁ brūyāt sa duṣkīrtiḥ śvasan-mṛtaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0819_lord_vamana_asks_b.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe vāmana-prādurbhāve ekona-viṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 19||

vishnu/bhagavata/0820_lord_vamana_takes_.sa cāhaṁ vittalobhena pratyācakṣe kathaṁ: sa cāhaṁ vitta-lobhena pratyācakṣe kathaṁ dvijam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0820_lord_vamana_takes_.na hyasatyāt paro'dharma iti hovāca bhūr: na hy-asatyāt paro'dharma iti hovāca bhūriyam|
vishnu/bhagavata/0820_lord_vamana_takes_.tasya tyāge nimittaṁ kiṁ viprastuṣyenna: tasya tyāge nimittaṁ kiṁ vipras-tuṣyen-na tena cet||
vishnu/bhagavata/0820_lord_vamana_takes_.na tathā tīrtha āyāte śraddhayā ye dhana: na tathā tīrtha āyāte śraddhayā ye dhana-tyajaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0820_lord_vamana_takes_.tathāpyenaṁ na hiṁsiṣye bhītaṁ brahmatan: tathāpy-enaṁ na hiṁsiṣye bhītaṁ brahma-tanuṁ ripum||
vishnu/bhagavata/0820_lord_vamana_takes_.yajamānaḥ svayaṁ tasya śrīmat pādayugaṁ: yajamānaḥ svayaṁ tasya śrīmat pāda-yugaṁ mudā|
vishnu/bhagavata/0820_lord_vamana_takes_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe viśvarūpa-darśanaṁ-nāma viṁśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 20||

vishnu/bhagavata/0821_bali_bound.txt.tasmādasya vadho dharmo bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇ: tasmād-asya vadho dharmo bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṁ ca naḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0821_bali_bound.txt.mā yudhyata nivartadhvaṁ na naḥ kālo'yam: mā yudhyata nivartadhvaṁ na naḥ kālo'yam-arthakṛt||
vishnu/bhagavata/0821_bali_bound.txt.padaikena mayā krānto bhūrlokaḥ khaṁ diś: padaikena mayā krānto bhūrlokaḥ khaṁ diśas-tanoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0821_bali_bound.txt.tad vyalīkaphalaṁ bhuṅkṣva nirayaṁ katic: tad vyalīka-phalaṁ bhuṅkṣva nirayaṁ katicit samāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/0821_bali_bound.txt.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-aṣṭama-skandhe vāmana-prādurbhāve bali-nigraho nāmaikaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 21||

vishnu/bhagavata/0822_bali_hymn_lord_lor.yaṁ na mātā pitā bhrātā suhṛdaścādiśanti: yaṁ na mātā pitā bhrātā suhṛdaś-cādiśanti hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/0822_bali_hymn_lord_lor.tvaṁ nūnamasurāṇāṁ naḥ pārokṣyaḥ paramo: tvaṁ nūnam-asurāṇāṁ naḥ pārokṣyaḥ paramo guruḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/0822_bali_hymn_lord_lor.baddhaśca vāruṇaiḥ pāśairnātivrīḍe na ca: baddhaś-ca vāruṇaiḥ pāśair-nātivrīḍe na ca vyathe||

vishnu/bhagavata/1001_lord_reassures_ear.ityuktaḥ sa khalaḥ pāpo bhojānāṁ kulapāṁ: ity-uktaḥ sa khalaḥ pāpo bhojānāṁ kula-pāṁsanaḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1002_lord_enters_womb_g.garbhasaṁkarṣaṇāt taṁ vai prāhuḥ saṁkarṣ: garbha-saṁkarṣaṇāt taṁ vai prāhuḥ saṁkarṣaṇaṁ bhuvi|

vishnu/bhagavata/1008_naming_ceremony_ch.jyotiścakraṁ jalaṁ tejo nabhasvān viyade: jyotiś-cakraṁ jalaṁ tejo nabhasvān viyad-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1008_naming_ceremony_ch.nandaḥ kimakarod brahman śreya evaṁ maho: nandaḥ kim-akarod brahman śreya evaṁ mahodayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1008_naming_ceremony_ch.yaśodā ca mahābhāgā papau yasyāḥ stanaṁ: yaśodā ca mahā-bhāgā papau yasyāḥ stanaṁ hariḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1008_naming_ceremony_ch.astvityuktaḥ sa bhagavān vraje droṇo mah: astv-ity-uktaḥ sa bhagavān vraje droṇo mahā-yaśāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1008_naming_ceremony_ch.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe viśvarūpa-darśane'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/1009_sri_krsna_bound_mo.tāṁ stanyakāma āsādya mathnantīṁ jananīṁ: tāṁ stanya-kāma āsādya mathnantīṁ jananīṁ hariḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1009_sri_krsna_bound_mo.na cāntarna bahiryasya na pūrvaṁ nāpi cā: na cāntar-na bahir-yasya na pūrvaṁ nāpi cāparam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1009_sri_krsna_bound_mo.tadapi dvyaṅgulaṁ nyūnaṁ yad yadādatta b: tadapi dvyaṅgulaṁ nyūnaṁ yad yad-ādatta bandhanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1009_sri_krsna_bound_mo.nemaṁ viriṁco na bhavo na śrīrapyaṁgasaṁ: nemaṁ viriṁco na bhavo na śrīr-apy-aṁga-saṁśrayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1009_sri_krsna_bound_mo.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe gopī-prasādo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 9||

vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.yattad vigarhitaṁ karma yena vā devarṣes: yattad vigarhitaṁ karma yena vā devarṣes-tamaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.taṁ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍitā devyo vivastrāḥ śāpaś: taṁ dṛṣṭvā vrīḍitā devyo vivastrāḥ śāpa-śaṁkitāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.na hyanyo juṣato joṣyān buddhibhraṁśo ra: na hyanyo juṣato joṣyān buddhi-bhraṁśo rajo-guṇaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.bhūtadhruk tatkṛte svārthaṁ kiṁ veda nir: bhūta-dhruk tat-kṛte svārthaṁ kiṁ veda nirayo yataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.mātuḥ piturvā balinaḥ kreturagneḥ śuno'p: mātuḥ pitur-vā balinaḥ kretur-agneḥ śuno'pi vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.vyaktāvyaktamidaṁ viśvaṁ rūpaṁ te brāhma: vyaktāvyaktam-idaṁ viśvaṁ rūpaṁ te brāhmaṇā viduḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.sa bhavān sarvalokasya bhavāya vibhavāya: sa bhavān sarva-lokasya bhavāya vibhavāya ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.ityuktau tau parikramya praṇamya ca puna: ity-uktau tau parikramya praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1010_deliverance_yamala.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe nārada-śāpo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.na te taduktaṁ jagṛhurna ghaṭeteti tasya: na te tad-uktaṁ jagṛhur-na ghaṭeteti tasya tat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.bāhukṣepaṁ ca kurute svānāṁ ca prītimāva: bāhu-kṣepaṁ ca kurute svānāṁ ca prītim-āvahan||
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.rāmaṁ ca rohiṇī devī krīḍantaṁ bālakairb: rāmaṁ ca rohiṇī devī krīḍantaṁ bālakair-bhṛśam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.ehyāvayoḥ priyaṁ dhehi svagṛhān yāta bāl: ehy-āvayoḥ priyaṁ dhehi svagṛhān yāta bālakāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.janmarkṣamadya bhavato viprebhyo dehi gā: janmarkṣam-adya bhavato viprebhyo dehi gāḥ śuciḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.tattatrādyaiva yāsyāmaḥ śakaṭān yuṅkta m: tat-tatrādyaiva yāsyāmaḥ śakaṭān yuṅkta mā ciram|
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.vrajān svān svān samāyujya yayū rūḍhapar: vrajān svān svān samāyujya yayū rūḍha-paricchadāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.taṁ vīkṣya vismitā bālāḥ śaśaṁsuḥ sādhu: taṁ vīkṣya vismitā bālāḥ śaśaṁsuḥ sādhu sādhv-iti|
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.svaṁ svaṁ vatsakulaṁ sarve pāyayiṣyanta: svaṁ svaṁ vatsa-kulaṁ sarve pāyayiṣyanta ekadā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.sa vai bako nāma mahānasuro bakarūpadhṛk: sa vai bako nāma mahān-asuro baka-rūpa-dhṛk|
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.apyāsīd vipriyaṁ teṣāṁ kṛtaṁ pūrvaṁ yato: apy-āsīd vipriyaṁ teṣāṁ kṛtaṁ pūrvaṁ yato bhayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.aho brahmavidāṁ vāco nāsatyāḥ santi karh: aho brahma-vidāṁ vāco nāsatyāḥ santi karhicit|
vishnu/bhagavata/1011_move_gokula_vrndav.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe vatsa-baka-vadho nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11||

vishnu/bhagavata/1012_deliverance_aghasu.yadi dūraṁ gataḥ kṛṣṇo vanaśobhekṣaṇāya: yadi dūraṁ gataḥ kṛṣṇo vana-śobhekṣaṇāya tam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1012_deliverance_aghasu.dṛṣṭvā taṁ tādṛśaṁ sarve matvā vṛndāvana: dṛṣṭvā taṁ tādṛśaṁ sarve matvā vṛndāvana-śriyam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1012_deliverance_aghasu.aho mitrāṇi gadata sattvakūṭaṁ puraḥ sth: aho mitrāṇi gadata sattva-kūṭaṁ puraḥ sthitam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1012_deliverance_aghasu.tad brūhi me mahāyogin paraṁ kautūhalaṁ: tad brūhi me mahā-yogin paraṁ kautūhalaṁ guro|
vishnu/bhagavata/1012_deliverance_aghasu.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12||

vishnu/bhagavata/1013_delusion_brahma_en.tataḥ kṛṣṇo mudaṁ kartuṁ tanmātṝṇāṁ ca k: tataḥ kṛṣṇo mudaṁ kartuṁ tan-mātṝṇāṁ ca kasya ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1013_delusion_brahma_en.tattadvatsān pṛthaṅ nītvā tattadgoṣṭhe n: tat-tad-vatsān pṛthaṅ nītvā tat-tad-goṣṭhe niveśya saḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1013_delusion_brahma_en.keyaṁ vā kuta āyātā daivī vā nāryutāsurī: keyaṁ vā kuta āyātā daivī vā nāry-utāsurī|
vishnu/bhagavata/1013_delusion_brahma_en.prāyo māyāstu me bharturnānyā me'pi vimo: prāyo māyās-tu me bhartur-nānyā me'pi vimohinī||
vishnu/bhagavata/1013_delusion_brahma_en.evameteṣu bhedeṣu ciraṁ dhyātvā sa ātmab: evam-eteṣu bhedeṣu ciraṁ dhyātvā sa ātma-bhūḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1013_delusion_brahma_en.anīśe'pi draṣṭuṁ kimidamiti vā muhyati s: anīśe'pi draṣṭuṁ kim-idam-iti vā muhyati sati
vishnu/bhagavata/1013_delusion_brahma_en.āste mahitvaṁ prāgdṛṣṭaṁ smṛtvā smṛtvā p: āste mahitvaṁ prāg-dṛṣṭaṁ smṛtvā smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1013_delusion_brahma_en.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 13||

vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.yasya kukṣāvidaṁ sarvaṁ sātmaṁ bhāti yat: yasya kukṣāv-idaṁ sarvaṁ sātmaṁ bhāti yathā tathā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.tattvayyapīha tat sarvaṁ kimidaṁ māyayā: tat-tvayy-apīha tat sarvaṁ kim-idaṁ māyayā vinā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.adyaiva tvadṛte'sya kiṁ mama na te: adyaiva tvad-ṛte'sya kiṁ mama na te
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.tāvanmoho'ṅghrinigaḍo yāvat kṛṣṇa na te: tāvan-moho'ṅghri-nigaḍo yāvat kṛṣṇa na te janāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.anujānīhi māṁ kṛṣṇa sarvaṁ tvaṁ vetsi sa: anujānīhi māṁ kṛṣṇa sarvaṁ tvaṁ vetsi sarva-dṛk|
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.hato'vitā vayaṁ cāsmāditi bālā vraje jag: hato'vitā vayaṁ cāsmād-iti bālā vraje jaguḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.yathā dehaḥ priyatamastathā na hyanu ye: yathā dehaḥ priyatamas-tathā na hyanu ye ca tam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.vastuto jānatāmatra kṛṣṇaṁ sthāsnu cariṣ: vastuto jānatām-atra kṛṣṇaṁ sthāsnu cariṣṇu ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.tasyāpi bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ kimatad vastu rū: tasyāpi bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ kim-atad vastu rūpyatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1014_brahma_hymn_lord.t.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe brahma-stutir-nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 14||

vishnu/bhagavata/1015_deliverance_dhenuk.evaṁ vṛndāvanaṁ śrīmat kṛṣṇaḥ prītamanāḥ: evaṁ vṛndāvanaṁ śrīmat kṛṣṇaḥ prīta-manāḥ paśūn|
vishnu/bhagavata/1015_deliverance_dhenuk.pārśvasthaṁ kampayan bhagnaḥ sa cānyaṁ s: pārśva-sthaṁ kampayan bhagnaḥ sa cānyaṁ so'pi cāparam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1015_deliverance_dhenuk.evaṁ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo vṛndāvanacaraḥ kv: evaṁ sa bhagavān kṛṣṇo vṛndāvana-caraḥ kvacit|
vishnu/bhagavata/1015_deliverance_dhenuk.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe dhenuka-vadho nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 15||

vishnu/bhagavata/1016_lord_grace_kaliya..sa vai bahuyugāvāsaṁ yathā''sīd vipra ka: sa vai bahu-yugāvāsaṁ yathā''sīd vipra kathyatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1016_lord_grace_kaliya..tāṁstathā kātarān vīkṣya bhagavān mādhav: tāṁs-tathā kātarān vīkṣya bhagavān mādhavo balaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1016_lord_grace_kaliya..aviśvāya ca viśvāya taddraṣṭre'sya ca he: aviśvāya ca viśvāya tad-draṣṭre'sya ca hetave||
vishnu/bhagavata/1016_lord_grace_kaliya..strīṇāṁ naḥ sādhuśocyānāṁ patiḥ prāṇaḥ p: strīṇāṁ naḥ sādhu-śocyānāṁ patiḥ prāṇaḥ pradīyatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1016_lord_grace_kaliya..vayaṁ ca tatra bhagavan sarpā jātyuruman: vayaṁ ca tatra bhagavan sarpā jāty-uru-manyavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1016_lord_grace_kaliya..bhavān hi kāraṇaṁ tatra sarvajño jagadīś: bhavān hi kāraṇaṁ tatra sarvajño jagad-īśvaraḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1016_lord_grace_kaliya..iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe kāliya-mokṣaṇaṁ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 16||

vishnu/bhagavata/1017_how_kaliya_came_ka.mīnān suduḥkhitān dṛṣṭvā dīnān mīnapatau: mīnān suduḥkhitān dṛṣṭvā dīnān mīna-patau hate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1017_how_kaliya_came_ka.yaśodā rohiṇī nando gopyo gopāśca kaurav: yaśodā rohiṇī nando gopyo gopāś-ca kaurava|
vishnu/bhagavata/1017_how_kaliya_came_ka.nandaḥ prītamanā rājan gāḥ suvarṇaṁ tadā: nandaḥ prīta-manā rājan gāḥ suvarṇaṁ tad-ādiśat||
vishnu/bhagavata/1017_how_kaliya_came_ka.tāṁ rātriṁ tatra rājendra kṣuttṛḍbhyāṁ ś: tāṁ rātriṁ tatra rājendra kṣut-tṛḍbhyāṁ śrama-karśitāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1017_how_kaliya_came_ka.eṣa ghoratamo vahnistāvakān grasate hi n: eṣa ghoratamo vahnis-tāvakān grasate hi naḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1017_how_kaliya_came_ka.sudustarānnaḥ svān pāhi kālāgneḥ suhṛdaḥ: sudustarān-naḥ svān pāhi kālāgneḥ suhṛdaḥ prabho|
vishnu/bhagavata/1017_how_kaliya_came_ka.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe dāvāgni-mocanaṁ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 17||

vishnu/bhagavata/1018_deliverance_pralam.īḍire kṛṣṇarāmau ca naṭā iva naṭaṁ nṛpa|: īḍire kṛṣṇa-rāmau ca naṭā iva naṭaṁ nṛpa||
vishnu/bhagavata/1018_deliverance_pralam.kvacid bilvaiḥ kvacit kumbhaiḥ kva cāmal: kvacid bilvaiḥ kvacit kumbhaiḥ kva cāmalaka-muṣṭibhiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1018_deliverance_pralam.gopāḥ suvismitā āsan sādhu sādhviti vādi: gopāḥ suvismitā āsan sādhu sādhv-iti vādinaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1018_deliverance_pralam.abhyavarṣan balaṁ mālyaiḥ śaśaṁsuḥ sādhu: abhyavarṣan balaṁ mālyaiḥ śaśaṁsuḥ sādhu sādhv-iti||
vishnu/bhagavata/1018_deliverance_pralam.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe pralamba-vadho nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 18||

vishnu/bhagavata/1019_cows_cowherds_save.ajā gāvo mahiṣyaśca nirviśantyo vanād va: ajā gāvo mahiṣyaś-ca nirviśantyo vanād vanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1019_cows_cowherds_save.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe dāvāgni-pānaṁ nāmaikonaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 19||

vishnu/bhagavata/1020_rainy_season_autum.aṣṭau māsān nipītaṁ yad bhūmyāścodamayaṁ: aṣṭau māsān nipītaṁ yad bhūmyāś-codamayaṁ vasu|
vishnu/bhagavata/1020_rainy_season_autum.sthairyaṁ na cakruḥ kāminyaḥ puruṣeṣu gu: sthairyaṁ na cakruḥ kāminyaḥ puruṣeṣu guṇiṣv-iva||
vishnu/bhagavata/1020_rainy_season_autum.śanaiḥ śanairjahuḥ paṅkaṁ sthalānyāmaṁ c: śanaiḥ śanair-jahuḥ paṅkaṁ sthalāny-āmaṁ ca vīrudhaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1020_rainy_season_autum.babhau bhūḥ pakvasasyāḍhyā kalābhyāṁ nit: babhau bhūḥ pakva-sasyāḍhyā kalābhyāṁ nitarāṁ hareḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1020_rainy_season_autum.varṣaruddhā yathā siddhāḥ svapiṇḍān kāla: varṣa-ruddhā yathā siddhāḥ sva-piṇḍān kāla āgate||
vishnu/bhagavata/1020_rainy_season_autum.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe prāvṛṭ- śarad-varṇana nāma viṁśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 20||

vishnu/bhagavata/1021_song_flute_venugit.raṁge yathā naṭavarau kva ca gāyamānau||: raṁge yathā naṭa-varau kva ca gāyamānau||
vishnu/bhagavata/1021_song_flute_venugit.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe veṇu-gītaṁ nāmaikaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 21||

vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.nandagopasutaṁ devi patiṁ me kuru te nam: nandagopa-sutaṁ devi patiṁ me kuru te namaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.iti mantraṁ japantyastāḥ pūjāṁ cakruḥ ku: iti mantraṁ japantyas-tāḥ pūjāṁ cakruḥ kumārikāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.evaṁ māsaṁ vrataṁ ceruḥ kumāryaḥ kṛṣṇace: evaṁ māsaṁ vrataṁ ceruḥ kumāryaḥ kṛṣṇa-cetasaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.satyaṁ bravāṇi no narma yad yūyaṁ vratak: satyaṁ bravāṇi no narma yad yūyaṁ vrata-karśitāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.na mayoditapūrvaṁ vā anṛtaṁ tadime viduḥ: na mayodita-pūrvaṁ vā anṛtaṁ tadime viduḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.tasya tat kṣvelitaṁ dṛṣṭvā gopyaḥ premap: tasya tat kṣvelitaṁ dṛṣṭvā gopyaḥ prema-pariplutāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.vrīḍitāḥ prekṣya cānyonyaṁ jātahāsā na n: vrīḍitāḥ prekṣya cānyonyaṁ jāta-hāsā na niryayuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.mānayaṁ bhoḥ kṛthāstvāṁ tu nandagopasuta: mānayaṁ bhoḥ kṛthās-tvāṁ tu nandagopa-sutaṁ priyam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.tato nṛpa svayaṁ gopāḥ kāmaṁ svādu papur: tato nṛpa svayaṁ gopāḥ kāmaṁ svādu papur-jalam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1022_taking_garments.tx.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe gopī-vastrāpahāro nāma dvāviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 22||

vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.prāptāñjānīta bhadraṁ vo gopān no rāmaco: prāptāñ-jānīta bhadraṁ vo gopān no rāma-coditān||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.iti te bhagavadyācñāṁ śṛṇvanto'pi na śuś: iti te bhagavad-yācñāṁ śṛṇvanto'pi na śuśruvuḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.na te yadomiti procurna neti ca paraṁtap: na te yad-om-iti procur-na neti ca paraṁtapa|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.dāsyanti kāmamannaṁ vaḥ snigdhā mayyuṣit: dāsyanti kāmam-annaṁ vaḥ snigdhā mayy-uṣitā dhiyā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.namo vo viprapatnībhyo nibodhata vacāṁsi: namo vo vipra-patnībhyo nibodhata vacāṁsi naḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.svāgataṁ vo mahābhāgā āsyatāṁ karavāma k: svāgataṁ vo mahā-bhāgā āsyatāṁ karavāma kim|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.yanno didṛkṣayā prāptā upapannamidaṁ hi: yanno didṛkṣayā prāptā upapannam-idaṁ hi vaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.yatsamparkāt priyā āsaṁstataḥ ko nvapara: yat-samparkāt priyā āsaṁs-tataḥ ko nv-aparaḥ priyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.tad yāta devayajanaṁ patayo vo dvijātaya: tad yāta deva-yajanaṁ patayo vo dvijātayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.dhig janma nastrivṛd vidyāṁ dhig vrataṁ: dhig janma nas-trivṛd vidyāṁ dhig vrataṁ dhig bahu-jñatām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.dhik kulaṁ dhik kriyādākṣyaṁ vimukhā ye: dhik kulaṁ dhik kriyā-dākṣyaṁ vimukhā ye tv-adhokṣaje||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.na tapo nātmamīmāṁsā na śaucaṁ na kriyāḥ: na tapo nātma-mīmāṁsā na śaucaṁ na kriyāḥ śubhāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.aho naḥ smārayāmāsa gopavākyaiḥ satāṁ ga: aho naḥ smārayāmāsa gopa-vākyaiḥ satāṁ gatiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.hitvānyān bhajate yaṁ śrīḥ pādasparśāśay: hitvānyān bhajate yaṁ śrīḥ pāda-sparśāśayā sakṛt|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.jāto yaduṣvityaśṛṇma hyapi mūḍhā na vidm: jāto yaduṣv-ity-aśṛṇma hyapi mūḍhā na vidmahe||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.aho vayaṁ dhanyatamā yeṣāṁ nastādṛśīḥ st: aho vayaṁ dhanyatamā yeṣāṁ nas-tādṛśīḥ striyaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.bhaktyā yāsāṁ matirjātā asmākaṁ niścalā: bhaktyā yāsāṁ matir-jātā asmākaṁ niścalā harau||
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.sa vai na ādyaḥ puruṣaḥ svamāyāmohitātma: sa vai na ādyaḥ puruṣaḥ sva-māyā-mohitātmanām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1023_lord_grace_wives_b.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe yajña-patny-uddharaṇaṁ nāma trayoviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 23||

vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.na hi gopyaṁ hi sādhūnāṁ kṛtyaṁ sarvātma: na hi gopyaṁ hi sādhūnāṁ kṛtyaṁ sarvātmanām-iha||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.tatra tāvat kriyāyogo bhavatāṁ kiṁ vicār: tatra tāvat kriyā-yogo bhavatāṁ kiṁ vicāritaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.taṁ tāta vayamanye ca vārmucāṁ patimīśva: taṁ tāta vayam-anye ca vārmucāṁ patim-īśvaram|
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.kāmāllobhād bhayād dveṣāt sa vai nāpnoti: kāmāl-lobhād bhayād dveṣāt sa vai nāpnoti śobhanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.kartāraṁ bhajate so'pi na hyakartuḥ prab: kartāraṁ bhajate so'pi na hy-akartuḥ prabhur-hi saḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.añjasā yena varteta tadevāsya hi daivata: añjasā yena varteta tad-evāsya hi daivatam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.na tasmād vindate kṣemaṁ jāraṁ nāryasatī: na tasmād vindate kṣemaṁ jāraṁ nāry-asatī yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.annaṁ bahuvidhaṁ tebhyo deyaṁ vo dhenuda: annaṁ bahuvidhaṁ tebhyo deyaṁ vo dhenu-dakṣiṇāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.etanmama mataṁ tāta kriyatāṁ yadi rocate: etan-mama mataṁ tāta kriyatāṁ yadi rocate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.ayaṁ gobrāhmaṇādrīṇāṁ mahyaṁ ca dayito m: ayaṁ go-brāhmaṇādrīṇāṁ mahyaṁ ca dayito makhaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.hanti hyasmai namasyāmaḥ śarmaṇe ātmano: hanti hy-asmai namasyāmaḥ śarmaṇe ātmano gavām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.yathā vidhāya te gopāḥ sahakṛṣṇā vrajaṁ: yathā vidhāya te gopāḥ saha-kṛṣṇā vrajaṁ yayuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1024_sacrifice_indra_st.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe caturviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 24||

vishnu/bhagavata/1025_lifting_govardhana.gopā gopyaśca śītārtā govindaṁ śaraṇaṁ y: gopā gopyaś-ca śītārtā govindaṁ śaraṇaṁ yayuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1025_lifting_govardhana.kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābhāga tvannāthaṁ gokulaṁ: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahā-bhāga tvan-nāthaṁ gokulaṁ prabho|
vishnu/bhagavata/1025_lifting_govardhana.gopāye svātmayogena so'yaṁ me vrata āhit: gopāye svātma-yogena so'yaṁ me vrata āhitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1025_lifting_govardhana.na trāsa iha vaḥ kāryo maddhastādrinipāt: na trāsa iha vaḥ kāryo maddhastādri-nipātane|
vishnu/bhagavata/1025_lifting_govardhana.bhagavānapi taṁ śailaṁ svasthāne pūrvava: bhagavān-api taṁ śailaṁ sva-sthāne pūrvavat prabhuḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1025_lifting_govardhana.yaśodā rohiṇī nando rāmaśca balināṁ vara: yaśodā rohiṇī nando rāmaś-ca balināṁ varaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1025_lifting_govardhana.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe pañcaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 25||

vishnu/bhagavata/1026_cowherds_speak_nan.evaṁvidhāni karmāṇi gopāḥ kṛṣṇasya vīkṣy: evaṁ-vidhāni karmāṇi gopāḥ kṛṣṇasya vīkṣya te|
vishnu/bhagavata/1026_cowherds_speak_nan.pītaḥ stanaḥ saha prāṇaiḥ kāleneva vayas: pītaḥ stanaḥ saha prāṇaiḥ kāleneva vayas-tanoḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1026_cowherds_speak_nan.tato no jāyate śaṁkā vrajanātha tavātmaj: tato no jāyate śaṁkā vraja-nātha tavātmaje||
vishnu/bhagavata/1026_cowherds_speak_nan.enaṁ kumāramuddiśya gargo me yaduvāca ha: enaṁ kumāram-uddiśya gargo me yad-uvāca ha||
vishnu/bhagavata/1026_cowherds_speak_nan.śuklo raktastathā pīta idānīṁ kṛṣṇatāṁ g: śuklo raktas-tathā pīta idānīṁ kṛṣṇatāṁ gataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1026_cowherds_speak_nan.ya etasmin mahābhāgāḥ prītiṁ kurvanti mā: ya etasmin mahā-bhāgāḥ prītiṁ kurvanti mānavāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1026_cowherds_speak_nan.ityaddhā māṁ samādiśya garge ca svagṛhaṁ: ity-addhā māṁ samādiśya garge ca sva-gṛhaṁ gate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1026_cowherds_speak_nan.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe ṣaḍviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 26||

vishnu/bhagavata/1027_anointing_sri_krsn.golokādāvrajat kṛṣṇaṁ surabhiḥ śakra eva: golokād-āvrajat kṛṣṇaṁ surabhiḥ śakra eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/1027_anointing_sri_krsn.tvaṁ naḥ paramakaṁ daivaṁ tvaṁ na indro: tvaṁ naḥ paramakaṁ daivaṁ tvaṁ na indro jagat-pate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1027_anointing_sri_krsn.bhavāya bhava govipradevānāṁ ye ca sādha: bhavāya bhava go-vipra-devānāṁ ye ca sādhavaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1027_anointing_sri_krsn.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe indra-stutir-nāma saptaviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 27||

vishnu/bhagavata/1028_nanda_brought_back.ānīto'yaṁ tava pitā tad bhavān kṣantumar: ānīto'yaṁ tava pitā tad bhavān kṣantum-arhati||
vishnu/bhagavata/1028_nanda_brought_back.iti svānāṁ sa bhagavān vijñāyākhiladṛk s: iti svānāṁ sa bhagavān vijñāyākhila-dṛk svayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1028_nanda_brought_back.satyaṁ jñānamanantaṁ yad brahma jyotiḥ s: satyaṁ jñānam-anantaṁ yad brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1028_nanda_brought_back.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe'ṣṭāviṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 28||

vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.uktaṁ purastādetatte caidyaḥ siddhiṁ yat: uktaṁ purastād-etat-te caidyaḥ siddhiṁ yathā gataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.kāmaṁ krodhaṁ bhayaṁ snehamaikyaṁ sauhṛd: kāmaṁ krodhaṁ bhayaṁ sneham-aikyaṁ sauhṛdam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.na caivaṁ vismayaḥ kāryo bhavatā bhagava: na caivaṁ vismayaḥ kāryo bhavatā bhagavaty-aje|
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.svāgataṁ vo mahābhāgāḥ priyaṁ kiṁ karavā: svāgataṁ vo mahā-bhāgāḥ priyaṁ kiṁ karavāṇi vaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.mātaraḥ pitaraḥ putrā bhrātaraḥ patayaśc: mātaraḥ pitaraḥ putrā bhrātaraḥ patayaś-ca vaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.krandanti vatsā bālāśca tān pāyayata duh: krandanti vatsā bālāś-ca tān pāyayata duhyata||
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.āgatā hyupapannaṁ vaḥ prīyante mayi jant: āgatā hy-upapannaṁ vaḥ prīyante mayi jantavaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṁ strīṇāṁ paro dharmo h: bhartuḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṁ strīṇāṁ paro dharmo hy-amāyayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.duḥśīlo durbhago vṛddho jaḍo rogyadhano': duḥśīlo durbhago vṛddho jaḍo rogy-adhano'pi vā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.yāmaḥ kathaṁ vrajamatho karavāma kiṁ vā|: yāmaḥ kathaṁ vrajam-atho karavāma kiṁ vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.stadvad vayaṁ ca tava pādarajaḥ prapannā: stadvad vayaṁ ca tava pāda-rajaḥ prapannāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.tāsāṁ tat saubhagamadaṁ vīkṣya mānaṁ ca: tāsāṁ tat saubhaga-madaṁ vīkṣya mānaṁ ca keśavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1029_beginning_rasa_lil.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe bhagavato rāsa-krīḍā-varṇanaṁ nāmaikonatriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 29||

vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.dṛṣṭo vaḥ kaccidaśvattha plakṣa nyagrodh: dṛṣṭo vaḥ kaccid-aśvattha plakṣa nyagrodha no manaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.prītiṁ vo janayan yātaḥ karasparśena mād: prītiṁ vo janayan yātaḥ kara-sparśena mādhavaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.mā bhaiṣṭa vātavarṣābhyāṁ tattrāṇaṁ vihi: mā bhaiṣṭa vāta-varṣābhyāṁ tat-trāṇaṁ vihitaṁ mayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.duṣṭāhe gaccha jāto'haṁ khalānāṁ nanu da: duṣṭāhe gaccha jāto'haṁ khalānāṁ nanu daṇḍa-dhṛk||
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.yanno vihāya govindaḥ prīto yāmanayad ra: yanno vihāya govindaḥ prīto yām-anayad rahaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.tasyā amūni naḥ kṣobhaṁ kurvantyuccaiḥ p: tasyā amūni naḥ kṣobhaṁ kurvanty-uccaiḥ padāni yat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.na lakṣyante padānyatra tasyā nūnaṁ tṛṇā: na lakṣyante padāny-atra tasyā nūnaṁ tṛṇāṁkuraiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.yāṁ gopīmanayat kṛṣṇo vihāyānyāḥ striyo: yāṁ gopīm-anayat kṛṣṇo vihāyānyāḥ striyo vane||
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.sā ca mene tadā''tmānaṁ variṣṭhaṁ sarvay: sā ca mene tadā''tmānaṁ variṣṭhaṁ sarva-yoṣitām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.hitvā gopīḥ kāmayānā māmasau bhajate pri: hitvā gopīḥ kāmayānā mām-asau bhajate priyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.hā nātha ramaṇa preṣṭha kvāsi kvāsi mahā: hā nātha ramaṇa preṣṭha kvāsi kvāsi mahā-bhuja|
vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.dāsyāste kṛpaṇāyā me sakhe darśaya sanni: dāsyās-te kṛpaṇāyā me sakhe darśaya sannidhim||
