vishnu/bhagavata/1030_state_gopis_separa.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe rāsa-krīḍāyāṁ kṛṣṇānveṣaṇaṁ nāma triṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 30||

vishnu/bhagavata/1031_song_gopis_gopikag.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe rāsa-krīḍāyāṁ gopī-gītaṁ nāmaikatriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 31||

vishnu/bhagavata/1032_lord_appears_conso.jahurvirahajaṁ tāpaṁ prājñaṁ prāpya yath: jahur-viraha-jaṁ tāpaṁ prājñaṁ prāpya yathā janāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1032_lord_appears_conso.nobhayāṁśca bhajantyeka etanno brūhi sād: nobhayāṁś-ca bhajanty-eka etanno brūhi sādhu bhoḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1032_lord_appears_conso.bhajantyabhajato ye vai karuṇāḥ pitaro y: bhajanty-abhajato ye vai karuṇāḥ pitaro yathā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1032_lord_appears_conso.bhajato'pi na vai kecid bhajantyabhajata: bhajato'pi na vai kecid bhajanty-abhajataḥ kutaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1032_lord_appears_conso.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe rāsa-krīḍāyāṁ gopī-sāntvanaṁ nāma dvātriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 32||

vishnu/bhagavata/1033_great_rasa_dance.t.unninye pūjitā tena prīyatā sādhu sādhvi: unninye pūjitā tena prīyatā sādhu sādhv-iti|
vishnu/bhagavata/1033_great_rasa_dance.t.tadeva dhruvamunninye tasyai mānaṁ ca ba: tadeva dhruvam-unninye tasyai mānaṁ ca bahv-adāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/1033_great_rasa_dance.t.kimabhiprāya etaṁ naḥ saṁśayaṁ chindhi s: kim-abhiprāya etaṁ naḥ saṁśayaṁ chindhi suvrata||
vishnu/bhagavata/1033_great_rasa_dance.t.tejīyasāṁ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarvabhujo ya: tejīyasāṁ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarva-bhujo yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1033_great_rasa_dance.t.manyamānāḥ svapārśvasthān svān svān dārā: manyamānāḥ sva-pārśvasthān svān svān dārān vrajaukasaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1033_great_rasa_dance.t.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe rāsa-krīḍā-varṇanaṁ nāma trayastriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 33||

vishnu/bhagavata/1034_deliverance_sudars.brāhmaṇebhyo daduḥ sarve devo naḥ prīyat: brāhmaṇebhyo daduḥ sarve devo naḥ prīyatām-iti||
vishnu/bhagavata/1034_deliverance_sudars.sa cukrośāhinā grastaḥ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahān: sa cukrośāhinā grastaḥ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahān-ayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1034_deliverance_sudars.grastaṁ ca dṛṣṭvā vibhrāntāḥ sarpaṁ vivy: grastaṁ ca dṛṣṭvā vibhrāntāḥ sarpaṁ vivyadhur-ulmukaiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1034_deliverance_sudars.tairimāṁ prāpito yoniṁ pralabdhaiḥ svena: tair-imāṁ prāpito yoniṁ pralabdhaiḥ svena pāpmanā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1034_deliverance_sudars.sadyaḥ punāti kiṁ bhūyastasya spṛṣṭaḥ pa: sadyaḥ punāti kiṁ bhūyas-tasya spṛṣṭaḥ padā hi te||
vishnu/bhagavata/1034_deliverance_sudars.tamanvadhāvad govindo yatra yatra sa dhā: tam-anvadhāvad govindo yatra yatra sa dhāvati|
vishnu/bhagavata/1034_deliverance_sudars.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe śaṁkhacūḍa-vadho nāma catustriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 34||

vishnu/bhagavata/1035_song_pairs_yugalag.evaṁ vrajastriyo rājan kṛṣṇalīlā nu gāya: evaṁ vraja-striyo rājan kṛṣṇa-līlā nu gāyatīḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1035_song_pairs_yugalag.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe vṛndāvana-krīḍāyāṁ gopikā-yugala-gītaṁ nāma pañcatriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 35||

vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.patantyakālato garbhāḥ sravanti sma bhay: patanty-akālato garbhāḥ sravanti sma bhayena vai|
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.gṛhītvā śṛṅgayostaṁ vā aṣṭādaśa padāni s: gṛhītvā śṛṅgayos-taṁ vā aṣṭādaśa padāni saḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.yaśodāyāḥ sutāṁ kanyāṁ devakyāḥ kṛṣṇamev: yaśodāyāḥ sutāṁ kanyāṁ devakyāḥ kṛṣṇam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.nyastau svamitre nande vai yābhyāṁ te pu: nyastau sva-mitre nande vai yābhyāṁ te puruṣā hatāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.rāmakṛṣṇau tato mahyaṁ mṛtyuḥ kila nidar: rāma-kṛṣṇau tato mahyaṁ mṛtyuḥ kila nidarśitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.bho bho dānapate mahyaṁ kriyatāṁ maitram: bho bho dāna-pate mahyaṁ kriyatāṁ maitram-ādṛtaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.tadbhrātaraṁ devakaṁ ca ye cānye vidviṣo: tad-bhrātaraṁ devakaṁ ca ye cānye vidviṣo mama||
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.tairahaṁ surapakṣīyān hatvā bhokṣye mahī: tair-ahaṁ sura-pakṣīyān hatvā bhokṣye mahīṁ nṛpān||
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.siddhyasiddhyoḥ samaṁ kuryād daivaṁ hi p: siddhy-asiddhyoḥ samaṁ kuryād daivaṁ hi phala-sādhanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1036_deliverance_arista.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe'krūra-saṁpreṣaṇaṁ nāma ṣaṭtriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 36||

vishnu/bhagavata/1037_deliverance_kesi_v.tasya tat karma vijñāya kṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇadaḥ: tasya tat karma vijñāya kṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇa-daḥ satām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1037_deliverance_kesi_v.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe vyomāsura-vadho nāma saptatriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 37||

vishnu/bhagavata/1038_akrura_journey_vra.akrūro'pi ca tāṁ rātriṁ madhupuryāṁ mahā: akrūro'pi ca tāṁ rātriṁ madhu-puryāṁ mahā-matiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1038_akrura_journey_vra.kiṁ vāthāpyarhate dattaṁ yad drakṣyāmyad: kiṁ vāthāpy-arhate dattaṁ yad drakṣyāmy-adya keśavam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1038_akrura_journey_vra.mahyaṁ na na syāt phalamañjasā dṛśaḥ||: mahyaṁ na na syāt phalam-añjasā dṛśaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1038_akrura_journey_vra.dadarśa kṛṣṇaṁ rāmaṁ ca vraje godohanaṁ: dadarśa kṛṣṇaṁ rāmaṁ ca vraje go-dohanaṁ gatau|
vishnu/bhagavata/1038_akrura_journey_vra.kiṁ nu svittatprajānāṁ vaḥ kuśalaṁ vimṛś: kiṁ nu svit-tat-prajānāṁ vaḥ kuśalaṁ vimṛśāmahe||
vishnu/bhagavata/1038_akrura_journey_vra.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe'krūrāgamanaṁ nāmāṣṭātriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 38||

vishnu/bhagavata/1039_sri_krsna_balarama.tathāpi tatparā rājanna hi vāñchanti kiṁ: tathāpi tatparā rājan-na hi vāñchanti kiṁcana||
vishnu/bhagavata/1039_sri_krsna_balarama.tāta saumyāgataḥ kaccit svāgataṁ bhadram: tāta saumyāgataḥ kaccit svāgataṁ bhadram-astu vaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1039_sri_krsna_balarama.yatsaṁdeśo yadarthaṁ vā dūtaḥ saṁpreṣita: yat-saṁdeśo yad-arthaṁ vā dūtaḥ saṁpreṣitaḥ svayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1039_sri_krsna_balarama.yāsyāmaḥ śvo madhupurīṁ dāsyāmo nṛpate r: yāsyāmaḥ śvo madhu-purīṁ dāsyāmo nṛpate rasān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1039_sri_krsna_balarama.nītāḥ sma naḥ kṣaṇamiva kṣaṇadā vinā taṁ: nītāḥ sma naḥ kṣaṇam-iva kṣaṇadā vinā taṁ
vishnu/bhagavata/1039_sri_krsna_balarama.tarhi svit syandane na sta ityunmajjya v: tarhi svit syandane na sta ity-unmajjya vyacaṣṭa saḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1039_sri_krsna_balarama.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe'krūra-pratiyāne ekona-catvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 39||

vishnu/bhagavata/1040_akrura_hymn_lord_s.tairāmṛṣṭaśuco lokā mudā gāyanti te yaśa: tair-āmṛṣṭa-śuco lokā mudā gāyanti te yaśaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1040_akrura_hymn_lord_s.abhyeti mṛgatṛṣṇāṁ vai tadvattvāhaṁ parā: abhyeti mṛgatṛṣṇāṁ vai tadvat-tvāhaṁ parāṅ mukhaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1040_akrura_hymn_lord_s.hṛṣīkeśa namastubhyaṁ prapannaṁ pāhi māṁ: hṛṣīkeśa namas-tubhyaṁ prapannaṁ pāhi māṁ prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/1040_akrura_hymn_lord_s.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe'krūra-stutir-nāma catvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 40||

vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.taṁ tvānupaśyato brahman kiṁ me dṛṣṭamih: taṁ tvānupaśyato brahman kiṁ me dṛṣṭam-ihādbhutam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.vasudevasutau vīkṣya prītā dṛṣṭiṁ na cād: vasudeva-sutau vīkṣya prītā dṛṣṭiṁ na cādaduḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.tyaktuṁ nārhasi māṁ nātha bhaktaṁ te bha: tyaktuṁ nārhasi māṁ nātha bhaktaṁ te bhakta-vatsala||
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.aiśvaryamatulaṁ lebhe gatiṁ caikāntināṁ: aiśvaryam-atulaṁ lebhe gatiṁ caikāntināṁ tu yā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.ūcuḥ paurā aho gopyastapaḥ kimacaran mah: ūcuḥ paurā aho gopyas-tapaḥ kim-acaran mahat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.bhaviṣyati paraṁ śreyo dātuste nātra saṁ: bhaviṣyati paraṁ śreyo dātus-te nātra saṁśayaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.badhnanti ghnanti lumpanti dṛptaṁ rājaku: badhnanti ghnanti lumpanti dṛptaṁ rāja-kulāni vai||
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.na hi vāṁ viṣamā dṛṣṭiḥ suhṛdorjagadātma: na hi vāṁ viṣamā dṛṣṭiḥ suhṛdor-jagad-ātmanoḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.tadbhakteṣu ca sauhārdaṁ bhūteṣu ca dayā: tad-bhakteṣu ca sauhārdaṁ bhūteṣu ca dayāṁ parām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.iti tasmai varaṁ dattvā śriyaṁ cānvayava: iti tasmai varaṁ dattvā śriyaṁ cānvaya-vardhinīm|
vishnu/bhagavata/1041_sri_krsna_enters_m.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe pura-praveśo nāma eka-catvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 41||

vishnu/bhagavata/1042_lord_grace_kubja_b.ṛjvīṁ kartuṁ manaścakre darśayan darśane: ṛjvīṁ kartuṁ manaś-cakre darśayan darśane phalam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1042_lord_grace_kubja_b.ehi vīra gṛhaṁ yāmo na tvāṁ tyaktumihots: ehi vīra gṛhaṁ yāmo na tvāṁ tyaktum-ihotsahe|
vishnu/bhagavata/1042_lord_grace_kubja_b.visṛjya mādhvyā vāṇyā tāṁ vrajan mārge v: visṛjya mādhvyā vāṇyā tāṁ vrajan mārge vaṇik-pathaiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1042_lord_grace_kubja_b.kaṁsastu dhanuṣo bhaṁgaṁ rakṣiṇāṁ svabal: kaṁsas-tu dhanuṣo bhaṁgaṁ rakṣiṇāṁ svabalasya ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1042_lord_grace_kubja_b.asatyapi dvitīye ca dvairūpyaṁ jyotiṣāṁ: asaty-api dvitīye ca dvairūpyaṁ jyotiṣāṁ tathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1042_lord_grace_kubja_b.paśyan maraṇasantrasto nidrāṁ lebhe na c: paśyan maraṇa-santrasto nidrāṁ lebhe na cintayā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1042_lord_grace_kubja_b.cāṇūro muṣṭikaḥ kūṭaḥ śalastośala eva ca: cāṇūro muṣṭikaḥ kūṭaḥ śalas-tośala eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1042_lord_grace_kubja_b.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe malla-raṁgopavarṇanaṁ nāma dvicatvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 42||

vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.ambaṣṭhāmbaṣṭha mārgaṁ nau dehyapakrama: ambaṣṭhāmbaṣṭha mārgaṁ nau dehy-apakrama mā ciram|
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.no cet sakuṁjaraṁ tvādya nayāmi yamasāda: no cet sakuṁjaraṁ tvādya nayāmi yama-sādanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.taṁ matvā patitaṁ kruddho dantābhyāṁ so': taṁ matvā patitaṁ kruddho dantābhyāṁ so'hanat-kṣitim||
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.ūcuḥ parasparaṁ te vai yathādṛṣṭaṁ yathā: ūcuḥ parasparaṁ te vai yathādṛṣṭaṁ yathā-śrutam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.eṣa vai kila devakyāṁ jāto nītaśca gokul: eṣa vai kila devakyāṁ jāto nītaś-ca gokulam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.arjunau guhyakaḥ keśī dhenuko'nye ca tad: arjunau guhyakaḥ keśī dhenuko'nye ca tad-vidhāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.kāliyo damitaḥ sarpa indraśca vimadaḥ kṛ: kāliyo damitaḥ sarpa indraś-ca vimadaḥ kṛtaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.he nandasūno he rāma bhavantau vīrasaṁma: he nanda-sūno he rāma bhavantau vīra-saṁmatau|
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.nityaṁ pramuditā gopā vatsapālā yathā sp: nityaṁ pramuditā gopā vatsa-pālā yathā sphuṭam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.na bālo na kiśorastvaṁ balaśca balināṁ v: na bālo na kiśoras-tvaṁ balaś-ca balināṁ varaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1043_deliverance_kuvala.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe kuvalayāpīḍa-vadho nāma tricatvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 43||

vishnu/bhagavata/1044_deliverance_canura.ṛte kaṁsaṁ vipramukhyāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhu s: ṛte kaṁsaṁ vipra-mukhyāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhu sādhv-iti||
vishnu/bhagavata/1044_deliverance_canura.tvayā hatena nihatā vayaṁ te sagṛhaprajā: tvayā hatena nihatā vayaṁ te sagṛha-prajāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1044_deliverance_canura.tenemāṁ bho daśāṁ nīto bhūtadhruk ko lab: tenemāṁ bho daśāṁ nīto bhūta-dhruk ko labheta śam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1044_deliverance_canura.goptā ca tadavadhyāyī na kvacit sukhamed: goptā ca tad-avadhyāyī na kvacit sukham-edhate||
vishnu/bhagavata/1044_deliverance_canura.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe kaṁsa-vadho nāma catuścatvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 44||

vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.mā bhūditi nijāṁ māyāṁ tatāna janamohinī: mā bhūd-iti nijāṁ māyāṁ tatāna jana-mohinīm||
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.yāṁ bālāḥ pitṛgehasthā vindante lālitā m: yāṁ bālāḥ pitṛ-geha-sthā vindante lālitā mudam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.yastayorātmajaḥ kalpa ātmanā ca dhanena: yas-tayor-ātmajaḥ kalpa ātmanā ca dhanena ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.vṛttiṁ na dadyāttaṁ pretya svamāṁsaṁ khā: vṛttiṁ na dadyāt-taṁ pretya sva-māṁsaṁ khādayanti hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.sa pitā sā ca jananī yau puṣṇītāṁ svaput: sa pitā sā ca jananī yau puṣṇītāṁ sva-putravat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.yāta yūyaṁ vrajaṁ tāta vayaṁ ca snehaduḥ: yāta yūyaṁ vrajaṁ tāta vayaṁ ca sneha-duḥkhitān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.jñātīn vo draṣṭumeṣyāmo vidhāya suhṛdāṁ: jñātīn vo draṣṭum-eṣyāmo vidhāya suhṛdāṁ sukham||
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.tathā cānvīkṣikīṁ vidyāṁ rājanītiṁ ca ṣa: tathā cānvīkṣikīṁ vidyāṁ rāja-nītiṁ ca ṣaḍ-vidhām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.līlāmanuṣya he viṣṇo yuvayoḥ karavāma ki: līlā-manuṣya he viṣṇo yuvayoḥ karavāma kim||
vishnu/bhagavata/1045_sacred_thread_sri_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe guru-putrānayanaṁ nāma pañcacatvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 45||

vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.mayi tāḥ preyasāṁ preṣṭhe dūrasthe gokul: mayi tāḥ preyasāṁ preṣṭhe dūra-sthe gokula-striyaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.sādhūnāṁ dharmaśīlānāṁ yadūnāṁ dveṣṭi ya: sādhūnāṁ dharma-śīlānāṁ yadūnāṁ dveṣṭi yaḥ sadā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.gopān vrajaṁ cātmanāthaṁ gāvo vṛndāvanaṁ: gopān vrajaṁ cātma-nāthaṁ gāvo vṛndāvanaṁ girim||
vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.manye kṛṣṇaṁ ca rāmaṁ ca prāptāviha suro: manye kṛṣṇaṁ ca rāmaṁ ca prāptāv-iha surottamau|
vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.na cāsya karma vā loke sadasanmiśrayoniṣ: na cāsya karma vā loke sad-asan-miśra-yoniṣu|
vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.sattvaṁ rajastama iti bhajate nirguṇo gu: sattvaṁ rajas-tama iti bhajate nirguṇo guṇān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.sarveṣāmātmajo hyātmā pitā mātā sa īśvar: sarveṣām-ātmajo hyātmā pitā mātā sa īśvaraḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.akrūra āgataḥ kiṁ vā yaḥ kaṁsasyārthasād: akrūra āgataḥ kiṁ vā yaḥ kaṁsasyārtha-sādhakaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1046_uddhava_journey_vr.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe nanda-śokāpanayanaṁ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 46||

vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.anyathā govraje tasya smaraṇīyaṁ na cakṣ: anyathā go-vraje tasya smaraṇīyaṁ na cakṣmahe|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.pumbhiḥ strīṣu kṛtā yadvat sumanassviva: pumbhiḥ strīṣu kṛtā yadvat sumanassv-iva ṣaṭpadaiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.khagā vītaphalaṁ vṛkṣaṁ bhuktvā cātithay: khagā vīta-phalaṁ vṛkṣaṁ bhuktvā cātithayo gṛham|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.dagdhaṁ mṛgāstathāraṇyaṁ jāro bhuktvā ra: dagdhaṁ mṛgās-tathāraṇyaṁ jāro bhuktvā ratāṁ striyam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.divi bhuvi ca rasāyāṁ kāḥ striyastaddurā: divi bhuvi ca rasāyāṁ kāḥ striyas-tad-durāpāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.smarati sa pitṛgehān saumya bandhūṁśca g: smarati sa pitṛ-gehān saumya bandhūṁś-ca gopān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.kvacidapi sa kathā naḥ kiṁkarīṇāṁ gṛṇīte: kvacid-api sa kathā naḥ kiṁkarīṇāṁ gṛṇīte|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.aho yūyaṁ sma pūrṇārthā bhavatyo lokapūj: aho yūyaṁ sma pūrṇārthā bhavatyo loka-pūjitāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.yathā bhūtāni bhūteṣu khaṁ vāyvagnirjala: yathā bhūtāni bhūteṣu khaṁ vāyv-agnir-jalaṁ mahī|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.yattvahaṁ bhavatīnāṁ vai dūre varte priy: yat-tvahaṁ bhavatīnāṁ vai dūre varte priyo dṛśām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.yathā dūracare preṣṭhe mana āviśya varta: yathā dūra-care preṣṭhe mana āviśya vartate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.strīṇāṁ ca na tathā cetaḥ sannikṛṣṭe'kṣi: strīṇāṁ ca na tathā cetaḥ sannikṛṣṭe'kṣi-gocare||
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.paraṁ saukhyaṁ hi nairāśyaṁ svairiṇyapyā: paraṁ saukhyaṁ hi nairāśyaṁ svairiṇy-apy-āha piṁgalā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.mādhvyā girā hṛtadhiyaḥ kathaṁ taṁ visma: mādhvyā girā hṛta-dhiyaḥ kathaṁ taṁ vismarāmahe||
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.vāñchanti yad bhavabhiyo munayo vayaṁ ca: vāñchanti yad bhava-bhiyo munayo vayaṁ ca
vishnu/bhagavata/1047_talk_uddhava_gopis.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe uddhava-pratiyāne sapta-catvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 47||

vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.tasyai kāmavaraṁ dattvā mānayitvā ca mān: tasyai kāma-varaṁ dattvā mānayitvā ca mānadaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.nanāma kṛṣṇaṁ rāmaṁ ca sa tairapyabhivād: nanāma kṛṣṇaṁ rāmaṁ ca sa tair-apy-abhivāditaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.diṣṭyā pāpo hataḥ kaṁsaḥ sānugo vāmidaṁ: diṣṭyā pāpo hataḥ kaṁsaḥ sānugo vām-idaṁ kulam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.bhavadbhyāṁ na vinā kiṁcit paramasti na: bhavadbhyāṁ na vinā kiṁcit param-asti na cāparam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.tvaṁ no guruḥ pitṛvyaśca ślāghyo bandhuś: tvaṁ no guruḥ pitṛvyaś-ca ślāghyo bandhuś-ca nityadā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.vayaṁ tu rakṣyāḥ poṣyāśca anukampyāḥ pra: vayaṁ tu rakṣyāḥ poṣyāś-ca anukampyāḥ prajā hi vaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilām: na hy-ammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.sa bhavān suhṛdāṁ vai naḥ śreyāñchreyaśc: sa bhavān suhṛdāṁ vai naḥ śreyāñchreyaś-cikīrṣayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.ānītāḥ svapuraṁ rājñā vasanta iti śuśrum: ānītāḥ sva-puraṁ rājñā vasanta iti śuśruma||
vishnu/bhagavata/1048_lord_goes_houses_k.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe aṣṭa-catvāriṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 48||

vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.teja ojo balaṁ vīryaṁ praśrayādīṁśca sad: teja ojo balaṁ vīryaṁ praśrayādīṁś-ca sad-guṇān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.ācakhyau sarvamevāsmai pṛthā vidura eva: ācakhyau sarvam-evāsmai pṛthā vidura eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.api smaranti naḥ saumya pitarau bhrātara: api smaranti naḥ saumya pitarau bhrātaraś-ca me|
vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.bhaginyo bhrātṛputrāśca jāmayaḥ sakhya e: bhaginyo bhrātṛ-putrāś-ca jāmayaḥ sakhya eva ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.bho bho vaicitravīrya tvaṁ kurūṇāṁ kīrti: bho bho vaicitravīrya tvaṁ kurūṇāṁ kīrti-vardhana|
vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.yathā vadati kalyāṇīṁ vācaṁ dānapate bha: yathā vadati kalyāṇīṁ vācaṁ dāna-pate bhavān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.īśvarasya vidhiṁ ko nu vidhunotyanyathā: īśvarasya vidhiṁ ko nu vidhunoty-anyathā pumān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.pāṇḍavān prati kauravya yadarthaṁ preṣit: pāṇḍavān prati kauravya yad-arthaṁ preṣitaḥ svayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1049_akrura_goes_hastin.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe pūrvārdhe ekona-pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 49||

vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.mṛte bhartari duḥkhārte īyatuḥ sma pitur: mṛte bhartari duḥkhārte īyatuḥ sma pitur-gṛhān||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.svapuraṁ tena saṁruddhaṁ svajanaṁ ca bha: sva-puraṁ tena saṁruddhaṁ svajanaṁ ca bhayākulam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.māgadhastu na hantavyo bhūyaḥ kartā balo: māgadhas-tu na hantavyo bhūyaḥ kartā balodyamam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.eṣa te ratha āyāto dayitānyāyudhāni ca||: eṣa te ratha āyāto dayitāny-āyudhāni ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.etadarthaṁ hi nau janma sādhūnāmīśa śarm: etad-arthaṁ hi nau janma sādhūnām-īśa śarma-kṛt||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.guptena hi tvayā manda na yotsye yāhi ba: guptena hi tvayā manda na yotsye yāhi bandhu-han||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.tava rāma yadi śraddhā yudhyasva dhairya: tava rāma yadi śraddhā yudhyasva dhairyam-udvaha|
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.hitvā vā maccharaiśchinnaṁ dehaṁ svaryāh: hitvā vā maccharaiś-chinnaṁ dehaṁ svaryāhi māṁ jahi||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.na vai śūrā vikatthante darśayantyeva pa: na vai śūrā vikatthante darśayanty-eva pauruṣam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.aho yadūnāṁ vṛjinaṁ prāptaṁ hyubhayato m: aho yadūnāṁ vṛjinaṁ prāptaṁ hy-ubhayato mahat||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.māgadho'pyadya vā śvo vā paraśvo vā''gam: māgadho'py-adya vā śvo vā paraśvo vā''gamiṣyati||
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.dṛśyate yatra hi tvāṣṭraṁ vijñānaṁ śilpa: dṛśyate yatra hi tvāṣṭraṁ vijñānaṁ śilpa-naipuṇam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1050_battle_jarasandha_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe durga-niveśanaṁ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 50||

vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.sa utthāya ciraṁ suptaḥ śanairunmīlya lo: sa utthāya ciraṁ suptaḥ śanair-unmīlya locane|
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.ko nāma sa pumān brahman kasya kiṁvīrya: ko nāma sa pumān brahman kasya kiṁ-vīrya eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.kasmād guhāṁ gataḥ śiśye kintejo yavanār: kasmād guhāṁ gataḥ śiśye kin-tejo yavanārdanaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.asmān pālayato vīra kāmāste sarva ujjhit: asmān pālayato vīra kāmās-te sarva ujjhitāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.varaṁ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṁ te ṛte kaivalyamad: varaṁ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṁ te ṛte kaivalyam-adya naḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.sūryaḥ somo mahendro vā lokapālo'paro'pi: sūryaḥ somo mahendro vā loka-pālo'paro'pi vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.yad bādhase guhādhvāntaṁ pradīpaḥ prabha: yad bādhase guhā-dhvāntaṁ pradīpaḥ prabhayā yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.ayaṁ ca yavano dagdho rājaṁste tigmacakṣ: ayaṁ ca yavano dagdho rājaṁs-te tigma-cakṣuṣā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.māṁ prapanno janaḥ kaścinna bhūyo'rhati: māṁ prapanno janaḥ kaścin-na bhūyo'rhati śocitum||
vishnu/bhagavata/1051_kalayavana_burnt_a.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe mucukunda-stutir-nāmaika-pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 51||

vishnu/bhagavata/1052_journey_dvaraka_ma.sa vīkṣya kṣullakān martyān paśūn vīrudv: sa vīkṣya kṣullakān martyān paśūn vīrud-vanaspatīn|
vishnu/bhagavata/1052_journey_dvaraka_ma.hatvā mlecchabalaṁ ninye tadīyaṁ dvārakā: hatvā mleccha-balaṁ ninye tadīyaṁ dvārakāṁ dhanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1052_journey_dvaraka_ma.ko nu tṛpyeta śṛṇvānaḥ śrutajño nityanūt: ko nu tṛpyeta śṛṇvānaḥ śruta-jño nitya-nūtanāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1052_journey_dvaraka_ma.kṛṣṇaśca sadṛśīṁ bhāryāṁ samudvoḍhuṁ man: kṛṣṇaś-ca sadṛśīṁ bhāryāṁ samudvoḍhuṁ mano dadhe||
vishnu/bhagavata/1052_journey_dvaraka_ma.sarvaṁ no brūhyaguhyaṁ cet kiṁ kāryaṁ ka: sarvaṁ no brūhy-aguhyaṁ cet kiṁ kāryaṁ karavāma te||
vishnu/bhagavata/1052_journey_dvaraka_ma.tanme bhavān khalu vṛtaḥ patiraṅga jāyā-: tanme bhavān khalu vṛtaḥ patir-aṅga jāyā-
vishnu/bhagavata/1052_journey_dvaraka_ma.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe rukmiṇy-udvāha-prastāve dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 52||

vishnu/bhagavata/1053_carrying_away_rukm.vaidarbhyāḥ sa tu sandeśaṁ niśamya yadun: vaidarbhyāḥ sa tu sandeśaṁ niśamya yadu-nandanaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1053_carrying_away_rukm.tathāhamapi taccitto nidrāṁ ca na labhe: tathāham-api tac-citto nidrāṁ ca na labhe niśi|
vishnu/bhagavata/1053_carrying_away_rukm.prādād dhenūśca viprebhyo rājā vidhividā: prādād dhenūś-ca viprebhyo rājā vidhividāṁ varaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1053_carrying_away_rukm.evaṁ cedipatī rājā damaghoṣaḥ sutāya vai: evaṁ cedi-patī rājā damaghoṣaḥ sutāya vai|
vishnu/bhagavata/1053_carrying_away_rukm.kṛṣṇaṁ caikaṁ gataṁ hartuṁ kanyāṁ kalaha: kṛṣṇaṁ caikaṁ gataṁ hartuṁ kanyāṁ kalaha-śaṁkitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1053_carrying_away_rukm.tābhyo devyai namaścakre śeṣāṁ ca jagṛhe: tābhyo devyai namaś-cakre śeṣāṁ ca jagṛhe vadhūḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1053_carrying_away_rukm.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe rukmiṇī-haraṇaṁ nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 53||

vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.tathāpyahaṁ na śocāmi na prahṛṣyāmi karh: tathāpy-ahaṁ na śocāmi na prahṛṣyāmi karhicit|
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.hataśeṣāḥ punaste'pi yayuḥ svaṁ svaṁ pur: hata-śeṣāḥ punas-te'pi yayuḥ svaṁ svaṁ puraṁ nṛpāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.kuṇḍinaṁ na pravekṣyāmi satyametad bravī: kuṇḍinaṁ na pravekṣyāmi satyam-etad bravīmi vaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.codayāśvān yataḥ kṛṣṇastasya me saṁyugaṁ: codayāśvān yataḥ kṛṣṇas-tasya me saṁyugaṁ bhavet||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.neṣye vīryamadaṁ yena svasā me prasabhaṁ: neṣye vīrya-madaṁ yena svasā me prasabhaṁ hṛtā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.dhanurvikṛṣya sudṛḍhaṁ jaghne kṛṣṇaṁ tri: dhanur-vikṛṣya sudṛḍhaṁ jaghne kṛṣṇaṁ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.āha cātra kṣaṇaṁ tiṣṭha yadūnāṁ kulapāṁs: āha cātra kṣaṇaṁ tiṣṭha yadūnāṁ kula-pāṁsana||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.yāvanna me hato bāṇaiḥ śayīthā muñca dār: yāvan-na me hato bāṇaiḥ śayīthā muñca dārikām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.aṣṭabhiścaturo vāhān dvābhyāṁ sūtaṁ dhva: aṣṭabhiś-caturo vāhān dvābhyāṁ sūtaṁ dhvajaṁ tribhiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.sa cānyad dhanurādāya kṛṣṇaṁ vivyādha pa: sa cānyad dhanur-ādāya kṛṣṇaṁ vivyādha pañcabhiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.hantuṁ nārhasi kalyāṇa bhrātaraṁ me mahā: hantuṁ nārhasi kalyāṇa bhrātaraṁ me mahā-bhuja||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.sukhaduḥkhado na cānyo'sti yataḥ svakṛta: sukha-duḥkhado na cānyo'sti yataḥ sva-kṛta-bhuk pumān||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.mānino'nyasya vā hetoḥ śrīmadāndhāḥ kṣip: mānino'nyasya vā hetoḥ śrī-madāndhāḥ kṣipanti hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.eka eva paro hyātmā sarveṣāmapi dehinām|: eka eva paro hyātmā sarveṣām-api dehinām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.yathā śayāna ātmānaṁ viṣayān phalameva c: yathā śayāna ātmānaṁ viṣayān phalam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.tadā mahotsavo nṝṇāṁ yadupuryāṁ gṛhe gṛh: tadā mahotsavo nṝṇāṁ yadu-puryāṁ gṛhe gṛhe|
vishnu/bhagavata/1054_defeat_sisupala_al.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe rukmiṇy-udvāhe catuḥpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 54||

vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.taṁ nirjagāra balavān mīnaḥ so'pyaparaiḥ: taṁ nirjagāra balavān mīnaḥ so'py-aparaiḥ saha|
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.sā ca kāmasya vai patnī ratirnāma yaśasv: sā ca kāmasya vai patnī ratir-nāma yaśasvinī|
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.sa ca māyāṁ samāśritya daiteyīṁ mayadarś: sa ca māyāṁ samāśritya daiteyīṁ maya-darśitām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.prāyuṁkta śataśo daityaḥ kārṣṇirvyadhama: prāyuṁkta śataśo daityaḥ kārṣṇir-vyadhamayat sa tāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.kṛṣṇaṁ matvā striyo hrītā nililyustatra: kṛṣṇaṁ matvā striyo hrītā nililyus-tatra tatra ha||
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.ko nvayaṁ naravaidūryaḥ kasya vā kamalek: ko nvayaṁ nara-vaidūryaḥ kasya vā kamalekṣaṇaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.dhṛtaḥ kayā vā jaṭhare keyaṁ labdhā tvan: dhṛtaḥ kayā vā jaṭhare keyaṁ labdhā tv-anena vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.mama cāpyātmajo naṣṭo nīto yaḥ sūtikāgṛh: mama cāpyātmajo naṣṭo nīto yaḥ sūtikā-gṛhāt|
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.sa eva vā bhavennūnaṁ yo me garbhe dhṛto: sa eva vā bhaven-nūnaṁ yo me garbhe dhṛto'rbhakaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.amuṣmin prītiradhikā vāmaḥ sphurati me b: amuṣmin prītir-adhikā vāmaḥ sphurati me bhujaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.dampatī tau pariṣvajya rukmiṇī ca yayurm: dampatī tau pariṣvajya rukmiṇī ca yayur-mudam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1055_birth_pradyumna_sl.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe pradyumnotpatti-nirūpaṇaṁ nāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 55||

vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.syamantakaḥ kutastasya kasmād dattā sutā: syamantakaḥ kutas-tasya kasmād dattā sutā hareḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.jñātvādya gūḍhaṁ yaduṣu draṣṭuṁ tvāṁ yāt: jñātvādya gūḍhaṁ yaduṣu draṣṭuṁ tvāṁ yāty-ajaḥ prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.dine dine svarṇabhārānaṣṭau sa sṛjati pr: dine dine svarṇa-bhārān-aṣṭau sa sṛjati prabho|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.sa yācito maṇiṁ kvāpi yadurājāya śauriṇā: sa yācito maṇiṁ kvāpi yadu-rājāya śauriṇā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.hataṁ prasenamaśvaṁ ca vīkṣya kesariṇā v: hataṁ prasenam-aśvaṁ ca vīkṣya kesariṇā vane|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.tamapūrvaṁ naraṁ dṛṣṭvā dhātrī cukrośa b: tam-apūrvaṁ naraṁ dṛṣṭvā dhātrī cukrośa bhītavat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.jāne tvāṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ prāṇa ojaḥ saho: jāne tvāṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ prāṇa ojaḥ saho balam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.tvaṁ hi viśvasṛjāṁ sraṣṭā sṛjyānāmapi ya: tvaṁ hi viśva-sṛjāṁ sraṣṭā sṛjyānām-api yacca sat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.setuḥ kṛtaḥ svayaśa ujjvalitā ca laṁkā: setuḥ kṛtaḥ sva-yaśa ujjvalitā ca laṁkā
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.ityuktaḥ svāṁ duhitaraṁ kanyāṁ jāmbavatī: ity-uktaḥ svāṁ duhitaraṁ kanyāṁ jāmbavatīṁ mudā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.teṣāṁ tu devyupasthānāt pratyādiṣṭāśiṣā: teṣāṁ tu devy-upasthānāt pratyādiṣṭāśiṣā sa ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.dāsye duhitaraṁ tasmai strīratnaṁ ratnam: dāsye duhitaraṁ tasmai strī-ratnaṁ ratnam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.evaṁ vyavasito buddhyā satrājit svasutāṁ: evaṁ vyavasito buddhyā satrājit sva-sutāṁ śubhām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.bhagavānāha na maṇiṁ pratīcchāmo vayaṁ n: bhagavān-āha na maṇiṁ pratīcchāmo vayaṁ nṛpa|
vishnu/bhagavata/1056_story_syamantaka_j.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe syamantakopākhyāne ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 56||

vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.kuntīṁ ca kulyakaraṇe saharāmo yayau kur: kuntīṁ ca kulya-karaṇe saha-rāmo yayau kurūn||
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.bhīṣmaṁ kṛpaṁ saviduraṁ gāndhārīṁ droṇam: bhīṣmaṁ kṛpaṁ saviduraṁ gāndhārīṁ droṇam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.tulyaduḥkhau ca saṁgamya hā kaṣṭamiti ho: tulya-duḥkhau ca saṁgamya hā kaṣṭam-iti hocatuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.ya idaṁ līlayā viśvaṁ sṛjatyavati hanti: ya idaṁ līlayā viśvaṁ sṛjaty-avati hanti ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.aprāptiṁ ca maṇeḥ prāha priyāyāḥ priyakṛ: aprāptiṁ ca maṇeḥ prāha priyāyāḥ priya-kṛd vibhuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.tataḥ sa kārayāmāsa kriyā bandhorhatasya: tataḥ sa kārayāmāsa kriyā bandhor-hatasya vai|
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.sākaṁ suhṛdbhirbhagavān yā yāḥ syuḥ sāmp: sākaṁ suhṛdbhir-bhagavān yā yāḥ syuḥ sāmparāyikāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.svasutāṁ gāndinīṁ prādāt tato'varṣat sma: sva-sutāṁ gāndinīṁ prādāt tato'varṣat sma kāśiṣu||
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.syamantako maṇiḥ śrīmān viditaḥ pūrvamev: syamantako maṇiḥ śrīmān viditaḥ pūrvam-eva naḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.kintu māmagrajaḥ samyaṅ na pratyeti maṇi: kintu mām-agrajaḥ samyaṅ na pratyeti maṇiṁ prati||
vishnu/bhagavata/1057_theft_syamantaka_d.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe syamantakopākhyāne sapta-pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 57||

vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.sānurāgasmitaṁ vaktraṁ vīkṣya tasya muda: sānurāga-smitaṁ vaktraṁ vīkṣya tasya mudaṁ yayuḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.tadaiva kuśalaṁ no'bhūt sanāthāste kṛtā: tadaiva kuśalaṁ no'bhūt sanāthās-te kṛtā vayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.jñātīn naḥ smaratā kṛṣṇa bhrātā me preṣi: jñātīn naḥ smaratā kṛṣṇa bhrātā me preṣitas-tvayā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.kiṁ na ācaritaṁ śreyo na vedāhamadhīśvar: kiṁ na ācaritaṁ śreyo na vedāham-adhīśvara|
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.tān ninyuḥ kiṁkarā rājñe medhyān parvaṇy: tān ninyuḥ kiṁkarā rājñe medhyān parvaṇy-upāgate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.manye tvāṁ patimicchantīṁ sarvaṁ kathaya: manye tvāṁ patim-icchantīṁ sarvaṁ kathaya śobhane||
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.mayaśca mocito vahneḥ sabhāṁ sakhya upāh: mayaś-ca mocito vahneḥ sabhāṁ sakhya upāharat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.na tāṁ śekurnṛpā voḍhumajitvā sapta govṛ: na tāṁ śekur-nṛpā voḍhum-ajitvā sapta go-vṛṣān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.kiṁ tvasmābhiḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṁ samayaḥ sātv: kiṁ tv-asmābhiḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṁ samayaḥ sātvatarṣabha|
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.rājapatnyaśca duhituḥ kṛṣṇaṁ labdhvā pri: rāja-patnyaś-ca duhituḥ kṛṣṇaṁ labdhvā priyaṁ patim|
vishnu/bhagavata/1058_other_marriages_lo.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe aṣṭa-mahiṣy-udvāho nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 58||

vishnu/bhagavata/1059_deliverance_bhauma.muraḥ śayāna uttasthau daityaḥ paṁcaśirā: muraḥ śayāna uttasthau daityaḥ paṁca-śirā jalāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/1059_deliverance_bhauma.taṁ praviṣṭaṁ striyo vīkṣya naravīraṁ vi: taṁ praviṣṭaṁ striyo vīkṣya nara-vīraṁ vimohitāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1059_deliverance_bhauma.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe pārijāta-haraṇa-naraka-vadho nāma ekona-ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 59||

vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.sa hi jātaḥ svasetūnāṁ gopīthāya yaduṣva: sa hi jātaḥ sva-setūnāṁ gopīthāya yaduṣv-ajaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.dattā bhrātrā svapitrā ca kasmānno vavṛṣ: dattā bhrātrā sva-pitrā ca kasmān-no vavṛṣe'samān||
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.tasmāt prāyeṇa na hyāḍhyā māṁ bhajanti s: tasmāt prāyeṇa na hy-āḍhyā māṁ bhajanti sumadhyame||
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.vṛtā vayaṁ guṇairhīnā bhikṣubhiḥ ślāghit: vṛtā vayaṁ guṇair-hīnā bhikṣubhiḥ ślāghitā mudhā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.yena tvamāśiṣaḥ satyā ihāmutra ca lapsya: yena tvam-āśiṣaḥ satyā ihāmutra ca lapsyase||
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.tad dṛṣṭvā bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ priyāyāḥ prem: tad dṛṣṭvā bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ priyāyāḥ prema-bandhanam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.mā mā vaidarbhyasūyethā jāne tvāṁ matpar: mā mā vaidarbhy-asūyethā jāne tvāṁ mat-parāyaṇām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.mayoditaṁ yadanvāttha sarvaṁ tat satyame: mayoditaṁ yad-anvāttha sarvaṁ tat satyam-eva hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.yān yān kāmayase kāmān mayyakāmāya bhāmi: yān yān kāmayase kāmān mayy-akāmāya bhāmini|
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.ye māṁ bhajanti dāmpatye tapasā vratacar: ye māṁ bhajanti dāmpatye tapasā vrata-caryayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1060_dialogue_sri_krsna.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe kṛṣṇa-rukmiṇī-saṁvādo nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 60||

vishnu/bhagavata/1061_children_lord_rukm.preṣṭhaṁ nyamaṁsata svaṁ svaṁ na tattatt: preṣṭhaṁ nyamaṁsata svaṁ svaṁ na tat-tattva-vidaḥ striyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1061_children_lord_rukm.taṁ tu rukmyajayattatra kāliṁgaḥ prāhasa: taṁ tu rukmy-ajayat-tatra kāliṁgaḥ prāhasad balam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1061_children_lord_rukm.tato lakṣaṁ rukmyagṛhṇād glahaṁ tatrājay: tato lakṣaṁ rukmy-agṛhṇād glahaṁ tatrājayad balaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1061_children_lord_rukm.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe aniruddha-vivāhe rukmi-vadho nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 61||

vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.śoṇitākhye pure ramye sa rājyamakarot pu: śoṇitākhye pure ramye sa rājyam-akarot purā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.doḥsahasraṁ tvayā dattaṁ paraṁ bhārāya m: doḥ-sahasraṁ tvayā dattaṁ paraṁ bhārāya me'bhavat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.trilokyāṁ pratiyoddhāraṁ na labhe tvadṛt: trilokyāṁ pratiyoddhāraṁ na labhe tvad-ṛte samam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.tacchrutvā bhagavān kruddhaḥ ketuste bha: tacchrutvā bhagavān kruddhaḥ ketus-te bhajyate yadā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.sā tatra tamapaśyantī kvāsi kānteti vādi: sā tatra tam-apaśyantī kvāsi kānteti vādinī|
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.kaṁ tvaṁ mṛgayase subhrūḥ kīdṛśaste mano: kaṁ tvaṁ mṛgayase subhrūḥ kīdṛśas-te manorathaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.vyalikhad rāmakṛṣṇau ca pradyumnaṁ vīkṣy: vyalikhad rāma-kṛṣṇau ca pradyumnaṁ vīkṣya lajjitā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.sā ca taṁ sundaravaraṁ vilokya muditānan: sā ca taṁ sundara-varaṁ vilokya muditānanā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.duṣprekṣye svagṛhe pumbhī reme prādyumni: duṣprekṣye sva-gṛhe pumbhī reme prādyumninā samam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1062_meeting_usa_anirud.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe- 'niruddha-bandho nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 62||

vishnu/bhagavata/1063_battle_banasura_lo.triśiraste prasanno'smi vyetu te majjvar: triśiraste prasanno'smi vyetu te maj-jvarād bhayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1063_battle_banasura_lo.tvaṁ hi brahma paraṁ jyotirgūḍhaṁ brahma: tvaṁ hi brahma paraṁ jyotir-gūḍhaṁ brahmaṇi vāṅ maye|
vishnu/bhagavata/1063_battle_banasura_lo.yo nādriyeta tvatpādau sa śocyo hyātmava: yo nādriyeta tvat-pādau sa śocyo hy-ātma-vaṁcakaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1063_battle_banasura_lo.ya evaṁ kṛṣṇavijayaṁ śaṁkareṇa ca saṁyug: ya evaṁ kṛṣṇa-vijayaṁ śaṁkareṇa ca saṁyugam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1063_battle_banasura_lo.saṁsmaret prātarutthāya na tasya syāt pa: saṁsmaret prātar-utthāya na tasya syāt parājayaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1063_battle_banasura_lo.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe 'niruddhānayanaṁ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 63||

vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.tāṁ nīyamānāṁ tatsvāmī dṛṣṭvovāca mameti: tāṁ nīyamānāṁ tat-svāmī dṛṣṭvovāca mameti tam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.pūrvaṁ tvamaśubhaṁ bhuṁkṣe utāho nṛpate: pūrvaṁ tvam-aśubhaṁ bhuṁkṣe utāho nṛpate śubham|
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.sa tvaṁ kathaṁ mama vibho'kṣipathaḥ parā: sa tvaṁ kathaṁ mama vibho'kṣi-pathaḥ parātmā
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.anujānīhi māṁ kṛṣṇa yāntaṁ devagatiṁ pra: anujānīhi māṁ kṛṣṇa yāntaṁ deva-gatiṁ prabho|
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.ityuktvā taṁ parikramya pādau spṛṣṭvā sv: ity-uktvā taṁ parikramya pādau spṛṣṭvā sva-maulinā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.brahmasvaṁ hi viṣaṁ proktaṁ nāsya prativ: brahma-svaṁ hi viṣaṁ proktaṁ nāsya pratividhirbhuvi||
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.svadattāṁ paradattāṁ vā brahmavṛttiṁ har: svadattāṁ para-dattāṁ vā brahma-vṛttiṁ harec-ca yaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.na me brahmadhanaṁ bhūyād yad gṛddhvālpā: na me brahma-dhanaṁ bhūyād yad gṛddhvālpāyuṣo narāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.tathā namata yūyaṁ ca yo'nyathā me sa da: tathā namata yūyaṁ ca yo'nyathā me sa daṇḍa-bhāk||
vishnu/bhagavata/1064_story_king_nrga.tx.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe nṛgopākhyānaṁ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 64||

vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.ciraṁ naḥ pāhi dāśārha sānujo jagadīśvar: ciraṁ naḥ pāhi dāśārha sānujo jagad-īśvaraḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.kaccit smaratha no rāma yūyaṁ dārasutānv: kaccit smaratha no rāma yūyaṁ dāra-sutānvitāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.diṣṭyā kaṁso hataḥ pāpo diṣṭyā muktāḥ su: diṣṭyā kaṁso hataḥ pāpo diṣṭyā muktāḥ suhṛj-janāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.mātaraṁ pitaraṁ bhrātṝn patīn putrān sva: mātaraṁ pitaraṁ bhrātṝn patīn putrān svasṝr-api|
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.yadarthe jahima dāśārha dustyajān svajan: yad-arthe jahima dāśārha dustyajān svajanān prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.tā naḥ sadyaḥ parityajya gataḥ saṁchinna: tā naḥ sadyaḥ parityajya gataḥ saṁchinna-sauhṛdaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.kathaṁ nu tādṛśaṁ strībhirna śraddhīyeta: kathaṁ nu tādṛśaṁ strībhir-na śraddhīyeta bhāṣitam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.yātyasmābhirvinā kālo yadi tasya tathaiv: yāty-asmābhir-vinā kālo yadi tasya tathaiva naḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.dvau māsau tatra cāvātsīnmadhuṁ mādhavam: dvau māsau tatra cāvātsīn-madhuṁ mādhavam-eva ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.rāma rāma mahābāho na jāne tava vikramam: rāma rāma mahā-bāho na jāne tava vikramam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1065_sri_balarama_goes_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe baladeva-vijaye yamunākarṣaṇaṁ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 65||

vishnu/bhagavata/1066_deliverance_paundr.yathā naṭaṁ raṁgagataṁ vijahāsa bhṛśaṁ h: yathā naṭaṁ raṁga-gataṁ vijahāsa bhṛśaṁ hariḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1066_deliverance_paundr.athāha pauṇḍrakaṁ śaurirbho bhoḥ pauṇḍra: athāha pauṇḍrakaṁ śaurir-bho bhoḥ pauṇḍraka yad bhavān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1066_deliverance_paundr.kimidaṁ kasya vā vaktramiti saṁśiśyire j: kim-idaṁ kasya vā vaktram-iti saṁśiśyire janāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1066_deliverance_paundr.paurāśca hā hatā rājan nātha nātheti prā: paurāś-ca hā hatā rājan nātha nātheti prārudan||
vishnu/bhagavata/1066_deliverance_paundr.vilokya tatrasuḥ sarve vanadāhe mṛgā yat: vilokya tatrasuḥ sarve vana-dāhe mṛgā yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1066_deliverance_paundr.śrutvā tajjanavaiklavyaṁ dṛṣṭvā svānāṁ c: śrutvā taj-jana-vaiklavyaṁ dṛṣṭvā svānāṁ ca sādhvasam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1066_deliverance_paundr.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe pauṇḍrakādi-vadho nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 66||

vishnu/bhagavata/1067_deliverance_dvivid.taṁ tu saṁkarṣaṇo mūrdhni patantamacalo: taṁ tu saṁkarṣaṇo mūrdhni patantam-acalo yathā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1067_deliverance_dvivid.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe dvivida-vadho nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 67||

vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.bhagnadarpāḥ śamaṁ yānti prāṇā iva susaṁ: bhagna-darpāḥ śamaṁ yānti prāṇā iva susaṁyatāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.taṁ te jighṛkṣavaḥ kruddhāstiṣṭha tiṣṭhe: taṁ te jighṛkṣavaḥ kruddhās-tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti bhāṣiṇaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.taṁ tu te virathaṁ cakruścatvāraścaturo: taṁ tu te virathaṁ cakruś-catvāraś-caturo hayān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.kumāraṁ svasya kanyāṁ ca svapuraṁ jayino: kumāraṁ svasya kanyāṁ ca sva-puraṁ jayino'viśan||
vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.sāntvayitvā tu tān rāmaḥ sannaddhān vṛṣṇ: sāntvayitvā tu tān rāmaḥ sannaddhān vṛṣṇi-puṁgavān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.taṁ saṁgamya yathānyāyaṁ gāmarghyaṁ ca n: taṁ saṁgamya yathānyāyaṁ gām-arghyaṁ ca nyavedayan|
vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.teṣāṁ ye tatprabhāvajñāḥ praṇemuḥ śirasā: teṣāṁ ye tat-prabhāva-jñāḥ praṇemuḥ śirasā balam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.adyāpi ca puraṁ hyetat sūcayad rāmavikra: adyāpi ca puraṁ hyetat sūcayad rāma-vikramam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1068_balarama_anger_kau.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe hāstinapura-karṣaṇa-rūpa-saṁkarṣaṇa-vijayo nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 68||

vishnu/bhagavata/1069_divine_sage_narada.hareḥ svakauśalaṁ yatra tvaṣṭrā kārtsnye: hareḥ sva-kauśalaṁ yatra tvaṣṭrā kārtsnyena darśitam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1069_divine_sage_narada.sa tu vismita utthāya tūṣṇīmanyadagād gṛ: sa tu vismita utthāya tūṣṇīm-anyad-agād gṛham||
vishnu/bhagavata/1069_divine_sage_narada.ghnantaṁ tataḥ paśūn medhyān parītaṁ yad: ghnantaṁ tataḥ paśūn medhyān parītaṁ yadu-puṁgavaiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1069_divine_sage_narada.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe kṛṣṇa-gārhasthya-darśanaṁ nāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 69||

vishnu/bhagavata/1070_daily_routine_lord.ye ca digvijaye tasya sannatiṁ na yayurn: ye ca dig-vijaye tasya sannatiṁ na yayur-nṛpāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1070_daily_routine_lord.vayaṁ tvāṁ śaraṇaṁ yāmo bhavabhītāḥ pṛth: vayaṁ tvāṁ śaraṇaṁ yāmo bhava-bhītāḥ pṛthag-dhiyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1070_daily_routine_lord.kiṁ vā janaḥ svakṛtamṛcchati tanna vidma: kiṁ vā janaḥ sva-kṛtam-ṛcchati tanna vidmaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1070_daily_routine_lord.prapannāḥ pādamūlaṁ te dīnānāṁ śaṁ vidhī: prapannāḥ pāda-mūlaṁ te dīnānāṁ śaṁ vidhīyatām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1070_daily_routine_lord.tasmin deva kratuvare bhavantaṁ vai surā: tasmin deva kratu-vare bhavantaṁ vai surādayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1070_daily_routine_lord.tvaṁ hi naḥ paramaṁ cakṣuḥ suhṛnmantrārt: tvaṁ hi naḥ paramaṁ cakṣuḥ suhṛn-mantrārtha-tattvavit|
vishnu/bhagavata/1070_daily_routine_lord.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe bhagavad-yāna-vicāre saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 70||

vishnu/bhagavata/1071_lord_sri_krsna_goe.yaśaśca tava govinda rājño baddhān vimuñ: yaśaś-ca tava govinda rājño baddhān vimuñcataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1071_lord_sri_krsna_goe.sa vai durviṣaho rājā nāgāyutasamo bale|: sa vai durviṣaho rājā nāgāyuta-samo bale|
vishnu/bhagavata/1071_lord_sri_krsna_goe.dvairathe sa tu jetavyo mā śatākṣauhiṇīy: dvairathe sa tu jetavyo mā śatākṣauhiṇī-yutaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1071_lord_sri_krsna_goe.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe kṛṣṇasyendraprastha-gamanaṁ nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 71||

vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.ye tvāṁ bhajanti na bhajantyuta vobhayeṣ: ye tvāṁ bhajanti na bhajanty-uta vobhayeṣāṁ
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.na kaścinmatparaṁ loke tejasā yaśasā śri: na kaścin-matparaṁ loke tejasā yaśasā śriyā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.te vijitya nṛpān vīrā ājahrurdigbhya oja: te vijitya nṛpān vīrā ājahrur-digbhya ojasā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.kiṁ na deyaṁ vadānyānāṁ kaḥ paraḥ samada: kiṁ na deyaṁ vadānyānāṁ kaḥ paraḥ sama-darśinām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.vyādhaḥ kapoto bahavo hyadhruveṇa dhruva: vyādhaḥ kapoto bahavo hy-adhruveṇa dhruvaṁ gatāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.he viprā vriyatāṁ kāmo dadāmyātmaśiro'pi: he viprā vriyatāṁ kāmo dadāmy-ātma-śiro'pi vaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.anayormātuleyaṁ māṁ kṛṣṇaṁ jānīhi te rip: anayor-mātuleyaṁ māṁ kṛṣṇaṁ jānīhi te ripum||
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.na tvayā bhīruṇā yotsye yudhi viklavacet: na tvayā bhīruṇā yotsye yudhi viklava-cetasā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.mathurāṁ svapurīṁ tyaktvā samudraṁ śaraṇ: mathurāṁ sva-purīṁ tyaktvā samudraṁ śaraṇaṁ gataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.arjuno na bhaved yoddhā bhīmastulyabalo: arjuno na bhaved yoddhā bhīmas-tulya-balo mama||
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.tad vijñāya mahāsattvo bhīmaḥ praharatāṁ: tad vijñāya mahā-sattvo bhīmaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.ekaṁ pādaṁ padā''kramya dorbhyāmanyaṁ pr: ekaṁ pādaṁ padā''kramya dorbhyām-anyaṁ pragṛhya saḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1072_pandavas_prepare_r.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe jarāsandha-vadho-nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 72||

vishnu/bhagavata/1073_farewell_kings_fre.ayute dve śatānyaṣṭau līlayā yudhi nirji: ayute dve śatāny-aṣṭau līlayā yudhi nirjitāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1073_farewell_kings_fre.prapannān pāhi naḥ kṛṣṇa nirviṇṇān ghora: prapannān pāhi naḥ kṛṣṇa nirviṇṇān ghora-saṁsṛteḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1073_farewell_kings_fre.prāptaṁ prāptaṁ ca sevanto maccittā vica: prāptaṁ prāptaṁ ca sevanto mac-cittā vicariṣyatha||
vishnu/bhagavata/1073_farewell_kings_fre.mayyāveśya manaḥ samyaṅ māmante brahma y: mayy-āveśya manaḥ samyaṅ mām-ante brahma yāsyatha||
vishnu/bhagavata/1073_farewell_kings_fre.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe kṛṣṇādy-āgamane trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 73||

vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.karmabhirvardhate tejo hrasate ca yathā: karmabhir-vardhate tejo hrasate ca yathā raveḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.na vai te'jita bhaktānāṁ mamāhamiti mādh: na vai te'jita bhaktānāṁ mamāham-iti mādhava|
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.tvaṁ taveti ca nānādhīḥ paśūnāmiva vaikṛ: tvaṁ taveti ca nānā-dhīḥ paśūnām-iva vaikṛtā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.ityuktvā yajñiye kāle vavre yuktān sa ṛt: ity-uktvā yajñiye kāle vavre yuktān sa ṛtvijaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.rājasūyaṁ samīyuḥ sma rājñaḥ pāṇḍusutasy: rājasūyaṁ samīyuḥ sma rājñaḥ pāṇḍu-sutasya vai||
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.arhati hyacyutaḥ śraiṣṭhyaṁ bhagavān sāt: arhati hy-acyutaḥ śraiṣṭhyaṁ bhagavān sātvatāṁ patiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.tacchrutvā tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve sādhu sādhviti: tacchrutvā tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve sādhu sādhv-iti sattamāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.yūyaṁ pātravidāṁ śreṣṭhā mā mandhvaṁ bāl: yūyaṁ pātra-vidāṁ śreṣṭhā mā mandhvaṁ bāla-bhāṣitam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.novāca kiṁcid bhagavān yathā siṁhaḥ śivā: novāca kiṁcid bhagavān yathā siṁhaḥ śivā-rutam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.tato nāpaiti yaḥ so'pi yātyadhaḥ sukṛtāc: tato nāpaiti yaḥ so'pi yāty-adhaḥ sukṛtāc-cyutaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.tāvadutthāya bhagavān svān nivārya svaya: tāvad-utthāya bhagavān svān nivārya svayaṁ ruṣā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.kṛṣṇaṁ kratuṁ ca śaṁsantaḥ svadhāmāni ya: kṛṣṇaṁ kratuṁ ca śaṁsantaḥ svadhāmāni yayur-mudā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.yo na sehe śriyaṁ sphītāṁ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍusu: yo na sehe śriyaṁ sphītāṁ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍu-sutasya tām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.ya idaṁ kīrtayed viṣṇoḥ karma caidyavadh: ya idaṁ kīrtayed viṣṇoḥ karma caidya-vadhādikam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1074_first_worship_offe.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe śiśupāla-vadho nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 74||

vishnu/bhagavata/1075_completion_rajasuy.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe duryodhana-māna-bhaṁgo nāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 75||

vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.abhedyaṁ kāmagaṁ vavre sa yānaṁ vṛṣṇibhī: abhedyaṁ kāmagaṁ vavre sa yānaṁ vṛṣṇi-bhīṣaṇam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.sa labdhvā kāmagaṁ yānaṁ tamodhāma durās: sa labdhvā kāmagaṁ yānaṁ tamo-dhāma durāsadam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.yayau dvāravatīṁ śālvo vairaṁ vṛṣṇikṛtaṁ: yayau dvāravatīṁ śālvo vairaṁ vṛṣṇi-kṛtaṁ smaran||
vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.bahurūpaikarūpaṁ tad dṛśyate na ca dṛśya: bahu-rūpaika-rūpaṁ tad dṛśyate na ca dṛśyate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.kvacid bhūmau kvacid vyomni girimūrdhni: kvacid bhūmau kvacid vyomni giri-mūrdhni jale kvacit|
vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.na tatyajū raṇaṁ svaṁ svaṁ lokadvayajigī: na tatyajū raṇaṁ svaṁ svaṁ loka-dvaya-jigīṣavaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.na yadūnāṁ kule jātaḥ śrūyate raṇavicyut: na yadūnāṁ kule jātaḥ śrūyate raṇa-vicyutaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.sūtaḥ kṛcchragataṁ rakṣed rathinaṁ sārat: sūtaḥ kṛcchra-gataṁ rakṣed rathinaṁ sārathiṁ rathī||
vishnu/bhagavata/1076_battle_yadavas_sal.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe śālva-yuddhe ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 76||

vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..dvābhyāṁ dhanuśca ketuṁ ca śareṇānyena v: dvābhyāṁ dhanuś-ca ketuṁ ca śareṇānyena vai śiraḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..vīkṣya tat kadanaṁ svānāṁ nirūpya purara: vīkṣya tat kadanaṁ svānāṁ nirūpya pura-rakṣaṇam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..saubhaṁ ca śālvarājaṁ ca dārukaṁ prāha k: saubhaṁ ca śālva-rājaṁ ca dārukaṁ prāha keśavaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..rathaṁ prāpaya me sūta śālvasyāntikamāśu: rathaṁ prāpaya me sūta śālvasyāntikam-āśu vai|
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..taṁ ca ṣoḍaśabhirviddhvā bāṇaiḥ saubhaṁ: taṁ ca ṣoḍaśabhir-viddhvā bāṇaiḥ saubhaṁ ca khe bhramat|
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..śālvaḥ śaurestu doḥ savyaṁ saśārṅgaṁ śār: śālvaḥ śaures-tu doḥ savyaṁ saśārṅgaṁ śārṅga-dhanvanaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..pramattaḥ sa sabhāmadhye tvayā vyāpādita: pramattaḥ sa sabhā-madhye tvayā vyāpāditaḥ sakhā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..vṛthā tvaṁ katthase manda na paśyasyanti: vṛthā tvaṁ katthase manda na paśyasy-antike'ntakam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..pauruṣaṁ darśayanti sma śūrā na bahubhāṣ: pauruṣaṁ darśayanti sma śūrā na bahu-bhāṣiṇaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..tatāḍa jatrau saṁrabdhaḥ sa cakampe vama: tatāḍa jatrau saṁrabdhaḥ sa cakampe vamann-asṛk||
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho pitā te pitṛvatsala: kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahā-bāho pitā te pitṛ-vatsala|
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..eṣa te janitā tāto yadarthamiha jīvasi|: eṣa te janitā tāto yad-artham-iha jīvasi|
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..yat svavāco virudhyeta nūnaṁ te na smara: yat sva-vāco virudhyeta nūnaṁ te na smaranty-uta||
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..kva śokamohau sneho vā bhayaṁ vā ye'jñas: kva śoka-mohau sneho vā bhayaṁ vā ye'jña-sambhavāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1077_deliverance_salva..iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe saubha-vadho nāma sapta-saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 77||

vishnu/bhagavata/1078_deliverance_dantav.diṣṭyā diṣṭyā bhavānadya mama dṛṣṭipatha: diṣṭyā diṣṭyā bhavān-adya mama dṛṣṭi-pathaṁ gataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1078_deliverance_dantav.tvaṁ mātuleyo naḥ kṛṣṇa mitradhruṅmāṁ ji: tvaṁ mātuleyo naḥ kṛṣṇa mitra-dhruṅ-māṁ jighāṁsasi|
vishnu/bhagavata/1078_deliverance_dantav.evaṁ rūkṣaistudan vākyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṁ tottrai: evaṁ rūkṣais-tudan vākyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṁ tottrair-iva dvipam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1078_deliverance_dantav.viśālaṁ brahmatīrthaṁ ca cakraṁ prācīṁ s: viśālaṁ brahma-tīrthaṁ ca cakraṁ prācīṁ sarasvatīm||
vishnu/bhagavata/1078_deliverance_dantav.kiṁ vaḥ kāmo muniśreṣṭhā brūtāhaṁ karavā: kiṁ vaḥ kāmo muni-śreṣṭhā brūtāhaṁ karavāṇy-atha|
vishnu/bhagavata/1078_deliverance_dantav.sa dūṣayati naḥ satrametya parvaṇi parva: sa dūṣayati naḥ satram-etya parvaṇi parvaṇi||
vishnu/bhagavata/1078_deliverance_dantav.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe baladeva-caritre balvala-vadhopakramo nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 78||

vishnu/bhagavata/1079_deliverance_balval.kāmakoṣṇīṁ purīṁ kāṁcīṁ kāverīṁ ca sarid: kāmakoṣṇīṁ purīṁ kāṁcīṁ kāverīṁ ca sarid-varām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1079_deliverance_balval.yuvāṁ tulyabalau vīrau he rājan he vṛkod: yuvāṁ tulya-balau vīrau he rājan he vṛkodara|
vishnu/bhagavata/1079_deliverance_balval.na lakṣyate jayo'nyo vā viramatvaphalo r: na lakṣyate jayo'nyo vā viramatv-aphalo raṇaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1079_deliverance_balval.sāyaṁ prātaranantasya viṣṇoḥ sa dayito b: sāyaṁ prātar-anantasya viṣṇoḥ sa dayito bhavet||
vishnu/bhagavata/1079_deliverance_balval.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe baladeva- tīrthayātrānirūpaṇaṁnāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 79||

vishnu/bhagavata/1080_sri_krsna_welcomes.tasya bhāryā kucailasya kṣutkṣāmā ca tat: tasya bhāryā kucailasya kṣut-kṣāmā ca tathāvidhā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1080_sri_krsna_welcomes.sa tānādāya viprāgryaḥ prayayau dvārakāṁ: sa tān-ādāya viprāgryaḥ prayayau dvārakāṁ kila|
vishnu/bhagavata/1080_sri_krsna_welcomes.trīṇi gulmānyatīyāya tisraḥ kakṣāśca sa: trīṇi gulmāny-atīyāya tisraḥ kakṣāś-ca sa dvijaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1080_sri_krsna_welcomes.kaccid gurukule vāsaṁ brahman smarasi na: kaccid guru-kule vāsaṁ brahman smarasi nau yataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1080_sri_krsna_welcomes.sa vai satkarmaṇāṁ sākṣād dvijāteriha sa: sa vai sat-karmaṇāṁ sākṣād dvijāter-iha sambhavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1080_sri_krsna_welcomes.ye mayā guruṇā vācā tarantyaṁjo bhavārṇa: ye mayā guruṇā vācā taranty-aṁjo bhavārṇavam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1080_sri_krsna_welcomes.tuṣṭo'haṁ bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ satyāḥ santu: tuṣṭo'haṁ bho dvija-śreṣṭhāḥ satyāḥ santu manorathāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1080_sri_krsna_welcomes.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe śrīdāma-carite'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 80||

vishnu/bhagavata/1081_sudama_receives_pr.sa itthaṁ dvijamukhyena saha saṁkathayan: sa itthaṁ dvija-mukhyena saha saṁkathayan hariḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1081_sudama_receives_pr.aṇvapyupāhṛtaṁ bhaktaiḥ premṇā bhūryeva: aṇv-apy-upāhṛtaṁ bhaktaiḥ premṇā bhūry-eva me bhavet|
vishnu/bhagavata/1081_sudama_receives_pr.sa cālabdhvā dhanaṁ kṛṣṇānna tu yācitavā: sa cālabdhvā dhanaṁ kṛṣṇān-na tu yācitavān svayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1081_sudama_receives_pr.adhano'yaṁ dhanaṁ prāpya mādyannuccairna: adhano'yaṁ dhanaṁ prāpya mādyann-uccair-na māṁ smaret|
vishnu/bhagavata/1081_sudama_receives_pr.kimidaṁ kasya vā sthānaṁ kathaṁ tadidami: kim-idaṁ kasya vā sthānaṁ kathaṁ tad-idam-ity-abhūt||
vishnu/bhagavata/1081_sudama_receives_pr.dāsīnāṁ niṣkakaṇṭhīnāṁ madhye bhāntīṁ sa: dāsīnāṁ niṣka-kaṇṭhīnāṁ madhye bhāntīṁ sa vismitaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1081_sudama_receives_pr.prītaḥ svayaṁ tayā yuktaḥ praviṣṭo nijam: prītaḥ svayaṁ tayā yuktaḥ praviṣṭo nija-mandiram|
vishnu/bhagavata/1081_sudama_receives_pr.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe pṛthukopākhyānaṁ nāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 81||

vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.taṁ jñātvā manujā rājan purastādeva sarv: taṁ jñātvā manujā rājan purastād-eva sarvataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.niḥkṣatriyāṁ mahīṁ kurvan rāmaḥ śastrabh: niḥkṣatriyāṁ mahīṁ kurvan rāmaḥ śastra-bhṛtāṁ varaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.daduḥ svannaṁ dvijāgryebhyaḥ kṛṣṇe no bh: daduḥ svannaṁ dvijāgryebhyaḥ kṛṣṇe no bhaktir-astv-iti|
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.svāgataṁ kuśalaṁ pṛṣṭvā cakruḥ kṛṣṇakath: svāgataṁ kuśalaṁ pṛṣṭvā cakruḥ kṛṣṇa-kathā mithaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.yad vā āpatsu madvārtāṁ nānusmaratha sat: yad vā āpatsu mad-vārtāṁ nānusmaratha sattamāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.kaṁsapratāpitāḥ sarve vayaṁ yātā diśaṁ d: kaṁsa-pratāpitāḥ sarve vayaṁ yātā diśaṁ diśam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.smaran kaṁsakṛtān kleśān putranyāsaṁ ca: smaran kaṁsa-kṛtān kleśān putra-nyāsaṁ ca gokule||
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.yaśodā ca mahābhāgā sutau vijahatuḥ śuca: yaśodā ca mahā-bhāgā sutau vijahatuḥ śucaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.vāyuryathā ghanānīkaṁ tṛṇaṁ tūlaṁ rajāṁs: vāyur-yathā ghanānīkaṁ tṛṇaṁ tūlaṁ rajāṁsi ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1082_gopas_gopis_meet_l.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe vṛṣṇi-gopa-saṁgamo nāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 82||

vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.he vaidarbhyacyuto bhadre he jāmbavati k: he vaidarbhy-acyuto bhadre he jāmbavati kausale|
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.he kṛṣṇapatnya etanno brūta vo bhagavān: he kṛṣṇa-patnya etanno brūta vo bhagavān svayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.pathi nirjitya rājanyān ninye taddāsyama: pathi nirjitya rājanyān ninye tad-dāsyam-astu me||
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.jñātvā mama mataṁ sādhvi pitā duhitṛvats: jñātvā mama mataṁ sādhvi pitā duhitṛ-vatsalaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.ayaṁ tu bahirācchanno dṛśyate sa jale pa: ayaṁ tu bahir-ācchanno dṛśyate sa jale param||
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.ādaduḥ saśaraṁ cāpaṁ veddhuṁ parṣadi mad: ādaduḥ saśaraṁ cāpaṁ veddhuṁ parṣadi mad-dhiyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.matsyābhāsaṁ jale vīkṣya jñātvā ca tadav: matsyābhāsaṁ jale vīkṣya jñātvā ca tad-avasthitim|
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.tasmin sandhāya viśikhaṁ matsyaṁ vīkṣya: tasmin sandhāya viśikhaṁ matsyaṁ vīkṣya sakṛj-jale|
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.na vayaṁ sādhvi sāmrājyaṁ svārājyaṁ bhau: na vayaṁ sādhvi sāmrājyaṁ svārājyaṁ bhaujyam-apy-uta|
vishnu/bhagavata/1083_draupadi_speaks_ch.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 83||

vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.aho vayaṁ janmabhṛto labdhaṁ kārtsnyena: aho vayaṁ janma-bhṛto labdhaṁ kārtsnyena tat-phalam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilām: na hy-ammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.yatropalabdhaṁ sad vyaktamavyaktaṁ ca ta: yatropalabdhaṁ sad vyaktam-avyaktaṁ ca tataḥ param||
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.tvayā saṁgamya sadgatyā yadantaḥ śreyasā: tvayā saṁgamya sad-gatyā yad-antaḥ śreyasāṁ paraḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.na yaṁ vidantyamī bhūpā ekārāmāśca vṛṣṇa: na yaṁ vidanty-amī bhūpā ekārāmāś-ca vṛṣṇayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.tvaṁ tvadya mukto dvābhyāṁ vai ṛṣipitror: tvaṁ tvadya mukto dvābhyāṁ vai ṛṣi-pitror-mahāmate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.jagatāmīśvaraṁ prārcaḥ sa yad vāṁ putrat: jagatām-īśvaraṁ prārcaḥ sa yad vāṁ putratāṁ gataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.ta enamṛṣayo rājan vṛtā dharmeṇa dhārmik: ta enam-ṛṣayo rājan vṛtā dharmeṇa dhārmikam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.adhunā śrīmadāndhākṣā na paśyāmaḥ puraḥ: adhunā śrī-madāndhākṣā na paśyāmaḥ puraḥ sataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.svajanānuta bandhūn vā na paśyati yayānd: svajanān-uta bandhūn vā na paśyati yayāndha-dṛk||
vishnu/bhagavata/1084_sacrificial_festiv.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe tīrtha-yātrānuvarṇanaṁ nāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 84||

vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.jāne vāmasya yat sākṣāt pradhānapuruṣau: jāne vāmasya yat sākṣāt pradhāna-puruṣau parau||
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.prāṇādīnāṁ viśvasṛjāṁ śaktayo yāḥ parasy: prāṇādīnāṁ viśva-sṛjāṁ śaktayo yāḥ parasya tāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.tarpaṇaṁ prāṇanamapāṁ deva tvaṁ tāśca ta: tarpaṇaṁ prāṇanam-apāṁ deva tvaṁ tāśca tad-rasaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.diśāṁ tvamavakāśo'si diśaḥ khaṁ sphoṭa ā: diśāṁ tvam-avakāśo'si diśaḥ khaṁ sphoṭa āśrayaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.yuvāṁ na naḥ sutau sākṣāt pradhānapuruṣe: yuvāṁ na naḥ sutau sākṣāt pradhāna-puruṣeśvarau|
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.bhavanti kila viśvātmaṁstaṁ tvādyāhaṁ ga: bhavanti kila viśvātmaṁs-taṁ tvādyāhaṁ gatiṁ gatā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.evaṁ saṁcoditau mātrā rāmaḥ kṛṣṇaśca bhā: evaṁ saṁcoditau mātrā rāmaḥ kṛṣṇaś-ca bhārata|
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.nityaṁ nibaddhavairāste vayaṁ cānye ca t: nityaṁ nibaddha-vairās-te vayaṁ cānye ca tādṛśāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.na vidantyapi yogeśā yogamāyāṁ kuto vaya: na vidanty-api yogeśā yogamāyāṁ kuto vayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1085_lord_teaches_vasud.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe mṛtāgrajānayanaṁ nāma pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 85||

vishnu/bhagavata/1086_carrying_away_subh.tatra tatra tamāyāntaṁ paurā jānapadā nṛ: tatra tatra tam-āyāntaṁ paurā jānapadā nṛpa|
vishnu/bhagavata/1086_carrying_away_subh.bhavān hi sarvabhūtānāmātmā sākṣī svadṛg: bhavān hi sarva-bhūtānām-ātmā sākṣī svadṛg vibho|
vishnu/bhagavata/1086_carrying_away_subh.nādya no darśanaṁ prāptaḥ paraṁ paramapū: nādya no darśanaṁ prāptaḥ paraṁ parama-pūruṣaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1086_carrying_away_subh.sa tvaṁ śādhi svabhṛtyān naḥ kiṁ deva ka: sa tvaṁ śādhi sva-bhṛtyān naḥ kiṁ deva karavāmahe|
vishnu/bhagavata/1086_carrying_away_subh.tapasā vidyayā tuṣṭyā kimu matkalayā yut: tapasā vidyayā tuṣṭyā kimu mat-kalayā yutaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1086_carrying_away_subh.carācaramidaṁ viśvaṁ bhāvā ye cāsya heta: carācaram-idaṁ viśvaṁ bhāvā ye cāsya hetavaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1086_carrying_away_subh.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe śrutadevānugraho nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 86||

vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.kathaṁ caranti śrutayaḥ sākṣāt sadasataḥ: kathaṁ caranti śrutayaḥ sākṣāt sad-asataḥ pare||
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.yo vai bhāratavarṣe'smin kṣemāya svastay: yo vai bhārata-varṣe'smin kṣemāya svastaye nṛṇām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.tata udagādananta tava dhāma śiraḥ param: tata udagād-ananta tava dhāma śiraḥ paramaṁ
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.punariha yat sametya na patanti kṛtāntam: punar-iha yat sametya na patanti kṛtānta-mukhe||
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.tarhi na sanna cāsadubhayaṁ na ca kālaja: tarhi na sanna cāsad-ubhayaṁ na ca kāla-javaḥ
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.kimapi na tatra śāstramavakṛṣya śayīta y: kimapi na tatra śāstram-avakṛṣya śayīta yadā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.janimasataḥ sato mṛtimutātmani ye ca bhi: janim-asataḥ sato mṛtim-utātmani ye ca bhidāṁ
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.tvayi na tataḥ paratra sa bhavedavabodha: tvayi na tataḥ paratra sa bhaved-avabodha-rase||
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.na hi vikṛtiṁ tyajanti kanakasya tadātma: na hi vikṛtiṁ tyajanti kanakasya tad-ātmatayā
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.stvayi kṛtasauhṛdāḥ khalu punanti na ye: stvayi kṛta-sauhṛdāḥ khalu punanti na ye vimukhāḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.na hi paramasya kaścidaparo na paraśca b: na hi paramasya kaścid-aparo na paraś-ca bhaved
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.ajani ca yanmayaṁ tadavimucya niyantṛ bh: ajani ca yan-mayaṁ tad-avimucya niyantṛ bhavet
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.tvayi ta ime tato vividhanāmaguṇaiḥ para: tvayi ta ime tato vividha-nāma-guṇaiḥ parame
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.stvayi sati kiṁ nṛṇāṁ śrayata ātmani sar: stvayi sati kiṁ nṛṇāṁ śrayata ātmani sarva-rase|
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.na yadidamagra āsa na bhaviṣyadato nidha: na yad-idam-agra āsa na bhaviṣyad-ato nidhanā-
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.yadi na samuddharanti yatayo hṛdi kāmaja: yadi na samuddharanti yatayo hṛdi kāma-jaṭā
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.dhārayaṁścara gāṁ kāmaṁ kāmānāṁ bharjana: dhārayaṁś-cara gāṁ kāmaṁ kāmānāṁ bharjanaṁ nṛṇām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.ityetad varṇitaṁ rājan yannaḥ praśnaḥ kṛ: ity-etad varṇitaṁ rājan yannaḥ praśnaḥ kṛtas-tvayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1087_hymn_vedas_vedastu.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe nārada-nārāyaṇa-saṁvāde veda-stutir-nāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 87||

vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.prāyaste dhanino bhojā na tu lakṣmyāḥ pa: prāyas-te dhanino bhojā na tu lakṣmyāḥ patiṁ harim||
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.etad veditumicchāmaḥ sandeho'tra mahān h: etad veditum-icchāmaḥ sandeho'tra mahān hi naḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.harirhi nirguṇaḥ sākṣāt puruṣaḥ prakṛteḥ: harir-hi nirguṇaḥ sākṣāt puruṣaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.sa sarvadṛgupadraṣṭā taṁ bhajan nirguṇo: sa sarva-dṛg-upadraṣṭā taṁ bhajan nirguṇo bhavet||
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.sa āha bhagavāṁstasmai prītaḥ śuśrūṣave: sa āha bhagavāṁs-tasmai prītaḥ śuśrūṣave prabhuḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.devaṁ sa vavre pāpīyān varaṁ bhūtabhayāv: devaṁ sa vavre pāpīyān varaṁ bhūta-bhayāvaham|
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.yasya yasya karaṁ śīrṣṇi dhāsye sa mriya: yasya yasya karaṁ śīrṣṇi dhāsye sa mriyatām-iti||
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.śākuneya bhavān vyaktaṁ śrāntaḥ kiṁ dūra: śākuneya bhavān vyaktaṁ śrāntaḥ kiṁ dūram-āgataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.evaṁ cettarhi tadvākyaṁ na vayaṁ śraddad: evaṁ cet-tarhi tad-vākyaṁ na vayaṁ śraddadhīmahi|
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.tadainaṁ jahyasadvācaṁ na yad vaktānṛtaṁ: tadainaṁ jahy-asad-vācaṁ na yad vaktānṛtaṁ punaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.hataḥ ko nu mahatsvīśa janturvai kṛtakil: hataḥ ko nu mahatsv-īśa jantur-vai kṛta-kilbiṣaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.kṣemī syāt kimu viśveśe kṛtāgasko jagadg: kṣemī syāt kimu viśveśe kṛtāgasko jagad-gurau||
vishnu/bhagavata/1088_lord_siva_saved_da.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe rudra-mokṣaṇaṁ nāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 88||

vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.tasya jijñāsayā te vai bhṛguṁ brahmasuta: tasya jijñāsayā te vai bhṛguṁ brahma-sutaṁ nṛpa|
vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.na tasmai prahvaṇaṁ stotraṁ cakre sattva: na tasmai prahvaṇaṁ stotraṁ cakre sattva-parīkṣayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.tataḥ kailāsamagamat sa taṁ devo maheśva: tataḥ kailāsam-agamat sa taṁ devo maheśvaraḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.visṛjya sa nṛpadvāri tāṁ gāthāṁ samagāya: visṛjya sa nṛpa-dvāri tāṁ gāthāṁ samagāyata||
vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.ahaṁ prajā vāṁ bhagavan rakṣiṣye dīnayor: ahaṁ prajā vāṁ bhagavan rakṣiṣye dīnayor-iha|
vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.tat kathaṁ nu bhavān karma duṣkaraṁ jaga: tat kathaṁ nu bhavān karma duṣkaraṁ jagad-īśvaraiḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.tataḥ kumāraḥ saṁjāto viprapatnyā rudan: tataḥ kumāraḥ saṁjāto vipra-patnyā rudan muhuḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.mauḍhyaṁ paśyata me yo'haṁ śraddadhe klī: mauḍhyaṁ paśyata me yo'haṁ śraddadhe klība-katthanam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1089_bhrgu_tests_three_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśamaskandheuttarārdhe dvija-kumārānayanaṁ nāma ekona-navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 89||

vishnu/bhagavata/1090_lilas_lord_sri_krs.sukhaṁ svapuryāṁ nivasan dvārakāyāṁ śriy: sukhaṁ sva-puryāṁ nivasan dvārakāyāṁ śriyaḥ patiḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1090_lilas_lord_sri_krs.tannigrahāya hariṇā proktā devā yadoḥ ku: tan-nigrahāya hariṇā proktā devā yadoḥ kule|
vishnu/bhagavata/1090_lilas_lord_sri_krs.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ daśama-skandhe uttarārdhe śrī-kṛṣṇa-caritānuvarṇanaṁ nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 90||

vishnu/bhagavata/1101_sages_curse_yadu_c.ācchidya kīrtiṁ suślokāṁ vitatya hyaṁjas: ācchidya kīrtiṁ suślokāṁ vitatya hy-aṁjasā nu kau|

vishnu/bhagavata/1101_sages_curse_yadu_c.kiṁ kṛtaṁ mandabhāgyairnaḥ kiṁ vadiṣyant: kiṁ kṛtaṁ manda-bhāgyair-naḥ kiṁ vadiṣyanti no janāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1101_sages_curse_yadu_c.śrutvāmoghaṁ vipraśāpaṁ dṛṣṭvā ca musala: śrutvāmoghaṁ vipra-śāpaṁ dṛṣṭvā ca musalaṁ nṛpa|

vishnu/bhagavata/1102_sage_narada_comes_.bhūtānāṁ devacaritaṁ duḥkhāya ca sukhāya: bhūtānāṁ deva-caritaṁ duḥkhāya ca sukhāya ca|

vishnu/bhagavata/1102_sage_narada_comes_.mucyema hyaṁjasaivāddhā tathā naḥ śādhi: mucyema hy-aṁjasaivāddhā tathā naḥ śādhi suvrata||
vishnu/bhagavata/1102_sage_narada_comes_.sadyaḥ punāti saddharmo deva viśvadruho': sadyaḥ punāti sad-dharmo deva viśva-druho'pi hi||

vishnu/bhagavata/1102_sage_narada_comes_.dhāvan nimīlya vā netre na skhalenna pat: dhāvan nimīlya vā netre na skhalen-na pated-iha||

vishnu/bhagavata/1102_sage_narada_comes_.gṛhītvāpīndriyairarthān yo na dveṣṭi na: gṛhītvāpīndriyair-arthān yo na dveṣṭi na hṛṣyati|
vishnu/bhagavata/1102_sage_narada_comes_.sajjate'sminnahaṁbhāvo dehe vai sa hareḥ: sajjate'sminn-ahaṁbhāvo dehe vai sa hareḥ priyaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1102_sage_narada_comes_.na yasya svaḥ para iti vitteṣvātmani vā: na yasya svaḥ para iti vitteṣv-ātmani vā bhidā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1102_sage_narada_comes_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-ekādaśa-skandhe dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/1103_maya_means_crossin.sāṁvartako meghagaṇo varṣati sma śataṁ s: sāṁvartako megha-gaṇo varṣati sma śataṁ samāḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1103_maya_means_crossin.karmayogaṁ vadata naḥ puruṣo yena saṁskṛ: karma-yogaṁ vadata naḥ puruṣo yena saṁskṛtaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1103_maya_means_crossin.sāṁgopāṁgāṁ sapārṣadāṁ tāṁ tāṁ mūrtiṁ sv: sāṁgopāṁgāṁ sapārṣadāṁ tāṁ tāṁ mūrtiṁ sva-mantrataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1103_maya_means_crossin.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-ekādaśa-skandhe tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/1104_avataras_lord.txt.cakre karoti kartā vā haristāni bruvantu: cakre karoti kartā vā haris-tāni bruvantu naḥ||

vishnu/bhagavata/1105_fate_those_without.vipro rājanyavaiśyau ca hareḥ prāptāḥ pa: vipro rājanya-vaiśyau ca hareḥ prāptāḥ padāntikam|

vishnu/bhagavata/1105_fate_those_without.ātmā vāṁ pāvitaḥ kṛṣṇe putrasnehaṁ praku: ātmā vāṁ pāvitaḥ kṛṣṇe putra-snehaṁ prakurvatoḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1105_fate_those_without.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-ekādaśa-skandhe pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||

vishnu/bhagavata/1106_gods_pray_lord_ret.dharmaśca sthāpitaḥ satsu satyasandheṣu: dharmaś-ca sthāpitaḥ satsu satya-sandheṣu vai tvayā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1106_gods_pray_lord_ret.vayaṁ ca tasminnāplutya tarpayitvā pitṝn: vayaṁ ca tasminn-āplutya tarpayitvā pitṝn surān|
vishnu/bhagavata/1106_gods_pray_lord_ret.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-ekādaśa-skandhe ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6||

vishnu/bhagavata/1107_story_avadhuta_eig.kaviṁ nirīkṣya taruṇaṁ yaduḥ papraccha d: kaviṁ nirīkṣya taruṇaṁ yaduḥ papraccha dharma-vit||

vishnu/bhagavata/1107_story_avadhuta_eig.kvacicchannaḥ kvacit spaṣṭa upāsyaḥ śrey: kvacic-channaḥ kvacit spaṣṭa upāsyaḥ śreya icchatām|

vishnu/bhagavata/1107_story_avadhuta_eig.kurvan vindeta santāpaṁ kapota iva dīnad: kurvan vindeta santāpaṁ kapota iva dīna-dhīḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1107_story_avadhuta_eig.aṇḍāni suṣuve nīḍe svapatyuḥ sannidhau s: aṇḍāni suṣuve nīḍe sva-patyuḥ sannidhau satī||
vishnu/bhagavata/1107_story_avadhuta_eig.śūnye gṛhe māṁ santyajya putraiḥ svaryāt: śūnye gṛhe māṁ santyajya putraiḥ svar-yāti sādhubhiḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1107_story_avadhuta_eig.so'haṁ śūnye gṛhe dīno mṛtadāro mṛtapraj: so'haṁ śūnye gṛhe dīno mṛta-dāro mṛta-prajaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1107_story_avadhuta_eig.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-ekādaśa-skandhe saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/1129_bhagavata_dharmas_.kiṁ vā bhavenna tava pādarajojuṣāṁ naḥ||: kiṁ vā bhaven-na tava pāda-rajo-juṣāṁ naḥ||

vishnu/bhagavata/1129_bhagavata_dharmas_.ayaṁ hi sarvakalpānāṁ sadhrīcīno mato ma: ayaṁ hi sarva-kalpānāṁ sadhrīcīno mato mama|

vishnu/bhagavata/1130_destruction_yadu_c.pratyākraṣṭuṁ nayanamabalā yatra lagnaṁ: pratyākraṣṭuṁ nayanam-abalā yatra lagnaṁ na śekuḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1130_destruction_yadu_c.caturbhujaṁ taṁ puruṣaṁ dṛṣṭvā sa kṛtaki: catur-bhujaṁ taṁ puruṣaṁ dṛṣṭvā sa kṛta-kilbiṣaḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1130_destruction_yadu_c.yāhi tvaṁ madanujñātaḥ svargaṁ sukṛtināṁ: yāhi tvaṁ mad-anujñātaḥ svargaṁ sukṛtināṁ padam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1130_destruction_yadu_c.iti bruvati sūte vai ratho garuḍalāñchan: iti bruvati sūte vai ratho garuḍa-lāñchanaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1130_destruction_yadu_c.dvārakāyāṁ ca na stheyaṁ bhavadbhiśca sv: dvārakāyāṁ ca na stheyaṁ bhavadbhiś-ca svabandhubhiḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1131_lord_returns_own_a.vismitāstāṁ praśaṁsantaḥ svaṁ svaṁ lokaṁ: vismitās-tāṁ praśaṁsantaḥ svaṁ svaṁ lokaṁ yayus-tadā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1131_lord_returns_own_a.ya etāṁ prātarutthāya kṛṣṇasya padavīṁ p: ya etāṁ prātar-utthāya kṛṣṇasya padavīṁ parām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1131_lord_returns_own_a.tvāṁ tu vaṁśadharaṁ kṛtvā jagmuḥ sarve m: tvāṁ tu vaṁśa-dharaṁ kṛtvā jagmuḥ sarve mahā-patham||
vishnu/bhagavata/1131_lord_returns_own_a.ya etad devadevasya viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi janma: ya etad deva-devasya viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi janma ca|
vishnu/bhagavata/1131_lord_returns_own_a.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyām-ekādaśa-skandhe eka-triṁśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 31||

vishnu/bhagavata/1201_royal_dynasties_ka.pradyotasaṁjñaṁ rājānaṁ kartā yat pālaka: pradyota-saṁjñaṁ rājānaṁ kartā yat pālakaḥ sutaḥ|

vishnu/bhagavata/1201_royal_dynasties_ka.teṣāmabhāve jagatīṁ mauryā bhokṣyanti va: teṣām-abhāve jagatīṁ mauryā bhokṣyanti vai kalau||

vishnu/bhagavata/1201_royal_dynasties_ka.bhūyo daśa guruṇḍāśca maunā ekādaśaiva t: bhūyo daśa guruṇḍāś-ca maunā ekādaśaiva tu||

vishnu/bhagavata/1201_royal_dynasties_ka.vīryavān kṣatramutsādya padmavatyāṁ sa v: vīryavān kṣatram-utsādya padmavatyāṁ sa vai puri|

vishnu/bhagavata/1202_dharma_kali_age.tx.tataścānudinaṁ dharmaḥ satyaṁ śaucaṁ kṣa: tataś-cānudinaṁ dharmaḥ satyaṁ śaucaṁ kṣamā dayā|

vishnu/bhagavata/1202_dharma_kali_age.tx.tadāviśat kalirlokaṁ pāpe yad ramate jan: tadāviśat kalir-lokaṁ pāpe yad ramate janaḥ||

vishnu/bhagavata/1202_dharma_kali_age.tx.tathā viṭśūdraviprāṇāṁ tāstā jñeyā yuge: tathā viṭ-śūdra-viprāṇāṁ tāstā jñeyā yuge yuge||
