vishnu/bhagavata/1202_dharma_kali_age.tx.bhūtadhruk tatkṛte svārthaṁ kiṁ veda nir: bhūta-dhruk tat-kṛte svārthaṁ kiṁ veda nirayo yataḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1202_dharma_kali_age.tx.matputrasya ca pautrasya matpūrvā vaṁśaj: mat-putrasya ca pautrasya mat-pūrvā vaṁśajasya vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1202_dharma_kali_age.tx.ye ye bhūpatayo rājan bhuṁjanti bhuvamoj: ye ye bhūpatayo rājan bhuṁjanti bhuvam-ojasā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1202_dharma_kali_age.tx.kālena te kṛtāḥ sarve kathāmātrāḥ kathās: kālena te kṛtāḥ sarve kathā-mātrāḥ kathāsu ca||
vishnu/bhagavata/1202_dharma_kali_age.tx.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 2||

vishnu/bhagavata/1203_kingdoms_dharma_ag.kāma eṣa narendrāṇāṁ moghaḥ syād viduṣām: kāma eṣa narendrāṇāṁ moghaḥ syād viduṣām-api|
vishnu/bhagavata/1203_kingdoms_dharma_ag.gatā yathāgataṁ yuddhe tāṁ māṁ jeṣyantya: gatā yathāgataṁ yuddhe tāṁ māṁ jeṣyanty-abuddhayaḥ||

vishnu/bhagavata/1203_kingdoms_dharma_ag.sattvaṁ rajastama iti dṛśyante puruṣe gu: sattvaṁ rajas-tama iti dṛśyante puruṣe guṇāḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1203_kingdoms_dharma_ag.tadā kṛtayugaṁ vidyājjñāne tapasi yad ru: tadā kṛta-yugaṁ vidyāj-jñāne tapasi yad ruciḥ||

vishnu/bhagavata/1203_kingdoms_dharma_ag.yathā hemni sthito vahnirdurvarṇaṁ hanti: yathā hemni sthito vahnir-durvarṇaṁ hanti dhātu-jam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1203_kingdoms_dharma_ag.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśaskandhetṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ|| 3||

vishnu/bhagavata/1204_four_kinds_pralaya.eṣa naimittikaḥ proktaḥ pralayo yatra vi: eṣa naimittikaḥ proktaḥ pralayo yatra viśva-sṛk|
vishnu/bhagavata/1204_four_kinds_pralaya.parjanyaḥ śatavarṣāṇi bhūmau rājan na va: parjanyaḥ śata-varṣāṇi bhūmau rājan na varṣati|
vishnu/bhagavata/1204_four_kinds_pralaya.sa vai viśati khaṁ rājaṁstataśca nabhaso: sa vai viśati khaṁ rājaṁs-tataś-ca nabhaso guṇam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1204_four_kinds_pralaya.dīpaścakṣuśca rūpaṁ ca jyotiṣo na pṛthag: dīpaś-cakṣuś-ca rūpaṁ ca jyotiṣo na pṛthag bhavet|
vishnu/bhagavata/1204_four_kinds_pralaya.evaṁ dhīḥ khāni mātrāśca na syuranyatamā: evaṁ dhīḥ khāni mātrāś-ca na syur-anyatamādṛtāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/1204_four_kinds_pralaya.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe caturtho'dhyāyaḥ|| 4||

vishnu/bhagavata/1205_final_teaching_sri.tvaṁ tu rājan mariṣyeti paśubuddhimimāṁ: tvaṁ tu rājan mariṣyeti paśu-buddhim-imāṁ jahi|

vishnu/bhagavata/1205_final_teaching_sri.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe brahmopadeśo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 5||

vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.hantukāmo nṛpaṁ gacchan dadarśa pathi ka: hantu-kāmo nṛpaṁ gacchan dadarśa pathi kaśyapam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.hāhākāro mahānāsīd bhuvi khe dikṣu sarva: hāhākāro mahān-āsīd bhuvi khe dikṣu sarvataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.sarpā anāgaso dagdhā janairdiṣṭaṁ hi bhu: sarpā anāgaso dagdhā janair-diṣṭaṁ hi bhujyate||

vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.na cemaṁ dehamāśritya vairaṁ kurvīta ken: na cemaṁ deham-āśritya vairaṁ kurvīta kenacit||
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.vedāśca katidhā vyastā etat saumyābhidhe: vedāś-ca katidhā vyastā etat saumyābhidhehi naḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.śṛṇoti ya imaṁ sphoṭaṁ suptaśrotre ca śū: śṛṇoti ya imaṁ sphoṭaṁ supta-śrotre ca śūnya-dṛk|
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.yena vāg vyajyate yasya vyaktirākāśa ātm: yena vāg vyajyate yasya vyaktir-ākāśa ātmanaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.bāṣkalāya ca so'pyāha śiṣyebhyaḥ saṁhitā: bāṣkalāya ca so'py-āha śiṣyebhyaḥ saṁhitāṁ svakām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.śākalyastatsutaḥ svāṁ tu paṁcadhā vyasya: śākalyas-tat-sutaḥ svāṁ tu paṁcadhā vyasya saṁhitām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.evaṁ stutaḥ sa bhagavān vājirūpadharo ha: evaṁ stutaḥ sa bhagavān vāji-rūpa-dharo hariḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.udīcyāḥ sāmagāḥ śiṣyā āsan paṁcaśatāni v: udīcyāḥ sāmagāḥ śiṣyā āsan paṁca-śatāni vai|
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.śiṣya ūce svaśiṣyebhyaḥ śeṣā āvantya ātm: śiṣya ūce sva-śiṣyebhyaḥ śeṣā āvantya ātmavān||
vishnu/bhagavata/1206_final_state_pariks.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe veda-śākhā-praṇayanaṁ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|| 6||

vishnu/bhagavata/1207_branches_atharvave.kṛtā svena nṛṇāṁ tatra kāmāccodanayāpi v: kṛtā svena nṛṇāṁ tatra kāmāc-codanayāpi vā||
vishnu/bhagavata/1207_branches_atharvave.virameta yadā cittaṁ hitvā vṛttitrayaṁ s: virameta yadā cittaṁ hitvā vṛtti-trayaṁ svayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1207_branches_atharvave.vārāhaṁ mātsyaṁ kaurmaṁ ca brahmāṇḍākhya: vārāhaṁ mātsyaṁ kaurmaṁ ca brahmāṇḍākhyam-iti triṣaṭ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1207_branches_atharvave.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 7||

vishnu/bhagavata/1208_austerities_markan.yaḥ kalpānte urvarito yena grastamidaṁ j: yaḥ kalpānte urvarito yena grastam-idaṁ jagat||
vishnu/bhagavata/1208_austerities_markan.sāyaṁ prātaḥ sa gurave bhaikṣyamāhṛtya v: sāyaṁ prātaḥ sa gurave bhaikṣyam-āhṛtya vāgyataḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1208_austerities_markan.brahmā bhṛgurbhavo dakṣo brahmaputrāśca: brahmā bhṛgur-bhavo dakṣo brahma-putrāś-ca ye pare|
vishnu/bhagavata/1208_austerities_markan.te vai tadāśramaṁ jagmurhimādreḥ pārśva: te vai tad-āśramaṁ jagmur-himādreḥ pārśva uttare|
vishnu/bhagavata/1208_austerities_markan.yannāgādahamo bhāvaṁ na taccitraṁ mahats: yannāgād-ahamo bhāvaṁ na tac-citraṁ mahatsu hi||
vishnu/bhagavata/1208_austerities_markan.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe'ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 8||

vishnu/bhagavata/1209_markandeya_sees_lo.drakṣye māyāṁ yayā lokaḥ sapālo veda sad: drakṣye māyāṁ yayā lokaḥ sapālo veda sad-bhidām||
vishnu/bhagavata/1209_markandeya_sees_lo.kvacicchokaṁ kvacinmohaṁ kvacid duḥkhaṁ: kvacicchokaṁ kvacin-mohaṁ kvacid duḥkhaṁ sukhaṁ bhayam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1209_markandeya_sees_lo.sa kadācid bhramaṁstasmin pṛthivyāḥ kaku: sa kadācid bhramaṁs-tasmin pṛthivyāḥ kakudi dvijaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1209_markandeya_sees_lo.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe māyā-darśanaṁ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 9||

vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.kurvasya tapasaḥ sākṣāt saṁsiddhiṁ siddh: kurv-asya tapasaḥ sākṣāt saṁsiddhiṁ siddhido bhavān||
vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.ayaṁ hi paramo lābho nṛṇāṁ sādhusamāgama: ayaṁ hi paramo lābho nṛṇāṁ sādhu-samāgamaḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.ityuktvā tamupeyāya bhagavān sa satāṁ ga: ity-uktvā tam-upeyāya bhagavān sa satāṁ gatiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.evaṁ stutaḥ sa bhagavānādidevaḥ satāṁ ga: evaṁ stutaḥ sa bhagavān-ādidevaḥ satāṁ gatiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.ahaṁ ca bhagavān brahmā svayaṁ ca harirī: ahaṁ ca bhagavān brahmā svayaṁ ca harir-īśvaraḥ||
vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.na te mayyacyute'je ca bhidāmaṇvapi cakṣ: na te mayy-acyute'je ca bhidām-aṇv-api cakṣate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.sa ciraṁ māyayā viṣṇorbhrāmitaḥ karśito: sa ciraṁ māyayā viṣṇor-bhrāmitaḥ karśito bhṛśam|
vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.evaṁ varān sa munaye dattvāgāttryakṣa īś: evaṁ varān sa munaye dattvāgāt-tryakṣa īśvaraḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1210_lord_sankara_boon_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe daśamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 10||

vishnu/bhagavata/1211_secret_lord_limbs_.tanno varṇaya bhadraṁ te kriyāyogaṁ bubh: tanno varṇaya bhadraṁ te kriyā-yogaṁ bubhutsatām|
vishnu/bhagavata/1211_secret_lord_limbs_.yāvānayaṁ vai puruṣo yāvatyā saṁsthayā m: yāvān-ayaṁ vai puruṣo yāvatyā saṁsthayā mitaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1211_secret_lord_limbs_.bibharti sāṁkhyaṁ yogaṁ ca devo makaraku: bibharti sāṁkhyaṁ yogaṁ ca devo makara-kuṇḍale|
vishnu/bhagavata/1211_secret_lord_limbs_.taccittaḥ prayato japtvā brahma veda guh: tac-cittaḥ prayato japtvā brahma veda guhā-śayam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1211_secret_lord_limbs_.eka eva hi lokānāṁ sūrya ātmā''dikṛddhar: eka eva hi lokānāṁ sūrya ātmā''di-kṛddhariḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1211_secret_lord_limbs_.kālo deśaḥ kriyā kartā karaṇaṁ kāryamāga: kālo deśaḥ kriyā kartā karaṇaṁ kāryam-āgamaḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1211_secret_lord_limbs_.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe āditya-vyūha-vivaraṇaṁ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 11||

vishnu/bhagavata/1212_brief_list_content.tataḥ prākṛtikaḥ sargaḥ sapta vaikṛtikāś: tataḥ prākṛtikaḥ sargaḥ sapta vaikṛtikāś-ca ye|
vishnu/bhagavata/1212_brief_list_content.kaurmaṁ dhānvantaraṁ mātsyaṁ vāmanaṁ ca: kaurmaṁ dhānvantaraṁ mātsyaṁ vāmanaṁ ca jagat-pateḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1212_brief_list_content.vratacaryā tu kanyānāṁ yatra tuṣṭo'cyuto: vrata-caryā tu kanyānāṁ yatra tuṣṭo'cyuto vrataiḥ|
vishnu/bhagavata/1212_brief_list_content.prāgjyotiṣapatiṁ hatvā kanyānāṁ haraṇaṁ: prāgjyotiṣa-patiṁ hatvā kanyānāṁ haraṇaṁ ca yat||
vishnu/bhagavata/1212_brief_list_content.patitaḥ skhalitaścārtaḥ kṣuttvā vā vivaś: patitaḥ skhalitaś-cārtaḥ kṣuttvā vā vivaśo bruvan|
vishnu/bhagavata/1212_brief_list_content.proktaṁ bhagavatā yattu tatpadaṁ paramaṁ: proktaṁ bhagavatā yattu tat-padaṁ paramaṁ vrajet||
vishnu/bhagavata/1212_brief_list_content.vaiśyo nidhipatitvaṁ ca śūdraḥ śuddhyeta: vaiśyo nidhi-patitvaṁ ca śūdraḥ śuddhyeta pātakāt||
vishnu/bhagavata/1212_brief_list_content.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe pāramahaṁ: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe dvādaśa-skandhārtha-nirūpaṇaṁ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 12||

vishnu/bhagavata/1213_number_verses_vari.mārkaṇḍaṁ nava vāhnaṁ ca daśapaṁca catuḥ: mārkaṇḍaṁ nava vāhnaṁ ca daśa-paṁca catuḥśatam||
vishnu/bhagavata/1213_number_verses_vari.kṣetrāṇāṁ caiva sarveṣāṁ yathā kāśī hyan: kṣetrāṇāṁ caiva sarveṣāṁ yathā kāśī hy-anuttamā|
vishnu/bhagavata/1213_number_verses_vari.bhave bhave yathā bhaktiḥ pādayostava jā: bhave bhave yathā bhaktiḥ pādayos-tava jāyate|
vishnu/bhagavata/1213_number_verses_vari.tathā kuruṣva deveśa nāthastvaṁ no yataḥ: tathā kuruṣva deveśa nāthas-tvaṁ no yataḥ prabho||
vishnu/bhagavata/1213_number_verses_vari.iti śrīmadbhāgavate mahāpurāṇe vaiyāsiky: iti śrīmad-bhāgavate mahā-purāṇe vaiyāsikyām-aṣṭādaśa-sāhasryāṁ pāramahaṁsyāṁ saṁhitāyāṁ dvādaśa-skandhe trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 13||

vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.tattāvadbhāti sākṣād gurupavanapure hant: tat-tāvad-bhāti sākṣād guru-pavana-pure hanta bhāgyaṁ janānām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.ete tāvad vayaṁ tu sthirataramanasā viśv: ete tāvad vayaṁ tu sthiratara-manasā viśva-pīḍāpahatyai
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.kasmānno niṣkalastvaṁ sakala iti vacastv: kasmān-no niṣkalas-tvaṁ sakala iti vacas-tvat-kalāsv-eva bhūman||
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.kaṣṭā te sṛṣṭiceṣṭā bahutarabhavakhedāva: kaṣṭā te sṛṣṭi-ceṣṭā bahutara-bhava-khedāvahā jīva-bhājām-ity-evaṁ pūrvam-ālocitam-ajita mayā naivam-adyābhijāne|
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.no cejjīvāḥ kathaṁ vā madhurataramidaṁ t: no cej-jīvāḥ kathaṁ vā madhurataram-idaṁ tvad-vapuś-cid-rasārdraṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.namrāṇāṁ saṁnidhatte satatamapi purastai: namrāṇāṁ saṁnidhatte satatam-api puras-tair-anabhyarthitān-apy-arthān kāmān-ajasraṁ vitarati paramānanda-sāndrāṁ gatiṁ ca|
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.itthaṁ niśśeṣalabhyo niravadhikaphalaḥ p: itthaṁ niśśeṣa-labhyo niravadhika-phalaḥ pārijāto hare tvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.kāruṇyāt kāmamanyaṁ dadati khalu pare sv: kāruṇyāt kāmam-anyaṁ dadati khalu pare svātmadas-tvaṁ viśeṣād-aiśvaryād-īśate'nye jagati para-jane svātmano'pīśvaras-tvam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.tvayyuccairāramanti pratipadamadhure cet: tvayy-uccair-āramanti pratipada-madhure cetanāḥ sphīta-bhāgyās-tvaṁ cātmārāma evety-atula-guṇa-gaṇādhāra śaure namaste||
vishnu/narayaniyam/001_dasakam_01_bhagav.aṅgāsaṅgā sadā śrīrakhilavidasi na kvāpi: aṅgāsaṅgā sadā śrīr-akhila-vid-asi na kvāpi te saṅga-vārtā

vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.saundaryottarato'pi sundarataraṁ tvadrūp: saundaryottarato'pi sundarataraṁ tvad-rūpam-āścaryato'py-āścaryaṁ bhuvane na kasya kutukaṁ puṣṇāti viṣṇo vibho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.sā devī paramotsukā cirataraṁ nāste svab: sā devī paramotsukā cirataraṁ nāste sva-bhakteṣv-api|
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.ye tvaddhyānaguṇānukīrtanarasāsaktā hi b: ye tvad-dhyāna-guṇānukīrtana-rasāsaktā hi bhaktā janās-teṣv-eṣā vasati sthiraiva dayita-prastāva-dattādarā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.evaṁbhūtatayā hi bhaktyabhihito yogaḥ sa: evaṁ-bhūtatayā hi bhakty-abhihito yogaḥ sa yoga-dvayāt
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.kliṣṭvā tarkapathe paraṁ tava vapurbrahm: kliṣṭvā tarka-pathe paraṁ tava vapur-brahmākhyam-anye punaś-cittārdratvam-ṛte vicintya bahubhiḥ siddhyanti janmāntaraiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/002_dasakam_02_bhagav.sadyaḥsiddhikarī jayatyayi vibho saivāst: sadyaḥ-siddhi-karī jayaty-ayi vibho saivāstu me tvat-pada-prema-prauḍhi-rasārdratā drutataraṁ vātālayādhīśvara||

vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.smaranto rūpaṁ te varada kathayanto guṇa: smaranto rūpaṁ te varada kathayanto guṇa-kathāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.caranto ye bhaktāstvayi khalu ramante pa: caranto ye bhaktās-tvayi khalu ramante paramamūnahaṁ dhanyān manye samadhigata-sarvābhilaṣitān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.gadakliṣṭaṁ kaṣṭaṁ tava caraṇasevārasabh: gada-kliṣṭaṁ kaṣṭaṁ tava caraṇa-sevā-rasa-bhare'py-anāsaktaṁ cittaṁ bhavati bata viṣṇo kuru dayām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.bhavatpādāmbhojasmaraṇarasiko nāmanivahā: bhavat-pādāmbhoja-smaraṇa-rasiko nāma-nivahān-ahaṁ gāyaṁ gāyaṁ kuhacana vivatsyāmi vijane||
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.kṛpā te jātā cetkimiva na hi labhyaṁ tan: kṛpā te jātā cet-kim-iva na hi labhyaṁ tanu-bhṛtāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.bhavadbhaktiḥ sphītā bhavatu mama saiva: bhavad-bhaktiḥ sphītā bhavatu mama saiva praśamayed-aśeṣa-kleśaughaṁ na khalu hṛdi saṁdeha-kaṇikā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.na ced vyāsasyoktistava ca vacanaṁ naiga: na ced vyāsasyoktis-tava ca vacanaṁ naigama-vaco
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.vidhūya kleśān me kuru caraṇayugmaṁ dhṛt: vidhūya kleśān me kuru caraṇa-yugmaṁ dhṛta-rasaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.bhavanmūrtyāloke nayanamatha te pādatula: bhavan-mūrty-āloke nayanam-atha te pāda-tulasī-parighrāṇe ghrāṇaṁ śravaṇam-api te cāru-carite||
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.bhavatsnehī so'haṁ subahu paritapye ca k: bhavat-snehī so'haṁ subahu paritapye ca kim-idam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.akīrtiste mā bhūd varada gadabhāraṁ praś: akīrtis-te mā bhūd varada gada-bhāraṁ praśamayan
vishnu/narayaniyam/003_dasakam_03_bhakta.kimuktairbhūyobhistava hi karuṇā yāvadud: kim-uktair-bhūyobhis-tava hi karuṇā yāvad-udiyād-ahaṁ tāvad deva prahita-vividhārtha-pralapitaḥ|

vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.kalyatāṁ mama kuruṣva tāvatīṁ kalyate bh: kalyatāṁ mama kuruṣva tāvatīṁ kalyate bhavad-upāsanaṁ yayā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.kurmahe dṛḍhamamī sukhāsanaṁ paṅkajādyam: kurmahe dṛḍham-amī sukhāsanaṁ paṅkajādyam-api vā bhavat-parāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.tvatsamādhivijaye tu yaḥ punarmaṅkṣu mok: tvat-samādhi-vijaye tu yaḥ punar-maṅkṣu mokṣa-rasikaḥ krameṇa vā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.liṅgadehamapi saṁtyajannatho līyate tvay: liṅga-deham-api saṁtyajann-atho līyate tvayi pare nirāgrahaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.īyate bhavadupāśrayastadā vedhasaḥ padam: īyate bhavad-upāśrayas-tadā vedhasaḥ padam-ataḥ puraiva vā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.tatra vā tava pade'thavā vasan prākṛtapr: tatra vā tava pade'thavā vasan prākṛta-pralaya eti muktatām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.svecchayā khalu purā vimucyate saṁvibhid: svecchayā khalu purā vimucyate saṁvibhidya jagad-aṇḍam-ojasā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.tattadātmakatayā viśan sukhī yāti te pad: tat-tad-ātmakatayā viśan sukhī yāti te padam-anāvṛtaṁ vibho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/004_dasakam_04_ashtan.arcirādigatimīdṛśīṁ vrajan vicyutiṁ na b: arcirādi-gatim-īdṛśīṁ vrajan vicyutiṁ na bhajate jagat-pate|

vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.no mṛtyuśca tadāmṛtaṁ ca samabhūnnāhno n: no mṛtyuś-ca tadāmṛtaṁ ca samabhūn-nāhno na rātreḥ sthitis-tatraikas-tvam-aśiṣyathāḥ kila parānanda-prakāśātmanā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.kālaḥ karma guṇāśca jīvanivahā viśvaṁ ca: kālaḥ karma guṇāś-ca jīva-nivahā viśvaṁ ca kāryaṁ vibho
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.teṣāṁ naiva vadantyasattvamayi bho śakty: teṣāṁ naiva vadanty-asattvam-ayi bho śaktyātmanā tiṣṭhatāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.no cet kiṁ gaganaprasūnasadṛśāṁ bhūyo bh: no cet kiṁ gagana-prasūna-sadṛśāṁ bhūyo bhavet-sambhavaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.bibhrāṇe tvayi cukṣubhe tribhuvanībhāvāy: bibhrāṇe tvayi cukṣubhe tri-bhuvanībhāvāya māyā svayam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.prādurbhūya guṇān vikāsya vidadhuḥ tasyā: prādurbhūya guṇān vikāsya vidadhuḥ tasyāḥ sahāya-kriyām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.tatrāsau triguṇātmako'pi ca mahān sattva: tatrāsau triguṇātmako'pi ca mahān sattva-pradhānaḥ svayaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.taccāntaḥkaraṇaṁ vibho tava balāt sattvā: tac-cāntaḥkaraṇaṁ vibho tava balāt sattvāṁśa evāsṛjat|
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.śabdād vyoma tatassasarjitha vibho sparś: śabdād vyoma tatas-sasarjitha vibho sparśaṁ tato mārutaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/005_dasakam_05_virat_.tasmād rūpamato maho'tha ca rasaṁ toyaṁ: tasmād rūpam-ato maho'tha ca rasaṁ toyaṁ ca gandhaṁ mahīm|

vishnu/narayaniyam/006_dasakam_06_virat_.siddhādayassvaragaṇā mukharandhramagnird: siddhādayas-svaragaṇā mukha-randhram-agnir-devā bhujāḥ stana-yugaṁ tava dharma-devaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/006_dasakam_06_virat_.pṛṣṭhaṁ tvadharma iha deva manassudhāṁśu: pṛṣṭhaṁ tv-adharma iha deva manas-sudhāṁśur-avyaktam-eva hṛdayāmbujam-ambujākṣa|

vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.evaṁ deva caturdaśātmakajagadrūpeṇa jāta: evaṁ deva caturdaśātmaka-jagad-rūpeṇa jātaḥ punas-tasyordhvaṁ khalu satyaloka-nilaye jāto'si dhātā svayam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.tāvattvaṁ jagatāmpate tapa tapetyevaṁ hi: tāvat-tvaṁ jagatām-pate tapa tapety-evaṁ hi vaihāyasīṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.divyaṁ varṣasahasramāttatapasā tena tvam: divyaṁ varṣa-sahasram-ātta-tapasā tena tvam-ārādhitas-tasmai darśitavān-asi sva-nilayaṁ vaikuṇṭham-ekādbhutam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.māyā yatra kadāpi no vikurute bhāte jaga: māyā yatra kadāpi no vikurute bhāte jagadbhyo bahiś-śoka-krodha-vimoha-sādhvasa-mukhā bhāvās-tu dūraṁgatāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.tatte dhāma vibhāvitaṁ vijayate vaikuṇṭh: tatte dhāma vibhāvitaṁ vijayate vaikuṇṭha-rūpaṁ vibho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.bhaktiprāptatathāvidhonnatapadā dīvyanti: bhakti-prāpta-tathāvidhonnata-padā dīvyanti divyā janās-tat-te dhāma nirasta-sarva-śamalaṁ vaikuṇṭha-rūpaṁ jayet||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.yasmin vismayanīyadivyavibhavaṁ tatte pa: yasmin vismayanīya-divya-vibhavaṁ tatte padaṁ dehi me||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.viśveṣāṁ tava rūpamaikṣata vidhistatte v: viśveṣāṁ tava rūpam-aikṣata vidhis-tat-te vibho bhātu me||
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.jānāsyeva manīṣitaṁ mama vibho jñānaṁ ta: jānāsy-eva manīṣitaṁ mama vibho jñānaṁ tad-āpādaya
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.ātāmre caraṇe vinamramatha taṁ hastena h: ātāmre caraṇe vinamram-atha taṁ hastena haste spṛśan
vishnu/narayaniyam/007_dasakam_07_hirany.ityābhāṣya giraṁ pratoṣya nitarāṁ taccit: ity-ābhāṣya giraṁ pratoṣya nitarāṁ tac-citta-rūḍhaḥ svayaṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/008_dasakam_08_pralay.tavaiva veṣe phaṇirājiśeṣe jalaikaśeṣe b: tavaiva veṣe phaṇi-rāji-śeṣe jalaika-śeṣe bhuvane sma śeṣe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/008_dasakam_08_pralay.caturyugāṇāṁ ca sahasramevaṁ tvayi prasu: catur-yugāṇāṁ ca sahasram-evaṁ tvayi prasupte punar-advitīye|
vishnu/narayaniyam/008_dasakam_08_pralay.samphullapatre nitarāṁ vicitre tasmin bh: samphulla-patre nitarāṁ vicitre tasmin bhavad-vīrya-dhṛte saroje|
vishnu/narayaniyam/008_dasakam_08_pralay.anantabhūmā mama rogarāśiṁ nirundhi vātā: ananta-bhūmā mama roga-rāśiṁ nirundhi vātālaya-vāsa viṣṇo||

vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.vilokya tadupāśrayaṁ tava tanuṁ tu nālok: vilokya tad-upāśrayaṁ tava tanuṁ tu nālokayan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.amuṣya hi saroruhaḥ kimapi kāraṇaṁ sambh: amuṣya hi saroruhaḥ kimapi kāraṇaṁ sambhaved-iti sma kṛta-niścayaḥ sa khalu nāla-randhrādhvanā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.svayogabalavidyayā samavarūḍhavān prauḍh: sva-yoga-bala-vidyayā samavarūḍhavān prauḍha-dhīs-tvadīyam-atimohanaṁ na tu kalevaraṁ dṛṣṭavān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.hare jaya jaya prabho padamupaiṣi diṣṭyā: hare jaya jaya prabho padam-upaiṣi diṣṭyā dṛśoḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.kuruṣva dhiyamāśu me bhuvananirmitau kar: kuruṣva dhiyam-āśu me bhuvana-nirmitau karmaṭhām-iti druhiṇa-varṇita-svaguṇa-bṛṁhimā pāhi mām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.gṛhāṇa madanugrahaṁ kuru tapaśca bhūyo v: gṛhāṇa mad-anugrahaṁ kuru tapaś-ca bhūyo vidhe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.bhavatvakhilasādhanī mayi ca bhaktiratyu: bhavatv-akhila-sādhanī mayi ca bhaktir-atyutkaṭety-udīrya giram-ādadhā mudita-cetasaṁ vedhasam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/009_dasakam_09_jagat_.śataṁ kṛtatapāstataḥ sa khalu divyasaṁva: śataṁ kṛta-tapās-tataḥ sa khalu divya-saṁvatsarān-avāpya ca tapo-balaṁ mati-balaṁ ca pūrvādhikam|

vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.te sṛṣṭikarmaṇi tu tena niyujyamānāstvat: te sṛṣṭi-karmaṇi tu tena niyujyamānās-tvat-pāda-bhakti-rasikā jagṛhur-na vāṇīm||
vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.nāmāni me kuru padāni ca hā viriñcetyāda: nāmāni me kuru padāni ca hā viriñcety-ādau ruroda kila tena sa rudra-nāmā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.mā mā prajāḥ sṛja tapaścara maṅgalāyetyā: mā mā prajāḥ sṛja tapaś-cara maṅgalāyety-ācaṣṭa taṁ kamala-bhūr-bhavad-īritātmā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.tasyātha sargarasikasya marīciratristatr: tasyātha sarga-rasikasya marīcir-atris-tatrāṅgirāḥ kratu-muniḥ pulahaḥ pulastyaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/010_dasakam_10_srisht.putreṣu teṣu vinidhāya sa sargavṛddhimap: putreṣu teṣu vinidhāya sa sarga-vṛddhim-aprāpnuvaṁs-tava padāmbujam-āśrito'bhūt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.krameṇa sarge parivardhamāne kadāpi divy: krameṇa sarge parivardhamāne kadāpi divyāḥ sanakādayas-te|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.anaupamaṁ taṁ bhavato niketaṁ munīśvarāḥ: anaupamaṁ taṁ bhavato niketaṁ munīśvarāḥ prāpur-atīta-kakṣyāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.bhavaddidṛkṣūn bhavanaṁ vivikṣūn dvāḥsth: bhavad-didṛkṣūn bhavanaṁ vivikṣūn dvāḥsthau jayas-tān vijayo'py-arundhām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.teṣāṁ ca citte padamāpa kopaḥ sarvaṁ bha: teṣāṁ ca citte padam-āpa kopaḥ sarvaṁ bhavat-preraṇayaiva bhūman||
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.iti praśaptau bhavadāśrayau tau harismṛt: iti praśaptau bhavad-āśrayau tau hari-smṛtir-no'stv-iti nematus-tān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.prasādya gīrbhiḥ stuvato munīndrānananya: prasādya gīrbhiḥ stuvato munīndrān-ananya-nāthāv-atha pārṣadau tau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.hiraṇyapūrvaḥ kaśipuḥ kilaikaḥ paro hira: hiraṇya-pūrvaḥ kaśipuḥ kilaikaḥ paro hiraṇyākṣa iti pratītaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.bhavatpriyāṁ kṣmāṁ salile nimajjya cacār: bhavat-priyāṁ kṣmāṁ salile nimajjya cacāra garvād-vinadan gadāvān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.tato jaleśāt sadṛśaṁ bhavantaṁ niśamya b: tato jaleśāt sadṛśaṁ bhavantaṁ niśamya babhrāma gaveṣayaṁs-tvām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/011_dasakam_11_hirany.bhaktaikadṛśyaḥ sa kṛpānidhistvaṁ nirund: bhaktaika-dṛśyaḥ sa kṛpā-nidhis-tvaṁ nirundhi rogān marud-ālayeśa||

vishnu/narayaniyam/012_dasakam_12_varaha.sraṣṭāramāpa śaraṇaṁ bhavadaṅghrisevātuṣ: sraṣṭāram-āpa śaraṇaṁ bhavad-aṅghri-sevā-tuṣṭāśayaṁ muni-janaiḥ saha satyaloke||
vishnu/narayaniyam/012_dasakam_12_varaha.ityevameṣa kathito manunā svayambhūrambh: ity-evam-eṣa kathito manunā svayambhūr-ambhoruhākṣa tava pāda-yugaṁ vyacintīt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/012_dasakam_12_varaha.hā hā vibho jalamahaṁ nyapibaṁ purastāda: hā hā vibho jalam-ahaṁ nyapibaṁ purastād-adyāpi majjati mahī kim-ahaṁ karomi|
vishnu/narayaniyam/012_dasakam_12_varaha.abhre tathāvidhamudīkṣya bhavantamuccair: abhre tathāvidham-udīkṣya bhavantam-uccair-vismeratāṁ vidhir-agāt saha sūnubhiḥ svaiḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.nadan kvāsau kvāsāviti sa muninā darśita: nadan kvāsau kvāsāv-iti sa muninā darśita-patho
vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.aho āraṇyo'yaṁ mṛga iti hasantaṁ bahutar: aho āraṇyo'yaṁ mṛga iti hasantaṁ bahutaraiduruktairvidhyantaṁ diti-sutam-avajñāya bhagavan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.mahīṁ dṛṣṭvā daṁṣṭrāśirasi cakitāṁ svena: mahīṁ dṛṣṭvā daṁṣṭrā-śirasi cakitāṁ svena mahasā
vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.samāruṣṭo muṣṭyā sa khalu vitudaṁstvāṁ s: samāruṣṭo muṣṭyā sa khalu vitudaṁs-tvāṁ samatanod
vishnu/narayaniyam/013_dasakam_13_hirany.grahā jihvāyāṁ te parapuruṣa karṇe ca ca: grahā jihvāyāṁ te para-puruṣa karṇe ca camasā

vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.nijamantaramantarāyahīnaṁ caritaṁ te kat: nijam-antaram-antarāya-hīnaṁ caritaṁ te kathayan sukhaṁ nināya||
vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.hasitollasitānanaṁ vibho tvaṁ vapurāviṣk: hasitollasitānanaṁ vibho tvaṁ vapur-āviṣkuruṣe sma kardamāya||
vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.stuvate pulakāvṛtāya tasmai manuputrīṁ d: stuvate pulakāvṛtāya tasmai manu-putrīṁ dayitāṁ navāpi putrīḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.śatavarṣamatha vyatītya so'yannava kanyā: śata-varṣam-atha vyatītya so'yan-nava kanyāḥ samavāpya dhanya-rūpāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/014_dasakam_14_kapila.kapilātmaka vāyumandireśa tvaritaṁ tvaṁ: kapilātmaka vāyu-mandireśa tvaritaṁ tvaṁ paripāhi māṁ gadaughāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/015_dasakam_15_kapila.prakṛtimahadahaṅkārāśca mātrāśca bhūtāny: prakṛti-mahad-ahaṅkārāś-ca mātrāś-ca bhūtāny-api hṛdapi daśākṣī pūruṣaḥ pañcaviṁśaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/015_dasakam_15_kapila.yadi tu sajati tasyāṁ tadguṇāstaṁ bhajer: yadi tu sajati tasyāṁ tad-guṇās-taṁ bhajeran|
vishnu/narayaniyam/015_dasakam_15_kapila.vadasi khalu dṛḍhaṁ tvaṁ tadvidhūyāmayān: vadasi khalu dṛḍhaṁ tvaṁ tad-vidhūyāmayān me

vishnu/narayaniyam/016_dasakam_16_nara_n.dattāṁ tvayā ca jagṛhustrapayaiva sarvas: dattāṁ tvayā ca jagṛhus-trapayaiva sarva-svarvāsi-garva-śamanīṁ punar-urvaśīṁ tām||

vishnu/narayaniyam/017_dasakam_17_dhruva.reme ciraṁ bhavadanugrahapūrṇakāmastāte: reme ciraṁ bhavad-anugraha-pūrṇa-kāmas-tāte gate ca vanam-āhṛta-rājya-bhāraḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/018_dasakam_18_prithu.jātasya dhruvakula eva tuṅgakīrteraṅgasy: jātasya dhruva-kula eva tuṅga-kīrter-aṅgasya vyajani sutaḥ sa vena-nāmā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/018_dasakam_18_prithu.taddoṣavyathitamatiḥ sa rājavaryastvatpā: tad-doṣa-vyathita-matiḥ sa rāja-varyas-tvat-pāde nihita-manā vanaṁ gato'bhūt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/018_dasakam_18_prithu.satrasthaṁ muninivahaṁ hitāni śaṁsannaik: satra-sthaṁ muni-nivahaṁ hitāni śaṁsannaikṣiṣṭhāḥ sanaka-mukhān munīn purastāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.pituḥ sisṛkṣāniratasya śāsanād bhavattap: pituḥ sisṛkṣā-niratasya śāsanād bhavat-tapasyābhiratā daśāpi te|
vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.bhavadvicintāpi śivāya dehināṁ bhavatvas: bhavad-vicintāpi śivāya dehināṁ bhavatv-asau rudra-nutiś-ca kāmadā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.tataśca te bhūtalarodhinaḥ tarūn krudhā: tataś-ca te bhūtala-rodhinaḥ tarūn krudhā dahanto druhiṇena vāritāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.drumaiśca dattāṁ tanayāmavāpya tāṁ tvadu: drumaiś-ca dattāṁ tanayām-avāpya tāṁ tvad-ukta-kālaṁ sukhino'bhiremire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/019_dasakam_19_prache.avāpya dakṣaṁ ca sutaṁ kṛtādhvarāḥ prace: avāpya dakṣaṁ ca sutaṁ kṛtādhvarāḥ pracetaso nārada-labdhayā dhiyā|

vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.tvayi trilokībhṛti rājyabhāraṁ nidhāya n: tvayi trilokī-bhṛti rājya-bhāraṁ nidhāya nābhiḥ saha merudevyā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.tapovanaṁ prāpya bhavanniṣevī gataḥ kilā: tapo-vanaṁ prāpya bhavan-niṣevī gataḥ kilānanda-padaṁ padaṁ te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.yadā tadā tvaṁ nijayogaśaktyā svavarṣame: yadā tadā tvaṁ nija-yoga-śaktyā sva-varṣam-enad-vyadadhāḥ suvarṣam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.śayuvrataṁ gomṛgakākacaryāṁ ciraṁ carann: śayu-vrataṁ go-mṛga-kāka-caryāṁ ciraṁ carann-āpya paraṁ svarūpam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/020_dasakam_20_rishab.davāhatāṅgaḥ kuṭakācale tvaṁ tāpān mamāp: davāhatāṅgaḥ kuṭakācale tvaṁ tāpān mamāpākuru vāta-nātha||

vishnu/narayaniyam/021_dasakam_21_jambud.nīlāmbaraṁ dhṛtahalaṁ bhujagāṅganābhirju: nīlāmbaraṁ dhṛta-halaṁ bhujagāṅganābhir-juṣṭaṁ bhaje hara gadān guru-geha-nātha||

vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.adharmakārī daśamī bhavan punardadhau bh: adharma-kārī daśamī bhavan punar-dadhau bhavan-nāma-yute sute ratim||
vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.na niṣkṛtiḥ kiṁ viditā bhavādṛśāmiti pra: na niṣkṛtiḥ kiṁ viditā bhavādṛśām-iti prabho tvat-puruṣā babhāṣire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.anantasevā tu nikṛntati dvayīmiti prabho: ananta-sevā tu nikṛntati dvayīm-iti prabho tvat-puruṣā babhāṣire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.yadagrahīnnāma bhayākulo hareriti prabho: yad-agrahīn-nāma bhayākulo harer-iti prabho tvat-puruṣā babhāṣire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/022_dasakam_22_ajamil.yathāgniredhāṁsi yathauṣadhaṁ gadāniti p: yathāgniredhāṁsi yathauṣadhaṁ gadān-iti prabho tvat-puruṣā babhāṣire||

vishnu/narayaniyam/023_dasakam_23_chitra.prācetasastu bhagavannaparo hi dakṣastva: prācetasas-tu bhagavann-aparo hi dakṣas-tvat-sevanaṁ vyadhita sarga-vivṛddhi-kāmaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/023_dasakam_23_chitra.āvirbabhūvitha tadā lasadaṣṭabāhustasmai: āvirbabhūvitha tadā lasad-aṣṭa-bāhus-tasmai varaṁ daditha tāṁ ca vadhūm-asiknīm||
vishnu/narayaniyam/023_dasakam_23_chitra.|| iti dakṣacaritaṁ citraketūpākhyānaṁ v: || iti dakṣa-caritaṁ citraketūpākhyānaṁ vṛtra-vadha-varṇanaṁ marutām-utpatti-kathanaṁ ca trayoviṁśatitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/024_dasakam_24_prahla.nihantuṁ tvāṁ bhūyastava padamavāptasya: nihantuṁ tvāṁ bhūyas-tava padam-avāptasya ca ripor-bahirdṛṣṭer-antardadhitha hṛdaye sūkṣma-vapuṣā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/024_dasakam_24_prahla.sa vai jātyā daityaḥ śiśurapi sametya tv: sa vai jātyā daityaḥ śiśur-api sametya tvayi ratiṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/024_dasakam_24_prahla.guruproktaṁ cāsāvidamidamabhadrāya dṛḍha: guru-proktaṁ cāsāv-idam-idam-abhadrāya dṛḍham-ity-apākurvan sarvaṁ tava caraṇa-bhaktyaiva vavṛdhe||
vishnu/narayaniyam/024_dasakam_24_prahla.balaṁ me vaikuṇṭhastava ca jagatāṁ cāpi: balaṁ me vaikuṇṭhas-tava ca jagatāṁ cāpi sa balaṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/025_dasakam_25_narasi.śrutvā yaṁ kila daityarājahṛdaye pūrvaṁ: śrutvā yaṁ kila daitya-rāja-hṛdaye pūrvaṁ kadāpy-aśrutaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/025_dasakam_25_narasi.sambhūtaṁ na mṛgātmakaṁ na manujākāraṁ v: sambhūtaṁ na mṛgātmakaṁ na manujākāraṁ vapus-te vibho|
vishnu/narayaniyam/025_dasakam_25_narasi.bhrāmyantaṁ ditijādhamaṁ punarapi prodgṛ: bhrāmyantaṁ ditijādhamaṁ punar-api prodgṛhya dorbhyāṁ javād
vishnu/narayaniyam/025_dasakam_25_narasi.śāntastvaṁ karamasya mūrdhni samadhāḥ st: śāntas-tvaṁ karam-asya mūrdhni samadhāḥ stotrair-athodgāyatas-tasyākāma-dhiyo'pi tenitha varaṁ lokāya cānugraham||

vishnu/narayaniyam/026_dasakam_26_gajend.etadvṛttaṁ tvāṁ ca māṁ ca prage yo: etad-vṛttaṁ tvāṁ ca māṁ ca prage yo

vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.jagadīśa bhavatparā tadānīṁ kamanīyā kam: jagad-īśa bhavat-parā tadānīṁ kamanīyā kamalā babhūva devī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.amalāmavalokya yāṁ vilolaḥ sakalo'pi spṛ: amalām-avalokya yāṁ vilolaḥ sakalo'pi spṛhayāmbabhūva lokaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.tvayi dattahṛde tadaiva devyai tridaśend: tvayi datta-hṛde tadaiva devyai tridaśendro maṇi-pīṭhikāṁ vyatārīt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.avamṛśya sadaiva sarvaramye nihitā tvayy: avamṛśya sadaiva sarva-ramye nihitā tvayy-anayāpi divya-mālā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.atimohanavibhramā tadānīṁ madayantī khal: atimohana-vibhramā tadānīṁ madayantī khalu vāruṇī nirāgāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.amṛtaṁ kalaśe vahan karābhyāmakhilārtiṁ: amṛtaṁ kalaśe vahan karābhyām-akhilārtiṁ hara mārutālayeśa||
vishnu/narayaniyam/028_dasakam_28_lakshm.|| iti amṛtamathane kālakūṭotpattivarṇan: || iti amṛta-mathane kālakūṭotpatti-varṇanaṁ lakṣmī-svayaṁvara-varṇanam amṛtotpatti-varṇanaṁ ca aṣṭāviṁśatitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/029_dasakam_29_vishnu.ghore'tha mūrcchati raṇe balidaityamāyāv: ghore'tha mūrcchati raṇe bali-daitya-māyā-vyāmohite sura-gaṇe tvam-ihāvirāsīḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/030_dasakam_30_vamana.tāṁ narmadottarataṭe hayamedhaśālāmāsedu: tāṁ narmadottara-taṭe hayamedha-śālām-āseduṣi tvayi rucā tava ruddha-netraiḥ|

vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.mattaḥ kiṁ te samabhilaṣitaṁ viprasūno v: mattaḥ kiṁ te samabhilaṣitaṁ vipra-sūno vada tvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.vittaṁ bhaktaṁ bhavanamavaniṁ vāpi sarva: vittaṁ bhaktaṁ bhavanam-avaniṁ vāpi sarvaṁ pradāsye||
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.tāmakṣīṇāṁ baligiramupākarṇya kāruṇyapūr: tām-akṣīṇāṁ bali-giram-upākarṇya kāruṇya-pūrṇo'py-asyotsekaṁ śamayitumanā daitya-vaṁśaṁ praśaṁsan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.viśveśaṁ māṁ tripadamiha kiṁ yācase bāli: viśveśaṁ māṁ tripadam-iha kiṁ yācase bāliśas-tvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.sarvāṁ bhūmiṁ vṛṇu kimamunetyālapattvāṁ: sarvāṁ bhūmiṁ vṛṇu kim-amunety-ālapat-tvāṁ sa dṛpyan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.pādatrayyā yadi na mudito viṣṭapairnāpi: pāda-trayyā yadi na mudito viṣṭapair-nāpi tuṣyed-ity-ukte'smin varada bhavate dātukāme'tha toyam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.yācatyevaṁ yadi sa bhagavān pūrṇakāmo'sm: yācatyevaṁ yadi sa bhagavān pūrṇa-kāmo'smi so'haṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.divyaṁ rūpaṁ tava ca tadidaṁ paśyatāṁ vi: divyaṁ rūpaṁ tava ca tad-idaṁ paśyatāṁ viśva-bhājām-uccair-uccair-avṛdhad-avadhīkṛtya viśvāṇḍa-bhāṇḍam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.kālātmāyaṁ vasati purato yadvaśāt prāgji: kālātmāyaṁ vasati purato yad-vaśāt prāg-jitāḥ smaḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.kiṁ vo yuddhairiti baligirā te'tha pātāl: kiṁ vo yuddhair-iti bali-girā te'tha pātālam-āpuḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.pāśairbaddhaṁ patagapatinā daityamuccair: pāśair-baddhaṁ pataga-patinā daityam-uccair-avādīs-tārttīyīkaṁ diśa mama padaṁ kiṁ na viśveśvaro'si|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.darpocchittyai vihitamakhilaṁ daitya sid: darpocchittyai vihitam-akhilaṁ daitya siddho'si puṇyair-lokas-te'stu tridiva-vijayī vāsavatvaṁ ca paścāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/031_dasakam_31_bali_v.matsāyujyaṁ bhaja ca punarityanvagṛhṇā b: mat-sāyujyaṁ bhaja ca punar-ity-anvagṛhṇā baliṁ taṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.kṣiptaṁ jale tvāṁ cakitaṁ vilokya ninye': kṣiptaṁ jale tvāṁ cakitaṁ vilokya ninye'mbu-pātreṇa muniḥ sva-geham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.svalpairahobhiḥ kalaśīṁ ca kūpaṁ vāpīṁ s: svalpair-ahobhiḥ kalaśīṁ ca kūpaṁ vāpīṁ saraś-cānaśiṣe vibho tvam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.nirīkṣya tuṣṭā munayastvaduktyā tvattuṅg: nirīkṣya tuṣṭā munayas-tvad-uktyā tvat-tuṅga-śṛṅge taraṇiṁ babandhuḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.saṁstūyamāno nṛvareṇa tena jñānaṁ paraṁ: saṁstūyamāno nṛ-vareṇa tena jñānaṁ paraṁ copadiśann-acārīḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.kalpāvadhau sapta munīn purovat prasthāp: kalpāvadhau sapta munīn purovat prasthāpya satyavrata-bhūmipaṁ tam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/032_dasakam_32_matsya.svatuṅgaśṛṅgakṣatavakṣasaṁ taṁ nipātya d: sva-tuṅga-śṛṅga-kṣata-vakṣasaṁ taṁ nipātya daityaṁ nigamān gṛhītvā|

vishnu/narayaniyam/033_dasakam_33_ambari.kṛtyāṁ ca tāmasidharāṁ bhuvanaṁ dahantīm: kṛtyāṁ ca tāmasidharāṁ bhuvanaṁ dahantīm-agre'bhivīkṣya nṛpatir-na padāc-cakampe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/033_dasakam_33_ambari.sāyujyamāpa ca sa māṁ pavaneśa pāyāḥ||: sāyujyam-āpa ca sa māṁ pavaneśa pāyāḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.tadbhuktyā tatpurandhrīṣvapi tisṛṣu sama: tad-bhuktyā tat-purandhrīṣv-api tisṛṣu samaṁ jāta-garbhāsu jāto
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.kalyāṁ kurvannahalyāṁ pathi padarajasā p: kalyāṁ kurvann-ahalyāṁ pathi pada-rajasā prāpya vaideha-geham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.rājyaṁ prātiṣṭhathāstvaṁ tribhirapi ca s: rājyaṁ prātiṣṭhathās-tvaṁ tribhir-api ca samaṁ bhrātṛ-vīraiḥ sadāraiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.yāte yāto'syayodhyāṁ sukhamiha nivasan k: yāte yāto'syayodhyāṁ sukham-iha nivasan kāntayā kānta-mūrtte|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.nāvā saṁtīrya gaṅgāmadhipadavi punastaṁ: nāvā saṁtīrya gaṅgāmadhipadavi punas-taṁ bharadvājamārāntvā tad-vākya-hetor-atisukham-avasaś-citrakūṭe girīndre||
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.śrutvā putrārtikhinnaṁ khalu bharatamukh: śrutvā putrārti-khinnaṁ khalu bharata-mukhāt svarga-yātaṁ sva-tātaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.atriṁ natvātha gatvā vanamativipulaṁ daṇ: atriṁ natvātha gatvā vanam-ativipulaṁ daṇḍakaṁ caṇḍa-kāyaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.hatvā daityaṁ virādhaṁ sugatimakalayaścā: hatvā daityaṁ virādhaṁ sugatim-akalayaś-cāru bho śārabhaṅgīm||
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.pratyaśrauṣīḥ priyaiṣī tadanu ca muninā: pratyaśrauṣīḥ priyaiṣī tadanu ca muninā vaiṣṇave divya-cāpe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.brahmāstre cāpi datte pathi pitṛsuhṛdaṁ: brahmāstre cāpi datte pathi pitṛ-suhṛdaṁ vīkṣya bhūyo jaṭāyuṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.modād godātaṭānte pariramasi purā pañcav: modād godā-taṭānte pariramasi purā pañcavaṭyāṁ vadhūṭyā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.tāṁ saumitrau visṛjya prabalatamaruṣā te: tāṁ saumitrau visṛjya prabalatama-ruṣā tena nirlūna-nāsām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.dṛṣṭvaināṁ ruṣṭacittaṁ kharamabhipatitaṁ: dṛṣṭvaināṁ ruṣṭa-cittaṁ kharam-abhipatitaṁ dūṣaṇaṁ ca trimūrddhaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.bhūyastanvīṁ vicinvannahṛta daśamukhastv: bhūyas-tanvīṁ vicinvann-ahṛta daśamukhas-tvad-vadhūṁ mad-vadhenety-uktvā yāte jaṭāyau divam-atha suhṛdaḥ prātanoḥ preta-kāryam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/034_dasakam_34_shri_r.gṛhṇānaṁ taṁ kabandhaṁ jaghanitha śabarī: gṛhṇānaṁ taṁ kabandhaṁ jaghanitha śabarīṁ prekṣya pampā-taṭe tvaṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.nītaḥ sugrīvamaitrīṁ tadanu hanumatā dun: nītaḥ sugrīva-maitrīṁ tadanu hanumatā dundubheḥ kāyam-uccaiḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.kṣiptvāṅguṣṭhena bhūyo luluvitha yugapat: kṣiptvāṅguṣṭhena bhūyo luluvitha yugapat-patriṇā sapta sālān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.sugrīveṇānujoktyā sabhayamabhiyatā vyūhi: sugrīveṇānujoktyā sabhayam-abhiyatā vyūhitāṁ vāhinīṁ tām-ṛkṣāṇāṁ vīkṣya dikṣu drutam-atha dayitā-mārgaṇāyāvanamrām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.mārge mārge mamārge kapibhirapi tadā tva: mārge mārge mamārge kapibhir-api tadā tvat-priyā saprayāsaiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.dṛṣṭvā pluṣṭvā ca laṅkāṁ jhaṭiti sa hanu: dṛṣṭvā pluṣṭvā ca laṅkāṁ jhaṭiti sa hanumān mauli-ratnaṁ dadau te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.tatproktāṁ śatruvārtāṁ rahasi niśamayan: tat-proktāṁ śatru-vārtāṁ rahasi niśamayan prārthanāpārthya-roṣa-prastāgneyāstra-tejas-trasad-udadhi-girā labdhavān madhya-mārgam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.vyākurvan sānujastvaṁ samarabhuvi paraṁ: vyākurvan sānujastvaṁ samara-bhuvi paraṁ vikramaṁ śakra-jetrā
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.prīto divyābhiṣekairayutasamadhikān vats: prīto divyābhiṣekair-ayuta-samadhikān vatsarān paryaraṁsīmaithilyāṁ pāpa-vācā śiva! śiva! kila tāṁ garbhiṇīm-abhyahāsīḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.sītāṁ tvayyāsukāme kṣitimaviśadasau tvaṁ: sītāṁ tvayy-āsukāme kṣitim-aviśad-asau tvaṁ ca kālārthito'bhūḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.sākaṁ nākaṁ prayāto nijapadamagamo deva: sākaṁ nākaṁ prayāto nija-padam-agamo deva vaikuṇṭham-ādyam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.no cetsvātmānubhūteḥ kva nu tava manaso: no cet-svātmānubhūteḥ kva nu tava manaso vikriyā cakra-pāṇe
vishnu/narayaniyam/035_dasakam_35_rama_c.sa tvaṁ sattvaikamūrte pavanapurapate vy: sa tvaṁ sattvaika-mūrte pavana-pura-pate vyādhunu vyādhi-tāpān||

vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.atreḥ putratayā purā tvamanasūyāyāṁ hi d: atreḥ putratayā purā tvam-anasūyāyāṁ hi dattābhidho
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.dṛṣṭo bhaktatamena haihayamahīpālena tas: dṛṣṭo bhaktatamena haihaya-mahīpālena tasmai varān-aṣṭaiśvarya-mukhān pradāya daditha svenaiva cānte vadham||
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.brahmadveṣi tadākhilaṁ nṛpakulaṁ hantuṁ: brahma-dveṣi tadākhilaṁ nṛpa-kulaṁ hantuṁ ca bhūmer-bharam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.saṁjāto jamadagnito bhṛgukule tvaṁ reṇuk: saṁjāto jamadagnito bhṛgu-kule tvaṁ reṇukāyāṁ hare
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.labdhāmnāyagaṇaścaturdaśavayā gandharvar: labdhāmnāya-gaṇaś-caturdaśa-vayā gandharva-rāje manāg-āsaktāṁ kila mātaraṁ prati pituḥ krodhākulasyājñayā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.tātājñātigasodaraiḥ samamimāṁ chittvātha: tātājñātiga-sodaraiḥ samam-imāṁ chittvātha śāntāt pitus-teṣāṁ jīvana-yogam-āpitha varaṁ mātā ca te'dād-varān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.cakre tvayyatha vaiṣṇave'pi viphale budd: cakre tvayy-atha vaiṣṇave'pi viphale buddhvā hariṁ tvāṁ mudā
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.bhūyo'marṣitahaihayātmajagaṇaistāte hate: bhūyo'marṣita-haihayātmaja-gaṇais-tāte hate reṇukāmāghnānāṁ hṛdayaṁ nirīkṣya bahuśo ghorāṁ pratijñāṁ vahan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.yajñe kṣmāmapi kāśyapādiṣu diśan śālvena: yajñe kṣmām-api kāśyapādiṣu diśan śālvena yudhyan punaḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/036_dasakam_36_parash.dhyāteṣvāsadhṛtānalāstracakitaṁ sindhuṁ: dhyāteṣvāsa-dhṛtānalāstra-cakitaṁ sindhuṁ sruva-kṣepaṇād-utsāryoddhṛta-keralo bhṛgu-pate vāteśa saṁrakṣa mām||

vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.sāndrānandatano hare nanu purā daivāsure: sāndrānanda-tano hare nanu purā daivāsure saṅgare
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.tvatkṛttā api karmaśeṣavaśato ye te na y: tvat-kṛttā api karma-śeṣa-vaśato ye te na yātā gatim|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.hā hā durjanabhūribhāramathitāṁ pāthonid: hā hā durjana-bhūri-bhāra-mathitāṁ pātho-nidhau pātukām-etāṁ pālaya hanta me vivaśatāṁ sampṛccha devān-imān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.ūce cāmbujabhūramūnayi surāḥ satyaṁ dhar: ūce cāmbuja-bhūr-amūn-ayi surāḥ satyaṁ dharitryā vaco
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.nanvasyā bhavatāṁ ca rakṣaṇavidhau dakṣo: nanv-asyā bhavatāṁ ca rakṣaṇa-vidhau dakṣo hi lakṣmī-patiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.tvadvācaṁ hṛdaye niśamya sakalānānandaya: tvad-vācaṁ hṛdaye niśamya sakalān-ānandayann-ūcivān-ākhyātaḥ paramātmanā svayam-ahaṁ vākyaṁ tad-ākarṇyatām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.jāne dīnadaśāmahaṁ diviṣadāṁ bhūmeśca bh: jāne dīna-daśām-ahaṁ diviṣadāṁ bhūmeś-ca bhīmair-nṛpais-tat-kṣepāya bhavāmi yādava-kule so'haṁ samagrātmanā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.śrutvā karṇarasāyanaṁ tava vacaḥ sarveṣu: śrutvā karṇa-rasāyanaṁ tava vacaḥ sarveṣu nirvāpita-svānteṣv-īśa gateṣu tāvaka-kṛpā-pīyūṣa-tṛptātmasu|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.udvāhāvasitau tadīyasahajaḥ kaṁso'tha sa: udvāhāvasitau tadīya-sahajaḥ kaṁso'tha sammānayann-etau sūtatayā gataḥ pathi rathe vyomotthayā tvad-girā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.saṁtrāsāt sa tu hantumantikagatāṁ tanvīṁ: saṁtrāsāt sa tu hantum-antika-gatāṁ tanvīṁ kṛpāṇīm-adhāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.gṛhṇānaścikureṣu tāṁ khalamatiḥ śaureści: gṛhṇānaś-cikureṣu tāṁ khala-matiḥ śaureś-ciraṁ sāntvanainoṁ muñcan punar-ātmajārpaṇa-girā prīto'tha yāto gṛhān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.duṣṭānāmapi deva puṣṭakaruṇā dṛṣṭā hi dh: duṣṭānām-api deva puṣṭa-karuṇā dṛṣṭā hi dhīr-ekadā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.yūyaṁ nanvasurāḥ surāśca yadavo jānāsi k: yūyaṁ nanv-asurāḥ surāś-ca yadavo jānāsi kiṁ na prabho|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.māyāvī sa harirbhavadvadhakṛte bhāvī sur: māyāvī sa harir-bhavad-vadha-kṛte bhāvī sura-prārthanād-ity-ākarṇya yadūn-adūdhunad-asau śaureś-ca sūnūn-ahan||
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.nīte mādhava rohiṇīṁ tvamapi bhoḥ saccit: nīte mādhava rohiṇīṁ tvam-api bhoḥ saccit-sukhaikātmakaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/037_dasakam_37_krishn.sa tvaṁ kṛṣṇa vidhūya rogapaṭalīṁ bhakti: sa tvaṁ kṛṣṇa vidhūya roga-paṭalīṁ bhaktiṁ parāṁ dehi me||

vishnu/narayaniyam/038_dasakam_38_krishn.deva prasīda parapūruṣa tāpavallīnirlūna: deva prasīda para-pūruṣa tāpa-vallī-nirlūna-dātra sama-netra kalā-vilāsin|
vishnu/narayaniyam/038_dasakam_38_krishn.khedānapākuru kṛpāgurubhiḥ kaṭākṣairityā: khedān-apākuru kṛpā-gurubhiḥ kaṭākṣair-ityādi tena muditena ciraṁ nuto'bhūḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.vimuktacikurotkarastvaritamāpatan bhojar: vimukta-cikurotkaras-tvaritam-āpatan bhoja-rāḍ-atuṣṭa iva dṛṣṭavān bhaginikā-kare kanyakām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.dhruvaṁ kapaṭaśālino madhuharasya māyā b: dhruvaṁ kapaṭa-śālino madhu-harasya māyā bhaved-asāv-iti kiśorikāṁ bhaginikā-karāliṅgitām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.adhastalamajagmuṣī vikasadaṣṭabāhusphura: adhastalam-ajagmuṣī vikasad-aṣṭa-bāhu-sphuran-mahāyudham-aho gatā kila vihāyasā didyute||
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.babhūva bhavadantakaḥ kvacana cintyatāṁ: babhūva bhavad-antakaḥ kvacana cintyatāṁ te hitam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.iti tvadanujā vibho khalamudīrya taṁ jag: iti tvad-anujā vibho khalam-udīrya taṁ jagmuṣī
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.tataḥ paśupamandire tvayi mukunda nandap: tataḥ paśupa-mandire tvayi mukunda nanda-priyā-prasūti-śayaneśaye rudati kiñcid-añcat-pade|
vishnu/narayaniyam/039_dasakam_39_yogama.punaḥ stanabharaṁ nijaṁ sapadi pāyayanty: punaḥ stana-bharaṁ nijaṁ sapadi pāyayantyā mudā

vishnu/narayaniyam/040_dasakam_40_putana.ayi sakhe tava bālakajanma māṁ sukhayate: ayi sakhe tava bālaka-janma māṁ sukhayate'dya nijātmaja-janmavat|
vishnu/narayaniyam/040_dasakam_40_putana.iti bhavatpitṛtāṁ vrajanāyake samadhirop: iti bhavat-pitṛtāṁ vraja-nāyake samadhiropya śaśaṁsa tam-ādarāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/040_dasakam_40_putana.iha ca santyanimittaśatāni te kaṭakasīmn: iha ca santy-animitta-śatāni te kaṭaka-sīmni tato laghu gamyatām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/040_dasakam_40_putana.iti ca tadvacasā vrajanāyako bhavadapāya: iti ca tad-vacasā vraja-nāyako bhavad-apāya-bhiyā drutam-āyayau||
vishnu/narayaniyam/040_dasakam_40_putana.avasare khalu tatra ca kācana vrajapade: avasare khalu tatra ca kācana vraja-pade madhurākṛtir-aṅganā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/040_dasakam_40_putana.sapadi sā hṛtabālakacetanā niśicarānvaya: sapadi sā hṛta-bālaka-cetanā niśicarānvaya-jā kila pūtanā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/040_dasakam_40_putana.asubhireva samaṁ dhayati tvayi stanamasa: asubhir-eva samaṁ dhayati tvayi stanam-asau stanitopama-nisvanā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/040_dasakam_40_putana.nirapatadbhayadāyi nijaṁ vapuḥ pratigatā: nirapatad-bhaya-dāyi nijaṁ vapuḥ pratigatā pravisārya bhujāv-ubhau||

vishnu/narayaniyam/041_dasakam_41_putana.madaṅgasaṅgasya phalaṁ na dūre kṣaṇena t: mad-aṅga-saṅgasya phalaṁ na dūre kṣaṇena tāvad-bhavatām-api syāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/041_dasakam_41_putana.citraṁ piśācyā na hataḥ kumāraścitraṁ pu: citraṁ piśācyā na hataḥ kumāraś-citraṁ puraivākathi śauriṇedam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/041_dasakam_41_putana.iti praśaṁsan kila gopaloko bhavanmukhāl: iti praśaṁsan kila gopa-loko bhavan-mukhāloka-rase nyamāṅkṣīt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/041_dasakam_41_putana.aho kumāro mayi dattadṛṣṭiḥ smitaṁ kṛtaṁ: aho kumāro mayi datta-dṛṣṭiḥ smitaṁ kṛtaṁ māṁ prati vatsakena|
vishnu/narayaniyam/041_dasakam_41_putana.ehyehi māmityupasārya pāṇiṁ tvayīśa kiṁ: ehyehi mām-ity-upasārya pāṇiṁ tvayīśa kiṁ kiṁ na kṛtaṁ vadhūbhiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/041_dasakam_41_putana.nipāyayantī stanamaṅkagaṁ tvāṁ vilokayan: nipāyayantī stanam-aṅkagaṁ tvāṁ vilokayantī vadanaṁ hasantī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/041_dasakam_41_putana.daśāṁ yaśodā katamāṁ na bheje sa tādṛśaḥ: daśāṁ yaśodā katamāṁ na bheje sa tādṛśaḥ pāhi hare gadān-mām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/041_dasakam_41_putana.|| iti pūtanāśarīradāhavarṇanaṁ gopīnāṁ: || iti pūtanā-śarīra-dāha-varṇanaṁ gopīnāṁ bāla-lālana-kautuka-varṇanaṁ ca ekacatvāriṁśattama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.mahānasastvāṁ savidhe nidhāya sā mahānas: mahānasas-tvāṁ savidhe nidhāya sā mahānasādau vavṛte vrajeśvarī||
vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.śiśoraho kiṁ kimabhūditi drutaṁ pradhāvy: śiśor-aho kiṁ kim-abhūd-iti drutaṁ pradhāvya nandaḥ paśupāś-ca bhūsurāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.na kāraṇaṁ kiñcidiheti te sthitāḥ svanās: na kāraṇaṁ kiñcid-iheti te sthitāḥ sva-nāsikā-datta-karās-tvad-īkṣakāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.mayā mayā dṛṣṭamano viparyagāditīśa te p: mayā mayā dṛṣṭamano viparyagād-itīśa te pālaka-bālakā jaguḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.pravālatāmraṁ kimidaṁ padaṁ kṣataṁ saroj: pravāla-tāmraṁ kim-idaṁ padaṁ kṣataṁ saroja-ramyau nu karau virājitau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.aye sutaṁ dehi jagatpateḥ kṛpātaraṅgapāt: aye sutaṁ dehi jagat-pateḥ kṛpā-taraṅga-pātāt-paripātam-adya me|
vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.iti sma saṁgṛhya pitā tvadaṅkaṁ muhurmuh: iti sma saṁgṛhya pitā tvad-aṅkaṁ muhurmuhuḥ śliṣyati jāta-kaṇṭakaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.anonilīnaḥ kila hantumāgataḥ surārirevaṁ: anonilīnaḥ kila hantum-āgataḥ surārir-evaṁ bhavatā vihiṁsitaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/042_dasakam_42_shakat.rajo'pi no dṛṣṭamamuṣya tatkathaṁ sa śud: rajo'pi no dṛṣṭam-amuṣya tat-kathaṁ sa śuddha-sattve tvayi līnavān dhruvam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/043_dasakam_43_trinav.vātyāvapuḥ sa kila daityavarastṛṇāvartāk: vātyāvapuḥ sa kila daitya-varas-tṛṇāvartākhyo jahāra jana-mānasa-hāriṇaṁ tvām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/043_dasakam_43_trinav.praikṣanta hanta nipatantamamuṣya vakṣas: praikṣanta hanta nipatantam-amuṣya vakṣasy-akṣīṇam-eva ca bhavantam-alaṁ hasantam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/044_dasakam_44_namaka.gūḍhaṁ vasudevagirā kartuṁ te niṣkriyasy: gūḍhaṁ vasudeva-girā kartuṁ te niṣkriyasya saṁskārān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/044_dasakam_44_namaka.kathamasya nāma kurve sahasranāmno hyana: katham-asya nāma kurve sahasranāmno hy-ananta-nāmno vā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/044_dasakam_44_namaka.iti nūnaṁ gargamuniścakre tava nāma nāma: iti nūnaṁ garga-muniś-cakre tava nāma nāma rahasi vibho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/044_dasakam_44_namaka.snihyati yastava putre muhyati sa na māy: snihyati yas-tava putre muhyati sa na māyikaiḥ punaḥ śokaiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/044_dasakam_44_namaka.druhyati yaḥ sa tu naśyedityavadatte mah: druhyati yaḥ sa tu naśyed-ity-avadat-te mahattvam-ṛṣi-varyaḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/045_dasakam_45_bala_k.tadanu caraṇacārī dārakaiḥ sākamārānnila: tadanu caraṇa-cārī dārakaiḥ sākam-ārān-nilaya-tatiṣu khelan bāla-cāpalya-śālī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/045_dasakam_45_bala_k.mama khalu baligehe yācanaṁ jātamāstāmih: mama khalu bali-gehe yācanaṁ jātam-āstām-iha punar-abalānām-agrato naiva kurve|
vishnu/narayaniyam/045_dasakam_45_bala_k.iti vihitamatiḥ kiṁ deva saṁtyajya yācñā: iti vihita-matiḥ kiṁ deva saṁtyajya yācñāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/045_dasakam_45_bala_k.tava dadhighṛtamoṣe ghoṣayoṣājanānāmabha: tava dadhi-ghṛta-moṣe ghoṣa-yoṣā-janānām-abhajata hṛdi roṣo nāvakāśaṁ na śokaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/045_dasakam_45_bala_k.śākhāgre'tha vidhuṁ vilokya phalamityamb: śākhāgre'tha vidhuṁ vilokya phalam-ity-ambāṁ ca tātaṁ muhuḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/045_dasakam_45_bala_k.citraṁ deva śaśī sa te karamagāt kiṁ brū: citraṁ deva śaśī sa te karam-agāt kiṁ brūmahe sampataj-jyotir-maṇḍala-pūritākhila-vapuḥ prāgā virāḍ-rūpatām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/045_dasakam_45_bala_k.māyāṁ punastanayamohamayīṁ vitanvannānan: māyāṁ punas-tanaya-mohamayīṁ vitanvann-ānanda-cinmaya jaganmaya pāhi rogāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.ayi deva purā kila tvayi svayamuttānaśay: ayi deva purā kila tvayi svayam-uttāna-śaye stanandhaye|
vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.punarapyatha bālakaiḥ samaṁ tvayi līlāni: punar-apy-atha bālakaiḥ samaṁ tvayi līlā-nirate jagat-pate|
vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.mṛdupāśanato rujā bhavediti bhītā jananī: mṛd-upāśanato rujā bhaved-iti bhītā jananī cukopa sā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.iti mātṛgiraṁ ciraṁ vibho vitathāṁ tvaṁ: iti mātṛ-giraṁ ciraṁ vibho vitathāṁ tvaṁ pratijajñiṣe hasan||
vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.api mṛllavadarśanotsukāṁ jananīṁ tāṁ bah: api mṛl-lava-darśanotsukāṁ jananīṁ tāṁ bahu tarpayann-iva|
vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.kuhacid vanamambudhiḥ kvacit kvacidabhra: kuhacid vanam-ambudhiḥ kvacit kvacid-abhraṁ kuhacid rasātalam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.manujā danujāḥ kvacitsurā dadṛśe kinna t: manujā danujāḥ kvacit-surā dadṛśe kinna tadā tvad-ānane||
vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.svapuraśca nijārbhakātmakaṁ katidhā tvāṁ: sva-puraś-ca nijārbhakātmakaṁ katidhā tvāṁ na dadarśa sā mukhe||
vishnu/narayaniyam/046_dasakam_46_vishva.dhṛtatattvadhiyaṁ tadā kṣaṇaṁ jananīṁ tā: dhṛta-tattva-dhiyaṁ tadā kṣaṇaṁ jananīṁ tāṁ praṇayena mohayan|

vishnu/narayaniyam/047_dasakam_47_ulukha.dugdhamīśa dahane parisrutaṁ dhartumāśu: dugdham-īśa dahane parisrutaṁ dhartum-āśu jananī jagāma te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/047_dasakam_47_ulukha.manthadaṇḍamupagṛhya pāṭitaṁ hanta deva: mantha-daṇḍam-upagṛhya pāṭitaṁ hanta deva dadhi-bhājanaṁ tvayā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/047_dasakam_47_ulukha.tvadyaśovisaravad dadarśa sā sadya eva d: tvad-yaśo-visaravad dadarśa sā sadya eva dadhi vistṛtaṁ kṣitau||
vishnu/narayaniyam/047_dasakam_47_ulukha.sā niyujya raśanāguṇān bahūn dvyaṅgulona: sā niyujya raśanā-guṇān bahūn dvyaṅgulonam-akhilaṁ kilaikṣata||
vishnu/narayaniyam/047_dasakam_47_ulukha.sthīyatāṁ ciramulūkhale khaletyāgatā bha: sthīyatāṁ ciram-ulūkhale khalety-āgatā bhavanam-eva sā yadā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/047_dasakam_47_ulukha.evamādi divijairabhiṣṭuto vātanātha pari: evam-ādi divijair-abhiṣṭuto vāta-nātha paripāhi māṁ gadāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.kuberasūnurnalakūbarābhidhaḥ paro maṇigr: kubera-sūnur-nalakūbarābhidhaḥ paro maṇigrīva iti prathāṁ gataḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.vivāsasau keliparau sa nārado bhavatpada: vivāsasau keli-parau sa nārado bhavat-padaika-pravaṇo niraikṣata||
vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.imau bhavadbhaktyupaśāntisiddhaye munirj: imau bhavad-bhakty-upaśānti-siddhaye munir-jagau śāntim-ṛte kutaḥ sukham||
vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.yuvāmavāptau kakubhātmatāṁ ciraṁ hariṁ n: yuvāmavāptau kakubhātmatāṁ ciraṁ hariṁ nirīkṣyātha padaṁ svam-āpnutam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.itīritau tau bhavadīkṣaṇaspṛhāṁ gatau vr: itīritau tau bhavad-īkṣaṇa-spṛhāṁ gatau vrajānte kakubhau babhūvatuḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.abhāji śākhidvitayaṁ yadā tvayā tadaiva: abhāji śākhi-dvitayaṁ yadā tvayā tadaiva tad-garbha-talān-nireyuṣā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.mahātviṣā yakṣayugena tatkṣaṇādabhāji go: mahā-tviṣā yakṣa-yugena tatkṣaṇād-abhāji govinda bhavān-api stavaiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.ihānyabhakto'pi sameṣyati kramād bhavant: ihānya-bhakto'pi sameṣyati kramād bhavantam-etau khalu rudra-sevakau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/048_dasakam_48_yamala.iti bruvāṇairgamito gṛhaṁ bhavān marutpu: iti bruvāṇair-gamito gṛhaṁ bhavān marutpurādhīśvara pāhi māṁ gadāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/049_dasakam_49_vrinda.bṛhadvanaṁ tatkhalu nandamukhyā vidhāya: bṛhadvanaṁ tat-khalu nanda-mukhyā vidhāya gauṣṭhīnam-atha kṣaṇena|
vishnu/narayaniyam/049_dasakam_49_vrinda.caran sarāmo'tha kumārakaistvaṁ samīrage: caran sarāmo'tha kumārakais-tvaṁ samīra-gehādhipa pāhi rogāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/050_dasakam_50_vatsas.śirasi bhavato harṣādvarṣanti nāma tadā: śirasi bhavato harṣād-varṣanti nāma tadā hare||
vishnu/narayaniyam/050_dasakam_50_vatsas.sapadi sahajāṁ saṁdraṣṭuṁ vā mṛtāṁ khalu: sapadi sahajāṁ saṁdraṣṭuṁ vā mṛtāṁ khalu pūtanām-anujam-agham-apy-agre gatvā pratīkṣitum-eva vā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/050_dasakam_50_vatsas.|| iti vatsāsuravadhavarṇanaṁ bakāsurava: || iti vatsāsura-vadha-varṇanaṁ bakāsura-vadha-varṇanaṁ ca pañcāśattama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/052_dasakam_52_vatsap.vatsānavīkṣya vivaśe paśupotkare tānānet: vatsān-avīkṣya vivaśe paśupotkare tān-ānetu-kāma iva dhātṛ-matānuvartī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/052_dasakam_52_vatsap.māyānimagnahṛdayo vimumoha yāvadeko babh: māyā-nimagna-hṛdayo vimumoha yāvad-eko babhūvitha tadā kavalārdha-pāṇiḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.atītya bālyaṁ jagatāṁ pate tvamupetya pa: atītya bālyaṁ jagatāṁ pate tvam-upetya paugaṇḍa-vayo manojñam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.kadāpi rāmeṇa samaṁ vanānte vanaśriyaṁ v: kadāpi rāmeṇa samaṁ vanānte vana-śriyaṁ vīkṣya caran sukhena|
vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.śrīdāmanāmnaḥ svasakhasya vācā modādagā: śrīdāma-nāmnaḥ sva-sakhasya vācā modād-agā dhenuka-kānanaṁ tvam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.uttālatālīnivahe tvaduktyā balena dhūte': uttāla-tālī-nivahe tvad-uktyā balena dhūte'tha balena dorbhyām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.samudyato dhainukapālane'haṁ kathaṁ vadh: samudyato dhainuka-pālane'haṁ kathaṁ vadhaṁ dhainukam-adya kurve|
vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.satyaṁ phalaṁ jātamiheti hāsī bālaiḥ sam: satyaṁ phalaṁ jātam-iheti hāsī bālaiḥ samaṁ tāla-phalāny-abhuṅkthāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.madhudravasrunti bṛhanti tāni phalāni me: madhu-drava-srunti bṛhanti tāni phalāni medo-bhara-bhṛnti bhuktvā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.tṛptaiśca dṛptairbhavanaṁ phalaughaṁ vah: tṛptaiś-ca dṛptair-bhavanaṁ phalaughaṁ vahadbhir-āgāḥ khalu bālakais-tvam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/053_dasakam_53_dhenuk.hato hato dhenuka ityupetya phalānyadadb: hato hato dhenuka ity-upetya phalāny-adadbhir-madhurāṇi lokaiḥ|

vishnu/narayaniyam/055_dasakam_55_kaliya.atha vāriṇi ghorataraṁ phaṇinaṁ prativār: atha vāriṇi ghorataraṁ phaṇinaṁ prativārayituṁ kṛta-dhīr-bhagavan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/055_dasakam_55_kaliya.parimajjayati sma dhanuśśatakaṁ taṭinī j: parimajjayati sma dhanuś-śatakaṁ taṭinī jhaṭiti sphuṭa-ghoṣavatī||
vishnu/narayaniyam/055_dasakam_55_kaliya.tvayi nṛtyati mārutagehapate paripāhi sa: tvayi nṛtyati māruta-geha-pate paripāhi sa māṁ tvam-adānta-gadāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/055_dasakam_55_kaliya.|| iti kāliyopākhyāne kāliyamardane bhag: || iti kāliyopākhyāne kāliya-mardane bhagavan-nartana-varṇanaṁ pañcapañcāśattama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/056_dasakam_56_bhagav.namati yadyadamuṣya śiro hare parivihāya: namati yad-yad-amuṣya śiro hare parivihāya tad-unnatam-unnatam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/056_dasakam_56_bhagav.ayi puraiva cirāya pariśrutatvadanubhāva: ayi puraiva cirāya pariśruta-tvad-anubhāva-vilīna-hṛdo hi tāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/056_dasakam_56_bhagav.ramaṇakaṁ vraja vāridhimadhyagaṁ phaṇiri: ramaṇakaṁ vraja vāridhi-madhya-gaṁ phaṇi-ripur-na karoti virodhitām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/056_dasakam_56_bhagav.niśi punastamasā vrajamandiraṁ vrajituma: niśi punas-tamasā vraja-mandiraṁ vrajitum-akṣama eva janotkare|
vishnu/narayaniyam/056_dasakam_56_bhagav.avitumāśu papātha mahānalaṁ kimiha citra: avitum-āśu papātha mahānalaṁ kimiha citramayaṁ khalu te mukham||
vishnu/narayaniyam/056_dasakam_56_bhagav.śikhini varṇata eva hi pītatā parilasaty: śikhini varṇata eva hi pītatā parilasaty-adhunā kriyayāpy-asau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/056_dasakam_56_bhagav.iti nutaḥ paśupairmuditairvibho hara har: iti nutaḥ paśupair-muditair-vibho hara hare duritaiḥ saha me gadān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/056_dasakam_56_bhagav.|| iti kāliyopākhyāne kāliyamardane bhag: || iti kāliyopākhyāne kāliya-mardane bhagavad-anugraha-varṇanaṁ ṣaṭpañcāśattama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/057_dasakam_57_pralam.rāmasakhaḥ kvāpi dine kāmada bhagavan ga: rāma-sakhaḥ kvāpi dine kāmada bhagavan gato bhavān vipinam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/057_dasakam_57_pralam.gopān vibhajya tanvan saṅghaṁ balabhadra: gopān vibhajya tanvan saṅghaṁ balabhadrakaṁ bhavatkam-api|
vishnu/narayaniyam/057_dasakam_57_pralam.rāmavijitaḥ pralambo jahāra taṁ dūrato b: rāma-vijitaḥ pralambo jahāra taṁ dūrato bhavad-bhītyā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/057_dasakam_57_pralam.tvaddūraṁ gamayantaṁ taṁ dṛṣṭvā halini v: tvad-dūraṁ gamayantaṁ taṁ dṛṣṭvā halini vihita-garima-bhare|
vishnu/narayaniyam/057_dasakam_57_pralam.daityaḥ svarūpamāgādyadrūpāt sa hi balo': daityaḥ svarūpam-āgād-yad-rūpāt sa hi balo'pi cakito'bhūt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/057_dasakam_57_pralam.kālaṁ vihāya sadyo lolambaruce hare hare: kālaṁ vihāya sadyo lolamba-ruce hare hareḥ kleśān||

vishnu/narayaniyam/058_dasakam_58_grishm.tvayi viharaṇalole bālajālaiḥ pralambapr: tvayi viharaṇa-lole bāla-jālaiḥ pralamba-pramathana-savilambe dhenavaḥ svaira-cārāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/058_dasakam_58_grishm.paśukulamabhivīkṣya kṣipramānetumārāttva: paśu-kulam-abhivīkṣya kṣipram-ānetum-ārāt-tvayi gatavati hī hī sarvato'gnir-jajṛmbhe||
vishnu/narayaniyam/058_dasakam_58_grishm.kva nu davadahano'sau kutra muñjāṭavī sā: kva nu dava-dahano'sau kutra muñjāṭavī sā
vishnu/narayaniyam/058_dasakam_58_grishm.jaya jaya tava māyā keyamīśeti teṣāṁ: jaya jaya tava māyā keyam-īśeti teṣāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/058_dasakam_58_grishm.atha śaradamupetāṁ tāṁ bhavadbhaktacetov: atha śaradam-upetāṁ tāṁ bhavad-bhakta-ceto-vimala-salila-pūrāṁ mānayan kānaneṣu|

vishnu/narayaniyam/059_dasakam_59_venuga.drāvaṇaṁ ca dṛṣadāmapi prabho tāvakaṁ vy: drāvaṇaṁ ca dṛṣadām-api prabho tāvakaṁ vyajani veṇu-kūjitam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/059_dasakam_59_venuga.tvatpadapraṇayi kānanaṁ ca tāḥ dhanyadha: tvat-pada-praṇayi kānanaṁ ca tāḥ dhanya-dhanyam-iti nanvamānayan||
vishnu/narayaniyam/059_dasakam_59_venuga.dūrato bata kṛtaṁ durāśayetyākulā muhuri: dūrato bata kṛtaṁ durāśayetyākulā muhur-imāḥ samāmuhan||
vishnu/narayaniyam/059_dasakam_59_venuga.rāgastāvajjāyate hi svabhāvānmokṣopāyo y: rāgas-tāvaj-jāyate hi svabhāvān-mokṣopāyo yatnataḥ syānna vā syāt|

vishnu/narayaniyam/060_dasakam_60_gopi_v.tava nāmakathāratāḥ samaṁ sudṛśaḥ prātar: tava nāma-kathā-ratāḥ samaṁ sudṛśaḥ prātar-upāgatā nadīm|
vishnu/narayaniyam/060_dasakam_60_gopi_v.iha tāvadupetya nīyatāṁ vasanaṁ vaḥ sudṛ: iha tāvad-upetya nīyatāṁ vasanaṁ vaḥ sudṛśo yathāyatham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/060_dasakam_60_gopi_v.iti narmamṛdusmite tvayi bruvati vyāmumu: iti narma-mṛdu-smite tvayi bruvati vyāmumuhe vadhū-janaiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/060_dasakam_60_gopi_v.ayi jīva ciraṁ kiśora nastava dāsīravaśī: ayi jīva ciraṁ kiśora nas-tava dāsīr-avaśīkaroṣi kim|
vishnu/narayaniyam/060_dasakam_60_gopi_v.adhiruhya taṭaṁ kṛtāñjalīḥ pariśuddhāḥ s: adhiruhya taṭaṁ kṛtāñjalīḥ pariśuddhāḥ sva-gatīr-nirīkṣya tāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/060_dasakam_60_gopi_v.viditaṁ nanu vo manīṣitaṁ vaditārastviha: viditaṁ nanu vo manīṣitaṁ vaditāras-tv-iha yogyam-uttaram|
vishnu/narayaniyam/060_dasakam_60_gopi_v.praṇayādayi vīkṣya vīkṣya te vadanābjaṁ: praṇayād-ayi vīkṣya vīkṣya te vadanābjaṁ śanakair-gṛhaṁ gatāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/060_dasakam_60_gopi_v.karuṇāśiśiro hare hara tvarayā me sakalā: karuṇā-śiśiro hare hara tvarayā me sakalāmayāvalim||

vishnu/narayaniyam/061_dasakam_61_dvijap.tataśca vṛndāvanato'tidūrato vanaṁ gatas: tataś-ca vṛndāvanato'tidūrato vanaṁ gatas-tvaṁ khalu gopa-gokulaiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/061_dasakam_61_dvijap.iti smitārdraṁ bhavateritā gatāste dārak: iti smitārdraṁ bhavateritā gatās-te dārakā dāra-janaṁ yayācire||
vishnu/narayaniyam/061_dasakam_61_dvijap.gṛhītanāmni tvayi sambhramākulāścaturvid: gṛhīta-nāmni tvayi sambhramākulāś-caturvidhaṁ bhojya-rasaṁ pragṛhya tāḥ|

vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.vijānannapyetān vinayamṛdu nandādipaśupā: vijānann-apy-etān vinaya-mṛdu nandādi-paśupān-apṛcchaḥ ko vāyaṁ janaka bhavatām-udyama iti||
vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.babhāṣe nandastvāṁ suta nanu vidheyo mag: babhāṣe nandas-tvāṁ suta nanu vidheyo maghavato
vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.iti śrutvā vācaṁ piturayi bhavānāha sara: iti śrutvā vācaṁ pitur-ayi bhavān-āha sarasaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.idaṁ tāvat satyaṁ yadiha paśavo naḥ kula: idaṁ tāvat satyaṁ yadiha paśavo naḥ kula-dhanaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.avocaścaivaṁ tān kimiha vitathaṁ me niga: avocaś-caivaṁ tān kimiha vitathaṁ me nigaditaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.ayaṁ gotro gotradviṣi ca kupite rakṣitum: ayaṁ gotro gotra-dviṣi ca kupite rakṣitum-alaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.pravṛttastvāṁ jetuṁ sa kila maghavā durm: pravṛttas-tvāṁ jetuṁ sa kila maghavā durmada-nidhiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.surendraḥ kruddhaśced dvijakaruṇayā śail: surendraḥ kruddhaś-ced dvija-karuṇayā śaila-kṛpayāpy-anātaṅko'smākaṁ niyata iti viśvāsya paśupān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/062_dasakam_62_indray.aho kiṁ nāyāto giribhiditi sañcintya niv: aho kiṁ nāyāto giribhid-iti sañcintya nivasan

vishnu/narayaniyam/063_dasakam_63_govard.kula iha khalu gotro daivataṁ gotraśatro: kula iha khalu gotro daivataṁ gotra-śatror-vihatim-iha sa rundhyāt ko nu vaḥ saṁśayo'smin|

vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.upetya tuṣṭāva sa naṣṭagarvaḥ spṛṣṭvā pa: upetya tuṣṭāva sa naṣṭa-garvaḥ spṛṣṭvā padābjaṁ maṇi-maulinā te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.jagattrayeśe tvayi gokuleśe tathābhiṣikt: jagat-trayeśe tvayi gokuleśe tathābhiṣikte sati gopa-vāṭaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.nāke'pi vaikuṇṭhapade'pyalabhyāṁ śriyaṁ: nāke'pi vaikuṇṭha-pade'py-alabhyāṁ śriyaṁ prapede bhavataḥ prabhāvāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.nītastamānetumagāḥ purīṁ tvaṁ tāṁ vāruṇī: nītas-tam-ānetum-agāḥ purīṁ tvaṁ tāṁ vāruṇīṁ kāraṇa-martya-rūpaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.sasambhramaṁ tena jalādhipena prapūjitas: sasambhramaṁ tena jalādhipena prapūjitas-tvaṁ pratigṛhya tātam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.nirīkṣya viṣṇo paramaṁ padaṁ tad durāpam: nirīkṣya viṣṇo paramaṁ padaṁ tad durāpam-anyais-tvam-adīdṛśas-tān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.ciraṁ nimagnāḥ khalu gopasaṅghāstvayaiva: ciraṁ nimagnāḥ khalu gopa-saṅghās-tvayaiva bhūman punar-uddhṛtās-te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.tadiha paśuparūpī tvaṁ hi sākṣāt parātmā: tadiha paśupa-rūpī tvaṁ hi sākṣāt parātmā
vishnu/narayaniyam/064_dasakam_64_govind.|| iti govindābhiṣekavarṇanaṁ nandānayan: || iti govindābhiṣeka-varṇanaṁ nandānayana-varṇanaṁ ca catuḥṣaṣṭitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/065_dasakam_65_gopi_s.tvāmāgatā nanu tathaiva vibhūṣitābhyastā: tvām-āgatā nanu tathaiva vibhūṣitābhyas-tā eva saṁrurucire tava locanāya||
vishnu/narayaniyam/065_dasakam_65_gopi_s.kāñcīṁ ca kaṇṭhabhuvi deva samāgatā tvām: kāñcīṁ ca kaṇṭha-bhuvi deva samāgatā tvām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/065_dasakam_65_gopi_s.kāścid gṛhāt kila niretumapārayantyastvā: kāścid gṛhāt kila niretum-apārayantyas-tvām-eva deva hṛdaye sudṛḍhaṁ vibhāvya|

vishnu/narayaniyam/066_dasakam_66_dharmo.abhivāñchitaṁ vidhātuṁ kṛtamatirapi tā j: abhivāñchitaṁ vidhātuṁ kṛta-matir-api tā jagātha vāmam-iva||
vishnu/narayaniyam/066_dasakam_66_dharmo.ākarṇya te pratīpāṁ vāṇīmeṇīdṛśaḥ paraṁ: ākarṇya te pratīpāṁ vāṇīm-eṇī-dṛśaḥ paraṁ dīnāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/066_dasakam_66_dharmo.|| iti rāsakrīḍāyāṁ dharmopadeśavarṇanaṁ: || iti rāsa-krīḍāyāṁ dharmopadeśa-varṇanaṁ krīḍā-varṇanaṁ ca ṣaṭṣaṣṭitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.bhavānupādāya gato vidūraṁ tayā saha sva: bhavān-upādāya gato vidūraṁ tayā saha svaira-vihāra-kārī||
vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.tirohite'tha tvayi jātatāpāḥ samaṁ samet: tirohite'tha tvayi jāta-tāpāḥ samaṁ sametāḥ kamalāyatākṣyaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.hā cūta hā campaka karṇikāra hā mallike: hā cūta hā campaka karṇikāra hā mallike mālati bāla-valyaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.kiṁ vīkṣito no hṛdayaikacaura ityādi tās: kiṁ vīkṣito no hṛdayaika-caura ityādi tās-tvat-pravaṇā vilepuḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.tvāṁ bhāvanācakṣuṣi vīkṣya kācittāpaṁ sa: tvāṁ bhāvanā-cakṣuṣi vīkṣya kācit-tāpaṁ sakhīnāṁ dviguṇīcakāra||
vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.vicitya bhūyo'pi tathaiva mānāttvayā viy: vicitya bhūyo'pi tathaiva mānāt-tvayā viyuktāṁ dadṛśuś-ca rādhām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.tataḥ samaṁ tā vipine samantāttamo'vatār: tataḥ samaṁ tā vipine samantāt-tamo'vatārāvadhi mārgayantyaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.sandigdhasandarśanamātmakāntaṁ tvāṁ vīkṣ: sandigdha-sandarśanam-ātma-kāntaṁ tvāṁ vīkṣya tanvyaḥ sahasā tadānīm|
vishnu/narayaniyam/067_dasakam_67_tirobh.|| iti rāsakrīḍāyāṁ bhagavatastirobhāvav: || iti rāsa-krīḍāyāṁ bhagavatas-tirobhāva-varṇanaṁ bhagavad-anveṣaṇa-varṇanaṁ bhagavad-āvirbhāva-varṇanaṁ ca saptaṣaṣṭitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.tadanu kācana tvatkarāmbujaṁ sapadi gṛhṇ: tadanu kācana tvat-karāmbujaṁ sapadi gṛhṇatī nirviśaṅkitam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.ghanapayodhare saṁnidhāya sā pulakasaṁvṛ: ghana-payodhare saṁnidhāya sā pulaka-saṁvṛtā tasthuṣī ciram||
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.tava vibho parā komalaṁ bhujaṁ nijagalān: tava vibho parā komalaṁ bhujaṁ nija-galāntare paryaveṣṭayat|
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.apagatatrapā kāpi kāminī tava mukhāmbujā: apagata-trapā kāpi kāminī tava mukhāmbujāt pūga-carvitam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.pratigṛhayya tad vaktrapaṅkaje nidadhatī: pratigṛhayya tad vaktra-paṅkaje nidadhatī gatā pūrṇa-kāmatām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.vikaruṇo vane saṁvihāya māmapagato'si kā: vikaruṇo vane saṁvihāya mām-apagato'si kā tvām-iha spṛśet|
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.iti saroṣayā tāvadekayā sajalalocanaṁ vī: iti saroṣayā tāvad-ekayā sajala-locanaṁ vīkṣito bhavān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.katividhā kṛpā ke'pi sarvato dhṛtadayoda: katividhā kṛpā ke'pi sarvato dhṛta-dayodayāḥ kecid-āśrite|
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.ayi kumārikā naiva śaṅkyatāṁ kaṭhinatā m: ayi kumārikā naiva śaṅkyatāṁ kaṭhinatā mayi prema-kātare|
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.mayi tu cetaso vo'nuvṛttaye kṛtamidaṁ ma: mayi tu cetaso vo'nuvṛttaye kṛtam-idaṁ mayety-ūcivān bhavān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.ayi niśamyatāṁ jīvavallabhāḥ priyatamo j: ayi niśamyatāṁ jīva-vallabhāḥ priyatamo jano nedṛśo mama|
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.kalitakautuko rāsakhelane gurupurīpate p: kalita-kautuko rāsa-khelane guru-purī-pate pāhi māṁ gadāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/068_dasakam_68_ananda.|| iti rāsakrīḍāyām ānandapāravaśyavarṇa: || iti rāsa-krīḍāyām ānanda-pāravaśya-varṇanaṁ praṇaya-kopa-varṇanaṁ bhagavat-kṛta-sāntvanā-varṇanaṁ ca aṣṭaṣaṣṭitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/069_dasakam_69_rasa_k.nāvidannapi ca nīvikāṁ kimapi kuntalīmap: nāvidann-api ca nīvikāṁ kimapi kuntalīm-api ca kañculīṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/069_dasakam_69_rasa_k.jyotiṣāmapi kadambakaṁ divi vilambitaṁ k: jyotiṣām-api kadambakaṁ divi vilambitaṁ kim-aparaṁ bruve||
vishnu/narayaniyam/069_dasakam_69_rasa_k.modasīmni bhuvanaṁ vilāpya vihṛtiṁ samāp: moda-sīmni bhuvanaṁ vilāpya vihṛtiṁ samāpya ca tato vibho
vishnu/narayaniyam/069_dasakam_69_rasa_k.svairamīśa nanu sūrajāpayasi cārunāma vi: svairam-īśa nanu sūrajā-payasi cāru-nāma vihṛtiṁ vyadhāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/069_dasakam_69_rasa_k.kāminīriti hi yāminīṣu khalu kāmanīyakan: kāminīr-iti hi yāminīṣu khalu kāmanīyaka-nidhe bhavān

vishnu/narayaniyam/070_dasakam_70_sudars.samunmukhamatholmukairabhihate'pi tasmin: samunmukham-atholmukair-abhihate'pi tasmin balād-amuñcati bhavat-pade nyapati pāhi pāhīti taiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/070_dasakam_70_sudars.stuvan nijapadaṁ yayau vrajapadaṁ ca gop: stuvan nija-padaṁ yayau vraja-padaṁ ca gopā mudā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/070_dasakam_70_sudars.kadāpi khalu sīriṇā viharati tvayi strīj: kadāpi khalu sīriṇā viharati tvayi strī-janair-jahāra dhanadānugaḥ sa kila śaṅkhacūḍo'balāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/070_dasakam_70_sudars.dineṣu ca suhṛjjanaiḥ saha vaneṣu līlāpa: dineṣu ca suhṛjjanaiḥ saha vaneṣu līlā-paraṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/070_dasakam_70_sudars.paṅktimāśu parighūrṇya paśūnāṁ chandasāṁ: paṅktim-āśu parighūrṇya paśūnāṁ chandasāṁ nidhim-avāpa bhavantam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/070_dasakam_70_sudars.vardhate ca vṛṣacetasi bhūyān moda ityab: vardhate ca vṛṣa-cetasi bhūyān moda ity-abhinuto'si surais-tvam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/070_dasakam_70_sudars.|| iti sudarśanaśāpamokṣavarṇanaṁ śaṅkha: || iti sudarśana-śāpa-mokṣa-varṇanaṁ śaṅkhacūḍa-vadha-varṇanaṁ vṛṣabhāsura-vadha-varṇanaṁ ca saptatitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.yatneṣu sarveṣvapi nāvakeśī keśī sa bhoj: yatneṣu sarveṣv-api nāvakeśī keśī sa bhojeśitur-iṣṭa-bandhuḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.tvaṁ sindhujāvāpya itīva matvā samprāpta: tvaṁ sindhujāvāpya itīva matvā samprāptavān sindhuja-vāji-rūpaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.bhavadvilokāvadhi gopavāṭīṁ pramardya pā: bhavad-vilokāvadhi gopa-vāṭīṁ pramardya pāpaḥ punar-āpatat tvām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.tārkṣyārpitāṅghrestava tārkṣya eṣa cikṣe: tārkṣyārpitāṅghres-tava tārkṣya eṣa cikṣepa vakṣo-bhuvi nāma pādam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.bhṛgoḥ padāghātakathāṁ niśamya svenāpi ś: bhṛgoḥ padāghāta-kathāṁ niśamya svenāpi śakyaṁ tad-itīva mohāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.pravañccayannasya khurāñccalaṁ drāgamuṁ: pravañccayann-asya khurāñccalaṁ drāg-amuṁ ca cikṣepitha dūra-dūram|
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.tvaṁ vāhadaṇḍe kṛtadhīśca bāhādaṇḍaṁ nya: tvaṁ vāha-daṇḍe kṛta-dhīś-ca bāhā-daṇḍaṁ nyadhās-tasya mukhe tadānīm|
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.ālambhamātreṇa paśoḥ surāṇāṁ prasādake n: ālambha-mātreṇa paśoḥ surāṇāṁ prasādake nūtna ivāśvamedhe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.kṛte tvayā harṣavaśāt surendrāstvāṁ tuṣṭ: kṛte tvayā harṣa-vaśāt surendrās-tvāṁ tuṣṭuvuḥ keśava-nāmadheyam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.kaṁsāya te śaurisutatvamuktvā taṁ tadvad: kaṁsāya te śauri-sutatvam-uktvā taṁ tad-vadhotkaṁ pratirudhya vācā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.kadāpi gopaiḥ saha kānanānte nilāyanakrī: kadāpi gopaiḥ saha kānanānte nilāyana-krīḍana-lolupaṁ tvām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.guhāsu kṛtvā pidadhe śilābhistvayā ca bu: guhāsu kṛtvā pidadhe śilābhis-tvayā ca buddhvā parimarddito'bhūt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.pade pade nūtanayannasīmāṁ parātmarūpin: pade pade nūtanayann-asīmāṁ parātma-rūpin pavaneśa pāyāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/071_dasakam_71_keshi_.|| iti keśimathanavarṇanaṁ vyomavadhavar: || iti keśi-mathana-varṇanaṁ vyoma-vadha-varṇanaṁ ca ekasaptatitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/072_dasakam_72_akrura.kaṁso'tha nāradagirā vrajavāsinaṁ tvāmāk: kaṁso'tha nārada-girā vraja-vāsinaṁ tvām-ākarṇya dīrṇa-hṛdayaḥ sa hi gāndineyam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/072_dasakam_72_akrura.kiṁ vakṣyate sa khalu māṁ kva nu vīkṣita: kiṁ vakṣyate sa khalu māṁ kva nu vīkṣitaḥ syād-itthaṁ nināya sa bhavan-mayam-eva mārgam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/072_dasakam_72_akrura.kiṁ brūmahe bahujanā hi tadāpi jātā: kiṁ brūmahe bahu-janā hi tadāpi jātā
vishnu/narayaniyam/072_dasakam_72_akrura.dhūrto vilambata iti pramadābhiruccairāś: dhūrto vilambata iti pramadābhir-uccair-āśaṅkito niśi marutpura-nātha pāyāḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.kimidaṁ kimidaṁ kathaṁ nvitīmāḥ samavetā: kim-idaṁ kim-idaṁ kathaṁ nvitīmāḥ samavetāḥ paridevitāny-akurvan||
vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.bata naḥ kimu daivamevamāsīditi tāstvadg: bata naḥ kimu daivam-evam-āsīd-iti tās-tvad-gata-mānasā vilepuḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.acirādupayāmi saṁnidhiṁ vo bhavitā sādhu: acirād-upayāmi saṁnidhiṁ vo bhavitā sādhu mayaiva saṅgamaśrīḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.niyamāya nimajjya vāriṇi tvāmabhivīkṣyāt: niyamāya nimajjya vāriṇi tvām-abhivīkṣyātha rathe'pi gāndineyaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.vivaśo'jani kiṁ nvidaṁ vibhoste nanu cit: vivaśo'jani kiṁ nvidaṁ vibhos-te nanu citraṁ tv-avalokanaṁ samantāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.punareṣa nimajjya puṇyaśālī puruṣaṁ tvāṁ: punar-eṣa nimajjya puṇya-śālī puruṣaṁ tvāṁ paramaṁ bhujaṅga-bhoge|
vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.sa tadā paramātmasaukhyasindhau vinimagn: sa tadā paramātma-saukhya-sindhau vinimagnaḥ praṇuvan prakāra-bhedaiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.avilokya punaśca harṣasindhoranuvṛttyā p: avilokya punaś-ca harṣa-sindhor-anuvṛttyā pulakāvṛto yayau tvām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/073_dasakam_73_mathur.atiharṣaniruttareṇa sārdhaṁ rathavāsī pa: atiharṣa-niruttareṇa sārdhaṁ ratha-vāsī pavaneśa pāhi māṁ tvam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.samprāpto mathurāṁ dinārdhavigame tatrān: samprāpto mathurāṁ dinārdha-vigame tatrāntarasmin vasann-ārāme vihitāśanaḥ sakhi-janair-yātaḥ purīm-īkṣitum|
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.tāsāmākalayannapāṅgavalanairmodaṁ prahar: tāsām-ākalayann-apāṅga-valanair-modaṁ praharṣādbhuta-vyāloleṣu janeṣu tatra rajakaṁ kaṁcit paṭīṁ prārthayan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.sadyastasya kareṇa śīrṣamahṛthāḥ so'pyāp: sadyas-tasya kareṇa śīrṣam-ahṛthāḥ so'py-āpa puṇyāṁ gatim||
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.dāśvāṁsaṁ svapadaṁ ninetha sukṛtaṁ ko ve: dāśvāṁsaṁ sva-padaṁ ninetha sukṛtaṁ ko veda jīvātmanām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.bhaktiṁ tena vṛtāṁ dideśitha parāṁ lakṣm: bhaktiṁ tena vṛtāṁ dideśitha parāṁ lakṣmīṁ ca lakṣmī-pate||
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.gṛhṇānaḥ kusumāni kiṁcana tadā mārge nib: gṛhṇānaḥ kusumāni kiṁcana tadā mārge nibaddhāñjalinātiṣṭhaṁ bata hā yato'dya vipulām-ārtiṁ vrajāmi prabho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.mādhuryeṇa nu tejasā nu puruṣairdūreṇa d: mādhuryeṇa nu tejasā nu puruṣair-dūreṇa dattāntaraḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.śiṣṭairduṣṭajanaiśca dṛṣṭamahimā prītyā: śiṣṭair-duṣṭa-janaiś-ca dṛṣṭa-mahimā prītyā ca bhītyā tataḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.sampaśyan purasampadaṁ pravicaran sāyaṁ: sampaśyan pura-sampadaṁ pravicaran sāyaṁ gato vāṭikām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/074_dasakam_74_mathur.śrīdāmnā saha rādhikāvirahajaṁ khedaṁ va: śrīdāmnā saha rādhikā-viraha-jaṁ khedaṁ vadan prasvapann-ānandann-avatāra-kārya-ghaṭanād vāteśa saṁrakṣa mām||

vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.saṅghe rājñāṁ ca mañcānabhiyayuṣi gate n: saṅghe rājñāṁ ca mañcān-abhiyayuṣi gate nandagope'pi harmyam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.pāpiṣṭhāpehi mārgād drutamiti vacasā niṣ: pāpiṣṭhāpehi mārgād drutam-iti vacasā niṣṭhura-kruddha-buddher-ambaṣṭhasya praṇodād-adhika-java-juṣā hastinā gṛhyamāṇaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.no no dhanyekṣaṇāḥ smastrijagati vayamev: no no dhanyekṣaṇāḥ smas-tri-jagati vayam-eveti sarve śaśaṁsuḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.tvāṁ rāmaṁ cābhipede jhaṭajhaṭiti mitho: tvāṁ rāmaṁ cābhipede jhaṭajhaṭiti mitho muṣṭi-pātātirūkṣam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.hā dhik kaṣṭaṁ kumārau sulalitavapuṣau m: hā dhik kaṣṭaṁ kumārau sulalita-vapuṣau malla-vīrau kaṭhorau
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.na drakṣyāmo vrajāmastvaritamiti jane bh: na drakṣyāmo vrajāmas-tvaritam-iti jane bhāṣamāṇe tadānīm|
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.kaṁsaḥ saṁvārya tūryaṁ khalamatiravidan: kaṁsaḥ saṁvārya tūryaṁ khala-matir-avidan kāryam-āryān pitṛṁs-tān-āhantuṁ vyāpta-mūrtes-tava ca samaśiṣad dūram-utsāraṇāya|
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.ruṣṭo duṣṭoktibhistvaṁ garuḍa iva giriṁ: ruṣṭo duṣṭoktibhis-tvaṁ garuḍa iva giriṁ mañcamañcannudañcatkhaḍgavyāvalgadussaṁgrahamapi ca haṭhāt prāgrahīr-augrasenim||
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.tvayyāpātye tadaiva tvadupari patitā nāk: tvayy-āpātye tadaiva tvad-upari patitā nākināṁ puṣpa-vṛṣṭiḥ|
