vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.kiṁ kiṁ brūmastadānīṁ satatamapi bhiyā t: kiṁ kiṁ brūmas-tadānīṁ satatam-api bhiyā tvad-gatātmā sa bheje
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.sāyujyaṁ tvadvadhotthā parama paramiyaṁ: sāyujyaṁ tvad-vadhotthā parama param-iyaṁ vāsanā kālanemeḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/075_dasakam_75_kamsa_.labdhvā tuṣṭo nagaryāṁ pavanapurapate ru: labdhvā tuṣṭo nagaryāṁ pavana-pura-pate rundhi me sarva-rogān||

vishnu/narayaniyam/076_dasakam_76_uddhav.śrīman kiṁ tvaṁ pitṛjanakṛte preṣito nir: śrīman kiṁ tvaṁ pitṛ-jana-kṛte preṣito nirdayena
vishnu/narayaniyam/076_dasakam_76_uddhav.kvāsau kānto nagarasudṛśāṁ hā hare nātha: kvāsau kānto nagara-sudṛśāṁ hā hare nātha pāyāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/076_dasakam_76_uddhav.āśleṣāṇāmamṛtavapuṣo hanta te cumbanānām: āśleṣāṇām-amṛta-vapuṣo hanta te cumbanānām-unmādānāṁ kuhaka-vacasāṁ vismaret kānta kā vā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/076_dasakam_76_uddhav.tvaṁ kiṁ maunaṁ kalayasi sakhe māninī ma: tvaṁ kiṁ maunaṁ kalayasi sakhe māninī mat-priyeva|
vishnu/narayaniyam/076_dasakam_76_uddhav.ityādyeva pravadati sakhi tvatpriyo nirj: ity-ādy-eva pravadati sakhi tvat-priyo nirjane mām-itthaṁ-vādair-aramayad-ayaṁ tvat-priyām-utpalākṣīm||
vishnu/narayaniyam/076_dasakam_76_uddhav.brahmānande milati nacirāt saṅgamo vā vi: brahmānande milati nacirāt saṅgamo vā viyogas-tulyo vaḥ syād-iti tava girā so'karon-nirvyathās-tāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/076_dasakam_76_uddhav.evaṁ bhaktiḥ sakalabhuvane nekṣitā na śr: evaṁ bhaktiḥ sakala-bhuvane nekṣitā na śrutā vā

vishnu/narayaniyam/077_dasakam_77_upashl.tato bhavān deva niśāsu kāsucinmṛgīdṛśaṁ: tato bhavān deva niśāsu kāsucin-mṛgīdṛśaṁ tāṁ nibhṛtaṁ vinodayan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/077_dasakam_77_upashl.akrūramandiramito'tha baloddhavābhyāmabh: akrūra-mandiram-ito'tha baloddhavābhyām-abhyarcito bahu nuto muditena tena|
vishnu/narayaniyam/077_dasakam_77_upashl.enaṁ visṛjya vipināgatapāṇḍaveyavṛttaṁ v: enaṁ visṛjya vipināgata-pāṇḍaveya-vṛttaṁ viveditha tathā dhṛtarāṣṭra-ceṣṭām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/077_dasakam_77_upashl.padbhyāṁ tvaṁ padmamālī cakita iva purān: padbhyāṁ tvaṁ padma-mālī cakita iva purān-nirgato dhāvamāno
vishnu/narayaniyam/077_dasakam_77_upashl.hā deveti stuvantaṁ varavitatiṣu taṁ niḥ: hā deveti stuvantaṁ vara-vitatiṣu taṁ niḥspṛhaṁ vīkṣya hṛṣyan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/077_dasakam_77_upashl.muktestulyāṁ ca bhaktiṁ dhutasakalamalāṁ: muktes-tulyāṁ ca bhaktiṁ dhuta-sakala-malāṁ mokṣam-apy-āśu dattvā
vishnu/narayaniyam/077_dasakam_77_upashl.kāryaṁ hiṁsāviśuddhyai tapa iti ca tadā: kāryaṁ hiṁsā-viśuddhyai tapa iti ca tadā prāttha loka-pratītyai||
vishnu/narayaniyam/077_dasakam_77_upashl.|| iti upaślokotpattivarṇanaṁ jarāsaṁdhā: || iti upaślokotpatti-varṇanaṁ jarāsaṁdhādi-yuddha-varṇanaṁ mucukundānugraha-varṇanaṁ ca saptasaptatitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.daduṣi revatabhūbhṛti revatīṁ halabhṛte: daduṣi revata-bhūbhṛti revatīṁ hala-bhṛte tanayāṁ vidhi-śāsanāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.atha vidarbhasutāṁ khalu rukmiṇīṁ praṇay: atha vidarbha-sutāṁ khalu rukmiṇīṁ praṇayinīṁ tvayi deva sahodaraḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.dvijasuto'pi ca tūrṇamupāyayau tava pura: dvija-suto'pi ca tūrṇam-upāyayau tava puraṁ hi durāśa-durāsadam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.mudamavāpa ca sādarapūjitaḥ sa bhavatā b: mudam-avāpa ca sādara-pūjitaḥ sa bhavatā bhava-tāpa-hṛtā svayam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.sa ca bhavantamavocata kuṇḍine nṛpasutā: sa ca bhavantam-avocata kuṇḍine nṛpa-sutā khalu rājati rukmiṇī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.tvayi samutsukayā nijadhīratārahitayā hi: tvayi samutsukayā nija-dhīratā-rahitayā hi tayā prahito'smy-aham||
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.tava hṛtāsmi puraiva guṇairahaṁ harati m: tava hṛtāsmi puraiva guṇair-ahaṁ harati māṁ kila cedi-nṛpo'dhunā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.ayi kṛpālaya pālaya māmiti prajagade jag: ayi kṛpālaya pālaya māmiti prajagade jagad-eka-pate tayā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.aśaraṇāṁ yadi māṁ tvamupekṣase sapadi jī: aśaraṇāṁ yadi māṁ tvam-upekṣase sapadi jīvitam-eva jahāmy-aham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.iti girā sutanoratanod bhṛśaṁ suhṛdayaṁ: iti girā sutanor-atanod bhṛśaṁ suhṛdayaṁ hṛdayaṁ tava kātaram||
vishnu/narayaniyam/078_dasakam_78_rukmin.pramuditena ca tena samaṁ tadā rathagato: pramuditena ca tena samaṁ tadā ratha-gato laghu kuṇḍinam-eyivān|

vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.dvijasutaṁ tvadupāgamavādinaṁ dhṛtarasā: dvija-sutaṁ tvad-upāgama-vādinaṁ dhṛta-rasā tarasā praṇanāma sā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.kulavadhūbhirupetya kumārikā girisutāṁ p: kula-vadhūbhir-upetya kumārikā giri-sutāṁ paripūjya ca sādaram|
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.muhurayācata tatpadapaṅkaje nipatitā pat: muhur-ayācata tat-pada-paṅkaje nipatitā patitāṁ tava kevalam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.samavalokya kutūhalasaṁkule nṛpakule nib: samavalokya kutūhala-saṁkule nṛpa-kule nibhṛtaṁ tvayi ca sthite|
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.tvamapi deva kaṭākṣavimokṣaṇaiḥ pramaday: tvam-api deva kaṭākṣa-vimokṣaṇaiḥ pramadayā madayāñcakṛṣe manāk||
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.kva nu gamiṣyasi candramukhīti tāṁ saras: kva nu gamiṣyasi candra-mukhīti tāṁ sarasam-etya kareṇa haran kṣaṇāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.samadhiropya rathaṁ tvamapāhṛthā bhuvi t: samadhiropya rathaṁ tvam-apāhṛthā bhuvi tato vitato ninado dviṣām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.kva nu gataḥ paśupāla iti krudhā kṛtaraṇ: kva nu gataḥ paśupāla iti krudhā kṛta-raṇā yadubhiś-ca jitā nṛpāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.na tu bhavānudacālyata tairaho piśunakai: na tu bhavān-udacālyata tair-aho piśunakaiḥ śunakair-iva kesarī||
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.hatamadaṁ parimucya baloktibhiḥ puramayā: hata-madaṁ parimucya baloktibhiḥ puram-ayā ramayā saha kāntayā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.aramayaḥ khalu nātha yathāsukhaṁ rahasi: aramayaḥ khalu nātha yathāsukhaṁ rahasi tāṁ hasitāṁśu-lasan-mukhīm||
vishnu/narayaniyam/079_dasakam_79_rukmin.ayi mukunda bhavaccaritāni naḥ pragadatā: ayi mukunda bhavac-caritāni naḥ pragadatāṁ gada-tāntim-apākuru||

vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.kapīndrastaṁ hatvā maṇimapi ca bālāya da: kapīndras-taṁ hatvā maṇim-api ca bālāya dadivān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.prasenaṁ taṁ dṛṣṭvā harimapi gato'bhūḥ k: prasenaṁ taṁ dṛṣṭvā harim-api gato'bhūḥ kapi-guhām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.mukundaśaraṇaṁ hi māṁ ka iha roddhumityā: mukunda-śaraṇaṁ hi māṁ ka iha roddhum-ity-ālapan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.vibho raghupate hare jaya jayetyalaṁ muṣ: vibho raghu-pate hare jaya jayety-alaṁ muṣṭibhiś-ciraṁ tava samarcanaṁ vyadhita bhakta-cūḍāmaṇiḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.buddhvātha tena dattāṁ navaramaṇīṁ varam: buddhvātha tena dattāṁ nava-ramaṇīṁ vara-maṇiṁ ca parigṛhṇan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.anugṛhṇannamumāgāḥ sapadi ca satrājite m: anugṛhṇann-amum-āgāḥ sapadi ca satrājite maṇiṁ prādāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.adita maṇinā tubhyaṁ labhyaṁ sametya bha: adita maṇinā tubhyaṁ labhyaṁ sametya bhavān-api
vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.bhaktastvayi sthirataraḥ sa hi gāndineya: bhaktas-tvayi sthirataraḥ sa hi gāndineyas-tasyaiva kāpatha-matiḥ katham-īśa jātā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/080_dasakam_80_syaman.yātaṁ bhayena kṛtavarmayutaṁ punastamāhū: yātaṁ bhayena kṛtavarma-yutaṁ punas-tam-āhūya tad-vinihitaṁ ca maṇiṁ prakāśya|

vishnu/narayaniyam/081_dasakam_81_subhad.snigdhāṁ mugdhāṁ satatamapi tāṁ lālayan: snigdhāṁ mugdhāṁ satatam-api tāṁ lālayan satyabhāmāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/081_dasakam_81_subhad.yāto bhūyaḥ saha khalu tayā yājñasenīviv: yāto bhūyaḥ saha khalu tayā yājñasenī-vivāham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/081_dasakam_81_subhad.bhadrāṁ nāma pradaduratha te deva saṁtar: bhadrāṁ nāma pradadur-atha te deva saṁtardanādyās-tat-sodaryāṁ varada bhavataḥ sāpi paitṛṣvaseyī||
vishnu/narayaniyam/081_dasakam_81_subhad.sa cakre cakreṇa pradalitaśirā maṅkṣu bh: sa cakre cakreṇa pradalita-śirā maṅkṣu bhavatā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/081_dasakam_81_subhad.sahasrāṇi strīṇāmapi ca dhanarāśiṁ ca vi: sahasrāṇi strīṇām-api ca dhana-rāśiṁ ca vipulam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/081_dasakam_81_subhad.hṛtvā kalpataruṁ ruṣābhipatitaṁ jitvendr: hṛtvā kalpataruṁ ruṣābhipatitaṁ jitvendram-abhyāgamas-tat-tu śrīmadadoṣa īdṛśa iti vyākhyātum-evākṛthāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/081_dasakam_81_subhad.|| iti subhadrāharaṇaṁ kālindyādivivāhav: || iti subhadrā-haraṇaṁ kālindyādi-vivāha-varṇanaṁ narakāsura-vadha-varṇanaṁ ca ekāśītitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.pradyumno raukmiṇeyaḥ sa khalu tava kalā: pradyumno raukmiṇeyaḥ sa khalu tava kalā śambareṇāhṛtas-taṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.hatvā ratyā sahāpto nijapuramaharad rukm: hatvā ratyā sahāpto nija-puram-aharad rukmi-kanyāṁ ca dhanyām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.tatrodvāhe gatastvaṁ nyavadhi musalinā r: tatrodvāhe gatas-tvaṁ nyavadhi musalinā rukmy-api dyūta-vairāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.bāṇasya sā balisutasya sahasrabāhormāheś: bāṇasya sā bali-sutasya sahasra-bāhor-māheśvarasya mahitā duhitā kiloṣā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.tatrāniruddhamuṣayā viditaṁ niśāyāmāneṣṭ: tatrāniruddham-uṣayā viditaṁ niśāyām-āneṣṭa yoga-balato bhavato niketāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.sa kumbhāṇḍo bhāṇḍaṁ navamiva balenāśu b: sa kumbhāṇḍo bhāṇḍaṁ navam-iva balenāśu bibhide||
vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.jñānī stutvātha dattvā tava caritajuṣāṁ: jñānī stutvātha dattvā tava carita-juṣāṁ vijvaraṁ sa jvaro'gāt
vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.prāyo'ntarjñānavanto'pi ca bahutamasā ra: prāyo'ntar-jñānavanto'pi ca bahu-tamasā raudra-ceṣṭā hi raudrāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/082_dasakam_82_bana_y.|| iti bāṇayuddhaṁ nṛgamokṣaṁ ca dvyaśīt: || iti bāṇa-yuddhaṁ nṛga-mokṣaṁ ca dvyaśītitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/083_dasakam_83_paundr.kṛtyānalaṁ kamapi bāṇaraṇātibhītairbhūta: kṛtyānalaṁ kamapi bāṇa-raṇātibhītair-bhūtaiḥ kathaṁcana vṛtaiḥ samam-abhyamuñcat||
vishnu/narayaniyam/083_dasakam_83_paundr.sa khalu dvivido rakṣoghāte kṛtopakṛtiḥ: sa khalu dvivido rakṣo-ghāte kṛtopakṛtiḥ purā
vishnu/narayaniyam/083_dasakam_83_paundr.te ghātyāḥ pāṇḍaveyairiti yadupṛtanāṁ nā: te ghātyāḥ pāṇḍaveyair-iti yadu-pṛtanāṁ nāmucas-tvaṁ tadānīṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/083_dasakam_83_paundr.taṁ tvāṁ durbodhalīlaṁ pavanapurapate tā: taṁ tvāṁ durbodha-līlaṁ pavana-pura-pate tāpa-śāntyai niṣeve||
vishnu/narayaniyam/083_dasakam_83_paundr.|| iti pauṇḍrakavadhavarṇanaṁ kāśīpurīdā: || iti pauṇḍraka-vadha-varṇanaṁ kāśī-purī-dāha-varṇanaṁ dvivida-vadha-varṇanaṁ lakṣmaṇā-svayaṁvaraṁ ca tryaśītitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/084_dasakam_84_samant.tava khalu dayitājanaiḥ sametā drupadasu: tava khalu dayitā-janaiḥ sametā drupada-sutā tvayi gāḍha-bhakti-bhārā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/084_dasakam_84_samant.tadanu ca bhagavan nirīkṣya gopānatikutu: tadanu ca bhagavan nirīkṣya gopān-atikutukād-upagamya mānayitvā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/084_dasakam_84_samant.iti kṛtaparirambhaṇe tvayi drāgativivaśā: iti kṛta-parirambhaṇe tvayi drāg-ativivaśā khalu rādhikā nililye||
vishnu/narayaniyam/084_dasakam_84_samant.apagatavirahavyathāstadā tā rahasi vidhā: apagata-viraha-vyathās-tadā tā rahasi vidhāya dadātha tattva-bodham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/084_dasakam_84_samant.samabhavadamutaḥ paraṁ tu tāsāṁ paramasu: samabhavad-amutaḥ paraṁ tu tāsāṁ parama-sukhaikyamayī bhavaddvicintā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/084_dasakam_84_samant.sumahati yajane vitāyamāne pramuditamitr: sumahati yajane vitāyamāne pramudita-mitra-jane sahaiva gopāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/084_dasakam_84_samant.vyapagamasamaye sametya rādhāṁ dṛḍhamupa: vyapagama-samaye sametya rādhāṁ dṛḍham-upagūhya nirīkṣya vīta-khedām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/084_dasakam_84_samant.pramuditahṛdayaḥ puraṁ prayātaḥ pavanapu: pramudita-hṛdayaḥ puraṁ prayātaḥ pavana-pureśvara pāhi māṁ gadebhyaḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.anāthaśaraṇāya te kamapi pūruṣaṁ prāhiṇo: anātha-śaraṇāya te kamapi pūruṣaṁ prāhiṇod-ayācata sa māgadha-kṣapaṇam-eva kiṁ bhūyasā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.nirīkṣya saha jiṣṇunā tvamapi rājayuddhv: nirīkṣya saha jiṣṇunā tvam-api rājayuddhvā sthitaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.nivārya nijapakṣagānabhimukhasya vidveṣi: nivārya nija-pakṣagān-abhimukhasya vidveṣiṇas-tvam-eva jahṛṣe śiro danuja-dāriṇā svāriṇā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.janustritayalabdhayā satatacintayā śuddh: janus-tritaya-labdhayā satata-cintayā śuddha-dhīs-tvayā sa param-ekatām-adhṛta yogināṁ durlabhām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.tataḥ sumahite tvayā kratuvare nirūḍhe j: tataḥ sumahite tvayā kratu-vare nirūḍhe jano
vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.yayau jayati dharmajo jayati kṛṣṇa ityāl: yayau jayati dharmajo jayati kṛṣṇa ity-ālapan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.khalaḥ sa tu suyodhano dhutamanāḥ sapatn: khalaḥ sa tu suyodhano dhuta-manāḥ sapatna-śriyā
vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.tadā hasitamutthitaṁ drupadanandanābhīma: tadā hasitam-utthitaṁ drupada-nandanā-bhīmayor-apāṅga-kalayā vibho kimapi tāvad-ujjṛmbhayan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/085_dasakam_85_jarasa.|| iti jarāsaṁdhavadhavarṇanaṁ rājasūyav: || iti jarāsaṁdha-vadha-varṇanaṁ rājasūya-varṇanaṁ ca pañcāśītitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.vindan saubhaṁ sa māyī tvayi vasati kurū: vindan saubhaṁ sa māyī tvayi vasati kurūṁs-tvat-purīm-abhyabhāṅkṣīt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.saubheśaṁ taṁ nyarundhāḥ sa ca kila gada: saubheśaṁ taṁ nyarundhāḥ sa ca kila gadayā śārṅgam-abhraṁśayat te|
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.māyātātaṁ vyahiṁsīdapi tava puratastat t: māyā-tātaṁ vyahiṁsīd-api tava puratas-tat tvayāpi kṣaṇārdhaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.kṣiptvā saubhaṁ gadācūrṇitamudakanidhau: kṣiptvā saubhaṁ gadā-cūrṇitam-udaka-nidhau maṅkṣu śālve'pi cakreṇotkṛtte dantavaktraḥ prasabham-abhipatann-abhyamuñcad-gadāṁ te|
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.tvayyāyāte'tha jāte kila kurusadasi dyūt: tvayy-āyāte'tha jāte kila kuru-sadasi dyūtake saṁyatāyāḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.yuddhodyoge'tha mantre milati sati vṛtaḥ: yuddhodyoge'tha mantre milati sati vṛtaḥ phalgunena tvam-ekaḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.bhīṣmadroṇādimānye tava khalu vacane dhi: bhīṣma-droṇādi-mānye tava khalu vacane dhik-kṛte kauraveṇa
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.jiṣṇostvaṁ kṛṣṇa sūtaḥ khalu samaramukhe: jiṣṇos-tvaṁ kṛṣṇa sūtaḥ khalu samara-mukhe bandhu-ghāte dayāluṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.khinnaṁ taṁ vīkṣya vīraṁ kimidamayi sakh: khinnaṁ taṁ vīkṣya vīraṁ kim-idam-ayi sakhe nitya eko'yam-ātmā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.ko vadhyaḥ ko'tra hantā tadiha vadhabhiy: ko vadhyaḥ ko'tra hantā tadiha vadha-bhiyaṁ projjhya mayy-arpitātmā
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.dharmyaṁ yuddhaṁ careti prakṛtimanayathā: dharmyaṁ yuddhaṁ careti prakṛtim-anayathā darśayan viśvarūpam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.nityaṁ nityaṁ vibhindatyavanibhṛdayutaṁ: nityaṁ nityaṁ vibhindaty-avani-bhṛd-ayutaṁ prāpta-sāde ca pārthe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.niśśastratvapratijñāṁ vijahadarivaraṁ dh: niśśastratva-pratijñāṁ vijahad-ari-varaṁ dhārayan krodha-śālīvādhāvan prāñjaliṁ taṁ nata-śirasam-atho vīkṣya modād-apāgāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.tatre tatrāpi pārthaṁ kimiva nahi bhavān: tatre tatrāpi pārthaṁ kimiva nahi bhavān pāṇḍavānām-akārṣīt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.yuddhādau tīrthagāmī sa khalu haladharo: yuddhādau tīrtha-gāmī sa khalu haladharo naimiṣa-kṣetram-ṛcchann-apratyutthāyi sūta-kṣaya-kṛd-atha sutaṁ tat-pade kalpayitvā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.yajñaghnaṁ balvalaṁ parvaṇi paridalayan: yajña-ghnaṁ balvalaṁ parvaṇi paridalayan snāta-tīrtho raṇānte
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.samprāpto bhīmaduryodhanaraṇamaśamaṁ vīk: samprāpto bhīma-duryodhana-raṇam-aśamaṁ vīkṣya yātaḥ purīṁ te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.tanmuktaṁ brāhmamastraṁ samahṛta vijayo: tan-muktaṁ brāhmam-astraṁ samahṛta vijayo mauli-ratnaṁ ca jahe|
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.dharmaughaṁ dharmasūnorabhidadhadakhilaṁ: dharmaughaṁ dharma-sūnor-abhidadhad-akhilaṁ chanda-mṛtyuḥ sa bhīṣmas-tvāṁ paśyan bhakti-bhūmnaiva hi sapadi yayau niṣkala-brahma-bhūyam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.samprāpto dvārakāṁ tvaṁ pavanapurapate p: samprāpto dvārakāṁ tvaṁ pavana-pura-pate pāhi māṁ sarva-rogāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/086_dasakam_86_shalva.|| iti śālvādivadhavarṇanaṁ bhāratayuddh: || iti śālvādi-vadha-varṇanaṁ bhārata-yuddha-varṇanaṁ ca ṣaḍaśītitama-daśakaṁ samāptam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.kucelanāmā bhavataḥ satīrthyatāṁ gataḥ s: kucela-nāmā bhavataḥ satīrthyatāṁ gataḥ sa sāṁdīpani-mandire dvijaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.tvadekarāgeṇa dhanādiniḥspṛho dināni nin: tvad-eka-rāgeṇa dhanādi-niḥspṛho dināni ninye praśamī gṛhāśramī||
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.samānaśīlāpi tadīyavallabhā tathaiva no: samāna-śīlāpi tadīya-vallabhā tathaiva no citta-jayaṁ sameyuṣī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.kadācidūce bata vṛttilabdhaye ramāpatiḥ: kadācid-ūce bata vṛtti-labdhaye ramā-patiḥ kiṁ na sakhā niṣevyate||
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.praviśya vaikuṇṭhamivāpa nirvṛtiṁ tavāti: praviśya vaikuṇṭham-ivāpa nirvṛtiṁ tavātisambhāvanayā tu kiṁ punaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.trapājuṣo'smāt pṛthukaṁ balādatha pragṛh: trapājuṣo'smāt pṛthukaṁ balād-atha pragṛhya muṣṭau sakṛd-āśite tvayā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.kṛtaṁ kṛtaṁ nanviyateti sambhramādramā k: kṛtaṁ kṛtaṁ nanv-iyateti sambhramād-ramā kilopetya karaṁ rurodha te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.bhakteṣu bhaktena sa mānitastvayā purīṁ: bhakteṣu bhaktena sa mānitas-tvayā purīṁ vasann-eka-niśāṁ mahā-sukham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.yadi hyayāciṣyamadāsyadacyuto vadāmi bhā: yadi hy-ayāciṣyam-adāsyad-acyuto vadāmi bhāryāṁ kimiti vrajann-asau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.kiṁ mārgavibhraṁśa iti bhraman kṣaṇaṁ gṛ: kiṁ mārga-vibhraṁśa iti bhraman kṣaṇaṁ gṛhaṁ praviṣṭaḥ sa dadarśa vallabhām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.sakhīparītāṁ maṇihemabhūṣitāṁ bubodha ca: sakhī-parītāṁ maṇi-hema-bhūṣitāṁ bubodha ca tvat-karuṇāṁ mahādbhutām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/087_dasakam_87_kuchel.sa ratnaśālāsu vasannapi svayaṁ samunnam: sa ratna-śālāsu vasann-api svayaṁ samunnamad-bhakti-bharo'mṛtaṁ yayau|

vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.kāṅkṣantyā māturuktyā sutalabhuvi baliṁ: kāṅkṣantyā mātur-uktyā sutala-bhuvi baliṁ prāpya tenārcitas-tvam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.dhātuḥ śāpāddhiraṇyānvitakaśipubhavān śa: dhātuḥ śāpāddhiraṇyānvitakaśipubhavān śaurijān kaṁsa-bhagnān-ānīyainān pradarśya sva-padam-anayathāḥ pūrva-putrān marīceḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.śrutadeva iti śrutaṁ dvijendraṁ bahulāśv: śrutadeva iti śrutaṁ dvijendraṁ bahulāśvaṁ nṛpatiṁ ca bhakti-pūrṇam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.anyena taddinabhṛtaiśca phalaudanādyaist: anyena tad-dina-bhṛtaiś-ca phalaudanādyais-tulyaṁ praseditha dadātha ca muktim-ābhyām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.ko vā daivaṁ nirundhyāditi kila kathayan: ko vā daivaṁ nirundhyād-iti kila kathayan viśva-voḍhāpy-asoḍhāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.jiṣṇorgarvaṁ vinetuṁ tvayi manujadhiyā k: jiṣṇor-garvaṁ vinetuṁ tvayi manuja-dhiyā kuṇṭhitāṁ cāsya buddhiṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.naṣṭā aṣṭāsya putrāḥ punarapi tava tūpek: naṣṭā aṣṭāsya putrāḥ punar-api tava tūpekṣayā kaṣṭa-vādaḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.spaṣṭo jāto janānāmatha tadavasare dvāra: spaṣṭo jāto janānām-atha tad-avasare dvārakām-āpa pārthaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.rundhānaḥ sūtigehaṁ punarapi sahasā dṛṣṭ: rundhānaḥ sūti-gehaṁ punar-api sahasā dṛṣṭa-naṣṭe kumāre|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.cakrāṁśukliṣṭadṛṣṭiṁ sthitamatha vijayaṁ: cakrāṁśu-kliṣṭa-dṛṣṭiṁ sthitam-atha vijayaṁ paśya paśyeti vārāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.pāre tvaṁ prādadarśaḥ kimapi hi tamasāṁ: pāre tvaṁ prādadarśaḥ kimapi hi tamasāṁ dūra-dūraṁ padaṁ te||
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.tatrāsīnaṁ bhujaṅgādhipaśayanatale divya: tatrāsīnaṁ bhujaṅgādhipa-śayana-tale divya-bhūṣāyudhādyair-āvītaṁ pīta-celaṁ pratinava-jalada-śyāmalaṁ śrīmad-aṅgam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.tvāmeva tvaṁ parātman priyasakhasahito n: tvām-eva tvaṁ parātman priya-sakha-sahito nemitha kṣema-rūpam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.evaṁ nānāvihārairjagadabhiramayan vṛṣṇiv: evaṁ nānā-vihārair-jagad-abhiramayan vṛṣṇi-vaṁśaṁ prapuṣṇann-ījāno yajña-bhedair-atula-vihṛtibhiḥ prīṇayann-eṇa-netrāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.prāyeṇa dvāravatyāmavṛtadayi tadā nārada: prāyeṇa dvāravatyām-avṛtad-ayi tadā nāradas-tvad-rasārdras-tasmāl-lebhe kadācit-khalu sukṛta-nidhis-tvat-pitā tattva-bodham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.bhaktānāmagrayāyī sa ca khalu matimānudd: bhaktānām-agrayāyī sa ca khalu matimān-uddhavas-tvatta eva
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.prāpto vijñānasāraṁ sa kila janahitāyādh: prāpto vijñāna-sāraṁ sa kila jana-hitāyādhunā''ste badaryām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.so'yaṁ kṛṣṇāvatāro jayati tava vibho yat: so'yaṁ kṛṣṇāvatāro jayati tava vibho yatra sauhārda-bhīti-sneha-dveṣānurāga-prabhṛtibhir-atulair-aśramair-yoga-bhedaiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/088_dasakam_88_santan.sa tvaṁ viśvārtiśāntyai pavanapurapate b: sa tvaṁ viśvārti-śāntyai pavana-pura-pate bhakti-pūrtyai ca bhūyāḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.ramājāne jāne yadiha tava bhakteṣu vibha: ramā-jāne jāne yadiha tava bhakteṣu vibhavo
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.praśānteṣu kṣipraṁ na khalu bhavadīye cy: praśānteṣu kṣipraṁ na khalu bhavadīye cyuti-kathā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.tapastaptvā ghoraṁ sa khalu kupitaḥ sapt: tapas-taptvā ghoraṁ sa khalu kupitaḥ saptama-dine
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.moktāraṁ bandhamukto hariṇapatiriva prād: moktāraṁ bandha-mukto hariṇa-patir-iva prādravat so'tha rudraṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.daityād bhītyā sma devo diśi diśi valate: daityād bhītyā sma devo diśi diśi valate pṛṣṭhato datta-dṛṣṭiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.bhadraṁ te śākuneya bhramasi kimadhunā t: bhadraṁ te śākuneya bhramasi kim-adhunā tvaṁ piśācasya vācā
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.saṁdehaścenmaduktau tava kimu na karoṣya: saṁdehaś-cen-mad-uktau tava kimu na karoṣy-aṅgulīm-aṅga maulau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.bhraṁśo hyevaṁ paropāsiturapi ca gatiḥ ś: bhraṁśo hyevaṁ paropāsitur-api ca gatiḥ śūlino'pi tvam-eva||
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.hare'pi ca jihiṁsiṣau girijayā dhṛte tvā: hare'pi ca jihiṁsiṣau girijayā dhṛte tvām-agāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.sarvaṁ kṣamasva munivarya bhavet sadā me: sarvaṁ kṣamasva muni-varya bhavet sadā me
vishnu/narayaniyam/089_dasakam_89_vrikas.niścitya te ca sudṛḍhaṁ tvayi baddhabhāv: niścitya te ca sudṛḍhaṁ tvayi baddha-bhāvāḥ

vishnu/narayaniyam/090_dasakam_90_agamad.tatrāpi sāttvikatanuṁ tava viṣṇumāhurdhā: tatrāpi sāttvika-tanuṁ tava viṣṇum-āhur-dhātā tu sattva-viralo rajasaiva pūrṇaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/090_dasakam_90_agamad.sattvotkaṭatvamapi cāsti tamovikāraceṣṭā: sattvotkaṭatvam-api cāsti tamo-vikāra-ceṣṭādikaṁ ca tava śaṁkara-nāmni mūrtau||
vishnu/narayaniyam/090_dasakam_90_agamad.tvāmeva mānayati yo na hi pakṣapātī|: tvām-eva mānayati yo na hi pakṣapātī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/090_dasakam_90_agamad.mūrtitrayātigamuvāca ca mantraśāstrasyād: mūrti-trayātigam-uvāca ca mantra-śāstrasyādau kalāya-suṣamaṁ sakaleśvaraṁ tvām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/090_dasakam_90_agamad.yad brāhmakalpa iha bhāgavatadvitīyaskan: yad brāhma-kalpa iha bhāgavata-dvitīya-skandhoditaṁ vapur-anāvṛtam-īśa dhātre|

vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.śrīkṛṣṇa tvatpadopāsanamabhayatamaṁ badd: śrī-kṛṣṇa tvat-padopāsanam-abhayatamaṁ baddha-mithyārtha-dṛṣṭer-martyasyārtasya manye vyapasarati bhayaṁ yena sarvātmanaiva|
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.bhūman kāyena vācā muhurapi manasā tvadb: bhūman kāyena vācā muhur-api manasā tvad-bala-preritātmā
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.yadyat kurve samastaṁ tadiha paratare tv: yadyat kurve samastaṁ tadiha paratare tvayy-asāv-arpayāmi|
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.jātyāpīha śvapākastvayi nihitamanaḥkarma: jātyāpīha śvapākas-tvayi nihita-manaḥ-karma-vāg-indriyārtha-prāṇo viśvaṁ punīte na tu vimukha-manās-tvat-padād-vipra-varyaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.bhītirnāma dvitīyād bhavati nanu manaḥka: bhītir-nāma dvitīyād bhavati nanu manaḥ-kalpitaṁ ca dvitīyaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.māyāviddhe tu tasmin punarapi na tathā b: māyā-viddhe tu tasmin punar-api na tathā bhāti māyādhināthaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.taṁ tvāṁ bhaktyā mahatyā satatamanubhaja: taṁ tvāṁ bhaktyā mahatyā satatam-anubhajann-īśa bhītiṁ vijahyām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.bhakterutpattivṛddhī tava caraṇajuṣāṁ sa: bhakter-utpatti-vṛddhī tava caraṇa-juṣāṁ saṅgamenaiva puṁsām-āsādye puṇya-bhājāṁ śriya iva jagati śrīmatāṁ saṅgamena|
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.tatsaṅgo deva bhūyānmama khalu satataṁ t: tat-saṅgo deva bhūyān-mama khalu satataṁ tan-mukhād-unmiṣadbhis-tvan-māhātmya-prakārair-bhavati ca sudṛḍhā bhaktir-uddhūta-pāpā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.gāyan kṣemāṇi nāmānyapi tadubhayataḥ pra: gāyan kṣemāṇi nāmāny-api tad-ubhayataḥ pradrutaṁ pradrutātmā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.udyaddhāsaḥ kadācit kuhacidapi rudan kvā: udyaddhāsaḥ kadācit kuhacid-api rudan kvāpi garjan pragāyann-unmādīva pranṛtyann-ayi kuru karuṇāṁ loka-bāhyaś-careyam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.tvatsevāyāṁ hi sidhyenmama tava kṛpayā b: tvat-sevāyāṁ hi sidhyen-mama tava kṛpayā bhakti-dārḍhyaṁ virāgas-tvat-tattvasyāvabodho'pi ca bhuvana-pate yatna-bhedaṁ vinaiva||
vishnu/narayaniyam/091_dasakam_91_bhakti.tvatprema tvatkamaitrī jaḍamatiṣu kṛpā d: tvat-prema tvatkamaitrī jaḍa-matiṣu kṛpā dviṭsu bhūyād-upekṣā|

vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.mā bhūdvedairniṣiddhe kuhacidapi manaḥka: mā bhūd-vedair-niṣiddhe kuhacid-api manaḥ-karma-vācāṁ pravṛttir-durvarjaṁ ced-avāptaṁ tadapi khalu bhavaty-arpaye cit-prakāśe||
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.hṛdyāṁ sattvaikarūpāṁ dṛṣadi hṛdi mṛdi k: hṛdyāṁ sattvaika-rūpāṁ dṛṣadi hṛdi mṛdi kvāpi vā bhāvayitvā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.puṣpairgandhairnivedyairapi ca viracitai: puṣpair-gandhair-nivedyair-api ca viracitaiḥ śaktito bhakti-pūtair-nityaṁ varyāṁ saparyāṁ vidadhad-ayi vibho tvat-prasādaṁ bhajeyam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.strīśūdrāstvatkathādiśravaṇavirahitā āsa: strī-śūdrās-tvat-kathādi-śravaṇa-virahitā āsatāṁ te dayārhās-tvat-pādāsanna-yātān dvija-kula-januṣo hanta śocāmy-aśāntān|
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.pāpo'yaṁ kṛṣṇa rāmetyabhilapati nijaṁ gū: pāpo'yaṁ kṛṣṇa rāmety-abhilapati nijaṁ gūhituṁ duścaritraṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.bhrātā me vandhyaśīlo bhajati kila sadā: bhrātā me vandhya-śīlo bhajati kila sadā viṣṇum-itthaṁ budhāṁs-te
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.nindantyuccairhasanti tvayi nihitamatīṁs: nindanty-uccair-hasanti tvayi nihita-matīṁs-tādṛśaṁ mā kṛthā mām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.śvetacchāyaṁ kṛte tvāṁ munivaravapuṣaṁ p: śvetacchāyaṁ kṛte tvāṁ muni-vara-vapuṣaṁ prīṇayante tapobhis-tretāyāṁ strukstruvādyaṅkitamaruṇatanuṁ yajña-rūpaṁ yajante|
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.so'yaṁ kāleyakālo jayati muraripo yatra: so'yaṁ kāleya-kālo jayati mura-ripo yatra saṁkīrtanādyair-niryatnair-eva mārgair-akhilada nacirāt tvat-prasādaṁ bhajante|
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.jātāstretākṛtādāvapi hi kila kalau sambh: jātās-tretā-kṛtādāv-api hi kila kalau sambhavaṁ kāmayante
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.daivāt tatraiva jātān viṣayaviṣarasairmā: daivāt tatraiva jātān viṣaya-viṣa-rasair-mā vibho vañcayāsmān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.kāverīṁ tāmraparṇīmanu kila kṛtamālāṁ ca: kāverīṁ tāmraparṇīm-anu kila kṛtamālāṁ ca puṇyāṁ pratīcīm|
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.hā māmapyetadantarbhavamapi ca vibho kiṁ: hā mām-apy-etad-antarbhavam-api ca vibho kiṁcid-añcad-rasaṁ tvayy-āśā-pāśair-nibadhya bhramaya na bhagavan pūraya tvan-niṣevām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.dṛṣṭvā dharmadruhaṁ taṁ kalimapakaruṇaṁ: dṛṣṭvā dharma-druhaṁ taṁ kalim-apakaruṇaṁ prāṅ mahī-kṣit parīkṣiddhantuṁ vyākṛṣṭa-khaḍgo'pi na vinihatavān sāra-vedī guṇāṁśāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.tvatsevādyāśu sidhyedasadiha na tathā tv: tvat-sevādy-āśu sidhyed-asad-iha na tathā tvat-pare caiṣa bhīrur-yat-tu prāg-eva rogādibhir-apaharate tatra hā śikṣayainam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.gaṅgā gītā ca gāyatryapi ca tulasikā gop: gaṅgā gītā ca gāyatry-api ca tulasikā gopikā-candanaṁ tat
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.devarṣīṇāṁ pitṝṇāmapi na punarṛṇī kiṅkar: devarṣīṇāṁ pitṝṇām-api na punar-ṛṇī kiṅkaro vā sa bhūman
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.yo'sau sarvātmanā tvāṁ śaraṇamupagataḥ s: yo'sau sarvātmanā tvāṁ śaraṇam-upagataḥ sarva-kṛtyāni hitvā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/092_dasakam_92_karma_.tanme pāpotthatāpān pavanapurapate rundh: tanme pāpottha-tāpān pavana-pura-pate rundhi bhaktiṁ praṇīyāḥ||

vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.bandhusnehaṁ vijahyāṁ tava hi karuṇayā t: bandhu-snehaṁ vijahyāṁ tava hi karuṇayā tvayy-upāveśitātmā
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.sarvaṁ tyaktvā careyaṁ sakalamapi jagadv: sarvaṁ tyaktvā careyaṁ sakalam-api jagad-vīkṣya māyā-vilāsam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.nānātvād bhrāntijanyāt sati khalu guṇado: nānātvād bhrānti-janyāt sati khalu guṇa-doṣāvabodhe vidhir-vā
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.vyāsedho vā kathaṁ tau tvayi nihitamater: vyāsedho vā kathaṁ tau tvayi nihita-mater-vīta-vaiṣamya-buddheḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.kṣuttṛṣṇālopamātre satatakṛtadhiyo janta: kṣut-tṛṣṇā-lopa-mātre satata-kṛta-dhiyo jantavaḥ santy-anantās-tebhyo vijñānavattvāt puruṣa iha varas-taj-janir-durlabhaiva|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.tatrāpyātmā''tmanaḥ syāt suhṛdapi ca rip: tatrāpy-ātmā''tmanaḥ syāt suhṛd-api ca ripur-yas-tvayi nyasta-cetās-tāpocchitter-upāyaṁ smarati sa hi suhṛt svātma-vairī tato'nyaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.tvatkāruṇye pravṛtte ka iva nahi gururlo: tvat-kāruṇye pravṛtte ka iva nahi gurur-loka-vṛtte'pi bhūman
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.sarvākrāntāpi bhūmirnahi calati tataḥ sa: sarvākrāntāpi bhūmir-nahi calati tataḥ sat-kṣamāṁ śikṣayeyam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.vyāptatvaṁ cātmano me gaganaguruvaśādbhā: vyāptatvaṁ cātmano me gagana-guru-vaśād-bhātu nirlepatā ca||
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.svacchaḥ syāṁ pāvano'haṁ madhura udakava: svacchaḥ syāṁ pāvano'haṁ madhura udakavad-vahnivan-mā sma gṛhṇāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.sarvānnīno'pi doṣaṁ taruṣu tamiva māṁ sa: sarvānnīno'pi doṣaṁ taruṣu tamiva māṁ sarva-bhūteṣv-aveyām|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.puṣṭirnaṣṭiḥ kalānāṁ śaśina iva tanornāt: puṣṭir-naṣṭiḥ kalānāṁ śaśina iva tanor-nātmano'stīti vidyāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.prāptaṁ prāśnan saheya kṣudhamapi śayuva: prāptaṁ prāśnan saheya kṣudham-api śayuvat sindhuvat syām-agādhaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.mā paptaṁ yoṣidādau śikhini śalabhavad b: mā paptaṁ yoṣid-ādau śikhini śalabhavad bhṛṅgavat sāra-bhāgī
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.hartānyastaṁ hi mādhvīhara iva mṛgavanmā: hartānyas-taṁ hi mādhvī-hara iva mṛgavan-mā muhaṁ grāmya-gītaiḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.nātyāsajjeya bhojye jhaṣa iva baḍiśe piṅ: nātyāsajjeya bhojye jhaṣa iva baḍiśe piṅgalāvan-nirāśaḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.supyāṁ bhartavyayogāt kurara iva vibho s: supyāṁ bhartavyayogāt kurara iva vibho sāmiṣo'nyair-na hanyai||
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.kanyāyā ekaśeṣo valaya iva vibho varjitā: kanyāyā ekaśeṣo valaya iva vibho varjitānyonya-ghoṣaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.tvayyeva tvatkṛtaṁ tvaṁ kṣapayasi jagadi: tvayy-eva tvat-kṛtaṁ tvaṁ kṣapayasi jagad-ity-ūrṇanābhāt pratīyāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.tvaccintā tvatsvarūpaṁ kuruta iti dṛḍhaṁ: tvac-cintā tvat-svarūpaṁ kuruta iti dṛḍhaṁ śikṣaye peśakārāt|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.viḍbhasmātmā ca deho bhavati guruvaro yo: viḍ-bhasmātmā ca deho bhavati guru-varo yo vivekaṁ viraktiṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.dhatte saṁcintyamāno mama tu bahurujāpīḍ: dhatte saṁcintyamāno mama tu bahu-rujā-pīḍito'yaṁ viśeṣāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.hī hī me dehamohaṁ tyaja pavanapurādhīśa: hī hī me deha-mohaṁ tyaja pavana-purādhīśa yat-prema-hetor-gehe vitte kalatrādiṣu ca vivaśitās-tvat-padaṁ vismaranti|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.so'yaṁ vahneḥ śuno vā paramiha parataḥ s: so'yaṁ vahneḥ śuno vā param-iha parataḥ sāmprataṁ cākṣi-karṇa-tvag-jihvādyā vikarṣanty-avaśam-ata itaḥ ko'pi na tvat-padābje||
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.durvāro dehamoho yadi punaradhunā tarhi: durvāro deha-moho yadi punar-adhunā tarhi niśśeṣa-rogān
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.hṛtvā bhaktiṁ draḍhiṣṭhāṁ kuru tava pada: hṛtvā bhaktiṁ draḍhiṣṭhāṁ kuru tava pada-paṅkeruhe paṅkajākṣa|
vishnu/narayaniyam/093_dasakam_93_guru_s.kṣudre hā hanta mā mā kṣipa viṣayarase p: kṣudre hā hanta mā mā kṣipa viṣaya-rase pāhi māṁ māruteśa||

vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.śuddhā niṣkāmadharmaiḥ pravaragurugirā t: śuddhā niṣkāma-dharmaiḥ pravara-guru-girā tat-svarūpaṁ paraṁ te
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.dāhyābhāvena vidyāśikhini ca virate tvan: dāhyābhāvena vidyā-śikhini ca virate tvanmayī khalv-avasthā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.evaṁ tvatprāptito'nyo na hi khalu nikhil: evaṁ tvat-prāptito'nyo na hi khalu nikhila-kleśa-hāner-upāyo
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.mattāstvāṁ vismarantaḥ prasajati patane: mattās-tvāṁ vismarantaḥ prasajati patane yānty-anantān viṣādān||
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.tvallokādanyalokaḥ kva nu bhayarahito ya: tval-lokād-anya-lokaḥ kva nu bhaya-rahito yat parārddha-dvayānte
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.tvadbhītaḥ satyaloke'pi na sukhavasatiḥ: tvad-bhītaḥ satyaloke'pi na sukha-vasatiḥ padma-bhūḥ padmanābha|
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.taṁ me tvaṁ chindhi bandhaṁ varada kṛpaṇ: taṁ me tvaṁ chindhi bandhaṁ varada kṛpaṇa-bandho kṛpā-pūra-sindho||
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.yāthārthyāt tvanmayasyaiva hi mama na vi: yāthārthyāt tvanmayasyaiva hi mama na vibho vastuto bandha-mokṣau
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.māyāvidyātanubhyāṁ tava tu viracitau sva: māyā-vidyā-tanubhyāṁ tava tu viracitau svapna-bodhopamau tau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.baddhe jīvadvimuktiṁ gatavati ca bhidā t: baddhe jīvad-vimuktiṁ gatavati ca bhidā tāvatī tāvad-eko
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.tannāmāśuddhabuddherna ca laghu manasaḥ: tan-nāmāśuddha-buddher-na ca laghu manasaḥ śodhanaṁ bhaktito'nyat|
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.kaṣṭaṁ bandhyaśramāste cirataramiha gāṁ: kaṣṭaṁ bandhya-śramās-te cirataram-iha gāṁ bibhrate niṣprasūtim|
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.saccitsāndraṁ ca rūpaṁ tava na nigaditaṁ: saccit-sāndraṁ ca rūpaṁ tava na nigaditaṁ tāṁ na vācaṁ bhriyāsam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.yo yāvān yādṛśo vā tvamiti kimapi naivāv: yo yāvān yādṛśo vā tvam-iti kimapi naivāvagacchāmi bhūmann-evaṁ cānanya-bhāvas-tvad-anubhajanam-evādriye caidya-vairin|
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.yadyallabhyeta tattattava samupahṛtaṁ de: yad-yal-labhyeta tat-tat-tava samupahṛtaṁ deva dāso'smi te'haṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.tvadgehonmārjanādyaṁ bhavatu mama muhuḥ: tvad-gehonmārjanādyaṁ bhavatu mama muhuḥ karma nirmāyam-eva|
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.bhakteṣvanyeṣu bhūyassvapi bahu manuṣe b: bhakteṣv-anyeṣu bhūyassv-api bahu manuṣe bhaktim-eva tvam-āsāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/094_dasakam_94_tattva.tanme tvadbhaktimeva draḍhaya hara gadān: tanme tvad-bhaktim-eva draḍhaya hara gadān kṛṣṇa vātālayeśa||

vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.tatrodvṛddhena sattvena tu guṇayugalaṁ b: tatrodvṛddhena sattvena tu guṇa-yugalaṁ bhakti-bhāvaṁ gatena
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.cchittvā sattvaṁ ca hitvā punaranupahito: cchittvā sattvaṁ ca hitvā punar-anupahito vartitāhe tvam-eva||
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.sattvonmeṣāt kadācit khalu viṣayarase do: sattvonmeṣāt kadācit khalu viṣaya-rase doṣa-bodhe'pi bhūman
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.bhūyo'pyeṣu pravṛttiḥ satamasi rajasi pr: bhūyo'py-eṣu pravṛttiḥ satamasi rajasi proddhate durnivārā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.cittaṁ tāvad guṇāśca grathitamiha mithas: cittaṁ tāvad guṇāś-ca grathitam-iha mithastāni sarvāṇi roddhuṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.turye tvayyekabhaktiḥ śaraṇamiti bhavān: turye tvayy-eka-bhaktiḥ śaraṇam-iti bhavān haṁsa-rūpī nyagādīt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.santi śreyāṁsi bhūyāṁsyapi rucibhidayā k: santi śreyāṁsi bhūyāṁsy-api ruci-bhidayā karmiṇāṁ nirmitāni
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.kṣudrānandāśca sāntā bahuvidhagatayaḥ kṛ: kṣudrānandāś-ca sāntā bahuvidha-gatayaḥ kṛṣṇa tebhyo bhaveyuḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.tvaṁ cācakhyātha sakhye nanu mahitatamāṁ: tvaṁ cācakhyātha sakhye nanu mahitatamāṁ śreyasāṁ bhaktim-ekāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.tvadbhaktyānandatulyaḥ khalu viṣayajuṣāṁ: tvad-bhakty-ānanda-tulyaḥ khalu viṣaya-juṣāṁ sammadaḥ kena vā syāt||
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.tvadbhaktyā tuṣṭabuddheḥ sukhamiha carat: tvad-bhaktyā tuṣṭa-buddheḥ sukham-iha carato vicyutāśasya cāśāḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.tvadbhakto bādhyamāno'pi ca viṣayarasair: tvad-bhakto bādhyamāno'pi ca viṣaya-rasair-indriyāśānti-hetor-bhaktyaivākramyamāṇaiḥ punar-api khalu tair-durbalair-nābhijayyaḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.tvadbhaktyoghe tathaiva pradahati durita: tvad-bhakty-oghe tathaiva pradahati duritaṁ durmadaḥ kvendriyāṇām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.cittārdrībhāvamuccairvapuṣi ca pulakaṁ h: cittārdrībhāvam-uccair-vapuṣi ca pulakaṁ harṣa-bāṣpaṁ ca hitvā
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.cittaṁ śudhyet kathaṁ vā kimu bahutapasā: cittaṁ śudhyet kathaṁ vā kimu bahu-tapasā vidyayā vīta-bhakteḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.cakṣurvattattvasūkṣmaṁ bhajati na tu tat: cakṣurvat-tattva-sūkṣmaṁ bhajati na tu tathābhyastayā tarka-koṭyā||
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.dhyānaṁ te śīlayeyaṁ samatanusukhabaddhā: dhyānaṁ te śīlayeyaṁ sama-tanu-sukha-baddhāsano nāsikāgra-nyastākṣaḥ pūrakādyair-jita-pavana-pathaś-citta-padmaṁ tvavāñcam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/095_dasakam_95_bhagav.tatrālīnaṁ tu cetaḥ paramasukhacidadvait: tatrālīnaṁ tu cetaḥ parama-sukha-cid-advaita-rūpe vitanvann-anyan-no cintayeyaṁ muhur-iti samupārūḍha-yogo bhaveyam||

vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.tvaṁ hi brahmaiva sākṣāt paramurumahiman: tvaṁ hi brahmaiva sākṣāt param-uru-mahimann-akṣarāṇām-akāras-tāro mantreṣu rājñāṁ manur-asi muniṣu tvaṁ bhṛgur-nārado'pi|
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.brahmaṇyānāṁ balistvaṁ kratuṣu ca japaya: brahmaṇyānāṁ balis-tvaṁ kratuṣu ca japa-yajño'si vīreṣu pārtho
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.bhaktānāmuddhavastvaṁ balamasi balināṁ d: bhaktānām-uddhavas-tvaṁ balam-asi balināṁ dhāma tejasvināṁ tvam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.tvaṁ jīvastvaṁ pradhānaṁ yadiha bhavadṛt: tvaṁ jīvas-tvaṁ pradhānaṁ yadiha bhavad-ṛte tanna kiṁcit prapañce||
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.jñānaṁ karmāpi bhaktistritayamiha bhavat: jñānaṁ karmāpi bhaktis-tritayam-iha bhavat-prāpakaṁ tatra tāvan-nirviṇṇānām-aśeṣe viṣaya iha bhavej-jñāna-yoge'dhikāraḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.saktānāṁ karmayogastvayi hi vinihito ye: saktānāṁ karma-yogas-tvayi hi vinihito ye tu nātyanta-saktā
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.nāpyatyantaṁ viraktāstvayi ca dhṛtarasā: nāpy-atyantaṁ viraktās-tvayi ca dhṛta-rasā bhakti-yogo hy-amīṣām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.jñānaṁ tvadbhaktatāṁ vā laghu sukṛtavaśā: jñānaṁ tvad-bhaktatāṁ vā laghu sukṛta-vaśān-martya-loke labhante
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.dūrasthaḥ karmayogo'pi ca paramaphale na: dūra-sthaḥ karma-yogo'pi ca parama-phale nanv-ayaṁ bhakti-yogas-tv-āmūlād-eva hṛdyas-tvaritam-ayi bhavat-prāpako vardhatāṁ me||
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.gāḍhaṁ tvatpādabhaktiṁ śaraṇamayati yast: gāḍhaṁ tvat-pāda-bhaktiṁ śaraṇam-ayati yas-tasya muktiḥ karāgre|
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.tvaddhyāne'pīha tulyā punarasukaratā cit: tvad-dhyāne'pīha tulyā punar-asukaratā citta-cāñcalya-hetor-abhyāsād-āśu śakyaṁ tadapi vaśayituṁ tvat-kṛpā-cārutābhyām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.nirviṇṇaḥ karmamārge khalu viṣamatame tv: nirviṇṇaḥ karma-mārge khalu viṣamatame tvat-kathādau ca gāḍhaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.jātaśraddho'pi kāmānayi bhuvanapate naiv: jāta-śraddho'pi kāmān-ayi bhuvana-pate naiva śaknomi hātum|
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.tadbhūyo niścayena tvayi nihitamanā doṣa: tad-bhūyo niścayena tvayi nihita-manā doṣa-buddhyā bhajaṁs-tān
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.puṣṇīyāṁ bhaktimeva tvayi hṛdayagate maṅ: puṣṇīyāṁ bhaktim-eva tvayi hṛdaya-gate maṅkṣu naṅkṣyanti saṅgāḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.prāgevaṁ prāha vipro na khalu mama janāḥ: prāg-evaṁ prāha vipro na khalu mama janāḥ kāla-karma-grahā vā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.ceto me duḥkhahetustadiha guṇagaṇaṁ bhāv: ceto me duḥkha-hetus-tad-iha guṇa-gaṇaṁ bhāvayat sarva-kārīty-uktvā śānto gatas-tvāṁ mama ca kuru vibho tādṛśīṁ citta-śāntim||
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.gāḍhaṁ nirvidya bhūyo yuvatisukhamidaṁ k: gāḍhaṁ nirvidya bhūyo yuvati-sukham-idaṁ kṣudram-eveti gāyan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.tvadbhaktiṁ prāpya pūrṇaḥ sukhataramacar: tvad-bhaktiṁ prāpya pūrṇaḥ sukhataram-acarat tadvad-uddhūya saṅgaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/096_dasakam_96_bhagav.bhaktottaṁsaṁ kriyā māṁ pavanapurapate h: bhaktottaṁsaṁ kriyā māṁ pavana-pura-pate hanta me rundhi rogān||

vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.traiguṇyādbhinnarūpaṁ bhavati hi bhuvane: traiguṇyād-bhinna-rūpaṁ bhavati hi bhuvane hīna-madhyottamaṁ yaj-jñānaṁ śraddhā ca kartā vasatir-api sukhaṁ karma cāhāra-bhedāḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.tvatkṣetratvanniṣevādi tu yadiha punastv: tvat-kṣetra-tvan-niṣevādi tu yadiha punas-tvat-paraṁ tattu sarvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.dasyau vipre mṛgādiṣvapi ca samamatirmuc: dasyau vipre mṛgādiṣv-api ca sama-matir-mucyamānāvamāna-sparddhāsūyādi-doṣaḥ satatam-akhila-bhūteṣu sampūjaye tvām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.tvadbhāvo yāvadeṣu sphurati na viśadaṁ t: tvad-bhāvo yāvad-eṣu sphurati na viśadaṁ tāvad-evaṁ hy-upāstiṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.tvaddharmasyāsya tāvat kimapi na bhagava: tvad-dharmasyāsya tāvat kimapi na bhagavan prastutasya praṇāśas-tasmāt sarvātmanaiva pradiśa mama vibho bhakti-mārgaṁ manojñam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.taṁ cainaṁ bhaktiyogaṁ draḍhayitumayi me: taṁ cainaṁ bhakti-yogaṁ draḍhayitum-ayi me sādhyam-ārogyam-āyur-diṣṭyā tatrāpi sevyaṁ tava caraṇamaho bheṣajāyeva dugdham|
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.sevitvā vatsaraṁ tvāṁ tava bhaṭanivahair: sevitvā vatsaraṁ tvāṁ tava bhaṭa-nivahair-drāvayāmāsa mṛtyum||
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.mārkaṇḍeyaścirāyuḥ sa khalu punarapi tva: mārkaṇḍeyaś-cirāyuḥ sa khalu punar-api tvat-paraḥ puṣpabhadrā-tīre ninye tapasyann-atula-sukha-ratiḥ ṣaṭ tu manvantarāṇi|
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.yogoṣmapluṣyamāṇairna tu punaraśakat tva: yogoṣma-pluṣyamāṇair-na tu punar-aśakat tvaj-janaṁ nirjayet kaḥ||
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.tuṣṭyā toṣṭūyamānaḥ sa tu vividhavarairl: tuṣṭyā toṣṭūyamānaḥ sa tu vividha-varair-lobhito nānumene|
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.yāte tvayyāśu vātākulajaladagalattoyapūr: yāte tvayy-āśu vātākula-jalada-galat-toya-pūrṇātighūrṇat-saptārṇo-rāśi-magne jagati sa tu jale sambhraman varṣa-koṭīḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.dṛṣṭvā tvāṁ hṛṣṭaromā tvaritamupagataḥ s: dṛṣṭvā tvāṁ hṛṣṭa-romā tvaritam-upagataḥ spraṣṭukāmo munīndraḥ
vishnu/narayaniyam/097_dasakam_97_uttama.evaṁ tvatsevayaiva smararipurapi sa prīy: evaṁ tvat-sevayaiva smara-ripur-api sa prīyate yena tasmān-mūrti-trayyātmakas-tvaṁ nanu sakala-niyanteti suvyaktam-āsīt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.yasminnetadvibhātaṁ yata idamabhavadyena: yasminn-etad-vibhātaṁ yata idam-abhavad-yena cedaṁ ya etad-yo'smād-uttīrṇa-rūpaḥ khalu sakalam-idaṁ bhāsitaṁ yasya bhāsā|
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.yo vācāṁ dūradūre punarapi manasāṁ yasya: yo vācāṁ dūra-dūre punar-api manasāṁ yasya devā munīndrā
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.no vidyustattvarūpaṁ kimu punarapare kṛṣ: no vidyus-tattva-rūpaṁ kimu punar-apare kṛṣṇa tasmai namaste||
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.janmātho karma nāma sphuṭamiha guṇadoṣād: janmātho karma nāma sphuṭam-iha guṇa-doṣādikaṁ vā na yasmin
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.no tiryañcaṁ na martyaṁ na ca suramasura: no tiryañcaṁ na martyaṁ na ca suram-asuraṁ na striyaṁ no pumāṁsaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.na dravyaṁ karma jātiṁ guṇamapi sadasadv: na dravyaṁ karma jātiṁ guṇam-api sad-asad-vāpi te rūpam-āhuḥ|
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.bhūyaḥ saṁhṛtya sarvaṁ kamaṭha iva padān: bhūyaḥ saṁhṛtya sarvaṁ kamaṭha iva padāny-ātmanā kāla-śaktyā
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.sattvenāsattayā vā na ca khalu sadasattv: sattvenāsattayā vā na ca khalu sad-asattvena nirvācya-rūpā
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.bhūṣāsu svarṇavadvā jagati ghaṭaśarāvādi: bhūṣāsu svarṇavad-vā jagati ghaṭaśarāvādike mṛttikāvat-tattve saṁcintyamāne sphurati tad-adhunāpy-advitīyaṁ vapus-te|
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.svapnadraṣṭuḥ prabodhe timiralayavidhau: svapna-draṣṭuḥ prabodhe timira-laya-vidhau jīrṇa-rajjoś-ca yadvad-vidyā-lābhe tathaiva sphuṭam-api vikaset kṛṣṇa tasmai namaste||
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.yadbhītyodeti sūryo dahati ca dahano vāt: yad-bhītyodeti sūryo dahati ca dahano vāti vāyus-tathānye
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.yenaivāropitāḥ prāṅnijapadamapi te cyāvi: yenaivāropitāḥ prāṅ-nija-padam-api te cyāvitāraś-ca paścāt-tasmai viśvaṁ niyantre vayam-api bhavate kṛṣṇa kurmaḥ praṇāmam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.satyaṁ śuddhaṁ vibuddhaṁ jayati tava vap: satyaṁ śuddhaṁ vibuddhaṁ jayati tava vapur-nitya-muktaṁ nirīhaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.nirmūlaṁ nirmalaṁ tanniravadhimahimollās: nirmūlaṁ nirmalaṁ tan-niravadhi-mahimollāsi nillīnam-antar-nissaṅgānāṁ munīnāṁ nirupama-paramānanda-sāndra-prakāśam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/098_dasakam_98_brahma.cakraṁ te kālarūpaṁ vyathayatu na tu māṁ: cakraṁ te kāla-rūpaṁ vyathayatu na tu māṁ tvat-padaikāvalambaṁ

vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.viṣṇorvīryāṇi ko vā kathayatu dharaṇeḥ k: viṣṇor-vīryāṇi ko vā kathayatu dharaṇeḥ kaśca reṇūn-mimīte
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yo'sau viśvāni dhatte priyamiha paramaṁ: yo'sau viśvāni dhatte priyam-iha paramaṁ dhāma tasyābhiyāyāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.ādyāyāśeṣakartre pratinimiṣanavīnāya bha: ādyāyāśeṣa-kartre pratinimiṣa-navīnāya bhartre vibhūter-bhaktātmā viṣṇave yaḥ pradiśati havir-ādīni yajñārcanādau|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.kṛṣṇādyaṁ janma yo vā mahadiha mahato va: kṛṣṇādyaṁ janma yo vā mahad-iha mahato varṇayet so'yam-eva
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.prītaḥ pūrṇo yaśobhistvaritamabhisaret p: prītaḥ pūrṇo yaśobhis-tvaritam-abhisaret prāpyam-ante padaṁ tat||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.he stotāraḥ kavīndrāstamiha khalu yathā: he stotāraḥ kavīndrās-tam-iha khalu yathā cetayadhve tathaiva
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.he viṣṇo kīrtanādyaistava khalu mahatast: he viṣṇo kīrtanādyais-tava khalu mahatas-tattva-bodhaṁ bhajeyam||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yānīndrasyaiṣa bhṛtyaḥ priyasakha iva ca: yānīndrasyaiṣa bhṛtyaḥ priya-sakha iva ca vyātanot kṣema-kārī|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.deva śreyāṁsi vidvān pratimuhurapi te nā: deva śreyāṁsi vidvān pratimuhur-api te nāma śaṁsāmi viṣṇo|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.taṁ tvāṁ saṁstaumi nānāvidhanutivacanair: taṁ tvāṁ saṁstaumi nānā-vidha-nuti-vacanair-asya loka-trayasyāpy-ūrdhvaṁ vibhrājamāne viracita-vasatiṁ tatra vaikuṇṭha-loke||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.āpaḥ sṛṣṭyādijanyāḥ prathamamayi vibho g: āpaḥ sṛṣṭyādi-janyāḥ prathamam-ayi vibho garbha-deśe dadhus-tvāṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yatra tvayyeva jīvā jalaśayana hare saṅg: yatra tvayy-eva jīvā jala-śayana hare saṅgatā aikyam-āpan|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.tasyājasya prabho te vinihitamabhavat pa: tasyājasya prabho te vinihitam-abhavat padmam-ekaṁ hi nābhau
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.he lokā viṣṇuretadbhuvanamajanayat tanna: he lokā viṣṇur-etad-bhuvanam-ajanayat tanna jānītha yūyaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yuṣmākaṁ hyantarasthaṁ kimapi tadaparaṁ: yuṣmākaṁ hy-antara-sthaṁ kimapi tad-aparaṁ vidyate viṣṇu-rūpam|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.mūrddhāmakṣṇāṁ padānāṁ vahasi khalu saha: mūrddhām-akṣṇāṁ padānāṁ vahasi khalu sahasrāṇi sampūrya viśvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ ca sarvaṁ parapuruṣa bhav: bhūtaṁ bhavyaṁ ca sarvaṁ para-puruṣa bhavān kiṁ ca dehendriyādiṣv-āviṣṭo hy-udgatatvād-amṛta-sukha-rasaṁ cānubhuṅkṣe tvam-eva||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.yattu trailokyarūpaṁ dadhadapi ca tato n: yattu trailokya-rūpaṁ dadhad-api ca tato nirgatānanta śuddha-jñānātmā vartase tvaṁ tava khalu mahimā so'pi tāvān kim-anyat|
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.bhūyiṣṭhaṁ sāndramodātmakamupari tato bh: bhūyiṣṭhaṁ sāndra-modātmakam-upari tato bhāti tasmai namaste||
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.avyaktaṁ te svarūpaṁ duradhigamatamaṁ ta: avyaktaṁ te svarūpaṁ duradhigamatamaṁ tattu śuddhaika-sattvaṁ
vishnu/narayaniyam/099_dasakam_99_bhagav.mūrtiṁ te saṁśraye'haṁ pavanapurapate pā: mūrtiṁ te saṁśraye'haṁ pavana-pura-pate pāhi māṁ kṛṣṇa rogāt||

vishnu/narayaniyam/100_dasakam_100_kesha.nānāvarṇaprasūnāvalikisalayinīṁ vanyamāl: nānā-varṇa-prasūnāvali-kisalayinīṁ vanya-mālāṁ vilolal-lolambāṁ lambamānām-urasi tava tathā bhāvaye ratna-mālām||
vishnu/narayaniyam/100_dasakam_100_kesha.ūrū cārū tavorū ghanamasṛṇarucau cittaco: ūrū cārū tavorū ghana-masṛṇa-rucau citta-corau ramāyā
vishnu/narayaniyam/100_dasakam_100_kesha.ānamrāṇāṁ purastānnyasanadhṛtasamastārth: ānamrāṇāṁ purastān-nyasana-dhṛta-samastārtha-pālī-samudgacchāyaṁ jānu-dvayaṁ ca krama-pṛthula-manojñe ca jaṅghe niṣeve||
vishnu/narayaniyam/100_dasakam_100_kesha.nityaṁ cittasthitaṁ me pavanapurapate kṛ: nityaṁ citta-sthitaṁ me pavana-pura-pate kṛṣṇa kāruṇya-sindho
